name: OverflowResidueRH.isClosed_gammaPoleSet
statement: theorem isClosed_gammaPoleSet : IsClosed gammaPoleSet
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_eq : gammaPoleSet = Neg.neg ⁻¹' Set.range ((↑) : ℕ → ℂ) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
      refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
      simp [hn]
    · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
      refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
      have : -((n : ℂ)) = z := by rw [hn]; ring
      exact this.symm
  rw [h_eq]
  refine IsClosed.preimage continuous_neg ?_
  
  have h_re_im :
      Set.range ((↑) : ℕ → ℂ)
        = (Complex.im ⁻¹' ({0} : Set ℝ)) ∩
          (Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.range ((↑) : ℕ → ℝ)) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨?_, n, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · simp
    · rintro ⟨him, n, hre⟩
      refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
      apply Complex.ext
      · 
        have h3 : ((n : ℂ)).re = (n : ℝ) := by simp
        exact h3.trans hre
      · 
        have h4 : ((n : ℂ)).im = 0 := by simp
        exact h4.trans him.symm
  rw [h_re_im]
  refine IsClosed.inter ?_ ?_
  · exact isClosed_singleton.preimage Complex.continuous_im
  · exact Nat.isClosedEmbedding_coe_real.isClosed_range.preimage
      Complex.continuous_re

name: OverflowResidueRH.CompletedXiRawEntireXiLocalEqualitySource.of_rawCorrectness
statement:
theorem CompletedXiRawEntireXiLocalEqualitySource.of_rawCorrectness
    (H : RawCompletedXiCorrectness) :
    CompletedXiRawEntireXiLocalEqualitySource
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro s hs
  have h_s_ne_one : s ≠ 1 :=
    fun h => hs (h ▸ completedXiFunction_one_eq_zero)
  have h_polePullback : s / 2 ∉ gammaPoleSet :=
    H.nonzero_excludes_gammaPole.not_gamma_pole s hs
  have hcont : Continuous (fun w : ℂ => w / 2) :=
    continuous_id.div_const _
  have hOpen1 : IsOpen ((fun w : ℂ => w / 2) ⁻¹' gammaPoleSet)ᶜ :=
    (isClosed_gammaPoleSet.preimage hcont).isOpen_compl
  have hOpen2 : IsOpen (({(1 : ℂ)} : Set ℂ))ᶜ := isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hU_open :
      IsOpen
        (((fun w : ℂ => w / 2) ⁻¹' gammaPoleSet)ᶜ ∩
          ({(1 : ℂ)} : Set ℂ)ᶜ) :=
    hOpen1.inter hOpen2
  have hsU :
      s ∈ ((fun w : ℂ => w / 2) ⁻¹' gammaPoleSet)ᶜ ∩
            ({(1 : ℂ)} : Set ℂ)ᶜ :=
    ⟨h_polePullback, h_s_ne_one⟩
  filter_upwards [hU_open.mem_nhds hsU] with w hwU
  exact H.offPole_eq w hwU.2 hwU.1

name: OverflowResidueRH.CompletedXiRawEntireXiOpenNeighborhoodEqualitySource.of_rawCorrectness
statement:
theorem CompletedXiRawEntireXiOpenNeighborhoodEqualitySource.of_rawCorrectness
    (H : RawCompletedXiCorrectness) :

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro s hs
  have h_s_ne_one : s ≠ 1 :=
    fun h => hs (h ▸ completedXiFunction_one_eq_zero)
  have h_polePullback : s / 2 ∉ gammaPoleSet :=
    H.nonzero_excludes_gammaPole.not_gamma_pole s hs
  let U : Set ℂ :=
    ((fun w : ℂ => w / 2) ⁻¹' gammaPoleSet)ᶜ ∩
      ({(1 : ℂ)} : Set ℂ)ᶜ
  have hcont : Continuous (fun w : ℂ => w / 2) :=
    continuous_id.div_const _
  have hOpen1 : IsOpen ((fun w : ℂ => w / 2) ⁻¹' gammaPoleSet)ᶜ :=
    (isClosed_gammaPoleSet.preimage hcont).isOpen_compl
  have hOpen2 : IsOpen (({(1 : ℂ)} : Set ℂ))ᶜ := isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hU_open : IsOpen U :=
    hOpen1.inter hOpen2
  have hsU : s ∈ U :=
    ⟨h_polePullback, h_s_ne_one⟩
  refine ⟨U, hU_open, hsU, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  exact H.offPole_eq w hw.2 hw.1

statement:

    (HzetaRaw : CompletedRiemannZetaRawOffPoleFormula)
    {s : ℂ} (hsPole : s / 2 ∉ gammaPoleSet) :
    rawCompletedXiFormula s
      = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * s * (s - 1) * completedRiemannZeta s

  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.CompletedXiRawEntireXiOffPolePointwiseFormula.of_completedZetaIdentities
statement:
theorem CompletedXiRawEntireXiOffPolePointwiseFormula.of_completedZetaIdentities
    (HzetaRaw : CompletedRiemannZetaRawOffPoleFormula)
    (Hzeta0 : CompletedRiemannZetaZeroCorrectionFormula)
    (Hxi : EntireRiemannXiFormulaSource) :
    CompletedXiRawEntireXiOffPolePointwiseFormula
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro s hs1 hsPole
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    intro hs
    apply hsPole
    rw [hs]
    exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  calc completedXiFunction s
      = rawCompletedXiFormula s := completedXiFunction_eq_rawFormula s
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * s * (s - 1) * completedRiemannZeta s :=
        rawCompletedXiFormula_eq_completedZeta HzetaRaw hsPole
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * s * (s - 1)
          * (completedRiemannZeta₀ s - 1 / s - 1 / (1 - s)) := by
        rw [Hzeta0.correction s]
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * s * (s - 1) * completedRiemannZeta₀ s + 1 / 2 :=
        xi_completedZeta_correction_algebra hs0 hs1
    _ = entireRiemannXi s := (Hxi.formula s).symm

    {s : ℂ} (hsPole : s / 2 ∉ gammaPoleSet) :
    Gammaℝ s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hG
  rcases Complex.Gammaℝ_eq_zero_iff.mp hG with ⟨n, hn⟩
  apply hsPole

name: OverflowResidueRH.GammaReal_eq_exp_gamma
statement:
theorem GammaReal_eq_exp_gamma (s : ℂ) :
    Gammaℝ s =
      Complex.exp (-(s / 2) * (Real.log Real.pi : ℂ))
        * Complex.Gamma (s / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Gammaℝ_def]
  congr 1
  rw [Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero]
  · congr 1
    rw [Complex.ofReal_log Real.pi_pos.le]
    ring
  · exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero

name: OverflowResidueRH.completedRiemannZetaRawOffPoleFormula
statement:
theorem completedRiemannZetaRawOffPoleFormula :
    CompletedRiemannZetaRawOffPoleFormula
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro s hsPole
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_half_not_gammaPole hsPole
  have hG : Gammaℝ s ≠ 0 := GammaReal_ne_zero_of_half_not_gammaPole hsPole
  calc
    completedRiemannZeta s
        = Gammaℝ s * riemannZeta s := by
            have hz := riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero (s := s) hs0
            rw [hz]
            field_simp [hG]
    _ = Complex.exp (-(s / 2) * (Real.log Real.pi : ℂ))
          * Complex.Gamma (s / 2) * riemannZeta s := by
            rw [GammaReal_eq_exp_gamma]

name: OverflowResidueRH.xi_completedZeta_correction_algebra
statement:
theorem xi_completedZeta_correction_algebra
    {s : ℂ} (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hs1 : s ≠ 1) :
    (1 / 2 : ℂ) * s * (s - 1)
        * (completedRiemannZeta₀ s - 1 / s - 1 / (1 - s))
      = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * s * (s - 1) * completedRiemannZeta₀ s + 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1s : (1 : ℂ) - s ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hs1)
  field_simp
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.integrableOn_Ioi_one_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_of_le_nat
statement:
theorem integrableOn_Ioi_one_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_of_le_nat
    {q p : ℝ} (n : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : q ≤ n) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ q * exp (-(p * x))) (Ioi 1)
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x ↦ x ^ (n : ℝ) * exp (-(p * x))
  have hg_int : IntegrableOn g (Ioi 0) := by
    simpa [g] using
      (integrableOn_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow
        (s := (n : ℝ)) (p := (1 : ℝ)) (b := p)
        (by
          have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
          linarith)
        (by norm_num) hp)
  refine (hg_int.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi zero_lt_one.le)).mono_nonneg ?_ ?_ ?_
  · fun_prop
  · exact (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi).mono fun x hx ↦
      mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hx.le) _)
        (Real.exp_nonneg _)
  · exact (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi).mono fun x hx ↦ by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx.le hq) (Real.exp_nonneg _)

name: OverflowResidueRH.integral_Ioi_one_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_le_factorial
statement:
theorem integral_Ioi_one_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_le_factorial
    {q p : ℝ} (n : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : q ≤ n) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 1, x ^ q * exp (-(p * x))) ≤
      (1 / p) ^ (n + 1 : ℝ) * n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x ↦ x ^ (n : ℝ) * exp (-(p * x))
  have hg_int : IntegrableOn g (Ioi 0) := by
    simpa [g] using
      (integrableOn_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow
        (s := (n : ℝ)) (p := (1 : ℝ)) (b := p)
        (by
          have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
          linarith)
        (by norm_num) hp)
  have hpoint : ∀ x ∈ Ioi (1 : ℝ),
      x ^ q * exp (-(p * x)) ≤ g x := by
    intro x hx
    dsimp [g]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx.le hq) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
  have hleft_int :
      IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ q * exp (-(p * x))) (Ioi 1) :=
    integrableOn_Ioi_one_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_of_le_nat n hp hq
  calc
    (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 1, x ^ q * exp (-(p * x)))
        ≤ ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 1, g x :=
          setIntegral_mono_on hleft_int
            (hg_int.mono_set (Ioi_subset_Ioi zero_lt_one.le)) measurableSet_Ioi hpoint
    _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, g x := by
      apply setIntegral_mono_set hg_int
      · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with x hx
        dsimp [g]
        exact mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le _) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
      · exact (Ioi_subset_Ioi zero_lt_one.le).eventuallyLE
    _ = (1 / p) ^ (n + 1 : ℝ) * n.factorial := by
      dsimp [g]
      simpa [Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial] using
        (integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi (a := (n : ℝ) + 1) (r := p)
          (by
            have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
            linarith)
          hp)

name: OverflowResidueRH.integral_Ioi_zero_inv_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_eq_factorial
statement:
theorem integral_Ioi_zero_inv_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_eq_factorial
    (n : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0,
        x ^ (-(n : ℝ) - 2) * exp (-(p / x))) =
      (1 / p) ^ (n + 1 : ℝ) * n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun y ↦ y ^ (n : ℝ) * exp (-(p * y))
  have hsub := integral_comp_rpow_Ioi g (p := (-1 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
  have hleft :
      (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0,
          ((|(-1 : ℝ)| * x ^ ((-1 : ℝ) - 1)) • g (x ^ (-1 : ℝ)))) =
        ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0,
          x ^ (-(n : ℝ) - 2) * exp (-(p / x)) := by
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : 0 < x := hx
    dsimp [g]
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul hx0.le]
    rw [abs_neg, abs_one, one_mul, ← mul_assoc,
      ← Real.rpow_add hx0, Real.rpow_neg_one]
    congr 2
    · ring
  rw [← hleft, hsub]
  simpa [g, Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial] using
    (integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi (a := (n : ℝ) + 1) (r := p)
      (by
        have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
        linarith)
      hp)

name: OverflowResidueRH.integrableOn_Ioi_zero_inv_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul
statement:
theorem integrableOn_Ioi_zero_inv_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul
    (n : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ ↦
      x ^ (-(n : ℝ) - 2) * exp (-(p / x))) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun y ↦ y ^ (n : ℝ) * exp (-(p * y))
  have hg_int : IntegrableOn g (Ioi 0) := by
    simpa [g] using
      (integrableOn_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow
        (s := (n : ℝ)) (p := (1 : ℝ)) (b := p)
        (by
          have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
          linarith)
        (by norm_num) hp)
  have htrans : IntegrableOn
      (fun x : ℝ ↦ (|(-1 : ℝ)| * x ^ ((-1 : ℝ) - 1)) •
        g (x ^ (-1 : ℝ))) (Ioi 0) :=
    (integrableOn_Ioi_comp_rpow_iff g (p := (-1 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)).mpr hg_int
  refine htrans.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ioi
  intro x hx
  have hx0 : 0 < x := hx
  dsimp [g]
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul hx0.le]
  rw [abs_neg, abs_one, one_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    ← Real.rpow_add hx0, Real.rpow_neg_one]
  congr 2
  · ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.MellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.norm_mellin_le_factorial
statement:
theorem MellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.norm_mellin_le_factorial
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} (H : MellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay f)
    (s : ℂ) (n : ℕ)
    (hupper : s.re - 1 ≤ n)
    (hlower : -(n : ℝ) - 2 ≤ s.re - 1 - H.k)
    (hconv : MellinConvergent f s) :
    ‖mellin f s‖ ≤
      2 * H.A * ((1 / H.p) ^ (n + 1 : ℝ) * n.factorial)
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun x ↦ (x : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • f x
  let E : ℝ := (1 / H.p) ^ (n + 1 : ℝ) * n.factorial
  have hF_int : IntegrableOn F (Ioi 0) := by
    simpa only [F, MellinConvergent] using hconv
  have hFnorm_full : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ ‖F x‖) (Ioi 0) := hF_int.norm
  have hFnorm (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
      ‖F x‖ = x ^ (s.re - 1) * ‖f x‖ := by
    dsimp [F]
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos hx]
    simp
  have hupper_int :
      ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 1, ‖F x‖ ≤ H.A * E := by
    have hmajor_int : IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ ↦ H.A * (x ^ (s.re - 1) * exp (-(H.p * x))))
        (Ioi 1) :=
      (integrableOn_Ioi_one_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_of_le_nat
        n H.p_pos hupper).const_mul H.A
    have hFnorm_int : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ ‖F x‖) (Ioi 1) :=
      IntegrableOn.mono_set hFnorm_full (Ioi_subset_Ioi zero_lt_one.le)
    calc
      ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 1, ‖F x‖ ≤
          ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 1,
            H.A * (x ^ (s.re - 1) * exp (-(H.p * x))) := by
        apply setIntegral_mono_on hFnorm_int hmajor_int measurableSet_Ioi
        intro x hx
        rw [hFnorm x (zero_lt_one.trans hx)]
        calc
          x ^ (s.re - 1) * ‖f x‖ ≤
              x ^ (s.re - 1) * (H.A * exp (-(H.p * x))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (H.upper x hx.le)
              (Real.rpow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hx.le) _)
          _ = H.A * (x ^ (s.re - 1) * exp (-(H.p * x))) := by ring
      _ = H.A *
          (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 1,
            x ^ (s.re - 1) * exp (-(H.p * x))) := by
        rw [← integral_const_mul]
      _ ≤ H.A * E := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (integral_Ioi_one_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_le_factorial
            n H.p_pos hupper) H.A_nonneg
  have hlower_int :
      ∫ x : ℝ in Ioc 0 1, ‖F x‖ ≤ H.A * E := by
    have hmajor_full : IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ ↦ H.A *
          (x ^ (-(n : ℝ) - 2) * exp (-(H.p / x)))) (Ioi 0) :=
      (integrableOn_Ioi_zero_inv_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul n H.p_pos).const_mul H.A
    have hmajor_int : IntegrableOn
        (fun x : ℝ ↦ H.A *
          (x ^ (-(n : ℝ) - 2) * exp (-(H.p / x)))) (Ioc 0 1) :=
      IntegrableOn.mono_set hmajor_full Ioc_subset_Ioi_self
    have hFnorm_int : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ ‖F x‖) (Ioc 0 1) :=
      IntegrableOn.mono_set hFnorm_full Ioc_subset_Ioi_self
    calc
      ∫ x : ℝ in Ioc 0 1, ‖F x‖ ≤
          ∫ x : ℝ in Ioc 0 1,
            H.A * (x ^ (-(n : ℝ) - 2) * exp (-(H.p / x))) := by
        apply setIntegral_mono_on hFnorm_int hmajor_int measurableSet_Ioc
        intro x hx
        rw [hFnorm x hx.1]
        calc
          x ^ (s.re - 1) * ‖f x‖ ≤
              x ^ (s.re - 1) *
                (H.A * x ^ (-H.k) * exp (-(H.p / x))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (H.lower x hx.1 hx.2)
              (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.1.le _)
          _ = H.A *
              (x ^ (s.re - 1 - H.k) * exp (-(H.p / x))) := by
            calc
              x ^ (s.re - 1) *
                    (H.A * x ^ (-H.k) * exp (-(H.p / x))) =
                  H.A * ((x ^ (s.re - 1) * x ^ (-H.k)) *
                    exp (-(H.p / x))) := by ring
              _ = H.A *
                    (x ^ (s.re - 1 - H.k) * exp (-(H.p / x))) := by
                rw [← Real.rpow_add hx.1]
                ring_nf
          _ ≤ H.A *
              (x ^ (-(n : ℝ) - 2) * exp (-(H.p / x))) := by
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hx.1 hx.2 hlower)
                (Real.exp_nonneg _)) H.A_nonneg
      _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0,
            H.A * (x ^ (-(n : ℝ) - 2) * exp (-(H.p / x))) := by
        apply setIntegral_mono_set hmajor_full
        · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with x hx
          exact mul_nonneg H.A_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le _) (Real.exp_nonneg _))
        · exact Ioc_subset_Ioi_self.eventuallyLE
      _ = H.A * E := by
        rw [integral_const_mul]
        dsimp [E]
        rw [integral_Ioi_zero_inv_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_eq_factorial n H.p_pos]
  calc
    ‖mellin f s‖ = ‖∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, F x‖ := rfl
    _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 0, ‖F x‖ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ = (∫ x : ℝ in Ioc 0 1, ‖F x‖) +
        ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi 1, ‖F x‖ := by
      rw [← Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi zero_le_one,
        setIntegral_union Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi]
      · exact IntegrableOn.mono_set hFnorm_full Ioc_subset_Ioi_self
      · exact IntegrableOn.mono_set hFnorm_full (Ioi_subset_Ioi zero_lt_one.le)
    _ ≤ H.A * E + H.A * E := add_le_add hlower_int hupper_int
    _ = 2 * H.A * E := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticUpperRealGrowthAtInfinity.toGlobal
statement:
theorem HasSubquadraticUpperRealGrowthAtInfinity.toGlobal
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hupper : HasSubquadraticUpperRealGrowthAtInfinity f)
    (hf : Continuous f) : HasSubquadraticUpperRealGrowth f
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hbound⟩ := hupper ε hε
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) R).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hf.continuousOn
  let C : ℝ := max 0 C₀
  refine ⟨C, le_max_left _ _, fun z ↦ ?_⟩
  by_cases hz : R ≤ ‖z‖
  · exact (hbound z hz).trans <| by
      have hC : 0 ≤ C := le_max_left _ _
      linarith
  · have hzball : z ∈ closedBall (0 : ℂ) R := by
      simp only [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      exact le_of_not_ge hz
    have hre : (f z).re ≤ ‖f z‖ := Complex.re_le_norm _
    have hnorm : ‖f z‖ ≤ C :=
      (hC₀ z hzball).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    have hquad : 0 ≤ ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hε.le (sq_nonneg _)
    exact hre.trans <| hnorm.trans <| by linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.hasSubquadraticNormGrowth_of_upperRealGrowth
statement:
theorem hasSubquadraticNormGrowth_of_upperRealGrowth
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hupper : HasSubquadraticUpperRealGrowth f) :
    HasSubquadraticNormGrowth f
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := hupper (ε / 16) (by positivity)
  let K : ℝ := 2 * C + 2 + 3 * ‖f 0‖
  let R₀ : ℝ := max 1 (2 * K / ε)
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by
    dsimp [K]
    positivity
  refine ⟨R₀, le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hz_one : 1 ≤ ‖z‖ :=
    le_trans (le_max_left (1 : ℝ) (2 * K / ε)) hz
  have hz_pos : 0 < ‖z‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hz_one
  let R : ℝ := 2 * ‖z‖
  let M : ℝ := C + (ε / 16) * R ^ 2 + 1
  have hR : 0 < R := by
    dsimp [R]
    positivity
  have hM : 0 < M := by
    dsimp [M]
    positivity
  have hmaps : MapsTo f (ball 0 R) {w : ℂ | w.re ≤ M} := by
    intro w hw
    have hwR : ‖w‖ < R := by
      simpa only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hw
    have hsq : ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]
    exact (hbound w).trans <| by
      dsimp [M]
      nlinarith
  have hzball : z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) R := by
    simp only [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    dsimp [R]
    linarith
  have hbc := Complex.borelCaratheodory hM hf.differentiableOn
    hmaps hR hzball
  have hbc' : ‖f z‖ ≤ 2 * M + 3 * ‖f 0‖ := by
    calc
      ‖f z‖ ≤
          2 * M * ‖z‖ / (R - ‖z‖) +
            ‖f 0‖ * (R + ‖z‖) / (R - ‖z‖) := hbc
      _ = 2 * M + 3 * ‖f 0‖ := by
        dsimp [R]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hz_pos]
        ring
  have hzK : 2 * K / ε ≤ ‖z‖ :=
    le_trans (le_max_right (1 : ℝ) (2 * K / ε)) hz
  have hmul : 2 * K ≤ ‖z‖ * ε := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hzK
  have hKlinear : K ≤ (ε / 2) * ‖z‖ := by
    nlinarith
  have hnorm_sq : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]
  have hKsq : K ≤ (ε / 2) * ‖z‖ ^ 2 :=
    hKlinear.trans <|
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm_sq (by positivity)
  calc
    ‖f z‖ ≤ 2 * M + 3 * ‖f 0‖ := hbc'
    _ = (ε / 2) * ‖z‖ ^ 2 + K := by
      dsimp [M, R, K]
      ring
    _ ≤ (ε / 2) * ‖z‖ ^ 2 + (ε / 2) * ‖z‖ ^ 2 :=
      add_le_add (le_refl _) hKsq
    _ = ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasLinearExponentialNormGrowth.toSubquadraticExponentialNormGrowth
statement:
theorem HasLinearExponentialNormGrowth.toSubquadraticExponentialNormGrowth
    {q : ℂ → ℂ} (hq : HasLinearExponentialNormGrowth q) :
    HasSubquadraticExponentialNormGrowth q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hbound⟩ := hq
  intro ε hε
  let D : ℝ := B ^ 2 / (4 * ε)
  refine ⟨A * Real.exp D, mul_pos hA (Real.exp_pos D), fun z ↦ ?_⟩
  have hexponent : B * ‖z‖ ≤ D + ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [D]
    have hsquare : 0 ≤ (B - 2 * ε * ‖z‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have haux : B * ‖z‖ - ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 / (4 * ε) := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ (show 0 < 4 * ε by positivity)).mpr
      nlinarith
    linarith
  calc
    ‖q z‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (B * ‖z‖) := hbound z
    _ ≤ A * Real.exp (D + ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2) := by
      gcongr
    _ = (A * Real.exp D) * Real.exp (ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2) := by
      rw [Real.exp_add]
      ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticExponentialNormGrowth.toLogNormGrowth
statement:
theorem HasSubquadraticExponentialNormGrowth.toLogNormGrowth
    {q : ℂ → ℂ} (hq : HasSubquadraticExponentialNormGrowth q)
    (hq_ne : ∀ z : ℂ, q z ≠ 0) :
    HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowth q
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hbound⟩ := hq ε hε
  let C : ℝ := max 0 (Real.log A)
  refine ⟨C, le_max_left _ _, fun z ↦ ?_⟩
  have hqnorm : 0 < ‖q z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hq_ne z)
  calc
    Real.log ‖q z‖ ≤
        Real.log (A * Real.exp (ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2)) :=
      Real.log_le_log hqnorm (hbound z)
    _ = Real.log A + ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [Real.log_mul hA.ne' (Real.exp_ne_zero _), Real.log_exp]
    _ ≤ C + ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      exact add_le_add
        (show Real.log A ≤ C from le_max_right (0 : ℝ) (Real.log A))
        (le_refl _)

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowth.upperRealGrowth_of_exp
statement:
theorem HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowth.upperRealGrowth_of_exp
    {q h : ℂ → ℂ} (hq : HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowth q)
    (hexp : ∀ z : ℂ, Complex.exp (h z) = q z) :
    HasSubquadraticUpperRealGrowth h
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := hq ε hε
  refine ⟨C, hC, fun z ↦ ?_⟩
  calc
    (h z).re = Real.log ‖q z‖ := by
      rw [← hexp z, Complex.norm_exp, Real.log_exp]
    _ ≤ C + ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := hbound z

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity.upperRealGrowth_of_exp
statement:
theorem HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity.upperRealGrowth_of_exp
    {q h : ℂ → ℂ} (hq : HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity q)
    (hexp : ∀ z : ℂ, Complex.exp (h z) = q z) :
    HasSubquadraticUpperRealGrowthAtInfinity h
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hbound⟩ := hq ε hε
  refine ⟨R, hR, fun z hz ↦ ?_⟩
  calc
    (h z).re = Real.log ‖q z‖ := by
      rw [← hexp z, Complex.norm_exp, Real.log_exp]
    _ ≤ ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := hbound z hz

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity.toGlobal_of_exp
statement:
theorem HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity.toGlobal_of_exp
    {q h : ℂ → ℂ} (hq : HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity q)
    (hh : Continuous h)
    (hexp : ∀ z : ℂ, Complex.exp (h z) = q z) :
    HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowth q
proof:
:= by
  have hupper : HasSubquadraticUpperRealGrowth h :=
    (hq.upperRealGrowth_of_exp hexp).toGlobal hh
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := hupper ε hε
  refine ⟨C, hC, fun z ↦ ?_⟩
  calc
    Real.log ‖q z‖ = (h z).re := by
      rw [← hexp z, Complex.norm_exp, Real.log_exp]
    _ ≤ C + ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := hbound z

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowth.log_hasSubquadraticNormGrowth
statement:
theorem HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowth.log_hasSubquadraticNormGrowth
    {q h : ℂ → ℂ} (hq : HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowth q)
    (hh : Differentiable ℂ h)
    (hexp : ∀ z : ℂ, Complex.exp (h z) = q z) :
    HasSubquadraticNormGrowth h
proof:
:=
  hasSubquadraticNormGrowth_of_upperRealGrowth hh
    (hq.upperRealGrowth_of_exp hexp)

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity.log_hasSubquadraticNormGrowth
statement:
theorem
    HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity.log_hasSubquadraticNormGrowth
    {q h : ℂ → ℂ} (hq : HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity q)
    (hh : Differentiable ℂ h)

    HasSubquadraticNormGrowth h
proof:

  hasSubquadraticNormGrowth_of_upperRealGrowth hh <|
    (hq.upperRealGrowth_of_exp hexp).toGlobal hh.continuous

name: OverflowResidueRH.eq_exp_affine_of_subquadraticLogNormGrowth
statement:
theorem eq_exp_affine_of_subquadraticLogNormGrowth
    {q h : ℂ → ℂ} (hq : HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowth q)
    (hh : Differentiable ℂ h)
    (hexp : ∀ z : ℂ, Complex.exp (h z) = q z) :
    ∃ a b : ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, q z = Complex.exp (a + b * z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ :=
    differentiable_eq_affine_of_subquadraticNormGrowth hh
      (hq.log_hasSubquadraticNormGrowth hh hexp)

statement:
theorem eq_exp_affine_of_subquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity

    differentiable_eq_affine_of_subquadraticNormGrowth hh
      (hq.log_hasSubquadraticNormGrowth hh hexp)
  exact ⟨a, b, fun z ↦ by rw [← hexp z, hab z]⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.complex_star_im
statement: theorem complex_star_im (ρ : ℂ) : (star ρ).im = -ρ.im
proof:
:= by
  change (starRingEnd ℂ ρ).im = -ρ.im
  exact Complex.conj_im ρ

name: OverflowResidueRH.StrictAntiHerglotzUHP.antiHerglotz
statement:
theorem StrictAntiHerglotzUHP.antiHerglotz
    {R : ℂ → ℂ} (hR : StrictAntiHerglotzUHP R) :
    AntiHerglotzUHP R
proof:
:=
  fun z hz => (hR z hz).le

name: OverflowResidueRH.antiHerglotz_iff_no_positiveUpperEscape
statement:
theorem antiHerglotz_iff_no_positiveUpperEscape (R : ℂ → ℂ) :
    AntiHerglotzUHP R ↔ ¬ PositiveUpperImaginaryEscape R
proof:
:= by
  unfold AntiHerglotzUHP PositiveUpperImaginaryEscape
  constructor
  · intro hanti ⟨z, hzim, hRim⟩
    exact absurd (hanti z hzim) (not_le.mpr hRim)
  · intro hno z hzim
    by_contra hpos
    push Not at hpos
    exact hno ⟨z, hzim, hpos⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.positive_escape_kills_antiHerglotz
statement:
theorem positive_escape_kills_antiHerglotz
    {R : ℂ → ℂ} (h : PositiveUpperImaginaryEscape R) :
    ¬ AntiHerglotzUHP R
proof:
:=
  fun hanti => (antiHerglotz_iff_no_positiveUpperEscape R).mp hanti h

name: OverflowResidueRH.complex_real_root_residue_imag_nonpos
statement:
theorem complex_real_root_residue_imag_nonpos
    (z : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (r : ℂ))).im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hne : z - (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
    have him : z.im = ((r : ℂ)).im := congr_arg Complex.im h
    rw [Complex.ofReal_im] at him
    linarith
  rw [one_div, Complex.inv_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero]
  have hns : 0 < Complex.normSq (z - (r : ℂ)) := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hne
  exact le_of_lt (div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) hns)

name: OverflowResidueRH.complex_real_root_residue_imag_neg
statement:
theorem complex_real_root_residue_imag_neg
    (z : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (r : ℂ))).im < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hne : z - (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
    have him : z.im = ((r : ℂ)).im := congrArg Complex.im h
    rw [Complex.ofReal_im] at him
    linarith
  rw [one_div, Complex.inv_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, sub_zero]
  have hns : 0 < Complex.normSq (z - (r : ℂ)) := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hne
  exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) hns

name: OverflowResidueRH.real_residue_cloud_antiHerglotz_list
statement:
theorem real_residue_cloud_antiHerglotz_list (rs : List ℝ) :
    AntiHerglotzUHP
      (fun z : ℂ => (rs.map (fun r : ℝ => (1 : ℂ) / (z - (r : ℂ)))).sum)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  change ((rs.map (fun r : ℝ => (1 : ℂ) / (z - (r : ℂ)))).sum).im ≤ 0
  induction rs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons r rs ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Complex.add_im]
    have h1 : ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (r : ℂ))).im ≤ 0 :=
      complex_real_root_residue_imag_nonpos z r hz
    linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.real_weighted_residue_cloud_antiHerglotz_list
statement:
theorem real_weighted_residue_cloud_antiHerglotz_list
    (atoms : List (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hweights : ∀ a ∈ atoms, 0 ≤ a.2) :
    AntiHerglotzUHP
      (fun z : ℂ =>
        (atoms.map fun a : ℝ × ℝ =>
          (a.2 : ℂ) * ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (a.1 : ℂ)))).sum)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  change ((atoms.map fun a : ℝ × ℝ =>
          (a.2 : ℂ) * ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (a.1 : ℂ)))).sum).im ≤ 0
  induction atoms with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a atoms ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Complex.add_im]
    have ha_weight : 0 ≤ a.2 := hweights a (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have hrest : ∀ b ∈ atoms, 0 ≤ b.2 :=
      fun b hb => hweights b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb)
    have h_residue : ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (a.1 : ℂ))).im ≤ 0 :=
      complex_real_root_residue_imag_nonpos z a.1 hz
    have h_atom :
        ((a.2 : ℂ) * ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (a.1 : ℂ)))).im ≤ 0 := by
      rw [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
          zero_mul, add_zero]
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ha_weight h_residue
    have h_tail := ih hrest
    linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.AntiHerglotzUHP.of_eventual_pointwise_tendsto_UHP
statement:
theorem AntiHerglotzUHP.of_eventual_pointwise_tendsto_UHP
    {F : ℝ → ℂ → ℂ} {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hF : ∀ᶠ X in Filter.atTop, AntiHerglotzUHP (F X))
    (hlim : ∀ z, 0 < z.im →
      Tendsto (fun X => F X z) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (f z))) :
    AntiHerglotzUHP f
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have him_tendsto :
      Tendsto (fun X => (F X z).im) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (f z).im) :=
    (Complex.continuous_im.tendsto _).comp (hlim z hz)
  have hF_im_le : ∀ᶠ X in Filter.atTop, (F X z).im ≤ 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hF] with X hFX
    exact hFX z hz
  exact le_of_tendsto him_tendsto hF_im_le

name: OverflowResidueRH.nonneg_pow_le_exp_mul_nat
statement:
theorem nonneg_pow_le_exp_mul_nat (x : Real) (hx : 0 <= x) (n : Nat) :
    x ^ n <= Real.exp (x * n)
proof:
:= by
  have hxexp : x <= Real.exp x := by
    linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp x]
  calc
    x ^ n <= (Real.exp x) ^ n := pow_le_pow_left₀ hx hxexp n
    _ = Real.exp (x * n) := by
      rw [<- Real.exp_nat_mul]
      congr 1
      ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.affineDyadicIndex_le_pureDyadic
proof:
:= by
  have hK : K <= K * 2 ^ m :=
    Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right K (by positivity)
  calc
    N <= K * 2 ^ m + K := hN
    _ <= K * 2 ^ m + K * 2 ^ m := Nat.add_le_add_left hK _
    _ = (2 * K) * 2 ^ m := by ring
    _ <= (2 * K + 1) * 2 ^ m := by
      gcongr
      omega

name: OverflowResidueRH.natCast_le_exp_of_le_dyadic
statement:
theorem natCast_le_exp_of_le_dyadic (D m N : Nat)
    (hN : N <= D * 2 ^ m) :
    (N : Real) <= Real.exp (((D : Real) + 2) * (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hDexp : (D : Real) <= Real.exp D := by
    linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (D : Real)]
  have htwo : (2 : Real) ^ m <= Real.exp ((2 : Real) * m) :=
    nonneg_pow_le_exp_mul_nat 2 (by norm_num) m
  have hcast : (N : Real) <= (D : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m := by
    exact_mod_cast hN
  calc
    (N : Real) <= (D : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m := hcast
    _ <= Real.exp D * Real.exp ((2 : Real) * m) :=
      mul_le_mul hDexp htwo (by positivity) (by positivity)
    _ = Real.exp ((D : Real) + 2 * m) := by rw [<- Real.exp_add]
    _ <= Real.exp (((D : Real) + 2) * (m + 1)) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hD0 : 0 <= (D : Real) := Nat.cast_nonneg D
      have hm0 : 0 <= (m : Real) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
      nlinarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.factorial_le_exp_of_le_dyadic
statement:
theorem factorial_le_exp_of_le_dyadic (D m N : Nat)
    (hN : N <= D * 2 ^ m) :
    (N.factorial : Real) <=
      Real.exp (((D : Real) + 2) * D *
        (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m))
proof:
:= by
  have hfact : (N.factorial : Real) <= (N : Real) ^ N := by
    exact_mod_cast N.factorial_le_pow
  have hbase := natCast_le_exp_of_le_dyadic D m N hN
  have hpow : (N : Real) ^ N <=
      (Real.exp (((D : Real) + 2) * (m + 1))) ^ N :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg N) hbase N
  have hNcast : (N : Real) <= (D : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m := by
    exact_mod_cast hN
  calc
    (N.factorial : Real) <= (N : Real) ^ N := hfact
    _ <= (Real.exp (((D : Real) + 2) * (m + 1))) ^ N := hpow
    _ = Real.exp ((((D : Real) + 2) * (m + 1)) * N) := by
      rw [<- Real.exp_nat_mul]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ <= Real.exp ((((D : Real) + 2) * (m + 1)) *
          ((D : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m)) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      gcongr
    _ = Real.exp (((D : Real) + 2) * D *
          (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m)) := by
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.pow_succ_le_exp_of_le_dyadic
statement:
theorem pow_succ_le_exp_of_le_dyadic (B : Real) (hB : 0 <= B)
    (D m N : Nat) (hN : N <= D * 2 ^ m) :
    B ^ (N + 1) <=
      Real.exp ((B * (D + 1)) *
        (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m))
proof:
:= by
  have hpow := nonneg_pow_le_exp_mul_nat B hB (N + 1)
  have hone : 1 <= 2 ^ m := Nat.one_le_pow m 2 (by norm_num)
  have hN1 : N + 1 <= (D + 1) * 2 ^ m := by
    calc
      N + 1 <= D * 2 ^ m + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right hN 1
      _ <= D * 2 ^ m + 2 ^ m := Nat.add_le_add_left hone _
      _ = (D + 1) * 2 ^ m := by ring
  have hN1cast : ((N + 1 : Nat) : Real) <=
      ((D + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m := by
    exact_mod_cast hN1
  calc
    B ^ (N + 1) <= Real.exp (B * (((N + 1 : Nat) : Real))) := hpow
    _ <= Real.exp (B * (((D + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m)) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN1cast hB
    _ <= Real.exp ((B * (D + 1)) *
          (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m)) := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hm1 : (1 : Real) <= ((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) := by norm_num
      calc
        B * (((D + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m) =
            (B * ((D + 1 : Nat) : Real)) * 1 * (2 : Real) ^ m := by ring
        _ <= (B * ((D + 1 : Nat) : Real)) *
            ((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m := by
          gcongr
        _ = (B * (D + 1)) *
            (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m) := by
          push_cast
          ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.le_exp_dyadic_self
statement:
theorem le_exp_dyadic_self (C : Real) (hC : 0 <= C) (m : Nat) :
    C <= Real.exp (C *
      (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m))
proof:
:= by
  have hself : C <= Real.exp C := by
    linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp C]
  apply hself.trans
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  have ht : (1 : Real) <=
      ((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m := by
    have hm : (1 : Real) <= ((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) := by norm_num
    have hp : (1 : Real) <= (2 : Real) ^ m := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_pow m 2 (by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  calc
    C = C * 1 := by ring
    _ <= C * (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hC

name: OverflowResidueRH.factorialDyadicGrowthRate_nonneg
statement:
theorem factorialDyadicGrowthRate_nonneg (C B : Real) (K : Nat)
    (hC : 0 <= C) (hB : 0 <= B) :
    0 <= factorialDyadicGrowthRate C B K
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [factorialDyadicGrowthRate]
  positivity

name: OverflowResidueRH.mul_pow_factorial_le_exp_dyadic
statement:
theorem mul_pow_factorial_le_exp_dyadic
    (C B : Real) (hC : 0 <= C) (hB : 0 <= B)
    (K m N : Nat) (hN : N <= K * 2 ^ m + K) :
    C * B ^ (N + 1) * (N.factorial : Real) <=
      Real.exp (factorialDyadicGrowthRate C B K *
        (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m))
proof:
:= by
  let D : Nat := 2 * K + 1
  have hND : N <= D * 2 ^ m := affineDyadicIndex_le_pureDyadic hN
  let t : Real := ((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m
  have hconst : C <= Real.exp (C * t) := le_exp_dyadic_self C hC m
  have hpower : B ^ (N + 1) <=
      Real.exp ((B * (D + 1)) * t) :=
    pow_succ_le_exp_of_le_dyadic B hB D m N hND
  have hfact : (N.factorial : Real) <=
      Real.exp ((((D : Real) + 2) * D) * t) :=
    factorial_le_exp_of_le_dyadic D m N hND
  calc
    C * B ^ (N + 1) * (N.factorial : Real) <=
        Real.exp (C * t) * Real.exp ((B * (D + 1)) * t) *
          Real.exp ((((D : Real) + 2) * D) * t) := by
      gcongr
    _ = Real.exp (factorialDyadicGrowthRate C B K *
          (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m)) := by
      rw [<- Real.exp_add, <- Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      dsimp [factorialDyadicGrowthRate, D, t]
      push_cast
      ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.mul_rpow_factorial_le_exp_dyadic
statement:
theorem mul_rpow_factorial_le_exp_dyadic
    (C B : Real) (hC : 0 <= C) (hB : 0 <= B)
    (K m N : Nat) (hN : N <= K * 2 ^ m + K) :
    C * (B ^ (((N + 1 : Nat) : Real)) * (N.factorial : Real)) <=
      Real.exp (factorialDyadicGrowthRate C B K *
        (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using
    mul_pow_factorial_le_exp_dyadic C B hC hB K m N hN

name: OverflowResidueRH.MellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.norm_mellin_le_exp_dyadic
statement:
theorem MellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.norm_mellin_le_exp_dyadic
    {f : Real -> Complex} (H : MellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay f)
    (s : Complex) (K m N : Nat)
    (hupper : s.re - 1 <= N)
    (hlower : -(N : Real) - 2 <= s.re - 1 - H.k)
    (hconv : MellinConvergent f s)
    (hN : N <= K * 2 ^ m + K) :
    ‖mellin f s‖ <=
      Real.exp (factorialDyadicGrowthRate (2 * H.A) (1 / H.p) K *
        (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m))
proof:
:= by
  refine (H.norm_mellin_le_factorial s N hupper hlower hconv).trans ?_
  simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
    (mul_rpow_factorial_le_exp_dyadic
      (2 * H.A) (1 / H.p)
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.A_nonneg)
      (div_nonneg (by norm_num) H.p_pos.le) K m N hN)

name: OverflowResidueRH.exists_factorialDyadic_orderOne_bound
statement:
theorem exists_factorialDyadic_orderOne_bound
    (C B : Real) (hC : 0 <= C) (hB : 0 <= B) (K lower : Nat) :
    ∃ A A0 : Real, 0 <= A ∧ 0 <= A0 ∧
      ∀ m N : Nat, lower <= m -> N <= K * 2 ^ m + K ->
        C * (B ^ (((N + 1 : Nat) : Real)) * (N.factorial : Real)) <=
          Real.exp (A * (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ m) + A0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨factorialDyadicGrowthRate C B K, 0,
    factorialDyadicGrowthRate_nonneg C B K hC hB, le_rfl, ?_⟩
  intro m N _ hN
  simpa using mul_rpow_factorial_le_exp_dyadic C B hC hB K m N hN

name: OverflowResidueRH.hermiteBiehlerSharp_sharp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hermiteBiehlerSharp_sharp (E : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    hermiteBiehlerSharp (hermiteBiehlerSharp E) z = E z
proof:
:= by
  simp [hermiteBiehlerSharp]

name: OverflowResidueRH.hermiteBiehlerSharp_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hermiteBiehlerSharp_add (E G : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    hermiteBiehlerSharp (fun w => E w + G w) z =
      hermiteBiehlerSharp E z + hermiteBiehlerSharp G z
proof:
:= by
  simp [hermiteBiehlerSharp]

name: OverflowResidueRH.deriv_schwarz
statement:
theorem deriv_schwarz
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, F (star z) = star (F z)) (z : ℂ) :
    star (deriv F (star z)) = deriv F z
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : conj ∘ F ∘ conj = F := by
    funext w
    change star (F (star w)) = F w
    rw [hF]
    simp
  have hderiv := congrArg (fun f : ℂ → ℂ => deriv f z) hfun
  rw [deriv_conj_conj] at hderiv
  simpa [Function.comp_apply] using hderiv

name: OverflowResidueRH.hermiteBiehlerSharp_derivativeCompanionEntireFunction
statement:
theorem hermiteBiehlerSharp_derivativeCompanionEntireFunction
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, F (star z) = star (F z)) (z : ℂ) :
    hermiteBiehlerSharp (derivativeCompanionEntireFunction F) z =
      F z - Complex.I * deriv F z
proof:
:= by
  change (starRingEnd ℂ)
      (F (star z) + Complex.I * deriv F (star z)) = _
  rw [map_add, map_mul, hF, Complex.conj_I]
  have hd := deriv_schwarz hF z
  change (starRingEnd ℂ) (deriv F (star z)) = deriv F z at hd
  rw [hd]
  have hs : (starRingEnd ℂ) (star (F z)) = F z := by
    exact star_star (F z)
  rw [hs]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.hermiteBiehlerUHP_derivativeCompanion_iff
statement:
theorem hermiteBiehlerUHP_derivativeCompanion_iff
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, F (star z) = star (F z)) :
    HermiteBiehlerUHP (derivativeCompanionEntireFunction F) ↔
      DerivativeCompanionHermiteBiehlerUHP F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h z hz
    simpa [DerivativeCompanionHermiteBiehlerAt,
      derivativeCompanionEntireFunction,
      hermiteBiehlerSharp_derivativeCompanionEntireFunction hF z] using h z hz
  · intro h z hz
    simpa [DerivativeCompanionHermiteBiehlerAt,
      derivativeCompanionEntireFunction,
      hermiteBiehlerSharp_derivativeCompanionEntireFunction hF z] using h z hz

name: OverflowResidueRH.hermiteBiehlerUHP_derivativeCompanion_iff_strictAntiHerglotz
statement:
theorem hermiteBiehlerUHP_derivativeCompanion_iff_strictAntiHerglotz
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, F (star z) = star (F z)) :
    HermiteBiehlerUHP (derivativeCompanionEntireFunction F) ↔
      StrictAntiHerglotzUHP (logDerivativeResponse F)
proof:
:=
  (hermiteBiehlerUHP_derivativeCompanion_iff hF).trans
    (derivativeCompanionHermiteBiehlerUHP_iff_strictAntiHerglotz F)

name: OverflowResidueRH.realPolynomialComplexEval_schwarz
statement:
theorem realPolynomialComplexEval_schwarz
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    realPolynomialComplexEval p (star z) =
      star (realPolynomialComplexEval p z)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [realPolynomialComplexEval, Polynomial.aeval_def] using
    Polynomial.aeval_conj p z

name: OverflowResidueRH.realPolynomialComplexEval_deriv
statement:
theorem realPolynomialComplexEval_deriv
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    deriv (realPolynomialComplexEval p) z =
      realPolynomialComplexEval p.derivative z
proof:
:= by
  change deriv (fun w : ℂ => (p.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)).eval w) z =
    (p.derivative.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)).eval z
  rw [Polynomial.deriv, Polynomial.derivative_map]

name: OverflowResidueRH.realPolynomialComplexEval_ofReal
statement:
theorem realPolynomialComplexEval_ofReal
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    realPolynomialComplexEval p (x : ℂ) = Complex.ofReal (p.eval x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [realPolynomialComplexEval]
  rw [Polynomial.eval_map]
  change Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) ((algebraMap ℝ ℂ) x) p =
    (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) (p.eval x)
  rw [Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply]

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_realPolynomialComplexEval
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_realPolynomialComplexEval
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) :
    logDerivativeResponse (realPolynomialComplexEval p) =
      polynomialLogDerivResponse (p.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  funext z
  simp only [logDerivativeResponse, polynomialLogDerivResponse]
  rw [realPolynomialComplexEval_deriv]
  simp [realPolynomialComplexEval, Polynomial.derivative_map]

name: OverflowResidueRH.realPolynomial_derivativeCompanion_hermiteBiehler_iff_roots_real
statement:
theorem realPolynomial_derivativeCompanion_hermiteBiehler_iff_roots_real
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    HermiteBiehlerUHP
        (derivativeCompanionEntireFunction (realPolynomialComplexEval p)) ↔
      0 < p.natDegree ∧
        ∀ ρ : ℂ, realPolynomialComplexEval p ρ = 0 → ρ.im = 0
proof:
:= by
  let q : Polynomial ℂ := p.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff
    (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ℝ ℂ)).mpr hp
  have hschwarz : ∀ z : ℂ,
      realPolynomialComplexEval p (star z) =
        star (realPolynomialComplexEval p z) :=
    realPolynomialComplexEval_schwarz p
  rw [hermiteBiehlerUHP_derivativeCompanion_iff_strictAntiHerglotz hschwarz]
  rw [logDerivativeResponse_realPolynomialComplexEval]
  rw [polynomial_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_roots_real q hq]
  · simp only [q, Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ℝ ℂ)]
    rfl
  · intro z
    simpa [q, realPolynomialComplexEval] using
      realPolynomialComplexEval_schwarz p z

name: OverflowResidueRH.derivativeCompanion_realPolynomial_at_real
statement:
theorem derivativeCompanion_realPolynomial_at_real
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    derivativeCompanionEntireFunction (realPolynomialComplexEval p) (x : ℂ) =
      Complex.ofReal (p.eval x) +
        Complex.I * Complex.ofReal (p.derivative.eval x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivativeCompanionEntireFunction,
    realPolynomialComplexEval_deriv]
  simp only [realPolynomialComplexEval]
  rw [Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.eval_map]
  change
    Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) ((algebraMap ℝ ℂ) x) p +
        Complex.I *
          Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) ((algebraMap ℝ ℂ) x) p.derivative =
      (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) (p.eval x) +
        Complex.I * (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) (p.derivative.eval x)
  rw [Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply, Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply]

name: OverflowResidueRH.derivativeCompanion_realPolynomial_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem derivativeCompanion_realPolynomial_ne_zero_iff
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    derivativeCompanionEntireFunction (realPolynomialComplexEval p) (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 ↔
      ¬ (p.eval x = 0 ∧ p.derivative.eval x = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivativeCompanion_realPolynomial_at_real]
  apply not_congr
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
      simpa using hre
    · have him := congrArg Complex.im h
      simpa using him
  · rintro ⟨hA, hB⟩
    simp [hA, hB]

name: OverflowResidueRH.realPolynomial_derivativeCompanion_hermiteBiehlerNoRealZeros_iff
statement:
theorem
    realPolynomial_derivativeCompanion_hermiteBiehlerNoRealZeros_iff
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    HermiteBiehlerNoRealZeros
        (derivativeCompanionEntireFunction (realPolynomialComplexEval p)) ↔
      0 < p.natDegree ∧
        (∀ ρ : ℂ, realPolynomialComplexEval p ρ = 0 → ρ.im = 0) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, ¬ (p.eval x = 0 ∧ p.derivative.eval x = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HermiteBiehlerNoRealZeros,
    realPolynomial_derivativeCompanion_hermiteBiehler_iff_roots_real p hp]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hdeg, hreal⟩, hno⟩
    exact ⟨hdeg, hreal, fun x =>
      (derivativeCompanion_realPolynomial_ne_zero_iff p x).mp (hno x)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hdeg, hreal, hno⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hdeg, hreal⟩, fun x =>
      (derivativeCompanion_realPolynomial_ne_zero_iff p x).mpr (hno x)⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData.polynomialHermiteBiehler_noRealZeros
statement:
theorem OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData.polynomialHermiteBiehler_noRealZeros
    {A B : Polynomial ℝ}
    (D : OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData A B) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, polynomialHermiteBiehlerFunction A B (x : ℂ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x hzero
  apply D.no_common_real_root x
  constructor
  · have hre := congrArg Complex.re hzero
    simpa [polynomialHermiteBiehlerFunction,
      realPolynomialComplexEval_ofReal] using hre
  · have him := congrArg Complex.im hzero
    simpa [polynomialHermiteBiehlerFunction,
      realPolynomialComplexEval_ofReal] using him

name: OverflowResidueRH.normalizedPolynomialHermiteBiehler_iff_interlacing
statement:
theorem normalizedPolynomialHermiteBiehler_iff_interlacing
    (T : NormalizedPolynomialHermiteBiehlerTheoremData)
    (A B : Polynomial ℝ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hB : B ≠ 0)
    (hdeg : A.natDegree = B.natDegree + 1) :
    HermiteBiehlerNoRealZeros (polynomialHermiteBiehlerFunction A B) ↔
      Nonempty (OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData A B)
proof:
:=
  ⟨T.forward A B hA hB hdeg, T.reverse A B hA hB hdeg⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireHermiteBiehler_iff_orientedStrictInterlacing
statement:
theorem entireHermiteBiehler_iff_orientedStrictInterlacing
    {A B : ℂ → ℂ}
    (T : EntireHermiteBiehlerInterlacingTheoremData A B) :
    HermiteBiehlerNoRealZeros (entireHermiteBiehlerFunction A B) ↔
      Nonempty (OrientedEntireBiInfiniteStrictInterlacingData A B)
proof:
:=
  ⟨T.forward, T.reverse⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_eq_zero_at_zero
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_eq_zero_at_zero
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ : ℂ} (hzero : f ρ = 0) :
    logDerivativeResponse f ρ = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold logDerivativeResponse
  rw [hzero, div_zero]

name: OverflowResidueRH.antiHerglotz_at_zero_is_vacuous
statement:
theorem antiHerglotz_at_zero_is_vacuous
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ : ℂ} (hzero : f ρ = 0) :
    (logDerivativeResponse f ρ).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDerivativeResponse_eq_zero_at_zero hzero]
  exact Complex.zero_im

name: OverflowResidueRH.lowerProbe_ne_pole
statement:
theorem lowerProbe_ne_pole
    (ρ : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I ≠ ρ
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have him_diff : (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = ρ.im := by rw [h]
  have him_calc : (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = ρ.im - ε := by
    simp [Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  rw [him_calc] at him_diff
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.antiHerglotz_iff_antiHerglotz_away_from_zeros
statement:
theorem antiHerglotz_iff_antiHerglotz_away_from_zeros
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    AntiHerglotzUHP (logDerivativeResponse f)
      ↔ ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → f z ≠ 0 →
          (logDerivativeResponse f z).im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h z hz _; exact h z hz
  · intro h z hz
    by_cases hfz : f z = 0
    · rw [antiHerglotz_at_zero_is_vacuous hfz]
    · exact h z hz hfz

name: OverflowResidueRH.Real.secant_le_log
statement:
theorem Real.secant_le_log
    {α β T : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hαβ : α < β) (hαT : α ≤ T) (hTβ : T ≤ β) :
    ((β - T) / (β - α)) * Real.log α + ((T - α) / (β - α)) * Real.log β
      ≤ Real.log T
proof:
:= by
  have hβ : 0 < β := lt_trans hα hαβ
  have hβα : 0 < β - α := by linarith
  set a := (β - T) / (β - α) with ha_def
  set b := (T - α) / (β - α) with hb_def
  have ha_nn : 0 ≤ a := div_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt hβα)
  have hb_nn : 0 ≤ b := div_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt hβα)
  have hab : a + b = 1 := by
    unfold a b
    rw [← add_div, show β - T + (T - α) = β - α from by ring, div_self hβα.ne']
  have h_avg : a * α + b * β = T := by
    unfold a b
    field_simp
    ring
  have hα_mem : α ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := hα
  have hβ_mem : β ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := hβ
  have h_concave := strictConcaveOn_log_Ioi.concaveOn.2 hα_mem hβ_mem ha_nn hb_nn hab
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h_concave
  rw [h_avg] at h_concave
  exact h_concave

name: OverflowResidueRH.im_inv_sq_complex
statement:
lemma im_inv_sq_complex (a b : ℝ) (_h : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    (((a : ℂ) + Complex.I * (b : ℂ)) ^ 2)⁻¹.im
      = -2 * a * b / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsq_re : (((a : ℂ) + Complex.I * (b : ℂ)) ^ 2).re = a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 := by
    rw [pow_two]
    simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
    ring
  have hsq_im : (((a : ℂ) + Complex.I * (b : ℂ)) ^ 2).im = 2 * a * b := by
    rw [pow_two]
    simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
    ring
  rw [Complex.inv_im, hsq_im, Complex.normSq_apply, hsq_re, hsq_im]
  have h_denom :
      (a ^ 2 - b ^ 2) * (a ^ 2 - b ^ 2) + 2 * a * b * (2 * a * b)
        = (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    ring
  rw [h_denom]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.intervalIntegrable_ofReal
statement:
lemma intervalIntegrable_ofReal
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hf : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume a b) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun u => ((f u : ℝ) : ℂ))
      MeasureTheory.volume a b
proof:
:=
  ⟨hf.1.ofReal, hf.2.ofReal⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.improperComplexIntegralConverges_of_normMajorant
statement:
theorem improperComplexIntegralConverges_of_normMajorant
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {M : ℝ → ℝ} {T LM : ℝ}
    (hf_int : ∀ X, T ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume T X)
    (hM_int : ∀ X, T ≤ X → IntervalIntegrable M MeasureTheory.volume T X)
    (hM_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun X => ∫ u in T..X, M u)
                    Filter.atTop (𝓝 LM))
    (hbound : ∀ᶠ u in Filter.atTop, ‖f u‖ ≤ M u) :
    ∃ L : ℂ, Filter.Tendsto (fun X => ∫ u in T..X, f u) Filter.atTop (𝓝 L)
proof:
:= by
  have h_cauchy :
      Cauchy (Filter.map (fun X => ∫ u in T..X, f u) Filter.atTop) := by
    rw [Metric.cauchy_iff]
    refine ⟨Filter.map_neBot, ?_⟩
    intro ε hε
    have hε2 : 0 < ε / 2 := by linarith
    have h_M_close : ∀ᶠ A in Filter.atTop,
        |(∫ u in T..A, M u) - LM| < ε / 2 := by
      have h := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hM_tendsto) (ε / 2) hε2
      filter_upwards [h] with A hdist
      rwa [Real.dist_eq] at hdist
    obtain ⟨N_M, hN_M⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp h_M_close
    obtain ⟨N0, hN0⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hbound
    let N : ℝ := max T (max N0 N_M)
    refine ⟨(fun X => ∫ u in T..X, f u) '' {X | N ≤ X}, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Filter.image_mem_map (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N)
    suffices key :
        ∀ Y1 Y2 : ℝ, N ≤ Y1 → N ≤ Y2 → Y1 ≤ Y2 →
          ‖(∫ u in T..Y2, f u) - (∫ u in T..Y1, f u)‖ < ε by
      rintro _ ⟨X1, hX1, rfl⟩ _ ⟨X2, hX2, rfl⟩
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      rcases le_total X1 X2 with hX12 | hX21
      · rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact key X1 X2 hX1 hX2 hX12
      · exact key X2 X1 hX2 hX1 hX21
    intro Y1 Y2 hY1 hY2 hY12
    have hT_Y1 : T ≤ Y1 := le_trans (le_max_left T _) hY1
    have hT_Y2 : T ≤ Y2 := le_trans (le_max_left T _) hY2
    have hN0_Y1 : N0 ≤ Y1 :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left N0 N_M) (le_max_right T _)) hY1
    have hN_M_Y1 : N_M ≤ Y1 :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right N0 N_M) (le_max_right T _)) hY1
    have hN_M_Y2 : N_M ≤ Y2 :=
      le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right N0 N_M) (le_max_right T _)) hY2
    have hf_int_TY2 := hf_int Y2 hT_Y2
    have hf_int_TY1 : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume T Y1 :=
      hf_int_TY2.mono_set (by
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hT_Y1, Set.uIcc_of_le hT_Y2]
        exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hY12)
    have hf_int_Y1Y2 : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume Y1 Y2 :=
      hf_int_TY2.mono_set (by
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hY12, Set.uIcc_of_le hT_Y2]
        exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc_left hT_Y1)
    have hM_int_TY2 := hM_int Y2 hT_Y2
    have hM_int_TY1 : IntervalIntegrable M MeasureTheory.volume T Y1 :=
      hM_int_TY2.mono_set (by
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hT_Y1, Set.uIcc_of_le hT_Y2]
        exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hY12)
    have hM_int_Y1Y2 : IntervalIntegrable M MeasureTheory.volume Y1 Y2 :=
      hM_int_TY2.mono_set (by
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hY12, Set.uIcc_of_le hT_Y2]
        exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc_left hT_Y1)
    have h_split_f : (∫ u in T..Y2, f u) =
        (∫ u in T..Y1, f u) + ∫ u in Y1..Y2, f u :=
      (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        hf_int_TY1 hf_int_Y1Y2).symm
    have h_tail_f :
        (∫ u in T..Y2, f u) - (∫ u in T..Y1, f u) = ∫ u in Y1..Y2, f u := by
      rw [h_split_f]; ring
    rw [h_tail_f]
    have hbound_Y1Y2 : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc Y1 Y2, ‖f u‖ ≤ M u := by
      intro u hu
      exact hN0 u (le_trans hN0_Y1 hu.1)
    have h_norm_int : ‖∫ u in Y1..Y2, f u‖ ≤ ∫ u in Y1..Y2, ‖f u‖ := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hY12,
          intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hY12]
      exact MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    have h_mono : ∫ u in Y1..Y2, ‖f u‖ ≤ ∫ u in Y1..Y2, M u :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hY12 hf_int_Y1Y2.norm hM_int_Y1Y2
        hbound_Y1Y2
    have h_comp : ‖∫ u in Y1..Y2, f u‖ ≤ ∫ u in Y1..Y2, M u :=
      le_trans h_norm_int h_mono
    have h_split_M : (∫ u in T..Y2, M u) =
        (∫ u in T..Y1, M u) + ∫ u in Y1..Y2, M u :=
      (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        hM_int_TY1 hM_int_Y1Y2).symm
    have h_M_tail_eq : ∫ u in Y1..Y2, M u =
        (∫ u in T..Y2, M u) - (∫ u in T..Y1, M u) := by linarith
    have h_M_close_Y1 := hN_M Y1 hN_M_Y1
    have h_M_close_Y2 := hN_M Y2 hN_M_Y2
    have h_M_diff_lt :
        |(∫ u in T..Y2, M u) - (∫ u in T..Y1, M u)| < ε := by
      calc |(∫ u in T..Y2, M u) - (∫ u in T..Y1, M u)|
          ≤ |(∫ u in T..Y2, M u) - LM| + |LM - (∫ u in T..Y1, M u)| :=
              abs_sub_le _ _ _
        _ = |(∫ u in T..Y2, M u) - LM| + |(∫ u in T..Y1, M u) - LM| := by
              rw [abs_sub_comm LM]
        _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := add_lt_add h_M_close_Y2 h_M_close_Y1
        _ = ε := by ring
    rw [h_M_tail_eq] at h_comp
    have h_le_abs :
        (∫ u in T..Y2, M u) - (∫ u in T..Y1, M u)
          ≤ |(∫ u in T..Y2, M u) - (∫ u in T..Y1, M u)| := le_abs_self _
    linarith
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := CompleteSpace.complete h_cauchy
  exact ⟨L, hL⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_inv_sq_le_four_div_sq_of_norm_ge_half
statement:
lemma norm_inv_sq_le_four_div_sq_of_norm_ge_half
    {w : ℂ} {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hw : u / 2 ≤ ‖w‖) :
    ‖(1 : ℂ) / w^2‖ ≤ 4 / u^2
proof:
:= by
  have hu_half_pos : 0 < u / 2 := by linarith
  have hw_pos : 0 < ‖w‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le hu_half_pos hw
  have h_sq : (u / 2)^2 ≤ ‖w‖^2 :=
    sq_le_sq' (by linarith [norm_nonneg w]) hw
  have hw_sq_pos : 0 < ‖w‖^2 := by positivity
  have hu_sq_pos : 0 < u^2 := by positivity
  rw [norm_div, norm_one, norm_pow, div_le_div_iff₀ hw_sq_pos hu_sq_pos]
  nlinarith [h_sq]

name: OverflowResidueRH.log_div_id_atTop_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma log_div_id_atTop_tendsto_zero :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => Real.log X / X) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have := Real.tendsto_pow_log_div_mul_add_atTop (1 : ℝ) (0 : ℝ) 1
    (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)
  simpa using this

name: OverflowResidueRH.complex_sub_real_ne_zero_of_im_pos
statement:
lemma complex_sub_real_ne_zero_of_im_pos
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) (u : ℝ) :
    z - (u : ℂ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have him : (z - (u : ℂ)).im = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
  have him' : (z - (u : ℂ)).im = z.im := by simp
  rw [him'] at him
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.complex_add_real_ne_zero_of_im_pos
statement:
lemma complex_add_real_ne_zero_of_im_pos
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) (u : ℝ) :
    z + (u : ℂ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have him : (z + (u : ℂ)).im = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
  have him' : (z + (u : ℂ)).im = z.im := by simp
  rw [him'] at him
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.arctan_shift_deriv_algebra
statement:
lemma arctan_shift_deriv_algebra
    {a y u : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (1 / (1 + ((u - a) / y) ^ 2)) * (1 / y)
      = y / ((u - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hy2 : y ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hy
  field_simp
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.tendsto_arctan_shift_atTop
statement:
lemma tendsto_arctan_shift_atTop
    (a : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun X : ℝ => Real.arctan ((X - a) / y))
      Filter.atTop
      (𝓝 (Real.pi / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have h_shift : Filter.Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => (X - a) / y)
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    have h_sub : Filter.Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => X - a) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_right Filter.atTop (-a) Filter.tendsto_id
    exact h_sub.atTop_div_const hy
  have h_arctan_at_top :
      Filter.Tendsto Real.arctan Filter.atTop (𝓝 (Real.pi / 2)) :=
    tendsto_nhds_of_tendsto_nhdsWithin Real.tendsto_arctan_atTop
  exact h_arctan_at_top.comp h_shift

name: OverflowResidueRH.cauchy_one_side_intervalIntegrable
statement:
lemma cauchy_one_side_intervalIntegrable
    (a T X : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u => y / ((u - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2))
      MeasureTheory.volume T X
proof:
:= by
  have h_cont : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => y / ((u - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) := by
    refine continuous_const.div ?_ ?_
    · exact ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).pow 2).add continuous_const
    · intro u
      have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (u - a) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < y ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith
  exact h_cont.intervalIntegrable T X

name: OverflowResidueRH.hasDerivAt_arctan_minus_div_one_add_sq
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_arctan_minus_div_one_add_sq (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun x : ℝ => Real.arctan x - x / (1 + x ^ 2))
      (2 * t ^ 2 / (1 + t ^ 2) ^ 2)
      t
proof:
:= by
  have h_arctan : HasDerivAt Real.arctan (1 / (1 + t ^ 2)) t :=
    Real.hasDerivAt_arctan t
  have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x) (1 : ℝ) t := hasDerivAt_id t
  have h_sq : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (2 * t) t := by
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2)
        (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * t ^ (2 - 1)) t := hasDerivAt_pow 2 t
    norm_num at h
    exact h
  have h_den : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => 1 + x ^ 2) (2 * t) t := by
    have h := (hasDerivAt_const t (1 : ℝ)).add h_sq
    rwa [zero_add] at h
  have h_ne : (1 : ℝ) + t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ t ^ 2 := sq_nonneg t
    linarith
  have h_div :
      HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x / (1 + x ^ 2))
        ((1 * (1 + t ^ 2) - t * (2 * t)) / (1 + t ^ 2) ^ 2) t :=
    h_id.div h_den h_ne
  have h_sub := h_arctan.sub h_div
  convert h_sub using 1
  all_goals first
    | rfl
    | (field_simp [h_ne]; ring)

name: OverflowResidueRH.pi_div_two_sub_arctan_eq_arctan_inv
statement:
lemma pi_div_two_sub_arctan_eq_arctan_inv
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan s = Real.arctan (1 / s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_div]
  exact (Real.arctan_inv_of_pos hs).symm

name: OverflowResidueRH.list_sum_le_sum_of_pointwise
statement:
lemma list_sum_le_sum_of_pointwise
    {α : Type*} {L : List α} {f g : α → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ a ∈ L, f a ≤ g a) :
    (L.map f).sum ≤ (L.map g).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a rest ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have h_a : f a ≤ g a := h a (by simp)
    have h_rest : ∀ b ∈ rest, f b ≤ g b :=
      fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)
    have h_rest_le := ih h_rest
    linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.kernel_factor_den_le_aux
statement:
lemma kernel_factor_den_le_aux
    {a y : ℝ} (_ha_nn : 0 ≤ a) (hbox : a ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ 16) :
    ((10 - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) * ((10 + a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
      ≤ 116 * (100 - a ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a ^ 2 := sq_nonneg a
  have hv : (0 : ℝ) ≤ y ^ 2 := sq_nonneg y
  have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by linarith
  have hv_le_16 : y ^ 2 ≤ 16 := by linarith
  have h_w_sq_le_256 :
      (a ^ 2 + y ^ 2) * (a ^ 2 + y ^ 2) ≤ 256 := by
    have h_mul : (a ^ 2 + y ^ 2) * (a ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
                ≤ (a ^ 2 + y ^ 2) * 16 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbox hnn
    linarith
  have h_lhs_expand :
      ((10 - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) * ((10 + a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
        = (a ^ 2 + y ^ 2) * (a ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
          + 200 * (a ^ 2 + y ^ 2) - 400 * a ^ 2 + 10000 := by
    ring
  rw [h_lhs_expand]
  linarith [h_w_sq_le_256, hu, hv, hv_le_16]

name: OverflowResidueRH.summable_of_nonneg_fiber_tsum_le
statement:
theorem summable_of_nonneg_fiber_tsum_le
    {ι : Type*}
    (bin : ι → ℕ)
    {f : ι → ℝ} {majorant : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i)
    (hfiber : ∀ n : ℕ, {i : ι | bin i = n}.Finite)
    (hmajorant : Summable majorant)
    (hfiber_le :
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        (∑' i : {i : ι // bin i = n}, f i) ≤ majorant n) :
    Summable f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : (Σ n : ℕ, {i : ι // bin i = n}) → ℝ :=
    fun p => f p.2.1
  have hF_nonneg : ∀ p, 0 ≤ F p := by
    intro p
    exact hf_nonneg p.2.1
  have hfiber_summable :
      ∀ n : ℕ, Summable fun i : {i : ι // bin i = n} => F ⟨n, i⟩ := by
    intro n
    haveI : Fintype {i : ι // bin i = n} := (hfiber n).fintype
    exact (hasSum_fintype (fun i : {i : ι // bin i = n} => F ⟨n, i⟩)).summable
  have hfiber_tsum_nonneg :
      ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ ∑' i : {i : ι // bin i = n}, F ⟨n, i⟩ := by
    intro n
    exact tsum_nonneg (fun i => hf_nonneg i.1)
  have hfiber_tsum_summable :
      Summable fun n : ℕ =>
        ∑' i : {i : ι // bin i = n}, F ⟨n, i⟩ :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
      hfiber_tsum_nonneg
      (fun n => by simpa [F] using hfiber_le n)
      hmajorant
  have hF_summable : Summable F := by
    exact (summable_sigma_of_nonneg hF_nonneg).mpr
      ⟨hfiber_summable, hfiber_tsum_summable⟩
  exact (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv bin).summable_iff.mp (by
    exact hF_summable)

name: OverflowResidueRH.summable_log_natCast_mul_pred_sq_inv
statement:
theorem summable_log_natCast_mul_pred_sq_inv :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => Real.log n * (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hsummable_rpow : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
    Real.summable_one_div_nat_rpow.mpr (by norm_num)
  refine summable_of_isBigO_nat hsummable_rpow ?_
  have hlog :
      (fun n : ℕ => Real.log n) =O[Filter.atTop]
        (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
    have h := (isLittleO_log_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)).isBigO
    exact h.comp_tendsto tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hinv :
      (fun n : ℕ => (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) =O[Filter.atTop]
        (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
    refine Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 4 ?_
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 2] with n hn
    have hx : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hcast : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) - 1 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]; norm_num
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity), Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity),
      hcast, inv_eq_one_div, inv_eq_one_div, mul_one_div,
      div_le_div_iff₀ (by nlinarith) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [hx]
  have hmul := hlog.mul hinv
  refine hmul.trans ?_
  refine Filter.EventuallyEq.isBigO ?_
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have e2 : ((n : ℝ) ^ 2) = (n : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ) := by rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]; norm_num
  have key :
      (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ = (n : ℝ) ^ (-(3 / 2) : ℝ) := by
    rw [e2, ← Real.rpow_neg hn0.le, ← Real.rpow_add hn0]
    congr 1
    norm_num
  rw [key, Real.rpow_neg hn0.le, one_div]

name: OverflowResidueRH.hasDerivAt_arctan_shift_div
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_arctan_shift_div
    (a : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun v : ℝ => Real.arctan ((v - a) / y))
      (y / ((u - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2))
      u
proof:
:= by
  have h_inner :
      HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => (v - a) / y) (1 / y) u := by
    have h_sub : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => v - a) (1 : ℝ) u :=
      (hasDerivAt_id u).sub_const a
    simpa [one_div] using h_sub.div_const y
  have h_arctan :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_arctan ((u - a) / y)).comp u h_inner
  have h_eq := arctan_shift_deriv_algebra (a := a) (y := y) (u := u) hy
  rw [h_eq] at h_arctan
  exact h_arctan

name: OverflowResidueRH.div_one_add_sq_le_arctan
statement:
lemma div_one_add_sq_le_arctan {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    s / (1 + s ^ 2) ≤ Real.arctan s
proof:
:= by
  have h_zero : Real.arctan 0 - 0 / (1 + (0 : ℝ) ^ 2) = 0 := by
    rw [Real.arctan_zero]; simp
  have h_cont :
      Continuous (fun t : ℝ => 2 * t ^ 2 / (1 + t ^ 2) ^ 2) := by
    refine (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow 2)).div ?_ ?_
    · exact ((continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)).pow 2)
    · intro t
      have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ t ^ 2 := sq_nonneg t
      have h_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + t ^ 2 := by linarith
      have : (0 : ℝ) < (1 + t ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith
  have hFTC :
      (Real.arctan s - s / (1 + s ^ 2))
          - (Real.arctan 0 - 0 / (1 + (0 : ℝ) ^ 2))
        = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..s, 2 * t ^ 2 / (1 + t ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
      (fun t _ => hasDerivAt_arctan_minus_div_one_add_sq t)
      (h_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 s)
    exact h.symm
  rw [h_zero, sub_zero] at hFTC
  have h_int_nn :
      0 ≤ ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..s, 2 * t ^ 2 / (1 + t ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hs
    intro u _
    have h_t_sq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * u ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg u]
    have h_den : (0 : ℝ) < (1 + u ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
    exact div_nonneg h_t_sq (le_of_lt h_den)
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.pi_div_two_sub_arctan_shift_eq_arctan_div
statement:
lemma pi_div_two_sub_arctan_shift_eq_arctan_div
    {A y : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hy : 0 < y) :
    Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan (A / y) = Real.arctan (y / A)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < A / y := div_pos hA hy
  rw [pi_div_two_sub_arctan_eq_arctan_inv hs]
  congr 1
  field_simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.log_10_div_2pi_ge_9_25
statement:
lemma log_10_div_2pi_ge_9_25 :
    (9 / 25 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (10 / (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_pi_lt : Real.pi < 3.15 := Real.pi_lt_d2
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have h_exp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (9/25) := Real.exp_pos _
  have h_one_sub : (-(9/25 : ℝ)) + 1 ≤ Real.exp (-(9/25)) := Real.add_one_le_exp _
  have h_1625 : (16/25 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-(9/25)) := by linarith
  rw [Real.exp_neg] at h_1625
  have h_exp_le : Real.exp (9/25) ≤ 25/16 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_1625 (le_of_lt h_exp_pos)
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h_exp_pos)] at this
    linarith
  have h_10_2pi_ge : (25/16 : ℝ) ≤ 10 / (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h_2pi_pos]; nlinarith
  have h_T_ge_exp : Real.exp (9/25) ≤ 10 / (2 * Real.pi) :=
    le_trans h_exp_le h_10_2pi_ge
  have h := Real.log_le_log h_exp_pos h_T_ge_exp
  rwa [Real.log_exp] at h

name: OverflowResidueRH.log_12_div_2pi_ge_2_5
statement:
lemma log_12_div_2pi_ge_2_5 :
    (2 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (12 / (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_pi_lt : Real.pi < 3.15 := Real.pi_lt_d2
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have h_exp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (2/5) := Real.exp_pos _
  have h_one_sub : (-(2/5 : ℝ)) + 1 ≤ Real.exp (-(2/5)) := Real.add_one_le_exp _
  have h_35 : (3/5 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-(2/5)) := by linarith
  rw [Real.exp_neg] at h_35
  have h_exp_le : Real.exp (2/5) ≤ 5/3 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_35 (le_of_lt h_exp_pos)
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h_exp_pos)] at this
    linarith
  have h_12_2pi_ge : (5/3 : ℝ) ≤ 12 / (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h_2pi_pos]; nlinarith
  have h_T_ge_exp : Real.exp (2/5) ≤ 12 / (2 * Real.pi) :=
    le_trans h_exp_le h_12_2pi_ge
  have h := Real.log_le_log h_exp_pos h_T_ge_exp
  rwa [Real.log_exp] at h

name: OverflowResidueRH.log_13_div_2pi_ge_1_2
statement:
lemma log_13_div_2pi_ge_1_2 :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (13 / (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_pi_lt : Real.pi < 3.15 := Real.pi_lt_d2
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have h_exp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (1/2) := Real.exp_pos _
  have h_one_sub : (-(1/2 : ℝ)) + 1 ≤ Real.exp (-(1/2)) := Real.add_one_le_exp _
  have h_half : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (-(1/2)) := by linarith
  rw [Real.exp_neg] at h_half
  have h_exp_le : Real.exp (1/2) ≤ 2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_half (le_of_lt h_exp_pos)
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h_exp_pos)] at this
    linarith
  have h_13_2pi_ge : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 13 / (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h_2pi_pos]; nlinarith
  have h_T_ge_exp : Real.exp (1/2) ≤ 13 / (2 * Real.pi) :=
    le_trans h_exp_le h_13_2pi_ge
  have h := Real.log_le_log h_exp_pos h_T_ge_exp

name: OverflowResidueRH.log_14_div_2pi_ge_3_4
statement:
lemma log_14_div_2pi_ge_3_4 :
    (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (14 / (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_pi_lt : Real.pi < 3.1416 := Real.pi_lt_d4
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have h_exp_1_lt : Real.exp 1 < 2.7182818286 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
  have h_exp_1_pos : 0 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos _
  have h_2718_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2.7182818286 := by norm_num
  have h_exp_1_cubed_lt : (Real.exp 1)^3 < (2.7182818286 : ℝ)^3 := by
    have := pow_lt_pow_left₀ h_exp_1_lt (le_of_lt h_exp_1_pos) (n := 3) (by norm_num)
    exact this
  have h_27_cube_le : (2.7182818286 : ℝ)^3 ≤ (17/8 : ℝ)^4 := by norm_num
  have h_exp_1_cubed_le : (Real.exp 1)^3 ≤ (17/8 : ℝ)^4 := by linarith
  have h_exp_3_eq : Real.exp 3 = (Real.exp 1)^3 := by
    have := Real.exp_one_pow 3
    have h_cast : ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (3 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [← h_cast]
    exact this.symm
  have h_exp_3_4_pow : (Real.exp (3/4 : ℝ))^4 = Real.exp 3 := by
    have := Real.exp_nat_mul (3/4 : ℝ) 4
    have h_eq : ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (3/4 : ℝ) = 3 := by norm_num
    rw [h_eq] at this
    exact this.symm
  have h_exp_3_le : Real.exp 3 ≤ (17/8 : ℝ)^4 := h_exp_3_eq ▸ h_exp_1_cubed_le
  have h_exp_3_4_le : Real.exp (3/4 : ℝ) ≤ 17/8 := by
    have h_pow_4_le : (Real.exp (3/4 : ℝ))^4 ≤ (17/8 : ℝ)^4 := h_exp_3_4_pow ▸ h_exp_3_le
    have h_exp_pos : 0 ≤ Real.exp (3/4 : ℝ) := le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)
    have h_178_pos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 17/8 := by norm_num
    exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ h_exp_pos h_178_pos (by norm_num : (4 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mp h_pow_4_le
  have h_178_le_142pi : (17/8 : ℝ) ≤ 14 / (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h_2pi_pos]
    nlinarith
  have h_exp_le_ratio : Real.exp (3/4 : ℝ) ≤ 14 / (2 * Real.pi) :=
    le_trans h_exp_3_4_le h_178_le_142pi
  have h_exp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (3/4 : ℝ) := Real.exp_pos _
  have h := Real.log_le_log h_exp_pos h_exp_le_ratio
  rwa [Real.log_exp] at h

name: OverflowResidueRH.log_19_div_2pi_ge_11_10
statement:
lemma log_19_div_2pi_ge_11_10 :
    (11 / 10 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (19 / (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_pi_lt : Real.pi < 3.1416 := Real.pi_lt_d4
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have h_exp_1_lt : Real.exp 1 < 2.7182818286 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
  have h_exp_1_pos : 0 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos _
  have h_exp_1_nn : 0 ≤ Real.exp 1 := le_of_lt h_exp_1_pos
  have h_exp_1_11_lt : (Real.exp 1)^11 < (2.7182818286 : ℝ)^11 :=
    pow_lt_pow_left₀ h_exp_1_lt h_exp_1_nn (by norm_num)
  have h_27_le_301 : (2.7182818286 : ℝ)^11 ≤ (301/100 : ℝ)^10 := by norm_num
  have h_exp_1_11_le : (Real.exp 1)^11 ≤ (301/100 : ℝ)^10 := by linarith
  have h_exp_11_eq : Real.exp 11 = (Real.exp 1)^11 := by
    have h := Real.exp_one_pow 11
    have h_cast : ((11 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (11 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [← h_cast]; exact h.symm
  have h_exp_11_10_pow : (Real.exp (11/10 : ℝ))^10 = Real.exp 11 := by
    have h := Real.exp_nat_mul (11/10 : ℝ) 10
    have h_eq : ((10 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (11/10 : ℝ) = 11 := by norm_num
    rw [h_eq] at h
    exact h.symm
  have h_exp_11_le : Real.exp 11 ≤ (301/100 : ℝ)^10 := h_exp_11_eq ▸ h_exp_1_11_le
  have h_exp_11_10_le : Real.exp (11/10 : ℝ) ≤ 301/100 := by

name: OverflowResidueRH.pade_log_5_div_pi
statement:
lemma pade_log_5_div_pi :
    2 * (5 - Real.pi) / (5 + Real.pi) ≤ Real.log (5 / Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_pi_lt : Real.pi < 3.15 := Real.pi_lt_d2
  have h_5_lt_pi : Real.pi < 5 := by linarith
  have hπ_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_pi_pos
  have h_5_plus_pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 5 + Real.pi := by linarith
  have h_x_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi := by
    apply div_nonneg
    · linarith
    · exact le_of_lt h_pi_pos
  have h_one_add : 1 + (5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi = 5 / Real.pi := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have h_pade := Real.le_log_one_add_of_nonneg h_x_nn
  rw [h_one_add] at h_pade
  have h_inner_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2 := by positivity
  have h_inner_ne : ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_inner_pos
  have h_step1 :
      2 * ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi)
        ≤ ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_pade (le_of_lt h_inner_pos)
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ h_inner_ne] at h
    linarith
  have h_step2 :
      2 * (5 - Real.pi) ≤ (5 + Real.pi) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_step1 (le_of_lt h_pi_pos)
    have hl : Real.pi * (2 * ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi)) = 2 * (5 - Real.pi) := by
      field_simp
    have h_factor :
        Real.pi * ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2) = 5 + Real.pi := by
      field_simp; ring
    have hr :
        Real.pi * (((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi))
          = (5 + Real.pi) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) := by
      rw [show Real.pi *
            (((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi))
            = (Real.pi * ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2))
                * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) from by ring,
          h_factor]
    linarith [h, hl.le, hl.symm.le, hr.le, hr.symm.le]
  have h5pπ_ne : (5 + Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_5_plus_pi_pos
  rw [div_le_iff₀ h_5_plus_pi_pos]
  linarith [h_step2]

name: OverflowResidueRH.integral_cauchy_one_side_eq_arctan_sub
statement:
lemma integral_cauchy_one_side_eq_arctan_sub
    (a T X : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (∫ u in T..X, y / ((u - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2))
      = Real.arctan ((X - a) / y) - Real.arctan ((T - a) / y)
proof:
:= by
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
  · intro u _
    exact hasDerivAt_arctan_shift_div a hy u
  · 
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => y / ((u - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) := by
      refine continuous_const.div ?_ ?_
      · exact ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).pow 2).add continuous_const
      · intro u
        have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (u - a) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
        have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < y ^ 2 := by positivity
        linarith
    exact h_cont.intervalIntegrable T X

name: OverflowResidueRH.arctan_div_lower_rational
statement:
lemma arctan_div_lower_rational
    {A y : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    y * A / (A ^ 2 + y ^ 2) ≤ Real.arctan (y / A)
proof:
:= by
  have hA_ne : A ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hA
  have h_div_nn : 0 ≤ y / A := div_nonneg hy (le_of_lt hA)
  have h_base : (y / A) / (1 + (y / A) ^ 2) ≤ Real.arctan (y / A) :=
    div_one_add_sq_le_arctan h_div_nn
  have h_alg : (y / A) / (1 + (y / A) ^ 2) = y * A / (A ^ 2 + y ^ 2) := by
    have hA_sq_pos : 0 < A ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hAy_sq_pos : 0 < A ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by positivity
    field_simp
  rw [h_alg] at h_base
  exact h_base

name: OverflowResidueRH.analyticOrderNatAt_zero_even_of_even
statement:
theorem analyticOrderNatAt_zero_even_of_even
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : AnalyticAt ℂ f 0)
    (hfinite : analyticOrderAt f 0 ≠ ⊤)
    (heven : ∀ z : ℂ, f (-z) = f z) :
    Even (analyticOrderNatAt f 0)
proof:
:= by
  let n : ℕ := analyticOrderNatAt f 0
  have horder : analyticOrderAt f 0 = (n : ENat) := by
    exact (Nat.cast_analyticOrderNatAt hfinite).symm
  have hnth_ne : iteratedDeriv n f 0 ≠ 0 :=
    ((analyticOrderAt_eq_nat_iff_iteratedDeriv_eq_zero hf).mp horder).2
  by_contra hneven
  have hnodd : Odd n := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp hneven
  have hfun : (fun z : ℂ ↦ f (-z)) = f := funext heven
  have hiter := congrArg (fun g : ℂ → ℂ ↦ iteratedDeriv n g 0) hfun
  rw [iteratedDeriv_comp_neg, neg_zero, hnodd.neg_one_pow] at hiter
  have hnth_zero : iteratedDeriv n f 0 = 0 := by
    have hneg : -(iteratedDeriv n f 0) = iteratedDeriv n f 0 := by
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hiter
    have htwo : (2 : ℂ) * iteratedDeriv n f 0 = 0 := by
      linear_combination -hneg
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp htwo).resolve_left (by norm_num)
  exact hnth_ne hnth_zero

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_add_I_mul_gt_norm_sub_I_mul_iff_div_im_neg
statement:
theorem norm_add_I_mul_gt_norm_sub_I_mul_iff_div_im_neg
    (a b : ℂ) :
    ‖a + Complex.I * b‖ > ‖a - Complex.I * b‖ ↔
      (b / a).im < 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · subst a
    simp
  · have hnormSq : 0 < Complex.normSq a := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr ha
    have hsquare :
        ‖a - Complex.I * b‖ < ‖a + Complex.I * b‖ ↔
          Complex.normSq (a - Complex.I * b) <
            Complex.normSq (a + Complex.I * b) := by
      rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
      exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).symm
    have hdiv :
        (b / a).im =
          (b.im * a.re - b.re * a.im) / Complex.normSq a := by
      rw [Complex.div_im]
      ring
    have hdivneg :
        (b.im * a.re - b.re * a.im) / Complex.normSq a < 0 ↔
          b.im * a.re - b.re * a.im < 0 := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact neg_of_div_neg_left h hnormSq.le
      · intro h
        exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos h hnormSq
    change ‖a - Complex.I * b‖ < ‖a + Complex.I * b‖ ↔
      (b / a).im < 0
    rw [hsquare, hdiv, hdivneg]
    simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
      Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    norm_num
    constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith
