name: OverflowResidueRH.quadraticExponential_conj
statement:
theorem quadraticExponential_conj (z : ℂ) :
    quadraticExponential (star z) = star (quadraticExponential z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold quadraticExponential
  calc
    Complex.exp (star z ^ 2) = Complex.exp (star (z ^ 2)) := by
      congr 1
      exact (map_pow (starRingEnd ℂ) z 2).symm
    _ = star (Complex.exp (z ^ 2)) := Complex.exp_conj _

name: OverflowResidueRH.quadraticExponential_ne_zero
statement:
theorem quadraticExponential_ne_zero (z : ℂ) :
    quadraticExponential z ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  Complex.exp_ne_zero _

name: OverflowResidueRH.quadraticExponential_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem quadraticExponential_hasDerivAt (z : ℂ) :
    HasDerivAt quadraticExponential
      (2 * z * quadraticExponential z) z
proof:
:= by
  unfold quadraticExponential
  convert (hasDerivAt_pow 2 z).cexp using 1
  all_goals
    first | rfl | (norm_num; ring)

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_quadraticExponential
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_quadraticExponential (z : ℂ) :
    logDerivativeResponse quadraticExponential z = 2 * z
proof:
:= by
  unfold logDerivativeResponse
  rw [(quadraticExponential_hasDerivAt z).deriv]
  simp [quadraticExponential_ne_zero]

name: OverflowResidueRH.quadraticExponential_positiveUpperImaginaryEscape
statement:
theorem quadraticExponential_positiveUpperImaginaryEscape :
    PositiveUpperImaginaryEscape
      (logDerivativeResponse quadraticExponential)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Complex.I, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  rw [logDerivativeResponse_quadraticExponential]
  norm_num

name: OverflowResidueRH.quadraticExponential_not_antiHerglotz
statement:
theorem quadraticExponential_not_antiHerglotz :
    ¬ AntiHerglotzUHP (logDerivativeResponse quadraticExponential)
proof:
:=
  positive_escape_kills_antiHerglotz
    quadraticExponential_positiveUpperImaginaryEscape

name: OverflowResidueRH.quadraticExponential_mul_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem quadraticExponential_mul_eq_zero_iff
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    quadraticExponential z * F z = 0 ↔ F z = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [quadraticExponential_ne_zero]

name: OverflowResidueRH.quadraticExponential_mul_neg
statement:
theorem quadraticExponential_mul_neg
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, F (-z) = F z) (z : ℂ) :
    quadraticExponential (-z) * F (-z) =
      quadraticExponential z * F z
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticExponential_neg, hF]

name: OverflowResidueRH.quadraticExponential_mul_conj
statement:
theorem quadraticExponential_mul_conj
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : ∀ z : ℂ, F (star z) = star (F z)) (z : ℂ) :
    quadraticExponential (star z) * F (star z) =
      star (quadraticExponential z * F z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticExponential_conj, hF, star_mul]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_quadraticExponential_mul
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_quadraticExponential_mul
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ}
    (hFz : F z ≠ 0) (hFdiff : DifferentiableAt ℂ F z) :
    logDerivativeResponse (fun w => quadraticExponential w * F w) z =
      2 * z + logDerivativeResponse F z
proof:
:= by
  change logDeriv (fun w => quadraticExponential w * F w) z =
    2 * z + logDeriv F z
  rw [logDeriv_mul z (quadraticExponential_ne_zero z) hFz
    (quadraticExponential_differentiable.differentiableAt) hFdiff]
  rw [show logDeriv quadraticExponential z = 2 * z by
    exact logDerivativeResponse_quadraticExponential z]

name: OverflowResidueRH.quadraticExponential_not_subquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity
statement:
theorem quadraticExponential_not_subquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity :
    ¬ HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity quadraticExponential
proof:
:= by
  intro hgrowth
  obtain ⟨R, _hR, hbound⟩ := hgrowth (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  let t : ℝ := max R 1
  let z : ℂ := (t : ℂ)
  have htR : R ≤ t := le_max_left _ _
  have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := le_max_right _ _
  have hzR : R ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    simpa [z, Complex.norm_real, abs_of_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one ht1)]
      using htR
  have h := hbound z hzR
  have hznorm : ‖z‖ = t := by
    simp [z, Complex.norm_real, abs_of_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one ht1)]
  have hlog : Real.log ‖quadraticExponential z‖ = t ^ 2 := by
    rw [quadraticExponential, Complex.norm_exp, Real.log_exp]
    norm_num [z, pow_two]
  rw [hlog, hznorm] at h
  have htpos : 0 < t ^ 2 :=
    sq_pos_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one ht1)
  nlinarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireQuotientCompletion_meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem entireQuotientCompletion_meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hg : Differentiable ℂ g)
    (horder : ∀ z : ℂ, analyticOrderAt f z = analyticOrderAt g z)
    (hfinite : ∀ z : ℂ, analyticOrderAt f z ≠ ⊤)
    (z : ℂ) :
    meromorphicOrderAt (entireQuotientCompletion f g) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmer : MeromorphicOn (f / g) Set.univ := by
    intro w _hw
    exact (hf.analyticAt w).meromorphicAt.div (hg.analyticAt w).meromorphicAt
  rw [entireQuotientCompletion,
    meromorphicOrderAt_toMeromorphicNFOn hmer (Set.mem_univ z),
    meromorphicOrderAt_div (hf.analyticAt z).meromorphicAt
      (hg.analyticAt z).meromorphicAt,
    (hf.analyticAt z).meromorphicOrderAt_eq,
    (hg.analyticAt z).meromorphicOrderAt_eq]
  lift analyticOrderAt f z to ℕ using hfinite z with n hn
  have hgn : analyticOrderAt g z = n := by
    rw [← horder z, hn]
  rw [hgn]
  simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireQuotientCompletion_differentiable
statement:
theorem entireQuotientCompletion_differentiable
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hg : Differentiable ℂ g)
    (horder : ∀ z : ℂ, analyticOrderAt f z = analyticOrderAt g z)
    (hfinite : ∀ z : ℂ, analyticOrderAt f z ≠ ⊤) :
    Differentiable ℂ (entireQuotientCompletion f g)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have hnormal :
      MeromorphicNFAt (entireQuotientCompletion f g) z :=
    meromorphicNFOn_toMeromorphicNFOn (f / g) Set.univ (Set.mem_univ z)
  exact (hnormal.meromorphicOrderAt_nonneg_iff_analyticAt.mp <| by
    rw [entireQuotientCompletion_meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero
      hf hg horder hfinite z]).differentiableAt

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireQuotientCompletion_ne_zero
statement:
theorem entireQuotientCompletion_ne_zero
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hg : Differentiable ℂ g)
    (horder : ∀ z : ℂ, analyticOrderAt f z = analyticOrderAt g z)
    (hfinite : ∀ z : ℂ, analyticOrderAt f z ≠ ⊤)
    (z : ℂ) :
    entireQuotientCompletion f g z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnormal :
      MeromorphicNFAt (entireQuotientCompletion f g) z :=
    meromorphicNFOn_toMeromorphicNFOn (f / g) Set.univ (Set.mem_univ z)
  exact hnormal.meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero_iff.mp
    (entireQuotientCompletion_meromorphicOrderAt_eq_zero
      hf hg horder hfinite z)

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireQuotientCompletion_eq_div
statement:
theorem entireQuotientCompletion_eq_div
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hg : Differentiable ℂ g)
    {z : ℂ} (hgz : g z ≠ 0) :
    entireQuotientCompletion f g z = f z / g z
proof:
:= by
  have hmer : MeromorphicOn (f / g) Set.univ := by
    intro w _hw
    exact (hf.analyticAt w).meromorphicAt.div (hg.analyticAt w).meromorphicAt
  have hnormal : MeromorphicNFAt (f / g) z :=
    ((hf.analyticAt z).div (hg.analyticAt z) hgz).meromorphicNFAt
  rw [entireQuotientCompletion,
    toMeromorphicNFOn_eq_toMeromorphicNFAt hmer (Set.mem_univ z),
    toMeromorphicNFAt_eq_self.2 hnormal]
  simp only [Pi.div_apply]

name: OverflowResidueRH.exists_differentiable_log_of_differentiable_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_differentiable_log_of_differentiable_ne_zero
    {q : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hq : Differentiable ℂ q)
    (hq_ne : ∀ z : ℂ, q z ≠ 0) :
    ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ,
      Differentiable ℂ h ∧ ∀ z : ℂ, Complex.exp (h z) = q z
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℂ → ℂ := fun z ↦ deriv q z / q z
  have hq_deriv : Differentiable ℂ (deriv q) := by
    intro z
    exact (hq.analyticAt z).deriv.differentiableAt
  have hr : Differentiable ℂ r := by
    intro z
    exact (hq_deriv z).div (hq z) (hq_ne z)
  obtain ⟨h, hh_zero, hh_deriv⟩ :=
    hr.isExactOn_univ.with_val_at 0 (Complex.log (q 0))
  have hh : Differentiable ℂ h := by
    intro z
    exact (hh_deriv z (Set.mem_univ z)).differentiableAt
  let u : ℂ → ℂ := fun z ↦ Complex.exp (h z) / q z
  have hu : Differentiable ℂ u := by
    intro z
    exact (hh z).cexp.div (hq z) (hq_ne z)
  have hu_deriv : ∀ z : ℂ, deriv u z = 0 := by
    intro z
    have hhz := hh_deriv z (Set.mem_univ z)
    change deriv (fun w : ℂ ↦ Complex.exp (h w) / q w) z = 0
    rw [deriv_fun_div (hh z).cexp (hq z) (hq_ne z),
      deriv_cexp (hh z), hhz.deriv]
    dsimp [r]
    field_simp [hq_ne z]
    ring
  have hu_const (z : ℂ) : u z = u 0 :=
    is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hu hu_deriv z 0
  have hu_zero : u 0 = 1 := by
    dsimp [u]
    rw [hh_zero, Complex.exp_log (hq_ne 0), div_self (hq_ne 0)]
  refine ⟨h, hh, fun z ↦ ?_⟩
  have huz : u z = 1 := (hu_const z).trans hu_zero
  exact (div_eq_one_iff_eq (hq_ne z)).mp (by simpa [u] using huz)

name: OverflowResidueRH.eq_exp_affine_of_differentiable_log_of_subquadraticNormGrowth
statement:
theorem eq_exp_affine_of_differentiable_log_of_subquadraticNormGrowth
    {q h : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hh : Differentiable ℂ h)
    (hexp : ∀ z : ℂ, Complex.exp (h z) = q z)
    (hgrowth : HasSubquadraticNormGrowth h) :
    ∃ a b : ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, q z = Complex.exp (a + b * z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ :=
    differentiable_eq_affine_of_subquadraticNormGrowth hh hgrowth
  exact ⟨a, b, fun z ↦ by rw [← hexp z, hab z]⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.exists_differentiable_log_entireQuotientCompletion
statement:
theorem exists_differentiable_log_entireQuotientCompletion
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hg : Differentiable ℂ g)
    (horder : ∀ z : ℂ, analyticOrderAt f z = analyticOrderAt g z)
    (hfinite : ∀ z : ℂ, analyticOrderAt f z ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ,
      Differentiable ℂ h ∧
        ∀ z : ℂ,
          Complex.exp (h z) = entireQuotientCompletion f g z
proof:
:=
  exists_differentiable_log_of_differentiable_ne_zero
    (entireQuotientCompletion_differentiable hf hg horder hfinite)
    (entireQuotientCompletion_ne_zero hf hg horder hfinite)

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSublinearNormGrowth.add_const
statement:
theorem HasSublinearNormGrowth.add_const
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : HasSublinearNormGrowth f) (c : ℂ) :
    HasSublinearNormGrowth (fun z => f z + c)
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨Rf, hRf, hf_bound⟩ := hf (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  let Rc : ℝ := 2 * ‖c‖ / ε
  refine ⟨max Rf Rc, hRf.trans (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hzRf : Rf ≤ ‖z‖ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hz
  have hzRc : Rc ≤ ‖z‖ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hz
  have hc : ‖c‖ ≤ (ε / 2) * ‖z‖ := by
    have hmul : 2 * ‖c‖ ≤ ‖z‖ * ε := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hzRc
    nlinarith
  calc
    ‖f z + c‖ ≤ ‖f z‖ + ‖c‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (ε / 2) * ‖z‖ + (ε / 2) * ‖z‖ :=
      add_le_add (hf_bound z hzRf) hc
    _ = ε * ‖z‖ := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSublinearNormGrowth.sub_const
statement:
theorem HasSublinearNormGrowth.sub_const
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : HasSublinearNormGrowth f) (c : ℂ) :
    HasSublinearNormGrowth (fun z => f z - c)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hf.add_const (-c)

name: OverflowResidueRH.deriv_eq_zero_of_sublinearNormGrowth
statement:
theorem deriv_eq_zero_of_sublinearNormGrowth
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hgrowth : HasSublinearNormGrowth f) (c : ℂ) :
    deriv f c = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_le_zero_iff.mp
  refine le_of_forall_gt_imp_ge_of_dense ?_
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨R, _hR, hbound⟩ := hgrowth (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  let r : ℝ := max (R + ‖c‖) (‖c‖ + 1)
  have hr_pos : 0 < r :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0 < ‖c‖ + 1) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hr_c : ‖c‖ ≤ r := by
    linarith [le_max_right (R + ‖c‖) (‖c‖ + 1)]
  have hsphere : ∀ z ∈ sphere c r, ‖f z‖ ≤ (ε / 2) * (2 * r) := by
    intro z hz
    have hzdist : ‖z - c‖ = r := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hz
    have hlower : R ≤ ‖z‖ := by
      have htri : ‖z - c‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + ‖c‖ := norm_sub_le z c
      rw [hzdist] at htri
      have hr_R : R + ‖c‖ ≤ r := le_max_left _ _
      linarith
    have hupper : ‖z‖ ≤ 2 * r := by
      have htri : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z - c‖ + ‖c‖ := by
        calc
          ‖z‖ = ‖(z - c) + c‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖z - c‖ + ‖c‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      rw [hzdist] at htri
      linarith
    exact (hbound z hlower).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hupper (by positivity))
  have hcauchy := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le
    hr_pos hf.diffContOnCl hsphere
  calc
    ‖deriv f c‖ ≤ ((ε / 2) * (2 * r)) / r := hcauchy
    _ = ε := by field_simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.differentiable_eq_const_of_sublinearNormGrowth
statement:
theorem differentiable_eq_const_of_sublinearNormGrowth
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hgrowth : HasSublinearNormGrowth f) :
    ∃ b : ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, f z = b
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨f 0, fun z ↦ is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hf
    (deriv_eq_zero_of_sublinearNormGrowth hf hgrowth) z 0⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticNormGrowth.add_const
statement:
theorem HasSubquadraticNormGrowth.add_const
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : HasSubquadraticNormGrowth f) (c : ℂ) :
    HasSubquadraticNormGrowth (fun z => f z + c)
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨Rf, hRf, hf_bound⟩ := hf (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  let Rc : ℝ := max 1 (2 * ‖c‖ / ε)
  refine ⟨max Rf Rc, hRf.trans (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hzRf : Rf ≤ ‖z‖ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hz
  have hzRc : Rc ≤ ‖z‖ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hz
  have hz_one : 1 ≤ ‖z‖ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hzRc
  have hz_c : 2 * ‖c‖ / ε ≤ ‖z‖ :=
    le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hzRc
  have hc_linear : ‖c‖ ≤ (ε / 2) * ‖z‖ := by
    have hmul : 2 * ‖c‖ ≤ ‖z‖ * ε := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hz_c
    nlinarith
  have hnorm_sq : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]
  have hc : ‖c‖ ≤ (ε / 2) * ‖z‖ ^ 2 :=
    hc_linear.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm_sq (by positivity))
  calc
    ‖f z + c‖ ≤ ‖f z‖ + ‖c‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (ε / 2) * ‖z‖ ^ 2 + (ε / 2) * ‖z‖ ^ 2 :=
      add_le_add (hf_bound z hzRf) hc
    _ = ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticNormGrowth.sub_const
statement:
theorem HasSubquadraticNormGrowth.sub_const
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : HasSubquadraticNormGrowth f) (c : ℂ) :
    HasSubquadraticNormGrowth (fun z => f z - c)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hf.add_const (-c)

name: OverflowResidueRH.iteratedDeriv_two_eq_zero_of_subquadraticNormGrowth
statement:
theorem iteratedDeriv_two_eq_zero_of_subquadraticNormGrowth
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hgrowth : HasSubquadraticNormGrowth f) (c : ℂ) :
    iteratedDeriv 2 f c = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply norm_le_zero_iff.mp
  refine le_of_forall_gt_imp_ge_of_dense ?_
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨R, _hR, hbound⟩ := hgrowth (ε / 8) (by positivity)
  let r : ℝ := max (R + ‖c‖) (‖c‖ + 1)
  have hr_pos : 0 < r :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0 < ‖c‖ + 1) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hr_c : ‖c‖ ≤ r := by
    linarith [le_max_right (R + ‖c‖) (‖c‖ + 1)]
  have hsphere : ∀ z ∈ sphere c r,
      ‖f z‖ ≤ (ε / 8) * (2 * r) ^ 2 := by
    intro z hz
    have hzdist : ‖z - c‖ = r := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hz
    have hlower : R ≤ ‖z‖ := by
      have htri : ‖z - c‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + ‖c‖ := norm_sub_le z c
      rw [hzdist] at htri
      have hr_R : R + ‖c‖ ≤ r := le_max_left _ _
      linarith
    have hupper : ‖z‖ ≤ 2 * r := by
      have htri : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z - c‖ + ‖c‖ := by
        calc
          ‖z‖ = ‖(z - c) + c‖ := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ ‖z - c‖ + ‖c‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      rw [hzdist] at htri
      linarith
    exact (hbound z hlower).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg z) hupper 2) (by positivity))
  have hcauchy := Complex.norm_iteratedDeriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le
    2 hr_pos hf.diffContOnCl hsphere
  calc
    ‖iteratedDeriv 2 f c‖ ≤
        (Nat.factorial 2 : ℝ) * ((ε / 8) * (2 * r) ^ 2) / r ^ 2 := hcauchy
    _ = ε := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hr_pos]
      ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.differentiable_eq_affine_of_subquadraticNormGrowth
statement:
theorem differentiable_eq_affine_of_subquadraticNormGrowth
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hgrowth : HasSubquadraticNormGrowth f) :
    ∃ a b : ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, f z = a + b * z
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv_diff : Differentiable ℂ (deriv f) := by
    rw [← differentiableOn_univ]
    exact hf.differentiableOn.deriv isOpen_univ
  have hsecond : ∀ z : ℂ, deriv (deriv f) z = 0 := by
    intro z
    simpa [iteratedDeriv_succ] using
      iteratedDeriv_two_eq_zero_of_subquadraticNormGrowth hf hgrowth z
  let b : ℂ := deriv f 0
  have hderiv_const : ∀ z : ℂ, deriv f z = b := by
    intro z
    exact is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hderiv_diff hsecond z 0
  refine ⟨f 0, b, ?_⟩
  intro z
  have hlinear_diff : Differentiable ℂ (fun w : ℂ ↦ b * w) := by
    fun_prop
  have hlinear_deriv : ∀ w : ℂ, deriv (fun u : ℂ ↦ b * u) w = b := by
    intro w
    simp
  have heq : ∀ w : ℂ, f w - b * w = f 0 - b * 0 := by
    intro w
    exact is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero (hf.sub hlinear_diff)
      (fun u ↦ by rw [deriv_sub hf.differentiableAt hlinear_diff.differentiableAt,
        hderiv_const, hlinear_deriv, sub_self]) w 0
  specialize heq z
  calc
    f z = (f z - b * z) + b * z := by ring
    _ = (f 0 - b * 0) + b * z := by rw [heq]
    _ = f 0 + b * z := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.escape_exceeds_bounded_background
statement:
theorem escape_exceeds_bounded_background
    (m K eps : ℝ) (_hm : m > 0) (hK : K > 0) (hε : 0 < eps)
    (hsmall : eps < m / K) :
    m / eps > K
proof:
:= by
  rw [gt_iff_lt, lt_div_iff₀ hε]
  have hKne : K ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hK
  have : K * eps < K * (m / K) := by
    apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsmall hK
  have hKK : K * (m / K) = m := by
    field_simp
  rw [hKK] at this
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.residual_escape_positive
statement:
theorem residual_escape_positive
    (m K eps : ℝ) (hm : m > 0) (hK : K > 0) (hε : 0 < eps)
    (hsmall : eps < m / K) :
    m / eps - K > 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := escape_exceeds_bounded_background m K eps hm hK hε hsmall
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.complex_probe_subtraction
statement:
theorem complex_probe_subtraction (a b eps : ℝ) :
    ((a : ℂ) + (b - eps) * Complex.I) - ((a : ℂ) + b * Complex.I)
      = -eps * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.im_principalPart_at_lowerProbe
statement:
theorem im_principalPart_at_lowerProbe (m eps : ℝ) (hε : eps ≠ 0) :
    ((m : ℂ) / ((-eps : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im = m / eps
proof:
:= by
  have hε2 : eps^2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hε
  rw [Complex.div_im]
  rw [Complex.normSq_mul, Complex.normSq_I, mul_one]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im,
    Complex.normSq_neg, Complex.normSq_ofReal,
    mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero, add_zero, neg_zero]
  field_simp
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.im_principalPart_at_lowerProbe_pos
statement:
theorem im_principalPart_at_lowerProbe_pos
    (m eps : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < eps) :
    0 < ((m : ℂ) / ((-eps : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im
proof:
:= by
  rw [im_principalPart_at_lowerProbe m eps (ne_of_gt hε)]
  exact div_pos hm hε

name: OverflowResidueRH.upper_pole_escape_with_background_complex
statement:
theorem upper_pole_escape_with_background_complex
    (m eps K : ℝ) (B : ℂ)
    (hm : 0 < m) (hK : 0 < K) (hε : 0 < eps)
    (hsmall : eps < m / K)
    (hB : |B.im| ≤ K) :
    0 < (((m : ℂ) / ((-eps : ℂ) * Complex.I)) + B).im
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.add_im, im_principalPart_at_lowerProbe m eps (ne_of_gt hε)]
  have hescape : m / eps > K :=
    escape_exceeds_bounded_background m K eps hm hK hε hsmall
  have hB_lb : -K ≤ B.im := neg_le_of_abs_le hB
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_upper_root_forces_escape_complex
statement:
theorem polynomial_upper_root_forces_escape_complex
    (a b eps m K : ℝ) (B : ℂ)
    (_hb : 0 < b) (hm : 0 < m) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hε : 0 < eps) (_hε_lt_b : eps < b)
    (hsmall : eps < m / K)
    (hB : |B.im| ≤ K) :
    0 < (((m : ℂ) /
      (((a : ℂ) + (b - eps) * Complex.I) - ((a : ℂ) + b * Complex.I))) + B).im
proof:
:= by
  rw [complex_probe_subtraction]
  exact upper_pole_escape_with_background_complex m eps K B hm hK hε hsmall hB

name: OverflowResidueRH.exists_lowerProbe_escape_of_localLogDerivPole
statement:
theorem exists_lowerProbe_escape_of_localLogDerivPole
    {R : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (D : LocalLogDerivPoleDecomposition R ρ) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < D.ε0 ∧
      0 < (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I).im ∧
      0 < (R (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im
proof:
:= by
  have hm_real_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (D.m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast D.hm_pos
  have hmK_pos : 0 < (D.m : ℝ) / D.K := div_pos hm_real_pos D.hK_pos
  let ε : ℝ := min (D.ε0 / 2) ((D.m : ℝ) / D.K / 2)
  have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by
    refine lt_min ?_ ?_
    · linarith [D.hε0]
    · linarith
  have hε_lt_ε0 : ε < D.ε0 := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) ?_
    linarith [D.hε0]
  have hε_lt_mK : ε < (D.m : ℝ) / D.K := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) ?_
    linarith
  refine ⟨ε, hε_pos, hε_lt_ε0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h_im : (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = ρ.im - ε := by
      simp [Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re,
            Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
    rw [h_im]
    linarith [D.hε0_lt]
  · rw [D.decomp_at_probe ε hε_pos hε_lt_ε0]
    have hsub : (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I) - ρ = -(ε : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      ring
    rw [hsub]
    have hB := D.background_bounded ε hε_pos hε_lt_ε0
    exact upper_pole_escape_with_background_complex
      (D.m : ℝ) ε D.K (D.background (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      hm_real_pos D.hK_pos hε_pos hε_lt_mK hB

name: OverflowResidueRH.positiveEscape_of_localLogDerivPole
statement:
theorem positiveEscape_of_localLogDerivPole
    {R : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (D : LocalLogDerivPoleDecomposition R ρ) :
    PositiveUpperImaginaryEscape R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, _hε, _hεD, hupper, hescape⟩ :=
    exists_lowerProbe_escape_of_localLogDerivPole D
  exact ⟨ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I, hupper, hescape⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.complex_local_pole_decomposition_simple_root
statement:
theorem complex_local_pole_decomposition_simple_root
    (z ρ q dq : ℂ) (hρ : z ≠ ρ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    (q + (z - ρ) * dq) / ((z - ρ) * q)
      = 1 / (z - ρ) + dq / q
proof:
:= by
  have hρ' : z - ρ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hρ
  field_simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.complex_local_pole_decomposition_double_root
statement:
theorem complex_local_pole_decomposition_double_root
    (z ρ q dq : ℂ) (hρ : z ≠ ρ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    (2 * (z - ρ) * q + (z - ρ)^2 * dq) / ((z - ρ)^2 * q)
      = 2 / (z - ρ) + dq / q
proof:
:= by
  have hρ' : z - ρ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hρ
  have hρ'2 : (z - ρ)^2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hρ'
  field_simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.complex_local_pole_decomposition_triple_root
statement:
theorem complex_local_pole_decomposition_triple_root
    (z ρ q dq : ℂ) (hρ : z ≠ ρ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    (3 * (z - ρ)^2 * q + (z - ρ)^3 * dq) / ((z - ρ)^3 * q)
      = 3 / (z - ρ) + dq / q
proof:
:= by
  have hρ' : z - ρ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hρ
  have hρ'3 : (z - ρ)^3 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 3 hρ'
  field_simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.complex_local_pole_decomposition_general
statement:
theorem complex_local_pole_decomposition_general
    (z ρ q dq : ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hρ : z ≠ ρ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (z - ρ)^k * q + (z - ρ)^(k + 1) * dq)
      / ((z - ρ)^(k + 1) * q)
      = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) / (z - ρ) + dq / q
proof:
:= by
  have hρ' : z - ρ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hρ
  have hρ'k : (z - ρ)^k ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero k hρ'
  have hρ'sk : (z - ρ)^(k + 1) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero (k + 1) hρ'
  rw [pow_succ]
  field_simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.continuousAt_implies_probe_bounded
statement:
theorem continuousAt_implies_probe_bounded
    {B : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (hB : ContinuousAt B ρ)
    (hupper : 0 < ρ.im) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧
    ∃ ε0 : ℝ, 0 < ε0 ∧ ε0 < ρ.im ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < ε0 →
        |(B (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im| ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff] at hB
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := hB 1 zero_lt_one
  refine ⟨‖B ρ‖ + 1, by positivity,
          min (δ/2) (ρ.im / 2), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
  intro ε hε_pos hε_lt
  have hε_lt_δ : ε < δ := by
    have : ε < δ / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith
  set z : ℂ := ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I with hz_def
  have hzρ : z - ρ = -(ε : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    change ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I - ρ = -(ε : ℂ) * Complex.I
    ring
  have hnorm : ‖z - ρ‖ = ε := by
    rw [hzρ, norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
    change ‖((ε : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = ε
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact abs_of_pos hε_pos
  have hdist : dist z ρ < δ := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, hnorm]; exact hε_lt_δ
  have h_dist_B : dist (B z) (B ρ) < 1 := hδ hdist
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at h_dist_B
  have h_im : |(B z).im| ≤ ‖B z‖ := Complex.abs_im_le_norm (B z)
  have h_tri : ‖B z‖ ≤ ‖B z - B ρ‖ + ‖B ρ‖ := by
    have h_eq : B z = (B z - B ρ) + B ρ := by ring
    nth_rewrite 1 [h_eq]
    exact norm_add_le (B z - B ρ) (B ρ)
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.probe_ne_pole
statement:
theorem probe_ne_pole (ρ : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I ≠ ρ
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have him_diff : (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = ρ.im := by rw [h]
  have him_calc : (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = ρ.im - ε := by
    simp [Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  rw [him_calc] at him_diff
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.continuousAt_implies_probe_nonzero
statement:
theorem continuousAt_implies_probe_nonzero
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (hf : ContinuousAt f ρ)
    (hfρ : f ρ ≠ 0)
    (hupper : 0 < ρ.im) :
    ∃ ε0 : ℝ, 0 < ε0 ∧ ε0 < ρ.im ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < ε0 →
        f (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff] at hf
  have h_pos : 0 < ‖f ρ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hfρ
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := hf (‖f ρ‖ / 2) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨min (δ/2) (ρ.im / 2), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
  intro ε hε_pos hε_lt
  have hε_lt_δ : ε < δ := by
    have : ε < δ / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith
  set z : ℂ := ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hzρ : z - ρ = -(ε : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    change ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I - ρ = -(ε : ℂ) * Complex.I
    ring
  have hnorm : ‖z - ρ‖ = ε := by
    rw [hzρ, norm_mul, norm_neg, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
    change ‖((ε : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = ε
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact abs_of_pos hε_pos
  have hdist : dist z ρ < δ := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, hnorm]; exact hε_lt_δ
  have h_dist : dist (f z) (f ρ) < ‖f ρ‖ / 2 := hδ hdist
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at h_dist
  intro hfz
  rw [hfz] at h_dist
  simp at h_dist
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity.toProximityGrowthAtInfinity
statement:
theorem HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity.toProximityGrowthAtInfinity
    {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hgrowth : HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity f)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity f
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hbound⟩ := hgrowth ε hε
  refine ⟨R, hR, fun r hr ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [proximity_top]
  apply circleAverage_mono_on_of_le_circle
    ((continuous_posLog.comp
      (continuous_norm.comp hf)).continuousOn.circleIntegrable')
  intro z hz
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := le_trans hR hr
  have hzr : ‖z‖ = r := by
    have : dist z 0 = |r| := by
      simpa [mem_sphere] using hz
    simpa [dist_zero_right, abs_of_nonneg hr0] using this
  have hzR : R ≤ ‖z‖ := by simpa [hzr] using hr
  have hzbound := hbound z hzR
  rw [hzr] at hzbound
  exact max_le (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hε) (sq_nonneg r)) hzbound

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity.toLogNormGrowthAtInfinity
statement:
theorem HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity.toLogNormGrowthAtInfinity
    {q h : ℂ → ℂ} (hprox : HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity q)
    (hh : Differentiable ℂ h)
    (hexp : ∀ z : ℂ, Complex.exp (h z) = q z) :
    HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity q
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hprox_bound⟩ := hprox (ε / 12) (by positivity)
  let R₀ : ℝ := max 1 R
  refine ⟨R₀, le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  let r : ℝ := ‖z‖
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := le_trans (le_max_left (1 : ℝ) R) hz
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hr1
  have hRr : R ≤ 2 * r := by
    have : R ≤ r := le_trans (le_max_right (1 : ℝ) R) hz
    linarith
  have hzball : z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) (2 * r) := by
    simpa [r, mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using (show r < 2 * r by linarith)
  let u : ℂ → ℝ := fun w ↦ (h w).re
  have hu_harm : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u
      (closedBall (0 : ℂ) (2 * r)) := by
    intro w _hw
    exact (hh.analyticAt w).harmonicAt_re
  have hpoisson := hu_harm.circleAverage_poissonKernel_smul hzball
  have hqdiff : Differentiable ℂ q := by
    have hfun : (fun w : ℂ ↦ Complex.exp (h w)) = q := funext hexp
    rw [← hfun]
    exact hh.cexp
  have hposInt : CircleIntegrable (fun w : ℂ ↦ log⁺ ‖q w‖)
      0 (2 * r) :=
    (continuous_posLog.comp
      (continuous_norm.comp hqdiff.continuous)).continuousOn.circleIntegrable'
  have hden : ∀ w ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) |2 * r|, w - z ≠ 0 := by
    intro w hw hwz
    have hw_eq : w = z := sub_eq_zero.mp hwz
    subst w
    have hz_norm : ‖z‖ = |2 * r| := by
      simpa [mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hw
    rw [show ‖z‖ = r from rfl,
      abs_of_pos (show 0 < 2 * r by positivity)] at hz_norm
    linarith
  have hleftInt : CircleIntegrable (poissonKernel 0 z • u) 0 (2 * r) := by
    change CircleIntegrable (fun w ↦ poissonKernel 0 z w * u w) 0 (2 * r)
    apply ContinuousOn.circleIntegrable'
    apply ContinuousOn.mul
    · rw [poissonKernel_eq_re_herglotzRieszKernel]
      simp only [Function.comp_def, herglotzRieszKernel_def]
      intro w hw
      have hwden : w - 0 - (z - 0) ≠ 0 := by simpa using hden w hw
      apply Complex.continuous_re.continuousAt.comp_continuousWithinAt
      exact ((continuousAt_id.sub continuousAt_const).add
        (continuousAt_const.sub continuousAt_const)).div
          ((continuousAt_id.sub continuousAt_const).sub
            (continuousAt_const.sub continuousAt_const)) hwden |>.continuousWithinAt
    · exact (Complex.continuous_re.comp hh.continuous).continuousOn
  have hpointwise : ∀ w ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) |2 * r|,
      (poissonKernel 0 z • u) w ≤ 3 * log⁺ ‖q w‖ := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : w ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) (2 * r) := by
      simpa [abs_of_pos (show 0 < 2 * r by positivity)] using hw
    have hk_le : poissonKernel 0 z w ≤ 3 := by
      rw [poissonKernel_eq_re_herglotzRieszKernel]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, herglotzRieszKernel_def, sub_zero]
      have hk := re_herglotzRieszKernel_le hw' hzball
      calc
        ((w + z) / (w - z)).re ≤
            (2 * r + ‖z‖) / (2 * r - ‖z‖) := by
          simpa using hk
        _ = 3 := by
          rw [show ‖z‖ = r from rfl]
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hr_pos]
          ring
    have hk_nonneg : 0 ≤ poissonKernel 0 z w := by
      rw [poissonKernel_eq_re_herglotzRieszKernel]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, herglotzRieszKernel_def, sub_zero]
      have hk := le_re_herglotzRieszKernel hw' hzball
      calc
        0 ≤ (2 * r - ‖z‖) / (2 * r + ‖z‖) := by
          rw [show ‖z‖ = r from rfl]
          apply div_nonneg <;> linarith
        _ ≤ ((w + z) / (w - z)).re := by simpa using hk
    have hu_log : u w = log ‖q w‖ := by
      dsimp [u]
      rw [← hexp w, Complex.norm_exp, Real.log_exp]
    have hu_le : u w ≤ log⁺ ‖q w‖ := by
      rw [hu_log]
      exact le_max_right _ _
    change poissonKernel 0 z w * u w ≤ 3 * log⁺ ‖q w‖
    calc
      poissonKernel 0 z w * u w ≤
          poissonKernel 0 z w * log⁺ ‖q w‖ := by gcongr
      _ ≤ 3 * log⁺ ‖q w‖ := by gcongr; exact posLog_nonneg
  have havg : circleAverage (poissonKernel 0 z • u) 0 (2 * r) ≤
      circleAverage (fun w : ℂ ↦ 3 * log⁺ ‖q w‖) 0 (2 * r) := by
    apply circleAverage_mono hleftInt
    · simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hposInt.const_fun_smul (a := (3 : ℝ))
    · exact hpointwise
  have hprox_z : proximity q ⊤ (2 * r) ≤ (ε / 12) * (2 * r) ^ 2 :=
    hprox_bound (2 * r) hRr
  calc
    log ‖q z‖ = u z := by
      dsimp [u]
      rw [← hexp z, Complex.norm_exp, Real.log_exp]
    _ = circleAverage (poissonKernel 0 z • u) 0 (2 * r) := hpoisson.symm
    _ ≤ circleAverage (fun w : ℂ ↦ 3 * log⁺ ‖q w‖) 0 (2 * r) := havg
    _ = 3 * proximity q ⊤ (2 * r) := by
      calc
        circleAverage (fun w : ℂ ↦ 3 * log⁺ ‖q w‖) 0 (2 * r) =
            3 * circleAverage (fun w : ℂ ↦ log⁺ ‖q w‖) 0 (2 * r) := by
          simpa [smul_eq_mul] using
            (circleAverage_fun_smul (f := fun w : ℂ ↦ log⁺ ‖q w‖)
              (c := 0) (R := 2 * r) (a := (3 : ℝ)))
        _ = 3 * proximity q ⊤ (2 * r) := by rw [proximity_top]
    _ ≤ 3 * ((ε / 12) * (2 * r) ^ 2) := by gcongr
    _ = ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by dsimp [r]; ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticCharacteristicGrowthAtInfinity.toProximityGrowthAtInfinity
statement:
theorem
    HasSubquadraticCharacteristicGrowthAtInfinity.toProximityGrowthAtInfinity
    {f : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hgrowth : HasSubquadraticCharacteristicGrowthAtInfinity f) :
    HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity f
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hbound⟩ := hgrowth ε hε
  let R₀ : ℝ := max 1 R
  refine ⟨R₀, le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_left _ _), fun r hr ↦ ?_⟩
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := le_trans (le_max_left (1 : ℝ) R) hr
  have hrR : R ≤ r := le_trans (le_max_right (1 : ℝ) R) hr
  have hcount : 0 ≤ logCounting f ⊤ r := logCounting_nonneg hr1
  have hchar := hbound r hrR
  simp only [characteristic, Pi.add_apply] at hchar
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity.toCharacteristicGrowthAtInfinity_of_analytic
statement:
theorem
    HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity.toCharacteristicGrowthAtInfinity_of_analytic
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hgrowth : HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity f)
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f univ) :
    HasSubquadraticCharacteristicGrowthAtInfinity f
proof:
:= by
  have hcount : logCounting f ⊤ = 0 := by
    rw [logCounting_top]
    rw [negPart_eq_zero.mpr
      (MeromorphicOn.AnalyticOnNhd.divisor_nonneg hf)]
    exact map_zero _
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hbound⟩ := hgrowth ε hε
  exact ⟨R, hR, fun r hr ↦ by
    simpa [characteristic, hcount] using hbound r hr⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.hasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity_of_proximity_and_characteristic
statement:
theorem
    hasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity_of_proximity_and_characteristic
    {f g q : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hfmer : Meromorphic f) (hgmer : Meromorphic g)
    (hquot : q =ᶠ[codiscrete ℂ] f * g⁻¹)
    (hfprox : HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity f)
    (hgchar : HasSubquadraticCharacteristicGrowthAtInfinity g) :
    HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity q
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨Rf, hRf, hfbound⟩ := hfprox (ε / 4) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨Rg, hRg, hgbound⟩ := hgchar (ε / 4) (by positivity)
  let C : ℝ := max |log ‖g 0‖| |log ‖meromorphicTrailingCoeffAt g 0‖|
  let Rc : ℝ := max 1 (2 * C / ε)
  let R : ℝ := max Rf (max Rg Rc)
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    exact le_max_of_le_left (abs_nonneg _)
  have hRnonneg : 0 ≤ R := hRf.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  refine ⟨R, hRnonneg, ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  have hrRf : Rf ≤ r := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hr
  have hrRg : Rg ≤ r :=
    le_trans (le_max_left Rg Rc) (le_trans (le_max_right Rf _) hr)
  have hrRc : Rc ≤ r :=
    le_trans (le_max_right Rg Rc) (le_trans (le_max_right Rf _) hr)
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := le_trans (le_max_left (1 : ℝ) _) hrRc
  have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hr1)
  have hClinear : C ≤ (ε / 2) * r := by
    have hCr : 2 * C / ε ≤ r :=
      le_trans (le_max_right (1 : ℝ) (2 * C / ε)) hrRc
    have hmul : 2 * C ≤ r * ε := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hCr
    nlinarith
  have hr_sq : r ≤ r ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hCsq : C ≤ (ε / 2) * r ^ 2 :=
    hClinear.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_sq (by positivity))
  have hcongr : proximity q ⊤ r = proximity (f * g⁻¹) ⊤ r :=
    proximity_congr_codiscrete hquot hr_ne
  have hmul := proximity_mul_top_le hfmer hgmer.inv r
  have hginvprox : proximity g⁻¹ ⊤ r ≤ characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r := by
    have hcount : 0 ≤ logCounting g⁻¹ ⊤ r := logCounting_nonneg hr1
    simp only [characteristic, Pi.add_apply]
    linarith
  have hfirst := characteristic_sub_characteristic_inv_le hgmer (R := r)
  have hginvchar : characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r ≤
      characteristic g ⊤ r + C := by
    have hdiff : characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r - characteristic g ⊤ r ≤ C := by
      calc
        characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r - characteristic g ⊤ r ≤
            |characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r - characteristic g ⊤ r| :=
          le_abs_self _
        _ = |characteristic g ⊤ r - characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r| :=
          abs_sub_comm _ _
        _ ≤ C := hfirst
    linarith
  calc
    proximity q ⊤ r = proximity (f * g⁻¹) ⊤ r := hcongr
    _ ≤ proximity f ⊤ r + proximity g⁻¹ ⊤ r := hmul
    _ ≤ proximity f ⊤ r + characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r := by
      gcongr
    _ ≤ proximity f ⊤ r + (characteristic g ⊤ r + C) := by
      linarith
    _ ≤ (ε / 4) * r ^ 2 + ((ε / 4) * r ^ 2 + C) :=
      add_le_add (hfbound r hrRf) (by linarith [hgbound r hrRg])
    _ ≤ (ε / 4) * r ^ 2 +
        ((ε / 4) * r ^ 2 + (ε / 2) * r ^ 2) := by
      gcongr
    _ = ε * r ^ 2 := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.hasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity_of_characteristic_factors
statement:
theorem hasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity_of_characteristic_factors
    {f g q : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hfmer : Meromorphic f) (hgmer : Meromorphic g)
    (hquot : q =ᶠ[codiscrete ℂ] f * g⁻¹)
    (hfchar : HasSubquadraticCharacteristicGrowthAtInfinity f)
    (hgchar : HasSubquadraticCharacteristicGrowthAtInfinity g) :
    HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity q
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨Rf, hRf, hfbound⟩ := hfchar (ε / 4) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨Rg, hRg, hgbound⟩ := hgchar (ε / 4) (by positivity)
  let C : ℝ := max |log ‖g 0‖| |log ‖meromorphicTrailingCoeffAt g 0‖|
  let Rc : ℝ := max 1 (2 * C / ε)
  let R : ℝ := max Rf (max Rg Rc)
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    exact le_max_of_le_left (abs_nonneg _)
  have hRnonneg : 0 ≤ R := hRf.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  refine ⟨R, hRnonneg, ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  have hrRf : Rf ≤ r := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hr
  have hrRg : Rg ≤ r :=
    le_trans (le_max_left Rg Rc) (le_trans (le_max_right Rf _) hr)
  have hrRc : Rc ≤ r :=
    le_trans (le_max_right Rg Rc) (le_trans (le_max_right Rf _) hr)
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := le_trans (le_max_left (1 : ℝ) _) hrRc
  have hr_ne : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hr1)
  have hClinear : C ≤ (ε / 2) * r := by
    have hCr : 2 * C / ε ≤ r :=
      le_trans (le_max_right (1 : ℝ) (2 * C / ε)) hrRc
    have hmul : 2 * C ≤ r * ε := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hCr
    nlinarith
  have hr_sq : r ≤ r ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hCsq : C ≤ (ε / 2) * r ^ 2 :=
    hClinear.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr_sq (by positivity))
  have hcongr : proximity q ⊤ r = proximity (f * g⁻¹) ⊤ r :=
    proximity_congr_codiscrete hquot hr_ne
  have hmul := proximity_mul_top_le hfmer hgmer.inv r
  have hfprox : proximity f ⊤ r ≤ characteristic f ⊤ r := by
    have hcount : 0 ≤ logCounting f ⊤ r := logCounting_nonneg hr1
    simp only [characteristic, Pi.add_apply]
    linarith
  have hginvprox : proximity g⁻¹ ⊤ r ≤ characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r := by
    have hcount : 0 ≤ logCounting g⁻¹ ⊤ r := logCounting_nonneg hr1
    simp only [characteristic, Pi.add_apply]
    linarith
  have hfirst := characteristic_sub_characteristic_inv_le hgmer (R := r)
  have hginvchar : characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r ≤ characteristic g ⊤ r + C := by
    have hdiff : characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r - characteristic g ⊤ r ≤ C := by
      calc
        characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r - characteristic g ⊤ r ≤
            |characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r - characteristic g ⊤ r| :=
          le_abs_self _
        _ = |characteristic g ⊤ r - characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r| :=
          abs_sub_comm _ _
        _ ≤ C := hfirst
    linarith
  calc
    proximity q ⊤ r = proximity (f * g⁻¹) ⊤ r := hcongr
    _ ≤ proximity f ⊤ r + proximity g⁻¹ ⊤ r := hmul
    _ ≤ characteristic f ⊤ r + characteristic g⁻¹ ⊤ r :=
      add_le_add hfprox hginvprox
    _ ≤ characteristic f ⊤ r + (characteristic g ⊤ r + C) := by
      linarith
    _ ≤ (ε / 4) * r ^ 2 + ((ε / 4) * r ^ 2 + C) :=
      add_le_add (hfbound r hrRf) (by linarith [hgbound r hrRg])
    _ ≤ (ε / 4) * r ^ 2 +
        ((ε / 4) * r ^ 2 + (ε / 2) * r ^ 2) := by
      gcongr
    _ = ε * r ^ 2 := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.errorMargin_at_XiPullback_zero_of_decomp

theorem cloudModel_im_nonpos (zeros : List ℝ) {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :

proof:
:= by
  unfold cloudModel
  induction zeros with
  | nil => simp
  | cons g rest ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    rw [Complex.add_im]
    have h1 : ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (g : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (g : ℂ))).im ≤ 0 :=
      paired_cauchy_kernel_im_nonpos_at z g hz
    linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothDensityTail_integrand_im_nonpos
statement:
lemma smoothDensityTail_integrand_im_nonpos
    (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (T u : ℝ) {z : ℂ}
    (hTu : T ≤ u)
    (hρ : ∀ v, T ≤ v → 0 ≤ ρ v)
    (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    (((ρ u : ℂ) *
        ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))).im) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hρu : 0 ≤ ρ u := hρ u hTu
  
  have hk_eq : (1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))
             = pairedCauchyKernel u z := rfl
  have hk : ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))).im ≤ 0 := by
    rw [hk_eq]
    exact pairedCauchyKernel_im_nonpos_at z u hz
  
  have him_eq :
      (((ρ u : ℂ) *
        ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))).im)
        = ρ u * ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))).im := by
    simp [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  rw [him_eq]
  exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hρu hk

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothDensityTailModelPartial_im_nonpos
statement:
lemma smoothDensityTailModelPartial_im_nonpos
    (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (T X : ℝ) {z : ℂ}
    (hTX : T ≤ X) (hz : 0 < z.im)
    (hρ_nonneg : ∀ u, T ≤ u → 0 ≤ ρ u)
    (hInt :
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u =>
          (ρ u : ℂ) *
            ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))))
        MeasureTheory.volume T X) :
    (smoothDensityTailModelPartial ρ T X z).im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothDensityTailModelPartial
  
  have h_imCLM_comm := Complex.imCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm
    (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (a := T) (b := X) hInt
  
  have him_eq :
      (∫ u in T..X,
        (ρ u : ℂ) *
          ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))).im
        =
      ∫ u in T..X,
        ((ρ u : ℂ) *
          ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))).im := by
    simpa [Complex.imCLM_apply] using h_imCLM_comm.symm
  rw [him_eq]
  
  have h_neg_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ∫ u in T..X,
        -(((ρ u : ℂ) *
            ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))).im) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hTX
    intro u hu
    have hTu : T ≤ u := hu.1
    have hpt := smoothDensityTail_integrand_im_nonpos ρ T u hTu hρ_nonneg hz
    linarith
  have h_int_neg :
      (∫ u in T..X,
        -(((ρ u : ℂ) *
            ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))).im))
        =
      -(∫ u in T..X,
        ((ρ u : ℂ) *
          ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))).im) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_neg
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothDensityTailModel_converges_at_UHP
statement:
theorem smoothDensityTailModel_converges_at_UHP
    (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (T : ℝ)
    (H : SmoothDensityTailMajorantDataUHP ρ T)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    ∃ L : ℂ,

        (fun X : ℝ => smoothDensityTailModelPartial ρ T X z)
        Filter.atTop (𝓝 L)
proof:
:= by
  rcases H.majorant_converges z hz with ⟨LM, hLM⟩
  exact improperComplexIntegralConverges_of_normMajorant
    (f := fun u =>
      (ρ u : ℂ) *
        ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))))
    (M := H.majorant z) (T := T) (LM := LM)
    (fun X hTX => H.integrand_intervalIntegrable z X hz hTX)
    (fun X hTX => H.majorant_intervalIntegrable z X hz hTX)
    hLM
    (H.norm_bound_eventually z hz)

theorem cloudModel_neg_im (zeros : List ℝ) (x y : ℝ) :

    have hL :
        cloudModel (g :: rest) ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)
          = (1 / (((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (g : ℂ))
             + 1 / (((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) + (g : ℂ)))
            + cloudModel rest ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      simp [cloudModel, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have hR :
        cloudImNegSum (g :: rest) x y
          = (y / ((x - g)^2 + y^2) + y / ((x + g)^2 + y^2))
            + cloudImNegSum rest x y := by
      simp [cloudImNegSum, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    rw [hL, hR, Complex.add_im]
    have h_single := paired_cauchy_kernel_im_eq x y g
    have h_dist :
        -y * (1 / ((x - g)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + g)^2 + y^2))
          = -(y / ((x - g)^2 + y^2) + y / ((x + g)^2 + y^2)) := by ring
    linarith [h_single, h_dist, ih]

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_entireRiemannXi_le_factorial
statement:
theorem norm_entireRiemannXi_le_factorial
    (s : ℂ) (n : ℕ)
    (hupper : (s / 2).re - 1 ≤ n)
    (hlower : -(n : ℝ) - 2 ≤ (s / 2).re - 1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    ‖entireRiemannXi s‖ ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖s‖ * ‖s - 1‖ *
        (hurwitzThetaMellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.A *
          ((1 / hurwitzThetaMellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.p) ^
            (n + 1 : ℝ) * n.factorial)) + 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [entireRiemannXi]
  calc
    ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ) * s * (s - 1) * completedRiemannZeta₀ s + (1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ ≤
        ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ) * s * (s - 1) * completedRiemannZeta₀ s‖ +
          ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖s‖ * ‖s - 1‖ * ‖completedRiemannZeta₀ s‖ +
          1 / 2 := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul]
      norm_num [Complex.norm_real]
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖s‖ * ‖s - 1‖ *
        (hurwitzThetaMellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.A *
          ((1 / hurwitzThetaMellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.p) ^
            (n + 1 : ℝ) * n.factorial)) + 1 / 2 := by
      gcongr
      exact norm_completedRiemannZeta₀_le_factorial s n hupper hlower

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_entireXiPullback_le_factorial_of_norm_le_nat
statement:
theorem norm_entireXiPullback_le_factorial_of_norm_le_nat
    (z : ℂ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ n) :
    ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (‖z‖ + 1 / 2) ^ 2 *
        (hurwitzThetaMellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.A *
          ((1 / hurwitzThetaMellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.p) ^
            (n + 1 : ℝ) * n.factorial)) + 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℂ := (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z
  have hs_norm : ‖s‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + 1 / 2 := by
    dsimp [s]
    calc
      ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z‖ ≤ ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ + ‖Complex.I * z‖ :=
        norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖z‖ + 1 / 2 := by
        rw [norm_mul, norm_I, one_mul]
        norm_num [Complex.norm_real]
        ring
  have hs_sub_norm : ‖s - 1‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + 1 / 2 := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [show (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z - 1 =
      -(1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z by ring]
    calc
      ‖-(1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z‖ ≤ ‖-(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ + ‖Complex.I * z‖ :=
        norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖z‖ + 1 / 2 := by
        rw [norm_neg, norm_mul, norm_I, one_mul]
        norm_num [Complex.norm_real]
        ring
  have hs_half_norm : ‖s / 2‖ ≤ n := by
    calc
      ‖s / 2‖ = ‖s‖ / 2 := by rw [norm_div, Complex.norm_two]
      _ ≤ (‖z‖ + 1 / 2) / 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hs_norm (by norm_num)
      _ ≤ n := by
        have hnR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
        nlinarith
  have hupper : (s / 2).re - 1 ≤ n := by
    calc
      (s / 2).re - 1 ≤ ‖s / 2‖ - 1 := sub_le_sub_right (Complex.re_le_norm _) _
      _ ≤ n := by linarith
  have hlower : -(n : ℝ) - 2 ≤ (s / 2).re - 1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    have hre : -(n : ℝ) ≤ (s / 2).re := by
      calc
        -(n : ℝ) ≤ -‖s / 2‖ := neg_le_neg hs_half_norm
        _ ≤ (s / 2).re := neg_le_of_abs_le (abs_re_le_norm (s / 2))
    linarith
  rw [EntireXiPullback]
  refine (norm_entireRiemannXi_le_factorial s n hupper hlower).trans ?_
  have hprod : ‖s‖ * ‖s - 1‖ ≤ (‖z‖ + 1 / 2) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖s‖ * ‖s - 1‖ ≤ (‖z‖ + 1 / 2) * (‖z‖ + 1 / 2) := by
        gcongr
      _ = (‖z‖ + 1 / 2) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hfactor : 0 ≤
      hurwitzThetaMellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.A *
        ((1 / hurwitzThetaMellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.p) ^
          (n + 1 : ℝ) * n.factorial) := by
    exact mul_nonneg hurwitzThetaMellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.A_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg
        (Real.rpow_nonneg
          (div_nonneg (by norm_num)
            hurwitzThetaMellinTwoSidedExponentialDecay.p_pos.le) _)
        (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  simpa [add_comm, mul_assoc] using
    (add_le_add_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod
          (show 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) by norm_num)) hfactor) (1 / 2 : ℝ))

name: OverflowResidueRH.antiHerglotz_im_le_zero_of_verticalEnergyIdentity_and_monotone
statement:
theorem antiHerglotz_im_le_zero_of_verticalEnergyIdentity_and_monotone
    (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hId : VerticalEnergyIdentityAwayFromZeros F)
    (hMono :
      ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < y → F (verticalLine x y) ≠ 0 →
        0 ≤ deriv (fun yy : ℝ => ‖F (verticalLine x yy)‖ ^ 2) y) :
    ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → F z ≠ 0 →
      (logDerivativeResponse F z).im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz hFz
  have hzline : verticalLine z.re z.im = z := verticalLine_re_im z
  have hFne : F (verticalLine z.re z.im) ≠ 0 := by rw [hzline]; exact hFz
  have hIdz := hId z.re z.im hz hFne
  have hMonoz := hMono z.re z.im hz hFne
  unfold VerticalEnergyIdentityAt at hIdz
  rw [hIdz, hzline] at hMonoz
  have hF_norm_pos : 0 < ‖F z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hFz
  have hF_norm_sq_pos : 0 < ‖F z‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  nlinarith [hMonoz, hF_norm_sq_pos]

name: OverflowResidueRH.energy_logDeriv_algebra
statement:
theorem energy_logDeriv_algebra
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) {z : ℂ}
    (hFz : F z ≠ 0) :
    2 * ((star (F z)) * (Complex.I * deriv F z)).re
      = -2 * ‖F z‖ ^ 2 * (logDerivativeResponse F z).im
proof:
:= by
  unfold logDerivativeResponse
  rw [Complex.sq_norm]
  have hF_normSq_pos : 0 < Complex.normSq (F z) := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hFz
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.div_im,
             Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im,
             Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.normSq_apply]
  have hF_re_im_pos : 0 < (F z).re * (F z).re + (F z).im * (F z).im := by
    have h_eq : Complex.normSq (F z) =
                (F z).re * (F z).re + (F z).im * (F z).im :=
      Complex.normSq_apply _
    linarith [hF_normSq_pos, h_eq.symm.le, h_eq.le]
  have hF_re_im_ne : (F z).re * (F z).re + (F z).im * (F z).im ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt hF_re_im_pos
  have hsq_ne : (F z).re ^ 2 + (F z).im ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    have h := hF_re_im_pos; rw [← pow_two, ← pow_two] at h; exact h.ne'
  field_simp [hsq_ne]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.hasDerivAt_norm_sq_complex
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_norm_sq_complex
    {g : ℝ → ℂ} {y : ℝ} {g' : ℂ}
    (hg : HasDerivAt g g' y) :
    HasDerivAt (fun yy : ℝ => ‖g yy‖ ^ 2)
      (2 * ((star (g y)) * g').re) y
proof:
:= by
  
  have hg_re : HasDerivAt (fun yy : ℝ => (g yy).re) g'.re y :=
    Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt y hg
  have hg_im : HasDerivAt (fun yy : ℝ => (g yy).im) g'.im y :=
    Complex.imCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt y hg
  
  have hre_sq : HasDerivAt (fun yy : ℝ => (g yy).re ^ 2)
                  (2 * (g y).re * g'.re) y := by
    convert hg_re.pow 2 using 2
    simp
  have him_sq : HasDerivAt (fun yy : ℝ => (g yy).im ^ 2)
                  (2 * (g y).im * g'.im) y := by
    convert hg_im.pow 2 using 2
    simp
  
  have hsum := hre_sq.add him_sq
  
  have h_fun_eq : (fun yy : ℝ => ‖g yy‖ ^ 2) =
                  (fun yy : ℝ => (g yy).re ^ 2 + (g yy).im ^ 2) := by
    funext yy
    rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
    ring
  
  have h_deriv_eq : 2 * (g y).re * g'.re + 2 * (g y).im * g'.im
                    = 2 * ((star (g y)) * g').re := by
    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re,
               Complex.conj_im, neg_mul]
    ring
  rw [h_fun_eq, ← h_deriv_eq]
  exact hsum

name: OverflowResidueRH.VerticalEnergyIdentityAwayFromZeros_of_hasDerivAt_vertical
statement:
theorem VerticalEnergyIdentityAwayFromZeros_of_hasDerivAt_vertical
    (F : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hvert :
      ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < y → F (verticalLine x y) ≠ 0 →
        HasDerivAt (fun yy : ℝ => F (verticalLine x yy))
          (Complex.I * deriv F (verticalLine x y)) y) :
    VerticalEnergyIdentityAwayFromZeros F
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hy hFne
  unfold VerticalEnergyIdentityAt
  
  have hg : HasDerivAt (fun yy : ℝ => F (verticalLine x yy))
              (Complex.I * deriv F (verticalLine x y)) y :=
    hvert x y hy hFne
  
  have h_energy := hasDerivAt_norm_sq_complex hg
  have h_deriv_eq : deriv (fun yy : ℝ => ‖F (verticalLine x yy)‖ ^ 2) y
                    = 2 * ((star (F (verticalLine x y)))
                            * (Complex.I * deriv F (verticalLine x y))).re :=
    h_energy.deriv
  
  have h_alg :
      2 * ((star (F (verticalLine x y)))
            * (Complex.I * deriv F (verticalLine x y))).re
        = -2 * ‖F (verticalLine x y)‖ ^ 2
            * (logDerivativeResponse F (verticalLine x y)).im :=
    energy_logDeriv_algebra F hFne
  rw [h_deriv_eq, h_alg]

name: OverflowResidueRH.hasDerivAt_verticalLine
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_verticalLine (x y : ℝ) :

  have h_real : HasDerivAt (fun yy : ℝ => (yy : ℂ)) (1 : ℂ) y := by

statement:
theorem XiPullback_vertical_hasDerivAt
    (hdiff : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → DifferentiableAt ℂ XiPullback z) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < y → XiPullback (verticalLine x y) ≠ 0 →
      HasDerivAt (fun yy : ℝ => XiPullback (verticalLine x yy))
        (Complex.I * deriv XiPullback (verticalLine x y)) y
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hy _
  
  have h_inner : HasDerivAt (fun yy : ℝ => verticalLine x yy) Complex.I y :=
    hasDerivAt_verticalLine x y

    rw [verticalLine_im]; exact hy

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireRiemannXi_deriv_one_sub
statement:
theorem entireRiemannXi_deriv_one_sub (s : ℂ) :
    deriv entireRiemannXi (1 - s) = -deriv entireRiemannXi s
proof:
:= by
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => 1 - w) (-1) s :=
    by
      convert (hasDerivAt_const s (1 : ℂ)).sub (hasDerivAt_id s) using 1
      all_goals first
        | rfl
        | simp only [zero_sub]
  have houter : HasDerivAt entireRiemannXi
      (deriv entireRiemannXi (1 - s)) (1 - s) :=
    (entireRiemannXi_differentiableAt (1 - s)).hasDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasDerivAt
      (fun w : ℂ => entireRiemannXi (1 - w))
      (deriv entireRiemannXi (1 - s) * (-1)) s := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using houter.comp s hinner
  have hfun : (fun w : ℂ => entireRiemannXi (1 - w)) = entireRiemannXi :=
    funext entireRiemannXi_one_sub
  have hderiv_fun :
      deriv (fun w : ℂ => entireRiemannXi (1 - w)) s =
        deriv entireRiemannXi s :=
    congrArg (fun f : ℂ → ℂ => deriv f s) hfun
  have hderiv :
      deriv entireRiemannXi s =
        deriv entireRiemannXi (1 - s) * (-1) := by
    rw [← hderiv_fun]
    exact hcomp.deriv
  have hderiv' :
      deriv entireRiemannXi s = -deriv entireRiemannXi (1 - s) := by
    simpa using hderiv
  have hneg := congrArg Neg.neg hderiv'
  simpa using hneg.symm

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXi_rightHalfPlaneStrictLogDerivSign_iff_pullback
statement:
theorem entireXi_rightHalfPlaneStrictLogDerivSign_iff_pullback :
    EntireXi.rightHalfPlaneStrictLogDerivSign ↔
      EntireXiPullback.StrictAntiHerglotzSign
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hright z hz
    rw [EntireXiPullback_logDeriv_chain_rule,
      Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      zero_mul, zero_add, one_mul]
    let s : ℂ := (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z
    have hs_left : s.re < (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      change ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z).re < (1 / 2 : ℝ)
      rw [critical_shift_re]
      linarith
    have hone_right : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < (1 - s).re := by
      rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]
      linarith
    have hpos := hright (1 - s) hone_right
    have hfe := congrArg Complex.re (entireRiemannXi_logDeriv_one_sub s)
    rw [Complex.neg_re] at hfe
    change (deriv entireRiemannXi s / entireRiemannXi s).re < 0
    linarith
  · intro hpull s hs
    let u : ℂ := 1 - s
    let z : ℂ := -Complex.I * (u - (1 / 2 : ℂ))
    have hu_left : u.re < (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      change (1 - s).re < (1 / 2 : ℝ)
      rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]
      linarith
    have hshift : (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z = u := by
      dsimp [z]
      ring_nf
      rw [Complex.I_sq]
      ring
    have hz : 0 < z.im := by
      have hre := critical_shift_re z
      rw [hshift] at hre
      linarith
    have hneg := hpull z hz
    rw [EntireXiPullback_logDeriv_chain_rule,
      Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      zero_mul, zero_add, one_mul, hshift] at hneg
    have hone : 1 - u = s := by
      dsimp [u]
      ring
    have hfe := congrArg Complex.re (entireRiemannXi_logDeriv_one_sub u)
    rw [hone, Complex.neg_re] at hfe
    linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiPullbackExpAffineHadamardData.zero_iff_origin_or_exists_zeroLoc
statement:
theorem EntireXiPullbackExpAffineHadamardData.zero_iff_origin_or_exists_zeroLoc
    (H : EntireXiPullbackExpAffineHadamardData) (z : ℂ) :
    EntireXiPullback z = 0 ↔
      (z = 0 ∧ H.originMultiplicity ≠ 0) ∨
        ∃ i : ℕ, z = H.zeroLoc i
proof:
:= by
  rw [H.factorization]
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hzero with hpow | hbase
    · left
      have hz : z = 0 := by
        by_contra hz
        exact (pow_ne_zero H.originMultiplicity hz) hpow
      refine ⟨hz, ?_⟩
      intro hm
      rw [hm] at hpow
      simp at hpow
    · right
      by_contra hindexed
      push Not at hindexed
      have hpref_ne : H.C * Complex.exp (H.a + H.b * z) ≠ 0 :=
        mul_ne_zero H.constant_ne_zero (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
      have hprod_ne : infiniteHadamardProduct H.zeroLoc z ≠ 0 :=
        H.zeroData.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability.infiniteProduct_ne_zero hindexed
      exact (mul_ne_zero hpref_ne hprod_ne) hbase
  · rintro (⟨rfl, hm⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · simp [expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity, hm]
    · unfold expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
      unfold expAffineGenusOneProduct
      rw [infiniteHadamardProduct_eq_zero_at_zeroLoc H.zeroData.zero_ne i]
      simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.riemannHypothesis_iff_entireXiPullback_strictAntiHerglotz
statement:
theorem riemannHypothesis_iff_entireXiPullback_strictAntiHerglotz
    (H : EntireXiPullbackExpAffineHadamardData) :
    RiemannHypothesis ↔ EntireXiPullback.StrictAntiHerglotzSign
proof:
:= by
  have hpull_schwarz : ∀ z : ℂ,
      EntireXiPullback (star z) = star (EntireXiPullback z) :=
    EntireXiPullback_schwarz
      (EntireRiemannXiRegularity_of_schwarz EntireXi.schwarzReflection_holds)
  constructor
  · intro hRH
    have hreal : ∀ z : ℂ, EntireXiPullback z = 0 → z.im = 0 :=
      riemannHypothesis_iff_entireXiPullback_zeros_real.mp hRH
    have hproduct_schwarz : ∀ z : ℂ,
        expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
            H.originMultiplicity H.C H.a H.b H.zeroLoc (star z) =
          star (expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
            H.originMultiplicity H.C H.a H.b H.zeroLoc z) := by
      simpa only [← H.factorization] using hpull_schwarz
    have hproduct_zeros : ∀ z : ℂ,
        expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
            H.originMultiplicity H.C H.a H.b H.zeroLoc z = 0 →
          z.im = 0 := by
      simpa only [← H.factorization] using hreal
    have hproduct_sign :=
      (expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_zeros_real_of_schwarz
        H.originMultiplicity H.constant_ne_zero H.zeroLoc H.zeroData
        hproduct_schwarz).mpr hproduct_zeros
    simpa only [EntireXiPullback.StrictAntiHerglotzSign,
      ← H.factorization] using hproduct_sign
  · intro hpull
    apply riemannHypothesis_iff_entireXiPullback_zeros_real.mpr
    exact entire_function_roots_real_of_analytic_nontrivial
      EntireXiPullback
      (fun z _hz => EntireXiPullback_analyticAt z)
      EntireXiPullback_nontrivial_holds
      (fun z hz _hz_nonzero => hpull.antiHerglotz z hz)
      hpull_schwarz

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient_neg
statement:
theorem entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient_neg
    (H : EntireXiPullbackCanonicalZeroDistribution) (z : ℂ) :
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient (-z) =
      entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient z
proof:
:= by
  let z₀ : ℂ := Complex.I / 2
  have hz₀_ne : z₀ ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [z₀]
    exact div_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero (by norm_num)
  have hFz₀ : EntireXiPullback z₀ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show EntireXiPullback z₀ = (1 / 2 : ℂ) by
      simpa only [z₀] using EntireXiPullback_apply_I_div_two]
    norm_num
  have hz₀loc : ∀ i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence,
      z₀ ≠ entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i := by
    intro i hzi
    apply hFz₀
    rw [hzi]
    exact entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc_is_zero i
  have hPz₀ : entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct z₀ ≠ 0 :=
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_ne_zero_of_away H hz₀_ne hz₀loc
  have hPevent : ∀ᶠ w in nhds z₀,
      entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct w ≠ 0 :=
    ((entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_differentiable H) z₀).continuousAt
      |>.eventually_ne hPz₀
  have hqevent :
      (fun w : ℂ ↦ entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient (-w)) =ᶠ[nhds z₀]
        entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient := by
    filter_upwards [hPevent] with w hPw
    have hneg :=
      EntireXiPullback_eq_canonicalQuotient_mul_canonicalProduct H (-w)
    have hpos :=
      EntireXiPullback_eq_canonicalQuotient_mul_canonicalProduct H w
    rw [entireXiPullback_neg,
      entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_neg] at hneg
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hPw (hneg.symm.trans hpos)
  have hq : Differentiable ℂ entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient :=
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient_differentiable H
  have hqneg : Differentiable ℂ
      (fun w : ℂ ↦ entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient (-w)) := by
    fun_prop
  have hfun : (fun w : ℂ ↦ entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient (-w)) =
      entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient := by
    apply AnalyticOnNhd.eq_of_eventuallyEq
      (DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd hqneg.differentiableOn isOpen_univ)
      (DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd hq.differentiableOn isOpen_univ)
      hqevent
  exact congrFun hfun z

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotientLog_neg
statement:
theorem entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotientLog_neg
    (H : EntireXiPullbackCanonicalZeroDistribution) (z : ℂ) :
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotientLog H (-z) =
      entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotientLog H z
proof:
:= by
  let h : ℂ → ℂ := entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotientLog H
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := differentiable_logs_eq_add_const
    (entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotientLog_differentiable H)
    (show Differentiable ℂ (fun w : ℂ ↦ h (-w)) by
      simpa [h, Function.comp_def] using
        (entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotientLog_differentiable H).comp
          differentiable_neg)
    (fun w ↦ by
      dsimp [h]
      rw [exp_entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotientLog H (-w),
        exp_entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotientLog H w,
        entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient_neg H w])
  have hc0 := hc 0
  have hc_zero : c = 0 := by
    dsimp [h] at hc0
    simp only [neg_zero] at hc0
    linear_combination -hc0
  have hz := hc z
  dsimp [h] at hz ⊢
  simpa [hc_zero] using hz

      ((n - 1 : Nat) : Real) < ‖entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i‖ :=
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalNormCeilFiber_pred_lt_norm
      (le_trans (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 2) hn) hi
  have hpred_pos : 0 < ((n - 1 : Nat) : Real) := by
    have h1n : 1 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 1 < 2) hn

  have hnorm_pos : 0 < ‖entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i‖ :=

        ≤ ‖entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i‖ ^ 2 := by

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellInvSqMass_le_card_mul
statement:
theorem entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellInvSqMass_le_card_mul
    (n : Nat) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellInvSqMass n
      ≤ (entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellCard n : Real) *
          ((((n - 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellInvSqMass
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellCard
  haveI : Fintype {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence //
      Nat.ceil ‖entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i‖ = n} :=
    (entireXiPullbackCanonicalNormCeilFiberFinite n).fintype
  rw [tsum_fintype, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  calc
    ∑ i : {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence //
        Nat.ceil ‖entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i‖ = n},
        (‖entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
      ≤ ∑ _i : {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence //
          Nat.ceil ‖entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i‖ = n},
          ((((n - 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _hi
        exact entireXiPullbackCanonicalNormCeilFiber_invSq_le_pred hn i.2
    _ = (Fintype.card {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence //
          Nat.ceil ‖entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i‖ = n} : Real) *
            ((((n - 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellInvSqMass_summable_of_eventual_shellCard_log_bound
statement:
theorem
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellInvSqMass_summable_of_eventual_shellCard_log_bound
    (lower : Nat) (hlower : 2 ≤ lower) (C C₀ : Real)
    (hcount : ∀ n : Nat, lower ≤ n →
      (entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellCard n : Real) ≤
        C * Real.log n + C₀) :
    Summable entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellInvSqMass
proof:
:= by
  refine (summable_nat_add_iff lower).mp ?_
  have hb : Summable (fun n : Nat => ((((n - 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)⁻¹)) := by
    have hp : Summable (fun n : Nat => (((n : Real) ^ 2)⁻¹)) :=
      Real.summable_nat_pow_inv.mpr (by norm_num)
    refine (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp (hp.congr ?_)
    intro n
    norm_num
  have hbig :
      Summable (fun n : Nat =>
        C * (Real.log n * ((((n - 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)⁻¹)) +
          C₀ * ((((n - 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)⁻¹)) :=
    (summable_log_natCast_mul_pred_sq_inv.mul_left C).add (hb.mul_left C₀)
  have hbig_shift := (summable_nat_add_iff lower).mpr hbig
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun n => entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellInvSqMass_nonneg _) ?_ hbig_shift
  intro n
  have hn_lower : lower ≤ n + lower := by omega
  have hn_two : 2 ≤ n + lower := le_trans hlower hn_lower
  have hmassle :=
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellInvSqMass_le_card_mul
      (n + lower) hn_two
  have hcard := hcount (n + lower) hn_lower
  have hinv_nonneg :
      (0 : Real) ≤ ((((n + lower - 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
    positivity
  calc
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellInvSqMass (n + lower)
        ≤ (entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellCard (n + lower) : Real) *
            ((((n + lower - 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)⁻¹) := hmassle
    _ ≤ (C * Real.log (↑(n + lower) : Real) + C₀) *
          ((((n + lower - 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hinv_nonneg
    _ = C * (Real.log (↑(n + lower) : Real) *
          ((((n + lower - 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)⁻¹)) +
        C₀ * ((((n + lower - 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.critical_shift_re
statement:
theorem critical_shift_re (z : ℂ) :
    ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z).re = 1 / 2 - z.im
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
      zero_mul, one_mul, zero_sub]
  have h_half : ((1 / 2 : ℂ)).re = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  rw [h_half]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.critical_shift_star
statement:

    star ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) =
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) - Complex.I * star z
proof:

  simp only [Complex.star_def]
  rw [map_add, map_mul, Complex.conj_I]
  have h_half : (starRingEnd ℂ) ((1 / 2 : ℂ)) = (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
    rw [show (1 / 2 : ℂ) = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) by norm_num,
        Complex.conj_ofReal]
  rw [h_half]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiPullback_neg
statement:

proof:

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiPullback_deriv_neg
statement:
theorem EntireXiPullback_deriv_neg (z : ℂ) :
    deriv EntireXiPullback (-z) = -deriv EntireXiPullback z
proof:
:= by
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => -w) (-1) z :=
    (hasDerivAt_id z).neg
  have houter : HasDerivAt EntireXiPullback
      (deriv EntireXiPullback (-z)) (-z) :=
    (EntireXiPullback_differentiable (-z)).hasDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => EntireXiPullback (-w))
      (deriv EntireXiPullback (-z) * (-1)) z := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using houter.comp z hinner
  have hfun : (fun w : ℂ => EntireXiPullback (-w)) = EntireXiPullback :=
    funext EntireXiPullback_neg
  have hderiv_fun :
      deriv (fun w : ℂ => EntireXiPullback (-w)) z =
        deriv EntireXiPullback z :=
    congrArg (fun f : ℂ → ℂ => deriv f z) hfun
  have hderiv :
      deriv EntireXiPullback z = deriv EntireXiPullback (-z) * (-1) := by
    rw [← hderiv_fun]
    exact hcomp.deriv
  have hneg := congrArg Neg.neg hderiv
  simpa using hneg.symm

  have htwo : (2 : ℂ) * deriv EntireXiPullback 0 = 0 := by

    exact eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero.mp h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp htwo).resolve_left (by norm_num)

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireRiemannXi_two
statement:
theorem entireRiemannXi_two :
    entireRiemannXi 2 = ((Real.pi / 6 : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hzeta := riemannZeta_eq_completedRiemannZeta₀
    (s := (2 : ℂ)) (by norm_num)
  rw [riemannZeta_two] at hzeta
  unfold entireRiemannXi
  norm_num [Complex.Gamma_one, Complex.cpow_neg_one] at hzeta ⊢
  have hpi : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Real.pi_ne_zero
  field_simp [hpi] at hzeta ⊢
  ring_nf at hzeta ⊢
  exact hzeta.symm

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiPullback_apply_I_div_two
statement:
theorem EntireXiPullback_apply_I_div_two :
    EntireXiPullback (Complex.I / 2) = (1 / 2 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold EntireXiPullback
  rw [show (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * (Complex.I / 2) = 0 by
    calc
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * (Complex.I / 2) =
          1 / 2 + (Complex.I * Complex.I) / 2 := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [Complex.I_mul_I]; norm_num]
  simp [entireRiemannXi]

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiPullback_apply_neg_three_halves_I
statement:
theorem EntireXiPullback_apply_neg_three_halves_I :
    EntireXiPullback (-(3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      ((Real.pi / 6 : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold EntireXiPullback
  rw [show (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * (-(3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) = 2 by
    calc
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * (-(3 / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
          1 / 2 - (3 / 2) * (Complex.I * Complex.I) := by ring
      _ = 2 := by rw [Complex.I_mul_I]; norm_num]
  exact entireRiemannXi_two

  have hre := congrArg Complex.re heq
  norm_num at hre

name: OverflowResidueRH.originMultiplicityResponse_im_nonpos
statement:
private theorem originMultiplicityResponse_im_nonpos
    (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    (((m : ℂ) / z).im) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.div_im]
  have hm_im : ((m : ℂ).im) = 0 := by simp
  have hm_re : ((m : ℂ).re) = (m : ℝ) := by simp
  rw [hm_im, hm_re]
  simp only [zero_mul, zero_div, zero_sub]
  exact neg_nonpos.mpr <| div_nonneg
    (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (le_of_lt hz))
    (Complex.normSq_nonneg z)

name: OverflowResidueRH.originMultiplicityResponse_im_neg
statement:
private theorem originMultiplicityResponse_im_neg
    (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≠ 0) (z : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    (((m : ℂ) / z).im) < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.div_im]
  have hm_im : ((m : ℂ).im) = 0 := by simp
  have hm_re : ((m : ℂ).re) = (m : ℝ) := by simp
  rw [hm_im, hm_re]
  simp only [zero_mul, zero_div, zero_sub]
  apply neg_neg_of_pos
  apply div_pos
  · exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm) hz
  · apply Complex.normSq_pos.mpr
    intro hzero
    subst z
    simp at hz

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiPullbackHadamardLogDerivativeData.strictAntiHerglotz_of_riemannHypothesis
statement:
theorem
    EntireXiPullbackHadamardLogDerivativeData.strictAntiHerglotz_of_riemannHypothesis
    {ι : Type u} (H : EntireXiPullbackHadamardLogDerivativeData ι)
    (hRH : RiemannHypothesis) :
    EntireXiPullback.StrictAntiHerglotzSign
proof:
:= by
  have hpull_zeros_real :
      ∀ z : ℂ, EntireXiPullback z = 0 → z.im = 0 :=
    riemannHypothesis_iff_entireXiPullback_zeros_real.mp hRH
  have hreal : ∀ i : ι, (H.zeroLoc i).im = 0 :=
    fun i => hpull_zeros_real (H.zeroLoc i) (H.zeroLoc_is_zero i)
  intro z hz
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    subst z
    simp at hz
  have hzloc : ∀ i : ι, z ≠ H.zeroLoc i := by
    intro i hzi
    have him := congrArg Complex.im hzi
    rw [hreal i] at him
    linarith
  rw [H.logDerivative_expansion z hz0 hzloc]
  simp only [Complex.add_im, H.b_im, add_zero]
  rcases H.support_nonempty with hm | hι
  · exact add_neg_of_neg_of_nonpos
      (originMultiplicityResponse_im_neg H.originMultiplicity hm z hz)
      (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_im_nonpos_of_real_indexed
        H.zeroLoc H.zeroData hreal hz)
  · letI : Nonempty ι := hι
    exact add_neg_of_nonpos_of_neg
      (originMultiplicityResponse_im_nonpos H.originMultiplicity z hz)
      (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_im_neg_of_real_indexed
        H.zeroLoc H.zeroData hreal hz)

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiPullbackCanonicalHadamardLogDerivativeData.b_eq_zero
statement:
theorem EntireXiPullbackCanonicalHadamardLogDerivativeData.b_eq_zero
    (H : EntireXiPullbackCanonicalHadamardLogDerivativeData) :
    H.b = 0
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℂ := Complex.I / 2
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [z]
    exact div_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero (by norm_num)
  have hFz : EntireXiPullback z ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show EntireXiPullback z = (1 / 2 : ℂ) by
      simpa only [z] using EntireXiPullback_apply_I_div_two]
    norm_num
  have hnegFz : EntireXiPullback (-z) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [EntireXiPullback_neg]
    exact hFz
  have hzloc : ∀ i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence,
      z ≠ entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i := by
    intro i hzi
    apply hFz
    rw [hzi]
    exact entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc_is_zero i
  have hnegzloc : ∀ i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence,
      -z ≠ entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i := by
    intro i hzi
    apply hnegFz
    rw [hzi]
    exact entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc_is_zero i
  have hodd := EntireXiPullback_logDerivativeResponse_neg z
  rw [H.logDerivative_expansion (-z) (neg_ne_zero.mpr hz0) hnegzloc,
    H.logDerivative_expansion z hz0 hzloc,
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalRegularizedSeries_neg, div_neg] at hodd
  have htwo : (2 : ℂ) * H.b = 0 := by
    linear_combination hodd
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp htwo).resolve_left (by norm_num)

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiPullbackCanonicalHadamardLogDerivativeData.support_nonempty
statement:
theorem EntireXiPullbackCanonicalHadamardLogDerivativeData.support_nonempty
    (H : EntireXiPullbackCanonicalHadamardLogDerivativeData) :
    entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity ≠ 0 ∨
      Nonempty EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hsupport
  push Not at hsupport
  rcases hsupport with ⟨hm, hocc⟩
  letI : IsEmpty EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence := hocc
  have hseries : ∀ z : ℂ,
      hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
          entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc z = 0 := by
    intro z
    simp [hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries]
  have haway : ∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 →
      logDerivativeResponse EntireXiPullback z = H.b := by
    intro z hz0
    rw [H.logDerivative_expansion z hz0 (fun i => isEmptyElim i),
      hm, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, zero_add, hseries, add_zero]
  have hb : H.b = 0 := H.b_eq_zero
  have hzero_free : ∀ z : ℂ, EntireXiPullback z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z
    by_cases hz0 : z = 0
    · subst z
      intro hFzero
      exact (entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity_ne_zero_iff.mpr hFzero) hm
    · intro hFzero
      obtain ⟨i, _hi⟩ :=
        entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc_exhaustive hFzero hz0
      exact isEmptyElim i
  have hderiv : ∀ z : ℂ, deriv EntireXiPullback z = 0 := by
    intro z
    by_cases hz0 : z = 0
    · subst z
      exact EntireXiPullback_deriv_zero
    · have hlog : logDerivativeResponse EntireXiPullback z = 0 := by
        rw [haway z hz0, hb]
      unfold logDerivativeResponse at hlog
      exact (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hlog).resolve_right (hzero_free z)
  exact EntireXiPullback_not_constant
    (is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero EntireXiPullback_differentiable hderiv)

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient_proximity_subquadratic_of_xiProximity
statement:
theorem
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient_proximity_subquadratic_of_xiProximity
    (Hdist : EntireXiPullbackCanonicalZeroDistribution)
    (hxi : HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity EntireXiPullback)
    (hproduct : HasSubquadraticCharacteristicGrowthAtInfinity
      entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct) :
    HasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity
      entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient
proof:
:= by
  have hFmer : Meromorphic EntireXiPullback := fun z ↦
    (EntireXiPullback_analyticAt z).meromorphicAt
  have hPmer : Meromorphic entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct := fun z ↦
    (entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_differentiable
      Hdist).analyticAt z |>.meromorphicAt
  have hPcodiscrete :
      entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ ∈ codiscrete ℂ :=
    (DifferentiableOn.analyticOnNhd
      (entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_differentiable
        Hdist).differentiableOn isOpen_univ)
      |>.preimage_zero_mem_codiscrete
        (canonicalProduct_I_div_two_ne_zero Hdist)
  have hquot : entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient =ᶠ[codiscrete ℂ]
      EntireXiPullback * entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct⁻¹ := by
    filter_upwards [hPcodiscrete] with z hz
    have hz' : entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct z ≠ 0 := by
      simpa using hz
    rw [entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient_eq_div Hdist hz']
    rfl
  exact
    hasSubquadraticProximityGrowthAtInfinity_of_proximity_and_characteristic
      hFmer hPmer hquot hxi hproduct

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient_logNorm_subquadraticAtInfinity_of_xiLogNorm
statement:
theorem
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalQuotient_logNorm_subquadraticAtInfinity_of_xiLogNorm
    (Hdist : EntireXiPullbackCanonicalZeroDistribution)
    (hxi : HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity EntireXiPullback)

      entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct) :

:= by

    (EntireXiPullback_analyticAt z).meromorphicAt
  have hPmer : Meromorphic entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct := fun z ↦
    (entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_differentiable

  have hPcodiscrete :

      (entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_differentiable

proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := analyticOrderAt_comp_of_deriv_ne_zero
    (f := entireRiemannXi)
    (g := fun w : Complex => (1 / 2 : Complex) + Complex.I * w)
    (z₀ := z)
    (by fun_prop)
    (by simp)
  have hfun :
      entireRiemannXi ∘
          (fun w : Complex => (1 / 2 : Complex) + Complex.I * w) =
        EntireXiPullback := by
    funext w
    rfl
  rw [hfun] at hcomp
