name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullback_zeroSet_locallyFinite
statement:
theorem entireXiPullback_zeroSet_locallyFinite (p : Complex) :
    ∃ U ∈ nhds p,
      (U ∩ {z : Complex | EntireXiPullback z = 0}).Finite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : EntireXiPullback p = 0
  · have hAn : AnalyticAt Complex EntireXiPullback p :=
      EntireXiPullback_analyticAt p
    rcases hAn.eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with hlocal | hpunct
    · exact absurd hlocal (EntireXiPullback_not_eventuallyEq_zero p)
    · rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff] at hpunct
      refine
        ⟨{z : Complex | z ∈ ({p}ᶜ : Set Complex) → EntireXiPullback z ≠ 0},
          hpunct, ?_⟩
      apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_singleton p)
      rintro z ⟨hzU, hzzero⟩
      by_cases hzp : z = p
      · simp [hzp]
      · have hzmem : z ∈ ({p}ᶜ : Set Complex) := hzp
        exact absurd hzzero (hzU hzmem)
  · have hcont : ContinuousAt EntireXiPullback p :=
      (EntireXiPullback_analyticAt p).continuousAt
    have hEventually_ne :
        ∀ᶠ z in nhds p, EntireXiPullback z ≠ 0 :=
      hcont.eventually_ne hp
    refine ⟨{z : Complex | EntireXiPullback z ≠ 0}, hEventually_ne, ?_⟩
    have hempty :
        {z : Complex | EntireXiPullback z ≠ 0} ∩
            {z : Complex | EntireXiPullback z = 0} =
          ∅ := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hz_ne, hz_zero⟩
        exact (hz_ne hz_zero).elim
      · intro hz
        exact absurd hz (Set.notMem_empty z)
    rw [hempty]
    exact Set.finite_empty

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullback_zeroSet_finite_in_closedBall
statement:
theorem entireXiPullback_zeroSet_finite_in_closedBall (R : Real) :
    {z : Complex |
      z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Complex) R ∧ EntireXiPullback z = 0}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Z : Set Complex :=
    {z : Complex |
      z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Complex) R ∧ EntireXiPullback z = 0}
  let K : Set Complex := Metric.closedBall (0 : Complex) R
  have hK : IsCompact K := ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : Complex) R
  have hZK : Z ⊆ K := by
    intro z hz
    exact hz.1
  have hlocal :
      ∀ p ∈ K, ∃ U ∈ nhds p, (U ∩ Z).Finite := by
    intro p _hp
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hfin⟩ := entireXiPullback_zeroSet_locallyFinite p
    refine ⟨U, hU, ?_⟩
    exact hfin.subset (by
      rintro z ⟨hzU, hz⟩
      exact ⟨hzU, hz.2⟩)
  choose! V hV_nhds hV_finite using hlocal
  obtain ⟨t, ht_sub, ht_cover⟩ := hK.elim_nhds_subcover V hV_nhds
  have hZsubset : Z ⊆ ⋃ p ∈ t, V p ∩ Z := by
    intro z hz
    have hzK : z ∈ K := hZK hz
    obtain ⟨p, hpt, hzVp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht_cover hzK)
    exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨p, hpt, hzVp, hz⟩
  have hZfinite : Z.Finite := by
    refine Set.Finite.subset ?_ hZsubset
    refine Set.Finite.biUnion t.finite_toSet ?_
    intro p hp
    exact hV_finite p (ht_sub p hp)
  simpa [Z] using hZfinite

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackNonzeroZero_norm_le_finite
statement:
private theorem entireXiPullbackNonzeroZero_norm_le_finite (R : Real) :
    {z : EntireXiPullbackNonzeroZero | (norm (z.1) : Real) ≤ R}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  let Z : Set Complex :=
    {z : Complex |
      z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : Complex) R ∧ EntireXiPullback z = 0}
  have hZ : Z.Finite := entireXiPullback_zeroSet_finite_in_closedBall R
  apply Set.Finite.of_finite_image
    (s := {z : EntireXiPullbackNonzeroZero | (norm (z.1) : Real) ≤ R})
    (f := fun z : EntireXiPullbackNonzeroZero => z.1)
  · exact hZ.subset (by
      rintro z ⟨rho, hrho, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨?_, rho.2.1⟩
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hrho)
  · exact Subtype.val_injective.injOn

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceNormProper
statement:
theorem entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceNormProper :
    HadamardZeroNormProper entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro R
  let S : Set EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence :=
    {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence |
      norm (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i) ≤ R}
  have hbase :
      ((fun i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence => i.1) '' S).Finite := by
    apply (entireXiPullbackNonzeroZero_norm_le_finite R).subset
    rintro rho ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact hi
  have hfiber :
      ∀ rho ∈
        (fun i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence => i.1) '' S,
        (S ∩
          (fun i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence => i.1) ⁻¹' {rho}).Finite := by
    intro rho _hrho
    apply (Set.finite_range
      (fun k : Fin (analyticOrderNatAt EntireXiPullback rho.1) =>
        Sigma.mk rho k)).subset
    intro i hi
    have hirho : i.1 = rho := hi.2
    subst rho
    exact ⟨i.2, rfl⟩
  exact Set.Finite.of_finite_fibers
    (fun i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence => i.1) hbase hfiber

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullback_zeroSet_countable
statement:
theorem entireXiPullback_zeroSet_countable :
    {z : Complex | EntireXiPullback z = 0}.Countable
proof:
:= by
  let D := MeromorphicOn.divisor EntireXiPullback (Set.univ : Set Complex)
  have hAn : AnalyticOnNhd Complex EntireXiPullback Set.univ :=
    fun z _hz => EntireXiPullback_analyticAt z
  have hfinite :
      ∀ z : (Set.univ : Set Complex),
        meromorphicOrderAt EntireXiPullback z.1 ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro z
    rw [(hAn z.1 z.2).meromorphicOrderAt_eq]
    simpa using entireXiPullback_analyticOrderAt_ne_top z.1
  have hsupport :
      {z : Complex | EntireXiPullback z = 0} = D.support := by
    have hzero := hAn.meromorphicNFOn.zero_set_eq_divisor_support hfinite
    ext z
    have hz := Set.ext_iff.mp hzero z
    simpa [D] using hz
  rw [hsupport]
  exact
    (HereditarilyLindelofSpace.isLindelof D.support).countable_of_isDiscrete
      D.discreteSupport

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiPullbackDyadicBoundaryGrowthData.log_norm_le_orderOne
statement:
theorem EntireXiPullbackDyadicBoundaryGrowthData.log_norm_le_orderOne
    (H : EntireXiPullbackDyadicBoundaryGrowthData) (z : ℂ)
    (hz : (2 : ℝ) ^ H.lower ≤ ‖z‖) :
    Real.log ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ ≤
      H.orderOneRate * ‖z‖ * (Real.log ‖z‖ + 1) + H.A₀
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := ‖z‖
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := by
    have hp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ H.lower :=
      one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    exact hp.trans hz
  obtain ⟨n, hnlow, hnup⟩ := exists_nat_pow_near hr1
    (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
  have hlower_n : H.lower ≤ n := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hnH : n + 1 ≤ H.lower :=
      Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnot)
    have hpows : (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ H.lower :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hnH
    linarith
  let q : ℝ := H.A * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n + H.A₀
  have hq_nonneg : 0 ≤ q := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact add_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg H.A_nonneg (by positivity)) (by positivity))
      H.A₀_nonneg
  have houter_pos : 0 < entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius n := by
    dsimp [entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius,
      entireXiPullbackJensenInnerRadius]
    positivity
  have hzclosed : z ∈ closedBall entireXiPullbackJensenCenter
      (entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius n) := by
    rw [mem_closedBall]
    calc
      dist z entireXiPullbackJensenCenter ≤ dist z 0 +
          dist 0 entireXiPullbackJensenCenter := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ = r + 1 / 2 := by
        simp [r, entireXiPullbackJensenCenter, dist_zero_right]
      _ ≤ entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius n := by
        dsimp [entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius,
          entireXiPullbackJensenInnerRadius]
        rw [pow_succ] at hnup
        nlinarith
  have hmax : ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ ≤ Real.exp q := by
    apply Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le
      isBounded_ball EntireXiPullback_differentiable.diffContOnCl
    · intro w hw
      apply H.boundary_norm_le n hlower_n w
      rw [frontier_ball _ houter_pos.ne'] at hw
      exact hw
    · rwa [closure_ball _ houter_pos.ne']
  have hlog : Real.log ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ ≤ q := by
    by_cases hzero : EntireXiPullback z = 0
    · simpa [hzero] using hq_nonneg
    · have hnormpos : 0 < ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hzero
      have := Real.log_le_log hnormpos hmax
      simpa using this
  have hlog_two : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlog_r_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log r := Real.log_nonneg hr1
  have hlog_pow : Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ≤ Real.log r :=
    Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hnlow
  have hn_log : (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.log r / Real.log 2 := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hlog_two).2
    simpa [Real.log_pow] using hlog_pow
  have hindex : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log r / Real.log 2 + 1 := by
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hinv_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 / Real.log (2 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hshape : Real.log r / Real.log 2 + 1 ≤
      (1 / Real.log 2 + 1) * (Real.log r + 1) := by
    calc
      Real.log r / Real.log 2 + 1 =
          (1 / Real.log 2) * Real.log r + 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 / Real.log 2) * Real.log r + 1 +
          (1 / Real.log 2 + Real.log r) :=
        le_add_of_nonneg_right (add_nonneg hinv_nonneg hlog_r_nonneg)
      _ = (1 / Real.log 2 + 1) * (Real.log r + 1) := by ring
  have hindex_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log r / Real.log 2 + 1 :=
    add_nonneg (div_nonneg hlog_r_nonneg hlog_two.le) zero_le_one
  have hscale : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤
      (1 / Real.log 2 + 1) * (Real.log r + 1) * r := by
    calc
      ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤
          (Real.log r / Real.log 2 + 1) * r :=
        mul_le_mul hindex hnlow (by positivity) hindex_nonneg
      _ ≤ ((1 / Real.log 2 + 1) * (Real.log r + 1)) * r :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hshape (by positivity)
  have hmain : H.A * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤
      H.orderOneRate * r * (Real.log r + 1) := by
    calc
      H.A * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n =
          H.A * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n) := by ring
      _ ≤ H.A * ((1 / Real.log 2 + 1) * (Real.log r + 1) * r) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale H.A_nonneg
      _ = H.orderOneRate * r * (Real.log r + 1) := by
        dsimp [EntireXiPullbackDyadicBoundaryGrowthData.orderOneRate]
        ring
  change Real.log ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ ≤
    H.orderOneRate * r * (Real.log r + 1) + H.A₀
  apply hlog.trans
  dsimp [q]
  linarith

  have h_shift : (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * (-Complex.I / 2) = 1 := by
    have h_I2 : Complex.I * Complex.I = -1 := Complex.I_mul_I
    have h_eq : Complex.I * (-Complex.I / 2)
                  = -((Complex.I * Complex.I) / 2) := by ring

  change (1 / 2 : ℂ) * 1 * (1 - 1) * completedRiemannZeta₀ 1 + (1 / 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiPullbackDyadicBoundaryGrowthData.log_norm_le_rLogREnvelope
statement:
theorem EntireXiPullbackDyadicBoundaryGrowthData.log_norm_le_rLogREnvelope
    (H : EntireXiPullbackDyadicBoundaryGrowthData) (z : ℂ)
    (hz : (2 : ℝ) ^ H.lower ≤ ‖z‖) :
    Real.log ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ ≤
      H.rLogRRate * ‖z‖ * Real.log ‖z‖ + H.A * ‖z‖ + H.A₀
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := ‖z‖
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := by
    have hp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ H.lower :=
      one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    exact hp.trans hz
  obtain ⟨n, hnlow, hnup⟩ := exists_nat_pow_near hr1
    (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
  have hlower_n : H.lower ≤ n := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hnH : n + 1 ≤ H.lower :=
      Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnot)
    have hpows : (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ H.lower :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hnH
    linarith
  let q : ℝ := H.A * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n + H.A₀
  have hq_nonneg : 0 ≤ q := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact add_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg H.A_nonneg (by positivity)) (by positivity))
      H.A₀_nonneg
  have houter_pos : 0 < entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius n := by
    dsimp [entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius,
      entireXiPullbackJensenInnerRadius]
    positivity
  have hzclosed : z ∈ closedBall entireXiPullbackJensenCenter
      (entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius n) := by
    rw [mem_closedBall]
    calc
      dist z entireXiPullbackJensenCenter ≤ dist z 0 +
          dist 0 entireXiPullbackJensenCenter := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ = r + 1 / 2 := by
        simp [r, entireXiPullbackJensenCenter, dist_zero_right]
      _ ≤ entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius n := by
        dsimp [entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius,
          entireXiPullbackJensenInnerRadius]
        rw [pow_succ] at hnup
        nlinarith
  have hmax : ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ ≤ Real.exp q := by
    apply Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le
      isBounded_ball EntireXiPullback_differentiable.diffContOnCl
    · intro w hw
      apply H.boundary_norm_le n hlower_n w
      rw [frontier_ball _ houter_pos.ne'] at hw
      exact hw
    · rwa [closure_ball _ houter_pos.ne']
  have hlog : Real.log ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ ≤ q := by
    by_cases hzero : EntireXiPullback z = 0
    · simpa [hzero] using hq_nonneg
    · have hnormpos : 0 < ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hzero
      have := Real.log_le_log hnormpos hmax
      simpa using this
  have hlog_two : 0 < Real.log (2 : ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlog_pow : Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ≤ Real.log r :=
    Real.log_le_log (by positivity) hnlow
  have hn_log : (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.log r / Real.log 2 := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hlog_two).2
    simpa [Real.log_pow] using hlog_pow
  have hindex : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.log r / Real.log 2 + 1 := by
    push_cast
    linarith
  have hindex_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log r / Real.log 2 + 1 := by
    have : 0 ≤ Real.log r := Real.log_nonneg hr1
    positivity
  have hscale : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤
      (Real.log r / Real.log 2 + 1) * r :=
    mul_le_mul hindex hnlow (by positivity) hindex_nonneg
  have hmain : H.A * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤
      H.rLogRRate * r * Real.log r + H.A * r := by
    calc
      H.A * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n =
          H.A * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n) := by ring
      _ ≤ H.A * ((Real.log r / Real.log 2 + 1) * r) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale H.A_nonneg
      _ = H.rLogRRate * r * Real.log r + H.A * r := by
        dsimp [EntireXiPullbackDyadicBoundaryGrowthData.rLogRRate]
        ring
  change Real.log ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ ≤
    H.rLogRRate * r * Real.log r + H.A * r + H.A₀
  exact hlog.trans (by dsimp [q]; linarith)

name: OverflowResidueRH.RLogRUpperIndicatorData.rLogRRayIndicator_le_add
statement:
theorem RLogRUpperIndicatorData.rLogRRayIndicator_le_add
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (H : RLogRUpperIndicatorData f)
    (θ ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    rLogRRayIndicator f θ ≤ (H.upper θ + ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hbound⟩ := H.bound θ ε hε
  apply Filter.limsup_le_of_le (by isBoundedDefault)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (max R (Real.exp 1))] with r hr
  have hrR : R ≤ r := (le_max_left R (Real.exp 1)).trans hr
  have hexp : Real.exp 1 ≤ r := (le_max_right R (Real.exp 1)).trans hr
  have hrpos : 0 < r := (Real.exp_pos 1).trans_le hexp
  have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log r := by
    have hrone : 1 < r :=
      (lt_trans (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2) Real.exp_one_gt_two).trans_le hexp
    exact Real.log_pos hrone
  have hdenpos : 0 < r * Real.log r := mul_pos hrpos hlogpos
  have hb := hbound r hrR
  have hq : rLogRRayQuotient f θ r ≤ H.upper θ + ε := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hdenpos).2
    simpa [rLogRRayQuotient, complexRay, mul_assoc] using hb
  exact_mod_cast hq

name: OverflowResidueRH.RLogRUpperIndicatorData.rLogRRayIndicator_le
statement:
theorem RLogRUpperIndicatorData.rLogRRayIndicator_le
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} (H : RLogRUpperIndicatorData f) (θ : ℝ) :
    rLogRRayIndicator f θ ≤ (H.upper θ : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let x := rLogRRayIndicator f θ
  have hfinite : x ≠ ⊤ := by
    have h : x ≤ (H.upper θ + 1 : ℝ) :=
      H.rLogRRayIndicator_le_add θ 1 (by norm_num)
    intro hx
    rw [hx] at h
    exact EReal.coe_ne_top (H.upper θ + 1) (top_le_iff.mp h)
  change x ≤ (H.upper θ : ℝ)
  by_cases hbot : x = ⊥
  · simp [hbot]
  · rw [← EReal.coe_toReal hfinite hbot]
    apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
    apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
    intro ε hε
    have h := H.rLogRRayIndicator_le_add θ ε hε
    have hreal := EReal.toReal_le_toReal h hbot (EReal.coe_ne_top _)
    simpa only [← EReal.coe_add, EReal.toReal_coe] using hreal

name: OverflowResidueRH.hasDerivAt_critical_shift
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_critical_shift (z : ℂ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) Complex.I z
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => z) (1 : ℂ) z := hasDerivAt_id z
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => Complex.I * z) (Complex.I * 1) z :=
    h1.const_mul Complex.I
  have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z)
                       (0 + Complex.I * 1) z :=
    (hasDerivAt_const z (1 / 2 : ℂ)).add h2
  simpa using h3

    {z : ℂ}

                  ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z)) :
    logDerivativeResponse XiPullback z =
      Complex.I *
        (deriv completedXiFunction ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) /
          completedXiFunction ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z))
proof:
:= by
  have h_outer : HasDerivAt completedXiFunction
                  (deriv completedXiFunction ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z))
                  ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) := hxi_diff.hasDerivAt
  have h_inner := hasDerivAt_critical_shift z
  have h_chain : HasDerivAt
                  (fun w : ℂ => completedXiFunction ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * w))
                  (deriv completedXiFunction ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z)
                    * Complex.I) z := by
    have h := h_outer.comp z h_inner
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using h
  unfold logDerivativeResponse XiPullback
  rw [h_chain.deriv]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.exists_hurwitzThetaMellinKernel_upper_bound
statement:
theorem exists_hurwitzThetaMellinKernel_upper_bound :
    ∃ p A : ℝ, 0 < p ∧ 0 ≤ A ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x →
        ‖hurwitzThetaMellinKernel x‖ ≤ A * Real.exp (-(p * x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hO⟩ := HurwitzZeta.isBigO_atTop_evenKernel_sub 0
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hCbound⟩ := hO.exists_nonneg
  obtain ⟨X₀, hX₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hCbound.bound
  let X : ℝ := max 1 X₀
  have hX : 1 ≤ X := le_max_left _ _
  have hlarge (x : ℝ) (hx : X ≤ x) :
      |HurwitzZeta.evenKernel 0 x - 1| ≤
        C * Real.exp (-(p * x)) := by
    have h := hX₀ x (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hx)
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using h
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun x ↦
    ‖((HurwitzZeta.evenKernel 0 x - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ *
      Real.exp (p * x)
  have hsubset : Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) X ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := by
    intro x hx
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hx.1
  have heven :
      ContinuousOn (HurwitzZeta.evenKernel 0) (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) X) :=
    (HurwitzZeta.continuousOn_evenKernel 0).mono hsubset
  have hsub : ContinuousOn
      (fun x : ℝ ↦ HurwitzZeta.evenKernel 0 x - 1)
      (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) X) :=
    heven.sub continuousOn_const
  have hq : ContinuousOn q (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) X) := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact (continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn hsub).norm.mul
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp
        (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).continuousOn
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hx₀max⟩ :=
    (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) X)).exists_isMaxOn
      (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr hX) hq
  let B : ℝ := q x₀
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by
    dsimp [B, q]
    positivity
  let A : ℝ := max C B
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := le_trans hC (le_max_left C B)
  refine ⟨p, A, hp, hA, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  by_cases hxone : x = 1
  · subst x
    rw [hurwitzThetaMellinKernel_one, norm_zero]
    positivity
  have hxlt : 1 < x := lt_of_le_of_ne hx (Ne.symm hxone)
  rw [hurwitzThetaMellinKernel_eq_evenKernel_sub_one hxlt]
  by_cases hcompact : x ≤ X
  · have hweighted :
        ‖((HurwitzZeta.evenKernel 0 x - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ *
            Real.exp (p * x) ≤ B := by
      exact hx₀max ⟨hx, hcompact⟩
    calc
      ‖((HurwitzZeta.evenKernel 0 x - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ =
          (‖((HurwitzZeta.evenKernel 0 x - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ *
              Real.exp (p * x)) * Real.exp (-(p * x)) := by
            rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
            simp
      _ ≤ B * Real.exp (-(p * x)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hweighted (Real.exp_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ A * Real.exp (-(p * x)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right C B) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
  · have hlarge' := hlarge x (le_of_not_ge hcompact)
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact le_trans hlarge'
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left C B) (Real.exp_nonneg _))

    (hconv : MellinConvergent hurwitzThetaMellinKernel s) :

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiPullbackDyadicBoundaryGrowthData.hasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity
statement:
theorem
    EntireXiPullbackDyadicBoundaryGrowthData.hasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity
    (H : EntireXiPullbackDyadicBoundaryGrowthData) :
    HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity EntireXiPullback
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  have hshift : Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 1) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))
      atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    (tendsto_pow_const_div_const_pow_of_one_lt 1
      (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hlin0 : Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ (2 * H.A) *
        ((((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 1) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.mul hshift
  have hlin : Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ H.A * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    convert hlin0 using 1
    funext n
    rw [pow_one, pow_succ]
    field_simp
  have hinvfour : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ n))
      atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_norm_lt_one (by norm_num)
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ H.A₀ / (4 : ℝ) ^ n)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hmul : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ H.A₀ * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ n)
        atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.mul hinvfour
    convert hmul using 1
    funext n
    rw [div_pow]
    simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hlin_small : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      H.A * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ n < ε / 2 :=
    hlin.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by positivity))
  have hconst_small : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      H.A₀ / (4 : ℝ) ^ n < ε / 2 :=
    hconst.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by positivity))
  have henv_event : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      H.A * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n + H.A₀ ≤
        ε * ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [hlin_small, hconst_small] with n hnlin hnconst
    have htwo : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
    have hfour : 0 < (4 : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
    have hnlin' : H.A * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) <
        (ε / 2) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n := (div_lt_iff₀ htwo).mp hnlin
    have hnconst' : H.A₀ < (ε / 2) * (4 : ℝ) ^ n :=
      (div_lt_iff₀ hfour).mp hnconst
    calc
      H.A * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n + H.A₀ ≤
          ((ε / 2) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n +
            (ε / 2) * (4 : ℝ) ^ n := by
        gcongr
      _ = ε * ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ 2 := by
        rw [four_pow_eq_two_pow_sq]
        ring
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := (eventually_atTop.1 henv_event)
  let N : ℕ := max H.lower N₀
  let R : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ N
  refine ⟨R, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  let r : ℝ := ‖z‖
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := by
    have hR1 : 1 ≤ R := by
      dsimp [R]
      exact one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    exact hR1.trans hz
  obtain ⟨n, hnlow, hnup⟩ := exists_nat_pow_near hr1
    (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
  have hNn : N ≤ n := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hnN : n + 1 ≤ N := Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnot)
    have hpows : (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ N := by
      exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hnN
    have hRr : R ≤ r := by simpa [r] using hz
    dsimp [R] at hRr
    linarith
  have hnlower : H.lower ≤ n :=
    (le_max_left H.lower N₀).trans hNn
  have hnN₀ : N₀ ≤ n :=
    (le_max_right H.lower N₀).trans hNn
  have henv := hN₀ n hnN₀
  let q : ℝ :=
    H.A * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n + H.A₀
  have hq_nonneg : 0 ≤ q := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact add_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg H.A_nonneg (by positivity)) (by positivity))
      H.A₀_nonneg
  have houter_pos : 0 < entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius n := by
    dsimp [entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius,
      entireXiPullbackJensenInnerRadius]
    positivity
  have hzclosed : z ∈ closedBall entireXiPullbackJensenCenter
      (entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius n) := by
    rw [mem_closedBall]
    calc
      dist z entireXiPullbackJensenCenter ≤ dist z 0 +
          dist 0 entireXiPullbackJensenCenter := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ = r + 1 / 2 := by
        simp [r, entireXiPullbackJensenCenter, dist_zero_right]
      _ ≤ entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius n := by
        dsimp [entireXiPullbackJensenOuterRadius,
          entireXiPullbackJensenInnerRadius]
        rw [pow_succ] at hnup
        nlinarith
  have hmax : ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ ≤ Real.exp q := by
    apply Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le
      isBounded_ball EntireXiPullback_differentiable.diffContOnCl
    · intro w hw
      apply H.boundary_norm_le n hnlower w
      rw [frontier_ball _ houter_pos.ne'] at hw
      exact hw
    · rwa [closure_ball _ houter_pos.ne']
  have hlog : Real.log ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ ≤ q := by
    by_cases hzero : EntireXiPullback z = 0
    · simpa [hzero] using hq_nonneg
    · have hnormpos : 0 < ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hzero
      have := Real.log_le_log hnormpos hmax
      simpa using this
  calc
    Real.log ‖EntireXiPullback z‖ ≤ q := hlog
    _ ≤ ε * ((2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ 2 := by simpa [q] using henv
    _ ≤ ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      gcongr

name: OverflowResidueRH.mellin_star_ofReal
statement:
theorem mellin_star_ofReal (f : ℝ → ℝ) (s : ℂ) :
    mellin (fun t : ℝ => ((f t : ℝ) : ℂ)) (star s)
      = star (mellin (fun t : ℝ => ((f t : ℝ) : ℂ)) s)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mellin
  rw [show star (∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        ((t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • ((f t : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      = ∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        star ((t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • ((f t : ℝ) : ℂ))
      from (integral_conj
        (f := fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • ((f t : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi 0))).symm]
  refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi ?_
  intro t ht
  change (t : ℂ) ^ (star s - 1) • ((f t : ℝ) : ℂ)
        = star ((t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • ((f t : ℝ) : ℂ))
  have htpos : 0 < t := ht
  have h_arg : ((t : ℂ)).arg ≠ Real.pi := by
    rw [Complex.arg_ofReal_of_nonneg htpos.le]
    exact (Real.pi_pos.ne').symm
  rw [Complex.star_def, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  congr 1
  have h_cpow := Complex.cpow_conj (t : ℂ) (s - 1) h_arg
  rw [Complex.conj_ofReal] at h_cpow
  have h_sub : (starRingEnd ℂ) (s - 1) = (starRingEnd ℂ) s - 1 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_one]
  rw [← h_sub]
  exact h_cpow

name: OverflowResidueRH.completedHurwitzZetaEven₀_zero_star

      = star (HurwitzZeta.completedHurwitzZetaEven₀ 0 s)
proof:

  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := h_real
  unfold HurwitzZeta.completedHurwitzZetaEven₀

    rw [Complex.star_def,
        show ((2 : ℂ)) = (((2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) from by norm_num,
        Complex.conj_ofReal]
  rw [show (star s : ℂ) / 2 = star (s / 2) from by rw [star_div₀, h_two_star]]
  rw [WeakFEPair_Λ₀_star_of_f_modif_ofReal _ φ hφ (s / 2)]

  intro s
  unfold entireRiemannXi
  rw [completedRiemannZeta₀_star h_real]
  have h_half : star ((1 / 2 : ℂ)) = (1 / 2 : ℂ) := by
    rw [Complex.star_def,
        show ((1 / 2 : ℂ)) = (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) from by norm_num,
        Complex.conj_ofReal]
  rw [show star ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * s * (s - 1) * completedRiemannZeta₀ s + (1 / 2 : ℂ))
        = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * star s * (star s - 1) * star (completedRiemannZeta₀ s)
          + (1 / 2 : ℂ)
      from by
    rw [star_add, star_mul', star_mul', star_mul', star_sub, star_one, h_half]]

name: OverflowResidueRH.hurwitzEvenFEPair_zero_f_modif_ofReal_holds
statement:
theorem hurwitzEvenFEPair_zero_f_modif_ofReal_holds :
    hurwitzEvenFEPair_zero_f_modif_ofReal_target
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hurwitzEven_zero_f_modif_real, ?_⟩
  intro x
  unfold hurwitzEven_zero_f_modif_real WeakFEPair.f_modif
  by_cases h1 : x ∈ Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ)
  · have h2 : x ∉ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      fun hx => absurd hx.2 (not_lt_of_gt h1)
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Set.indicator_of_mem h1, Set.indicator_of_notMem h2,
               add_zero]
    change ((HurwitzZeta.evenKernel 0 x : ℝ) : ℂ)
          - (if (0 : UnitAddCircle) = 0 then 1 else 0)
        = ((HurwitzZeta.evenKernel 0 x - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ)
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    push_cast
    ring
  · by_cases h2 : x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1
    · have h1' : x ∉ Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ) := h1
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Set.indicator_of_notMem h1', Set.indicator_of_mem h2,
                 zero_add]
      change ((HurwitzZeta.evenKernel 0 x : ℝ) : ℂ)
            - ((1 : ℂ) * ((x ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)) • (1 : ℂ)
          = ((HurwitzZeta.evenKernel 0 x - x ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      rw [one_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      push_cast
      ring
    · have h1' : x ∉ Set.Ioi (1 : ℝ) := h1
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Set.indicator_of_notMem h1', Set.indicator_of_notMem h2,
                 add_zero]
      simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence_dyadicBallCard_le_divisor
statement:
theorem entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence_dyadicBallCard_le_divisor
    (n : Nat) :
    (hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard
        entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc n : Int) ≤
      ∑ᶠ z, MeromorphicOn.divisor EntireXiPullback
        (closedBall entireXiPullbackJensenCenter
          (entireXiPullbackJensenInnerRadius n)) z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r : Real := entireXiPullbackJensenInnerRadius n
  let B : Set ℂ := closedBall entireXiPullbackJensenCenter r
  let D := MeromorphicOn.divisor EntireXiPullback B
  have hAn : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ EntireXiPullback B :=
    analyticOnNhd_entireXiPullback B
  have hDfinite : D.support.Finite :=
    D.finiteSupport (isCompact_closedBall entireXiPullbackJensenCenter r)
  letI : Fintype D.support := hDfinite.fintype
  let Target := Sigma fun z : D.support =>
    Fin (analyticOrderNatAt EntireXiPullback z.1)
  let Source := {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence //
    ‖entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n}
  have hmem (i : Source) :
      entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i.1 ∈ B := by
    change dist (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i.1)
      entireXiPullbackJensenCenter ≤ r
    calc
      dist (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i.1)
          entireXiPullbackJensenCenter ≤
          dist (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i.1) 0 +
            dist 0 entireXiPullbackJensenCenter :=
        dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n + 1 := by
        have hc : dist (0 : ℂ) entireXiPullbackJensenCenter ≤ 1 := by
          unfold entireXiPullbackJensenCenter
          rw [dist_eq_norm]
          norm_num
        have hi : dist (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i.1) 0 ≤
            (2 : Real) ^ n := by
          simpa [dist_eq_norm] using i.2
        linarith
      _ = r := rfl
  have hD_eq_nat (z : D.support) :
      D z.1 = (analyticOrderNatAt EntireXiPullback z.1 : Int) := by
    rw [MeromorphicOn.AnalyticOnNhd.divisor_apply hAn
      (D.supportWithinDomain z.2)]
    rw [← Nat.cast_analyticOrderNatAt
      (entireXiPullback_analyticOrderAt_ne_top z.1)]
    simp
  have hsupp (i : Source) :
      entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i.1 ∈ D.support := by
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    rw [show D (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i.1) =
        (analyticOrderNatAt EntireXiPullback
          (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i.1) : Int) by
      rw [MeromorphicOn.AnalyticOnNhd.divisor_apply hAn (hmem i)]
      rw [← Nat.cast_analyticOrderNatAt
        (entireXiPullback_analyticOrderAt_ne_top
          (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i.1))]
      simp]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt
      (entireXiPullbackNonzeroZero_analyticOrderNatAt_pos i.1.1)
  let e : Source → Target := fun i =>
    ⟨⟨entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i.1, hsupp i⟩, i.1.2⟩
  have he : Function.Injective e := by
    intro i j hij
    have hz : entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i.1 =
        entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc j.1 :=
      congrArg (fun x : Target => (x.1.1 : ℂ)) hij
    have hk : i.1.2.val = j.1.2.val :=
      congrArg (fun x : Target => x.2.val) hij
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hbase : i.1.1 = j.1.1 := Subtype.ext hz
    exact Sigma.ext hbase ((Fin.heq_ext_iff (by rw [hbase])).mpr hk)
  have hcard : Nat.card Source ≤ Nat.card Target :=
    Nat.card_le_card_of_injective e he
  have htarget : (Nat.card Target : Int) = ∑ᶠ z, D z := by
    rw [Nat.card_sigma]
    simp only [Nat.card_fin]
    push_cast
    rw [← finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype]
    simp_rw [← hD_eq_nat]
    rw [finsum_set_coe_eq_finsum_mem]
    exact finsum_mem_support D
  change (Nat.card Source : Int) ≤ ∑ᶠ z, D z
  rw [← htarget]
  exact_mod_cast hcard

name: OverflowResidueRH.geometric_mul_inv_sq_pow_two_pred_eq
statement:
private lemma geometric_mul_inv_sq_pow_two_pred_eq
    (base : Real) (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    base ^ n * ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) =
      4 * (base / 4) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  have hfour : (4 : Real) ^ k = 2 ^ (k * 2) := by
    calc
      (4 : Real) ^ k = ((2 : Real) ^ 2) ^ k := by norm_num
      _ = 2 ^ (2 * k) := by rw [pow_mul]
      _ = 2 ^ (k * 2) := by rw [Nat.mul_comm]
  norm_num [pow_succ, div_pow]
  field_simp
  rw [hfour]
  ring

proof:

  have hfour : (4 : Real) ^ k = 2 ^ (k * 2) := by
    calc
      (4 : Real) ^ k = ((2 : Real) ^ 2) ^ k := by norm_num
      _ = 2 ^ (2 * k) := by rw [pow_mul]
      _ = 2 ^ (k * 2) := by rw [Nat.mul_comm]
  norm_num [pow_succ, div_pow]

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardZeroDyadicGeometricInvSqMajorant_summable
statement:
theorem hadamardZeroDyadicGeometricInvSqMajorant_summable
    {C C₀ base : Real} (hbase0 : 0 ≤ base) (hbase4 : base < 4) :
    Summable (hadamardZeroDyadicGeometricInvSqMajorant C C₀ base)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : Summable (fun n : Nat ↦ (base / 4) ^ n) :=
    summable_geometric_of_lt_one (div_nonneg hbase0 (by norm_num))
      ((div_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : Real) < 4)).mpr hbase4)
  have hquarter : Summable (fun n : Nat ↦ (1 / 4 : Real) ^ n) :=
    summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by positivity) (by norm_num)
  refine
    ((hbase.mul_left (4 * C)).add
      (hquarter.mul_left (4 * C₀))).congr ?_
  intro n
  simp [hadamardZeroDyadicGeometricInvSqMajorant]

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicGeometricCumulativeCountData.shellInvSqMass_summable
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicGeometricCumulativeCountData.shellInvSqMass_summable
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicGeometricCumulativeCountData zeroLoc) :
    Summable (hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass zeroLoc)
proof:
:= by
  let shift := H.lower + 1
  refine (summable_nat_add_iff shift).mp ?_
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
    (f := fun n ↦ hadamardZeroDyadicGeometricInvSqMajorant
      H.C H.C₀ H.base (n + shift))
    (g := fun n ↦ hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass zeroLoc (n + shift))
    (fun n ↦ hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass_nonneg zeroLoc (n + shift)) ?_ ?_
  · intro n
    have hm_one : 1 ≤ n + shift := by
      dsimp [shift]
      omega
    have hm_lower : H.lower ≤ n + shift := by
      dsimp [shift]
      omega
    have hmass :=
      hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass_le_ballCard_mul
        H.normProper (n + shift) hm_one
    have hcount := H.count_le (n + shift) hm_lower
    have hinv_nonneg :
        0 ≤ ((((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by positivity
    calc
      hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass zeroLoc (n + shift)
          ≤ (hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard zeroLoc (n + shift) : Real) *
              ((((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := hmass
      _ ≤ (H.C * H.base ^ (n + shift) + H.C₀) *
              ((((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount hinv_nonneg
      _ = hadamardZeroDyadicGeometricInvSqMajorant
            H.C H.C₀ H.base (n + shift) := by
        calc
          (H.C * H.base ^ (n + shift) + H.C₀) *
                ((((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) =
              H.C * (H.base ^ (n + shift) *
                ((((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹)) +
              H.C₀ * ((((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
            ring
          _ = H.C * (4 * (H.base / 4) ^ (n + shift)) +
                H.C₀ * (4 * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ (n + shift)) := by
            rw [geometric_mul_inv_sq_pow_two_pred_eq
              H.base (n + shift) hm_one,
              inv_sq_pow_two_pred_eq_geometric (n + shift) hm_one]
          _ = hadamardZeroDyadicGeometricInvSqMajorant
                H.C H.C₀ H.base (n + shift) := by
            unfold hadamardZeroDyadicGeometricInvSqMajorant
            ring
  · exact
      (hadamardZeroDyadicGeometricInvSqMajorant_summable
        H.base_nonneg H.base_lt_four).comp_injective
          (fun _ _ h ↦ Nat.add_right_cancel h)

:= by
  have hfun : (fun z : ℂ ↦ Complex.exp (h z)) =
      fun z : ℂ ↦ Complex.exp (k z) :=
    funext hexp
  have hderiv : ∀ z : ℂ, deriv k z = deriv h z := by
    intro z
    have hd := congrArg (fun f : ℂ → ℂ ↦ deriv f z) hfun
    rw [deriv_cexp (hh z), deriv_cexp (hk z), hexp z] at hd
    exact (mul_left_cancel₀ (Complex.exp_ne_zero (k z)) hd).symm
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℂ (fun z ↦ k z - h z) := hk.sub hh
  have hdiffDeriv : ∀ z : ℂ, deriv (fun w ↦ k w - h w) z = 0 := by
    intro z
    change deriv (k - h) z = 0
    rw [deriv_sub (hk z) (hh z), hderiv z, sub_self]
  let c : ℂ := k 0 - h 0
  refine ⟨c, fun z ↦ ?_⟩
  have hconst : k z - h z = c :=
    is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hdiff hdiffDeriv z 0
  dsimp [c] at hconst ⊢
  linear_combination hconst

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiPullback_eq_zero_of_canonicalProduct_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem EntireXiPullback_eq_zero_of_canonicalProduct_eq_zero
    (H : EntireXiPullbackCanonicalZeroDistribution) {z : ℂ}

    EntireXiPullback z = 0
proof:

    rw [entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_analyticOrderAt H z, hxiOrder]
  have hproductNe : entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct z ≠ 0 :=
    ((entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_differentiable H).analyticAt z)
      |>.analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mp hproductOrder
  exact hproductNe hz

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct
    (H : EntireXiPullbackCanonicalZeroDistribution) {z : ℂ}
    (hz0 : z ≠ 0)
    (hzloc : ∀ i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence,
      z ≠ entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i) :
    logDerivativeResponse entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct z =
      (entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity : ℂ) / z +
        hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
          entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc z
proof:
:= by
  have hpowDiff : DifferentiableAt ℂ
      (fun w : ℂ ↦ w ^ entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity) z := by
    fun_prop
  have hproductDiff : DifferentiableAt ℂ
      (infiniteHadamardProduct entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc) z :=
    (infiniteHadamardProduct_differentiable_of_invSq_normProper
      H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability
      entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceNormProper) z
  have hpowNe : z ^ entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity hz0
  have hproductNe :
      infiniteHadamardProduct entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc z ≠ 0 :=
    H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability.infiniteProduct_ne_zero hzloc
  change logDerivativeResponse
      (fun w : ℂ ↦ w ^ entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity *
        infiniteHadamardProduct entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc w) z = _
  rw [logDerivativeResponse_mul_eq_add hpowDiff hproductDiff hpowNe hproductNe,
    logDerivativeResponse_pow_id,
    logDerivativeResponse_infiniteHadamardProduct_eq_tsum_indexed
      H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability
      entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceNormProper hzloc]

name: OverflowResidueRH.half_not_mem_gammaPoleSet_of_nontrivial_zeta_zero
statement:
theorem half_not_mem_gammaPoleSet_of_nontrivial_zeta_zero
    {s : ℂ} (hzeta : riemannZeta s = 0)
    (hnot_trivial : ¬ ∃ n : ℕ, s = -2 * (n + 1)) :
    s / 2 ∉ gammaPoleSet
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · subst n
    have hs0 : s = 0 := by
      linear_combination 2 * hn
    subst s
    norm_num [riemannZeta_zero] at hzeta
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn0
    apply hnot_trivial
    refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
    have hn' : s / 2 = -((m : ℂ) + 1) := by
      simpa using hn
    linear_combination 2 * hn'

    (hs1 : s ≠ 1) :

    half_not_mem_gammaPoleSet_of_nontrivial_zeta_zero hzeta hnot_trivial

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireRiemannXi_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re
statement:
theorem entireRiemannXi_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    entireRiemannXi s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst s
    norm_num at hs
  have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    subst s
    norm_num at hs
  have hsPole : s / 2 ∉ gammaPoleSet := by
    rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re hn
    simp at hre
    have hn_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    nlinarith
  have hgamma : Complex.Gamma (s / 2) ≠ 0 := by
    apply Complex.Gamma_ne_zero
    intro n hn
    exact hsPole ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hraw : completedXiFunction s ≠ 0 := by
    unfold completedXiFunction
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero
        (mul_ne_zero
          (mul_ne_zero
            (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hs0)
            (sub_ne_zero.mpr hs1))
          (Complex.exp_ne_zero _))
        hgamma)
      (riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re hs)
  rw [completedXiRawEntireXiOffPolePointwiseFormula.pointwise_eq s hs1 hsPole] at hraw
  exact hraw

proof:

name: OverflowResidueRH.half_not_mem_gammaPoleSet_of_entireRiemannXi_zero
statement:
theorem half_not_mem_gammaPoleSet_of_entireRiemannXi_zero
    {s : ℂ} (hxi : entireRiemannXi s = 0) :
    s / 2 ∉ gammaPoleSet
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · subst n
    have hs0 : s = 0 := by
      linear_combination 2 * hn
    subst s
    norm_num [entireRiemannXi] at hxi
  · have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re hn
    simp at hre
    have hright : 1 < (1 - s).re := by
      rw [Complex.sub_re]
      norm_num
      nlinarith
    apply entireRiemannXi_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re hright

name: OverflowResidueRH.riemannZeta_eq_zero_of_entireRiemannXi_zero
statement:
theorem riemannZeta_eq_zero_of_entireRiemannXi_zero
    {s : ℂ} (hxi : entireRiemannXi s = 0) :
    riemannZeta s = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsPole : s / 2 ∉ gammaPoleSet :=
    half_not_mem_gammaPoleSet_of_entireRiemannXi_zero hxi
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_half_not_gammaPole hsPole
  have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := ne_one_of_entireRiemannXi_zero hxi
  have hgamma : Complex.Gamma (s / 2) ≠ 0 := by
    apply Complex.Gamma_ne_zero
    intro n hn
    exact hsPole ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hraw : completedXiFunction s = 0 := by
    rw [completedXiRawEntireXiOffPolePointwiseFormula.pointwise_eq s hs1 hsPole]
    exact hxi
  rw [completedXiFunction] at hraw
  have hcoefficient :
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * s * (s - 1)
          * Complex.exp (-(s / 2) * (Real.log Real.pi : ℂ))
          * Complex.Gamma (s / 2) ≠ 0 := by
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero
        (mul_ne_zero
          (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hs0)
          (sub_ne_zero.mpr hs1))
        (Complex.exp_ne_zero _))
      hgamma
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hraw).resolve_left hcoefficient

name: OverflowResidueRH.not_trivial_of_entireRiemannXi_zero

  intro htrivial
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := htrivial

theorem entireRiemannXi_zero_re_mem_Ioo
    {s : ℂ} (hxi : entireRiemannXi s = 0) :
    s.re ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hzeta : riemannZeta s = 0 :=
    riemannZeta_eq_zero_of_entireRiemannXi_zero hxi
  have hre_lt_one : s.re < 1 := by
    apply lt_of_not_ge
    intro hre
    exact (riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re hre) hzeta
  have hreflected : entireRiemannXi (1 - s) = 0 := by
    rw [entireRiemannXi_one_sub]
    exact hxi
  have hzeta_reflected : riemannZeta (1 - s) = 0 :=
    riemannZeta_eq_zero_of_entireRiemannXi_zero hreflected
  have hreflected_lt_one : (1 - s).re < 1 := by
    apply lt_of_not_ge
    intro hre
    exact (riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re hre) hzeta_reflected
  have hre_pos : 0 < s.re := by
    rw [Complex.sub_re] at hreflected_lt_one
    norm_num at hreflected_lt_one ⊢
    linarith
  exact ⟨hre_pos, hre_lt_one⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullback_zero_im_abs_lt_half

theorem entireXiPullback_zero_im_abs_lt_half

proof:
:= by

    (s := (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) hz

  rw [abs_lt]
  constructor <;> linarith [hstrip.1, hstrip.2]

name: OverflowResidueRH.analyticAt_GammaReal_of_re_pos
statement:
private theorem analyticAt_GammaReal_of_re_pos
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ Complex.Gammaℝ s
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (Complex.Gammaℝ w)⁻¹) s :=
    Complex.differentiable_Gammaℝ_inv.analyticAt s
  have hinv_ne : (Complex.Gammaℝ s)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
    inv_ne_zero (Complex.Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos hs)
  have hdouble := hinv.inv hinv_ne
  change AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => ((Complex.Gammaℝ w)⁻¹)⁻¹) s at hdouble
  simpa only [inv_inv] using hdouble

name: OverflowResidueRH.analyticAt_entireRiemannXiZetaUnit_of_re_pos

private theorem analyticAt_entireRiemannXiZetaUnit_of_re_pos
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ entireRiemannXiZetaUnit s
proof:
:= by
  have hpoly :
      AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (1 / 2 : ℂ) * w * (w - 1)) s := by

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireRiemannXi_eventuallyEq_zetaUnit_mul_riemannZeta_at_zero
statement:
private theorem
    entireRiemannXi_eventuallyEq_zetaUnit_mul_riemannZeta_at_zero
    {s : ℂ} (hxi : entireRiemannXi s = 0) :
    entireRiemannXi =ᶠ[𝓝 s] entireRiemannXiZetaUnit * riemannZeta
proof:
:= by
  have hstrip := entireRiemannXi_zero_re_mem_Ioo hxi
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    intro hs
    subst s
    norm_num at hstrip
  have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := by
    intro hs
    subst s
    norm_num at hstrip
  have hpos : ∀ᶠ w : ℂ in 𝓝 s, 0 < w.re :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds hstrip.1
  filter_upwards [hpos, eventually_ne_nhds hs0, eventually_ne_nhds hs1]
    with w hwpos hw0 hw1
  change entireRiemannXi w =
    entireRiemannXiZetaUnit w * riemannZeta w
  rw [entireRiemannXi_eq_completedRiemannZeta hw0 hw1,
    completedRiemannZeta_eq_GammaReal_mul_riemannZeta hw0
      (Complex.Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos hwpos)]
  unfold entireRiemannXiZetaUnit
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireRiemannXi_analyticOrderAt_eq_riemannZeta_of_zero
statement:
theorem entireRiemannXi_analyticOrderAt_eq_riemannZeta_of_zero
    {s : ℂ} (hxi : entireRiemannXi s = 0) :
    analyticOrderAt entireRiemannXi s =
      analyticOrderAt riemannZeta s
proof:
:= by
  have hstrip := entireRiemannXi_zero_re_mem_Ioo hxi
  have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := by
    intro hs
    subst s
    norm_num at hstrip
  have hunit : AnalyticAt ℂ entireRiemannXiZetaUnit s :=
    analyticAt_entireRiemannXiZetaUnit_of_re_pos hstrip.1
  have hunit_ne : entireRiemannXiZetaUnit s ≠ 0 := by
    unfold entireRiemannXiZetaUnit
    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
      intro hs
      subst s
      norm_num at hstrip
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero
        (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hs0)
        (sub_ne_zero.mpr hs1))
      (Complex.Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos hstrip.1)
  have hzeta : AnalyticAt ℂ riemannZeta s := by
    exact analyticOn_riemannZeta s (by simpa using hs1)
  rw [analyticOrderAt_congr
    (entireRiemannXi_eventuallyEq_zetaUnit_mul_riemannZeta_at_zero hxi)]
  rw [analyticOrderAt_mul hunit hzeta,
    hunit.analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mpr hunit_ne, zero_add]

proof:

name: OverflowResidueRH.riemannHypothesis_iff_entireXiPullback_zeros_real
statement:
theorem riemannHypothesis_iff_entireXiPullback_zeros_real :
    RiemannHypothesis ↔
      ∀ z : ℂ, EntireXiPullback z = 0 → z.im = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannHypothesis_iff_entireRiemannXi_zeros_on_critical_line]
  constructor
  · intro hcritical z hz
    have hline := hcritical
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) hz
    rw [critical_shift_re] at hline
    linarith
  · intro hreal s hs
    let z : ℂ := -Complex.I * (s - (1 / 2 : ℂ))
    have hshift : (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z = s := by
      dsimp [z]
      ring_nf
      rw [Complex.I_sq]
      ring
    have hz : EntireXiPullback z = 0 := by
      unfold EntireXiPullback
      rw [hshift]
      exact hs
    have him : z.im = 0 := hreal z hz
    have hre := critical_shift_re z
    rw [hshift, him] at hre
    simpa using hre

statement:
lemma tailGap_sq_le_sub_sq (x X : ℝ) (hX : |x| < X) :
    (X - |x|)^2 ≤ (X - x)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hX_pos : 0 < X := lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg x) hX
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg hx]
  · have hxle : x ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hx
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hxle]

    nlinarith [hXx_nonpos]

    rw [abs_of_nonpos hxle, sub_neg_eq_add]

lemma intervalIntegral_abs_le_intervalIntegral_majorant
    {f M : ℝ → ℝ} {A B : ℝ}
    (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (hf_int : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume A B)
    (hM_int : IntervalIntegrable M MeasureTheory.volume A B)
    (hbound : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc A B, |f u| ≤ M u) :
    |∫ u in A..B, f u| ≤ ∫ u in A..B, M u
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_abs_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun u => |f u|) MeasureTheory.volume A B :=
    hf_int.abs
  have h1 : |∫ u in A..B, f u| ≤ ∫ u in A..B, |f u| :=
    intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs hAB
  
  have h2 : ∫ u in A..B, |f u| ≤ ∫ u in A..B, M u := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hAB h_abs_int hM_int
    intro u hu
    exact hbound u hu
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.integral_eighteen_y_D_over_u3
statement:
lemma integral_eighteen_y_D_over_u3
    {y D T γ : ℝ} (hT_pos : 0 < T) (hTγ : T ≤ γ) :
    ∫ u in T..γ, 18 * y * D / u ^ 3
      = 9 * y * D / T ^ 2 - 9 * y * D / γ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hγ_pos : 0 < γ := lt_of_lt_of_le hT_pos hTγ
  have h_deriv : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc T γ,
      HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => -9 * y * D / v ^ 2)
        (18 * y * D / u ^ 3) u := by
    intro u hu
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hTγ] at hu
    have hu_pos : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le hT_pos hu.1
    have hu_ne : u ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hu_pos
    have hu_sq_ne : u ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hu_ne
    have h_num : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => -9 * y * D) 0 u :=
      hasDerivAt_const u _
    have h_den : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => v ^ 2)
                  ((2 : ℕ) * u ^ (2 - 1)) u :=
      hasDerivAt_pow 2 u
    have h_div_raw : HasDerivAt
        (fun v : ℝ => -9 * y * D / v ^ 2)
        ((0 * u ^ 2 - (-9 * y * D) * ((2 : ℕ) * u ^ (2 - 1))) / (u ^ 2) ^ 2) u :=
      h_num.div h_den hu_sq_ne
    convert h_div_raw using 1
    have hu_cube_ne : u ^ 3 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 3 hu_ne
    field_simp
    ring
  have h_cont : ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => 18 * y * D / u ^ 3)
                  (Set.uIcc T γ) := by
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hTγ]
    apply ContinuousOn.div continuousOn_const
      ((continuous_id.pow 3).continuousOn)
    intro u hu
    have hu_pos : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le hT_pos hu.1
    exact pow_ne_zero 3 (ne_of_gt hu_pos)
  have h_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => 18 * y * D / u ^ 3)
                MeasureTheory.volume T γ :=
    h_cont.intervalIntegrable
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt h_deriv h_int]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.log_T_le_4_of_le_54
statement:
theorem log_T_le_4_of_le_54 {T : ℝ} (hT_pos : 0 < T) (hT : T ≤ 54) :
    Real.log T ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  have h_2718_lt_exp_1 : (2.718 : ℝ) < Real.exp 1 :=
    lt_trans (by norm_num : (2.718 : ℝ) < 2.7182818283) Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  have h_2718_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2.718 := by norm_num
  have h_pow_le : (2.718 : ℝ)^4 ≤ (Real.exp 1)^4 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ h_2718_nn (le_of_lt h_2718_lt_exp_1) 4
  have h_exp_4_eq : Real.exp 4 = (Real.exp 1)^4 := by
    have := Real.exp_one_pow 4
    have h_cast : ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (4 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [← h_cast]; exact this.symm
  have h_54_le_pow : (54 : ℝ) ≤ (2.718 : ℝ)^4 := by norm_num
  have h_54_le_exp_4 : (54 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 4 := by
    rw [h_exp_4_eq]; linarith
  have h_T_le : T ≤ Real.exp 4 := le_trans hT h_54_le_exp_4
  have h := Real.log_le_log hT_pos h_T_le
  rwa [Real.log_exp] at h

name: OverflowResidueRH.log_T_le_5_of_le_140
statement:
theorem log_T_le_5_of_le_140 {T : ℝ} (hT_pos : 0 < T) (hT : T ≤ 140) :
    Real.log T ≤ 5
proof:
:= by
  have h_e_gt : 2.71 < Real.exp 1 := lt_trans (by norm_num) Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  have h_e_pos : 0 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos 1
  have h_e_nn : 0 ≤ Real.exp 1 := le_of_lt h_e_pos
  have h_exp5_eq :
      Real.exp 5 = Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 := by
    rw [show (5 : ℝ) = 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 from by norm_num,
        Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_add]
  have h_271_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2.71 := by norm_num
  have h_e_ge : (2.71 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := le_of_lt h_e_gt
  have h_e_sq_ge : (2.71 : ℝ) * 2.71 ≤ Real.exp 1 * Real.exp 1 :=
    mul_le_mul h_e_ge h_e_ge h_271_nn h_e_nn
  have h_e_cube_ge :

name: OverflowResidueRH.hasDerivAt_derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive
    (y C D u : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t => derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive y C D t)
      (derivativeSideMajorant y C D u)
      u
proof:
:= by
  unfold derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive derivativeSideMajorant
  have hu_ne : u ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hu
  have hu_sq_pos : 0 < u^2 := by positivity
  have hu_sq_ne : u^2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hu_sq_pos
  have h_log : HasDerivAt Real.log u⁻¹ u := Real.hasDerivAt_log hu_ne
  have h_g : HasDerivAt (fun t => C * Real.log t + D + C / 2) (C * u⁻¹) u := by
    have h1 := h_log.const_mul C
    have h2 := h1.add_const D
    exact h2.add_const (C / 2)
  have h_sq : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t^2) (2 * u) u := by
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2)
        ((2 : ℕ) * u ^ (2 - 1)) u := hasDerivAt_pow 2 u
    convert h using 1
    push_cast
    ring
  have h_div : HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => (C * Real.log t + D + C / 2) / t^2)
      ((C * u⁻¹ * u^2 - (C * Real.log u + D + C / 2) * (2 * u)) / (u^2)^2) u :=
    h_g.div h_sq hu_sq_ne
  have h_neg9y : HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => -9 * y * ((C * Real.log t + D + C / 2) / t^2))
      (-9 * y * ((C * u⁻¹ * u^2 - (C * Real.log u + D + C / 2) * (2 * u))
                  / (u^2)^2)) u :=
    h_div.const_mul (-9 * y)
  have h_fun_eq : (fun t : ℝ => -9 * y * ((C * Real.log t + D + C / 2) / t^2))
                = (fun t : ℝ => -9 * y * (C * Real.log t + D + C / 2) / t^2) := by
    funext t; ring
  rw [h_fun_eq] at h_neg9y
  have h_val :
      -9 * y * ((C * u⁻¹ * u^2 - (C * Real.log u + D + C / 2) * (2 * u))
                  / (u^2)^2)
        = (C * Real.log u + D) * (18 * y / u^3) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [h_val] at h_neg9y
  exact h_neg9y

name: OverflowResidueRH.one_div_sq_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma one_div_sq_tendsto_zero :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => 1 / X^2) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h_inv := const_div_tendsto_zero_atTop (1 : ℝ)
  have h_prod : Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => 1 / X * (1 / X)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (0 * 0)) :=
    h_inv.mul h_inv
  rw [show (0 * 0 : ℝ) = 0 from by ring] at h_prod
  have h_eq : (fun X : ℝ => 1 / X * (1 / X)) = (fun X : ℝ => 1 / X^2) := by
    funext X; rw [pow_two]; ring
  rw [h_eq] at h_prod
  exact h_prod

name: OverflowResidueRH.log_div_sq_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma log_div_sq_tendsto_zero :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => Real.log X / X^2) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le'
    (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (0 : ℝ)))
    (const_div_tendsto_zero_atTop (1 : ℝ))
  · 
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with X hX
    have hX_pos : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1) hX
    have hlog_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log X := Real.log_nonneg hX
    positivity
  · 
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ),
                    eventually_log_le_self] with X hX hlog
    have hX_pos : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1) hX
    have hX_sq_pos : 0 < X^2 := by positivity
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hX_sq_pos hX_pos]
    
    have h_mul : X * Real.log X ≤ X * X :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hX_pos.le
    nlinarith [h_mul]

name: OverflowResidueRH.neg_derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive_le_closedFormSErrorBoundCD
statement:
lemma neg_derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive_le_closedFormSErrorBoundCD
    (C D y T : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hT_ge_1 : 1 ≤ T) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    -derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive y C D T
      ≤ closedFormSErrorBoundCD C D y T
proof:
:= by
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hT_ge_1
  have hT2_pos : 0 < T^2 := by positivity
  have hT2_ne : T^2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hT2_pos
  have hlog_T : 0 ≤ Real.log T := Real.log_nonneg hT_ge_1
  have h_diff :
      closedFormSErrorBoundCD C D y T
        - (-derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive y C D T)
        = 8 * y * (C * Real.log T + D) / T^2 := by
    unfold derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive closedFormSErrorBoundCD
    field_simp
    ring
  have h_diff_nn : 0 ≤ 8 * y * (C * Real.log T + D) / T^2 := by
    apply div_nonneg _ hT2_pos.le
    have h1 : 0 ≤ C * Real.log T := mul_nonneg hC hlog_T
    have h2 : 0 ≤ C * Real.log T + D := by linarith
    have h3 : 0 ≤ 8 * y := by linarith
    exact mul_nonneg h3 h2
  linarith

    exact h2.add_const D
  have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t) (1 : ℝ) u := hasDerivAt_id u
  have h_div : HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => (C * (Real.log t + 1) + D) / t)
      ((C * u⁻¹ * u - (C * (Real.log u + 1) + D) * 1) / u^2) u :=
    h_g.div h_id hu_ne
  have h_neg8 : HasDerivAt
      (fun t : ℝ => -8 * ((C * (Real.log t + 1) + D) / t))

  rw [h_fun_eq] at h_neg8
  have h_val :
      -8 * ((C * u⁻¹ * u - (C * (Real.log u + 1) + D) * 1) / u^2)
        = 8 * (C * Real.log u + D) / u^2 := by

    {T : ℝ} (hT12 : 12 ≤ T) (hT13 : T ≤ 13) :
    (2 / 5 : ℝ) + (T - 12) / 10
      ≤ Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have h_2pi_ne : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_2pi_pos
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hT_ne : T ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hT_pos
  
  have h12pos : (0 : ℝ) < 12 := by norm_num
  have h_12_lt_13 : (12 : ℝ) < 13 := by norm_num
  have h_secant := Real.secant_le_log h12pos h_12_lt_13 hT12 hT13

name: OverflowResidueRH.slabSimplePolyIneq_of_nonneg_x

theorem slabSimplePolyIneq_of_nonneg_x
    {zeros : List ℝ} {Tmin Tmax C D : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ x y T : ℝ,
        0 ≤ x →
        Tmin ≤ T → T ≤ Tmax → 0 < y →
        2 * (1 + x + y) ≤ T →
          closedFormSErrorBoundCD C D y T
            ≤ simpleCloudSum zeros x y
              + smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs x y T) :
    SlabSimplePolyIneq zeros Tmin Tmax C D
proof:
:= by
  intro x y T hTmin hTmax hy hreg
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · have habs : |x| = x := abs_of_nonneg hx
    rw [habs] at hreg
    exact H x y T hx hTmin hTmax hy hreg
  · push Not at hx
    have hxneg : 0 ≤ -x := by linarith
    have habs : |x| = -x := abs_of_neg hx
    rw [habs] at hreg
    have Hneg := H (-x) y T hxneg hTmin hTmax hy hreg
    rw [← simpleCloudSum_neg_x zeros x y,
        ← smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs_neg_x x y T]
    exact Hneg

:= by
  unfold trueKernelLogMajorantPrimitive
  have h_logterm : Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => (-8 * C) * (Real.log X / X))
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 ((-8 * C) * 0)) :=
    log_div_id_atTop_tendsto_zero.const_mul (-8 * C)
  have h_constterm : Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => (-8 * (C + D)) * (1 / X))
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 ((-8 * (C + D)) * 0)) :=
    (const_div_tendsto_zero_atTop (1 : ℝ)).const_mul (-8 * (C + D))
  have h_sum : Tendsto (fun X : ℝ =>
      (-8 * C) * (Real.log X / X) + (-8 * (C + D)) * (1 / X))
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 ((-8 * C) * 0 + (-8 * (C + D)) * 0)) :=
    h_logterm.add h_constterm
  have h_zero_eq : (-8 * C) * 0 + (-8 * (C + D)) * 0 = 0 := by ring
  rw [h_zero_eq] at h_sum
  refine Filter.Tendsto.congr' ?_ h_sum
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with X hX
  have hX_ne : X ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hX
  field_simp
  ring

    (tailGap_sq_pos_of_abs_lt x X hX) (tailGap_sq_le_sub_den x y X hX)

name: OverflowResidueRH.derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive_tendsto_zero
    (y C D : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive y C D X)
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive
  
  have h_logterm : Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => (-9 * y * C) * (Real.log X / X^2))
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 ((-9 * y * C) * 0)) :=
    log_div_sq_tendsto_zero.const_mul (-9 * y * C)
  have h_constterm : Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => (-9 * y * (D + C/2)) * (1 / X^2))
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 ((-9 * y * (D + C/2)) * 0)) :=
    one_div_sq_tendsto_zero.const_mul (-9 * y * (D + C/2))
  have h_sum : Tendsto (fun X : ℝ =>
      (-9 * y * C) * (Real.log X / X^2) + (-9 * y * (D + C/2)) * (1 / X^2))
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 ((-9 * y * C) * 0 + (-9 * y * (D + C/2)) * 0)) :=
    h_logterm.add h_constterm
  have h_zero_eq : (-9 * y * C) * 0 + (-9 * y * (D + C/2)) * 0 = 0 := by ring
  rw [h_zero_eq] at h_sum
  
  refine Filter.Tendsto.congr' ?_ h_sum
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with X hX
  have hX_sq_ne : X^2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 (ne_of_gt hX)
  field_simp
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.abs_pairedCauchyImKernel_le_quadratic_tail
statement:
theorem abs_pairedCauchyImKernel_le_quadratic_tail
    (x y X : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hX : |x| < X) :
    |pairedCauchyImKernel x y X|
      ≤ 2 * y / (X - |x|)^2
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairedCauchyImKernel
  
  have h_neg_form :
      -y * (1 / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + X)^2 + y^2))
      = -(y * (1 / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + X)^2 + y^2))) := by ring
  rw [h_neg_form, abs_neg]
  
  have h_sum_nn : 0 ≤ 1 / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + X)^2 + y^2) :=
    reciprocal_quadratic_sum_nonneg x X y
  have h_prod_nn : 0 ≤ y * (1 / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + X)^2 + y^2)) :=
    mul_nonneg hy h_sum_nn
  rw [abs_of_nonneg h_prod_nn]
  
  have h_distrib :
      y * (1 / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + X)^2 + y^2))
      = y / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + y / ((x + X)^2 + y^2) := by
    rw [mul_add, mul_one_div, mul_one_div]
  rw [h_distrib]
  have h_sub := cauchy_sub_term_le_tail x y X hy hX
  have h_add := cauchy_add_term_le_tail x y X hy hX
  have h_double : y / (X - |x|)^2 + y / (X - |x|)^2
                = 2 * y / (X - |x|)^2 := by ring
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.derivativeSidePartial_abs_le_majorant_partial
statement:
lemma derivativeSidePartial_abs_le_majorant_partial
    {S : ℝ → ℝ} (C D x y T X : ℝ)
    (hy : 0 < y) (hT : 0 < T) (_hC : 0 ≤ C) (_hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hreg : 2 * (1 + |x| + y) ≤ T)
    (hS_T : ∀ u, T ≤ u → |S u| ≤ C * Real.log u + D)
    (hInt : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u => S u * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      MeasureTheory.volume T X)
    (hTX : T ≤ X) :
    |derivativeSidePartial S x y T X|
      ≤ ∫ u in T..X, derivativeSideMajorant y C D u
proof:
:= by
  unfold derivativeSidePartial
  apply intervalIntegral_abs_le_intervalIntegral_majorant hTX hInt
    (derivativeSideMajorant_intervalIntegrable y C D T X hT hTX)
  intro u hu
  unfold derivativeSideMajorant
  rw [abs_mul]
  have hSu : |S u| ≤ C * Real.log u + D := hS_T u hu.1
  have hreg_u : 2 * (1 + |x| + y) ≤ u := le_trans hreg hu.1
  have hk : |pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u| ≤ 18 * y / u^3 :=
    abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_adaptive_18 hy.le hreg_u le_rfl
  have henv_nn : 0 ≤ C * Real.log u + D := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hSu
  exact mul_le_mul hSu hk (abs_nonneg _) henv_nn

name: OverflowResidueRH.stieltjes_limit_identity_of_finite_decompositions
statement:
theorem stieltjes_limit_identity_of_finite_decompositions
    {ι : Type} {A Tail : Finset ι → ℂ} {Z M L : ℂ}
    (hA : Tendsto A Filter.atTop (𝓝 Z))
    (hTail : Tendsto Tail Filter.atTop (𝓝 L))
    (hEq : ∀ F : Finset ι, A F = M + Tail F) :
    Z = M + L
proof:
:= by
  have hA_model :
      Tendsto (fun F : Finset ι => M + Tail F) Filter.atTop (𝓝 Z) :=
    hA.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun F => hEq F)
  have hModel :
      Tendsto (fun F : Finset ι => M + Tail F) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (M + L)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.add hTail
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hA_model hModel

name: OverflowResidueRH.lowFirstZeroDerivativeSide_abs_le_majorant
statement:
theorem lowFirstZeroDerivativeSide_abs_le_majorant
    (Dzero : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T0 : ℝ)
    {x y T γ D : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y)
    (h_reg : 2 * (1 + |x| + y) ≤ T)
    (hTγ : T ≤ γ)
    (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hS : ∀ u, T ≤ u → u ≤ γ →
      |finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u| ≤ D)
    (hSint : IntervalIntegrable
              (fun u => |lowFirstZeroIBPIntegrand Dzero T0 x y u|)
              MeasureTheory.volume T γ) :
    |lowFirstZeroDerivativeSide Dzero T0 x y T γ|
      ≤ 9 * y * D / T ^ 2 - 9 * y * D / γ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowFirstZeroDerivativeSide
  have hx_nn : 0 ≤ |x| := abs_nonneg x
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have h_abs_int :
      |∫ u in T..γ, lowFirstZeroIBPIntegrand Dzero T0 x y u|
        ≤ ∫ u in T..γ, |lowFirstZeroIBPIntegrand Dzero T0 x y u| :=
    intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs hTγ
  have h_pointwise : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc T γ,
      |lowFirstZeroIBPIntegrand Dzero T0 x y u| ≤ 18 * y * D / u ^ 3 := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨huT, huγ⟩ := hu
    unfold lowFirstZeroIBPIntegrand
    rw [abs_mul]
    have hS_u : |finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u| ≤ D :=
      hS u huT huγ
    have h_k_bnd : |pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u| ≤ 18 * y / u ^ 3 :=
      abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_adaptive_18 hy.le h_reg huT
    have hu_pos : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le hT_pos huT
    have h_k_nn : 0 ≤ 18 * y / u ^ 3 := by positivity
    calc |finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u|
          * |pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u|
        ≤ D * (18 * y / u ^ 3) :=
          mul_le_mul hS_u h_k_bnd (abs_nonneg _) hD
      _ = 18 * y * D / u ^ 3 := by ring
  have h_maj_cont : ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => 18 * y * D / u ^ 3)
                      (Set.uIcc T γ) := by
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hTγ]
    apply ContinuousOn.div continuousOn_const
      ((continuous_id.pow 3).continuousOn)
    intro u hu
    have hu_pos : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le hT_pos hu.1
    exact pow_ne_zero 3 (ne_of_gt hu_pos)
  have h_maj_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => 18 * y * D / u ^ 3)
                    MeasureTheory.volume T γ :=
    h_maj_cont.intervalIntegrable
  have h_int_mono :
      ∫ u in T..γ, |lowFirstZeroIBPIntegrand Dzero T0 x y u|
        ≤ ∫ u in T..γ, 18 * y * D / u ^ 3 :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hTγ hSint h_maj_int h_pointwise
  have h_maj_eval :
      ∫ u in T..γ, 18 * y * D / u ^ 3
        = 9 * y * D / T ^ 2 - 9 * y * D / γ ^ 2 :=
    integral_eighteen_y_D_over_u3 hT_pos hTγ
  linarith [h_abs_int, h_int_mono, h_maj_eval]

name: OverflowResidueRH.paired_arctan_tail_lower_rational
statement:
lemma paired_arctan_tail_lower_rational
    {x y T : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y)
    (hminus : 0 < T - |x|)
    (hplus : 0 < T + |x|) :
    y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
      + y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
    ≤ (Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T - x) / y))
      + (Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T + x) / y))
proof:
:= by
  have h_minus := one_side_tail_lower_rational hminus hy
  have h_plus := one_side_tail_lower_rational hplus hy
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · have habs : |x| = x := abs_of_nonneg hx
    rw [habs] at h_minus h_plus
    rw [habs]
    linarith
  · push Not at hx
    have habs : |x| = -x := abs_of_neg hx
    have eq1 : T - (-x : ℝ) = T + x := by ring
    have eq2 : T + (-x : ℝ) = T - x := by ring
    rw [habs] at h_minus h_plus
    rw [eq1] at h_minus
    rw [eq2] at h_plus
    rw [habs, eq1, eq2]
    linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.positiveSmoothKernel_tail_integral_tendsto
statement:
theorem positiveSmoothKernel_tail_integral_tendsto
    (x T : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    Tendsto
      (fun X : ℝ => ∫ u in T..X, positiveSmoothKernel x y u)
      Filter.atTop
      (𝓝 ((Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T - x) / y))
          + (Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T - (-x)) / y))))
proof:
:= by
  have hy_ne : y ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hy
  have h1 := cauchy_one_side_tail_integral_tendsto x T hy
  have h2 := cauchy_one_side_tail_integral_tendsto (-x) T hy
  have h_sum := h1.add h2
  refine h_sum.congr' ?_
  refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun X => ?_)
  
  have hpoint : ∀ u : ℝ,
      positiveSmoothKernel x y u
        = y / ((u - x) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) + y / ((u - (-x)) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) :=
    fun u => positiveSmoothKernel_eq_sum_one_sides x y u
  have hcongr_integrand :
      (∫ u in T..X, positiveSmoothKernel x y u)
        = ∫ u in T..X,
            (y / ((u - x) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) + y / ((u - (-x)) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun u _ => hpoint u)
  have h_int_x := cauchy_one_side_intervalIntegrable x T X hy_ne
  have h_int_neg_x := cauchy_one_side_intervalIntegrable (-x) T X hy_ne
  have hsplit :
      (∫ u in T..X,
          (y / ((u - x) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
            + y / ((u - (-x)) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)))
        = (∫ u in T..X, y / ((u - x) ^ 2 + y ^ 2))
            + ∫ u in T..X, y / ((u - (-x)) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_add h_int_x h_int_neg_x
  exact (hsplit.symm.trans hcongr_integrand.symm)

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothDensityTailModelPartial_neg_im_eq_real_integral
statement:
lemma smoothDensityTailModelPartial_neg_im_eq_real_integral
    (ρ : ℝ → ℝ) (T X : ℝ) {z : ℂ}
    (h_int : IntervalIntegrable
              (fun u =>
                (ρ u : ℂ) *
                  ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) +
                   (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))))
              MeasureTheory.volume T X) :
    -(smoothDensityTailModelPartial ρ T X z).im
      = ∫ u in T..X,
          ρ u * (z.im *
            (1 / ((z.re - u)^2 + z.im^2)
              + 1 / ((z.re + u)^2 + z.im^2)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothDensityTailModelPartial
  rw [show (∫ u in T..X,
              (ρ u : ℂ) *
                ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) +
                 (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))).im
          = Complex.imCLM (∫ u in T..X,
              (ρ u : ℂ) *
                ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) +
                 (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))) from rfl,
      ← Complex.imCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm h_int]
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
  refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr ?_
  intro u _
  change -(Complex.imCLM ((ρ u : ℂ) *
            ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) +
             (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))))
    = ρ u * (z.im *
      (1 / ((z.re - u)^2 + z.im^2)
        + 1 / ((z.re + u)^2 + z.im^2)))
  rw [Complex.imCLM_apply]
  have hpair : (pairedCauchyKernel u z).im = pairedCauchyImKernel z.re z.im u := by
    have h := pairedCauchyKernel_im_eq_imKernel z.re z.im u
    rw [Complex.re_add_im z] at h
    exact h
  have h_im :
      ((ρ u : ℂ) *
        ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))).im
        = ρ u * pairedCauchyImKernel z.re z.im u := by
    change ((ρ u : ℂ) * pairedCauchyKernel u z).im
          = ρ u * pairedCauchyImKernel z.re z.im u
    have hmul : ((ρ u : ℂ) * pairedCauchyKernel u z).im
            = ρ u * (pairedCauchyKernel u z).im := by
      simp [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
    rw [hmul, hpair]
  rw [h_im]
  have hneg : -pairedCauchyImKernel z.re z.im u
              = z.im * (1 / ((z.re - u)^2 + z.im^2)
                        + 1 / ((z.re + u)^2 + z.im^2)) :=
    neg_pairedCauchyImKernel_eq z.re z.im u
  linear_combination ρ u * hneg

name: OverflowResidueRH.abs_pairedCauchyImKernel_adaptive_8

    {x y T : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) (h_reg : 2 * (1 + |x| + y) ≤ T) :
    |pairedCauchyImKernel x y T| ≤ 8 * y / T ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hx_nn : 0 ≤ |x| := abs_nonneg x
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have h_x_lt_T : |x| < T := by linarith
  have h_kbnd : |pairedCauchyImKernel x y T| ≤ 2 * y / (T - |x|) ^ 2 :=
    abs_pairedCauchyImKernel_le_quadratic_tail x y T hy h_x_lt_T
  have h_T_minus_x_ge : T / 2 ≤ T - |x| := by linarith
  have h_T_minus_x_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ T / 2 := by linarith
  have h_T_minus_x_pos : 0 < T - |x| := by linarith
  have h_sq_ge : (T / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (T - |x|) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ h_T_minus_x_nn h_T_minus_x_ge 2
  have h_half_sq_eq : (T / 2) ^ 2 = T ^ 2 / 4 := by ring
  rw [h_half_sq_eq] at h_sq_ge
  have h_sq_pos : 0 < (T - |x|) ^ 2 := pow_pos h_T_minus_x_pos 2
  have h_T_sq_pos : 0 < T ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h_target : 2 * y / (T - |x|) ^ 2 ≤ 8 * y / T ^ 2 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h_sq_pos h_T_sq_pos]
    nlinarith [h_sq_ge, hy]
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.upperHalfPoint_sub_real_norm_ge_half

lemma upperHalfPoint_sub_real_norm_ge_half
    (x y u : ℝ) (hu : 2 * |x| ≤ u) :
    u / 2 ≤ ‖upperHalfPoint x y - (u : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  have h_re : (upperHalfPoint x y - (u : ℂ)).re = x - u := by
    simp [upperHalfPoint]
  have h_abs_x : |x| ≤ u / 2 := by linarith
  have hu_nn : 0 ≤ u := by linarith [abs_nonneg x]
  have h_x_upper : x ≤ u / 2 := le_trans (le_abs_self x) h_abs_x
  have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ u - x := by linarith
  have h_abs_eq : |x - u| = u - x := by
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
    exact abs_of_nonneg h_nonneg
  have h_abs_ge : u / 2 ≤ |x - u| := by
    rw [h_abs_eq]; linarith
  have h_norm_ge : |x - u| ≤ ‖upperHalfPoint x y - (u : ℂ)‖ := by
    have := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (upperHalfPoint x y - (u : ℂ))
    rw [h_re] at this
    exact this
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.largeTScalarConditionTwentyTwoFifteenths_implies_domination

theorem largeTScalarConditionTwentyTwoFifteenths_implies_domination
    {x y T : ℝ}
    (hT140 : 140 ≤ T)
    (hy : 0 < y)
    (hadapt : 2 * (1 + |x| + y) ≤ T)
    (hscalar : largeTScalarMarginConditionTwentyTwoFifteenths T) :
    closedFormSErrorBoundCD (1 / 2 : ℝ) (49 / 20 : ℝ) y T
      ≤ smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs x y T
proof:
:= by
  have h_2pi_lt_140 : 2 * Real.pi < 140 := by
    have h_pi_lt : Real.pi < 4 := Real.pi_lt_four
    linarith
  have hT2pi : 2 * Real.pi ≤ T := le_trans (le_of_lt h_2pi_lt_140) hT140
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hT_ne : T ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hT_pos
  have hT2_pos : 0 < T^2 := by positivity
  have hy_nn : 0 ≤ y := le_of_lt hy
  rw [closedFormSErrorBoundCD_half_4920_eq hT_ne]
  unfold closedFormSErrorBoundHalf4920
  have h_yT2_nn : 0 ≤ y / T^2 := div_nonneg hy_nn (le_of_lt hT2_pos)
  have h_step2 :
      (y / T^2) * ((17 / 2) * Real.log T + 439 / 10)
        ≤ (y / T^2) *
            (((22 / 15) * T / (2 * Real.pi)) *
              Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscalar h_yT2_nn
  have h_step3 :
      (y / T^2) *
          (((22 / 15) * T / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)))
        = (22 / 15) * zeroDensityRho T * y / T := by
    unfold zeroDensityRho
    have hpi_ne : (Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_pi_pos
    field_simp
  rw [h_step3] at h_step2
  have h_geom :
      (22 / 15) * zeroDensityRho T * y / T
        ≤ smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs x y T :=
    smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs_ge_22_15 hT2pi hy hadapt
  linarith

        pairedCauchyComplexKernelDeriv S T X (upperHalfPoint x y)).im
      = derivativeSidePartial S x y T X
proof:
:= by
  unfold complexDensityTailPartial derivativeSidePartial
  
  have hpoint : ∀ u : ℝ,
      pairedCauchyComplexKernelDeriv u (upperHalfPoint x y) * (S u : ℂ)
        = ((S u * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u : ℝ) : ℂ)
          * Complex.I := by
    intro u

    have h1 : (upperHalfPoint x y).re = x := by simp [upperHalfPoint]
    have h2 : (upperHalfPoint x y).im = y := by simp [upperHalfPoint]
    rw [h1, h2]
    push_cast
    ring
  
  have hint :
      (∫ u in T..X,
          pairedCauchyComplexKernelDeriv u (upperHalfPoint x y) * (S u : ℂ))
        = ∫ u in T..X,
            ((S u * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u : ℝ) : ℂ)
              * Complex.I :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun u _ => hpoint u)
  rw [hint]
  
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
  
  simp
