name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue_le_eight_div_sq
statement:
lemma norm_pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue_le_eight_div_sq
    (x y u : ℝ) (hu_pos : 0 < u) (hu_large : 2 * |x| ≤ u) :
    ‖pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue u (upperHalfPoint x y)‖
      ≤ 8 / u^2
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue
  have hsub :=
    norm_inv_sq_le_four_div_sq_of_norm_ge_half
      (w := upperHalfPoint x y - (u : ℂ)) hu_pos
      (upperHalfPoint_sub_real_norm_ge_half x y u hu_large)
  have hadd :=
    norm_inv_sq_le_four_div_sq_of_norm_ge_half
      (w := upperHalfPoint x y + (u : ℂ)) hu_pos
      (upperHalfPoint_add_real_norm_ge_half x y u hu_large)
  calc
    ‖(1 : ℂ) / (upperHalfPoint x y - (u : ℂ))^2
        - (1 : ℂ) / (upperHalfPoint x y + (u : ℂ))^2‖
        ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ) / (upperHalfPoint x y - (u : ℂ))^2‖
          + ‖(1 : ℂ) / (upperHalfPoint x y + (u : ℂ))^2‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ 4 / u^2 + 4 / u^2 := add_le_add hsub hadd
    _ = 8 / u^2 := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue_im
statement:
lemma pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue_im (u x y : ℝ) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue u (upperHalfPoint x y)).im
      = pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue
  rw [Complex.sub_im]
  have h1 : upperHalfPoint x y - (u : ℂ)
            = ((x - u : ℝ) : ℂ) + Complex.I * ((y : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    unfold upperHalfPoint
    push_cast
    ring
  have h2 : upperHalfPoint x y + (u : ℂ)
            = ((x + u : ℝ) : ℂ) + Complex.I * ((y : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    unfold upperHalfPoint
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [show ((1 : ℂ) / (upperHalfPoint x y - (u : ℂ))^2)
        = ((upperHalfPoint x y - (u : ℂ))^2)⁻¹ from one_div _]
  rw [show ((1 : ℂ) / (upperHalfPoint x y + (u : ℂ))^2)
        = ((upperHalfPoint x y + (u : ℂ))^2)⁻¹ from one_div _]
  rw [h1, h2]
  have hd1 : (x - u)^2 + y^2 ≠ 0 := by
    have h_pos : 0 < (x - u)^2 + y^2 := by
      have : 0 < y^2 := by positivity
      linarith [sq_nonneg (x - u)]
    exact ne_of_gt h_pos
  have hd2 : (x + u)^2 + y^2 ≠ 0 := by
    have h_pos : 0 < (x + u)^2 + y^2 := by
      have : 0 < y^2 := by positivity
      linarith [sq_nonneg (x + u)]
    exact ne_of_gt h_pos
  rw [im_inv_sq_complex (x - u) y hd1, im_inv_sq_complex (x + u) y hd2]
  unfold pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.zeroDensityRho_pairedCauchyKernel_intervalIntegrable_UHP
statement:
theorem zeroDensityRho_pairedCauchyKernel_intervalIntegrable_UHP
    (T X : ℝ) {z : ℂ}
    (hTpos : 0 < T) (hTX : T ≤ X) (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u =>
        (zeroDensityRho u : ℂ) *
          ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))))
      MeasureTheory.volume T X
proof:
:= by
  
  have hρ_real : ContinuousOn zeroDensityRho (Set.Icc T X) := by
    apply zeroDensityRho_continuousOn_Ioi.mono
    intro u hu
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hTpos hu.1
  have hρ : ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => (zeroDensityRho u : ℂ))
      (Set.Icc T X) :=
    Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn hρ_real
  
  have hk : ContinuousOn
      (fun u : ℝ =>
        (1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))
      (Set.Icc T X) :=
    (continuous_pairedCauchyKernel_u_of_im_pos hz).continuousOn
  have hprod : ContinuousOn
      (fun u =>
        (zeroDensityRho u : ℂ) *
          ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))))
      (Set.Icc T X) :=
    hρ.mul hk
  exact ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hTX hprod

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothZeroCountingN0_sub_le_width_mul_density
statement:
theorem smoothZeroCountingN0_sub_le_width_mul_density
    {a b : Real} (ha : 2 * Real.pi ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    smoothZeroCountingN0 b - smoothZeroCountingN0 a ≤
      (b - a) * zeroDensityRho b
proof:
:= by
  have ha_pos : 0 < a := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) ha
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn Real smoothZeroCountingN0 (Set.Icc a b) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx_pos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le ha_pos hx.1
    exact (hasDerivAt_smoothZeroCountingN0 hx_pos).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hderiv :
      ∀ x ∈ interior (Set.Icc a b),
        deriv smoothZeroCountingN0 x ≤ zeroDensityRho b := by
    intro x hx
    have hxIcc : x ∈ Set.Icc a b := interior_subset hx
    have hx_pos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le ha_pos hxIcc.1
    rw [deriv_smoothZeroCountingN0 hx_pos]
    exact zeroDensityRho_mono_on_tail
      (le_trans ha hxIcc.1) (le_trans ha hab) hxIcc.2
  have h := (convex_Icc a b).image_sub_le_mul_sub_of_deriv_le
    hdiff.continuousOn
    (hdiff.mono interior_subset)
    hderiv
    a (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr hab)
    b (Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr hab)
    hab
  simpa [mul_comm] using h

name: OverflowResidueRH.canonicalNormCeilShell_abs_re_bounds
statement:
theorem canonicalNormCeilShell_abs_re_bounds
    {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence} {n : Nat}
    (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hi : Nat.ceil ‖entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i‖ = n) :
    ((n - 2 : Nat) : Real) <
        |(entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i).re| ∧
      |(entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i).re| ≤ (n : Real)
proof:
:= by
  have hinner :=
    entireXiPullbackCanonicalNormCeilFiber_pred_lt_norm
      (le_trans (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 2) hn) hi
  have houter :
      ‖entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i‖ ≤ (n : Real) := by
    exact Nat.le_of_ceil_le (by rw [hi])
  have him : |(entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i).im| < (1 / 2 : Real) :=
    entireXiPullback_zero_im_abs_lt_half
      (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc_is_zero i)
  have hnorm_le :=
    Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im
      (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i)
  have hcast_pred : (((n - 1 : Nat) : Real)) = (n : Real) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n)]
    norm_num
  have hcast_two : (((n - 2 : Nat) : Real)) = (n : Real) - 2 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hn]
    norm_num
  constructor
  · rw [hcast_two]
    rw [hcast_pred] at hinner
    linarith
  · exact (Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans houter

  · by_cases hj : 0 < (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc j.1).re

    · simp only [canonicalNormCeilShellToSignedHeightSlab, hi, hj,
        dite_true, dite_false] at hij

  · by_cases hj : 0 < (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc j.1).re
    · simp only [canonicalNormCeilShellToSignedHeightSlab, hi, hj,
        dite_true, dite_false] at hij

    · simp only [canonicalNormCeilShellToSignedHeightSlab, hi, hj,

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellCard_le_two_mul_heightSlabCard

      2 * canonicalPositiveHeightOccurrenceSlabCard
        ((n - 2 : Nat) : Real) n
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype
      (canonicalPositiveHeightOccurrenceSlabType ((n - 2 : Nat) : Real) n) :=
    (canonicalPositiveHeightOccurrenceSlab_finite ((n - 2 : Nat) : Real) n).fintype
  unfold entireXiPullbackCanonicalShellCard
  calc
    Nat.card (canonicalNormCeilShellType n) ≤
        Nat.card
          (canonicalPositiveHeightOccurrenceSlabType ((n - 2 : Nat) : Real) n ⊕
            canonicalPositiveHeightOccurrenceSlabType ((n - 2 : Nat) : Real) n) :=
      Nat.card_le_card_of_injective
        (canonicalNormCeilShellToSignedHeightSlab n hn)
        (canonicalNormCeilShellToSignedHeightSlab_injective n hn)
    _ = 2 * canonicalPositiveHeightOccurrenceSlabCard
        ((n - 2 : Nat) : Real) n := by

        Nat.card_coe_set_eq]

theorem pullbackZeroContribution_eq_canonicalXiPullbackZeroContribution
    (Hsrc : CompletedXi.LogDerivSourceAwayFromZeros)
    {z : ℂ} (hne : XiPullback z ≠ 0) :
    pullbackZeroContribution Hsrc z = canonicalXiPullbackZeroContribution z
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℂ := (1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z
  have hs_ne : completedXiFunction s ≠ 0 := by
    change completedXiFunction ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) ≠ 0
    simpa [XiPullback] using hne
  have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℂ completedXiFunction s :=
    Hsrc.xi_diff_at s hs_ne
  have hchain :
      logDerivativeResponse XiPullback z =
        Complex.I *
          (deriv completedXiFunction s / completedXiFunction s) := by
    simpa [s] using XiPullback_logDeriv_chain_rule (z := z) hdiff
  have hlog :
      deriv completedXiFunction s / completedXiFunction s =
        Hsrc.xiZeroContribution s := by
    simpa [logDerivativeResponse] using Hsrc.xi_logDeriv_eq s hs_ne
  unfold pullbackZeroContribution
  change Complex.I * Hsrc.xiZeroContribution s =
    canonicalXiPullbackZeroContribution z
  unfold canonicalXiPullbackZeroContribution
  rw [hchain]
  rw [hlog]

name: OverflowResidueRH.canonicalShellInvSqMass_le_card_mul
statement:
theorem canonicalShellInvSqMass_le_card_mul (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    canonicalShellInvSqMass n
      ≤ (canonicalShellCard n : ℝ) * (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold canonicalShellInvSqMass canonicalShellCard
  haveI : Fintype {i : EntireXiNonzeroZeroIndex //
      Nat.ceil ‖concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i‖ = n} :=
    (entireXiCanonicalZeroNormCeilFiberFinite n).fintype
  rw [tsum_fintype, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  calc
    ∑ i : {i : EntireXiNonzeroZeroIndex //
        Nat.ceil ‖concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i‖ = n},
        (‖concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
      ≤ ∑ _i : {i : EntireXiNonzeroZeroIndex //
          Nat.ceil ‖concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i‖ = n},
          (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        exact entireXiCanonicalZeroNormCeilFiber_invSq_le_pred hn i.2
    _ = (Fintype.card {i : EntireXiNonzeroZeroIndex //
          Nat.ceil ‖concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i‖ = n} : ℝ)
            * (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: OverflowResidueRH.canonicalShellInvSqMass_summable_of_shellCard_log_bound
statement:
theorem canonicalShellInvSqMass_summable_of_shellCard_log_bound
    (C C₀ : ℝ)
    (hcount : ∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n →
      (canonicalShellCard n : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.log n + C₀) :
    Summable canonicalShellInvSqMass
proof:
:= by
  refine (summable_nat_add_iff 2).mp ?_
  have hb : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
    have hp : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
      Real.summable_nat_pow_inv.mpr (by norm_num)
    refine (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp (hp.congr ?_)
    intro n
    norm_num
  have hbig :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
        C * (Real.log n * (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) +
          C₀ * ((((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹)) :=
    (summable_log_natCast_mul_pred_sq_inv.mul_left C).add (hb.mul_left C₀)
  have hbig2 := (summable_nat_add_iff 2).mpr hbig
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => canonicalShellInvSqMass_nonneg _) ?_ hbig2
  intro n
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n + 2 := by omega
  have hmassle := canonicalShellInvSqMass_le_card_mul (n + 2) hn2
  have hcard := hcount (n + 2) hn2
  have hinv_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (((n + 2 - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
  calc
    canonicalShellInvSqMass (n + 2)
        ≤ (canonicalShellCard (n + 2) : ℝ) * (((n + 2 - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ := hmassle
    _ ≤ (C * Real.log (↑(n + 2)) + C₀) * (((n + 2 - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hinv_nonneg
    _ = C * (Real.log (↑(n + 2)) * (((n + 2 - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) +
          C₀ * ((((n + 2 - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.canonicalPositiveHeightOccurrenceSlabCard_eq_zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab
statement:
theorem canonicalPositiveHeightOccurrenceSlabCard_eq_zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab
    {A B : Real} (hAB : A <= B) :
    canonicalPositiveHeightOccurrenceSlabCard A B =
      ZetaRectangle.zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab A B
proof:
:= by

  unfold ZetaRectangle.zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab

proof:

      IsCompact (closedBall (0 : Complex) (1 + |T|)) :=
    ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : Complex) (1 + |T|)
  apply hcompact.inter_riemannZetaZeros_finite.subset
  intro s hs
  have hxi : entireRiemannXi s = 0 :=
    entireRiemannXi_eq_zero_iff_mathlib_nontrivial_zeta_zero.mpr hs.1
  have hstrip : s.re ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : Real) 1 :=
    entireRiemannXi_zero_re_mem_Ioo hxi
  refine ⟨?_, hs.1.1⟩
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  calc
    ‖s‖ ≤ |s.re| + |s.im| := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im s
    _ = s.re + s.im := by
      rw [abs_of_pos hstrip.1, abs_of_pos hs.2.1]
    _ ≤ 1 + |T| := by
      have him_le_abs : s.im ≤ |T| := hs.2.2.trans (le_abs_self T)
      linarith [hstrip.2, him_le_abs]

name: OverflowResidueRH.scalarGap22_15_monotoneOn_Ici_140

theorem scalarGap22_15_monotoneOn_Ici_140 :

proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  
  have ha_ge : (140 : ℝ) ≤ a := ha
  have hb_ge : (140 : ℝ) ≤ b := hb

  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_pi_lt_4 : Real.pi < 4 := Real.pi_lt_four
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith

  have h_15pi_pos : 0 < 15 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have h_15pi_ne : (15 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_15pi_pos
  
  have h_2pi_lt_a : 2 * Real.pi < a := by linarith
  have h_2pi_lt_b : 2 * Real.pi < b := by linarith
  
  have h_a_2pi_gt_1 : 1 < a / (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ h_2pi_pos]; linarith
  have h_b_2pi_gt_1 : 1 < b / (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ h_2pi_pos]; linarith
  have h_log_b_2pi_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (b / (2 * Real.pi)) :=
    le_of_lt (Real.log_pos h_b_2pi_gt_1)
  
  have h_b_div_a_ge_1 : 1 ≤ b / a := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hap]; linarith
  have h_log_ba_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (b / a) := Real.log_nonneg h_b_div_a_ge_1
  
  have h_α_a_ge : (17 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 11 * a / (15 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h_15pi_pos]
    
    nlinarith [ha_ge, h_pi_lt_4]
  
  have h_log_a_2pi : Real.log (a / (2 * Real.pi))
                  = Real.log a - Real.log (2 * Real.pi) :=
    Real.log_div h_a_ne h_2pi_ne
  have h_log_b_2pi : Real.log (b / (2 * Real.pi))
                  = Real.log b - Real.log (2 * Real.pi) :=
    Real.log_div h_b_ne h_2pi_ne
  have h_log_ba : Real.log (b / a) = Real.log b - Real.log a :=
    Real.log_div h_b_ne h_a_ne
  
  unfold scalarGap22_15
  have h_id :
      (((22 / 15) * b / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (b / (2 * Real.pi))

name: OverflowResidueRH.zeroDensityRho_nonneg_of_ge_two_pi
statement:
theorem zeroDensityRho_nonneg_of_ge_two_pi
    {u : ℝ} (hu : 2 * Real.pi ≤ u) :
    0 ≤ zeroDensityRho u
proof:
:= by
  unfold zeroDensityRho
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have h_ratio_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ u / (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h2pi_pos]
    linarith
  have h_log_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi)) :=
    Real.log_nonneg h_ratio_ge_one
  have h_coef_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity

name: OverflowResidueRH.deriv_smoothZeroCountingN0
statement:
theorem deriv_smoothZeroCountingN0
    {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    deriv smoothZeroCountingN0 u = zeroDensityRho u
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothZeroCountingN0 zeroDensityRho
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have h2pi_ne : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h2pi_pos
  have hu_ne : u ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hu
  have hq_pos : (0 : ℝ) < u / (2 * Real.pi) := div_pos hu h2pi_pos
  have hq_ne : u / (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_pos
  
  have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => u / (2 * Real.pi)) (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) u := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).div_const (2 * Real.pi)
  
  have h_log_inner :
      HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))) (1 / u) u := by
    have hlog := Real.hasDerivAt_log hq_ne
    have h_comp := hlog.comp u h_lin
    have h_simp : (u / (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) = 1 / u := by
      field_simp
    rw [h_simp] at h_comp
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using h_comp
  
  have h_prod :
      HasDerivAt
        (fun u : ℝ => (u / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi)))
        ((1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))
          + (u / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1 / u)) u :=
    h_lin.mul h_log_inner
  
  have h_sub :
      HasDerivAt
        (fun u : ℝ =>
          (u / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi)) - u / (2 * Real.pi))
        ((1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))
          + (u / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1 / u) - 1 / (2 * Real.pi)) u :=
    h_prod.sub h_lin
  
  have h_final :
      HasDerivAt
        (fun u : ℝ =>
          (u / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi)) - u / (2 * Real.pi)
            + 7 / 8)
        ((1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))
          + (u / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1 / u) - 1 / (2 * Real.pi)) u :=
    h_sub.add_const (7 / 8)
  rw [h_final.deriv]
  
  field_simp
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.hasDerivAt_smoothZeroCountingN0
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_smoothZeroCountingN0
    {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    HasDerivAt smoothZeroCountingN0 (zeroDensityRho u) u
proof:
:= by
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have h2pi_ne : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h2pi_pos
  have hu_ne : u ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hu
  have hq_pos : (0 : ℝ) < u / (2 * Real.pi) := div_pos hu h2pi_pos
  have hq_ne : u / (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_pos
  have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => u / (2 * Real.pi)) (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) u := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).div_const (2 * Real.pi)
  have h_log_inner :
      HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))) (1 / u) u := by
    have hlog := Real.hasDerivAt_log hq_ne
    have h_comp := hlog.comp u h_lin
    have h_simp : (u / (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) = 1 / u := by
      field_simp
    rw [h_simp] at h_comp
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using h_comp
  have h_prod := h_lin.mul h_log_inner
  have h_sub := h_prod.sub h_lin
  have h_final := h_sub.add_const (7 / 8)
  
  have h_func_eq :
      (fun u : ℝ => (u / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))
                    - u / (2 * Real.pi) + 7 / 8)
        = smoothZeroCountingN0 := by
    funext v; rfl
  have h_deriv_eq :
      (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))
        + (u / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1 / u) - 1 / (2 * Real.pi)
      = zeroDensityRho u := by
    unfold zeroDensityRho
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [← h_func_eq, ← h_deriv_eq]
  exact h_final

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothZeroCountingN0_monotoneOn_Ici_two_pi
statement:
theorem smoothZeroCountingN0_monotoneOn_Ici_two_pi :
    MonotoneOn smoothZeroCountingN0 (Set.Ici (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Ici _)
  · intro x hx
    have hx_ge : 2 * Real.pi ≤ x := hx
    have hx_pos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hx_ge
    exact (hasDerivAt_smoothZeroCountingN0 hx_pos).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · intro x hx
    rw [interior_Ici] at hx
    have hx_2pi : 2 * Real.pi < x := hx
    have hx_pos : 0 < x := lt_trans (by positivity) hx_2pi
    exact (hasDerivAt_smoothZeroCountingN0 hx_pos).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro x hx
    rw [interior_Ici] at hx
    have hx_2pi : 2 * Real.pi < x := hx
    have hx_pos : 0 < x := lt_trans (by positivity) hx_2pi
    rw [(hasDerivAt_smoothZeroCountingN0 hx_pos).deriv]
    exact zeroDensityRho_nonneg_of_ge_two_pi (le_of_lt hx_2pi)

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothZeroCountingN0_at_14_le_half

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothZeroCountingN0_at_10_ge_neg_one_twentieth
statement:
theorem smoothZeroCountingN0_at_10_ge_neg_one_twentieth :
    -(1 / 20 : ℝ) ≤ smoothZeroCountingN0 10
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothZeroCountingN0
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_pi_lt : Real.pi < 3.15 := Real.pi_lt_d2
  have h_pi_gt : 3.14 < Real.pi := Real.pi_gt_d2
  have h_eq : (10 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.pi) = 5 / Real.pi := by ring
  rw [h_eq]
  have h_5_lt_pi : Real.pi < 5 := by linarith
  have h_5pi_pos : 0 < 5 / Real.pi := by positivity
  
  have h_x_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi := by
    apply div_nonneg
    · linarith
    · exact le_of_lt h_pi_pos
  
  have h_one_add : 1 + (5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi = 5 / Real.pi := by
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have h_pade_raw :
      2 * ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi) / ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2)
        ≤ Real.log (1 + (5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi) :=
    Real.le_log_one_add_of_nonneg h_x_nn
  rw [h_one_add] at h_pade_raw
  
  have h_5_plus_pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 5 + Real.pi := by linarith
  have hπ_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_pi_pos
  have h5pπ_ne : (5 + Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_5_plus_pi_pos
  have h_inner_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2 := by positivity
  have h_inner_ne : ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_inner_pos
  
  have h_pade_step1 :
      2 * ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi)
        ≤ ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_pade_raw (le_of_lt h_inner_pos)
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ h_inner_ne] at h
    linarith
  
  
  have h_pade_poly :
      2 * (5 - Real.pi) ≤ (5 + Real.pi) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pade_step1 (le_of_lt h_pi_pos)
    have hl : Real.pi * (2 * ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi)) = 2 * (5 - Real.pi) := by
      field_simp
    have h_factor :
        Real.pi * ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2) = 5 + Real.pi := by
      field_simp; ring
    have hr :
        Real.pi * (((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi))
          = (5 + Real.pi) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) := by
      rw [show Real.pi *
            (((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi))
            = (Real.pi * ((5 - Real.pi) / Real.pi + 2))
                * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) from by ring,
          h_factor]
    linarith [h, hl.symm.le, hl.le, hr.le, hr.symm.le]
  
  
  have h_polyq :
      (200 - 37 * Real.pi) * (5 + Real.pi) ≤ 400 * (5 - Real.pi) := by
    nlinarith [h_pi_lt, h_pi_gt, sq_nonneg (Real.pi - 3.14),
               sq_nonneg (3.15 - Real.pi)]
  
  have h_chain :
      (200 - 37 * Real.pi) * (5 + Real.pi)
        ≤ 200 * ((5 + Real.pi) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi)) := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pade_poly (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 200)
    linarith
  
  have h_200_log :
      200 - 37 * Real.pi ≤ 200 * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) := by
    by_contra hneg
    push Not at hneg
    have h_mul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hneg h_5_plus_pi_pos
    have h_assoc :
        200 * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) * (5 + Real.pi)
          = 200 * ((5 + Real.pi) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi)) := by ring
    rw [h_assoc] at h_mul
    linarith
  
  
  have h_target_poly :
      (0 : ℝ) ≤ 200 * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) - 200 + 37 * Real.pi := by
    linarith
  
  have h_inv_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (40 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have h_scaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_target_poly (le_of_lt h_inv_pos)
  rw [mul_zero] at h_scaled
  
  have h_lhs_eq :
      (1 / (40 * Real.pi))
        * (200 * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) - 200 + 37 * Real.pi)
        = (5 / Real.pi) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) - 5 / Real.pi + 37 / 40 := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [h_lhs_eq] at h_scaled
  
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.zeroDensityRho_le_T
statement:
lemma zeroDensityRho_le_T
    {T : ℝ} (hT2pi : 2 * Real.pi ≤ T) :
    zeroDensityRho T ≤ T
proof:
:= by
  unfold zeroDensityRho
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_pi_gt_d2 : 3.14 < Real.pi := Real.pi_gt_d2
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hT_2pi_pos : 0 < T / (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have h_log_le : Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) ≤ T / (2 * Real.pi) - 1 :=
    Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hT_2pi_pos
  have h_log_le_T_2pi : Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) ≤ T / (2 * Real.pi) := by
    linarith
  have h_inv_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have h_step :
      (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi))
        ≤ (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * (T / (2 * Real.pi)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_log_le_T_2pi (le_of_lt h_inv_pos)
  
  have h_2pi_ne : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_2pi_pos
  have h_eq :
      (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * (T / (2 * Real.pi))
        = T / ((2 * Real.pi)^2) := by
    rw [sq, mul_comm (2 * Real.pi) (2 * Real.pi)]
    field_simp
  have h_2pi_sq_gt_1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * Real.pi)^2 := by
    nlinarith [h_pi_gt_d2]
  have h_T_div_le : T / ((2 * Real.pi)^2) ≤ T := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < (2 * Real.pi)^2)]
    nlinarith [hT_pos, h_2pi_sq_gt_1]
  linarith [h_step, h_eq, h_T_div_le]

name: OverflowResidueRH.zeroDensityRho_abs_le_log_div_two_pi_of_ge_two_pi
statement:
lemma zeroDensityRho_abs_le_log_div_two_pi_of_ge_two_pi
    {u : ℝ} (hu : 2 * Real.pi ≤ u) :
    |zeroDensityRho u| ≤ (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log u
proof:
:= by
  have h_nn : 0 ≤ zeroDensityRho u := zeroDensityRho_nonneg_of_ge_two_pi hu
  rw [abs_of_nonneg h_nn]
  unfold zeroDensityRho
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have h2pi_inv_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have h2pi_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
    have := Real.pi_gt_three
    linarith
  have h_log_2pi_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * Real.pi) := Real.log_nonneg h2pi_ge_one
  have h_log_eq : Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))
                  = Real.log u - Real.log (2 * Real.pi) := by
    have h_u_pos : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le h2pi_pos hu
    rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt h_u_pos) (ne_of_gt h2pi_pos)]
  rw [h_log_eq]
  
  
  have h_diff_nn :
      (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log u -
        (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * (Real.log u - Real.log (2 * Real.pi))
        = (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (2 * Real.pi) := by ring
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg h2pi_inv_nn h_log_2pi_nn]

name: OverflowResidueRH.zeroDensityRho_mono_on_tail
statement:
lemma zeroDensityRho_mono_on_tail :
    MonotoneOn zeroDensityRho (Set.Ici (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  unfold zeroDensityRho
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have h2pi_inv_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have hab_div : a / (2 * Real.pi) ≤ b / (2 * Real.pi) := by
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hab (le_of_lt h2pi_pos)
  have ha_div_pos : 0 < a / (2 * Real.pi) :=
    div_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le h2pi_pos ha) h2pi_pos
  have h_log_le :
      Real.log (a / (2 * Real.pi)) ≤ Real.log (b / (2 * Real.pi)) :=
    Real.log_le_log ha_div_pos hab_div
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_log_le h2pi_inv_nn

name: OverflowResidueRH.zeroDensityRho_continuousAt
statement:
lemma zeroDensityRho_continuousAt {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) :
    ContinuousAt zeroDensityRho X
proof:
:= by
  unfold zeroDensityRho
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have h_div_pos : 0 < X / (2 * Real.pi) := div_pos hX h2pi_pos
  have h_div_ne : X / (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_div_pos
  have h_inner : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ => u / (2 * Real.pi)) X :=
    (continuous_id.div_const _).continuousAt
  
  
  have h_log : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))) X :=
    h_inner.log h_div_ne
  exact continuousAt_const.mul h_log

name: OverflowResidueRH.zeroDensityRho_le_of_tail

lemma zeroDensityRho_le_of_tail
    {T u : ℝ} (hT : 2 * Real.pi ≤ T) (hTu : T ≤ u) :

proof:
:= by
  exact zeroDensityRho_mono_on_tail hT (le_trans hT hTu) hTu

proof:

name: OverflowResidueRH.abs_smoothZeroCountingN0_le_half_on_first_band_param
statement:
theorem abs_smoothZeroCountingN0_le_half_on_first_band_param
    {U : ℝ} (hU_ge_two_pi : 2 * Real.pi ≤ U)
    (hN0_U_le_half : smoothZeroCountingN0 U ≤ 1 / 2)
    {u : ℝ}
    (hlo : 2 * Real.pi ≤ u) (hhi : u ≤ U) :
    |smoothZeroCountingN0 u| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h_mono := smoothZeroCountingN0_monotoneOn_Ici_two_pi
  have h_2pi_mem : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ici (2 * Real.pi) := Set.self_mem_Ici
  have h_u_mem : u ∈ Set.Ici (2 * Real.pi) := Set.mem_Ici.mpr hlo
  have h_U_mem : U ∈ Set.Ici (2 * Real.pi) := Set.mem_Ici.mpr hU_ge_two_pi
  have h_low : smoothZeroCountingN0 (2 * Real.pi) ≤ smoothZeroCountingN0 u :=
    h_mono h_2pi_mem h_u_mem hlo
  have h_high : smoothZeroCountingN0 u ≤ smoothZeroCountingN0 U :=
    h_mono h_u_mem h_U_mem hhi
  rw [smoothZeroCountingN0_at_two_pi] at h_low
  have h_high' : smoothZeroCountingN0 u ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    le_trans h_high hN0_U_le_half
  rw [abs_le]
  refine ⟨?_, h_high'⟩
  linarith

statement:

proof:

name: OverflowResidueRH.abs_N0_10_sub_N0_le_half_on_11_14
statement:
theorem abs_N0_10_sub_N0_le_half_on_11_14
    {u : ℝ} (hu11 : 11 ≤ u) (hu14 : u ≤ 14) :
    |smoothZeroCountingN0 10 - smoothZeroCountingN0 u| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h_pi_lt_four : Real.pi < 4 := Real.pi_lt_four
  have h_2pi_le_10 : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≤ 10 := by linarith
  have h_10_le_u : (10 : ℝ) ≤ u := by linarith
  have h_10_le_14 : (10 : ℝ) ≤ 14 := by norm_num
  have h_mono := smoothZeroCountingN0_monotoneOn_Ici_two_pi
  have h_10_mem : (10 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ici (2 * Real.pi) :=
    Set.mem_Ici.mpr h_2pi_le_10
  have h_u_mem : u ∈ Set.Ici (2 * Real.pi) :=
    Set.mem_Ici.mpr (le_trans h_2pi_le_10 h_10_le_u)
  have h_14_mem : (14 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ici (2 * Real.pi) :=
    Set.mem_Ici.mpr (le_trans h_2pi_le_10 h_10_le_14)
  have h_10_le_N0_u : smoothZeroCountingN0 10 ≤ smoothZeroCountingN0 u :=
    h_mono h_10_mem h_u_mem h_10_le_u
  have h_N0_u_le_14 : smoothZeroCountingN0 u ≤ smoothZeroCountingN0 14 :=
    h_mono h_u_mem h_14_mem hu14
  have h_diff_le : smoothZeroCountingN0 14 - smoothZeroCountingN0 10
                 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    smoothZeroCountingN0_14_sub_10_le_half
  
  have h_eq : |smoothZeroCountingN0 10 - smoothZeroCountingN0 u|
            = smoothZeroCountingN0 u - smoothZeroCountingN0 10 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : smoothZeroCountingN0 10
                                       - smoothZeroCountingN0 u ≤ 0)]
    ring
  rw [h_eq]
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.zeroDensityRho_10_ge_259_div_3586
statement:
theorem zeroDensityRho_10_ge_259_div_3586 :
    (259 / 3586 : ℝ) ≤ zeroDensityRho 10
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq : (10 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.pi) = 5 / Real.pi := by ring
  have h_inv : (7 / 44 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi) :=
    one_div_two_pi_ge_seven_fortyfour
  have h_log : (74 / 163 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (5 / Real.pi) :=
    log_5_div_pi_ge_74_div_163
  have h_44_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (74 / 163 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  have h_inv_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi) := by
    have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    positivity
  calc (259 / 3586 : ℝ)
      = (7 / 44) * (74 / 163) := by norm_num
    _ ≤ (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (5 / Real.pi) :=
        mul_le_mul h_inv h_log h_44_nn h_inv_nn
    _ = zeroDensityRho 10 := by
        unfold zeroDensityRho
        rw [h_eq]

statement:

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_zetaLogDeriv_two_add_mul_I_le
statement:
theorem norm_zetaLogDeriv_two_add_mul_I_le (y : Real) :
    ‖zetaLogDeriv ((2 : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      backlundRightEdgeLogDerivBound
proof:
:= by
  let f : Nat → Complex :=
    fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : Complex)
  let s : Complex := (2 : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I
  have hsre : s.re = 2 := by
    simp [s]
  have hsumTwo : LSeriesSummable f (2 : Complex) := by
    dsimp [f]
    exact ArithmeticFunction.LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt (by norm_num)
  have hsumS : LSeriesSummable f s := by
    exact hsumTwo.of_re_le_re (by rw [hsre]; norm_num)
  have hnorm :
      ‖LSeries f s‖ ≤ ∑' n : Nat, ‖LSeries.term f s n‖ := by
    exact norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hsumS.norm
  have hterms :
      (fun n : Nat => ‖LSeries.term f s n‖) =
        fun n : Nat => ‖LSeries.term f (2 : Complex) n‖ := by
    funext n
    simp only [LSeries.norm_term_eq]
    rw [hsre]
    norm_num
  rw [hterms] at hnorm
  have hident :
      LSeries f s =
        -(deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s) := by
    have h := ArithmeticFunction.LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq_deriv_riemannZeta_div
      (s := s) (by rw [hsre]; norm_num)
    simpa [f, neg_div] using h
  have hzeta : zetaLogDeriv s = -LSeries f s := by
    unfold zetaLogDeriv
    rw [hident]
    simp
  simpa [backlundRightEdgeLogDerivBound, f, s, hzeta] using hnorm

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.deriv_bottomEdge
statement:
theorem deriv_bottomEdge (R : ZetaRectangle) (t : Real) :
    deriv R.bottomEdge t = (R.right - R.left : Complex)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : R.bottomEdge = fun u : Real =>
      (R.left : Complex) + u * (R.right - R.left) +
        (R.bottom : Complex) * Complex.I := by
    funext u
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [bottomEdge]
  rw [hfun]
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_const t (R.left : Complex)).add
    (((hasDerivAt_id (t : Complex)).comp_ofReal).mul_const
      (R.right - R.left))).add_const
        ((R.bottom : Complex) * Complex.I) |>.deriv
  convert h using 1
  · congr 1
  · ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.deriv_rightEdge
statement:
theorem deriv_rightEdge (R : ZetaRectangle) (t : Real) :
    deriv R.rightEdge t = (R.top - R.bottom : Complex) * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : R.rightEdge = fun u : Real =>
      (R.right : Complex) +
        ((R.bottom : Complex) + u * (R.top - R.bottom)) * Complex.I := by
    funext u
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [rightEdge]
  rw [hfun]
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_const t (R.right : Complex)).add
    (((hasDerivAt_const t (R.bottom : Complex)).add
      (((hasDerivAt_id (t : Complex)).comp_ofReal).mul_const
        (R.top - R.bottom))).mul_const Complex.I)).deriv
  convert h using 1
  · congr 1
  · ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.deriv_topEdge
statement:
theorem deriv_topEdge (R : ZetaRectangle) (t : Real) :
    deriv R.topEdge t = -(R.right - R.left : Complex)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : R.topEdge = fun u : Real =>
      (R.right : Complex) - u * (R.right - R.left) +
        (R.top : Complex) * Complex.I := by
    funext u
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [topEdge]
  rw [hfun]
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_const t (R.right : Complex)).sub
    (((hasDerivAt_id (t : Complex)).comp_ofReal).mul_const
      (R.right - R.left))).add_const
        ((R.top : Complex) * Complex.I) |>.deriv
  convert h using 1
  · congr 1
  · ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.deriv_leftEdge
statement:
theorem deriv_leftEdge (R : ZetaRectangle) (t : Real) :
    deriv R.leftEdge t = -(R.top - R.bottom : Complex) * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : R.leftEdge = fun u : Real =>
      (R.left : Complex) +
        ((R.top : Complex) - u * (R.top - R.bottom)) * Complex.I := by
    funext u
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [leftEdge]
  rw [hfun]
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_const t (R.left : Complex)).add
    (((hasDerivAt_const t (R.top : Complex)).sub
      (((hasDerivAt_id (t : Complex)).comp_ofReal).mul_const
        (R.top - R.bottom))).mul_const Complex.I)).deriv
  convert h using 1
  · congr 1
  · ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.bottomLogDerivIntegral_eq_horizontal
statement:
theorem bottomLogDerivIntegral_eq_horizontal (R : ZetaRectangle) :
    R.bottomLogDerivIntegral =
      ∫ x in R.left..R.right,
        zetaLogDeriv (x + (R.bottom : Complex) * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bottomLogDerivIntegral
  simp_rw [deriv_bottomEdge]
  have hpath (t : Real) : R.bottomEdge t =
      ((R.left + (R.right - R.left) * t : Real) : Complex) +
        (R.bottom : Complex) * Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [bottomEdge, mul_comm]
  simp_rw [hpath]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  have h := intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_add_mul
    (fun x : Real => zetaLogDeriv (x + (R.bottom : Complex) * Complex.I))
    (R.right - R.left) R.left (a := (0 : Real)) (b := 1)
  convert h using 1
  · simp [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]
  · congr 1 <;> ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.rightLogDerivIntegral_eq_vertical
statement:
theorem rightLogDerivIntegral_eq_vertical (R : ZetaRectangle) :
    R.rightLogDerivIntegral = Complex.I *
      ∫ y in R.bottom..R.top,
        zetaLogDeriv ((R.right : Complex) + y * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rightLogDerivIntegral
  simp_rw [deriv_rightEdge]
  have hpath (t : Real) : R.rightEdge t =
      (R.right : Complex) +
        ((R.bottom + (R.top - R.bottom) * t : Real) : Complex) * Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [rightEdge, mul_comm]
  simp_rw [hpath]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  have h := intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_add_mul
    (fun y : Real => zetaLogDeriv ((R.right : Complex) + y * Complex.I))
    (R.top - R.bottom) R.bottom (a := (0 : Real)) (b := 1)
  calc
    (∫ (t : Real) in 0..1,
        zetaLogDeriv
          ((R.right : Complex) +
            ((R.bottom + (R.top - R.bottom) * t : Real) : Complex) * Complex.I)) *
        ((R.top - R.bottom : Complex) * Complex.I) =
        Complex.I * ((R.top - R.bottom) •
          ∫ (t : Real) in 0..1,
            zetaLogDeriv
              ((R.right : Complex) +
                ((R.bottom + (R.top - R.bottom) * t : Real) : Complex) * Complex.I)) := by
          simp [Algebra.smul_def]
          ring
    _ = Complex.I *
        ∫ y in R.bottom..R.top,
          zetaLogDeriv ((R.right : Complex) + y * Complex.I) := by
      congr 1
      convert h using 1
      congr 1 <;> ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.norm_standard_rightLogDerivIntegral_le
statement:
theorem norm_standard_rightLogDerivIntegral_le
    {A T : Real} (hAT : A < T) :
    ‖(standard A T hAT).rightLogDerivIntegral‖ ≤
      backlundRightEdgeLogDerivBound * (T - A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightLogDerivIntegral_eq_vertical]
  simp only [standard_right, standard_bottom, standard_top]
  rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
  calc
    ‖∫ y in A..T,
        zetaLogDeriv ((2 : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
        backlundRightEdgeLogDerivBound * |T - A| := by
      apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      intro y _hy
      exact norm_zetaLogDeriv_two_add_mul_I_le y
    _ = backlundRightEdgeLogDerivBound * (T - A) := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hAT.le)]

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.topLogDerivIntegral_eq_horizontal
statement:
theorem topLogDerivIntegral_eq_horizontal (R : ZetaRectangle) :
    R.topLogDerivIntegral = -
      ∫ x in R.left..R.right,
        zetaLogDeriv (x + (R.top : Complex) * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  unfold topLogDerivIntegral
  simp_rw [deriv_topEdge]
  have hpath (t : Real) : R.topEdge t =
      ((R.right + (R.left - R.right) * t : Real) : Complex) +
        (R.top : Complex) * Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [topEdge]
    ring
  simp_rw [hpath]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  have h := intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_add_mul
    (fun x : Real => zetaLogDeriv (x + (R.top : Complex) * Complex.I))
    (R.left - R.right) R.right (a := (0 : Real)) (b := 1)
  have hreverse :
      (R.left - R.right) •
          ∫ (t : Real) in 0..1,
            zetaLogDeriv
              (((R.right + (R.left - R.right) * t : Real) : Complex) +
                (R.top : Complex) * Complex.I) =
        ∫ x in R.right..R.left,
          zetaLogDeriv (x + (R.top : Complex) * Complex.I) := by
    convert h using 1
    congr 1 <;> ring
  calc
    (∫ (t : Real) in 0..1,
        zetaLogDeriv
          (((R.right + (R.left - R.right) * t : Real) : Complex) +
            (R.top : Complex) * Complex.I)) *
        (-(R.right - R.left : Complex)) =
        (R.left - R.right) •
          ∫ (t : Real) in 0..1,
            zetaLogDeriv
              (((R.right + (R.left - R.right) * t : Real) : Complex) +
                (R.top : Complex) * Complex.I) := by
      simp [Algebra.smul_def]
      ring
    _ = ∫ x in R.right..R.left,
          zetaLogDeriv (x + (R.top : Complex) * Complex.I) := hreverse
    _ = -∫ x in R.left..R.right,
          zetaLogDeriv (x + (R.top : Complex) * Complex.I) := by
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_symm R.left R.right

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.leftLogDerivIntegral_eq_vertical
statement:
theorem leftLogDerivIntegral_eq_vertical (R : ZetaRectangle) :
    R.leftLogDerivIntegral = -Complex.I *
      ∫ y in R.bottom..R.top,
        zetaLogDeriv ((R.left : Complex) + y * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  unfold leftLogDerivIntegral
  simp_rw [deriv_leftEdge]
  have hpath (t : Real) : R.leftEdge t =
      (R.left : Complex) +
        ((R.top + (R.bottom - R.top) * t : Real) : Complex) * Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [leftEdge]
    ring
  simp_rw [hpath]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  have h := intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_add_mul
    (fun y : Real => zetaLogDeriv ((R.left : Complex) + y * Complex.I))
    (R.bottom - R.top) R.top (a := (0 : Real)) (b := 1)
  have hreverse :
      (R.bottom - R.top) •
          ∫ (t : Real) in 0..1,
            zetaLogDeriv
              ((R.left : Complex) +
                ((R.top + (R.bottom - R.top) * t : Real) : Complex) * Complex.I) =
        ∫ y in R.top..R.bottom,
          zetaLogDeriv ((R.left : Complex) + y * Complex.I) := by
    convert h using 1
    congr 1 <;> ring
  calc
    (∫ (t : Real) in 0..1,
        zetaLogDeriv
          ((R.left : Complex) +
            ((R.top + (R.bottom - R.top) * t : Real) : Complex) * Complex.I)) *
        (-(R.top - R.bottom : Complex) * Complex.I) =
        Complex.I * ((R.bottom - R.top) •
          ∫ (t : Real) in 0..1,
            zetaLogDeriv
              ((R.left : Complex) +
                ((R.top + (R.bottom - R.top) * t : Real) : Complex) * Complex.I)) := by
      simp [Algebra.smul_def]
      ring
    _ = Complex.I *
        ∫ y in R.top..R.bottom,
          zetaLogDeriv ((R.left : Complex) + y * Complex.I) := by
      rw [hreverse]
    _ = -Complex.I *
        ∫ y in R.bottom..R.top,
          zetaLogDeriv ((R.left : Complex) + y * Complex.I) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm R.bottom R.top]
      ring

theorem isNontrivialZetaZeroInside_iff_heightSlab
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {s : Complex}
    (hleft : R.left < 0)
    (hright : 1 < R.right)
    (hbottom : 0 <= R.bottom)
    (htopGood : ZetaGoodHeight R.top) :
    R.IsNontrivialZetaZeroInside s ↔
      IsNontrivialZetaZeroInHeightSlab R.bottom R.top s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hs, hrect⟩
    exact ⟨hs, lt_of_le_of_lt hbottom hrect.2.2.1,
      hrect.2.2.1, hrect.2.2.2.le⟩
  · rintro ⟨hs, _himpos, hslabBottom, htop⟩
    have hxi : entireRiemannXi s = 0 :=
      entireRiemannXi_eq_zero_iff_mathlib_nontrivial_zeta_zero.mpr hs
    have hstrip : s.re ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : Real) 1 :=
      entireRiemannXi_zero_re_mem_Ioo hxi
    have himTop : s.im < R.top :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne htop (htopGood s hs)
    exact ⟨hs, lt_trans hleft hstrip.1, lt_trans hstrip.2 hright,
      hslabBottom, himTop⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.natCard_zetaZeroOccurrenceInHeightSlab
statement:
theorem natCard_zetaZeroOccurrenceInHeightSlab
    {A B : Real} (hAB : A <= B) :
    Nat.card (ZetaZeroOccurrenceInHeightSlab A B) =
      zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab A B
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (ZetaZeroOccurrenceUpToHeight A) :=
    zetaZeroOccurrenceUpToHeight_finite A
  letI : Finite (ZetaZeroOccurrenceUpToHeight B) :=
    zetaZeroOccurrenceUpToHeight_finite B
  letI : Finite (ZetaZeroOccurrenceInHeightSlab A B) :=
    zetaZeroOccurrenceInHeightSlab_finite A B
  have hcard := Nat.card_congr
    (zetaZeroOccurrenceUpToHeightEquivSumSlab hAB)
  rw [Nat.card_sum] at hcard
  unfold zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab
  unfold zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight
  rw [hcard]
  omega

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.rectangleBoundaryIntegral_zetaSlabPrincipalPart_eq
statement:
theorem rectangleBoundaryIntegral_zetaSlabPrincipalPart_eq
    {R : ZetaRectangle}
    (hleft : R.left < 0)
    (hright : 1 < R.right)
    (_hbottom : 0 <= R.bottom)
    (htopGood : ZetaGoodHeight R.top) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral R.zetaSlabPrincipalPart
        R.left R.right R.bottom R.top =
      twoPiI *
        (zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab R.bottom R.top : Complex)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hprincipal := rectangleBoundaryIntegral_finitePrincipalPart_eq
    (Finset.univ : Finset
      (ZetaZeroOccurrenceInHeightSlab R.bottom R.top))
    (fun i : ZetaZeroOccurrenceInHeightSlab R.bottom R.top => i.fst.1)
    (fun _ => (1 : Complex))
    (left := R.left) (right := R.right)
    (bottom := R.bottom) (top := R.top)
    (by
      intro i _hi
      have hxi : entireRiemannXi i.fst.1 = 0 :=
        entireRiemannXi_eq_zero_iff_mathlib_nontrivial_zeta_zero.mpr
          i.fst.2.1
      exact lt_trans hleft (entireRiemannXi_zero_re_mem_Ioo hxi).1)
    (by
      intro i _hi
      have hxi : entireRiemannXi i.fst.1 = 0 :=
        entireRiemannXi_eq_zero_iff_mathlib_nontrivial_zeta_zero.mpr
          i.fst.2.1
      exact lt_trans (entireRiemannXi_zero_re_mem_Ioo hxi).2 hright)
    (by
      intro i _hi
      exact i.fst.2.2.2.1)
    (by
      intro i _hi
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne i.fst.2.2.2.2
        (htopGood i.fst.1 i.fst.2.1))
  rw [zetaSlabPrincipalPart]
  rw [hprincipal]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  simp only [mul_one]
  have hcard :
      Fintype.card (ZetaZeroOccurrenceInHeightSlab R.bottom R.top) =
        zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab R.bottom R.top := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
      natCard_zetaZeroOccurrenceInHeightSlab R.bottom_lt_top.le
  exact_mod_cast hcard

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab_add_lower
statement:
theorem zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab_add_lower
    {A B : Real} (hAB : A <= B) :
    zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab A B +
        zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight A =
      zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight B
proof:
:= by
  unfold zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab
  exact Nat.sub_add_cancel (zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight_mono hAB)

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.ResidueIdentity.rectangleLogDerivIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem ResidueIdentity.rectangleLogDerivIntegral_eq
    {R : ZetaRectangle} (H : R.ResidueIdentity) :
    R.rectangleLogDerivIntegral =
      twoPiI *
        (zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab R.bottom R.top : Complex)
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.rectangleLogDerivIntegral_eq_mathlibBoundary]
  exact H.boundary.boundaryIntegral_eq

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.count_eq_smooth_add_rectangleArgumentTerm_of_residueIdentity
statement:
theorem count_eq_smooth_add_rectangleArgumentTerm_of_residueIdentity
    {R : ZetaRectangle} (H : R.ResidueIdentity) :
    (zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight R.top : Real) =
      smoothZeroCountingN0 R.top + R.rectangleArgumentTerm
proof:
:= by
  have hboundary := H.rectangleLogDerivIntegral_eq
  have hquot :
      R.rectangleLogDerivIntegral / twoPiI =
        (zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab R.bottom R.top : Complex) := by
    rw [hboundary]
    field_simp [twoPiI_ne_zero]
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re hquot
  have hre' :
      (R.rectangleLogDerivIntegral / twoPiI).re =
        (zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab R.bottom R.top : Real) := by
    simpa using hre
  have hcountNat := zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab_add_lower
    R.bottom_lt_top.le
  have hcountReal :
      (zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab R.bottom R.top : Real) +
          (zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight R.bottom : Real) =
        (zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight R.top : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcountNat
  unfold rectangleArgumentTerm
  rw [hre']
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.ZetaStandardRectangleResidueFormula.rectangleAt_admissible
statement:
theorem ZetaStandardRectangleResidueFormula.rectangleAt_admissible
    {A : Real} (F : ZetaStandardRectangleResidueFormula A)
    {T : Real} (hT : (F.threshold : Real) <= T)
    (hgood : ZetaGoodHeight T) :
    (F.rectangleAt T hT).AdmissibleForZeta
proof:
:= by
  unfold ZetaStandardRectangleResidueFormula.rectangleAt
  exact standard_admissibleForZeta F.A_pos
    (lt_of_lt_of_le F.A_lt_threshold hT) F.A_good hgood

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.ZetaStandardRectangleResidueFormula.count_eq_at_good_height
statement:
theorem ZetaStandardRectangleResidueFormula.count_eq_at_good_height
    {A : Real} (F : ZetaStandardRectangleResidueFormula A)
    {T : Real} (hT : (F.threshold : Real) <= T)
    (hgood : ZetaGoodHeight T) :
    (zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight T : Real) =
      smoothZeroCountingN0 T + (F.rectangleAt T hT).rectangleArgumentTerm
proof:
:= by
  let hAT : A < T := lt_of_lt_of_le F.A_lt_threshold hT
  have Hres : (standard A T hAT).ResidueIdentity :=
    F.residue T hT hAT hgood
  simpa [ZetaStandardRectangleResidueFormula.rectangleAt,
    hAT] using
      count_eq_smooth_add_rectangleArgumentTerm_of_residueIdentity Hres

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.ZetaStandardRectangleBacklundBound.count_sub_smooth_bound_at_good_height
statement:
theorem ZetaStandardRectangleBacklundBound.count_sub_smooth_bound_at_good_height
    {A : Real} {F : ZetaStandardRectangleResidueFormula A}
    (B : ZetaStandardRectangleBacklundBound F)
    {T : Real} (hT : (F.threshold : Real) <= T)
    (hgood : ZetaGoodHeight T) :
    |(zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight T : Real) -
        smoothZeroCountingN0 T| <= B.C * Real.log T + B.D
proof:
:= by
  have hformula := F.count_eq_at_good_height hT hgood
  have hbound := B.bound T hT hgood
  rw [hformula]
  simpa using hbound

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.ArgumentPrincipleFormula.admissible

    {R : ZetaRectangle} (F : ArgumentPrincipleFormula R) :

:=

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.ArgumentPrincipleFormula.argumentIndex_nonneg
statement:
theorem ArgumentPrincipleFormula.argumentIndex_nonneg

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.ArgumentPrincipleFormula.toResidueIdentity
statement:
theorem ArgumentPrincipleFormula.toResidueIdentity
    {R : ZetaRectangle} (F : ArgumentPrincipleFormula R) :
    R.ResidueIdentity
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { left_of_strip := F.left_of_strip
      right_of_strip := F.right_of_strip
      bottom_pos := F.bottom_pos
      bottom_good := F.bottom_good
      top_good := F.top_good
      boundary := ?_ }
  unfold RectangleResidueIdentity
  change R.mathlibBoundaryLogDerivIntegral =
    twoPiI *
      (zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab R.bottom R.top : Complex)
  rw [← R.rectangleLogDerivIntegral_eq_mathlibBoundary]
  calc
    R.rectangleLogDerivIntegral =
        twoPiI * (F.argumentIndex : Complex) := F.realizesBoundaryIndex
    _ = twoPiI *
        (zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab R.bottom R.top : Complex) := by
      rw [F.formula]
      norm_cast

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRiemannVonMangoldtArgumentFormula.argumentTerm_eq_count_sub_smooth
statement:
theorem ZetaRiemannVonMangoldtArgumentFormula.argumentTerm_eq_count_sub_smooth
    (F : ZetaRiemannVonMangoldtArgumentFormula)
    {T : Real} (hT : (F.threshold : Real) <= T) :
    F.argumentTerm T =
      (zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight T : Real) -
        smoothZeroCountingN0 T
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.formula T hT]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaBacklundArgumentBound.count_sub_smooth_bound
statement:
theorem ZetaBacklundArgumentBound.count_sub_smooth_bound
    {F : ZetaRiemannVonMangoldtArgumentFormula}
    (B : ZetaBacklundArgumentBound F)
    {T : Real} (hT : (max F.threshold B.threshold : Nat) <= T) :
    |(zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight T : Real) -
        smoothZeroCountingN0 T| <= B.C * Real.log T + B.D
proof:
:= by
  have hF : (F.threshold : Real) <= T :=
    le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_max_left F.threshold B.threshold) hT
  have hB : (B.threshold : Real) <= T :=
    le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_max_right F.threshold B.threshold) hT
  rw [← F.argumentTerm_eq_count_sub_smooth hF]
  exact B.bound T hB

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.zetaZeroHeightSetUpTo_finite
statement:

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.exists_zetaGoodHeight_between
statement:
theorem exists_zetaGoodHeight_between
    {A B : Real} (hA : 0 < A) (hAB : A < B) :
    ∃ T : Real, A < T ∧ T < B ∧ ZetaGoodHeight T
proof:
:= by
  let H : Set Real := Complex.im '' zetaNontrivialZerosUpToHeightSet B
  have hH : H.Finite := zetaZeroHeightSetUpTo_finite B
  have hdiff : (Set.Ioo A B \ H).Infinite :=
    (Set.Ioo_infinite hAB).sdiff hH
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hTnot⟩ := hdiff.nonempty
  refine ⟨T, hT.1, hT.2, ?_⟩
  intro s hs hsT
  apply hTnot
  refine ⟨s, ?_, hsT⟩
  refine ⟨hs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hsT]
    exact lt_trans hA hT.1
  · rw [hsT]
    exact hT.2.le

  exact ⟨⟨T, hAT, hTB, hgood⟩⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.admissibleForZeta_of_wide_positive_good
statement:
theorem admissibleForZeta_of_wide_positive_good
    {R : ZetaRectangle}
    (hleft : R.left < 0)
    (hright : 1 < R.right)
    (hbottom : 0 < R.bottom)
    (hbottomGood : ZetaGoodHeight R.bottom)
    (htopGood : ZetaGoodHeight R.top) :
    R.AdmissibleForZeta where
  noZerosOnBoundary
proof:
:= by
    intro s hs hboundary
    rcases hboundary with ⟨hclosed, hnotOpen⟩
    have hxi : entireRiemannXi s = 0 :=
      entireRiemannXi_eq_zero_iff_mathlib_nontrivial_zeta_zero.mpr hs
    have hstrip : s.re ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : Real) 1 :=
      entireRiemannXi_zero_re_mem_Ioo hxi
    have hreLeft : R.left < s.re := lt_trans hleft hstrip.1
    have hreRight : s.re < R.right := lt_trans hstrip.2 hright
    have himBottom : R.bottom < s.im :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hclosed.2.2.1 (Ne.symm (hbottomGood s hs))
    have himTop : s.im < R.top :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hclosed.2.2.2 (htopGood s hs)
    exact hnotOpen ⟨hreLeft, hreRight, himBottom, himTop⟩
  poleNotOnBoundary := by
    intro hboundary
    have him := hboundary.1.2.2.1
    norm_num at him
    linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.standard_admissibleForZeta
statement:
theorem standard_admissibleForZeta
    {A T : Real} (hA : 0 < A) (hAT : A < T)
    (hAgood : ZetaGoodHeight A) (hTgood : ZetaGoodHeight T) :
    (standard A T hAT).AdmissibleForZeta
proof:
:= by
  apply admissibleForZeta_of_wide_positive_good
  · norm_num
  · norm_num
  · exact hA
  · exact hAgood
  · exact hTgood

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.differentiableAt_riemannZeta_of_containsClosed_bottom_pos
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_riemannZeta_of_containsClosed_bottom_pos
    {R : ZetaRectangle} (hbottom : 0 < R.bottom)
    {s : Complex} (hs : R.ContainsClosed s) :
    DifferentiableAt Complex riemannZeta s
proof:
:= by
  apply differentiableAt_riemannZeta
  intro hs1
  subst s
  have him := hs.2.2.1
  norm_num at him
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.ZetaRectangle.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_admissible_on_boundary
statement:
theorem riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_admissible_on_boundary
    {R : ZetaRectangle} (H : R.AdmissibleForZeta)
    (hbottom : 0 < R.bottom) {s : Complex}
    (hs : R.ContainsBoundary s) :
    riemannZeta s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have himpos : 0 < s.im := lt_of_lt_of_le hbottom hs.1.2.2.1
  apply H.noZerosOnBoundary s ?_ hs
  refine ⟨hz, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    norm_num at himpos
  · intro hs1
    subst s
    norm_num at himpos

name: OverflowResidueRH.twoPiI_ne_zero
statement: theorem twoPiI_ne_zero : twoPiI ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold twoPiI
  exact mul_ne_zero
    (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero))
    Complex.I_ne_zero

name: OverflowResidueRH.rectangleBoundaryIntegral_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn
statement:
theorem rectangleBoundaryIntegral_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn
    {g : Complex → Complex} {left right bottom top : Real}
    (hg : DifferentiableOn Complex g
      ([[left, right]] ×ℂ [[bottom, top]])) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral g left right bottom top = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [rectangleBoundaryIntegral] using
    (Complex.integral_boundary_rect_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn

name: OverflowResidueRH.RectangleResidueIdentity.boundaryIntegral_eq
statement:
theorem RectangleResidueIdentity.boundaryIntegral_eq
    {logDerivative : Complex → Complex}
    {left right bottom top : Real} {divisorMass : Int}
    (H : RectangleResidueIdentity logDerivative
      left right bottom top divisorMass) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral logDerivative left right bottom top =

name: OverflowResidueRH.integral_inv_horizontal_eq_log_sub
statement:
private theorem integral_inv_horizontal_eq_log_sub
    {a b y : Real} {rho : Complex} (hy : y ≠ rho.im) :
    (∫ x in a..b,
      (((x : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho)⁻¹)) =
      Complex.log ((b : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho) -
        Complex.log ((a : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho)
proof:
:= by
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
  · intro x _hx
    have hlin : HasDerivAt
        (fun u : Real =>
          (u : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho) 1 x := by
      simpa using
        ((((hasDerivAt_id (x : Complex)).comp_ofReal).add_const
          ((y : Complex) * Complex.I)).sub_const rho)
    have hslit :
        (x : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho ∈
          Complex.slitPlane := by
      rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff]
      right
      have him :
          ((x : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho).im =
            y - rho.im := by simp
      rw [him]
      exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hy
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using hlin.clog_real hslit
  · apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    exact
      (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const).sub continuous_const).inv₀
        (fun x => by
          intro hzero
          apply hy
          have him := congrArg Complex.im hzero
          apply sub_eq_zero.mp
          simpa using him)).continuousOn

name: OverflowResidueRH.I_mul_integral_inv_vertical_right_eq_log_sub
statement:
private theorem I_mul_integral_inv_vertical_right_eq_log_sub
    {a b x : Real} {rho : Complex} (hx : rho.re < x) :
    Complex.I * (∫ y in a..b,
      (((x : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho)⁻¹)) =
      Complex.log ((x : Complex) + (b : Complex) * Complex.I - rho) -
        Complex.log ((x : Complex) + (a : Complex) * Complex.I - rho)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
  · intro y _hy
    have hlin : HasDerivAt
        (fun u : Real =>
          (x : Complex) + (u : Complex) * Complex.I - rho)
        Complex.I y := by
      simpa using
        (((hasDerivAt_const y (x : Complex)).add
          (((hasDerivAt_id (y : Complex)).comp_ofReal).mul_const Complex.I)).sub_const rho)
    have hslit :
        (x : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho ∈
          Complex.slitPlane := by
      rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff]
      left
      simpa using hx
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using hlin.clog_real hslit
  · apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    exact
      (continuous_const.mul
        (((continuous_const.add
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).sub continuous_const).inv₀
          (fun y => by
            intro hzero
            have hre := congrArg Complex.re hzero
            have hxsub : x - rho.re = 0 := by simpa using hre
            have : x = rho.re := sub_eq_zero.mp hxsub
            exact (ne_of_gt hx) this))).continuousOn

name: OverflowResidueRH.I_mul_integral_inv_vertical_left_eq_negLog_sub
statement:
private theorem I_mul_integral_inv_vertical_left_eq_negLog_sub
    {a b x : Real} {rho : Complex} (hx : x < rho.re) :
    Complex.I * (∫ y in a..b,
      (((x : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho)⁻¹)) =
      Complex.log (-((x : Complex) + (b : Complex) * Complex.I - rho)) -
        Complex.log (-((x : Complex) + (a : Complex) * Complex.I - rho))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
  · intro y _hy
    have hlin : HasDerivAt
        (fun u : Real =>
          -((x : Complex) + (u : Complex) * Complex.I - rho))
        (-Complex.I) y := by
      have hbase : HasDerivAt
          (fun u : Real =>
            (x : Complex) + (u : Complex) * Complex.I - rho)
          Complex.I y := by
        simpa using
          (((hasDerivAt_const y (x : Complex)).add
            (((hasDerivAt_id (y : Complex)).comp_ofReal).mul_const Complex.I)).sub_const rho)
      exact hbase.neg
    have hslit :
        -((x : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho) ∈
          Complex.slitPlane := by
      rw [Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff]
      left
      simpa using hx
    have hlog := hlin.clog_real hslit
    have hcoeff :
        (-Complex.I) /
            (-((x : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho)) =
          Complex.I *
            ((x : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho)⁻¹ := by
      rw [neg_div_neg_eq]
      rfl
    rw [hcoeff] at hlog
    exact hlog
  · apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
    exact
      (continuous_const.mul
        (((continuous_const.add
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).sub continuous_const).inv₀
          (fun y => by
            intro hzero
            have hre := congrArg Complex.re hzero
            have hxsub : x - rho.re = 0 := by simpa using hre
            have : x = rho.re := sub_eq_zero.mp hxsub
            exact (ne_of_lt hx) this))).continuousOn

name: OverflowResidueRH.rectangleBoundaryIntegral_inv_sub_eq_twoPiI
statement:
theorem rectangleBoundaryIntegral_inv_sub_eq_twoPiI
    {left right bottom top : Real} {rho : Complex}
    (hleft : left < rho.re) (hright : rho.re < right)
    (hbottom : bottom < rho.im) (htop : rho.im < top) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral (fun z => (z - rho)⁻¹)
      left right bottom top = twoPiI
proof:
:= by
  have hbottom_ne : bottom ≠ rho.im := ne_of_lt hbottom
  have htop_ne : top ≠ rho.im := ne_of_gt htop
  rw [rectangleBoundaryIntegral,
    integral_inv_horizontal_eq_log_sub hbottom_ne,
    integral_inv_horizontal_eq_log_sub htop_ne,
    I_mul_integral_inv_vertical_right_eq_log_sub hright,
    I_mul_integral_inv_vertical_left_eq_negLog_sub hleft]
  let zBottom : Complex :=
    (left : Complex) + (bottom : Complex) * Complex.I - rho
  let zTop : Complex :=
    (left : Complex) + (top : Complex) * Complex.I - rho
  have hzBottom_im : zBottom.im < 0 := by
    dsimp [zBottom]
    simpa using hbottom
  have hzTop_im : 0 < zTop.im := by
    dsimp [zTop]
    simpa using htop
  have hlogBottom :
      Complex.log (-zBottom) - Complex.log zBottom =
        (Real.pi : Complex) * Complex.I := by
    rw [Complex.log, Complex.log, norm_neg,
      Complex.arg_neg_eq_arg_add_pi_of_im_neg hzBottom_im]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hlogTop :
      Complex.log zTop - Complex.log (-zTop) =
        (Real.pi : Complex) * Complex.I := by
    rw [Complex.log, Complex.log, norm_neg,
      Complex.arg_neg_eq_arg_sub_pi_of_im_pos hzTop_im]
    push_cast
    ring
  change
    (Complex.log
          ((right : Complex) + (bottom : Complex) * Complex.I - rho) -
        Complex.log zBottom) -
      (Complex.log
          ((right : Complex) + (top : Complex) * Complex.I - rho) -
        Complex.log zTop) +
      (Complex.log
          ((right : Complex) + (top : Complex) * Complex.I - rho) -
        Complex.log
          ((right : Complex) + (bottom : Complex) * Complex.I - rho)) -
      (Complex.log (-zTop) - Complex.log (-zBottom)) = twoPiI
  have hnegBottom : Complex.log (-zBottom) =
      Complex.log zBottom + (Real.pi : Complex) * Complex.I := by
    linear_combination hlogBottom
  have hnegTop : Complex.log (-zTop) =
      Complex.log zTop - (Real.pi : Complex) * Complex.I := by
    linear_combination -hlogTop
  rw [hnegBottom, hnegTop]
  unfold twoPiI
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.rectangleBoundaryIntegral_const_mul_inv_sub_eq
statement:
theorem rectangleBoundaryIntegral_const_mul_inv_sub_eq
    {left right bottom top : Real} {rho c : Complex}
    (hleft : left < rho.re) (hright : rho.re < right)
    (hbottom : bottom < rho.im) (htop : rho.im < top) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral (fun z => c * (z - rho)⁻¹)
      left right bottom top = twoPiI * c
proof:
:= by
  unfold rectangleBoundaryIntegral
  simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  have h := rectangleBoundaryIntegral_inv_sub_eq_twoPiI
    hleft hright hbottom htop
  unfold rectangleBoundaryIntegral at h
  rw [← h]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.rectangleBoundaryIntegral_inv_sub_eq_zero_of_outside
statement:
theorem rectangleBoundaryIntegral_inv_sub_eq_zero_of_outside
    {left right bottom top : Real} {rho : Complex}
    (hout : ∀ z ∈ ([[left, right]] ×ℂ [[bottom, top]]), z ≠ rho) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral (fun z => (z - rho)⁻¹)
      left right bottom top = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply rectangleBoundaryIntegral_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn
  intro z hz
  exact ((differentiableAt_id.sub (differentiableAt_const rho)).inv
    (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hout z hz))).differentiableWithinAt

name: OverflowResidueRH.rectangleBoundaryIntegral_const_mul_inv_sub_eq_zero_of_outside
statement:
theorem rectangleBoundaryIntegral_const_mul_inv_sub_eq_zero_of_outside
    {left right bottom top : Real} {rho c : Complex}
    (hout : ∀ z ∈ ([[left, right]] ×ℂ [[bottom, top]]), z ≠ rho) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral (fun z => c * (z - rho)⁻¹)
      left right bottom top = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral (fun z => c * (z - rho)⁻¹)
        left right bottom top =
        c * rectangleBoundaryIntegral (fun z => (z - rho)⁻¹)
          left right bottom top := by
      unfold rectangleBoundaryIntegral
      simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      ring
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [rectangleBoundaryIntegral_inv_sub_eq_zero_of_outside hout]
      simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_horizontal
statement:
private theorem intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_horizontal
    {a b y : Real} {rho c : Complex} (hy : y ≠ rho.im) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : Real =>
        c * ((x : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume a b
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
  exact
    (continuous_const.mul
      (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const).sub continuous_const).inv₀
        (fun x => by
          intro hzero
          apply hy
          have him := congrArg Complex.im hzero
          apply sub_eq_zero.mp
          simpa using him))).continuousOn

private theorem intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_vertical

proof:

    (continuous_const.mul
      (((continuous_const.add
        (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)).sub continuous_const).inv₀
        (fun y => by
          intro hzero
          apply hx
          have hre := congrArg Complex.re hzero
          apply sub_eq_zero.mp
          simpa using hre))).continuousOn

statement:
private theorem intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_horizontal_of_ne

      (x : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I ≠ rho) :

name: OverflowResidueRH.rectangleBoundaryIntegral_finitePrincipalPart_eq_sum
statement:
theorem rectangleBoundaryIntegral_finitePrincipalPart_eq_sum
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (rho : ι → Complex) (c : ι → Complex)
    {left right bottom top : Real}
    (hBottomInt : ∀ i ∈ s, IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : Real =>
        c i * ((x : Complex) + (bottom : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume left right)
    (hTopInt : ∀ i ∈ s, IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : Real =>
        c i * ((x : Complex) + (top : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume left right)
    (hRightInt : ∀ i ∈ s, IntervalIntegrable
      (fun y : Real =>
        c i * ((right : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume bottom top)
    (hLeftInt : ∀ i ∈ s, IntervalIntegrable
      (fun y : Real =>
        c i * ((left : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume bottom top) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral (finitePrincipalPart s rho c)
        left right bottom top =
      ∑ i ∈ s, rectangleBoundaryIntegral
        (fun z => c i * (z - rho i)⁻¹) left right bottom top
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold rectangleBoundaryIntegral finitePrincipalPart
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum hBottomInt,
    intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum hTopInt,
    intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum hRightInt,
    intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum hLeftInt]
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]

name: OverflowResidueRH.rectangleBoundaryIntegral_finitePrincipalPart_eq_insideSum
statement:
theorem rectangleBoundaryIntegral_finitePrincipalPart_eq_insideSum
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (rho : ι → Complex) (c : ι → Complex)
    {left right bottom top : Real}
    (hlr : left ≤ right) (hbt : bottom ≤ top)
    (hclass : ∀ i ∈ s,
      InOpenRectangle left right bottom top (rho i) ∨
        (∀ z ∈ ([[left, right]] ×ℂ [[bottom, top]]), z ≠ rho i)) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral (finitePrincipalPart s rho c)
        left right bottom top =
      twoPiI * ∑ i ∈ s.filter
        (InOpenRectangle left right bottom top ∘ rho), c i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hBottomInt : ∀ i ∈ s, IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : Real =>
        c i * ((x : Complex) + (bottom : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume left right := by
    intro i hi
    rcases hclass i hi with hin | hout
    · exact intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_horizontal
        (ne_of_lt hin.2.2.1)
    · apply intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_horizontal_of_ne
      intro x hx
      apply hout ((x : Complex) + (bottom : Complex) * Complex.I)
      constructor
      · simpa using hx
      · simpa [Set.uIcc_of_le hbt]
  have hTopInt : ∀ i ∈ s, IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : Real =>
        c i * ((x : Complex) + (top : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume left right := by
    intro i hi
    rcases hclass i hi with hin | hout
    · exact intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_horizontal
        (ne_of_gt hin.2.2.2)
    · apply intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_horizontal_of_ne
      intro x hx
      apply hout ((x : Complex) + (top : Complex) * Complex.I)
      constructor
      · simpa using hx
      · simpa [Set.uIcc_of_le hbt]
  have hRightInt : ∀ i ∈ s, IntervalIntegrable
      (fun y : Real =>
        c i * ((right : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume bottom top := by
    intro i hi
    rcases hclass i hi with hin | hout
    · exact intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_vertical
        (ne_of_gt hin.2.1)
    · apply intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_vertical_of_ne
      intro y hy
      apply hout ((right : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I)
      constructor
      · simpa [Set.uIcc_of_le hlr]
      · simpa using hy
  have hLeftInt : ∀ i ∈ s, IntervalIntegrable
      (fun y : Real =>
        c i * ((left : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume bottom top := by
    intro i hi
    rcases hclass i hi with hin | hout
    · exact intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_vertical
        (ne_of_lt hin.1)
    · apply intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_vertical_of_ne
      intro y hy
      apply hout ((left : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I)
      constructor
      · simpa [Set.uIcc_of_le hlr]
      · simpa using hy
  rw [rectangleBoundaryIntegral_finitePrincipalPart_eq_sum
    s rho c hBottomInt hTopInt hRightInt hLeftInt]
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ s, rectangleBoundaryIntegral
        (fun z => c i * (z - rho i)⁻¹) left right bottom top) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, if InOpenRectangle left right bottom top (rho i)
        then twoPiI * c i else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      split_ifs with hin
      · exact rectangleBoundaryIntegral_const_mul_inv_sub_eq
          hin.1 hin.2.1 hin.2.2.1 hin.2.2.2
      · rcases hclass i hi with hinside | hout
        · exact (hin hinside).elim
        · exact rectangleBoundaryIntegral_const_mul_inv_sub_eq_zero_of_outside hout
    _ = twoPiI * ∑ i ∈ s.filter
          (InOpenRectangle left right bottom top ∘ rho), c i := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      clear hclass hBottomInt hTopInt hRightInt hLeftInt hlr hbt
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp
      | @insert a s ha ih =>
          by_cases hp : InOpenRectangle left right bottom top (rho a)
          · rw [Finset.filter_insert]
            simp [ha, hp, ih, Function.comp_apply]
          · rw [Finset.filter_insert]
            simp [ha, hp, ih, Function.comp_apply]

name: OverflowResidueRH.rectangleBoundaryIntegral_finitePrincipalPart_eq
statement:
theorem rectangleBoundaryIntegral_finitePrincipalPart_eq
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (rho : ι → Complex) (c : ι → Complex)
    {left right bottom top : Real}
    (hleft : ∀ i ∈ s, left < (rho i).re)
    (hright : ∀ i ∈ s, (rho i).re < right)
    (hbottom : ∀ i ∈ s, bottom < (rho i).im)
    (htop : ∀ i ∈ s, (rho i).im < top) :
    rectangleBoundaryIntegral (finitePrincipalPart s rho c)
      left right bottom top = twoPiI * ∑ i ∈ s, c i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hBottomInt : ∀ i ∈ s, IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : Real =>
        c i * ((x : Complex) + (bottom : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume left right := by
    intro i hi
    exact intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_horizontal
      (ne_of_lt (hbottom i hi))
  have hTopInt : ∀ i ∈ s, IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : Real =>
        c i * ((x : Complex) + (top : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume left right := by
    intro i hi
    exact intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_horizontal
      (ne_of_gt (htop i hi))
  have hRightInt : ∀ i ∈ s, IntervalIntegrable
      (fun y : Real =>
        c i * ((right : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume bottom top := by
    intro i hi
    exact intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_vertical
      (ne_of_gt (hright i hi))
  have hLeftInt : ∀ i ∈ s, IntervalIntegrable
      (fun y : Real =>
        c i * ((left : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)
      MeasureTheory.volume bottom top := by
    intro i hi
    exact intervalIntegrable_const_mul_inv_vertical
      (ne_of_lt (hleft i hi))
  unfold rectangleBoundaryIntegral finitePrincipalPart
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum hBottomInt,
    intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum hTopInt,
    intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum hRightInt,
    intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum hLeftInt]
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ x in left..right,
          c i * ((x : Complex) + (bottom : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹) -
        (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ x in left..right,
          c i * ((x : Complex) + (top : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹) +
        Complex.I * (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ y in bottom..top,
          c i * ((right : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹) -
        Complex.I * (∑ i ∈ s, ∫ y in bottom..top,
          c i * ((left : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹) =
        ∑ i ∈ s,
          ((∫ x in left..right,
              c i * ((x : Complex) + (bottom : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹) -
            (∫ x in left..right,
              c i * ((x : Complex) + (top : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹) +
            Complex.I * (∫ y in bottom..top,
              c i * ((right : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹) -
            Complex.I * (∫ y in bottom..top,
              c i * ((left : Complex) + (y : Complex) * Complex.I - rho i)⁻¹)) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ s, twoPiI * c i := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      simpa [rectangleBoundaryIntegral] using
        (rectangleBoundaryIntegral_const_mul_inv_sub_eq
          (hleft i hi) (hright i hi) (hbottom i hi) (htop i hi)
          (c := c i))
    _ = twoPiI * ∑ i ∈ s, c i := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: OverflowResidueRH.cloudTerm_lb
statement:
theorem cloudTerm_lb (x y g : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    2 * y / (x^2 + g^2 + y^2)
      ≤ y / ((x - g)^2 + y^2) + y / ((x + g)^2 + y^2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs_pos : 0 < x^2 + g^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  have hA_pos : 0 < (x - g)^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  have hB_pos : 0 < (x + g)^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  rw [div_add_div _ _ (ne_of_gt hA_pos) (ne_of_gt hB_pos),
      div_le_div_iff₀ hs_pos (mul_pos hA_pos hB_pos)]
  
  
  
  nlinarith [hy.le, sq_nonneg x, sq_nonneg g, sq_nonneg y, sq_nonneg (x * g),
             mul_nonneg hy.le (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg x) (sq_nonneg g))]

name: OverflowResidueRH.simpleCloudSumNorm_term_lower
statement:
lemma simpleCloudSumNorm_term_lower
    {x y γ : ℝ} (hxy : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ 16) (hy : 0 < y) :
    (2 : ℝ) / (γ ^ 2 + 16) ≤ 2 / (x ^ 2 + γ ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h_xsq_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x ^ 2 := sq_nonneg x
  have h_ysq_pos : (0 : ℝ) < y ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h_gamma_sq_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ γ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg γ
  have h_denom_pos : (0 : ℝ) < x ^ 2 + γ ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by linarith
  have h_denom_target_pos : (0 : ℝ) < γ ^ 2 + 16 := by positivity
  have h_denom_le : x ^ 2 + γ ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ γ ^ 2 + 16 := by linarith
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h_denom_target_pos h_denom_pos]
  nlinarith [h_denom_le, h_denom_pos, h_denom_target_pos]

name: OverflowResidueRH.cloudImNegSum_ge_simpleCloudSum
statement:
theorem cloudImNegSum_ge_simpleCloudSum
    (zeros : List ℝ) (x y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    simpleCloudSum zeros x y ≤ cloudImNegSum zeros x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold simpleCloudSum cloudImNegSum
  induction zeros with
  | nil => simp
  | cons g rest ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have h_head := cloudTerm_lb x y g hy
    linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.simpleCloudSum_neg_x
statement:
theorem simpleCloudSum_neg_x (zeros : List ℝ) (x y : ℝ) :
    simpleCloudSum zeros (-x) y = simpleCloudSum zeros x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold simpleCloudSum
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro g _
  have : (-x)^2 = x^2 := by ring
  rw [this]

name: OverflowResidueRH.simpleCloudSum_ge_T_box_bound
statement:
theorem simpleCloudSum_ge_T_box_bound
    (zeros : List ℝ) (x y M : ℝ)
    (h_sq : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2) (hy : 0 < y) :
    2 * y * (zeros.map fun g => 1 / (M^2 + g^2)).sum
      ≤ simpleCloudSum zeros x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold simpleCloudSum
  induction zeros with
  | nil => simp
  | cons g rest ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    have h_den_pos : 0 < x^2 + g^2 + y^2 := by positivity
    have h_den_le : x^2 + g^2 + y^2 ≤ M^2 + g^2 := by linarith [sq_nonneg g]
    have h_term : 1 / (M^2 + g^2) ≤ 1 / (x^2 + g^2 + y^2) :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le h_den_pos h_den_le
    have hy_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * y := by linarith
    have h_term_mul : 2 * y * (1 / (M^2 + g^2))
                    ≤ 2 * y * (1 / (x^2 + g^2 + y^2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_term hy_nn
    have h_two_y_div :
        2 * y * (1 / (x^2 + g^2 + y^2)) = 2 * y / (x^2 + g^2 + y^2) := by
      field_simp
    have h_two_y_div_max :
        2 * y * (1 / (M^2 + g^2)) = 2 * y / (M^2 + g^2) := by field_simp
    have h_distrib :
        2 * y * (1 / (M^2 + g^2)
            + (List.map (fun g => 1 / (M^2 + g^2)) rest).sum)
          = 2 * y * (1 / (M^2 + g^2))
            + 2 * y * (List.map (fun g => 1 / (M^2 + g^2)) rest).sum := by
      ring
    rw [h_distrib]
    linarith [h_term_mul, h_two_y_div, h_two_y_div_max, ih]

name: OverflowResidueRH.simpleCloudSum_append_ge_left
statement:
lemma simpleCloudSum_append_ge_left
    (zs extra : List ℝ) {x y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    simpleCloudSum zs x y ≤ simpleCloudSum (zs ++ extra) x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold simpleCloudSum
  rw [List.map_append, List.sum_append]
  have hnonneg :
      0 ≤ (extra.map (fun γ => 2 * y / (x^2 + γ^2 + y^2))).sum := by
    apply List.sum_nonneg
    intro a ha
    simp only [List.mem_map] at ha
    rcases ha with ⟨γ, _, rfl⟩
    have hnum : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * y := by linarith
    have hdenpos : 0 < x^2 + γ^2 + y^2 := by positivity
    exact div_nonneg hnum (le_of_lt hdenpos)
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.cloudK_T_antitone_T
proof:
:= by
  unfold cloudK_T
  apply List.sum_le_sum
  intro γ _hγ
  have h_T₂_pos : 0 < T₂ / 2 - 1 := by linarith
  have h_sq_le : (T₁ / 2 - 1)^2 ≤ (T₂ / 2 - 1)^2 :=
    sq_le_sq' (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have h_den_le : (T₁ / 2 - 1)^2 + γ^2 ≤ (T₂ / 2 - 1)^2 + γ^2 := by linarith
  have h_T₁_box_pos : 0 < (T₁ / 2 - 1)^2 + γ^2 := by
    have hsq : 0 < (T₁ / 2 - 1)^2 := pow_pos h_T₁_pos 2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg γ]
  exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le h_T₁_box_pos h_den_le

name: OverflowResidueRH.simpleCloudSum_eq_y_mul_norm
statement:
lemma simpleCloudSum_eq_y_mul_norm (zeros : List ℝ) (x y : ℝ) :
    simpleCloudSum zeros x y = y * simpleCloudSumNorm zeros x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold simpleCloudSum simpleCloudSumNorm
  induction zeros with
