name: OverflowResidueRH.paired_cauchy_kernel_im_eq
statement:
theorem paired_cauchy_kernel_im_eq (x y u : ℝ) :
    (((1 : ℂ) / (((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (u : ℂ)))
     + ((1 : ℂ) / (((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) + (u : ℂ)))).im
    = -y * (1 / ((x - u)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + u)^2 + y^2))
proof:
:= by
  have him1 : (((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (u : ℂ)).im = y := by
    simp [Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  have him2 : (((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) + (u : ℂ)).im = y := by
    simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  have hns1 : Complex.normSq (((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (u : ℂ))
            = (x - u)^2 + y^2 := by
    rw [Complex.normSq_apply]
    simp [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
          Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
    ring
  have hns2 : Complex.normSq (((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) + (u : ℂ))
            = (x + u)^2 + y^2 := by
    rw [Complex.normSq_apply]
    simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
          Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
          Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
    ring
  rw [Complex.add_im, one_div, one_div, Complex.inv_im, Complex.inv_im,
      him1, him2, hns1, hns2]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.paired_cauchy_kernel_im_nonpos
statement:
theorem paired_cauchy_kernel_im_nonpos
    (x y u : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    (((1 : ℂ) / (((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (u : ℂ)))
     + ((1 : ℂ) / (((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) + (u : ℂ)))).im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [paired_cauchy_kernel_im_eq]
  have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < (x - u)^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (x + u)^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  have h1' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / ((x - u)^2 + y^2) := le_of_lt (one_div_pos.mpr h1)
  have h2' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / ((x + u)^2 + y^2) := le_of_lt (one_div_pos.mpr h2)
  nlinarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.paired_cauchy_kernel_im_nonpos_at
statement:
theorem paired_cauchy_kernel_im_nonpos_at
    (z : ℂ) (u : ℝ) (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))).im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq : ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))).im
            = ((1 : ℂ) / (((z.re : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) - (u : ℂ))
               + (1 : ℂ) / (((z.re : ℂ) + (z.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) + (u : ℂ))).im := by
    rw [Complex.re_add_im z]
  rw [h_eq]
  exact paired_cauchy_kernel_im_nonpos z.re z.im u hz

name: OverflowResidueRH.positive_paired_cloud_antiHerglotz

proof:

  change ((us.map (fun u : ℝ =>
          (1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ)))).sum).im ≤ 0
  induction us with
  | nil => simp

    have h1 : ((1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))).im ≤ 0 :=

name: OverflowResidueRH.pairedCauchyKernel_eq_two_mul
statement:
theorem pairedCauchyKernel_eq_two_mul
    (u : ℝ) (z : ℂ) (h : z ^ 2 ≠ (u : ℂ) ^ 2) :
    pairedCauchyKernel u z = 2 * z / (z ^ 2 - (u : ℂ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairedCauchyKernel
  have hz_minus_u : z - (u : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    apply h
    have : z = (u : ℂ) := sub_eq_zero.mp heq
    rw [this]
  have hz_plus_u : z + (u : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    apply h
    have hzu : z = -(u : ℂ) := add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.mp heq
    rw [hzu]; ring
  have hsub : z^2 - (u : ℂ)^2 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h
  field_simp
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.finitePositivePairedTail_antiHerglotz
statement:
theorem finitePositivePairedTail_antiHerglotz
    (nodes weights : List ℝ)
    (hweights : ∀ w ∈ weights, 0 ≤ w) :
    AntiHerglotzUHP (finitePositivePairedTail nodes weights)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  revert weights hweights
  induction nodes with
  | nil =>
    intro weights _
    simp [finitePositivePairedTail]
  | cons u nodes' ih =>
    intro weights hweights
    cases weights with
    | nil => simp [finitePositivePairedTail]
    | cons w weights' =>
      unfold finitePositivePairedTail
      simp only [List.zip_cons_cons, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [Complex.add_im]
      have hw_nn : 0 ≤ w := hweights w (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl))
      have hrest : ∀ w' ∈ weights', 0 ≤ w' := fun w' hw' =>
        hweights w' (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hw'))
      have ih_applied := ih weights' hrest
      have hker : ((w : ℂ) * pairedCauchyKernel u z).im ≤ 0 := by
        rw [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
            zero_mul, add_zero]
        exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hw_nn
          (pairedCauchyKernel_im_nonpos_at z u hz)
      unfold finitePositivePairedTail at ih_applied
      linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.deriv_pairedCauchyImKernel
statement:
theorem deriv_pairedCauchyImKernel
    (x y u : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    deriv (fun v : ℝ => pairedCauchyImKernel x y v) u
      = pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairedCauchyImKernel pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv
  have hd1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (x - u)^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  have hd2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (x + u)^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  have hd1 : (x - u)^2 + y^2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hd1_pos
  have hd2 : (x + u)^2 + y^2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hd2_pos
  
  have hxsub : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => x - v) (-1 : ℝ) u := by
    have h := (hasDerivAt_const u x).sub (hasDerivAt_id u)
    rwa [zero_sub] at h
  have hxadd : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => x + v) (1 : ℝ) u := by
    have h := (hasDerivAt_const u x).add (hasDerivAt_id u)
    rwa [zero_add] at h
  
  have hxsub_sq : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => (x - v)^2) (2 * (x - u) * (-1)) u := by
    have h := hxsub.pow 2; convert h using 1; norm_num
  have hxadd_sq : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => (x + v)^2) (2 * (x + u) * 1) u := by
    have h := hxadd.pow 2; convert h using 1; norm_num
  
  have hxsub_denom : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => (x - v)^2 + y^2)
                                (2 * (x - u) * (-1)) u :=
    hxsub_sq.add_const (y^2)
  have hxadd_denom : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => (x + v)^2 + y^2)
                                (2 * (x + u) * 1) u :=
    hxadd_sq.add_const (y^2)
  
  have h_inv1 :
      HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => 1 / ((x - v)^2 + y^2))
        ((0 * ((x - u)^2 + y^2) - 1 * (2 * (x - u) * (-1))) /
          ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2) u :=
    (hasDerivAt_const u (1 : ℝ)).div hxsub_denom hd1
  have h_inv2 :
      HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => 1 / ((x + v)^2 + y^2))
        ((0 * ((x + u)^2 + y^2) - 1 * (2 * (x + u) * 1)) /
          ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2) u :=
    (hasDerivAt_const u (1 : ℝ)).div hxadd_denom hd2
  
  have h_sum := h_inv1.add h_inv2
  
  have h_final := HasDerivAt.const_mul (-y) h_sum
  
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at h_final
  rw [h_final.deriv]
  field_simp
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_triangle
statement:
theorem abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_triangle (x y u : ℝ) :
    |pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u|
      ≤ 2 * |y| *
        (|x + u| / ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2
          + |x - u| / ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv
  have h2y_eq : |(2 : ℝ) * y| = 2 * |y| := by
    rw [abs_mul]; simp
  have hd1_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2 := by positivity
  have hd2_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2 := by positivity
  have h_tri : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a - b| ≤ |a| + |b| := fun a b => by
    have := abs_add_le a (-b)
    rwa [← sub_eq_add_neg, abs_neg] at this
  calc |2 * y * ((x + u) / ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2
                  - (x - u) / ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2)|
      = |2 * y| * |(x + u) / ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2
                    - (x - u) / ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2| := abs_mul _ _
    _ ≤ |2 * y| * (|(x + u) / ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2|
                    + |(x - u) / ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2|) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_tri _ _) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = 2 * |y| * (|x + u| / ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2
                    + |x - u| / ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2) := by
        rw [h2y_eq, abs_div, abs_div, abs_of_nonneg hd1_nn,
            abs_of_nonneg hd2_nn]

name: OverflowResidueRH.abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_sep
statement:
theorem abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_sep
    {x y u : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hu : |x| < u) :
    |pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u|
      ≤ 4 * y * (u + |x|) / (u - |x|)^4
proof:
:= by
  have hu_pos : 0 < u := lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg x) hu
  have hu_nn : 0 ≤ u := le_of_lt hu_pos
  have hsep_pos : 0 < u - |x| := by linarith
  have hsep_nn : 0 ≤ u - |x| := le_of_lt hsep_pos
  have hux_nn : 0 ≤ u + |x| := by linarith [abs_nonneg x]
  
  have h_xpu_le : |x + u| ≤ u + |x| := by
    calc |x + u| ≤ |x| + |u| := abs_add_le x u
      _ = |x| + u := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hu_nn]
      _ = u + |x| := by ring
  have h_xmu_le : |x - u| ≤ u + |x| := by
    rw [show x - u = -(u - x) from by ring, abs_neg]
    calc |u - x| = |u + -x| := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ |u| + |-x| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = u + |x| := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hu_nn, abs_neg]
  
  have h_xpu_abs_ge : u - |x| ≤ |x + u| := by
    have h := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub u (-x)
    rw [abs_neg, show u - -x = x + u from by ring, abs_of_nonneg hu_nn] at h
    exact h
  have h_xmu_abs_ge : u - |x| ≤ |x - u| := by
    have h := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub u x
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hu_nn, abs_sub_comm] at h
    exact h
  
  have h_d1_ge : (u - |x|)^2 ≤ (x + u)^2 := by
    calc (u - |x|)^2 ≤ |x + u|^2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hsep_nn h_xpu_abs_ge 2
      _ = (x + u)^2 := sq_abs (x + u)
  have h_d2_ge : (u - |x|)^2 ≤ (x - u)^2 := by
    calc (u - |x|)^2 ≤ |x - u|^2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hsep_nn h_xmu_abs_ge 2
      _ = (x - u)^2 := sq_abs (x - u)
  have h_D1_ge : (u - |x|)^2 ≤ (x + u)^2 + y^2 := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ y^2 := sq_nonneg y
    linarith
  have h_D2_ge : (u - |x|)^2 ≤ (x - u)^2 + y^2 := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ y^2 := sq_nonneg y
    linarith
  have h_sep_sq_nn : 0 ≤ (u - |x|)^2 := sq_nonneg _
  have h_D1sq_ge : (u - |x|)^4 ≤ ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2 := by
    calc (u - |x|)^4 = ((u - |x|)^2)^2 := by ring
      _ ≤ ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ h_sep_sq_nn h_D1_ge 2
  have h_D2sq_ge : (u - |x|)^4 ≤ ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2 := by
    calc (u - |x|)^4 = ((u - |x|)^2)^2 := by ring
      _ ≤ ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ h_sep_sq_nn h_D2_ge 2
  have h_sep_pow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (u - |x|)^4 := by positivity
  
  have h_term1 : |x + u| / ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2 ≤ (u + |x|) / (u - |x|)^4 :=
    div_le_div₀ hux_nn h_xpu_le h_sep_pow_pos h_D1sq_ge
  have h_term2 : |x - u| / ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2 ≤ (u + |x|) / (u - |x|)^4 :=
    div_le_div₀ hux_nn h_xmu_le h_sep_pow_pos h_D2sq_ge
  
  have h_triangle := abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_triangle x y u
  have h_y_abs : |y| = y := abs_of_nonneg hy
  rw [h_y_abs] at h_triangle
  have h_2y_nn : 0 ≤ 2 * y := by linarith
  calc |pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u|
      ≤ 2 * y *
          (|x + u| / ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2
            + |x - u| / ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2) := h_triangle
    _ ≤ 2 * y *
          ((u + |x|) / (u - |x|)^4 + (u + |x|) / (u - |x|)^4) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add h_term1 h_term2) h_2y_nn
    _ = 4 * y * (u + |x|) / (u - |x|)^4 := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_split
statement:
theorem abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_split
    {x y u : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hu : |x| < u) :
    |pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u|
      ≤ 2 * y * (1 / (u - |x|)^3 + 1 / (u + |x|)^3)
proof:
:= by
  have hu_pos : 0 < u := lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg x) hu
  have hu_nn : 0 ≤ u := le_of_lt hu_pos
  
  have h_inv_bound : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → a / (a^2 + b^2)^2 ≤ 1 / a^3 := by
    intro a b ha
    have ha3 : (0 : ℝ) < a^3 := by positivity
    have hd : (0 : ℝ) < (a^2 + b^2)^2 := by positivity
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hd ha3]
    have h_a_sq_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a^2 := sq_nonneg _
    have h_a_sq_le : a^2 ≤ a^2 + b^2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
    have h_pow : (a^2)^2 ≤ (a^2 + b^2)^2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ h_a_sq_nn h_a_sq_le 2
    nlinarith
  
  have h_triangle := abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_triangle x y u
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hy] at h_triangle
  have h_2y_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * y := by linarith
  
  rcases le_or_gt 0 x with hx | hx
  · 
    have h_abs : |x| = x := abs_of_nonneg hx
    have hxpu_pos : 0 < x + u := by linarith
    have humx_pos : 0 < u - x := by
      have := hu; rw [h_abs] at this; linarith
    have hxpu_abs : |x + u| = x + u := abs_of_pos hxpu_pos
    have hxmu_abs : |x - u| = u - x := by
      rw [show x - u = -(u - x) from by ring, abs_neg, abs_of_pos humx_pos]
    rw [hxpu_abs, hxmu_abs,
        show (x - u)^2 = (u - x)^2 from by ring] at h_triangle
    have h1 := h_inv_bound (x + u) y hxpu_pos
    have h2 := h_inv_bound (u - x) y humx_pos
    calc |pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u|
        ≤ 2 * y * ((x + u) / ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2
                    + (u - x) / ((u - x)^2 + y^2)^2) := h_triangle
      _ ≤ 2 * y * (1 / (x + u)^3 + 1 / (u - x)^3) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add h1 h2) h_2y_nn
      _ = 2 * y * (1 / (u - |x|)^3 + 1 / (u + |x|)^3) := by
          rw [h_abs]; ring
  · 
    have h_abs : |x| = -x := abs_of_neg hx
    have hxpu_pos : 0 < x + u := by
      have := hu; rw [h_abs] at this; linarith
    have humx_pos : 0 < u - x := by linarith
    have hxpu_abs : |x + u| = x + u := abs_of_pos hxpu_pos
    have hxmu_abs : |x - u| = u - x := by
      rw [show x - u = -(u - x) from by ring, abs_neg, abs_of_pos humx_pos]
    rw [hxpu_abs, hxmu_abs,
        show (x - u)^2 = (u - x)^2 from by ring] at h_triangle
    have h1 := h_inv_bound (x + u) y hxpu_pos
    have h2 := h_inv_bound (u - x) y humx_pos
    calc |pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u|
        ≤ 2 * y * ((x + u) / ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2
                    + (u - x) / ((u - x)^2 + y^2)^2) := h_triangle
      _ ≤ 2 * y * (1 / (x + u)^3 + 1 / (u - x)^3) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add h1 h2) h_2y_nn
      _ = 2 * y * (1 / (u - |x|)^3 + 1 / (u + |x|)^3) := by
          rw [h_abs]; ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_continuous
statement:
lemma pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_continuous
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (x : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun u : ℝ => pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv
  have h_plus_sq : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2) := by
    have h : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => (x + u)^2 + y^2) :=
      ((continuous_const.add continuous_id).pow 2).add continuous_const
    exact h.pow 2
  have h_minus_sq : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2) := by
    have h : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => (x - u)^2 + y^2) :=
      ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).pow 2).add continuous_const
    exact h.pow 2
  have hne_plus : ∀ u : ℝ, ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2 ≠ 0 := fun u => by
    have : 0 < ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2 := by positivity
    exact ne_of_gt this
  have hne_minus : ∀ u : ℝ, ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2 ≠ 0 := fun u => by
    have : 0 < ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2 := by positivity
    exact ne_of_gt this
  have h_div_plus : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => (x + u) / ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2) :=
    (continuous_const.add continuous_id).div h_plus_sq hne_plus
  have h_div_minus : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => (x - u) / ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2) :=
    (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).div h_minus_sq hne_minus
  exact continuous_const.mul (h_div_plus.sub h_div_minus)

name: OverflowResidueRH.abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_adaptive_18
statement:
theorem abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_adaptive_18
    {x y T u : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (hT : 2 * (1 + |x| + y) ≤ T)
    (hu : T ≤ u) :
    |pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u| ≤ 18 * y / u^3
proof:
:= by
  have hx_nn : 0 ≤ |x| := abs_nonneg x
  
  have hu_pos : 0 < u := by linarith
  have hu_pow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < u^3 := by positivity
  
  have h_x_le : |x| ≤ u / 2 := by linarith
  have h_x_lt_u : |x| < u := by linarith
  have h_sep_ge : u / 2 ≤ u - |x| := by linarith
  have h_add_ge : u ≤ u + |x| := by linarith
  have h_sep_pos : 0 < u - |x| := by linarith
  have h_add_pos : 0 < u + |x| := by linarith
  
  have h_inv1 : 1 / (u - |x|)^3 ≤ 8 / u^3 := by
    have h_sep_pow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (u - |x|)^3 := by positivity
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h_sep_pow_pos hu_pow_pos]
    have h_half_pos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ u / 2 := by linarith
    have h_pow_ge : (u / 2)^3 ≤ (u - |x|)^3 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ h_half_pos h_sep_ge 3
    nlinarith [h_pow_ge]
  
  have h_inv2 : 1 / (u + |x|)^3 ≤ 1 / u^3 := by
    have h_add_pow_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (u + |x|)^3 := by positivity
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h_add_pow_pos hu_pow_pos]
    have h_pow_ge : u^3 ≤ (u + |x|)^3 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt hu_pos) h_add_ge 3
    linarith
  
  have h_split := abs_pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_le_split hy h_x_lt_u
  have h_2y_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * y := by linarith
  calc |pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u|
      ≤ 2 * y * (1 / (u - |x|)^3 + 1 / (u + |x|)^3) := h_split
    _ ≤ 2 * y * (8 / u^3 + 1 / u^3) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add h_inv1 h_inv2) h_2y_nn
    _ = 18 * y / u^3 := by
        have hu_pow_ne : u^3 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hu_pow_pos
        field_simp
        ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_pairedCauchyKernel_le_const_div_sq_eventually
statement:
lemma norm_pairedCauchyKernel_le_const_div_sq_eventually
    (z : ℂ) :
    ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in Filter.atTop,
      ‖(1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))‖
        ≤ 4 * (‖z‖ + 1) / u^2
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards
    [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (2 * (‖z‖ + 1)),
     Filter.eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)]
    with u hu_large hu_pos
  have h_z_nn : 0 ≤ ‖z‖ := norm_nonneg z
  have h_u_pos_sq : 0 < u^2 := by positivity
  have h_2_zp1_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (‖z‖ + 1) := by linarith
  have h_u_sq_ge : (2 * (‖z‖ + 1))^2 ≤ u^2 := by
    have := mul_self_le_mul_self h_2_zp1_nn hu_large
    nlinarith [this]
  have h_diff_bound : u^2 / 2 ≤ u^2 - ‖z‖^2 := by
    nlinarith [h_u_sq_ge, h_z_nn]
  have h_norm_u_sq : ‖((u : ℂ))^2‖ = u^2 := by
    have h_pow : ((u : ℂ))^2 = ((u^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [h_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg u)]
  have h_norm_z_sq : ‖z^2‖ = ‖z‖^2 := by
    rw [pow_two, pow_two, norm_mul]
  have h_rev_tri : u^2 - ‖z‖^2 ≤ ‖z^2 - (u : ℂ)^2‖ := by
    have h := norm_sub_norm_le ((u : ℂ)^2) (z^2)
    rw [h_norm_u_sq, h_norm_z_sq, ← norm_sub_rev] at h
    exact h
  have h_diff_lower : u^2 / 2 ≤ ‖z^2 - (u : ℂ)^2‖ :=
    le_trans h_diff_bound h_rev_tri
  have h_u_half_pos : 0 < u^2 / 2 := by linarith
  have h_diff_norm_pos : 0 < ‖z^2 - (u : ℂ)^2‖ :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le h_u_half_pos h_diff_lower
  have h_diff_ne : z^2 - (u : ℂ)^2 ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp h_diff_norm_pos
  have h_z_sq_ne : z^2 ≠ (u : ℂ)^2 := sub_ne_zero.mp h_diff_ne
  have h_kernel_eq :
      (1 : ℂ) / (z - (u : ℂ)) + (1 : ℂ) / (z + (u : ℂ))
        = 2 * z / (z^2 - (u : ℂ)^2) := by
    have := pairedCauchyKernel_eq_two_mul u z h_z_sq_ne
    unfold pairedCauchyKernel at this
    exact this
  rw [h_kernel_eq, norm_div]
  have h_num_norm : ‖(2 : ℂ) * z‖ = 2 * ‖z‖ := by
    rw [norm_mul]; simp
  rw [h_num_norm]
  have h_2z_nn : 0 ≤ 2 * ‖z‖ := by linarith
  calc 2 * ‖z‖ / ‖z^2 - (u : ℂ)^2‖
      ≤ 2 * ‖z‖ / (u^2 / 2) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left h_2z_nn h_u_half_pos h_diff_lower
    _ = 4 * ‖z‖ / u^2 := by field_simp; ring
    _ ≤ 4 * (‖z‖ + 1) / u^2 := by
        gcongr
        linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothTail_kernel_le_five_y_div_T
statement:
lemma smoothTail_kernel_le_five_y_div_T
    {x y T : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y)
    (hreg : 2 * (1 + |x| + y) ≤ T) :
    (y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2)
      + y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2))
      ≤ 5 * y / T
proof:
:= by
  have h_absx_nn : 0 ≤ |x| := abs_nonneg _
  have hy_nn : 0 ≤ y := le_of_lt hy
  have hT_ge : T ≥ 2 := by linarith
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hTpos2 : 0 < T / 2 := by linarith
  
  have h_T_minus_x_lo : T / 2 ≤ T - |x| := by linarith
  have h_T_plus_x_lo : T ≤ T + |x| := by linarith
  have h_T_minus_x_pos : 0 < T - |x| := by linarith
  have h_T_plus_x_pos : 0 < T + |x| := by linarith
  
  have h_term1_bound : y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2) ≤ y / (T - |x|) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < (T - |x|)^2 + y^2) h_T_minus_x_pos]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (T - |x|), sq_nonneg y]
  have h_term2_bound : y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2) ≤ y / (T + |x|) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < (T + |x|)^2 + y^2) h_T_plus_x_pos]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (T + |x|), sq_nonneg y]
  
  have h_term1_le_2yT : y / (T - |x|) ≤ 2 * y / T := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h_T_minus_x_pos hT_pos]
    nlinarith [h_T_minus_x_lo, hy_nn]
  have h_term2_le_yT : y / (T + |x|) ≤ y / T :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hy_nn hT_pos h_T_plus_x_lo
  
  have h_total : y / (T - |x|) + y / (T + |x|) ≤ 3 * y / T := by
    have : 2 * y / T + y / T = 3 * y / T := by ring
    linarith [h_term1_le_2yT, h_term2_le_yT]
  have h3le5 : 3 * y / T ≤ 5 * y / T := by
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (le_of_lt hT_pos)
    nlinarith
  linarith [h_term1_bound, h_term2_bound, h_total, h3le5]

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs_neg_x
statement:

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs_ge_22_15
statement:
theorem smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs_ge_22_15
    {x y T : ℝ}
    (hT : 2 * Real.pi ≤ T)
    (hy : 0 < y)
    (hadapt : 2 * (1 + |x| + y) ≤ T) :
    (22 / 15) * zeroDensityRho T * y / T
      ≤ smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs x y T
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs
  have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ zeroDensityRho T := zeroDensityRho_nonneg_of_ge_two_pi hT
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hT_ne : T ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hT_pos
  have hT_nn : 0 ≤ T := le_of_lt hT_pos
  have hy_nn : 0 ≤ y := le_of_lt hy
  have hx_nn : 0 ≤ |x| := abs_nonneg x
  
  have hx_le : |x| ≤ T / 2 - 1 := by linarith
  have hy_le_x : y ≤ T / 2 - 1 - |x| := by linarith
  have h_2y_le : 2 * y ≤ T - 2 * |x| := by linarith
  have h_Tm2x_pos : 0 < T - 2 * |x| := by linarith
  have h_Tm2x_nn : 0 ≤ T - 2 * |x| := le_of_lt h_Tm2x_pos
  
  have h_tmx_pos : 0 < T - |x| := by linarith
  have h_tmx_nn : 0 ≤ T - |x| := le_of_lt h_tmx_pos
  have h_tpx_pos : 0 < T + |x| := by linarith
  have h_tpx_nn : 0 ≤ T + |x| := le_of_lt h_tpx_pos
  
  have h_7T_ge_8x : 8 * |x| ≤ 7 * T := by linarith
  have h_T_p_4x_nn : 0 ≤ T + 4 * |x| := by linarith
  have h_denom1_pos : 0 < (T - |x|)^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  have h_denom2_pos : 0 < (T + |x|)^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  
  have h_2y_nn : 0 ≤ 2 * y := by linarith
  have h_4y_sq_le : 4 * y^2 ≤ (T - 2 * |x|)^2 := by
    have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ h_2y_nn h_2y_le 2
    have h_2y_eq : (2 * y)^2 = 4 * y^2 := by ring
    linarith [h, h_2y_eq]
  
  
  have h_alg1 :
      (T - |x|) * (T + 4 * |x|) - (T - 2 * |x|)^2
        = |x| * (7 * T - 8 * |x|) := by ring
  have h_alg1_diff_nn :
      0 ≤ |x| * (7 * T - 8 * |x|) :=
    mul_nonneg hx_nn (by linarith)
  have h_step1a : (T - 2 * |x|)^2 ≤ (T - |x|) * (T + 4 * |x|) := by
    linarith [h_alg1, h_alg1_diff_nn]
  have h_step1b : 4 * y^2 ≤ (T - |x|) * (T + 4 * |x|) := by
    linarith [h_4y_sq_le, h_step1a]
  
  have h_alg1_full :
      5 * T * (T - |x|) - 4 * ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2)
        = (T - |x|) * (T + 4 * |x|) - 4 * y^2 := by ring
  have h_alg1_full_nn :
      0 ≤ 5 * T * (T - |x|) - 4 * ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2) := by
    linarith [h_alg1_full, h_step1b]
  have h_5T_pos : 0 < 5 * T := by linarith
  have h_Y1_ge :
      4 * y / (5 * T) ≤ y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h_5T_pos h_denom1_pos]
    have h_calc :
        y * (T - |x|) * (5 * T) - 4 * y * ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2)
          = y * (5 * T * (T - |x|) - 4 * ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2)) := by ring
    have h_nn :
        0 ≤ y * (5 * T * (T - |x|) - 4 * ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2)) :=
      mul_nonneg hy_nn h_alg1_full_nn
    linarith
  
  
  have h_alg2 :
      2 * ((T + |x|) * (T - 2 * |x|)) - (T - 2 * |x|)^2
        = (T - 2 * |x|) * (T + 4 * |x|) := by ring
  have h_alg2_diff_nn :
      0 ≤ (T - 2 * |x|) * (T + 4 * |x|) :=
    mul_nonneg h_Tm2x_nn h_T_p_4x_nn
  have h_step2a :
      (T - 2 * |x|)^2 ≤ 2 * ((T + |x|) * (T - 2 * |x|)) := by
    linarith [h_alg2, h_alg2_diff_nn]
  have h_step2b : 2 * y^2 ≤ (T + |x|) * (T - 2 * |x|) := by
    linarith [h_4y_sq_le, h_step2a]
  
  have h_alg2_full :
      3 * T * (T + |x|) - 2 * ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2)
        = (T + |x|) * (T - 2 * |x|) - 2 * y^2 := by ring
  have h_alg2_full_nn :
      0 ≤ 3 * T * (T + |x|) - 2 * ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2) := by
    linarith [h_alg2_full, h_step2b]
  have h_3T_pos : 0 < 3 * T := by linarith
  have h_Y2_ge :
      2 * y / (3 * T) ≤ y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h_3T_pos h_denom2_pos]
    have h_calc :
        y * (T + |x|) * (3 * T) - 2 * y * ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2)
          = y * (3 * T * (T + |x|) - 2 * ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2)) := by ring
    have h_nn :
        0 ≤ y * (3 * T * (T + |x|) - 2 * ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2)) :=
      mul_nonneg hy_nn h_alg2_full_nn
    linarith
  
  have h_sum_eq :
      4 * y / (5 * T) + 2 * y / (3 * T) = 22 * y / (15 * T) := by
    field_simp; ring
  have h_sum_ge :
      22 * y / (15 * T)
        ≤ y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2)
            + y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2) := by
    have h := add_le_add h_Y1_ge h_Y2_ge
    rw [h_sum_eq] at h
    exact h
  
  have h_mul :
      zeroDensityRho T * (22 * y / (15 * T))
        ≤ zeroDensityRho T *
            (y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2)
              + y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_ge hρ_nn
  
  have h_eq :
      (22 / 15) * zeroDensityRho T * y / T
        = zeroDensityRho T * (22 * y / (15 * T)) := by
    field_simp
  rw [h_eq]
  exact h_mul

proof:
:= by
  unfold positiveSmoothKernel
  have h1 : (x - u) ^ 2 = (u - x) ^ 2 := by ring
  have h2 : (x + u) ^ 2 = (u - (-x)) ^ 2 := by ring

  unfold positiveSmoothKernel

  · refine continuous_const.div ?_ ?_
    · exact ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).pow 2).add continuous_const
    · intro u
      have h : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x - u) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      linarith
  · refine continuous_const.div ?_ ?_
    · exact ((continuous_const.add continuous_id).pow 2).add continuous_const

      linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothKernelNormFactor_ge_five_div_twentyNine
statement:
theorem smoothKernelNormFactor_ge_five_div_twentyNine
    {x y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (hbox : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ 16) :
    (5 / 29 : ℝ)
      ≤ (10 - |x|) / ((10 - |x|) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
        + (10 + |x|) / ((10 + |x|) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  set a := |x| with ha_def
  have ha_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a := abs_nonneg x
  have ha_sq : a ^ 2 = x ^ 2 := sq_abs x
  have ha_box : a ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ 16 := by rw [ha_sq]; exact hbox
  have ha_sq_le_16 : a ^ 2 ≤ 16 := by
    have := sq_nonneg y; linarith
  have ha_le_4 : a ≤ 4 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 4), ha_sq_le_16, ha_nn]
  have h_10_sub_a_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 10 - a := by linarith
  have h_10_add_a_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 10 + a := by linarith
  have h_A_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (10 - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h_B_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (10 + a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h_D_pos : (0 : ℝ) <
      ((10 - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) * ((10 + a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) :=
    mul_pos h_A_pos h_B_pos
  have h_N_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 100 - a ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by
    have := sq_nonneg y; linarith
  have h_identity :
      (10 - a) / ((10 - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
        + (10 + a) / ((10 + a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
        = 20 * (100 - a ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
          / (((10 - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) * ((10 + a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [h_identity]
  have h_den_le :
      ((10 - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) * ((10 + a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2)
        ≤ 116 * (100 - a ^ 2 + y ^ 2) :=
    kernel_factor_den_le_aux ha_nn ha_box
  rw [le_div_iff₀ h_D_pos]
  nlinarith [h_den_le, h_N_pos]

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs_le_100y

proof:

  have h_rho_le : zeroDensityRho T ≤ T := zeroDensityRho_le_T hT2pi
  have h_rho_nn : 0 ≤ zeroDensityRho T := by
    unfold zeroDensityRho
    have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
    have hT_2pi_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ T / (2 * Real.pi) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ h_2pi_pos]; linarith
    have h_log_nn : 0 ≤ Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) := Real.log_nonneg hT_2pi_ge_one
    positivity
  have h_kernel : (y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2)
                    + y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2))
                    ≤ 5 * y / T :=
    smoothTail_kernel_le_five_y_div_T hy hreg
  have h_kernel_nn :
      0 ≤ y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2)
            + y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2) := by
    have h_absx_nn : 0 ≤ |x| := abs_nonneg _
    have hT_ge : T ≥ 2 := by linarith
    have h_T_minus_x_pos : 0 < T - |x| := by linarith
    have h_T_plus_x_pos : 0 < T + |x| := by linarith
    have h1 : 0 ≤ y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2) := by
      apply div_nonneg
      · exact mul_nonneg hy_nn (le_of_lt h_T_minus_x_pos)
      · positivity
    have h2 : 0 ≤ y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2) := by
      apply div_nonneg
      · exact mul_nonneg hy_nn (le_of_lt h_T_plus_x_pos)
      · positivity
    linarith
  have h_combine :
      zeroDensityRho T * (y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2)
        + y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2))
        ≤ T * (5 * y / T) := by
    apply mul_le_mul h_rho_le h_kernel h_kernel_nn (by linarith)
  have h_T5y : T * (5 * y / T) = 5 * y := by
    field_simp
  have h_5y_le : 5 * y ≤ 100 * y := by linarith
  linarith

  have h2 :
      (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (5 / 3) * (7 / 44)
        ≤ (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (5 / 3) * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_2pi_inv hA_nn
  have h3 :
      (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (5 / 3) * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1 / B)
        ≤ (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (5 / 3) * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1 / T) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv_T hA_2pi_nn
  have h4 :
      (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (5 / 3) * (7 / 44) * (1 / B)
        ≤ (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (5 / 3) * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1 / B) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 h_inv_B_nn
  have h_const :
      (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (5 / 3) * (7 / 44) * (1 / B) = 7 / (18 * B) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.tailK_80_140_ge_const
statement:
lemma tailK_80_140_ge_const
    {T : ℝ} (_hT80 : 80 ≤ T) (hT140 : T ≤ 140) :
    tailK80_const ≤ tailK_80_140 T
proof:
:= by
  unfold tailK80_const tailK_80_140
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have h_2pi_inv : (7 / 44 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi) :=
    one_div_two_pi_ge_seven_fortyfour
  have h_inv_T : (1 / 140 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / T := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hT_pos hT140
  have h_form_eq : (22 / 15 : ℝ) *
      ((2 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.pi)) / T
      = (22 / 15) * (2 : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1/T) := by ring
  rw [h_form_eq]
  have h_22_15_2_nn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (22 / 15) * (2 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have h_22_15_2_2pi_nn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (22 / 15) * (2 : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) := by
    positivity
  have h2 : (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) * (7/44)
          ≤ (22 / 15) * (2 : ℝ) * (1/(2*Real.pi)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_2pi_inv h_22_15_2_nn
  have h3 : (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) * (1/(2*Real.pi)) * (1/140)
          ≤ (22 / 15) * (2 : ℝ) * (1/(2*Real.pi)) * (1/T) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv_T h_22_15_2_2pi_nn
  have h_C_le_A :
      (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) * (7/44) * (1/140)
        ≤ (22 / 15) * (2 : ℝ) * (1/(2*Real.pi)) * (1/140) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (by norm_num)
  have h_const_eq : (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) * (7/44) * (1/140) = 1/300 := by norm_num
  linarith [h3, h_C_le_A, h_const_eq]

name: OverflowResidueRH.tailK_80_140_ge_seven_fifteen_div
statement:
lemma tailK_80_140_ge_seven_fifteen_div
    {T B : ℝ} (hT_pos : 0 < T) (hB_pos : 0 < B) (hT_le : T ≤ B) :
    (7 / (15 * B) : ℝ) ≤ tailK_80_140 T
proof:
:= by
  unfold tailK_80_140
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have h_2pi_inv : (7 / 44 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi) :=
    one_div_two_pi_ge_seven_fortyfour
  have h_inv_T : (1 / B : ℝ) ≤ 1 / T := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hT_pos hT_le
  have h_form_eq : (22 / 15 : ℝ) *
      ((2 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.pi)) / T
      = (22 / 15) * (2 : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1/T) := by ring
  rw [h_form_eq]
  have h_22_15_2_nn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (22 / 15) * (2 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have h_22_15_2_2pi_nn : (0:ℝ) ≤ (22 / 15) * (2 : ℝ) * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) := by
    positivity
  have h2 : (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) * (7/44)
          ≤ (22 / 15) * (2 : ℝ) * (1/(2*Real.pi)) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_2pi_inv h_22_15_2_nn
  have h3 : (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) * (1/(2*Real.pi)) * (1/B)
          ≤ (22 / 15) * (2 : ℝ) * (1/(2*Real.pi)) * (1/T) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv_T h_22_15_2_2pi_nn
  have h_inv_B_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/B := le_of_lt (one_div_pos.mpr hB_pos)
  have h_C_le_A :
      (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) * (7/44) * (1/B)
        ≤ (22 / 15) * (2 : ℝ) * (1/(2*Real.pi)) * (1/B) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 h_inv_B_nn
  have hB_ne : B ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hB_pos
  have h_const_eq : (22 / 15 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) * (7/44) * (1/B) = 7/(15*B) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  linarith [h3, h_C_le_A, h_const_eq]

name: OverflowResidueRH.cauchy_one_side_tail_integral_tendsto
statement:
lemma cauchy_one_side_tail_integral_tendsto
    (a T : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    Tendsto
      (fun X : ℝ => ∫ u in T..X, y / ((u - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2))
      Filter.atTop
      (𝓝 (Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T - a) / y)))
proof:
:= by
  have hy_ne : y ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hy
  have h_eq : ∀ X : ℝ,
      (∫ u in T..X, y / ((u - a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2))
        = Real.arctan ((X - a) / y) - Real.arctan ((T - a) / y) := by
    intro X
    exact integral_cauchy_one_side_eq_arctan_sub a T X hy_ne
  have h_arctan_T : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => Real.arctan ((T - a) / y))
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 (Real.arctan ((T - a) / y))) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have h_sub :
      Tendsto
        (fun X : ℝ =>
          Real.arctan ((X - a) / y) - Real.arctan ((T - a) / y))
        Filter.atTop
        (𝓝 (Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T - a) / y))) :=
    (tendsto_arctan_shift_atTop a hy).sub h_arctan_T
  exact (h_sub.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun X => (h_eq X).symm))

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_derivative_root_between
statement:
theorem polynomial_derivative_root_between
    (p : Polynomial ℝ) {x y : ℝ}
    (hxy : x < y) (hx : p.eval x = 0) (hy : p.eval y = 0) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, x < c ∧ c < y ∧ p.derivative.eval c = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hder⟩ :=
    exists_deriv_eq_zero hxy p.continuousOn (hx.trans hy.symm)
  refine ⟨c, hc.1, hc.2, ?_⟩
  rwa [p.deriv] at hder

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_derivative_roots_real
statement:
theorem polynomial_derivative_roots_real
    {P : Polynomial ℂ} (hdegree : 0 < P.degree)
    (hreal : ∀ z : ℂ, P.eval z = 0 → z.im = 0) :
    ∀ z : ℂ, P.derivative.eval z = 0 → z.im = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : Convex ℝ {z : ℂ | z.im = 0} := by
    intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx hy ⊢
    simp [hx, hy]
  have hrootSubset : P.rootSet ℂ ⊆ {z : ℂ | z.im = 0} := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Polynomial.mem_rootSet, Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval] at hz
    exact hreal z hz.2
  have hhull : convexHull ℝ (P.rootSet ℂ) ⊆ {z : ℂ | z.im = 0} :=
    convexHull_min hrootSubset hconv
  intro z hz
  apply hhull
  apply Polynomial.rootSet_derivative_subset_convexHull_rootSet hdegree
  rw [Polynomial.mem_rootSet, Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval]
  exact ⟨Polynomial.derivative_ne_zero.mpr
    ((Polynomial.natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.mpr hdegree).ne'), hz⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData.A_ne_zero
statement:
theorem A_ne_zero {A B : Polynomial ℝ}
    (D : OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData A B) : A ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.factorA]
  exact mul_ne_zero (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr D.leadingA_ne)
    (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero _)

name: OverflowResidueRH.OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData.B_ne_zero
statement:
theorem B_ne_zero {A B : Polynomial ℝ}
    (D : OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData A B) : B ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.factorB]
  exact mul_ne_zero (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr D.leadingB_ne)
    (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero _)

name: OverflowResidueRH.OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData.a_isRoot
proof:
:= by
  calc
    A.eval (D.a i) =
        (Polynomial.C D.leadingA *
          ∏ j : Fin (D.n + 1),
            (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (D.a j))).eval (D.a i) :=
      congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℝ => p.eval (D.a i)) D.factorA
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_prod]
      apply mul_eq_zero.mpr
      right
      exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (by simp)

name: OverflowResidueRH.OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData.b_isRoot
proof:
:= by
  calc
    B.eval (D.b i) =
        (Polynomial.C D.leadingB *
          ∏ j : Fin D.n,
            (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (D.b j))).eval (D.b i) :=
      congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℝ => p.eval (D.b i)) D.factorB
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_prod]
      apply mul_eq_zero.mpr
      right
      exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (by simp)

name: OverflowResidueRH.OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData.A_eval_eq_zero_iff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heval : A.eval x =
      D.leadingA * ∏ i : Fin (D.n + 1), (x - D.a i) := by
    calc
      A.eval x =
          (Polynomial.C D.leadingA *
            ∏ i : Fin (D.n + 1),
              (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (D.a i))).eval x :=
        congrArg (Polynomial.eval x) D.factorA
      _ = D.leadingA * ∏ i : Fin (D.n + 1), (x - D.a i) := by
        simp [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_prod]
  rw [heval, mul_eq_zero]
  simp only [D.leadingA_ne, false_or, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨i, (sub_eq_zero.mp hi).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨i, sub_eq_zero.mpr hi.symm⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData.B_eval_eq_zero_iff
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heval : B.eval x =
      D.leadingB * ∏ i : Fin D.n, (x - D.b i) := by
    calc
      B.eval x =
          (Polynomial.C D.leadingB *
            ∏ i : Fin D.n,
              (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (D.b i))).eval x :=
        congrArg (Polynomial.eval x) D.factorB
      _ = D.leadingB * ∏ i : Fin D.n, (x - D.b i) := by
        simp [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_prod]
  rw [heval, mul_eq_zero]
  simp only [D.leadingB_ne, false_or, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨i, (sub_eq_zero.mp hi).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨i, sub_eq_zero.mpr hi.symm⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData.a_ne_b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i.val ≤ j.val
  · have hfin : i ≤ j.castSucc := hij
    have hle : D.a i ≤ D.a j.castSucc := D.interlaces.1.monotone hfin
    exact ne_of_lt (hle.trans_lt (D.interlaces.left_lt j))
  · have hji : j.val + 1 ≤ i.val := by omega
    have hfin : j.succ ≤ i := hji
    have hle : D.a j.succ ≤ D.a i := D.interlaces.1.monotone hfin
    exact ne_of_gt ((D.interlaces.right_lt j).trans_le hle)

name: OverflowResidueRH.OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData.no_common_real_root
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hA, hB⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (D.A_eval_eq_zero_iff x).mp hA
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (D.B_eval_eq_zero_iff x).mp hB
  exact D.a_ne_b i j (hi.trans hj.symm)

name: OverflowResidueRH.OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData.derivative_root_between_a

theorem derivative_root_between_a {A B : Polynomial ℝ}
    (D : OrientedStrictInterlacingPolynomialData A B) (i : Fin D.n) :

      D.a i.castSucc < c ∧ c < D.a i.succ ∧ A.derivative.eval c = 0

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireBiInfiniteStrictInterlacingData.no_common
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hA, hB⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (D.A_zero_iff z).mp hA
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (D.B_zero_iff z).mp hB
  have hab : D.a m = D.b n := by
    exact_mod_cast hm.symm.trans hn
  rcases lt_trichotomy m n with hmn | hmn | hnm
  · have haa : D.a m < D.a n := D.a_strictMono hmn
    have hnb : D.a n < D.b n := (D.alternating n).1
    exact (ne_of_lt (haa.trans hnb)) hab
  · subst n
    exact (ne_of_lt (D.alternating m).1) hab
  · have hindex : n + 1 ≤ m := by omega
    have haa : D.a (n + 1) ≤ D.a m := D.a_strictMono.monotone hindex
    have hlt : D.b n < D.a m := (D.alternating n).2.trans_le haa
    exact (ne_of_gt hlt) hab

name: OverflowResidueRH.LaguerrePolyaApproximationData.differentiable
statement:
theorem LaguerrePolyaApproximationData.differentiable
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (A : LaguerrePolyaApproximationData F) :
    Differentiable ℂ F
proof:
:= by
  have hdiffOn : DifferentiableOn ℂ F Set.univ :=
    A.tendstoLocallyUniformly.differentiableOn
      (Eventually.of_forall fun n => (A.approximant n).differentiableOn)
      isOpen_univ
  simpa only [differentiableOn_univ] using hdiffOn

name: OverflowResidueRH.LaguerrePolyaApproximationData.schwarz
statement:
theorem LaguerrePolyaApproximationData.schwarz
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (A : LaguerrePolyaApproximationData F) (z : ℂ) :
    F (star z) = star (F z)
proof:
:= by
  have h_at_star :
      Tendsto (fun n => (A.approximant n).eval (star z)) atTop
        (𝓝 (F (star z))) :=
    A.tendstoLocallyUniformly.tendsto_at (Set.mem_univ (star z))
  have h_at_z :
      Tendsto (fun n => (A.approximant n).eval z) atTop (𝓝 (F z)) :=
    A.tendstoLocallyUniformly.tendsto_at (Set.mem_univ z)
  have h_conj :
      Tendsto (fun n => star ((A.approximant n).eval z)) atTop
        (𝓝 (star (F z))) :=
    (tendsto_star (F z)).comp h_at_z
  have h_at_star' :
      Tendsto (fun n => (A.approximant n).eval (star z)) atTop
        (𝓝 (star (F z))) := by
    apply h_conj.congr'
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun n => (A.approximant_schwarz n z).symm
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique h_at_star h_at_star'

name: OverflowResidueRH.LaguerrePolyaApproximationData.logDerivative_im_nonpos_away
statement:
theorem LaguerrePolyaApproximationData.logDerivative_im_nonpos_away
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (A : LaguerrePolyaApproximationData F) :
    ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → F z ≠ 0 →
      (logDerivativeResponse F z).im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz hFz
  have hpolyDiff :
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
        DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun w => (A.approximant n).eval w) Set.univ :=
    Eventually.of_forall fun n => (A.approximant n).differentiableOn
  have hlog := Complex.logDeriv_tendsto
    isOpen_univ (Set.mem_univ z) A.tendstoLocallyUniformly hpolyDiff hFz
  have him :
      Tendsto
        (fun n => (logDeriv (fun w => (A.approximant n).eval w) z).im)
        atTop (𝓝 ((logDeriv F z).im)) :=
    (Complex.continuous_im.tendsto _).comp hlog
  have hpolySign :
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        (logDeriv (fun w => (A.approximant n).eval w) z).im ≤ 0 := by
    intro n
    have hanti :
        AntiHerglotzUHP
          (polynomialLogDerivResponse (A.approximant n)) :=
      (polynomial_antiHerglotz_iff_roots_closedLower
        (A.approximant n) (A.approximant_ne_zero n)).mpr
          (fun ρ hroot => (A.approximant_roots_real n ρ hroot).le)
    simpa [logDeriv_apply, polynomialLogDerivResponse] using hanti z hz
  have hlimit : (logDeriv F z).im ≤ 0 :=
    le_of_tendsto him (Eventually.of_forall hpolySign)
  simpa [logDerivativeResponse, logDeriv_apply] using hlimit

name: OverflowResidueRH.LaguerrePolyaApproximationData.antiHerglotz
statement:
theorem LaguerrePolyaApproximationData.antiHerglotz
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (A : LaguerrePolyaApproximationData F) :
    AntiHerglotzUHP (logDerivativeResponse F)
proof:
:=
  (antiHerglotz_iff_antiHerglotz_away_from_zeros F).2
    A.logDerivative_im_nonpos_away

name: OverflowResidueRH.LaguerrePolyaApproximationData.roots_real
statement:
theorem LaguerrePolyaApproximationData.roots_real
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (A : LaguerrePolyaApproximationData F)
    (h_nontrivial : ∃ z : ℂ, F z ≠ 0) :
    ∀ ρ : ℂ, F ρ = 0 → ρ.im = 0
proof:
:=
  entire_function_roots_real_of_analytic_nontrivial F
    (A.differentiable.differentiableOn.analyticOnNhd isOpen_univ)
    h_nontrivial A.logDerivative_im_nonpos_away A.schwarz

name: OverflowResidueRH.jensenPolynomial_eq_map
statement:
theorem jensenPolynomial_eq_map
    (γ : ℕ → ℝ) (n d : ℕ) :
    jensenPolynomial γ n d =
      (realJensenPolynomial γ n d).map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [jensenPolynomial, realJensenPolynomial, Polynomial.map_sum,
    Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_pow]

name: OverflowResidueRH.jensenPolynomial_coeff
statement:
theorem jensenPolynomial_coeff
    (γ : ℕ → ℝ) (n d k : ℕ) :
    (jensenPolynomial γ n d).coeff k =
      if k ≤ d then (((Nat.choose d k : ℝ) * γ (n + k) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [jensenPolynomial]
  rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  simp_rw [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  by_cases hk : k ≤ d
  · rw [if_pos hk]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
    · simp
    · intro b hb hbk
      simp [Ne.symm hbk]
    · simp [Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr hk]
  · rw [if_neg hk]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro b hb
    have hbk : b ≠ k := by
      intro h
      subst b
      exact hk (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hb))
    simp [Ne.symm hbk]

name: OverflowResidueRH.jensenPolynomial_natDegree_le
statement:
theorem jensenPolynomial_natDegree_le
    (γ : ℕ → ℝ) (n d : ℕ) :
    (jensenPolynomial γ n d).natDegree ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro k hk
  rw [jensenPolynomial_coeff]
  simp only [if_neg (Nat.not_le.mpr hk)]

name: OverflowResidueRH.jensenPolynomial_natDegree_eq
statement:
theorem jensenPolynomial_natDegree_eq
    (γ : ℕ → ℝ) (n d : ℕ) (hγ : γ (n + d) ≠ 0) :
    (jensenPolynomial γ n d).natDegree = d
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (jensenPolynomial_natDegree_le γ n d)
  apply Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_ne_zero
  rw [jensenPolynomial_coeff, if_pos le_rfl]
  simp [hγ]

name: OverflowResidueRH.jensenPolynomial_derivative_succ
statement:
theorem jensenPolynomial_derivative_succ
    (γ : ℕ → ℝ) (n d : ℕ) :
    (jensenPolynomial γ n (d + 1)).derivative =
      Polynomial.C ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * jensenPolynomial γ (n + 1) d
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_derivative, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
    jensenPolynomial_coeff, jensenPolynomial_coeff]
  by_cases hk : k ≤ d
  · rw [if_pos hk, if_pos (Nat.succ_le_succ hk)]
    push_cast
    have hchoose :
        (((d + 1).choose (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) =
          ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((d.choose k : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq d k).symm
    rw [show n + (k + 1) = n + 1 + k by omega]
    calc
      (((d + 1).choose (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) *
            ((γ (n + 1 + k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((k : ℂ) + 1) =
          ((((d + 1).choose (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℂ) *
            ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)) * ((γ (n + 1 + k) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
              push_cast
              ring
      _ = (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((d.choose k : ℕ) : ℂ)) *
            ((γ (n + 1 + k) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by rw [hchoose]
      _ = ((d : ℂ) + 1) *
            (((d.choose k : ℕ) : ℂ) * ((γ (n + 1 + k) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
              push_cast
              ring
  · rw [if_neg hk]
    have hksucc : ¬ k + 1 ≤ d + 1 := by omega
    rw [if_neg hksucc]
    simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.PolynomialHyperbolic.derivative
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact hderiv
  · apply polynomial_derivative_roots_real
    · have hn : 0 < p.natDegree :=
        (Polynomial.derivative_ne_zero.mp hderiv).bot_lt
      exact Polynomial.natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.mp hn
    · exact hp.2

name: OverflowResidueRH.PolynomialHyperbolic.of_C_mul
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hpzero
    apply h.1
    simp [hpzero]
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply h.2 ρ
    simp [hρ]

name: OverflowResidueRH.JensenPolynomialHyperbolicity.atOrigin
statement:
theorem JensenPolynomialHyperbolicity.atOrigin
    {γ : ℕ → ℝ} (hγ : JensenPolynomialHyperbolicity γ) :
    JensenPolynomialHyperbolicityAtOrigin γ
proof:
:=
  hγ 0

name: OverflowResidueRH.jensenPolynomial_hyperbolic_shift_of_succ
statement:
theorem jensenPolynomial_hyperbolic_shift_of_succ
    {γ : ℕ → ℝ} {n d : ℕ}
    (h : PolynomialHyperbolic (jensenPolynomial γ n (d + 1)))
    (hγ : γ (n + 1 + d) ≠ 0) :
    PolynomialHyperbolic (jensenPolynomial γ (n + 1) d)
proof:
:= by
  have hJne : jensenPolynomial γ (n + 1) d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hcoeff := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℂ => p.coeff d) hzero
    rw [jensenPolynomial_coeff, if_pos le_rfl] at hcoeff
    simp [hγ] at hcoeff
  have hderiv_ne : (jensenPolynomial γ n (d + 1)).derivative ≠ 0 := by
    rw [jensenPolynomial_derivative_succ]
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero d)) hJne
  have hderiv := h.derivative hderiv_ne
  rw [jensenPolynomial_derivative_succ] at hderiv
  exact hderiv.of_C_mul

name: OverflowResidueRH.JensenPolynomialHyperbolicityAtOrigin.allShifts_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem JensenPolynomialHyperbolicityAtOrigin.allShifts_of_ne_zero
    {γ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (H : JensenPolynomialHyperbolicityAtOrigin γ)
    (hγ : ∀ n : ℕ, γ n ≠ 0) :
    JensenPolynomialHyperbolicity γ
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro d
      exact H d
  | succ n ih =>
      intro d
      exact jensenPolynomial_hyperbolic_shift_of_succ
        (ih (d + 1)) (hγ (n + 1 + d))

name: OverflowResidueRH.jensenPolynomial_schwarz
statement:
theorem jensenPolynomial_schwarz
    (γ : ℕ → ℝ) (n d : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    (jensenPolynomial γ n d).eval (star z) =
      star ((jensenPolynomial γ n d).eval z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [jensenPolynomial, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_pow,
    Polynomial.eval_X]
  change (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
      (((Nat.choose d k : ℝ) * γ (n + k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (star z) ^ k) =
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
      (((Nat.choose d k : ℝ) * γ (n + k) : ℝ) : ℂ) * z ^ k)
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.rescaledJensenPolynomial_schwarz
statement:
theorem rescaledJensenPolynomial_schwarz
    (γ : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    (rescaledJensenPolynomial γ d).eval (star z) =
      star ((rescaledJensenPolynomial γ d).eval z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rescaledJensenPolynomial
  rw [Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_comp]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_X]
  simpa [Complex.star_def, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal] using
    jensenPolynomial_schwarz γ 0 (d + 1)
      (Complex.ofReal (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) * z)

name: OverflowResidueRH.JensenPolynomialHyperbolicityAtOrigin.rescaled
statement:
theorem JensenPolynomialHyperbolicityAtOrigin.rescaled
    {γ : ℕ → ℝ} (hγ : JensenPolynomialHyperbolicityAtOrigin γ) (d : ℕ) :
    PolynomialHyperbolic (rescaledJensenPolynomial γ d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rescaledJensenPolynomial
  let q := Polynomial.C (Complex.ofReal (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹)) * Polynomial.X
  have hJ := hγ (d + 1)
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    rcases Polynomial.comp_eq_zero_iff.mp hzero with hJzero | hconstant
    · exact hJ.1 hJzero
    · have hcoeff := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℂ => p.coeff 1) hconstant.2
      norm_num [q] at hcoeff
      have hsucc : (d : ℂ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero d
      exact hsucc hcoeff
  · intro ρ hρ
    have hroot :
        (jensenPolynomial γ 0 (d + 1)).eval
          (Complex.ofReal (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹) * ρ) = 0 := by
      simpa [Polynomial.eval_comp] using hρ
    have him := hJ.2 _ hroot
    have him' : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ρ.im = 0 := by
      rw [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
        zero_mul, add_zero] at him
      exact him
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp him').resolve_left (ne_of_gt hpos)

name: OverflowResidueRH.roots_real_of_jensen_hyperbolicity
statement:
theorem roots_real_of_jensen_hyperbolicity
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {γ : ℕ → ℝ}
    (C : JensenConvergenceData F γ)
    (H : JensenPolynomialHyperbolicityAtOrigin γ)
    (h_nontrivial : ∃ z : ℂ, F z ≠ 0) :
    ∀ ρ : ℂ, F ρ = 0 → ρ.im = 0
proof:
:=
  (C.toLaguerrePolyaApproximationData H).roots_real h_nontrivial

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_upper_root_has_lowerProbe_signViolation
statement:
theorem polynomial_upper_root_has_lowerProbe_signViolation
    (p : Polynomial ℂ) (hp : p ≠ 0) {ρ : ℂ}
    (hroot : p.eval ρ = 0) (hupper : 0 < ρ.im) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < ρ.im ∧
      0 < (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I).im ∧
      p.eval (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 ∧
      0 < (polynomialLogDerivResponse p
        (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ :=
    (polynomialPoleWitnessHypothesis_of_nonzero_polynomial p hp)
      |>.decomp_at_each_upper_root ρ hroot hupper
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεD, hprobeUpper, hprobePos⟩ :=
    exists_lowerProbe_escape_of_localLogDerivPole D
  have hεUpper : ε < ρ.im := lt_trans hεD D.hε0_lt
  have hprobeNonzero : p.eval (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    unfold polynomialLogDerivResponse at hprobePos
    rw [hzero, div_zero, Complex.zero_im] at hprobePos
    exact (lt_irrefl 0 hprobePos)
  exact ⟨ε, hε, hεUpper, hprobeUpper, hprobeNonzero, hprobePos⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial_eval
statement:
@[simp] theorem symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial_eval (ρ z : ℂ) :
    (symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial ρ).eval z =
      (z - ρ) * (z - star ρ) * (z + ρ) * (z + star ρ)
proof:
:= by

name: OverflowResidueRH.symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial_ne_zero (ρ : ℂ) :
    symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial ρ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial
  exact mul_ne_zero
    (mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero ρ)
        (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero (star ρ)))
      (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero (-ρ)))
    (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero (-star ρ))

theorem symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial_orbit_roots (ρ : ℂ) :

theorem symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial_neg (ρ z : ℂ) :

name: OverflowResidueRH.symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial_conj

theorem symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial_conj (ρ z : ℂ) :

name: OverflowResidueRH.symmetricZeroQuartet_forces_lowerProbe_signViolation
statement:
theorem symmetricZeroQuartet_forces_lowerProbe_signViolation
    {ρ : ℂ} (hupper : 0 < ρ.im) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < ρ.im ∧
      0 < (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I).im ∧
      (symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial ρ).eval
        (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 ∧
      0 < (polynomialLogDerivResponse
        (symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial ρ)
        (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im
proof:
:=
  polynomial_upper_root_has_lowerProbe_signViolation
    (symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial ρ)
    (symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial_ne_zero ρ)
    (symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial_root ρ) hupper

name: OverflowResidueRH.symmetricZeroQuartet_not_antiHerglotz
statement:
theorem symmetricZeroQuartet_not_antiHerglotz
    {ρ : ℂ} (hupper : 0 < ρ.im) :
    ¬ AntiHerglotzUHP
      (polynomialLogDerivResponse (symmetricZeroQuartetPolynomial ρ))
proof:
:= by
  intro hanti
  obtain ⟨ε, _hε, _hεUpper, hprobeUpper, _hprobeNonzero, hprobePos⟩ :=
    symmetricZeroQuartet_forces_lowerProbe_signViolation hupper
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hanti _ hprobeUpper)) hprobePos

theorem polynomial_logDeriv_poleWitness

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_roots_real_of_logDeriv_antiHerglotz_and_conjSymm

theorem polynomial_logDeriv_background_continuousAt

:= by

  · exact (Polynomial.continuous q.derivative).continuousAt
  · exact (Polynomial.continuous q).continuousAt

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_logDeriv_background_bounded_on_probe
statement:
theorem polynomial_logDeriv_background_bounded_on_probe
    {q : Polynomial ℂ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (hqρ : q.eval ρ ≠ 0)
    (hupper : 0 < ρ.im) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧
    ∃ ε0 : ℝ, 0 < ε0 ∧ ε0 < ρ.im ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < ε0 →
        |((q.derivative.eval (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I)) /
           (q.eval (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I))).im| ≤ K
proof:
:=
  continuousAt_implies_probe_bounded
    (polynomial_logDeriv_background_continuousAt hqρ) hupper

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_factor_at_root_with_nonzero_remainder
statement:
theorem polynomial_factor_at_root_with_nonzero_remainder
    {p : Polynomial ℂ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hroot : p.eval ρ = 0) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧
    ∃ q : Polynomial ℂ,
      p = (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ρ)^m * q ∧
      q.eval ρ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set m := p.rootMultiplicity ρ with hm_def
  have hm_pos : 0 < m := by
    rw [hm_def]
    exact (Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_pos hp).mpr hroot
  obtain ⟨q, hq_eq⟩ : (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ρ)^m ∣ p :=
    Polynomial.pow_rootMultiplicity_dvd p ρ
  refine ⟨m, hm_pos, q, hq_eq, ?_⟩
  
  
  intro hq_eval
  have h_dvd_q : (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ρ) ∣ q :=
    Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr hq_eval
  have h_succ_dvd : (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ρ)^(m+1) ∣ p := by
    rw [hq_eq, pow_succ]
    exact mul_dvd_mul_left _ h_dvd_q
  have h_le := (Polynomial.le_rootMultiplicity_iff hp).mpr h_succ_dvd
  rw [← hm_def] at h_le
  omega

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_logDeriv_local_decomposition_of_factor
statement:
theorem polynomial_logDeriv_local_decomposition_of_factor
    {p q : Polynomial ℂ} {ρ z : ℂ} {k : ℕ}
    (hfac : p = (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ρ) ^ (k + 1) * q)
    (hzρ : z ≠ ρ)
    (hqz : q.eval z ≠ 0) :
    polynomialLogDerivResponse p z =
      (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) / (z - ρ))
        + q.derivative.eval z / q.eval z
proof:
:= by
  unfold polynomialLogDerivResponse
  
  have hp_eval : p.eval z = (z - ρ)^(k+1) * q.eval z := by
    rw [hfac]
    simp [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow,
          Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
  
  have hp_deriv_eval : p.derivative.eval z
                    = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (z - ρ)^k * q.eval z
                      + (z - ρ)^(k+1) * q.derivative.eval z := by
    rw [hfac, Polynomial.derivative_mul, Polynomial.derivative_pow_succ]
    simp [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow,
          Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C,
          Polynomial.derivative_sub, Polynomial.derivative_X,
          Polynomial.derivative_C]
  rw [hp_eval, hp_deriv_eval]
  exact complex_local_pole_decomposition_general z ρ (q.eval z)
          (q.derivative.eval z) k hzρ hqz

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomialPoleWitnessHypothesis_of_nonzero_polynomial
statement:
theorem polynomialPoleWitnessHypothesis_of_nonzero_polynomial
    (p : Polynomial ℂ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    PolynomialPoleWitnessHypothesis p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro ρ hroot hupper
  obtain ⟨m, hm, q, hfac, hqρ⟩ :=
    polynomial_factor_at_root_with_nonzero_remainder hp hroot
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 :=
    ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  exact ⟨localLogDerivPoleDecomposition_of_polynomial_factor
    hupper hfac hqρ⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_roots_real_of_logDeriv_antiHerglotz_and_conjSymm'
statement:
theorem polynomial_roots_real_of_logDeriv_antiHerglotz_and_conjSymm'
    (p : Polynomial ℂ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hanti : AntiHerglotzUHP (polynomialLogDerivResponse p))
    (hsym : ∀ z : ℂ, p.eval (star z) = star (p.eval z)) :
    ∀ ρ : ℂ, p.eval ρ = 0 → ρ.im = 0
proof:
:=
  polynomial_roots_real_of_logDeriv_antiHerglotz_and_conjSymm
    p (polynomialPoleWitnessHypothesis_of_nonzero_polynomial p hp)
    hanti hsym

name: OverflowResidueRH.lowerHalfPlane_residue_imag_nonpos
statement:
theorem lowerHalfPlane_residue_imag_nonpos
    (z rho : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) (hrho : rho.im ≤ 0) :
    ((1 : ℂ) / (z - rho)).im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hne : z - rho ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have him : (z - rho).im = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
    rw [Complex.sub_im] at him
    linarith
  rw [one_div, Complex.inv_im, Complex.sub_im]
  have hnorm : 0 < Complex.normSq (z - rho) := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hne
  exact le_of_lt (div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) hnorm)

name: OverflowResidueRH.lowerHalfPlane_residue_imag_neg
statement:
theorem lowerHalfPlane_residue_imag_neg
    (z rho : ℂ) (hz : 0 < z.im) (hrho : rho.im ≤ 0) :
    ((1 : ℂ) / (z - rho)).im < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hne : z - rho ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have him : (z - rho).im = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
    rw [Complex.sub_im] at him
    linarith
  rw [one_div, Complex.inv_im, Complex.sub_im]
  have hnorm : 0 < Complex.normSq (z - rho) := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hne
  exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) hnorm

name: OverflowResidueRH.lowerHalfPlane_residue_cloud_antiHerglotz_multiset
statement:
theorem lowerHalfPlane_residue_cloud_antiHerglotz_multiset
    (roots : Multiset ℂ)
    (hroots : ∀ rho ∈ roots, rho.im ≤ 0) :
    AntiHerglotzUHP
      (fun z : ℂ => (roots.map fun rho : ℂ => (1 : ℂ) / (z - rho)).sum)
proof:
:= by
  revert hroots
  induction roots using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      intro _ z _
      simp
  | @cons rho roots ih =>
      intro hroots z hz
      have hrho : rho.im ≤ 0 := hroots rho (by simp)
      have htail : ∀ sigma ∈ roots, sigma.im ≤ 0 := by
        intro sigma hsigma
        exact hroots sigma (by simp [hsigma])
      have hhead := lowerHalfPlane_residue_imag_nonpos z rho hz hrho
      have hrest := ih htail z hz
      simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, Complex.add_im]
      exact add_nonpos hhead hrest

name: OverflowResidueRH.lowerHalfPlane_residue_cloud_strictAntiHerglotz_multiset
statement:
theorem lowerHalfPlane_residue_cloud_strictAntiHerglotz_multiset
    (roots : Multiset ℂ) (hne : roots ≠ 0)
    (hroots : ∀ rho ∈ roots, rho.im ≤ 0) :
    StrictAntiHerglotzUHP
      (fun z : ℂ => (roots.map fun rho : ℂ => (1 : ℂ) / (z - rho)).sum)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  induction roots using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact (hne rfl).elim
  | @cons rho roots _ih =>
      have hrho : rho.im ≤ 0 := hroots rho (by simp)
      have htail : ∀ sigma ∈ roots, sigma.im ≤ 0 := by
        intro sigma hsigma
        exact hroots sigma (by simp [hsigma])
      have hhead := lowerHalfPlane_residue_imag_neg z rho hz hrho
      have hrest := lowerHalfPlane_residue_cloud_antiHerglotz_multiset
        roots htail z hz
      simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, Complex.add_im]
      linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_antiHerglotz_iff_roots_closedLower
statement:
theorem polynomial_antiHerglotz_iff_roots_closedLower
    (p : Polynomial ℂ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    AntiHerglotzUHP (polynomialLogDerivResponse p) ↔
      ∀ rho : ℂ, p.eval rho = 0 → rho.im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsign rho hroot
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hupper
    have hnonzero := antiHerglotz_forbids_upper_zeros
      (polynomial_logDeriv_poleWitness p
        (polynomialPoleWitnessHypothesis_of_nonzero_polynomial p hp))
      hsign rho hupper
    exact hnonzero hroot
  · intro hroots z hz
    by_cases hpz : p.eval z = 0
    · unfold polynomialLogDerivResponse
      rw [hpz, div_zero, Complex.zero_im]
    · unfold polynomialLogDerivResponse
      rw [(IsAlgClosed.splits p).eval_derivative_div_eval_of_ne_zero hpz]
      exact lowerHalfPlane_residue_cloud_antiHerglotz_multiset p.roots
        (fun rho hrho => hroots rho ((Polynomial.mem_roots hp).mp hrho)) z hz

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_roots_closedLower
statement:
theorem polynomial_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_roots_closedLower
    (p : Polynomial ℂ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    StrictAntiHerglotzUHP (polynomialLogDerivResponse p) ↔
      0 < p.natDegree ∧
        ∀ rho : ℂ, p.eval rho = 0 → rho.im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsign
    refine ⟨?_, (polynomial_antiHerglotz_iff_roots_closedLower p hp).mp
      hsign.antiHerglotz⟩
    by_contra hdegree
    have hdegree_zero : p.natDegree = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hdegree
    have hI := hsign Complex.I (by simp)
    rw [Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hdegree_zero] at hI
    simp [polynomialLogDerivResponse] at hI
  · rintro ⟨hdegree, hroots⟩ z hz
    have hpz : p.eval z ≠ 0 := by
      intro hpz
      have := hroots z hpz
      linarith
    unfold polynomialLogDerivResponse
    rw [(IsAlgClosed.splits p).eval_derivative_div_eval_of_ne_zero hpz]
    exact lowerHalfPlane_residue_cloud_strictAntiHerglotz_multiset
      p.roots
      ((IsAlgClosed.splits p).roots_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hdegree))
      (fun rho hrho => hroots rho ((Polynomial.mem_roots hp).mp hrho)) z hz

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_logDeriv_sign_away_iff_roots_closedLower
statement:
theorem polynomial_logDeriv_sign_away_iff_roots_closedLower
    (p : Polynomial ℂ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → p.eval z ≠ 0 →
        (polynomialLogDerivResponse p z).im ≤ 0) ↔
      ∀ rho : ℂ, p.eval rho = 0 → rho.im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsign
    apply (polynomial_antiHerglotz_iff_roots_closedLower p hp).mp
    intro z hz
    by_cases hpz : p.eval z = 0
    · unfold polynomialLogDerivResponse
      rw [hpz, div_zero, Complex.zero_im]
    · exact hsign z hz hpz
  · intro hroots z hz _hpz
    exact (polynomial_antiHerglotz_iff_roots_closedLower p hp).mpr
      hroots z hz

name: OverflowResidueRH.prodLinearReal_eval
statement:
private theorem prodLinearReal_eval
    (roots : List ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    (roots.map fun r : ℝ => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((r : ℝ) : ℂ)).prod.eval z
      = (roots.map fun r : ℝ => z - (r : ℂ)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction roots with
  | nil => simp
  | cons r rs ih =>
    simp [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X,
          Polynomial.eval_C, ih]

name: OverflowResidueRH.prodLinearReal_eval_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem prodLinearReal_eval_ne_zero
    (roots : List ℝ) {z : ℂ} (hz : ∀ r ∈ roots, z ≠ (r : ℂ)) :
    (roots.map fun r : ℝ => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((r : ℝ) : ℂ)).prod.eval z
      ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [prodLinearReal_eval]
  induction roots with
  | nil => simp
  | cons r rs ih =>
    have h_head : z ≠ (r : ℂ) := hz r (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have h_tail : ∀ s ∈ rs, z ≠ (s : ℂ) :=
      fun s hs => hz s (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hs)
    have h_rest := ih h_tail
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
    exact mul_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr h_head) h_rest

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomialLogDeriv_of_linearProd_eq_cloud
statement:
theorem polynomialLogDeriv_of_linearProd_eq_cloud
    (roots : List ℝ) (z : ℂ)
    (hz : ∀ r ∈ roots, z ≠ (r : ℂ)) :
    polynomialLogDerivResponse
        (roots.map fun r : ℝ => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((r : ℝ) : ℂ)).prod z
      = (roots.map fun r : ℝ => (1 : ℂ) / (z - (r : ℂ))).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction roots with
  | nil =>
    
    simp [polynomialLogDerivResponse]
  | cons r rs ih =>
    have h_head : z ≠ (r : ℂ) := hz r (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have h_tail : ∀ s ∈ rs, z ≠ (s : ℂ) :=
      fun s hs => hz s (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hs)
    have h_rest := ih h_tail
    
    set q : Polynomial ℂ :=
      (rs.map fun r : ℝ => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((r : ℝ) : ℂ)).prod
      with hq_def
    have hq_eval : q.eval z ≠ 0 :=
      prodLinearReal_eval_ne_zero rs h_tail
    
    have h_p_eval :
        ((List.map (fun r : ℝ => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((r : ℝ) : ℂ))
              (r :: rs)).prod).eval z
          = (z - (r : ℂ)) * q.eval z := by
      simp [hq_def, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_sub,
            Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
    have h_p_deriv_eval :
        (((List.map (fun r : ℝ => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((r : ℝ) : ℂ))
              (r :: rs)).prod).derivative).eval z
          = q.eval z + (z - (r : ℂ)) * q.derivative.eval z := by
      simp [hq_def, Polynomial.derivative_mul, Polynomial.derivative_sub,
            Polynomial.derivative_X, Polynomial.derivative_C,
            Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_sub,
            Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
    have hr_ne : z - (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h_head
    
    change polynomialLogDerivResponse
            (List.map (fun r : ℝ => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((r : ℝ) : ℂ))
              (r :: rs)).prod z
          = (List.map (fun r : ℝ => (1 : ℂ) / (z - (r : ℂ))) (r :: rs)).sum
    unfold polynomialLogDerivResponse
    rw [h_p_eval, h_p_deriv_eval]
    have h_alg :
        (q.eval z + (z - (r : ℂ)) * q.derivative.eval z) /
          ((z - (r : ℂ)) * q.eval z)
          = 1 / (z - (r : ℂ)) + q.derivative.eval z / q.eval z := by
      field_simp
    rw [h_alg, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    
    
    have h_rest' : q.derivative.eval z / q.eval z
                  = (List.map (fun r : ℝ => (1 : ℂ) / (z - (r : ℂ))) rs).sum :=
      h_rest
    rw [h_rest']

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomialLogDeriv_C_mul
statement:
private theorem polynomialLogDeriv_C_mul
    (c : ℂ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (q : Polynomial ℂ) (z : ℂ) (hq : q.eval z ≠ 0) :
    polynomialLogDerivResponse (Polynomial.C c * q) z
      = polynomialLogDerivResponse q z
proof:
:= by
  unfold polynomialLogDerivResponse
  have h_eval : (Polynomial.C c * q).eval z = c * q.eval z := by
    simp [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  have h_deriv :
      ((Polynomial.C c * q).derivative).eval z = c * q.derivative.eval z := by
    simp [Polynomial.derivative_mul, Polynomial.derivative_C,
          Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  rw [h_eval, h_deriv]
  field_simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.prodLinearReal_eval_zero_of_mem
statement:
private theorem prodLinearReal_eval_zero_of_mem
    (roots : List ℝ) {z : ℂ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ roots) (hz : z = (r : ℂ)) :
    (roots.map fun s : ℝ => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((s : ℝ) : ℂ)).prod.eval z
      = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [prodLinearReal_eval]
  induction roots with
  | nil => exact absurd hr (List.not_mem_nil)
  | cons s rs ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hr with rfl | hr_tail
    · simp [hz]
    · rw [ih hr_tail]; ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomialLogDeriv_eq_real_residue_cloud_of_factorization
statement:
theorem polynomialLogDeriv_eq_real_residue_cloud_of_factorization
    {p : Polynomial ℂ}
    (F : PolynomialRealLinearFactorization p)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : p.eval z ≠ 0) :
    polynomialLogDerivResponse p z =
      (F.roots.map fun r : ℝ => (1 : ℂ) / (z - (r : ℂ))).sum
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  set q : Polynomial ℂ :=
    (F.roots.map fun r : ℝ => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((r : ℝ) : ℂ)).prod
    with hq_def
  
  have h_z_ne : ∀ r ∈ F.roots, z ≠ (r : ℂ) := by
    intro r hr hz_eq
    apply hz
    have hp_eval : p.eval z = F.c * q.eval z := by
      have h := congrArg (Polynomial.eval z) F.factorization
      rw [h, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
    rw [hp_eval, prodLinearReal_eval_zero_of_mem F.roots hr hz_eq, mul_zero]
  
  have h_q_eval : q.eval z ≠ 0 :=
    prodLinearReal_eval_ne_zero F.roots h_z_ne
  have hp_lhs :
      polynomialLogDerivResponse p z
        = polynomialLogDerivResponse (Polynomial.C F.c * q) z :=
    congrArg (fun r => polynomialLogDerivResponse r z) F.factorization
  rw [hp_lhs, polynomialLogDeriv_C_mul F.c F.hc q z h_q_eval]
  
  exact polynomialLogDeriv_of_linearProd_eq_cloud F.roots z h_z_ne

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_antiHerglotz_of_realLinearFactorization

name: OverflowResidueRH.polynomial_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_roots_real

name: OverflowResidueRH.eventually_nhds_implies_probe_eventually
statement:
theorem eventually_nhds_implies_probe_eventually
    {P : ℂ → Prop} {ρ : ℂ}
    (hP : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 ρ, P z)
    (hupper : 0 < ρ.im) :
    ∃ ε0 : ℝ, 0 < ε0 ∧ ε0 < ρ.im ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < ε0 →
        P (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff] at hP
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := hP
  refine ⟨min (δ/2) (ρ.im / 2), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
  intro ε hε_pos hε_lt
  apply hδ
  rw [dist_eq_norm,
      show ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I - ρ = -((ε : ℂ) * Complex.I) by ring,
      norm_neg, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
  change ‖((ε : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ < δ
  rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε_pos]
  have hε_lt_half : ε < δ / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_left _ _)
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.eventually_nhds_implies_probe_eventually_nhds
statement:
theorem eventually_nhds_implies_probe_eventually_nhds
    {P : ℂ → Prop} {ρ : ℂ}
    (hP : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 ρ, P z)
    (hupper : 0 < ρ.im) :
    ∃ ε0 : ℝ, 0 < ε0 ∧ ε0 < ρ.im ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < ε0 →
        ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I), P z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff] at hP
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ⟩ := hP
  refine ⟨min (δ / 2) (ρ.im / 2), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
  intro ε hε_pos hε_lt
  have hε_lt_half : ε < δ / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt (min_le_left _ _)
  rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
  refine ⟨δ / 4, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  apply hδ
  have hprobe_dist : dist (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ = ε := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm,
        show ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I - ρ = -((ε : ℂ) * Complex.I) by ring,
        norm_neg, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one]
    change ‖((ε : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = ε
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε_pos]
  calc dist w ρ
        ≤ dist w (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I) +
            dist (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I) ρ := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ < δ / 4 + ε := by linarith
    _ < δ := by linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDeriv_of_eventual_factorization
statement:
theorem logDeriv_of_eventual_factorization
    {F g : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ z : ℂ} {m : ℕ}
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (hzρ : z ≠ ρ)
    (hgz : g z ≠ 0)
    (hF_eq : F =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w => (w - ρ) ^ m * g w)
    (hgdiff : DifferentiableAt ℂ g z) :
    logDerivativeResponse F z =
      ((m : ℕ) : ℂ) / (z - ρ) + deriv g z / g z
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  
  have hF_val : F z = (z - ρ) ^ (k + 1) * g z := hF_eq.eq_of_nhds
  
  have h_sub : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w - ρ) 1 z :=
    (hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const ρ
  have h_pow : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (w - ρ) ^ (k + 1))
                (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (z - ρ) ^ k) z := by
    have h := h_sub.pow (k + 1)
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, mul_one] at h
    convert h using 2
    all_goals rfl
  have hg : HasDerivAt g (deriv g z) z := hgdiff.hasDerivAt
  have h_prod : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (w - ρ) ^ (k + 1) * g w)
                  (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (z - ρ) ^ k * g z +
                    (z - ρ) ^ (k + 1) * deriv g z) z := h_pow.mul hg
  have h_F_deriv : deriv F z =
      ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * (z - ρ) ^ k * g z +
        (z - ρ) ^ (k + 1) * deriv g z := by
    rw [hF_eq.deriv_eq]; exact h_prod.deriv
  unfold logDerivativeResponse
  rw [h_F_deriv, hF_val]
  exact complex_local_pole_decomposition_general z ρ (g z) (deriv g z) k hzρ hgz

name: OverflowResidueRH.analytic_zero_admits_factorization
statement:
theorem analytic_zero_admits_factorization
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (ρ : ℂ) :
    AnalyticZeroAdmitsFactorization F ρ
proof:
:= by
  intro hND hzero
  obtain ⟨n, g, hg_an, hg_ne, hg_eq⟩ :=
    (AnalyticAt.exists_eventuallyEq_pow_smul_nonzero_iff hND.isAnalytic).mpr
      hND.not_eventually_zero
  
  have hm_pos : 0 < n := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hn0 : n = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hcon
    subst hn0
    have heq : F ρ = (ρ - ρ) ^ 0 • g ρ := hg_eq.self_of_nhds
    simp only [pow_zero, one_smul] at heq
    rw [hzero] at heq
    exact hg_ne heq.symm
  
  have hfactor : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 ρ, F z = (z - ρ) ^ n * g z := by
    filter_upwards [hg_eq] with z hz
    rw [hz, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hg_diff_nhds : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 ρ, DifferentiableAt ℂ g z := by
    filter_upwards [hg_an.eventually_analyticAt] with z hz
    exact hz.differentiableAt
  
  have hcont_background : ContinuousAt (fun z => deriv g z / g z) ρ :=
    hg_an.deriv.continuousAt.div hg_an.continuousAt hg_ne
  exact ⟨{ m := n
           hm_pos := hm_pos
           g := g
           hgρ := hg_ne
           hg_diff_nhds := hg_diff_nhds
           hcont_background := hcont_background
           hfactor := hfactor }⟩

proof:

  refine ⟨hF ρ (Set.mem_univ ρ), ?_⟩
  intro hlocal
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h_nontrivial
  apply hw
  have hpre : IsPreconnected (Set.univ : Set ℂ) := isPreconnected_univ
  have hF_eq_zero : F =ᶠ[𝓝 ρ] 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hlocal] with z hz
    simpa using hz

    hF.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero

  simpa using hzero_on (Set.mem_univ w)

    {f R : ℂ → ℂ}

    ∀ ρ : ℂ, 0 < ρ.im → f ρ ≠ 0
proof:

name: OverflowResidueRH.realZeros_of_antiHerglotz_logDerivative
statement:
theorem realZeros_of_antiHerglotz_logDerivative
    {f R : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hpole : LogDerivPoleWitnessLaw f R)
    (hanti : AntiHerglotzUHP R)
    (hsym : ∀ z : ℂ, f (star z) = star (f z)) :
    ∀ ρ : ℂ, f ρ = 0 → ρ.im = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro ρ hρzero
  rcases lt_trichotomy ρ.im 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
  · 
    have hconj_zero : f (star ρ) = 0 := by
      rw [hsym ρ, hρzero]
      simp
    have hupper_conj : 0 < (star ρ).im := by
      rw [complex_star_im]
      linarith
    exact absurd hconj_zero
      (antiHerglotz_forbids_upper_zeros hpole hanti (star ρ) hupper_conj)
  · exact hzero
  · 
    exact absurd hρzero
      (antiHerglotz_forbids_upper_zeros hpole hanti ρ hpos)
