name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_infiniteHadamardProduct_eq_tsum_nat
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_infiniteHadamardProduct_eq_tsum_nat
    {zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    {s : ℂ} (hs_ne : ∀ i : ℕ, s ≠ zeroLoc i) :
    logDerivativeResponse (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) s =
      hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries zeroLoc s
proof:
:= by
  let Hluc : HadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData zeroLoc
      (natHadamardFiniteExhaustion H) :=
    natHadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData H
  let Hderiv : HadamardFiniteDerivativeLimitData zeroLoc
      (natHadamardFiniteExhaustion H) :=
    HadamardFiniteDerivativeLimitData.of_locallyUniformProduct Hluc
  apply Hderiv.logDeriv_eq_tsum_at
  · change s ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℂ)
    exact Set.mem_univ s
  · exact H.zero_ne
  · exact hs_ne
  · exact H.infiniteProduct_ne_zero hs_ne

name: OverflowResidueRH.finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_nonpos
statement:
theorem finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_nonpos
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.im) :
    (finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
      (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) F s).im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
  rw [Complex.im_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_nonpos
  intro i _hi
  rw [Complex.add_im]
  have hregularizer : (1 / (((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ))).im = 0 := by
    simp
  rw [hregularizer, add_zero]
  exact complex_real_root_residue_imag_nonpos s (zeroLoc i) hs

name: OverflowResidueRH.finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_le_residue
statement:
theorem finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_le_residue
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ∈ F)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.im) :
    (finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
      (fun j : ℕ => ((zeroLoc j : ℝ) : ℂ)) F s).im ≤
        ((1 : ℂ) / (s - ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ))).im
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsplit :
      finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
          (fun j : ℕ => ((zeroLoc j : ℝ) : ℂ)) F s =
        finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
            (fun j : ℕ => ((zeroLoc j : ℝ) : ℂ)) (F.erase i) s +
          (1 / (s - ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) +
            1 / ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    unfold finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
    exact (F.sum_erase_add _ hi).symm
  have hrest := finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_nonpos
    zeroLoc (F.erase i) hs
  have hregularizer : (1 / ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)).im = 0 := by simp
  rw [hsplit, Complex.add_im, Complex.add_im, hregularizer, add_zero]
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_neg
statement:
theorem finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_neg
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℝ) (F : Finset ℕ) (hF : F.Nonempty)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.im) :
    (finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
      (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) F s).im < 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hF
  have hle := finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_le_residue
    zeroLoc F hi hs
  have hstrict := complex_real_root_residue_imag_neg s (zeroLoc i) hs
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle hstrict

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_real_im_nonpos
statement:
theorem hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_real_im_nonpos
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℝ)
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability
      (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.im) :
    (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
      (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) s).im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsum_tendsto :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
            (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Finset.range n) s)
        Filter.atTop
        (𝓝 (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
          (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) s)) :=
    H.finiteRegularizedSum_tendsto_at_exhaustion_totalized
      Finset.range_mono natRange_exhaustive s
  have him_tendsto :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          (finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
            (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Finset.range n) s).im)
        Filter.atTop
        (𝓝 (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
          (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) s).im) :=
    (Complex.continuous_im.tendsto _).comp hsum_tendsto
  exact le_of_tendsto him_tendsto
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n =>
      finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_nonpos zeroLoc (Finset.range n) hs)

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_real_im_neg
statement:
theorem hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_real_im_neg
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℝ)
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability
      (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.im) :
    (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
      (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) s).im < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsum_tendsto :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
            (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Finset.range n) s)
        Filter.atTop
        (𝓝 (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
          (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) s)) :=
    H.finiteRegularizedSum_tendsto_at_exhaustion_totalized
      Finset.range_mono natRange_exhaustive s
  have him_tendsto :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          (finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
            (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Finset.range n) s).im)
        Filter.atTop
        (𝓝 (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
          (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) s).im) :=
    (Complex.continuous_im.tendsto _).comp hsum_tendsto
  have hbound :
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        (finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
          (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Finset.range n) s).im ≤
            ((1 : ℂ) / (s - ((zeroLoc 0 : ℝ) : ℂ))).im := by
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with n hn
    exact finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_le_residue
      zeroLoc (Finset.range n) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hn) hs
  have hlimit_le :
      (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
        (fun i : ℕ => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) s).im ≤
          ((1 : ℂ) / (s - ((zeroLoc 0 : ℝ) : ℂ))).im :=
    le_of_tendsto him_tendsto hbound
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hlimit_le
    (complex_real_root_residue_imag_neg s (zeroLoc 0) hs)

name: OverflowResidueRH.infiniteHadamardProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_of_zero_sequence_real
statement:

    · simpa [realLoc] using (hreal i).symm

name: OverflowResidueRH.infiniteHadamardProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_zero_sequence_real
statement:
theorem infiniteHadamardProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_zero_sequence_real
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ)
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    (h_schwarz : ∀ z : ℂ,
      infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc (star z) =
        star (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc z)) :
    StrictAntiHerglotzUHP
        (logDerivativeResponse (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc)) ↔
      ∀ i : ℕ, (zeroLoc i).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hstrict
    let Hluc : HadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData zeroLoc
        (natHadamardFiniteExhaustion H) :=
      natHadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData H
    have hanalytic :
        AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) Set.univ := by
      have hdifferentiable :
          Differentiable ℂ (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) :=
        fun z => Hluc.infinite_differentiableAt (Set.mem_univ z)
      intro z _hz
      exact hdifferentiable.analyticAt z
    have hnontrivial :
        ∃ z : ℂ, infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc z ≠ 0 := by
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [infiniteHadamardProduct_zero]
      exact one_ne_zero
    have hroots := entire_function_roots_real_of_analytic_nontrivial
      (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) hanalytic hnontrivial
      (fun z hz _hz_nonzero => hstrict.antiHerglotz z hz) h_schwarz
    intro i
    exact hroots (zeroLoc i)
      (infiniteHadamardProduct_eq_zero_at_zeroLoc H.zero_ne i)
  · intro hreal
    exact infiniteHadamardProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_of_zero_sequence_real
      zeroLoc H hreal

name: OverflowResidueRH.tprod_reindex_bool_pairs
statement:
private theorem tprod_reindex_bool_pairs
    {ι κ : Type*} (f : ι → ℂ) (e : κ × Bool ≃ ι)
    (hf : Multipliable f) :
    (∏' i : ι, f i) =
      ∏' j : κ, (f (e (j, false)) * f (e (j, true)))
proof:
:= by
  let g : κ × Bool → ℂ := fun p ↦ f (e p)
  have hg : Multipliable g := (e.multipliable_iff).2 hf
  have hgb : ∀ j : κ, Multipliable (fun b : Bool ↦ g (j, b)) := by
    intro j
    exact Multipliable.of_finite
  calc
    (∏' i : ι, f i) = ∏' p : κ × Bool, g p :=
      (e.tprod_eq f).symm
    _ = ∏' j : κ, ∏' b : Bool, g (j, b) := hg.tprod_prod' hgb
    _ = ∏' j : κ, (f (e (j, false)) * f (e (j, true))) := by
      simp only [tprod_bool, g]

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardNegationPairingData.infiniteHadamardProduct_eq_paired
statement:
theorem HadamardNegationPairingData.infiniteHadamardProduct_eq_paired
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardNegationPairingData zeroLoc)
    (Hinv : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc) (z : ℂ) :
    infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc z =
      pairedQuadraticProduct H.repLoc z
proof:
:= by
  unfold infiniteHadamardProduct pairedQuadraticProduct
  rw [tprod_reindex_bool_pairs
    (fun i ↦ hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) z) H.pairEquiv
    (Hinv.product_multipliable z)]
  apply tprod_congr
  intro j
  dsimp [HadamardNegationPairingData.repLoc]
  rw [H.loc_true]
  exact hadamardGenus1Factor_mul_neg_location
    (Hinv.zero_ne (H.pairEquiv (j, false)))

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardNegationPairingData.repLoc_normProper
statement:
theorem HadamardNegationPairingData.repLoc_normProper
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (P : HadamardNegationPairingData zeroLoc)
    (H : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) :
    HadamardZeroNormProper P.repLoc
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro R
  let e : P.half → ι := fun j ↦ P.pairEquiv (j, false)
  have he : Function.Injective e := by
    intro j k hjk
    have hp : (j, false) = (k, false) := P.pairEquiv.injective hjk
    exact congrArg Prod.fst hp
  exact (H.finite_norm_le R).preimage he.injOn

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardNegationPairingData.repLoc_invSqSummability
statement:
theorem HadamardNegationPairingData.repLoc_invSqSummability
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (P : HadamardNegationPairingData zeroLoc)
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) :
    HadamardZeroInvSqSummability P.repLoc where
  zero_ne j
proof:
:= H.zero_ne (P.pairEquiv (j, false))
  inv_sq_summable := by
    let e : P.half → ι := fun j ↦ P.pairEquiv (j, false)
    have he : Function.Injective e := by
      intro j k hjk
      have hp : (j, false) = (k, false) := P.pairEquiv.injective hjk
      exact congrArg Prod.fst hp
    simpa [HadamardNegationPairingData.repLoc, Function.comp_def] using
      H.inv_sq_summable.comp_injective he
  eventually_large := (P.repLoc_normProper Hproper).eventually_large

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardNegationPairingData.repLoc_dyadicBallCard_le
statement:
theorem HadamardNegationPairingData.repLoc_dyadicBallCard_le
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (P : HadamardNegationPairingData zeroLoc)
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) (n : ℕ) :
    hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard P.repLoc n ≤
      hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard zeroLoc n
proof:
:= by
  let f : {j : P.half // ‖P.repLoc j‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n} →
      {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n} :=
    fun j ↦ ⟨P.pairEquiv (j.1, false), j.2⟩
  letI : Finite {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n} :=
    Hproper.finite_norm_le ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)
  unfold hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard
  exact Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f (by
    intro j k hjk
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hp : (j.1, false) = (k.1, false) :=
      P.pairEquiv.injective (congrArg Subtype.val hjk)
    exact congrArg Prod.fst hp)

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardNegationPairingData.dyadicBallCard_eq_two_mul_repLoc
statement:
theorem HadamardNegationPairingData.dyadicBallCard_eq_two_mul_repLoc
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (P : HadamardNegationPairingData zeroLoc) (n : ℕ) :
    hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard zeroLoc n =
      2 * hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard P.repLoc n
proof:
:= by
  unfold hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard
  calc
    Nat.card {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n} =
        Nat.card ({j : P.half // ‖P.repLoc j‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n} × Bool) :=
      Nat.card_congr (P.repLocBallProdBoolEquiv ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)).symm
    _ = Nat.card {j : P.half // ‖P.repLoc j‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n} *
        Nat.card Bool := Nat.card_prod _ _
    _ = 2 * Nat.card {j : P.half // ‖P.repLoc j‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n} := by
      simp [Nat.mul_comm]

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_pairedQuadraticFactor_le_exp_linear
statement:
theorem norm_pairedQuadraticFactor_le_exp_linear
    {ρ z : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) :
    ‖1 - (z / ρ) ^ 2‖ ≤ Real.exp (4 * ‖z‖ / ‖ρ‖)
proof:
:= by
  have hid := hadamardGenus1Factor_mul_neg_location (ρ := ρ) (z := z) hρ
  rw [← hid, norm_mul]
  have hpos : 0 ≤ Real.exp (2 * ‖z‖ / ‖ρ‖) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  calc
    ‖hadamardGenus1Factor ρ z‖ * ‖hadamardGenus1Factor (-ρ) z‖ ≤
        Real.exp (2 * ‖z‖ / ‖ρ‖) *
          Real.exp (2 * ‖z‖ / ‖-ρ‖) := by
      exact mul_le_mul
        (norm_hadamardGenus1Factor_le_exp_linear ρ z)
        (norm_hadamardGenus1Factor_le_exp_linear (-ρ) z)
        (norm_nonneg _) hpos
    _ = Real.exp (4 * ‖z‖ / ‖ρ‖) := by
      rw [norm_neg, ← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_pairedQuadraticFactor_le_exp_quadratic
statement:
theorem norm_pairedQuadraticFactor_le_exp_quadratic
    (ρ z : ℂ) :
    ‖1 - (z / ρ) ^ 2‖ ≤
      Real.exp (‖z‖ ^ 2 * (‖ρ‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have htriangle : ‖1 - (z / ρ) ^ 2‖ ≤ 1 + ‖z / ρ‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖1 - (z / ρ) ^ 2‖ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖(z / ρ) ^ 2‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = 1 + ‖z / ρ‖ ^ 2 := by rw [norm_pow]; norm_num
  have hshape : ‖z / ρ‖ ^ 2 = ‖z‖ ^ 2 * (‖ρ‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [norm_div, div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [hshape] at htriangle
  exact htriangle.trans (by
    simpa [add_comm] using
      Real.add_one_le_exp (‖z‖ ^ 2 * (‖ρ‖ ^ 2)⁻¹))

name: OverflowResidueRH.multipliable_pairedQuadraticFactor
statement:
theorem multipliable_pairedQuadraticFactor
    {κ : Type*} {repLoc : κ → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability repLoc) (z : ℂ) :
    Multipliable (fun j : κ ↦ 1 - (z / repLoc j) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let a : κ → ℂ := fun j ↦ -(z / repLoc j) ^ 2
  have hnorm : Summable (fun j : κ ↦ ‖a j‖) := by
    have h := H.inv_sq_summable.mul_left (‖z‖ ^ 2)
    apply h.congr
    intro j
    dsimp [a]
    rw [norm_neg, norm_pow, norm_div, div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]
  have ha : Summable a := Summable.of_norm hnorm
  have hm := Complex.multipliable_one_add_of_summable ha
  simpa [a, sub_eq_add_neg] using hm

name: OverflowResidueRH.pow_two_le_exp_nat
statement:
private theorem pow_two_le_exp_nat (m : ℕ) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ m ≤ Real.exp (m : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (2 : ℝ) ^ m ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ m := by
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) Real.exp_one_gt_two.le m
    _ = Real.exp (m : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      norm_num

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_pairedQuadraticFactor_le_exp_dyadicShell
statement:
theorem norm_pairedQuadraticFactor_le_exp_dyadicShell
    {κ : Type*} {repLoc : κ → ℂ} (j : κ) (z : ℂ)
    (K n : ℕ) (hn_one : 1 ≤ n) (hnK : n ≤ K)
    (hbin : hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j = n)
    (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ K) :
    ‖1 - (z / repLoc j) ^ 2‖ ≤
      Real.exp (3 * (((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let d : ℕ := K - n
  have hKd : n + d = K := by omega
  have hlower :=
    pow_two_pred_lt_norm_of_hadamardZeroDyadicBin_eq hn_one hbin
  have hρpos : 0 < ‖repLoc j‖ := (by positivity : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)).trans hlower
  have hratio : ‖z / repLoc j‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) := by
    rw [norm_div, div_le_iff₀ hρpos]
    calc
      ‖z‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ K := hz
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) := by
        rw [← pow_add]
        congr 2
        omega
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) * ‖repLoc j‖ := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlower.le (by positivity)
  have htriangle : ‖1 - (z / repLoc j) ^ 2‖ ≤
      1 + ((2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1)) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖1 - (z / repLoc j) ^ 2‖ ≤
          ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖(z / repLoc j) ^ 2‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = 1 + ‖z / repLoc j‖ ^ 2 := by rw [norm_pow]; norm_num
      _ ≤ 1 + ((2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1)) ^ 2 := by gcongr
  have hpow :
      1 + ((2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1)) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (d + 1) + 1) := by
    have heq : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1)) ^ 2 =
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (d + 1)) := by
      have hd : (d + 1) + (d + 1) = 2 * (d + 1) := by omega
      rw [pow_two, ← pow_add, hd]
    rw [heq]
    have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (d + 1)) :=
      one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    rw [pow_succ]
    nlinarith
  have hexp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (d + 1) + 1) ≤
      Real.exp (3 * ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    calc
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * (d + 1) + 1) ≤
          Real.exp ((2 * (d + 1) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        pow_two_le_exp_nat _
      _ ≤ Real.exp (3 * ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        exact_mod_cast (show 2 * (d + 1) + 1 ≤ 3 * (d + 1) by omega)
  change ‖1 - (z / repLoc j) ^ 2‖ ≤
    Real.exp (3 * (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
  exact htriangle.trans (hpow.trans hexp)

name: OverflowResidueRH.hasSum_succ_mul_half
statement:
private lemma hasSum_succ_mul_half :
    HasSum (fun d : ℕ ↦ ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ d) 4
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := hasSum_coe_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one
    (𝕜 := ℝ) (r := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num)
  have hgeom :=
    hasSum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (K := ℝ) (ξ := (1 / 2 : ℝ))
      (by norm_num)
  have hadd := hnat.add hgeom
  norm_num at hadd
  simpa [Nat.cast_add, add_mul] using hadd

name: OverflowResidueRH.pow_two_sub_eq_mul_half
statement:
private lemma pow_two_sub_eq_mul_half
    (K d : ℕ) (hd : d ≤ K) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (K - d) = (2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_sub₀ (2 : ℝ) (by norm_num) hd, ← inv_pow]
  norm_num

name: OverflowResidueRH.sum_dyadicPairedShellWeight_le
statement:
theorem sum_dyadicPairedShellWeight_le (K : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
        (((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (2 : ℝ) ^ n)) ≤
      4 * ((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦
    ((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect f (K + 1)]
  have hterm : ∀ d ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
      f (K + 1 - 1 - d) ≤
        (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K) *
          (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ d) := by
    intro d hdmem
    have hd : d ≤ K := by simpa [Finset.mem_range] using hdmem
    have hback : K - (K - d) = d := Nat.sub_sub_self hd
    have hindex : ((K - d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.sub_le K d) 1
    dsimp [f]
    rw [hback, pow_two_sub_eq_mul_half K d hd]
    calc
      ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((K - d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ d) =
          ((K - d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ K * (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ d)) := by
        ring
      _ ≤ ((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ K * (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ d)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hindex (by positivity)
      _ = (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K) *
            (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ d) := by ring
  calc
    (∑ d ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), f (K + 1 - 1 - d)) ≤
        ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
          (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K) *
            (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ d) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K) *
        ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
          (((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ d) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K) * 4 := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      · exact (hasSum_succ_mul_half.summable.sum_le_tsum _
          (fun _ _ ↦ by positivity)).trans_eq hasSum_succ_mul_half.tsum_eq
      · positivity
    _ = 4 * ((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.sum_dyadicPairedShellDistance_le
statement:
theorem sum_dyadicPairedShellDistance_le (K : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), ((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), ((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ _n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), ((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro n hn
      exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.sub_le K n) 1
    _ = (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      push_cast
      ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardZeroDyadicShellCard_le_ballCard
statement:
theorem hadamardZeroDyadicShellCard_le_ballCard
    {κ : Type*} {repLoc : κ → ℂ}
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper repLoc) (n : ℕ) :
    hadamardZeroDyadicShellCard repLoc n ≤
      hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard repLoc n
proof:
:= by
  let f : {j : κ // hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j = n} →
      {j : κ // ‖repLoc j‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n} :=
    fun j ↦ ⟨j.1, by
      simpa [j.2] using hadamardZero_norm_le_pow_two_dyadicBin repLoc j.1⟩
  letI : Finite {j : κ // ‖repLoc j‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n} :=
    Hproper.finite_norm_le ((2 : ℝ) ^ n)
  unfold hadamardZeroDyadicShellCard hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard
  exact Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f (by
    intro j k hjk
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg
      (fun x : {j : κ // ‖repLoc j‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n} ↦ x.1) hjk))

name: OverflowResidueRH.sum_hadamardZeroDyadicHead_weight_eq_shellCard
statement:
theorem sum_hadamardZeroDyadicHead_weight_eq_shellCard
    {κ : Type*} {repLoc : κ → ℂ}
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper repLoc) (K : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ j ∈ hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset Hproper K,
        w (hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j)) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
        (hadamardZeroDyadicShellCard repLoc n : ℝ) * w n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset Hproper K
  have hmaps : ∀ j ∈ F,
      hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j ∈ Finset.range (K + 1) := by
    intro j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    have hj' : hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j ≤ K := by
      simpa [F] using hj
    omega
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n hn
  have hnK : n ≤ K := by
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hn
    omega
  haveI : Fintype {j : κ // hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j = n} :=
    (hadamardZeroDyadicBin_finite Hproper n).fintype
  unfold hadamardZeroDyadicShellCard
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  change (∑ j ∈ F with hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j = n,
      w (hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j)) =
    (Fintype.card {j : κ // hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j = n} : ℝ) * w n
  calc
    (∑ j ∈ F with hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j = n,
        w (hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j)) =
        ∑ _j : {j : κ // hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j = n}, w n := by
      refine Finset.sum_bij
        (fun j hj ↦
          (⟨j, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hj).2⟩ :
            {j : κ // hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j = n})) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro j hj
        simp
      · intro j₁ hj₁ j₂ hj₂ heq
        exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
      · intro j hj
        refine ⟨j.1, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Finset.mem_filter]
          refine ⟨?_, j.2⟩
          rw [mem_hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset]
          simpa [j.2] using hnK
        · exact Subtype.ext (by rfl)
      · intro j hj
        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hj).2]
    _ = (Fintype.card {j : κ // hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j = n} : ℝ) *
        w n := by simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.sum_pairedHighWeight_le
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.sum_pairedHighWeight_le
    {κ : Type*} {repLoc : κ → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData repLoc)
    (K : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset H.normProper K,
        if max 1 H.lower ≤ hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j then
          3 * (((K - hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
        else 0) ≤
      12 * H.C * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K +
        3 * H.C₀ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := max 1 H.lower
  let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun n ↦
    if L ≤ n then 3 * (((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) else 0
  rw [show (∑ j ∈ hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset H.normProper K,
      if max 1 H.lower ≤ hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j then
        3 * (((K - hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) else 0) =
      ∑ j ∈ hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset H.normProper K,
        w (hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j) by rfl]
  rw [sum_hadamardZeroDyadicHead_weight_eq_shellCard H.normProper K w]
  have hpoint : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
      (hadamardZeroDyadicShellCard repLoc n : ℝ) * w n ≤
        3 * (((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
          (H.C * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n + H.C₀) := by
    intro n hn
    have hnK : n ≤ K := by simpa [Finset.mem_range] using hn
    by_cases hnL : L ≤ n
    · have hshellNat := hadamardZeroDyadicShellCard_le_ballCard H.normProper n
      have hshell : (hadamardZeroDyadicShellCard repLoc n : ℝ) ≤
          (hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard repLoc n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hshellNat
      have hcount := H.count_le n ((le_max_right 1 H.lower).trans hnL)
      have hcard := hshell.trans hcount
      dsimp [w]
      rw [if_pos hnL]
      have hw0 : 0 ≤ 3 * (((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
        mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard hw0
      simpa [mul_comm] using hmul
    · dsimp [w]
      rw [if_neg hnL]
      have hright : 0 ≤
          3 * (((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
            (H.C * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n + H.C₀) := by
        exact mul_nonneg
          (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
          (add_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg
              (mul_nonneg H.C_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) (by positivity))
            H.C₀_nonneg)
      simpa using hright
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
        (hadamardZeroDyadicShellCard repLoc n : ℝ) * w n) ≤
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
          3 * (((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
            (H.C * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ n + H.C₀) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hpoint
    _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
          (3 * H.C *
            (((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              (2 : ℝ) ^ n) +
          3 * H.C₀ * ((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n hn
      ring
    _ = 3 * H.C *
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
            (((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
              (2 : ℝ) ^ n)) +
        3 * H.C₀ *
          (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
            ((K - n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ 3 * H.C *
          (4 * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K) +
        3 * H.C₀ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
      exact add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_dyadicPairedShellWeight_le K)
          (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C_nonneg))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_dyadicPairedShellDistance_le K)
          (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C₀_nonneg))
    _ = 12 * H.C * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K +
        3 * H.C₀ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.sum_dyadicHead_lowInv_eq_lowInvMass
statement:
theorem sum_dyadicHead_lowInv_eq_lowInvMass
    {κ : Type*} {repLoc : κ → ℂ}
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper repLoc)
    (L K : ℕ) (hL : 1 ≤ L) (hLK : L ≤ K) :
    (∑ j ∈ hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset Hproper K,
        if hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j < L then ‖repLoc j‖⁻¹ else 0) =
      hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass repLoc L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let FK := hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset Hproper K
  let FL := hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset Hproper (L - 1)
  have hLm : L - 1 < L := by omega
  have hsub : FL ⊆ FK := by
    intro j hj
    rw [mem_hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset] at hj ⊢
    exact hj.trans (hLm.le.trans hLK)
  have hzero : ∀ j ∈ FK, j ∉ FL →
      (if hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j < L then ‖repLoc j‖⁻¹ else 0) = 0 := by
    intro j hjK hjnot
    rw [mem_hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset] at hjnot
    have hnotlt : ¬ hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j < L := by
      intro hlt
      exact hjnot (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hlt)
    rw [if_neg hnotlt]
  calc
    (∑ j ∈ FK,
        if hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j < L then ‖repLoc j‖⁻¹ else 0) =
        ∑ j ∈ FL,
          (if hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j < L then ‖repLoc j‖⁻¹ else 0) :=
      (Finset.sum_subset hsub hzero).symm
    _ = ∑ j ∈ FL, ‖repLoc j‖⁻¹ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [mem_hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset] at hj
      rw [if_pos (lt_of_le_of_lt hj hLm)]
    _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range ((L - 1) + 1),
        hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass repLoc n :=
      sum_hadamardZeroDyadicHead_inv_eq_sum_shellInvMass Hproper (L - 1)
    _ = hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass repLoc L := by
      unfold hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hL]

name: OverflowResidueRH.tsum_compl_dyadicHead_invSq_eq_tail
statement:
theorem tsum_compl_dyadicHead_invSq_eq_tail
    {κ : Type*} {repLoc : κ → ℂ}
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper repLoc) (K : ℕ) :
    (∑' j : {j : κ // j ∉ hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset Hproper K},
        (‖repLoc j.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) =
      ∑' j : {j : κ // K < hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j},
        (‖repLoc j.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let e : {j : κ // j ∉ hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset Hproper K} ≃
      {j : κ // K < hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j} := {
    toFun j := ⟨j.1, by
      rw [← Nat.not_le]
      simpa using j.2⟩
    invFun j := ⟨j.1, by
      rw [mem_hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset]
      exact Nat.not_le_of_lt j.2⟩
    left_inv j := Subtype.ext rfl
    right_inv j := Subtype.ext rfl }
  simpa [e] using
    (e.tsum_eq
      (fun j : {j : κ // K < hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j} ↦
        (‖repLoc j.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹))

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.norm_pairedQuadraticProduct_le_exp_raw
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.norm_pairedQuadraticProduct_le_exp_raw
    {κ : Type*} {repLoc : κ → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData repLoc)
    (K : ℕ) (hK : max 1 H.lower ≤ K)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ K) :
    ‖pairedQuadraticProduct repLoc z‖ ≤
      Real.exp
        (4 * ‖z‖ * hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass repLoc (max 1 H.lower) +
          (12 * H.C * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K +
            3 * H.C₀ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)) +
          ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
            (4 * H.C * (((K + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ K) +
              4 * H.C₀ * ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ K)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := max 1 H.lower
  let F := hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset H.normProper K
  let b : κ → ℝ := fun j ↦
    if hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j < L then 4 * ‖z‖ / ‖repLoc j‖
    else if hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j ≤ K then
      3 * (((K - hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
    else ‖z‖ ^ 2 * (‖repLoc j‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
  have hmul : Multipliable (fun j : κ ↦ 1 - (z / repLoc j) ^ 2) :=
    multipliable_pairedQuadraticFactor H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability z
  have hb : Summable b := by
    apply Summable.add_compl (s := F) Summable.of_finite
    have htail := (H.invSq_summable.subtype (fun j ↦ j ∉ F)).mul_left (‖z‖ ^ 2)
    apply htail.congr
    intro j
    have hjK : ¬ hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j.1 ≤ K := by
      simpa [F, mem_hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset] using j.2
    have hjL : ¬ hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j.1 < L := by
      intro hjlt
      exact hjK ((Nat.le_of_lt hjlt).trans hK)
    simp [b, hjL, hjK]
  have hb_nonneg : ∀ j, 0 ≤ b j := by
    intro j
    dsimp [b]
    split_ifs <;> positivity
  have hfactor : ∀ j,
      ‖1 - (z / repLoc j) ^ 2‖ ≤ Real.exp (b j) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hjL : hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j < L
    · simp only [b, if_pos hjL]
      exact norm_pairedQuadraticFactor_le_exp_linear (H.zero_ne j)
    · have hjL' : L ≤ hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j := Nat.le_of_not_gt hjL
      by_cases hjK : hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j ≤ K
      · simp only [b, if_neg hjL, if_pos hjK]
        exact norm_pairedQuadraticFactor_le_exp_dyadicShell j z K
          (hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j)
          ((le_max_left 1 H.lower).trans hjL') hjK rfl hz
      · simp only [b, if_neg hjL, if_neg hjK]
        exact norm_pairedQuadraticFactor_le_exp_quadratic (repLoc j) z
  have hmajor := norm_tprod_le_exp_tsum hmul hb hb_nonneg hfactor
  have hhead_eq :
      (∑ j ∈ F, b j) =
        4 * ‖z‖ *
          (∑ j ∈ F,
            if hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j < L then ‖repLoc j‖⁻¹ else 0) +
        ∑ j ∈ F,
          (if L ≤ hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j then
            3 * (((K - hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
          else 0) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hjK : hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j ≤ K := by
      simpa [F] using hj
    by_cases hjL : hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j < L
    · have hnL : ¬ L ≤ hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j := Nat.not_le_of_lt hjL
      simp [b, hjL, hnL, div_eq_mul_inv]
    · have hLj : L ≤ hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j := Nat.le_of_not_gt hjL
      simp [b, hjL, hLj, hjK]
  have hlow_eq :
      (∑ j ∈ F,
        if hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j < L then ‖repLoc j‖⁻¹ else 0) =
        hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass repLoc L := by
    simpa [F, L] using sum_dyadicHead_lowInv_eq_lowInvMass
      H.normProper L K (le_max_left 1 H.lower) hK
  have hhigh :
      (∑ j ∈ F,
          (if L ≤ hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j then
            3 * (((K - hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
          else 0)) ≤
        12 * H.C * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K +
          3 * H.C₀ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    simpa [F, L] using H.sum_pairedHighWeight_le K
  have hhead :
      (∑ j ∈ F, b j) ≤
        4 * ‖z‖ * hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass repLoc L +
          (12 * H.C * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K +
            3 * H.C₀ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)) := by
    rw [hhead_eq, hlow_eq]
    linarith
  have htail_eq :
      (∑' j : {j : κ // j ∉ F}, b j.1) =
        ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
          ∑' j : {j : κ // K < hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j},
            (‖repLoc j.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    calc
      (∑' j : {j : κ // j ∉ F}, b j.1) =
          ∑' j : {j : κ // j ∉ F},
            ‖z‖ ^ 2 * (‖repLoc j.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        apply tsum_congr
        intro j
        have hjK : ¬ hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j.1 ≤ K := by
          simpa [F, mem_hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset] using j.2
        have hjL : ¬ hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j.1 < L := by
          intro hjlt
          exact hjK ((Nat.le_of_lt hjlt).trans hK)
        simp [b, hjL, hjK]
      _ = ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
          ∑' j : {j : κ // j ∉ F}, (‖repLoc j.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        rw [tsum_mul_left]
      _ = ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
          ∑' j : {j : κ // K < hadamardZeroDyadicBin repLoc j},
            (‖repLoc j.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        rw [show F = hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset H.normProper K by rfl,
          tsum_compl_dyadicHead_invSq_eq_tail H.normProper K]
  have htailBase := H.tailInvSqMass_le K
    ((le_max_right 1 H.lower).trans hK)
  have htail :
      (∑' j : {j : κ // j ∉ F}, b j.1) ≤
        ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
          (4 * H.C * (((K + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ K) +
            4 * H.C₀ * ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ K)) := by
    rw [htail_eq]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htailBase (by positivity)
  have htsum := hb.sum_add_tsum_subtype_compl F
  have hexponent : (∑' j, b j) ≤
      4 * ‖z‖ * hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass repLoc L +
        (12 * H.C * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K +
          3 * H.C₀ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)) +
        ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
          (4 * H.C * (((K + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ K) +
            4 * H.C₀ * ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ K)) := by
    rw [← htsum]
    exact add_le_add hhead htail
  change ‖∏' j : κ, (1 - (z / repLoc j) ^ 2)‖ ≤ _
  exact hmajor.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by simpa [L] using hexponent))

name: OverflowResidueRH.paired_sq_mul_half_pow_le_self
statement:
private lemma paired_sq_mul_half_pow_le_self
    (r : ℝ) (K : ℕ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr : r ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ K) :
    r ^ 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ K ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  have hpowpos : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ K := by positivity
  have hpow : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ K = ((2 : ℝ) ^ K)⁻¹ := by
    rw [div_pow]
    norm_num
  have hratio : r * ((2 : ℝ) ^ K)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [mul_inv_le_iff₀ hpowpos]
    simpa using hr
  rw [hpow]
  calc
    r ^ 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ K)⁻¹ = r * (r * ((2 : ℝ) ^ K)⁻¹) := by ring
    _ ≤ r * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio hr0
    _ = r := mul_one r

name: OverflowResidueRH.paired_sq_mul_quarter_pow_le_self
statement:
private lemma paired_sq_mul_quarter_pow_le_self
    (r : ℝ) (K : ℕ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr : r ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ K) :
    r ^ 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ K ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  calc
    r ^ 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ K ≤ r ^ 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ K := by
      gcongr
      norm_num
    _ ≤ r := paired_sq_mul_half_pow_le_self r K hr0 hr

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.norm_pairedQuadraticProduct_le_exp_rLogR
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.norm_pairedQuadraticProduct_le_exp_rLogR
    {κ : Type*} {repLoc : κ → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData repLoc)
    (K : ℕ) (hK : max 1 H.lower ≤ K)
    (z : ℂ)
    (hzlow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (K - 1) ≤ ‖z‖)
    (hzup : ‖z‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ K) :
    ‖pairedQuadraticProduct repLoc z‖ ≤
      Real.exp
        ((4 * hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass repLoc (max 1 H.lower) +
            32 * H.C + 8 * H.C₀) *
          ‖z‖ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hraw := H.norm_pairedQuadraticProduct_le_exp_raw K hK z hzup
  apply hraw.trans
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  let r : ℝ := ‖z‖
  let low : ℝ := hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass repLoc (max 1 H.lower)
  have hKone : 1 ≤ K := (le_max_left 1 H.lower).trans hK
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := norm_nonneg _
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (K - 1) := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    exact this.trans (by simpa [r] using hzlow)
  have hpow2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ K ≤ 2 * r := by
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hKone)
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ] at hzlow ⊢
    nlinarith
  have hkpowNat : K + 1 ≤ 2 ^ K := Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr K.lt_two_pow_self
  have hkpow : (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ K := by
    exact_mod_cast hkpowNat
  have hhalf : r ^ 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ K ≤ r :=
    paired_sq_mul_half_pow_le_self r K hr0 (by simpa [r] using hzup)
  have hquarter : r ^ 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ K ≤ r :=
    paired_sq_mul_quarter_pow_le_self r K hr0 (by simpa [r] using hzup)
  have hk3 : (((K + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show K + 3 ≤ 2 * (K + 1) by omega)
  have hhighC :
      12 * H.C * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K ≤
        24 * H.C * r * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    have hm :
        (12 * H.C * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K ≤
          (12 * H.C * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) * (2 * r) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow2
        (mul_nonneg
          (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C_nonneg) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    nlinarith
  have hhighC₀ :
      3 * H.C₀ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) ≤
        6 * H.C₀ * r * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    have hkp := hkpow.trans hpow2
    have hm :
        (3 * H.C₀ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
          (3 * H.C₀ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) * (2 * r) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkp
        (mul_nonneg
          (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C₀_nonneg) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    nlinarith
  have htailC :
      r ^ 2 * (4 * H.C *
        (((K + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ K)) ≤
        8 * H.C * r * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    have hm :
        (4 * H.C * r) * (((K + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
          (4 * H.C * r) * (2 * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk3
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C_nonneg) hr0)
    have ht :
        (4 * H.C * (((K + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ))) *
            (r ^ 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ K) ≤
          (4 * H.C * (((K + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ))) * r :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhalf
        (mul_nonneg
          (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C_nonneg) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    nlinarith
  have htailC₀ :
      r ^ 2 * (4 * H.C₀ * ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ K)) ≤
        2 * H.C₀ * r * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    have hkcast : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_pos K)
    have hrk : r ≤ r * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
      nlinarith
    have hm : (4 / 3 : ℝ) * H.C₀ * r ≤
        (4 / 3 : ℝ) * H.C₀ * (r * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrk
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C₀_nonneg)
    have ht : (4 / 3 : ℝ) * H.C₀ *
        (r ^ 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ K) ≤ (4 / 3 : ℝ) * H.C₀ * r :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hquarter
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C₀_nonneg)
    nlinarith
  change
    4 * r * low +
        (12 * H.C * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * (2 : ℝ) ^ K +
          3 * H.C₀ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)) +
        r ^ 2 *
          (4 * H.C * (((K + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ K) +
            4 * H.C₀ * ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ K)) ≤
      (4 * low + 32 * H.C + 8 * H.C₀) * r * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
  have hlow0 : 0 ≤ low := hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass_nonneg _ _
  have hkcast : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_pos K)
  have hlow : 4 * r * low ≤ 4 * low * r * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    have hm : 4 * low * r * 1 ≤
        4 * low * r * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkcast
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hlow0) hr0)
    nlinarith
  nlinarith [hhighC, hhighC₀, htailC, htailC₀]

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.log_norm_pairedQuadraticProduct_le_rLogR
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.log_norm_pairedQuadraticProduct_le_rLogR
    {κ : Type*} {repLoc : κ → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData repLoc)
    (K : ℕ) (hK : max 1 H.lower ≤ K)
    (z : ℂ)
    (hzlow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (K - 1) ≤ ‖z‖)
    (hzup : ‖z‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ K) :
    Real.log ‖pairedQuadraticProduct repLoc z‖ ≤
      (4 * hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass repLoc (max 1 H.lower) +
          32 * H.C + 8 * H.C₀) *
        ‖z‖ * (((K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : pairedQuadraticProduct repLoc z = 0
  · rw [hp, norm_zero, Real.log_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg
        (add_nonneg
          (add_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
              (hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass_nonneg repLoc (max 1 H.lower)))
            (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C_nonneg))
          (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C₀_nonneg))
        (norm_nonneg z))
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  · exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (norm_pos_iff.mpr hp)).2
      (H.norm_pairedQuadraticProduct_le_exp_rLogR K hK z hzlow hzup)

name: OverflowResidueRH.expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity_analyticOrderAt_zero
statement:
theorem expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity_analyticOrderAt_zero
    (m : ℕ) {C a b : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ) (H : NatHadamardZeroInvSqData zeroLoc) :
    analyticOrderAt
      (expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity m C a b zeroLoc) 0 =
        (m : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  let Hgen : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc :=
    H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability
  let Hluc : HadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData zeroLoc
      (natHadamardFiniteExhaustion Hgen) :=
    natHadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData Hgen
  have hbase_differentiable :
      Differentiable ℂ (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc) := by
    intro z
    unfold expAffineGenusOneProduct
    exact ((by fun_prop :
      DifferentiableAt ℂ
        (fun w : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * w)) z).mul
          (Hluc.infinite_differentiableAt (Set.mem_univ z)))
  have hbase_analytic :
      AnalyticAt ℂ (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc) 0 :=
    hbase_differentiable.analyticAt 0
  have hbase_ne :
      expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc 0 ≠ 0 := by
    unfold expAffineGenusOneProduct
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero hC (Complex.exp_ne_zero _))
      (Hgen.infiniteProduct_ne_zero (fun i => (H.zero_ne i).symm))
  have hfull_differentiable :
      Differentiable ℂ
        (expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
          m C a b zeroLoc) := by
    intro z
    unfold expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
    exact (by fun_prop :
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w ^ m) z).mul
        (hbase_differentiable z)
  have hfull_analytic :
      AnalyticAt ℂ
        (expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
          m C a b zeroLoc) 0 :=
    hfull_differentiable.analyticAt 0
  rw [hfull_analytic.analyticOrderAt_eq_natCast]
  refine ⟨expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc,
    hbase_analytic, hbase_ne, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards with z
  simp [expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity]

statement:

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
    {m : ℕ} {C a b : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0)
    {zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    {z : ℂ} (hz0 : z ≠ 0) (hz : ∀ i : ℕ, z ≠ zeroLoc i) :
    logDerivativeResponse
        (expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
          m C a b zeroLoc) z =
      (m : ℂ) / z + b +
        logDerivativeResponse (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) z
proof:
:= by
  let Hluc : HadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData zeroLoc
      (natHadamardFiniteExhaustion H) :=
    natHadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData H
  have hpow_diff :
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w ^ m) z := by fun_prop
  have hbase_diff :
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc) z := by
    unfold expAffineGenusOneProduct
    exact (by fun_prop :
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * w)) z).mul
        (Hluc.infinite_differentiableAt (Set.mem_univ z))
  have hbase_ne : expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc z ≠ 0 := by
    unfold expAffineGenusOneProduct
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero hC (Complex.exp_ne_zero _))
      (H.infiniteProduct_ne_zero hz)
  unfold expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
  rw [logDerivativeResponse_mul_eq_add
      hpow_diff hbase_diff (pow_ne_zero m hz0) hbase_ne,
    logDerivativeResponse_pow_id,
    logDerivativeResponse_expAffineGenusOneProduct hC H hz]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.exists_point_away_from_origin_and_zero_sequence
statement:
private theorem exists_point_away_from_origin_and_zero_sequence
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ∃ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, z ≠ zeroLoc i
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set ℂ := Set.range zeroLoc ∪ {0}
  have hS_countable : S.Countable :=
    (Set.countable_range zeroLoc).union (Set.countable_singleton 0)
  have hS_ne_univ : S ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro hS
    apply not_countable_complex
    rw [← hS]
    exact hS_countable
  have hexists : ∃ z : ℂ, z ∉ S := by
    by_contra h
    apply hS_ne_univ
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro z
    by_contra hz
    exact h ⟨z, hz⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hexists
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hz0
    apply hz
    right
    simp [hz0]
  · intro i hzi
    apply hz
    left
    exact ⟨i, hzi.symm⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.expAffineGenusOneProduct_schwarz_of_withOriginMultiplicity_schwarz
statement:
private theorem expAffineGenusOneProduct_schwarz_of_withOriginMultiplicity_schwarz
    (m : ℕ) {C a b : ℂ} (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ)
    (H : NatHadamardZeroInvSqData zeroLoc)
    (h_schwarz : ∀ z : ℂ,
      expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
          m C a b zeroLoc (star z) =
        star (expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
          m C a b zeroLoc z)) :
    ∀ z : ℂ,
      expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc (star z) =
        star (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc z)
proof:
:= by
  let Hgen : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc :=
    H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability
  let Hluc : HadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData zeroLoc
      (natHadamardFiniteExhaustion Hgen) :=
    natHadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData Hgen
  have hbase_continuous :
      Continuous (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc) := by
    refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun z => ?_)
    unfold expAffineGenusOneProduct
    exact ((by fun_prop :
        DifferentiableAt ℂ
          (fun w : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * w)) z).mul
            (Hluc.infinite_differentiableAt (Set.mem_univ z))).continuousAt
  have hpunctured : ∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 →
      expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc (star z) =
        star (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc z) := by
    intro z hz
    have hfull := h_schwarz z
    unfold expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity at hfull
    simp only [star_mul', star_pow] at hfull
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero m (star_ne_zero.mpr hz)) hfull
  intro z
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst z
    have hleft :
        Tendsto
          (fun w : ℂ =>
            expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc (star w))
          (𝓝[≠] 0)
          (𝓝 (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc (star 0))) :=
      (hbase_continuous.comp continuous_star).continuousAt.mono_left inf_le_left
    have hright :
        Tendsto
          (fun w : ℂ =>
            star (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc w))
          (𝓝[≠] 0)
          (𝓝 (star (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc 0))) :=
      (continuous_star.comp hbase_continuous).continuousAt.mono_left inf_le_left
    have heq :
        (fun w : ℂ =>
          expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc (star w)) =ᶠ[𝓝[≠] 0]
        (fun w : ℂ =>
          star (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc w)) := by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with w hw
      exact hpunctured w (by simpa using hw)
    simpa using tendsto_nhds_unique_of_eventuallyEq hleft hright heq
  · exact hpunctured z hz

    (m : ℕ) {C a b : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ) (H : NatHadamardZeroInvSqData zeroLoc)

name: OverflowResidueRH.expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_zeros_real
statement:
theorem
    expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_zeros_real
    (m : ℕ) {C a b : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0) (hb : b.im = 0)
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ)
    (H : NatHadamardZeroInvSqData zeroLoc)
    (h_schwarz : ∀ z : ℂ,
      expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
          m C a b zeroLoc (star z) =
        star (expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
          m C a b zeroLoc z)) :
    StrictAntiHerglotzUHP
        (logDerivativeResponse
          (expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
            m C a b zeroLoc)) ↔
      ∀ rho : ℂ,
        expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
            m C a b zeroLoc rho = 0 →
          rho.im = 0
proof:
:= by
  let Hgen : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc :=
    H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability
  let Hluc : HadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData zeroLoc
      (natHadamardFiniteExhaustion Hgen) :=
    natHadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData Hgen
  have hdifferentiable :
      Differentiable ℂ
        (expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
          m C a b zeroLoc) := by
    intro z
    unfold expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
    apply DifferentiableAt.mul
    · fun_prop
    · unfold expAffineGenusOneProduct
      exact (by fun_prop :
        DifferentiableAt ℂ
          (fun w : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * w)) z).mul
            (Hluc.infinite_differentiableAt (Set.mem_univ z))
  have hanalytic :
      AnalyticOnNhd ℂ
        (expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
          m C a b zeroLoc) Set.univ :=
    fun z _hz => hdifferentiable.analyticAt z
  have hnontrivial :
      ∃ z : ℂ,
        expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
          m C a b zeroLoc z ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz⟩ :=
      exists_point_away_from_origin_and_zero_sequence zeroLoc
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    unfold expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
    apply mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero m hz0)
    unfold expAffineGenusOneProduct
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero hC (Complex.exp_ne_zero _))
      (Hgen.infiniteProduct_ne_zero hz)
  constructor
  · intro hstrict
    exact entire_function_roots_real_of_analytic_nontrivial
      (expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity m C a b zeroLoc)
      hanalytic hnontrivial
      (fun z hz _hz_nonzero => hstrict.antiHerglotz z hz)
      h_schwarz
  · intro hzeros
    have hreal : ∀ i : ℕ, (zeroLoc i).im = 0 := by
      intro i
      apply hzeros (zeroLoc i)
      unfold expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
      unfold expAffineGenusOneProduct
      rw [infiniteHadamardProduct_eq_zero_at_zeroLoc H.zero_ne i]
      simp
    intro z hz
    have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      rw [hzero, Complex.zero_im] at hz
      linarith
    have hz_ne : ∀ i : ℕ, z ≠ zeroLoc i := by
      intro i hzi
      have him := congrArg Complex.im hzi
      rw [hreal i] at him
      linarith
    rw [logDerivativeResponse_expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity
      hC Hgen hz0 hz_ne]
    rw [Complex.add_im, Complex.add_im, hb, add_zero]
    have horigin := originMultiplicityResponse_im_nonpos m z hz
    have hproduct :=
      infiniteHadamardProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_of_nat_invSqData
        zeroLoc H hreal z hz
    linarith

theorem
    expAffineGenusOneProductWithOriginMultiplicity_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_zeros_real_of_schwarz
    (m : ℕ) {C a b : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ)

name: OverflowResidueRH.canonicalProductWithOrigin_analyticOrderAt
statement:
theorem canonicalProductWithOrigin_analyticOrderAt
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ} (m : ℕ)
    (Hinv : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) (z : ℂ) :
    analyticOrderAt (canonicalProductWithOrigin m zeroLoc) z =
      if z = 0 then (m : ENat)
      else (Nat.card {i : ι // zeroLoc i = z} : ENat)
proof:
:= by
  have hmonomial : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ ↦ w ^ m) z := by fun_prop
  have hproduct : AnalyticAt ℂ (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) z :=
    (infiniteHadamardProduct_differentiable_of_invSq_normProper
      Hinv Hproper).analyticAt z
  unfold canonicalProductWithOrigin
  rw [analyticOrderAt_mul hmonomial hproduct,
    infiniteHadamardProduct_analyticOrderAt_eq_fiber_natCard
      Hinv Hproper z]
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst z
    letI : IsEmpty {i : ι // zeroLoc i = 0} :=
      ⟨fun i ↦ Hinv.zero_ne i.1 i.2⟩
    rw [Nat.card_of_isEmpty]
    simp only [ENat.coe_zero, add_zero, if_pos]
    change analyticOrderAt ((id : ℂ → ℂ) ^ m) (0 : ℂ) = (m : ENat)
    rw [analyticOrderAt_pow analyticAt_id, analyticOrderAt_id]
    simp
  · rw [hmonomial.analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero m hz),
      zero_add, if_neg hz]

name: OverflowResidueRH.deriv_neg_of_even
statement:
theorem deriv_neg_of_even
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} (hF : Differentiable ℂ F)
    (heven : ∀ z : ℂ, F (-z) = F z) (z : ℂ) :
    deriv F (-z) = -deriv F z
proof:
:= by
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ ↦ -w) (-1) z :=
    (hasDerivAt_id z).neg
  have houter : HasDerivAt F (deriv F (-z)) (-z) :=
    (hF (-z)).hasDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ ↦ F (-w))
      (deriv F (-z) * (-1)) z := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using houter.comp z hinner
  have hfun : (fun w : ℂ ↦ F (-w)) = F := funext heven
  have hderiv_fun := congrArg (fun f : ℂ → ℂ ↦ deriv f z) hfun
  have hderiv : deriv F z = deriv F (-z) * (-1) := by
    rw [← hderiv_fun]
    exact hcomp.deriv
  have hneg := congrArg Neg.neg hderiv
  simpa using hneg.symm

    logDerivativeResponse F (-z) = -logDerivativeResponse F z
proof:

statement:
theorem CompletedLFunctionHadamardData.strictAntiHerglotz_of_onlyRealZeros
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ι : Type u}
    (H : CompletedLFunctionHadamardData F ι)
    (hrealZeros : HasOnlyRealZeros F) :
    StrictAntiHerglotzUHP (logDerivativeResponse F)
proof:
:= by
  have hreal : ∀ i : ι, (H.zeroLoc i).im = 0 :=
    fun i ↦ hrealZeros (H.zeroLoc i) (H.zeroLoc_is_zero i)
  intro z hz
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    subst z
    simp at hz
  have hzloc : ∀ i : ι, z ≠ H.zeroLoc i := by
    intro i hzi
    have him := congrArg Complex.im hzi
    rw [hreal i] at him
    linarith
  rw [H.logDerivative_expansion z hz0 hzloc]
  simp only [Complex.add_im, H.b_im, add_zero]
  rcases H.support_nonempty with hm | hι
  · exact add_neg_of_neg_of_nonpos
      (originMultiplicityResponse_im_neg H.originMultiplicity hm z hz)
      (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_im_nonpos_of_real_indexed
        H.zeroLoc H.zeroData hreal hz)
  · letI : Nonempty ι := hι
    exact add_neg_of_nonpos_of_neg
      (originMultiplicityResponse_im_nonpos H.originMultiplicity z hz)
      (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_im_neg_of_real_indexed
        H.zeroLoc H.zeroData hreal hz)

name: OverflowResidueRH.CompletedLFunctionHadamardData.onlyRealZeros_iff_strictAntiHerglotz
statement:
theorem CompletedLFunctionHadamardData.onlyRealZeros_iff_strictAntiHerglotz
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ι : Type u}
    (H : CompletedLFunctionHadamardData F ι) :
    HasOnlyRealZeros F ↔
      StrictAntiHerglotzUHP (logDerivativeResponse F)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact H.strictAntiHerglotz_of_onlyRealZeros
  · intro hstrict
    exact entire_function_roots_real_of_analytic_nontrivial F
      H.analytic H.nontrivial
      (fun z hz _hFz ↦ (hstrict z hz).le) H.schwarz

name: OverflowResidueRH.finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_nonpos_indexed
statement:
theorem finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_nonpos_indexed
    {ι : Type*} (zeroLoc : ι → ℝ) (F : Finset ι)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.im) :
    (finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
      (fun i : ι => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) F s).im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
  rw [Complex.im_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_nonpos
  intro i _hi
  rw [Complex.add_im]
  have hregularizer : (1 / (((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ))).im = 0 := by
    simp
  rw [hregularizer, add_zero]
  exact complex_real_root_residue_imag_nonpos s (zeroLoc i) hs

name: OverflowResidueRH.finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_le_residue_indexed
statement:
theorem finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_le_residue_indexed
    {ι : Type*} (zeroLoc : ι → ℝ) (F : Finset ι)
    {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ F) {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.im) :
    (finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
      (fun j : ι => ((zeroLoc j : ℝ) : ℂ)) F s).im ≤
        ((1 : ℂ) / (s - ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ))).im
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsplit :
      finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
          (fun j : ι => ((zeroLoc j : ℝ) : ℂ)) F s =
        finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
            (fun j : ι => ((zeroLoc j : ℝ) : ℂ)) (F.erase i) s +
          (1 / (s - ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) +
            1 / ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    unfold finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
    exact (F.sum_erase_add _ hi).symm
  have hrest := finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_nonpos_indexed
    zeroLoc (F.erase i) hs
  have hregularizer : (1 / ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)).im = 0 := by
    simp
  rw [hsplit, Complex.add_im, Complex.add_im, hregularizer, add_zero]
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_real_im_nonpos_indexed
statement:
theorem hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_real_im_nonpos_indexed
    {ι : Type*} (zeroLoc : ι → ℝ)
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability
      (fun i : ι => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.im) :
    (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
      (fun i : ι => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) s).im ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsum_tendsto := H.finiteRegularizedSum_tendsto_totalized s
  have him_tendsto :
      Tendsto
        (fun F : Finset ι =>
          (finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
            (fun i : ι => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) F s).im)
        Filter.atTop
        (𝓝 (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
          (fun i : ι => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) s).im) :=
    (Complex.continuous_im.tendsto _).comp hsum_tendsto
  exact le_of_tendsto him_tendsto
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun F =>
      finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_nonpos_indexed zeroLoc F hs)

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_real_im_neg_indexed
statement:
theorem hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_real_im_neg_indexed
    {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι] (zeroLoc : ι → ℝ)
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability
      (fun i : ι => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.im) :
    (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
      (fun i : ι => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) s).im < 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let i₀ : ι := Classical.choice inferInstance
  have hsum_tendsto := H.finiteRegularizedSum_tendsto_totalized s
  have him_tendsto :
      Tendsto
        (fun F : Finset ι =>
          (finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
            (fun i : ι => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) F s).im)
        Filter.atTop
        (𝓝 (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
          (fun i : ι => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) s).im) :=
    (Complex.continuous_im.tendsto _).comp hsum_tendsto
  have hbound :
      ∀ᶠ F : Finset ι in Filter.atTop,
        (finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
          (fun i : ι => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) F s).im ≤
            ((1 : ℂ) / (s - ((zeroLoc i₀ : ℝ) : ℂ))).im := by
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop ({i₀} : Finset ι)] with F hF
    exact finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_real_im_le_residue_indexed
      zeroLoc F (hF (by simp)) hs
  have hlimit_le :
      (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
        (fun i : ι => ((zeroLoc i : ℝ) : ℂ)) s).im ≤
          ((1 : ℂ) / (s - ((zeroLoc i₀ : ℝ) : ℂ))).im :=
    le_of_tendsto him_tendsto hbound
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hlimit_le
    (complex_real_root_residue_imag_neg s (zeroLoc i₀) hs)

name: OverflowResidueRH.NatHadamardZeroInvSqData.eventually_large
statement:
theorem NatHadamardZeroInvSqData.eventually_large
    {zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ} (H : NatHadamardZeroInvSqData zeroLoc)
    (s : ℂ) :
    ∀ᶠ i in Filter.cofinite, 2 * ‖s‖ ≤ ‖zeroLoc i‖
proof:
:= by
  let R : ℝ := 2 * ‖s‖
  by_cases hR : R = 0
  · filter_upwards with i
    change R ≤ ‖zeroLoc i‖
    rw [hR]
    exact norm_nonneg (zeroLoc i)
  · have hR_nonneg : 0 ≤ R := by
      dsimp [R]
      positivity
    have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_of_le_of_ne hR_nonneg (Ne.symm hR)
    have heps_pos : 0 < (R ^ 2)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (sq_pos_of_pos hR_pos)
    have htendsto :
        Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
          Filter.cofinite (𝓝 0) :=
      H.inv_sq_summable.tendsto_cofinite_zero
    have hsmall :
        ∀ᶠ i : ℕ in Filter.cofinite,
          (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ < (R ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
      htendsto.eventually_lt_const heps_pos
    filter_upwards [hsmall] with i hi
    have hnorm_pos : 0 < ‖zeroLoc i‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (H.zero_ne i)
    have hsquare : R ^ 2 < ‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2 :=
      (inv_lt_inv₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hnorm_pos) (sq_pos_of_pos hR_pos)).mp hi
    have hlt : R < ‖zeroLoc i‖ := by nlinarith
    exact le_of_lt (by simpa [R] using hlt)

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroNormProper.sum
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroNormProper.sum
    {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} {zeroLocF : ι → ℂ} {zeroLocG : κ → ℂ}
    (HF : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLocF)
    (HG : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLocG) :
    HadamardZeroNormProper
      (completedLProductZeroLoc zeroLocF zeroLocG) where
  finite_norm_le R
proof:
:= by
    let e := completedLProductZeroLocNormBallEquiv zeroLocF zeroLocG R
    letI : Fintype {i : ι // ‖zeroLocF i‖ ≤ R} :=
      (HF.finite_norm_le R).fintype
    letI : Fintype {j : κ // ‖zeroLocG j‖ ≤ R} :=
      (HG.finite_norm_le R).fintype
    rw [Set.finite_def]
    exact ⟨Fintype.ofEquiv
      ({i : ι // ‖zeroLocF i‖ ≤ R} ⊕ {j : κ // ‖zeroLocG j‖ ≤ R})
      e.symm⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard_completedLProductZeroLoc
statement:
theorem hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard_completedLProductZeroLoc
    {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} (zeroLocF : ι → ℂ) (zeroLocG : κ → ℂ)
    (HF : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLocF)
    (HG : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLocG) (n : ℕ) :
    hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard
        (completedLProductZeroLoc zeroLocF zeroLocG) n =
      hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard zeroLocF n +
        hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard zeroLocG n
proof:
:= by
  let R : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ n
  let e := completedLProductZeroLocNormBallEquiv zeroLocF zeroLocG R
  letI : Finite {i : ι // ‖zeroLocF i‖ ≤ R} :=
    (HF.finite_norm_le R).to_subtype
  letI : Finite {j : κ // ‖zeroLocG j‖ ≤ R} :=
    (HG.finite_norm_le R).to_subtype
  unfold hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard
  change Nat.card
      {x : ι ⊕ κ //
        ‖completedLProductZeroLoc zeroLocF zeroLocG x‖ ≤ R} =
    Nat.card {i : ι // ‖zeroLocF i‖ ≤ R} +
      Nat.card {j : κ // ‖zeroLocG j‖ ≤ R}
  rw [Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_sum]

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_completedLProductZeroLoc
statement:
theorem hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries_completedLProductZeroLoc
    {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} {zeroLocF : ι → ℂ} {zeroLocG : κ → ℂ}
    (HF : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLocF)
    (HG : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLocG)
    (z : ℂ) (hzF : ∀ i : ι, z ≠ zeroLocF i)
    (hzG : ∀ j : κ, z ≠ zeroLocG j) :
    hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
        (completedLProductZeroLoc zeroLocF zeroLocG) z =
      hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries zeroLocF z +
        hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries zeroLocG z
proof:
:= by
  let termF : ι → ℂ := fun i ↦
    1 / (z - zeroLocF i) + 1 / zeroLocF i
  let termG : κ → ℂ := fun j ↦
    1 / (z - zeroLocG j) + 1 / zeroLocG j
  let termSum : ι ⊕ κ → ℂ := Sum.elim termF termG
  have hF : Summable termF := by
    simpa only [termF] using HF.summable_regularized hzF
  have hG : Summable termG := by
    simpa only [termG] using HG.summable_regularized hzG
  have hsum : HasSum termSum ((∑' i, termF i) + ∑' j, termG j) :=
    hF.hasSum.sum hG.hasSum
  have heq :
      (fun x : ι ⊕ κ ↦
        1 / (z - completedLProductZeroLoc zeroLocF zeroLocG x) +
          1 / completedLProductZeroLoc zeroLocF zeroLocG x) = termSum := by
    funext x
    rcases x with i | j <;> rfl
  unfold hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
  rw [heq]
  simpa only [termF, termG] using hsum.tsum_eq

name: OverflowResidueRH.CompletedLFunctionHadamardData.ne_zero_of_ne_zeroLoc
statement:
theorem CompletedLFunctionHadamardData.ne_zero_of_ne_zeroLoc
    {F : ℂ → ℂ} {ι : Type u} (H : CompletedLFunctionHadamardData F ι)
    {z : ℂ} (hz0 : z ≠ 0) (hzloc : ∀ i : ι, z ≠ H.zeroLoc i) :
    F z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzorder : analyticOrderAt F z = 0 := by
    rw [H.analyticOrderAt_eq z, if_neg hz0]
    letI : IsEmpty {i : ι // H.zeroLoc i = z} :=
      ⟨fun i ↦ hzloc i.1 i.2.symm⟩
    rw [Nat.card_of_isEmpty]
    simp
  exact (H.analytic z (Set.mem_univ z)).analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mp hzorder

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardFiniteDerivativeLimitData.logDeriv_eq_tsum_at
statement:
theorem HadamardFiniteDerivativeLimitData.logDeriv_eq_tsum_at
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    {Hex : HadamardFiniteExhaustion zeroLoc}
    (Hderiv : HadamardFiniteDerivativeLimitData zeroLoc Hex)
    {s : ℂ}
    (hs_region : s ∈ Hderiv.region)
    (hzero_ne : ∀ i : ι, zeroLoc i ≠ 0)
    (hs_ne : ∀ i : ι, s ≠ zeroLoc i)
    (hprod_ne : infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s ≠ 0) :
    logDerivativeResponse (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) s
      = hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries zeroLoc s
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv_lim := Hderiv.derivative_tendsto s hs_region
  have hprod_lim := Hex.product_tendsto s
  have hsum_lim := Hex.regularized_sum_tendsto s
  have hmul_lim :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc (Hex.exhaust n) s
            * finiteHadamardRegularizedSum zeroLoc (Hex.exhaust n) s)
        Filter.atTop
        (𝓝 (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s
          * hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries zeroLoc s)) :=
    hprod_lim.mul hsum_lim
  have hderiv_eq_mul :
      (fun n : ℕ =>
          deriv
            (fun s' : ℂ =>
              indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc (Hex.exhaust n) s') s)
        =ᶠ[Filter.atTop]
      (fun n : ℕ =>
          indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc (Hex.exhaust n) s
            * finiteHadamardRegularizedSum zeroLoc (Hex.exhaust n) s) := by
    filter_upwards [] with n
    exact deriv_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_at_exhaustion
      Hex
      (fun i _hi => hzero_ne i)
      (fun i _hi => hs_ne i)
  have hderiv_mul_lim :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          deriv
            (fun s' : ℂ =>
              indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc (Hex.exhaust n) s') s)
        Filter.atTop
        (𝓝 (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s
          * hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries zeroLoc s)) :=
    hmul_lim.congr' hderiv_eq_mul.symm
  have hderiv_eq :
      deriv (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) s
        =
      infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s
        * hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries zeroLoc s :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique hderiv_lim hderiv_mul_lim
  unfold logDerivativeResponse
  rw [hderiv_eq]
  field_simp [hprod_ne]

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamard_regularized_term_eq
statement:
lemma hadamard_regularized_term_eq {s ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) (hsρ : s ≠ ρ) :
    1 / (s - ρ) + 1 / ρ = s / ((s - ρ) * ρ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsρ' : s - ρ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hsρ
  field_simp
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_hadamard_regularized_term_eq
statement:
lemma norm_hadamard_regularized_term_eq
    {s ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) (hsρ : s ≠ ρ) :
    ‖1 / (s - ρ) + 1 / ρ‖ = ‖s‖ / (‖s - ρ‖ * ‖ρ‖)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hadamard_regularized_term_eq hρ hsρ, norm_div, norm_mul]

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_sub_ge_half_of_two_norm_le
proof:
:= by
  have htriangle : ‖ρ‖ ≤ ‖s‖ + ‖s - ρ‖ := by
    have h_sub := norm_sub_le s (s - ρ)
    have h_eq : s - (s - ρ) = ρ := by ring
    rw [h_eq] at h_sub
    exact h_sub
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_hadamard_regularized_term_le_large
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_hadamard_regularized_term_eq hρ hsρ]
  have hρ_pos : 0 < ‖ρ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hρ
  have h_sρ_pos : 0 < ‖s - ρ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hsρ)
  have h_denom_pos : 0 < ‖s - ρ‖ * ‖ρ‖ := mul_pos h_sρ_pos hρ_pos
  have h_ρ_sq_pos : 0 < ‖ρ‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h_sρ_ge : ‖ρ‖ / 2 ≤ ‖s - ρ‖ := norm_sub_ge_half_of_two_norm_le hlarge
  have h_s_nn : 0 ≤ ‖s‖ := norm_nonneg _
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h_denom_pos h_ρ_sq_pos]
  have h_ρ_le : ‖ρ‖ ≤ 2 * ‖s - ρ‖ := by linarith
  have h_mul : ‖ρ‖ * ‖ρ‖ ≤ 2 * ‖s - ρ‖ * ‖ρ‖ :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_ρ_le hρ_pos.le
  have h_ρ_sq : ‖ρ‖ ^ 2 = ‖ρ‖ * ‖ρ‖ := by ring
  nlinarith [h_mul, h_s_nn, h_ρ_sq]

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroNormProper.eventually_large
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroNormProper.eventually_large
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) :
    ∀ s : ℂ, ∀ᶠ i in Filter.cofinite, 2 * ‖s‖ ≤ ‖zeroLoc i‖
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  rw [Filter.eventually_cofinite]
  exact (H.finite_norm_le (2 * ‖s‖)).subset (by
    intro i hi
    exact (not_le.mp hi).le)

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroNormProper.mem_normExhaustion
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroNormProper.mem_normExhaustion
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc)
    {n : ℕ} {i : ι} :
    i ∈ H.normExhaustion n ↔ ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold HadamardZeroNormProper.normExhaustion
  rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
  rfl

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroNormProper.normExhaustion_mono
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroNormProper.normExhaustion_mono
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) :
    Monotone H.normExhaustion
proof:
:= by
  intro n m hnm i hi
  rw [H.mem_normExhaustion] at hi
  rw [H.mem_normExhaustion]
  exact le_trans hi (Nat.cast_le.mpr hnm)

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroNormProper.normExhaustion_exhaustive
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroNormProper.normExhaustion_exhaustive
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) :
    ∀ i : ι, ∃ n : ℕ, i ∈ H.normExhaustion n
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_ge ‖zeroLoc i‖
  exact ⟨n, (H.mem_normExhaustion).mpr hn⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.of_invSqSummable_normProper
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.of_invSqSummable_normProper
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (hzero : ∀ i, zeroLoc i ≠ 0)
    (hinv : Summable fun i : ι => (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) :
    HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc
proof:
:=
  { zero_ne := hzero
    inv_sq_summable := hinv
    eventually_large := Hproper.eventually_large }

name: OverflowResidueRH.summable_hadamard_regularized_terms_of_inv_sq
statement:
theorem summable_hadamard_regularized_terms_of_inv_sq
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (hzero_ne : ∀ i, zeroLoc i ≠ 0)
    (hs_ne : ∀ i, s ≠ zeroLoc i)
    (hinv_sq : Summable fun i : ι => (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
    (heventual_large :
      ∀ᶠ i in Filter.cofinite, 2 * ‖s‖ ≤ ‖zeroLoc i‖) :
    Summable fun i : ι => 1 / (s - zeroLoc i) + 1 / zeroLoc i
proof:
:= by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded_eventually
    (g := fun i => 2 * ‖s‖ * (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
  · exact hinv_sq.mul_left (2 * ‖s‖)
  · filter_upwards [heventual_large] with i hi
    have h_bound :=
      norm_hadamard_regularized_term_le_large (hzero_ne i) (hs_ne i) hi
    have h_eq :
        (2 : ℝ) * ‖s‖ / ‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2
          = 2 * ‖s‖ * (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    linarith [h_eq ▸ h_bound]

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.summable_regularized
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.summable_regularized
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    {s : ℂ} (hs_ne : ∀ i, s ≠ zeroLoc i) :
    Summable fun i : ι => 1 / (s - zeroLoc i) + 1 / zeroLoc i
proof:
:=
  summable_hadamard_regularized_terms_of_inv_sq
    H.zero_ne hs_ne H.inv_sq_summable (H.eventually_large s)

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.summable_regularized_totalized
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.summable_regularized_totalized
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    (s : ℂ) :
    Summable fun i : ι => 1 / (s - zeroLoc i) + 1 / zeroLoc i
proof:
:= by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded_eventually
    (g := fun i => 2 * ‖s‖ * (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
  · exact H.inv_sq_summable.mul_left (2 * ‖s‖)
  · filter_upwards [H.eventually_large s] with i hi
    have hs_ne : s ≠ zeroLoc i := by
      intro h
      have hnorm_zero : ‖s‖ = 0 := by
        rw [← h] at hi
        have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖s‖ := norm_nonneg s
        linarith
      have hs0 : s = 0 := norm_eq_zero.mp hnorm_zero
      exact H.zero_ne i (by rw [← h, hs0])
    have h_bound :=
      norm_hadamard_regularized_term_le_large (H.zero_ne i) hs_ne hi
    have h_eq :
        (2 : ℝ) * ‖s‖ / ‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2
          = 2 * ‖s‖ * (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    linarith [h_eq ▸ h_bound]

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_one_sub_hadamardGenus1Factor_le_large
statement:
lemma norm_one_sub_hadamardGenus1Factor_le_large
    {ρ s : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) (hlarge : ‖s‖ ≤ ‖ρ‖)
    (Hbound : GenusOneTaylorBoundData) :
    ‖1 - hadamardGenus1Factor ρ s‖ ≤ 4 * (‖s‖ ^ 2 / ‖ρ‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hadamardGenus1Factor
  have hρ_pos : 0 < ‖ρ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hρ
  have hw : ‖s / ρ‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [norm_div]
    exact div_le_one_of_le₀ hlarge (norm_nonneg _)
  have h := Hbound.bound (s / ρ) hw
  rw [norm_div, div_pow] at h
  exact h

name: OverflowResidueRH.summable_norm_one_sub_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_inv_sq
statement:
theorem summable_norm_one_sub_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_inv_sq
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (Hbound : GenusOneTaylorBoundData)
    (hzero_ne : ∀ i, zeroLoc i ≠ 0)
    (hinv_sq : Summable fun i : ι => (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
    (heventual_large :
      ∀ᶠ i in Filter.cofinite, ‖s‖ ≤ ‖zeroLoc i‖) :
    Summable fun i : ι => ‖1 - hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s‖
proof:
:= by
  apply Summable.of_norm_bounded_eventually
    (g := fun i => 4 * ‖s‖ ^ 2 * (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
  · exact hinv_sq.mul_left (4 * ‖s‖ ^ 2)
  · filter_upwards [heventual_large] with i hi
    have h_bound :=
      norm_one_sub_hadamardGenus1Factor_le_large (hzero_ne i) hi Hbound
    have h_eq : (4 : ℝ) * ‖s‖ ^ 2 * (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
              = 4 * (‖s‖ ^ 2 / ‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2) := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
    linarith [h_eq ▸ h_bound]

name: OverflowResidueRH.summable_one_sub_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_inv_sq
statement:
theorem summable_one_sub_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_inv_sq
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (Hbound : GenusOneTaylorBoundData)
    (hzero_ne : ∀ i, zeroLoc i ≠ 0)
    (hinv_sq : Summable fun i : ι => (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
    (heventual_large :
      ∀ᶠ i in Filter.cofinite, ‖s‖ ≤ ‖zeroLoc i‖) :
    Summable fun i : ι => 1 - hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s
proof:
:=
  Summable.of_norm
    (summable_norm_one_sub_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_inv_sq
      Hbound hzero_ne hinv_sq heventual_large)

name: OverflowResidueRH.multipliable_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_inv_sq
statement:
theorem multipliable_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_inv_sq
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (Hbound : GenusOneTaylorBoundData)
    (hzero_ne : ∀ i, zeroLoc i ≠ 0)
    (hinv_sq : Summable fun i : ι => (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
    (heventual_large :
      ∀ᶠ i in Filter.cofinite, ‖s‖ ≤ ‖zeroLoc i‖) :
    Multipliable fun i : ι => hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s
proof:
:= by
  have h_sum :=
    summable_one_sub_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_inv_sq
      Hbound hzero_ne hinv_sq heventual_large
  have h_sum_neg :
      Summable fun i : ι => hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s - 1 := by
    have := h_sum.neg
    simpa [neg_sub] using this
  have h_mul := Complex.multipliable_one_add_of_summable h_sum_neg
  simpa using h_mul

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.multipliable_genus1
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.multipliable_genus1
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    (Hbound : GenusOneTaylorBoundData) (s : ℂ) :
    Multipliable fun i : ι => hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s
proof:
:= by
  apply multipliable_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_inv_sq
    Hbound H.zero_ne H.inv_sq_summable
  filter_upwards [H.eventually_large s] with i hi
  have h_s_nn : 0 ≤ ‖s‖ := norm_nonneg s
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.genusOneTaylorBoundData
statement: theorem genusOneTaylorBoundData : GenusOneTaylorBoundData
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro w hw
  have h_decomp :
      (1 : ℂ) - (1 - w) * Complex.exp w
        = -(Complex.exp w - 1 - w) + w * (Complex.exp w - 1) := by
    ring
  rw [h_decomp]
  have h_exp_sub_1_sub_id := Complex.norm_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le hw
  have h_exp_sub_1 := Complex.norm_exp_sub_one_le hw
  have h_w_nn : 0 ≤ ‖w‖ := norm_nonneg _
  calc ‖-(Complex.exp w - 1 - w) + w * (Complex.exp w - 1)‖
      ≤ ‖-(Complex.exp w - 1 - w)‖ + ‖w * (Complex.exp w - 1)‖ :=
        norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖Complex.exp w - 1 - w‖ + ‖w‖ * ‖Complex.exp w - 1‖ := by
        rw [norm_neg, norm_mul]
    _ ≤ ‖w‖ ^ 2 + ‖w‖ * (2 * ‖w‖) := by
        gcongr
    _ = 3 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ 4 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖w‖]

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.product_multipliable
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.product_multipliable
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc) :
    ∀ s : ℂ,
      Multipliable fun i : ι => hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s
proof:
:=
  fun s => H.multipliable_genus1 genusOneTaylorBoundData s
