name: OverflowResidueRH.hasProdLocallyUniformlyOn_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_summable_bound
statement:
theorem hasProdLocallyUniformlyOn_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_summable_bound
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {u : ι → ℝ}
    (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hu : Summable u)
    (hbound :
      ∀ᶠ i in Filter.cofinite,
        ∀ s ∈ U,
          ‖hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s - 1‖ ≤ u i) :
    HasProdLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun i : ι => fun s : ℂ => hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s)
      (fun s : ℂ => infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s)
      U
proof:
:= by
  have hcts :
      ∀ i : ι,
        ContinuousOn
          (fun s : ℂ => hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s - 1) U := by
    intro i s _hs
    exact
      ((hadamardGenus1Factor_differentiableAt (zeroLoc i) s).continuousAt.sub
        continuousAt_const).continuousWithinAt
  have hprod :=
    hu.hasProdLocallyUniformlyOn_one_add
      (K := U)
      (f := fun i : ι => fun s : ℂ =>
        hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s - 1)
      hU
      hbound
      hcts
  simpa [infiniteHadamardProduct, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm,
    add_assoc] using hprod

name: OverflowResidueRH.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_of_summable_bound
statement:
theorem tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_of_summable_bound
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ} {u : ι → ℝ}
    (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hu : Summable u)
    (hbound :
      ∀ᶠ i in Filter.cofinite,
        ∀ s ∈ U,
          ‖hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s - 1‖ ≤ u i) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun F : Finset ι => fun s : ℂ =>
        indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc F s)
      (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc)
      Filter.atTop
      U
proof:
:= by
  have hprod :=
    hasProdLocallyUniformlyOn_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_summable_bound
      (zeroLoc := zeroLoc) hU hu hbound
  simpa [HasProdLocallyUniformlyOn, indexedFiniteHadamardProduct] using hprod

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.eventually_uniform_factor_sub_one_bound
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.eventually_uniform_factor_sub_one_bound
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    {U : Set ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hUbound : ∀ s : ℂ, s ∈ U → ‖s‖ ≤ R) :
    ∀ᶠ i in Filter.cofinite,
      ∀ s ∈ U,
        ‖hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s - 1‖
          ≤ 4 * R ^ 2 * (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [H.eventually_large ((R : ℝ) : ℂ)] with i hi s hs
  have hnorm_R : ‖((R : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = R := by
    simp [hR]
  rw [hnorm_R] at hi
  have hR_le : R ≤ ‖zeroLoc i‖ := by
    nlinarith [hR, hi]
  have hlarge : ‖s‖ ≤ ‖zeroLoc i‖ :=
    le_trans (hUbound s hs) hR_le
  have htail :=
    norm_one_sub_hadamardGenus1Factor_le_large
      (ρ := zeroLoc i) (s := s) (H.zero_ne i) hlarge
      genusOneTaylorBoundData
  have hdiff :
      ‖hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s - 1‖
        = ‖1 - hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s‖ := by
    rw [← norm_neg (hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s - 1)]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hsq : ‖s‖ ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hUbound s hs, norm_nonneg s, hR]
  have hinv_nonneg : 0 ≤ (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
    inv_nonneg.mpr (sq_nonneg _)
  calc
    ‖hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s - 1‖
        = ‖1 - hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s‖ := hdiff
    _ ≤ 4 * (‖s‖ ^ 2 / ‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2) := htail
    _ = 4 * (‖s‖ ^ 2 * (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    _ ≤ 4 * (R ^ 2 * (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        gcongr
    _ = 4 * R ^ 2 * (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_of_norm_bounded_open
statement:
theorem tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_of_norm_bounded_open
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    {U : Set ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hUbound : ∀ s : ℂ, s ∈ U → ‖s‖ ≤ R) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun F : Finset ι => fun s : ℂ =>
        indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc F s)
      (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc)
      Filter.atTop
      U
proof:
:= by
  have hu :
      Summable fun i : ι =>
        4 * R ^ 2 * (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
    H.inv_sq_summable.mul_left (4 * R ^ 2)
  exact
    tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_of_summable_bound
      hU
      hu
      (H.eventually_uniform_factor_sub_one_bound hR hUbound)

name: OverflowResidueRH.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_at_exhaustion
statement:
theorem tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_at_exhaustion
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    {U : Set ℂ} {exhaust : ℕ → Finset ι}
    (HlucFinset :
      TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
        (fun F : Finset ι => fun s : ℂ =>
          indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc F s)
        (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc)
        Filter.atTop
        U)
    (hmono : Monotone exhaust)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ i : ι, ∃ n : ℕ, i ∈ exhaust n) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun n : ℕ => fun s : ℂ =>
        indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc (exhaust n) s)
      (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc)
      Filter.atTop
      U
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV x hx
  rcases HlucFinset V hV x hx with ⟨t, ht, htail⟩
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  exact
    (tendsto_atTop_finset_of_monotone hmono hexhaustive).eventually htail

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_univ
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_univ
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun F : Finset ι => fun s : ℂ =>
        indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc F s)
      (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc)
      Filter.atTop
      Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV x _hx
  let R : ℝ := ‖x‖ + 1
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := by
    have hxnn : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg x
    linarith
  have hRpos : 0 < R := by
    have hxnn : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg x
    linarith
  have hxball : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball]
    simp [R, dist_eq_norm]
  have hUbound :
      ∀ s : ℂ, s ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R → ‖s‖ ≤ R := by
    intro s hs
    exact le_of_lt (by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hs
      simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hs)
  have hball :=
    tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_of_norm_bounded_open
      H Metric.isOpen_ball hR hUbound
  rcases hball V hV x hxball with ⟨t, ht, htail⟩
  refine ⟨t, ?_, htail⟩
  have ht_nhds : t ∈ 𝓝 x := by
    rwa [Metric.isOpen_ball.nhdsWithin_eq hxball] at ht
  simpa using ht_nhds

name: OverflowResidueRH.infiniteHadamardProduct_ne_zero_of_summable_factor_sub_one
statement:
theorem infiniteHadamardProduct_ne_zero_of_summable_factor_sub_one
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (hfactor_ne :
      ∀ i : ι, hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s ≠ 0)
    (hsum :
      Summable fun i : ι => hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s - 1) :
    infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold infiniteHadamardProduct
  have hlog :
      Summable fun i : ι =>
        Complex.log (hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s) := by
    have h :=
      Complex.summable_log_one_add_of_summable
        (f := fun i : ι => hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s - 1)
        hsum
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using h
  have hprod :=
    Complex.cexp_tsum_eq_tprod
      (f := fun i : ι => hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s)
      hfactor_ne
      hlog
  intro hzero
  have hexp_zero :
      Complex.exp
          (∑' i : ι,
            Complex.log (hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s))
        = 0 := by
    exact hprod.trans hzero
  exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _ hexp_zero

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.infiniteProduct_ne_zero
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroInvSqSummability.infiniteProduct_ne_zero
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    {s : ℂ} (hs_ne : ∀ i : ι, s ≠ zeroLoc i) :
    infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine
    infiniteHadamardProduct_ne_zero_of_summable_factor_sub_one
      (zeroLoc := zeroLoc) (s := s) ?_ ?_
  · intro i
    exact hadamardGenus1Factor_ne_zero (H.zero_ne i) (hs_ne i)
  · have h_one_sub :
        Summable fun i : ι =>
          1 - hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s :=
      summable_one_sub_hadamardGenus1Factor_of_inv_sq
        genusOneTaylorBoundData
        H.zero_ne
        H.inv_sq_summable
        (by
          filter_upwards [H.eventually_large s] with i hi
          have h_s_nn : 0 ≤ ‖s‖ := norm_nonneg s
          linarith)
    have h_neg := h_one_sub.neg
    simpa [neg_sub] using h_neg

statement:
theorem EntireXiHadamardPrefactor.exp_affine
    {C a b : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0) :
    EntireXiHadamardPrefactor
      (fun s : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * s))
proof:

      nonzero_at_nonzero := ?_ }

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireRiemannXi_not_eventuallyEq_zero
statement:
theorem entireRiemannXi_not_eventuallyEq_zero (p : ℂ) :
    ¬ entireRiemannXi =ᶠ[𝓝 p] 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hlocal
  have h_on : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ entireRiemannXi Set.univ :=
    fun z _hz => entireRiemannXi_differentiable.analyticAt z
  have heq : Set.EqOn entireRiemannXi 0 Set.univ :=
    h_on.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero
      isPreconnected_univ
      (Set.mem_univ p)
      hlocal

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireRiemannXi_zeroSet_locallyFinite
statement:
theorem entireRiemannXi_zeroSet_locallyFinite (p : ℂ) :
    ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p, (U ∩ {s : ℂ | entireRiemannXi s = 0}).Finite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : entireRiemannXi p = 0
  · have hAn : AnalyticAt ℂ entireRiemannXi p :=
      entireRiemannXi_differentiable.analyticAt p
    rcases hAn.eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with hlocal | hpunct
    · exact absurd hlocal (entireRiemannXi_not_eventuallyEq_zero p)
    · rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff] at hpunct
      refine
        ⟨{z : ℂ | z ∈ ({p}ᶜ : Set ℂ) → entireRiemannXi z ≠ 0},
          hpunct, ?_⟩
      apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_singleton p)
      rintro z ⟨hzU, hzzero⟩
      by_cases hzp : z = p
      · simp [hzp]
      · have hzmem : z ∈ ({p}ᶜ : Set ℂ) := hzp
        exact absurd hzzero (hzU hzmem)
  · have hcont : ContinuousAt entireRiemannXi p :=
      (entireRiemannXi_differentiable.analyticAt p).continuousAt
    have hEventually_ne :
        ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 p, entireRiemannXi z ≠ 0 :=
      hcont.eventually_ne hp
    refine ⟨{z : ℂ | entireRiemannXi z ≠ 0}, hEventually_ne, ?_⟩
    have hempty :
        {z : ℂ | entireRiemannXi z ≠ 0}
            ∩ {s : ℂ | entireRiemannXi s = 0}
          = ∅ := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hz_ne, hz_zero⟩
        exact (hz_ne hz_zero).elim
      · intro hz
        exact absurd hz (Set.notMem_empty z)
    rw [hempty]
    exact Set.finite_empty

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireRiemannXi_zeroSet_finite_in_closedBall
statement:
theorem entireRiemannXi_zeroSet_finite_in_closedBall (R : ℝ) :
    {s : ℂ |
      s ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R ∧ entireRiemannXi s = 0}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Z : Set ℂ :=
    {s : ℂ |
      s ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R ∧ entireRiemannXi s = 0}
  let K : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R
  have hK : IsCompact K := ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) R
  have hZK : Z ⊆ K := by
    intro z hz
    exact hz.1
  have hlocal :
      ∀ p ∈ K, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p, (U ∩ Z).Finite := by
    intro p _hp
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hfin⟩ := entireRiemannXi_zeroSet_locallyFinite p
    refine ⟨U, hU, ?_⟩
    exact hfin.subset (by
      rintro z ⟨hzU, hz⟩
      exact ⟨hzU, hz.2⟩)
  choose! V hV_nhds hV_finite using hlocal
  obtain ⟨t, ht_sub, ht_cover⟩ := hK.elim_nhds_subcover V hV_nhds
  have hZsubset : Z ⊆ ⋃ p ∈ t, V p ∩ Z := by
    intro z hz
    have hzK : z ∈ K := hZK hz
    obtain ⟨p, hpt, hzVp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht_cover hzK)
    exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨p, hpt, hzVp, hz⟩
  have hZfinite : Z.Finite := by
    refine Set.Finite.subset ?_ hZsubset
    refine Set.Finite.biUnion t.finite_toSet ?_
    intro p hp
    exact hV_finite p (ht_sub p hp)
  simpa [Z] using hZfinite

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiCanonicalZeroNormProper
statement:
theorem entireXiCanonicalZeroNormProper :
    EntireXiCanonicalZeroNormProper
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro R
  let S : Set EntireXiNonzeroZeroIndex :=
    {i : EntireXiNonzeroZeroIndex |
      ‖concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i‖ ≤ R}
  let Z : Set ℂ :=
    {s : ℂ |
      s ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R ∧ entireRiemannXi s = 0}
  have hZfinite : Z.Finite :=
    entireRiemannXi_zeroSet_finite_in_closedBall R
  have himage_sub :
      (fun i : EntireXiNonzeroZeroIndex =>
          concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i) '' S ⊆ Z := by
    rintro s ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc_is_zero i⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero]
    exact hi
  have himage_finite :
      ((fun i : EntireXiNonzeroZeroIndex =>
          concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i) '' S).Finite :=
    hZfinite.subset himage_sub
  exact
    Set.Finite.of_finite_image himage_finite (by
      intro i _hi j _hj hij
      exact Subtype.ext hij)

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiHadamardFactorization.of_quotientFactorization
proof:

  · rcases hhit with ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hxi : entireRiemannXi s = 0 := by

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiCanonicalZeroNormCeilFiber_invSq_le_pred
statement:
theorem entireXiCanonicalZeroNormCeilFiber_invSq_le_pred
    {i : EntireXiNonzeroZeroIndex} {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hi : Nat.ceil ‖concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i‖ = n) :
    (‖concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
      ≤ (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hpred_lt_norm :
      ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < ‖concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i‖ :=
    entireXiCanonicalZeroNormCeilFiber_pred_lt_norm
      (le_trans (by norm_num : 1 ≤ 2) hn) hi
  have hpred_pos : 0 < ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have h1n : 1 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 1 < 2) hn
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_pos_of_lt h1n
  have hnorm_pos : 0 < ‖concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i‖ :=
    lt_trans hpred_pos hpred_lt_norm
  have hsquares :
      ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2
        ≤ ‖concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hpred_lt_norm, hpred_pos]
  exact
    (inv_le_inv₀
      (sq_pos_of_pos hnorm_pos)
      (sq_pos_of_pos hpred_pos)).mpr hsquares

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_hadamardGenus1Factor_le_exp_linear
statement:
lemma norm_hadamardGenus1Factor_le_exp_linear
    (ρ z : ℂ) :
    ‖hadamardGenus1Factor ρ z‖ ≤ Real.exp (2 * ‖z‖ / ‖ρ‖)
proof:
:= by
  let w : ℂ := z / ρ
  have hre : w.re ≤ ‖w‖ := Complex.re_le_norm _
  have hone : ‖(1 : ℂ) - w‖ ≤ 1 + ‖w‖ := by
    calc
      ‖(1 : ℂ) - w‖ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖w‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = 1 + ‖w‖ := by simp
  have hone_exp : 1 + ‖w‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
    simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp ‖w‖
  calc
    ‖hadamardGenus1Factor ρ z‖ = ‖(1 - w) * Complex.exp w‖ := by
      simp only [hadamardGenus1Factor, w]
    _ = ‖1 - w‖ * Real.exp w.re := by rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
    _ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ * Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
      exact mul_le_mul (hone.trans hone_exp) (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hre)
        (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = Real.exp (2 * ‖w‖) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ = Real.exp (2 * ‖z‖ / ‖ρ‖) := by
      congr 1
      rw [norm_div]
      ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_hadamardGenus1Factor_le_exp_quadratic
statement:
lemma norm_hadamardGenus1Factor_le_exp_quadratic
    (ρ z : ℂ) :
    ‖hadamardGenus1Factor ρ z‖ ≤
      Real.exp (4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 * (‖ρ‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  let w : ℂ := z / ρ
  have hbound_w : ‖(1 - w) * Complex.exp w‖ ≤ Real.exp (4 * ‖w‖ ^ 2) := by
    by_cases hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1
    · have hdev := genusOneTaylorBoundData.bound w hw
      have hnorm : ‖(1 - w) * Complex.exp w‖ ≤ 1 + 4 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
        calc
          ‖(1 - w) * Complex.exp w‖ =
              ‖1 - (1 - (1 - w) * Complex.exp w)‖ := by
            congr 1
            ring
          _ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖1 - (1 - w) * Complex.exp w‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ 1 + 4 * ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
            simpa using add_le_add_left hdev 1
      exact hnorm.trans (by
        simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp (4 * ‖w‖ ^ 2))
    · have hw_one : 1 ≤ ‖w‖ := le_of_not_ge hw
      have hlin : ‖(1 - w) * Complex.exp w‖ ≤ Real.exp (2 * ‖w‖) := by
        have hre : w.re ≤ ‖w‖ := Complex.re_le_norm _
        have hone : ‖(1 : ℂ) - w‖ ≤ 1 + ‖w‖ := by
          calc
            ‖(1 : ℂ) - w‖ ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ + ‖w‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
            _ = 1 + ‖w‖ := by simp
        calc
          ‖(1 - w) * Complex.exp w‖ = ‖1 - w‖ * Real.exp w.re := by
            rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
          _ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ * Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
            have hone_exp : 1 + ‖w‖ ≤ Real.exp ‖w‖ := by
              simpa [add_comm] using Real.add_one_le_exp ‖w‖
            exact mul_le_mul (hone.trans hone_exp) (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hre)
              (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.exp_pos _).le
          _ = Real.exp (2 * ‖w‖) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]
            congr 1
            ring
      exact hlin.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖w‖]))
  calc
    ‖hadamardGenus1Factor ρ z‖ = ‖(1 - w) * Complex.exp w‖ := by
      simp only [hadamardGenus1Factor, w]
    _ ≤ Real.exp (4 * ‖w‖ ^ 2) := hbound_w
    _ = Real.exp (4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 * (‖ρ‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      congr 1
      rw [norm_div, div_pow, div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_tprod_le_exp_tsum
statement:
lemma norm_tprod_le_exp_tsum
    {ι : Type*} {f : ι → ℂ} {b : ι → ℝ}
    (hf : Multipliable f) (hb : Summable b)
    (hb_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i)
    (hfb : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ Real.exp (b i)) :
    ‖∏' i, f i‖ ≤ Real.exp (∑' i, b i)
proof:
:= by
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun F : Finset ι ↦ ∏ i ∈ F, f i) atTop
      (𝓝 (∏' i, f i)) := hf.hasProd
  have hnormlim : Tendsto (fun F : Finset ι ↦ ‖∏ i ∈ F, f i‖) atTop
      (𝓝 ‖∏' i, f i‖) := hlim.norm
  refine le_of_tendsto' hnormlim (fun F ↦ ?_)
  rw [norm_prod]
  calc
    ∏ i ∈ F, ‖f i‖ ≤ ∏ i ∈ F, Real.exp (b i) := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_prod
      · intro i _hi
        exact norm_nonneg _
      · intro i _hi
        exact hfb i
    _ = Real.exp (∑ i ∈ F, b i) := (Real.exp_sum F b).symm
    _ ≤ Real.exp (∑' i, b i) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hb.sum_le_tsum F fun i _ ↦ hb_nonneg i)

name: OverflowResidueRH.norm_infiniteHadamardProduct_le_exp_split
statement:
lemma norm_infiniteHadamardProduct_le_exp_split
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    (F : Finset ι) (z : ℂ) :
    ‖infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc z‖ ≤
      Real.exp
        ((∑ i ∈ F, 2 * ‖z‖ / ‖zeroLoc i‖) +
          4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
            ∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b : ι → ℝ := fun i ↦
    if i ∈ F then 2 * ‖z‖ / ‖zeroLoc i‖
    else 4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 * (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
  have hb : Summable b := by
    apply Summable.add_compl (s := F) Summable.of_finite
    have htail := (H.inv_sq_summable.subtype (fun i ↦ i ∉ F)).mul_left
      (4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2)
    exact htail.congr (fun i ↦ by simp [b, i.2])
  have hb_nonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i := by
    intro i
    dsimp [b]
    split_ifs <;> positivity
  have hfactor : ∀ i,
      ‖hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) z‖ ≤ Real.exp (b i) := by
    intro i
    dsimp [b]
    split_ifs
    · exact norm_hadamardGenus1Factor_le_exp_linear (zeroLoc i) z
    · exact norm_hadamardGenus1Factor_le_exp_quadratic (zeroLoc i) z
  have hmajor := norm_tprod_le_exp_tsum (H.product_multipliable z) hb
    hb_nonneg hfactor
  have hsum_head :
      ∑ i ∈ F, b i = ∑ i ∈ F, 2 * ‖z‖ / ‖zeroLoc i‖ := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp [b, hi]
  have hsum_tail :
      ∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, b i.1 =
        4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
          ∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [← tsum_mul_left]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro i
    simp [b, i.2]
  have htsum :
      ∑' i, b i =
        (∑ i ∈ F, 2 * ‖z‖ / ‖zeroLoc i‖) +
          4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
            ∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [← hb.sum_add_tsum_subtype_compl F, hsum_head, hsum_tail]
  change ‖∏' i, hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) z‖ ≤ _
  exact hmajor.trans_eq (congrArg Real.exp htsum)

name: OverflowResidueRH.infiniteHadamardProduct_hasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity
statement:
theorem infiniteHadamardProduct_hasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc) :
    HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity
      (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro ε hε
  let a : ι → ℝ := fun i ↦ (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
  have htail_event :
      ∀ᶠ F : Finset ι in atTop,
        (∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, a i.1) < ε / 8 :=
    (tendsto_order.1 (tendsto_tsum_compl_atTop_zero a)).2 _ (by positivity)
  simp only [eventually_atTop, Finset.le_eq_subset] at htail_event
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := htail_event
  have htail :
      (∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) < ε / 8 := by
    simpa [a] using hF F (by rfl)
  let A : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ F, 2 / ‖zeroLoc i‖
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := by
    dsimp [A]
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _hi
    positivity
  let R : ℝ := max 1 (2 * A / ε)
  refine ⟨R, le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  let r : ℝ := ‖z‖
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := norm_nonneg _
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := le_trans (le_max_left (1 : ℝ) (2 * A / ε)) hz
  have hAr : A ≤ (ε / 2) * r := by
    have hdiv : 2 * A / ε ≤ r :=
      le_trans (le_max_right (1 : ℝ) (2 * A / ε)) hz
    have hmul : 2 * A ≤ r * ε := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hdiv
    nlinarith
  have hhead_absorb : A * r ≤ (ε / 2) * r ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith
  have htail_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
    tsum_nonneg fun _ ↦ by positivity
  have htail_absorb :
      4 * r ^ 2 *
          (∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤
        (ε / 2) * r ^ 2 := by
    calc
      4 * r ^ 2 *
          (∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤
          4 * r ^ 2 * (ε / 8) := by
        gcongr
      _ = (ε / 2) * r ^ 2 := by ring
  have hhead_eq :
      (∑ i ∈ F, 2 * r / ‖zeroLoc i‖) = A * r := by
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ F, 2 * r / ‖zeroLoc i‖) =
          ∑ i ∈ F, (2 / ‖zeroLoc i‖) * r := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _hi
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
        ring
      _ = A * r := by simp [A, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hexponent :
      (∑ i ∈ F, 2 * ‖z‖ / ‖zeroLoc i‖) +
          4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
            (∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤
        ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    change (∑ i ∈ F, 2 * r / ‖zeroLoc i‖) +
        4 * r ^ 2 *
          (∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤
      ε * r ^ 2
    rw [hhead_eq]
    nlinarith
  have hnorm := norm_infiniteHadamardProduct_le_exp_split H F z
  have hnorm_eps :
      ‖infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc z‖ ≤ Real.exp (ε * ‖z‖ ^ 2) :=
    hnorm.trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent)
  by_cases hp : infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc z = 0
  · rw [hp, norm_zero, Real.log_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hε.le (sq_nonneg _)
  · exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (norm_pos_iff.mpr hp)).2 hnorm_eps

name: OverflowResidueRH.HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity.mul
statement:
theorem HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity.mul
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hf : HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity f)
    (hg : HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity g) :
    HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨Rf, hRf, hfbound⟩ := hf (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨Rg, hRg, hgbound⟩ := hg (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  let R : ℝ := max Rf Rg
  refine ⟨R, hRf.trans (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hzf : Rf ≤ ‖z‖ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hz
  have hzg : Rg ≤ ‖z‖ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hz
  by_cases hfz : f z = 0
  · rw [Pi.mul_apply, hfz, zero_mul, norm_zero, Real.log_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hε.le (sq_nonneg _)
  by_cases hgz : g z = 0
  · rw [Pi.mul_apply, hgz, mul_zero, norm_zero, Real.log_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg hε.le (sq_nonneg _)
  rw [Pi.mul_apply, norm_mul,
    Real.log_mul (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hfz) (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hgz)]
  nlinarith [hfbound z hzf, hgbound z hzg]

name: OverflowResidueRH.monomial_hasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity
statement:
theorem monomial_hasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity (m : ℕ) :
    HasSubquadraticLogNormGrowthAtInfinity (fun z : ℂ ↦ z ^ m)
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  let R : ℝ := max 1 ((m : ℝ) / ε)
  refine ⟨R, le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  let r : ℝ := ‖z‖
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := le_trans (le_max_left (1 : ℝ) ((m : ℝ) / ε)) hz
  have hrpos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hr1
  have hm : (m : ℝ) ≤ ε * r := by
    have hdiv : (m : ℝ) / ε ≤ r :=
      le_trans (le_max_right (1 : ℝ) ((m : ℝ) / ε)) hz
    simpa [mul_comm] using (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hdiv
  have hlog : Real.log r ≤ r :=
    (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hrpos).trans (by linarith)
  rw [norm_pow, Real.log_pow]
  change (m : ℝ) * Real.log r ≤ ε * r ^ 2
  calc
    (m : ℝ) * Real.log r ≤ (m : ℝ) * r := by gcongr
    _ ≤ ε * r ^ 2 := by nlinarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_expAffineGenusOneProduct
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_expAffineGenusOneProduct
    {C a b : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0)
    {zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ∀ i : ℕ, z ≠ zeroLoc i) :
    logDerivativeResponse (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc) z =
      b + logDerivativeResponse (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) z
proof:
:= by
  let Hluc : HadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData zeroLoc
      (natHadamardFiniteExhaustion H) :=
    natHadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData H
  have hpref_diff :
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * w)) z := by
    fun_prop
  have hprod_diff :
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) z :=
    Hluc.infinite_differentiableAt (Set.mem_univ z)
  have hpref_ne : C * Complex.exp (a + b * z) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero hC (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
  have hprod_ne : infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc z ≠ 0 :=
    H.infiniteProduct_ne_zero hz
  unfold expAffineGenusOneProduct
  rw [logDerivativeResponse_mul_eq_add
      hpref_diff hprod_diff hpref_ne hprod_ne,
    logDerivativeResponse_exp_affine_prefactor hC]

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_zero_im_eq_zero_of_schwarz
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_zero_im_eq_zero_of_schwarz
    (F : ℂ → ℂ) (h_schwarz : ∀ z : ℂ, F (star z) = star (F z)) :
    (logDerivativeResponse F 0).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : conj ∘ F ∘ conj = F := by
    funext z
    change star (F (star z)) = F z
    rw [h_schwarz]
    simp
  have hderiv_eq := congrArg (fun f : ℂ → ℂ => deriv f 0) hfun
  have hderiv_star : star (deriv F 0) = deriv F 0 := by
    rw [deriv_conj_conj] at hderiv_eq
    simpa using hderiv_eq
  have hvalue_star : star (F 0) = F 0 := by
    simpa using (h_schwarz 0).symm
  have hderiv_im : (deriv F 0).im = 0 :=
    Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hderiv_star
  have hvalue_im : (F 0).im = 0 :=
    Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp hvalue_star
  simp [logDerivativeResponse, Complex.div_im, hderiv_im, hvalue_im]

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_infiniteHadamardProduct_zero
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_infiniteHadamardProduct_zero
    {zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ} (H : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc) :
    logDerivativeResponse (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero_ne : ∀ i : ℕ, (0 : ℂ) ≠ zeroLoc i :=
    fun i => (H.zero_ne i).symm
  rw [logDerivativeResponse_infiniteHadamardProduct_eq_tsum_nat H hzero_ne]
  unfold hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
  simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.expAffineGenusOneProduct_slope_real_of_schwarz
statement:
theorem expAffineGenusOneProduct_slope_real_of_schwarz
    {C a b : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ) (H : NatHadamardZeroInvSqData zeroLoc)
    (h_schwarz : ∀ z : ℂ,
      expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc (star z) =
        star (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc z)) :
    b.im = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero_ne : ∀ i : ℕ, (0 : ℂ) ≠ zeroLoc i :=
    fun i => (H.zero_ne i).symm
  have hlog := logDerivativeResponse_expAffineGenusOneProduct
    (a := a) (b := b) hC H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability hzero_ne
  rw [logDerivativeResponse_infiniteHadamardProduct_zero
      H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability,
    add_zero] at hlog
  have him := congrArg Complex.im hlog
  rw [logDerivativeResponse_zero_im_eq_zero_of_schwarz
      (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc) h_schwarz] at him
  exact him.symm

name: OverflowResidueRH.expAffineGenusOneProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_of_zero_sequence_real
statement:
theorem expAffineGenusOneProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_of_zero_sequence_real
    {C a b : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0) (hb : b.im = 0)
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ)
    (H : NatHadamardZeroInvSqData zeroLoc)
    (hreal : ∀ i : ℕ, (zeroLoc i).im = 0) :
    StrictAntiHerglotzUHP
      (logDerivativeResponse (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc))
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hz_ne : ∀ i : ℕ, z ≠ zeroLoc i := by
    intro i hzi
    have him := congrArg Complex.im hzi
    rw [hreal i] at him
    linarith
  rw [logDerivativeResponse_expAffineGenusOneProduct hC
      H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability hz_ne,
    Complex.add_im, hb, zero_add]
  exact infiniteHadamardProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_of_nat_invSqData
    zeroLoc H hreal z hz

name: OverflowResidueRH.expAffineGenusOneProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_zeros_real
statement:
theorem expAffineGenusOneProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_zeros_real
    {C a b : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0) (hb : b.im = 0)
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ)
    (H : NatHadamardZeroInvSqData zeroLoc)
    (h_schwarz : ∀ z : ℂ,
      expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc (star z) =
        star (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc z)) :
    StrictAntiHerglotzUHP
        (logDerivativeResponse
          (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc)) ↔
      ∀ rho : ℂ,
        expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc rho = 0 → rho.im = 0
proof:
:= by
  let Hluc : HadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData zeroLoc
      (natHadamardFiniteExhaustion H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability) :=
    natHadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData
      H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability
  have hdifferentiable :
      Differentiable ℂ (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc) := by
    intro z
    exact (by fun_prop :
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * w)) z).mul
        (Hluc.infinite_differentiableAt (Set.mem_univ z))
  have hanalytic :
      AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc) Set.univ :=
    fun z _hz => hdifferentiable.analyticAt z
  have hnontrivial :
      ∃ z : ℂ, expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc z ≠ 0 := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    simp [expAffineGenusOneProduct, infiniteHadamardProduct_zero,
      hC, Complex.exp_ne_zero]
  constructor
  · intro hstrict
    exact entire_function_roots_real_of_analytic_nontrivial
      (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc)
      hanalytic hnontrivial
      (fun z hz _hz_nonzero => hstrict.antiHerglotz z hz)
      h_schwarz
  · intro hzeros
    apply expAffineGenusOneProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_of_zero_sequence_real
      hC hb zeroLoc H
    intro i
    apply hzeros (zeroLoc i)
    unfold expAffineGenusOneProduct
    rw [infiniteHadamardProduct_eq_zero_at_zeroLoc H.zero_ne i, mul_zero]

name: OverflowResidueRH.expAffineGenusOneProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_zeros_real_of_schwarz
statement:
theorem expAffineGenusOneProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_zeros_real_of_schwarz
    {C a b : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (zeroLoc : ℕ → ℂ)
    (H : NatHadamardZeroInvSqData zeroLoc)
    (h_schwarz : ∀ z : ℂ,
      expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc (star z) =
        star (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc z)) :
    StrictAntiHerglotzUHP
        (logDerivativeResponse
          (expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc)) ↔
      ∀ rho : ℂ,
        expAffineGenusOneProduct C a b zeroLoc rho = 0 → rho.im = 0
proof:
:=
  expAffineGenusOneProduct_strictAntiHerglotz_iff_zeros_real
    hC
    (expAffineGenusOneProduct_slope_real_of_schwarz
      hC zeroLoc H h_schwarz)
    zeroLoc H h_schwarz

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_exp_affine_prefactor
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_exp_affine_prefactor
    {C a b s : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0) :
    logDerivativeResponse
        (fun w : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * w)) s = b
proof:
:= by
  unfold logDerivativeResponse
  have h_aff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => a + b * w) s :=
    (differentiableAt_const _).add
      ((differentiableAt_const _).mul differentiableAt_fun_id)
  have h_deriv_aff :
      deriv (fun w : ℂ => a + b * w) s = b := by
    rw [deriv_fun_add (differentiableAt_const _)
          ((differentiableAt_const _).mul differentiableAt_fun_id),
        deriv_const,
        deriv_fun_mul (differentiableAt_const _) differentiableAt_fun_id,
        deriv_const, deriv_id'']
    ring
  have h_deriv_exp :
      deriv (fun w : ℂ => Complex.exp (a + b * w)) s
        = Complex.exp (a + b * s) * b := by
    rw [deriv_cexp h_aff, h_deriv_aff]
  have h_deriv :
      deriv (fun w : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * w)) s
        = C * (Complex.exp (a + b * s) * b) := by
    rw [deriv_fun_mul (differentiableAt_const _) h_aff.cexp,
        deriv_const, h_deriv_exp]
    ring
  rw [h_deriv]
  have h_exp : Complex.exp (a + b * s) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  field_simp [hC, h_exp]

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardGenus1Factor_analyticOrderAt_self
statement:
theorem hadamardGenus1Factor_analyticOrderAt_self
    {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) :
    analyticOrderAt (hadamardGenus1Factor ρ) ρ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let left : ℂ → ℂ := fun z ↦ 1 - z / ρ
  let right : ℂ → ℂ := fun z ↦ Complex.exp (z / ρ)
  have hleft : AnalyticAt ℂ left ρ := by
    dsimp [left]
    fun_prop
  have hright : AnalyticAt ℂ right ρ := by
    dsimp [right]
    fun_prop
  have hleft_zero : left ρ = 0 := by
    simp [left, hρ]
  have hleft_deriv : deriv left ρ = -(1 / ρ) := by
    dsimp [left]
    simp
  have hleft_order : analyticOrderAt left ρ = 1 :=
    hleft.analyticOrderAt_eq_one_of_zero_deriv_ne_zero hleft_zero (by
      rw [hleft_deriv]
      exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (one_div_ne_zero hρ))
  have hright_order : analyticOrderAt right ρ = 0 :=
    hright.analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mpr (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
  change analyticOrderAt (left * right) ρ = 1
  rw [analyticOrderAt_mul hleft hright, hleft_order, hright_order, add_zero]

name: OverflowResidueRH.infiniteHadamardProduct_analyticOrderAt_eq_fiber_natCard
statement:
theorem infiniteHadamardProduct_analyticOrderAt_eq_fiber_natCard
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (Hinv : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc)
    (ρ : ℂ) :
    analyticOrderAt (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) ρ =
      (Nat.card {i : ι // zeroLoc i = ρ} : ENat)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Set ι := {i | zeroLoc i = ρ}
  change analyticOrderAt (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) ρ =
    (Nat.card s : ENat)
  have hs_finite : s.Finite := Hproper.finite_fiber ρ
  letI : Fintype s := hs_finite.fintype
  let fiberLoc : s → ℂ := fun i ↦ zeroLoc i.1
  let complementLoc : (sᶜ : Set ι) → ℂ := fun i ↦ zeroLoc i.1
  let fiberProduct : ℂ → ℂ := infiniteHadamardProduct fiberLoc
  let complementProduct : ℂ → ℂ := infiniteHadamardProduct complementLoc
  have HcompProper : HadamardZeroNormProper complementLoc :=
    Hproper.subtype (fun i ↦ i ∈ sᶜ)
  have HcompInv : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability complementLoc :=
    Hinv.subtype_of_normProper Hproper (fun i ↦ i ∈ sᶜ)
  have hfiber_eq :
      fiberProduct = fun z ↦ hadamardGenus1Factor ρ z ^ Fintype.card s := by
    funext z
    simp only [fiberProduct, infiniteHadamardProduct, fiberLoc, tprod_fintype]
    calc
      ∏ i : s, hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i.1) z =
          ∏ _i : s, hadamardGenus1Factor ρ z := by
        apply Fintype.prod_congr
        intro i
        rw [i.2]
      _ = hadamardGenus1Factor ρ z ^ Fintype.card s := by simp
  have hsplit : fiberProduct * complementProduct =
      infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc := by
    funext z
    change
      (∏' i : s, hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i.1) z) *
          (∏' i : (sᶜ : Set ι), hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i.1) z) =
        ∏' i, hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) z
    refine Multipliable.tprod_mul_tprod_compl
      (f := fun i : ι ↦ hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) z)
      (s := s) ?_ ?_
    · exact Multipliable.of_finite
    · exact HcompInv.product_multipliable z
  have hfiber_analytic : AnalyticAt ℂ fiberProduct ρ := by
    rw [hfiber_eq]
    exact (hadamardGenus1Factor_differentiable ρ).analyticAt ρ |>.pow _
  have hfiber_order :
      analyticOrderAt fiberProduct ρ = (Fintype.card s : ENat) := by
    rw [hfiber_eq]
    change analyticOrderAt ((hadamardGenus1Factor ρ) ^ Fintype.card s) ρ =
      (Fintype.card s : ENat)
    by_cases hsne : s.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hsne
      have hρ : ρ ≠ 0 := by
        rw [← hi]
        exact Hinv.zero_ne i
      rw [analyticOrderAt_pow
        ((hadamardGenus1Factor_differentiable ρ).analyticAt ρ),
        hadamardGenus1Factor_analyticOrderAt_self hρ]
      simp
    · letI : IsEmpty s := ⟨fun i ↦ hsne ⟨i.1, i.2⟩⟩
      have hcard : Fintype.card s = 0 := Fintype.card_eq_zero
      simp [analyticOrderAt_eq_zero]
  have hcomp_diff : Differentiable ℂ complementProduct :=
    infiniteHadamardProduct_differentiable_of_invSq_normProper HcompInv HcompProper
  have hcomp_ne : complementProduct ρ ≠ 0 := by
    apply HcompInv.infiniteProduct_ne_zero
    intro i hi
    exact i.2 hi.symm
  have hcomp_order : analyticOrderAt complementProduct ρ = 0 :=
    (hcomp_diff.analyticAt ρ).analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mpr hcomp_ne
  rw [← hsplit,
    analyticOrderAt_mul hfiber_analytic (hcomp_diff.analyticAt ρ),
    hfiber_order, hcomp_order, add_zero]
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_infiniteHadamardProduct_eq_tsum_indexed
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_infiniteHadamardProduct_eq_tsum_indexed
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (Hinv : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability zeroLoc)
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ∀ i : ι, z ≠ zeroLoc i) :
    logDerivativeResponse (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) z =
      hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries zeroLoc z
proof:
:= by
  let Hex : HadamardFiniteExhaustion zeroLoc :=
    HadamardFiniteExhaustion.of_invSq_mono_exhaustive Hinv
      Hproper.normExhaustion Hproper.normExhaustion_mono
      Hproper.normExhaustion_exhaustive
  let HlucSeq : HadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData zeroLoc Hex :=
    HadamardProductLocallyUniformLimitData.of_invSq_univ Hinv Hex
      Hproper.normExhaustion_exhaustive
  let HderivAll : HadamardFiniteDerivativeLimitData zeroLoc Hex :=
    HadamardFiniteDerivativeLimitData.of_locallyUniformProduct HlucSeq
  let Hderiv : HadamardFiniteDerivativeLimitData zeroLoc Hex :=
    { region := {z}
      derivative_tendsto := by
        intro s hs
        have hsz : s = z := by simpa using hs
        subst s
        exact HderivAll.derivative_tendsto z (mem_univ z) }
  let Hlog : HadamardLogDerivLimitData zeroLoc :=
    HadamardLogDerivLimitData.of_finiteDerivativeLimitData_invSq
      Hinv Hderiv
      (by
        intro s hs
        have hsz : s = z := by simpa [Hderiv] using hs
        subst s
        exact HlucSeq.infinite_differentiableAt (mem_univ z))
      (by
        intro s hs i
        have hsz : s = z := by simpa [Hderiv] using hs
        subst s
        exact hz i)
  apply Hlog.logDeriv_eq_tsum_at z
  change z ∈ ({z} : Set ℂ)
  simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.pow_two_pred_lt_norm_of_hadamardZeroDyadicBin_eq
statement:
theorem pow_two_pred_lt_norm_of_hadamardZeroDyadicBin_eq
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ} {i : ι} {n : Nat}
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hi : hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n) :
    (2 : Real) ^ (n - 1) < ‖zeroLoc i‖
proof:
:= by
  have hceil_one : 1 < Nat.ceil ‖zeroLoc i‖ := by
    by_contra h
    have hle : Nat.ceil ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ 1 := Nat.le_of_not_gt h
    have hclog : hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = 0 := by
      unfold hadamardZeroDyadicBin
      exact Nat.clog_of_right_le_one hle 2
    omega
  have hp := Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self Nat.one_lt_two hceil_one
  unfold hadamardZeroDyadicBin at hi
  rw [hi] at hp
  simpa [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one] using Nat.lt_ceil.mp hp

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardZeroDyadicBin_finite

theorem hadamardZeroDyadicBin_finite
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}

proof:

name: OverflowResidueRH.pow_two_mul_inv_sq_pred_eq_of_pos

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass_le_ballCard_mul
statement:
theorem hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass_le_ballCard_mul
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass zeroLoc n ≤
      (hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard zeroLoc n : Real) *
        ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsub :
      {i : ι | hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} ⊆
        {i : ι | ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n} := by
    intro i hi
    have h := hadamardZero_norm_le_pow_two_dyadicBin zeroLoc i
    rw [hi] at h
    exact h
  have hcard :
      Nat.card {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} ≤
        Nat.card {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n} := by
    let f : {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} →
        {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n} :=
      fun i ↦ ⟨i.1, hsub i.2⟩
    letI : Finite {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n} :=
      Hproper.finite_norm_le ((2 : Real) ^ n)
    exact Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f (by
      intro i j hij
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg
        (fun x : {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n} ↦ x.1) hij)
  haveI : Fintype {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} :=
    (hadamardZeroDyadicBin_finite Hproper n).fintype
  unfold hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard
  rw [tsum_fintype]
  calc
    ∑ i : {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n},
        (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
        ≤ ∑ _i : {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n},
            ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _hi
          have hlower :=
            pow_two_pred_lt_norm_of_hadamardZeroDyadicBin_eq hn i.2
          have hpow_pos : 0 < (2 : Real) ^ (n - 1) := by positivity
          have hnorm_pos : 0 < ‖zeroLoc i.1‖ := lt_trans hpow_pos hlower
          apply
            (inv_le_inv₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hnorm_pos)
              (sq_pos_of_pos hpow_pos)).mpr
          nlinarith [hlower]
    _ = (Fintype.card
          {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} : Real) *
          ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ = (Nat.card
          {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} : Real) *
          ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    _ ≤ (Nat.card
          {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n} : Real) *
          ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
        gcongr

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant_summable
statement:
theorem hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant_summable (C C₀ : Real) :
    Summable (hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant C C₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf :
      Summable (fun n : Nat ↦ (n : Real) * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ n) := by
    simpa using
      (summable_pow_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (R := Real) 1
        (r := (1 / 2 : Real)) (by norm_num))
  have hhalf_succ :
      Summable
        (fun n : Nat ↦ ((n + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ n) := by
    simpa [Nat.cast_add, add_mul] using hhalf.add summable_geometric_two
  have hquarter : Summable (fun n : Nat ↦ (1 / 4 : Real) ^ n) :=
    summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by positivity) (by norm_num)
  refine
    ((hhalf_succ.mul_left (4 * C)).add
      (hquarter.mul_left (4 * C₀))).congr ?_
  intro n
  unfold hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.shellInvSqMass_summable
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.shellInvSqMass_summable
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData zeroLoc) :
    Summable (hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass zeroLoc)
proof:
:= by
  let shift := H.lower + 1
  refine (summable_nat_add_iff shift).mp ?_
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
    (f := fun n ↦ hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant H.C H.C₀ (n + shift))
    (g := fun n ↦ hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass zeroLoc (n + shift))
    (fun n ↦ hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass_nonneg zeroLoc (n + shift)) ?_ ?_
  · intro n
    have hm_one : 1 ≤ n + shift := by
      dsimp [shift]
      omega
    have hm_lower : H.lower ≤ n + shift := by
      dsimp [shift]
      omega
    have hmass :=
      hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass_le_ballCard_mul
        H.normProper (n + shift) hm_one
    have hcount := H.count_le (n + shift) hm_lower
    have hinv_nonneg :
        0 ≤ ((((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by positivity
    calc
      hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass zeroLoc (n + shift)
          ≤ (hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard zeroLoc (n + shift) : Real) *
              ((((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := hmass
      _ ≤ (H.C * (((n + shift) + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
              (2 : Real) ^ (n + shift) + H.C₀) *
              ((((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount hinv_nonneg
      _ = hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant H.C H.C₀ (n + shift) := by
          unfold hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant
          have hratio :=
            pow_two_mul_inv_sq_pred_eq_of_pos (n + shift) hm_one
          have hratio₀ :=
            inv_sq_pow_two_pred_eq_of_pos (n + shift) hm_one
          calc
            (H.C * (((n + shift) + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
                (2 : Real) ^ (n + shift) + H.C₀) *
                ((((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) =
                H.C * (((n + shift) + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
                    ((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift) *
                      ((((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹)) +
                  H.C₀ *
                    ((((2 : Real) ^ (n + shift - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
                      ring
            _ = 4 * H.C * (((n + shift) + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
                  (1 / 2 : Real) ^ (n + shift) +
                4 * H.C₀ * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ (n + shift) := by
                    rw [hratio, hratio₀]
                    ring
  · exact
      (hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant_summable H.C H.C₀).comp_injective
        (fun _ _ h ↦ Nat.add_right_cancel h)

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.invSq_summable
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.invSq_summable
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}

    Summable fun i : ι ↦ (‖zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  refine summable_of_nonneg_fiber_tsum_le
    (hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc) (fun _ ↦ by positivity)
    (hadamardZeroDyadicBin_finite H.normProper)
    H.shellInvSqMass_summable ?_
  intro n
  exact le_rfl

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardGenus1Factor_ne_zero
statement:
lemma hadamardGenus1Factor_ne_zero {ρ s : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) (hsρ : s ≠ ρ) :
    hadamardGenus1Factor ρ s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold hadamardGenus1Factor
  apply mul_ne_zero
  · intro h
    have h1 : s / ρ = 1 := by linear_combination -h
    have h2 : s = ρ := by
      have := h1
      field_simp at this
      exact this
    exact hsρ h2
  · exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardGenus1Factor_differentiableAt
statement:
lemma hadamardGenus1Factor_differentiableAt (ρ s : ℂ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (hadamardGenus1Factor ρ) s
proof:
:= by
  unfold hadamardGenus1Factor
  have h_left : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y : ℂ => 1 - y / ρ) s :=
    (differentiableAt_const _).sub (differentiableAt_fun_id.div_const _)
  have h_inner : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y : ℂ => y / ρ) s :=
    differentiableAt_fun_id.div_const _
  have h_right : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y : ℂ => Complex.exp (y / ρ)) s :=
    h_inner.cexp
  exact h_left.mul h_right

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_eq_logDeriv
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_eq_logDeriv (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :

proof: := rfl

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_mul_eq_add
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_mul_eq_add
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (hf_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ f s)
    (hg_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ g s)
    (hf_ne : f s ≠ 0)
    (hg_ne : g s ≠ 0) :
    logDerivativeResponse (fun w : ℂ => f w * g w) s
      = logDerivativeResponse f s + logDerivativeResponse g s
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDerivativeResponse_eq_logDeriv,
      logDeriv_mul s hf_ne hg_ne hf_diff hg_diff,
      ← logDerivativeResponse_eq_logDeriv (f := f),
      ← logDerivativeResponse_eq_logDeriv (f := g)]

name: OverflowResidueRH.deriv_div_eq_zero_of_logDerivativeResponse_eq
statement:
theorem deriv_div_eq_zero_of_logDerivativeResponse_eq
    {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (hf_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ f s)
    (hg_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ g s)
    (hf_ne : f s ≠ 0)
    (hg_ne : g s ≠ 0)
    (hlog : logDerivativeResponse f s = logDerivativeResponse g s) :
    deriv (fun w : ℂ => f w / g w) s = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold logDerivativeResponse at hlog
  rw [deriv_fun_div hf_diff hg_diff hg_ne]
  field_simp [hf_ne, hg_ne] at hlog ⊢
  ring_nf at hlog ⊢
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hlog

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDeriv_hadamardGenus1Factor
statement:
theorem logDeriv_hadamardGenus1Factor {ρ s : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ ρ) :
    logDeriv (hadamardGenus1Factor ρ) s = 1 / (s - ρ) + 1 / ρ
proof:
:= by
  have h_left_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y : ℂ => 1 - y/ρ) s :=
    (differentiableAt_const _).sub (differentiableAt_fun_id.div_const _)
  have h_inner_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y : ℂ => y/ρ) s :=
    differentiableAt_fun_id.div_const _
  have h_right_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun y : ℂ => Complex.exp (y/ρ)) s :=
    h_inner_diff.cexp
  have hsmρ : s - ρ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hs
  have h_left_ne : (1 : ℂ) - s/ρ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 : s/ρ = 1 := by linear_combination -h
    apply hs
    field_simp at h1
    exact h1
  have h_exp_ne : Complex.exp (s/ρ) ≠ 0 := Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  have h_deriv_inner : deriv (fun y : ℂ => y/ρ) s = 1/ρ := by
    rw [deriv_div_const, deriv_id'']
  have h_deriv_left : deriv (fun y : ℂ => 1 - y/ρ) s = -(1/ρ) := by
    rw [deriv_fun_sub (differentiableAt_const _) (differentiableAt_fun_id.div_const _),
        deriv_const, h_deriv_inner]
    ring
  have h_deriv_right : deriv (fun y : ℂ => Complex.exp (y/ρ)) s
      = Complex.exp (s/ρ) * (1/ρ) := by
    rw [deriv_cexp h_inner_diff, h_deriv_inner]
  have hρs : ρ - s ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hs)
  rw [logDeriv_apply]
  unfold hadamardGenus1Factor
  rw [deriv_fun_mul h_left_diff h_right_diff, h_deriv_left, h_deriv_right]
  rw [show -(1 / ρ) * Complex.exp (s / ρ)
            + (1 - s / ρ) * (Complex.exp (s / ρ) * (1 / ρ))
          = Complex.exp (s / ρ) * (-(1 / ρ) + (1 - s / ρ) * (1 / ρ)) from by ring,
      show (1 - s / ρ) * Complex.exp (s / ρ)
          = Complex.exp (s / ρ) * (1 - s / ρ) from by ring,
      mul_div_mul_left _ _ h_exp_ne]
  rw [show -(1 / ρ) + (1 - s / ρ) * (1 / ρ) = -s / ρ ^ 2 from by
        field_simp; ring]
  rw [show (1 : ℂ) - s / ρ = (ρ - s) / ρ from by field_simp]
  field_simp
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_hadamardGenus1Factor
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_hadamardGenus1Factor
    {ρ s : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ ρ) :
    logDerivativeResponse (hadamardGenus1Factor ρ) s = 1 / (s - ρ) + 1 / ρ
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDerivativeResponse_eq_logDeriv]

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardGenus1Factor_neg_location
statement:
theorem hadamardGenus1Factor_neg_location (ρ z : ℂ) :

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardGenus1Factor_mul_neg_location
statement:
theorem hadamardGenus1Factor_mul_neg_location
    {ρ z : ℂ} (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) :
    hadamardGenus1Factor ρ z * hadamardGenus1Factor (-ρ) z =
      1 - (z / ρ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by

  unfold hadamardGenus1Factor

name: OverflowResidueRH.infiniteHadamardProduct_even_of_neg_equiv
statement:
theorem infiniteHadamardProduct_even_of_neg_equiv
    {ι : Type*} (zeroLoc : ι → ℂ) (e : ι ≃ ι)
    (he : ∀ i : ι, zeroLoc (e i) = -zeroLoc i) (z : ℂ) :
    infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc (-z) =
      infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc z
proof:
:= by
  unfold infiniteHadamardProduct
  calc
    ∏' i : ι, hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) (-z) =
        ∏' i : ι, hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc (e i)) z := by
      apply tprod_congr
      intro i
      rw [he i]
      exact (hadamardGenus1Factor_neg_location (zeroLoc i) z).symm
    _ = ∏' i : ι, hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) z :=
      e.tprod_eq (fun i : ι ↦ hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) z)

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDeriv_finiteHadamardProduct
statement:
theorem logDeriv_finiteHadamardProduct
    {zeros : Finset ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (hρ_ne : ∀ ρ ∈ zeros, ρ ≠ 0)
    (hs_ne : ∀ ρ ∈ zeros, s ≠ ρ) :
    logDeriv (finiteHadamardProduct zeros) s
      = ∑ ρ ∈ zeros, logDeriv (hadamardGenus1Factor ρ) s
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteHadamardProduct
  exact logDeriv_prod
    (fun ρ hρ => hadamardGenus1Factor_ne_zero (hρ_ne ρ hρ) (hs_ne ρ hρ))
    (fun ρ _ => hadamardGenus1Factor_differentiableAt ρ s)

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_finiteHadamardProduct
statement:

      = ∑ ρ ∈ zeros, logDerivativeResponse (hadamardGenus1Factor ρ) s

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDeriv_finiteHadamardProduct_regularized
statement:
theorem logDeriv_finiteHadamardProduct_regularized
    {zeros : Finset ℂ} {s : ℂ}

    (hs_ne : ∀ ρ ∈ zeros, s ≠ ρ) :

      = ∑ ρ ∈ zeros, (1 / (s - ρ) + 1 / ρ)

  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_finiteHadamardProduct_regularized

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDeriv_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct
statement:
theorem logDeriv_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ} {F : Finset ι} {s : ℂ}
    (hρ : ∀ i ∈ F, zeroLoc i ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ i ∈ F, s ≠ zeroLoc i) :
    logDeriv (fun s' : ℂ => indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc F s') s
      = finiteHadamardRegularizedSum zeroLoc F s
proof:
:= by
  unfold indexedFiniteHadamardProduct finiteHadamardRegularizedSum
  rw [logDeriv_prod (f := fun i => fun s' => hadamardGenus1Factor (zeroLoc i) s')
        (fun i hi => hadamardGenus1Factor_ne_zero (hρ i hi) (hs i hi))
        (fun i _ => hadamardGenus1Factor_differentiableAt (zeroLoc i) s)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact logDeriv_hadamardGenus1Factor (hρ i hi) (hs i hi)

name: OverflowResidueRH.logDerivativeResponse_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct
statement:
theorem logDerivativeResponse_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct

    (hρ : ∀ i ∈ F, zeroLoc i ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ i ∈ F, s ≠ zeroLoc i) :
    logDerivativeResponse
        (fun s' : ℂ => indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc F s') s
      = finiteHadamardRegularizedSum zeroLoc F s

name: OverflowResidueRH.deriv_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct
statement:
theorem deriv_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ} {F : Finset ι} {s : ℂ}
    (hρ : ∀ i ∈ F, zeroLoc i ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ i ∈ F, s ≠ zeroLoc i) :
    deriv (fun s' : ℂ => indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc F s') s
      =
    indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc F s
      * finiteHadamardRegularizedSum zeroLoc F s
proof:
:= by
  have hprod_ne :
      indexedFiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc F s ≠ 0 := by
    unfold indexedFiniteHadamardProduct
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (by
      intro i hi
      exact hadamardGenus1Factor_ne_zero (hρ i hi) (hs i hi))
  have hlog :=
    logDeriv_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct
      (zeroLoc := zeroLoc) (F := F) (s := s) hρ hs
  simp only [logDeriv_apply] at hlog
  field_simp [hprod_ne] at hlog
  exact hlog

name: OverflowResidueRH.deriv_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_eq_response

theorem deriv_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_eq_response

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc_fiber_natCard
statement:
theorem entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc_fiber_natCard
    {z : ℂ} (hz0 : z ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence //
        entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i = z} =
      analyticOrderNatAt EntireXiPullback z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : EntireXiPullback z = 0
  · let ρ : EntireXiPullbackNonzeroZero := ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩
    calc
      Nat.card {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence //
          entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i = z} =
          Nat.card {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence // i.1 = ρ} := by
        exact Nat.card_congr
          (entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLocFiberEquiv ρ)
      _ = analyticOrderNatAt EntireXiPullback z := by
        simpa [ρ] using entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence_fiber_natCard ρ
  · letI : IsEmpty {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence //
        entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i = z} :=
      ⟨fun i ↦ hz (by
        rw [← i.2]
        exact entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc_is_zero i.1)⟩
    have horder : analyticOrderAt EntireXiPullback z = 0 :=
      (EntireXiPullback_analyticAt z).analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mpr hz
    simp [analyticOrderNatAt, horder]

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_differentiable
statement:
theorem entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_differentiable
    (H : EntireXiPullbackCanonicalZeroDistribution) :
    Differentiable ℂ entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct
proof:
:= by
  have hmonomial : Differentiable ℂ
      (fun z : ℂ ↦ z ^ entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity) := by
    fun_prop
  have hproduct : Differentiable ℂ
      (infiniteHadamardProduct entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc) :=
    infiniteHadamardProduct_differentiable_of_invSq_normProper
      H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability
      entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceNormProper
  exact hmonomial.mul hproduct

name: OverflowResidueRH.analyticOrderAt_monomial_zero
statement:
theorem analyticOrderAt_monomial_zero (m : ℕ) :
    analyticOrderAt (fun z : ℂ ↦ z ^ m) 0 = (m : ENat)
proof:
:= by
  change analyticOrderAt ((id : ℂ → ℂ) ^ m) (0 : ℂ) = (m : ENat)
  rw [analyticOrderAt_pow analyticAt_id, analyticOrderAt_id]
  simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_analyticOrderAt
statement:
theorem entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct_analyticOrderAt
    (H : EntireXiPullbackCanonicalZeroDistribution) (z : ℂ) :
    analyticOrderAt entireXiPullbackCanonicalProduct z =
      analyticOrderAt EntireXiPullback z
proof:
:= by
  let Hinv : HadamardZeroInvSqSummability
      entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc :=
    H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability
  have hmonomial : AnalyticAt ℂ
      (fun w : ℂ ↦ w ^ entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity) z := by
    fun_prop
  have hproduct : AnalyticAt ℂ
      (infiniteHadamardProduct entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc) z :=
    (infiniteHadamardProduct_differentiable_of_invSq_normProper
      Hinv entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceNormProper).analyticAt z
  change analyticOrderAt
      ((fun w : ℂ ↦ w ^ entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity) *
        infiniteHadamardProduct entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc) z =
    analyticOrderAt EntireXiPullback z
  rw [analyticOrderAt_mul hmonomial hproduct,
    infiniteHadamardProduct_analyticOrderAt_eq_fiber_natCard
      Hinv entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceNormProper z]
  by_cases hz0 : z = 0
  · subst z
    letI : IsEmpty {i : EntireXiPullbackZeroOccurrence //
        entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc i = 0} :=
      ⟨fun i ↦ entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc_ne_zero i.1 i.2⟩
    rw [Nat.card_of_isEmpty]
    simp only [ENat.coe_zero, add_zero]
    rw [analyticOrderAt_monomial_zero,
      entireXiPullback_analyticOrderAt_zero]
  · rw [hmonomial.analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mpr
        (pow_ne_zero entireXiPullbackOriginMultiplicity hz0),
      zero_add,
      entireXiPullbackZeroOccurrenceLoc_fiber_natCard hz0,
      Nat.cast_analyticOrderNatAt
        (entireXiPullback_analyticOrderAt_ne_top z)]

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass_nonneg
statement:

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardZeroDyadicBelow_finite
statement:
theorem hadamardZeroDyadicBelow_finite
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) (lower : Nat) :
    {i : ι | hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i < lower}.Finite
proof:

  refine (Hproper.finite_norm_le ((2 : Real) ^ lower)).subset ?_
  intro i hi
  exact (hadamardZero_norm_le_pow_two_dyadicBin zeroLoc i).trans
    (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : Real) ≤ 2) (Nat.le_of_lt hi))

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass_nonneg

name: OverflowResidueRH.hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass_le_ballCard_mul
statement:
theorem hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass_le_ballCard_mul
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass zeroLoc n ≤
      (hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard zeroLoc n : Real) *
        ((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsub :
      {i : ι | hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} ⊆
        {i : ι | ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n} := by
    intro i hi
    have h := hadamardZero_norm_le_pow_two_dyadicBin zeroLoc i
    rw [hi] at h
    exact h
  have hcard :
      Nat.card {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} ≤
        Nat.card {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n} := by
    let f : {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} →
        {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n} :=
      fun i ↦ ⟨i.1, hsub i.2⟩
    letI : Finite {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n} :=
      Hproper.finite_norm_le ((2 : Real) ^ n)
    exact Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f (by
      intro i j hij
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg
        (fun x : {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n} ↦ x.1) hij)
  haveI : Fintype {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} :=
    (hadamardZeroDyadicBin_finite Hproper n).fintype
  unfold hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard
  rw [tsum_fintype]
  calc
    ∑ i : {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n},
        ‖zeroLoc i.1‖⁻¹
        ≤ ∑ _i : {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n},
            ((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹ := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _hi
          have hlower :=
            pow_two_pred_lt_norm_of_hadamardZeroDyadicBin_eq hn i.2
          have hpow_pos : 0 < (2 : Real) ^ (n - 1) := by positivity
          have hnorm_pos : 0 < ‖zeroLoc i.1‖ := lt_trans hpow_pos hlower
          exact (inv_le_inv₀ hnorm_pos hpow_pos).2 hlower.le
    _ = (Fintype.card
          {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} : Real) *
          ((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ = (Nat.card
          {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} : Real) *
          ((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹ := by
        rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    _ ≤ (Nat.card
          {i : ι // ‖zeroLoc i‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ n} : Real) *
          ((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹ := by
        gcongr

name: OverflowResidueRH.pow_two_mul_inv_pred_eq_of_pos
statement:
private lemma pow_two_mul_inv_pred_eq_of_pos (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (2 : Real) ^ n * ((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹ = 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ]
  field_simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.inv_pow_two_pred_eq_of_pos
statement:
private lemma inv_pow_two_pred_eq_of_pos (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹ = 2 * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ, div_pow]
  field_simp
  simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.pow_two_mul_inv_sq_pred_eq_of_pos_explicit
statement:
private lemma pow_two_mul_inv_sq_pred_eq_of_pos_explicit
    (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (2 : Real) ^ n * ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) =
      4 * ((1 / 2 : Real) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  norm_num [div_pow, pow_succ]
  field_simp
  norm_num

name: OverflowResidueRH.inv_sq_pow_two_pred_eq_of_pos_explicit
statement:
private lemma inv_sq_pow_two_pred_eq_of_pos_explicit
    (n : Nat) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) =
      4 * ((1 / 4 : Real) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  norm_num [div_pow, pow_succ]
  field_simp
  rw [show (4 : Real) = 2 * 2 by norm_num, mul_pow]
  rw [pow_two]

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.shellInvMass_le
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.shellInvMass_le
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData zeroLoc)
    (n : Nat) (hn_one : 1 ≤ n) (hn_lower : H.lower ≤ n) :
    hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass zeroLoc n ≤
      2 * H.C * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Real) +
        2 * H.C₀ * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hmass :=
    hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass_le_ballCard_mul H.normProper n hn_one
  have hcount := H.count_le n hn_lower
  have hinv_nonneg : 0 ≤ ((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹ := by positivity
  calc
    hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass zeroLoc n ≤
        (hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard zeroLoc n : Real) *
          ((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹ := hmass
    _ ≤ (H.C * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ n + H.C₀) *
          ((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount hinv_nonneg
    _ = H.C * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
          ((2 : Real) ^ n * ((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹) +
        H.C₀ * ((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = H.C * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Real) * 2 +
        H.C₀ * (2 * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ n) := by
      rw [pow_two_mul_inv_pred_eq_of_pos n hn_one,
        inv_pow_two_pred_eq_of_pos n hn_one]
    _ = 2 * H.C * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Real) +
          2 * H.C₀ * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ n := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.shellInvSqMass_le
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.shellInvSqMass_le
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData zeroLoc)
    (n : Nat) (hn_one : 1 ≤ n) (hn_lower : H.lower ≤ n) :
    hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass zeroLoc n ≤
      hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant H.C H.C₀ n
proof:
:= by
  have hmass :=
    hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass_le_ballCard_mul H.normProper n hn_one
  have hcount := H.count_le n hn_lower
  have hinv_nonneg : 0 ≤ ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by positivity
  calc
    hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass zeroLoc n ≤
        (hadamardZeroDyadicBallCard zeroLoc n : Real) *
          ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := hmass
    _ ≤ (H.C * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Real) * (2 : Real) ^ n + H.C₀) *
          ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcount hinv_nonneg
    _ = H.C * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
          ((2 : Real) ^ n * ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹)) +
        H.C₀ * ((((2 : Real) ^ (n - 1)) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by ring
    _ = H.C * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
          (4 * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ n) +
        H.C₀ * (4 * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ n) := by
      rw [pow_two_mul_inv_sq_pred_eq_of_pos_explicit n hn_one,
        inv_sq_pow_two_pred_eq_of_pos_explicit n hn_one]
    _ = hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant H.C H.C₀ n := by
      unfold hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant
      ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.mem_hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset

@[simp] theorem mem_hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset

      hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i ≤ K
proof:
:= by

statement:
private lemma hasSum_half_explicit :
    HasSum (fun j : Nat ↦ (1 / 2 : Real) ^ j) 2

    hasSum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one (K := Real) (ξ := (1 / 2 : Real))
