name: OverflowResidueRH.hasSum_hadamardDyadicWeightedHalf_tail
statement:
theorem hasSum_hadamardDyadicWeightedHalf_tail (K : Nat) :
    HasSum
      (fun j : Nat ↦ (((K + 1 + j) + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
        (1 / 2 : Real) ^ (K + 1 + j))
      (((K + 3 : Nat) : Real) * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ K)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasSum_nat_mul_half_explicit.add
    (hasSum_half_explicit.mul_left ((K + 2 : Nat) : Real))
  have hs := h.mul_left ((1 / 2 : Real) ^ (K + 1))
  have hvalue :
      (1 / 2 : Real) ^ (K + 1) * (2 + ((K + 2 : Nat) : Real) * 2) =
        ((K + 3 : Nat) : Real) * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ K := by
    push_cast
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring
  have hfun :
      (fun j : Nat ↦ (((K + 1 + j) + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
        (1 / 2 : Real) ^ (K + 1 + j)) =
      (fun j : Nat ↦ (1 / 2 : Real) ^ (K + 1) *
        ((j : Real) * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ j +
          ((K + 2 : Nat) : Real) * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ j)) := by
    funext j
    push_cast
    rw [pow_add]
    ring
  rw [hfun, ← hvalue]
  exact hs

name: OverflowResidueRH.hasSum_hadamardDyadicQuarter_tail
statement:
theorem hasSum_hadamardDyadicQuarter_tail (K : Nat) :
    HasSum (fun j : Nat ↦ (1 / 4 : Real) ^ (K + 1 + j))
      ((1 / 3 : Real) * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ K)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := hasSum_quarter_explicit.mul_left ((1 / 4 : Real) ^ (K + 1))
  have hvalue :
      (1 / 4 : Real) ^ (K + 1) * (4 / 3) =
        (1 / 3 : Real) * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ K := by
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring
  have hfun :
      (fun j : Nat ↦ (1 / 4 : Real) ^ (K + 1 + j)) =
      (fun j : Nat ↦ (1 / 4 : Real) ^ (K + 1) *
        (1 / 4 : Real) ^ j) := by
    funext j
    rw [pow_add]
  rw [hfun, ← hvalue]
  exact hs

name: OverflowResidueRH.sum_hadamardZeroDyadicHead_inv_eq_sum_shellInvMass
statement:
theorem sum_hadamardZeroDyadicHead_inv_eq_sum_shellInvMass
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) (K : Nat) :
    (∑ i ∈ hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset Hproper K, ‖zeroLoc i‖⁻¹) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
        hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass zeroLoc n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset Hproper K
  have hmaps : ∀ i ∈ F,
      hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i ∈ Finset.range (K + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    have hi' : hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i ≤ K := by
      simpa [F] using hi
    omega
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro n hn
  have hnK : n ≤ K := by
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hn
    omega
  haveI : Fintype {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n} :=
    (hadamardZeroDyadicBin_finite Hproper n).fintype
  unfold hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass
  rw [tsum_fintype]
  change (∑ i ∈ F with hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n,
      ‖zeroLoc i‖⁻¹) =
    ∑ i : {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n},
      ‖zeroLoc i.1‖⁻¹
  refine Finset.sum_bij
    (fun i hi ↦
      (⟨i, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2⟩ :
        {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = n})) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro i hi
    simp
  · intro i₁ hi₁ i₂ hi₂ heq
    exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
  · intro j hj
    refine ⟨j.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨?_, j.2⟩
      rw [mem_hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset]
      simpa [j.2] using hnK
    · exact Subtype.ext (by rfl)
  · intro i hi
    rfl

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.sum_head_inv_le
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.sum_head_inv_le
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData zeroLoc)
    (K : Nat) (hK_one : 1 ≤ K) (hK_lower : H.lower ≤ K) :
    (∑ i ∈ hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset H.normProper K,
        ‖zeroLoc i‖⁻¹) ≤
      hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass zeroLoc (max 1 H.lower) +
        ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
          (2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) + 2 * H.C₀)
proof:
:= by
  let L : Nat := max 1 H.lower
  have hL_one : 1 ≤ L := le_max_left _ _
  have hL_lower : H.lower ≤ L := le_max_right _ _
  have hLK : L ≤ K := max_le hK_one hK_lower
  have hLK1 : L ≤ K + 1 := hLK.trans (Nat.le_add_right K 1)
  rw [sum_hadamardZeroDyadicHead_inv_eq_sum_shellInvMass H.normProper K]
  have hhigh :
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico L (K + 1),
          hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass zeroLoc n) ≤
        ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
          (2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) + 2 * H.C₀) := by
    calc
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico L (K + 1),
          hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass zeroLoc n) ≤
          ∑ _n ∈ Finset.Ico L (K + 1),
            (2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) + 2 * H.C₀) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro n hn
        have hnL : L ≤ n := (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hn).1
        have hnK : n ≤ K := by
          have := (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hn).2
          omega
        have hshell := H.shellInvMass_le n
          (hL_one.trans hnL) (hL_lower.trans hnL)
        have hcast : ((n + 1 : Nat) : Real) ≤ ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hnK 1
        have hpow : (1 / 2 : Real) ^ n ≤ 1 :=
          pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        have hCpart :
            2 * H.C * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Real) ≤
              2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcast
            (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C_nonneg)
        have hC₀part :
            2 * H.C₀ * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ n ≤ 2 * H.C₀ := by
          calc
            2 * H.C₀ * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ n ≤ 2 * H.C₀ * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow
                (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C₀_nonneg)
            _ = 2 * H.C₀ := by ring
        calc
          hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass zeroLoc n ≤
              2 * H.C * ((n + 1 : Nat) : Real) +
                2 * H.C₀ * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ n := hshell
          _ ≤ 2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) + 2 * H.C₀ :=
            add_le_add hCpart hC₀part
      _ = (((K + 1 - L : Nat) : Real)) *
          (2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) + 2 * H.C₀) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        simp
      _ ≤ ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
          (2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) + 2 * H.C₀) := by
        have hcast : (((K + 1 - L : Nat) : Real)) ≤
            ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) := by
          exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le (K + 1) L
        have hfactor :
            0 ≤ 2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) + 2 * H.C₀ :=
          add_nonneg
            (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C_nonneg) (by positivity))
            (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C₀_nonneg)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcast hfactor
  have hsplit := Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico
    (fun n ↦ hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass zeroLoc n) hLK1
  calc
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
        hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass zeroLoc n) =
        hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass zeroLoc L +
          ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico L (K + 1),
            hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvMass zeroLoc n := by
      unfold hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass
      exact hsplit.symm
    _ ≤ hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass zeroLoc L +
        ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
          (2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) + 2 * H.C₀) :=
      add_le_add_right hhigh _
    _ = hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass zeroLoc (max 1 H.lower) +
        ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
          (2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) + 2 * H.C₀) := by rfl

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.tailInvSqMass_le
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.tailInvSqMass_le
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData zeroLoc)
    (K : Nat) (hK_lower : H.lower ≤ K) :
    (∑' i : {i : ι // K < hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i},
        (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤
      4 * H.C * (((K + 3 : Nat) : Real) * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ K) +
        4 * H.C₀ * ((1 / 3 : Real) * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ K)
proof:
:= by
  let tail : Set ι := {i | K < hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i}
  let f : tail → Real := fun i ↦ (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
  let g : tail → Nat :=
    fun i ↦ hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i.1 - (K + 1)
  have hf : Summable f := by
    exact H.invSq_summable.subtype tail
  have hregroup := hf.hasSum.tsum_fiberwise g
  have hfiber_le : ∀ j : Nat,
      (∑' x : g ⁻¹' {j}, f x.1) ≤
        hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass zeroLoc (K + 1 + j) := by
    intro j
    let e : (g ⁻¹' {j}) →
        {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = K + 1 + j} :=
      fun x ↦ ⟨x.1.1, by
        have htail : K < hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc x.1.1 := x.1.2
        have hx := x.2
        change g x.1 = j at hx
        dsimp [g] at hx
        omega⟩
    have he : Function.Injective e := by
      intro x y hxy
      have hval : x.1.1 = y.1.1 := congrArg
        (fun w : {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = K + 1 + j} ↦ w.1)
        hxy
      have htail : x.1 = y.1 := Subtype.ext hval
      exact Subtype.ext htail
    have hsource : Summable (fun x : g ⁻¹' {j} ↦ f x.1) := hf.subtype _
    have htarget : Summable
        (fun i : {i : ι // hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i = K + 1 + j} ↦
          (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
      H.invSq_summable.subtype _
    unfold hadamardZeroDyadicShellInvSqMass
    exact Summable.tsum_le_tsum_of_inj e he
      (fun i _hi ↦ by positivity)
      (fun x ↦ by rfl) hsource htarget
  have hpoint : ∀ j : Nat,
      (∑' x : g ⁻¹' {j}, f x.1) ≤
        hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant H.C H.C₀ (K + 1 + j) := by
    intro j
    exact (hfiber_le j).trans
      (H.shellInvSqMass_le (K + 1 + j) (by omega) (by omega))
  have hmajorant : HasSum
      (fun j : Nat ↦
        hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant H.C H.C₀ (K + 1 + j))
      (4 * H.C * (((K + 3 : Nat) : Real) * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ K) +
        4 * H.C₀ * ((1 / 3 : Real) * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ K)) := by
    have h1 :=
      (hasSum_hadamardDyadicWeightedHalf_tail K).mul_left (4 * H.C)
    have h2 :=
      (hasSum_hadamardDyadicQuarter_tail K).mul_left (4 * H.C₀)
    have hfun :
        (fun j : Nat ↦
          hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant H.C H.C₀ (K + 1 + j)) =
        (fun j : Nat ↦
          4 * H.C * ((((K + 1 + j) + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
            (1 / 2 : Real) ^ (K + 1 + j)) +
          4 * H.C₀ * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ (K + 1 + j)) := by
      funext j
      unfold hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant
      ring
    rw [hfun]
    exact h1.add h2
  change (∑' i : tail, f i) ≤ _
  calc
    (∑' i : tail, f i) = ∑' j, ∑' x : g ⁻¹' {j}, f x.1 :=
      hregroup.tsum_eq.symm
    _ ≤ ∑' j, hadamardZeroDyadicInvSqMajorant H.C H.C₀ (K + 1 + j) :=
      hregroup.summable.tsum_le_tsum hpoint hmajorant.summable
    _ = _ := hmajorant.tsum_eq

name: OverflowResidueRH.tsum_compl_hadamardZeroDyadicHead_eq_tail
statement:
private theorem tsum_compl_hadamardZeroDyadicHead_eq_tail
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (Hproper : HadamardZeroNormProper zeroLoc) (K : Nat) :
    (∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset Hproper K},
        (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) =
      ∑' i : {i : ι // K < hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i},
        (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let e : {i : ι // i ∉ hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset Hproper K} ≃
      {i : ι // K < hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i} := {
    toFun i := ⟨i.1, by
      rw [← Nat.not_le]
      simpa using i.2⟩
    invFun i := ⟨i.1, by
      rw [mem_hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset]
      exact Nat.not_le_of_lt i.2⟩
    left_inv i := Subtype.ext rfl
    right_inv i := Subtype.ext rfl }
  simpa [e] using
    (e.tsum_eq
      (fun i : {i : ι // K < hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i} ↦
        (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹))

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.norm_infiniteHadamardProduct_le_exp_dyadic
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.norm_infiniteHadamardProduct_le_exp_dyadic
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData zeroLoc)
    (K : Nat) (hK_one : 1 ≤ K) (hK_lower : H.lower ≤ K) (z : ℂ) :
    ‖infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc z‖ ≤
      Real.exp
        (2 * ‖z‖ *
            (hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass zeroLoc (max 1 H.lower) +
              ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
                (2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) + 2 * H.C₀)) +
          4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
            (4 * H.C * (((K + 3 : Nat) : Real) * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ K) +
              4 * H.C₀ * ((1 / 3 : Real) * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ K)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := hadamardZeroDyadicHeadFinset H.normProper K
  have hsplit := norm_infiniteHadamardProduct_le_exp_split
    H.toHadamardZeroInvSqSummability F z
  have hhead_eq :
      (∑ i ∈ F, 2 * ‖z‖ / ‖zeroLoc i‖) =
        2 * ‖z‖ * ∑ i ∈ F, ‖zeroLoc i‖⁻¹ := by
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ F, 2 * ‖z‖ / ‖zeroLoc i‖) =
          ∑ i ∈ F, (2 * ‖z‖) * ‖zeroLoc i‖⁻¹ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      _ = 2 * ‖z‖ * ∑ i ∈ F, ‖zeroLoc i‖⁻¹ := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have hhead := H.sum_head_inv_le K hK_one hK_lower
  have hhead' :
      (∑ i ∈ F, 2 * ‖z‖ / ‖zeroLoc i‖) ≤
        2 * ‖z‖ *
          (hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass zeroLoc (max 1 H.lower) +
            ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
              (2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) + 2 * H.C₀)) := by
    rw [hhead_eq]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa [F] using hhead) (by positivity)
  have htail_eq :
      (∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) =
        ∑' i : {i : ι // K < hadamardZeroDyadicBin zeroLoc i},
          (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    simpa [F] using
      tsum_compl_hadamardZeroDyadicHead_eq_tail H.normProper K
  have htail := H.tailInvSqMass_le K hK_lower
  have htail' :
      4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
          (∑' i : {i : ι // i ∉ F}, (‖zeroLoc i.1‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤
        4 * ‖z‖ ^ 2 *
          (4 * H.C * (((K + 3 : Nat) : Real) * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ K) +
            4 * H.C₀ * ((1 / 3 : Real) * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ K)) := by
    rw [htail_eq]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (by positivity)
  apply hsplit.trans
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  exact add_le_add hhead' htail'

name: OverflowResidueRH.sq_mul_half_pow_le_self
statement:
private lemma sq_mul_half_pow_le_self
    (r : Real) (K : Nat) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr : r ≤ (2 : Real) ^ K) :
    r ^ 2 * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ K ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  have hpowpos : 0 < (2 : Real) ^ K := by positivity
  have hpow : (1 / 2 : Real) ^ K = ((2 : Real) ^ K)⁻¹ := by
    rw [div_pow]
    norm_num
  have hratio : r * ((2 : Real) ^ K)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [mul_inv_le_iff₀ hpowpos]
    simpa using hr
  rw [hpow]
  calc
    r ^ 2 * ((2 : Real) ^ K)⁻¹ =
        r * (r * ((2 : Real) ^ K)⁻¹) := by ring
    _ ≤ r * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio hr0
    _ = r := mul_one r

name: OverflowResidueRH.sq_mul_quarter_pow_le_self
statement:
private lemma sq_mul_quarter_pow_le_self
    (r : Real) (K : Nat) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr : r ≤ (2 : Real) ^ K) :
    r ^ 2 * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ K ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  calc
    r ^ 2 * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ K ≤ r ^ 2 * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ K := by
      gcongr
      norm_num
    _ ≤ r := sq_mul_half_pow_le_self r K hr0 hr

name: OverflowResidueRH.dyadic_exponent_algebra
statement:
private lemma dyadic_exponent_algebra
    (r low C C₀ k half quarter : Real)
    (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hlow : 0 ≤ low) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hhalf : r ^ 2 * half ≤ r)
    (hquarter : r ^ 2 * quarter ≤ r) :
    2 * r * (low + (k + 1) * (2 * C * (k + 1) + 2 * C₀)) +
        4 * r ^ 2 *
          (4 * C * ((k + 3) * half) + 4 * C₀ * ((1 / 3) * quarter)) ≤
      (2 * low + 20 * C + 14 * C₀) * r * (k + 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hk3 : 0 ≤ k + 3 := by linarith
  have htailC :
      16 * C * (k + 3) * (r ^ 2 * half) ≤ 16 * C * (k + 3) * r :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhalf (by positivity)
  have htailC₀ :
      (16 / 3) * C₀ * (r ^ 2 * quarter) ≤ (16 / 3) * C₀ * r :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hquarter (by positivity)
  have htail :
      4 * r ^ 2 *
          (4 * C * ((k + 3) * half) + 4 * C₀ * ((1 / 3) * quarter)) ≤
        16 * C * r * (k + 3) + (16 / 3) * C₀ * r := by
    calc
      4 * r ^ 2 *
          (4 * C * ((k + 3) * half) + 4 * C₀ * ((1 / 3) * quarter)) =
          16 * C * (k + 3) * (r ^ 2 * half) +
            (16 / 3) * C₀ * (r ^ 2 * quarter) := by ring
      _ ≤ 16 * C * (k + 3) * r + (16 / 3) * C₀ * r :=
        add_le_add htailC htailC₀
      _ = 16 * C * r * (k + 3) + (16 / 3) * C₀ * r := by ring
  have hsquare_one : 1 ≤ (k + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hlow_scaled : 2 * low * r ≤ 2 * low * r * (k + 1) ^ 2 := by
    have hcoef : 0 ≤ 2 * low * r := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hk_poly : k + 3 ≤ (k + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hC_scaled :
      4 * C * r * (k + 1) ^ 2 + 16 * C * r * (k + 3) ≤
        20 * C * r * (k + 1) ^ 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk_poly
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 16 * C * r)
    nlinarith
  have hC₀_poly : 4 * (k + 1) + 16 / 3 ≤ 14 * (k + 1) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith
  have hC₀_scaled :
      4 * C₀ * r * (k + 1) + (16 / 3) * C₀ * r ≤
        14 * C₀ * r * (k + 1) ^ 2 := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hC₀_poly
      (mul_nonneg hC₀ hr0)
    nlinarith
  calc
    2 * r * (low + (k + 1) * (2 * C * (k + 1) + 2 * C₀)) +
        4 * r ^ 2 *
          (4 * C * ((k + 3) * half) + 4 * C₀ * ((1 / 3) * quarter)) ≤
        2 * r * (low + (k + 1) * (2 * C * (k + 1) + 2 * C₀)) +
          (16 * C * r * (k + 3) + (16 / 3) * C₀ * r) :=
      add_le_add le_rfl htail
    _ = 2 * low * r +
        (4 * C * r * (k + 1) ^ 2 + 16 * C * r * (k + 3)) +
        (4 * C₀ * r * (k + 1) + (16 / 3) * C₀ * r) := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * low * r * (k + 1) ^ 2 +
        20 * C * r * (k + 1) ^ 2 +
        14 * C₀ * r * (k + 1) ^ 2 := by
      exact add_le_add (add_le_add hlow_scaled hC_scaled) hC₀_scaled
    _ = (2 * low + 20 * C + 14 * C₀) * r * (k + 1) ^ 2 := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.norm_infiniteHadamardProduct_le_exp_logSq
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.norm_infiniteHadamardProduct_le_exp_logSq
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData zeroLoc)
    (K : Nat) (hK_one : 1 ≤ K) (hK_lower : H.lower ≤ K)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ K) :
    ‖infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc z‖ ≤
      Real.exp
        ((2 * hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass zeroLoc (max 1 H.lower) +
            20 * H.C + 14 * H.C₀) *
          ‖z‖ * (((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hraw :=
    H.norm_infiniteHadamardProduct_le_exp_dyadic K hK_one hK_lower z
  apply hraw.trans
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  let r : Real := ‖z‖
  let A : Real :=
    hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass zeroLoc (max 1 H.lower)
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by
    dsimp [A]
    exact hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass_nonneg _ _
  have hhalf : r ^ 2 * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ K ≤ r := by
    exact sq_mul_half_pow_le_self r K hr0 (by simpa [r] using hz)
  have hquarter : r ^ 2 * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ K ≤ r := by
    exact sq_mul_quarter_pow_le_self r K hr0 (by simpa [r] using hz)
  have hKcast : (1 : Real) ≤ (K : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hK_one
  change
    2 * r *
        (A + ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) *
          (2 * H.C * ((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) + 2 * H.C₀)) +
      4 * r ^ 2 *
        (4 * H.C * (((K + 3 : Nat) : Real) * (1 / 2 : Real) ^ K) +
          4 * H.C₀ * ((1 / 3 : Real) * (1 / 4 : Real) ^ K)) ≤
      (2 * A + 20 * H.C + 14 * H.C₀) * r *
        (((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)
  convert dyadic_exponent_algebra r A H.C H.C₀ (K : Real)
      ((1 / 2 : Real) ^ K) ((1 / 4 : Real) ^ K)
      hr0 hA0 H.C_nonneg H.C₀_nonneg hKcast hhalf hquarter using 1 <;>
    norm_num [Nat.cast_add]

name: OverflowResidueRH.HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.log_norm_infiniteHadamardProduct_le_logSq
statement:
theorem HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData.log_norm_infiniteHadamardProduct_le_logSq
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    (H : HadamardZeroDyadicCumulativeCountData zeroLoc)
    (K : Nat) (hK_one : 1 ≤ K) (hK_lower : H.lower ≤ K)
    (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ K) :
    Real.log ‖infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc z‖ ≤
      (2 * hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass zeroLoc (max 1 H.lower) +
          20 * H.C + 14 * H.C₀) *
        ‖z‖ * (((K + 1 : Nat) : Real) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeff :
      0 ≤ 2 * hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass zeroLoc (max 1 H.lower) +
          20 * H.C + 14 * H.C₀ := by
    exact add_nonneg
      (add_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
          (hadamardZeroDyadicLowInvMass_nonneg zeroLoc (max 1 H.lower)))
        (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C_nonneg))
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) H.C₀_nonneg)
  by_cases hp : infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc z = 0
  · rw [hp, norm_zero, Real.log_zero]
    positivity
  · exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp (norm_pos_iff.mpr hp)).2
      (H.norm_infiniteHadamardProduct_le_exp_logSq
        K hK_one hK_lower z hz)

name: OverflowResidueRH.upper_pole_probe_imag
statement:
theorem upper_pole_probe_imag (m eps : ℝ) (hε : eps ≠ 0) :
    ((m : ℂ) / ((-eps : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im = m / eps
proof:
:= by
  have hε2 : eps^2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hε
  rw [Complex.div_im]
  rw [Complex.normSq_mul, Complex.normSq_I, mul_one]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im,
    Complex.normSq_neg, Complex.normSq_ofReal,
    mul_zero, mul_one, sub_zero, add_zero, neg_zero]
  field_simp
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.upper_pole_probe_imag_positive
statement:
theorem upper_pole_probe_imag_positive
    (m eps : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hε : 0 < eps) :
    0 < ((m : ℂ) / ((-eps : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im
proof:
:= by
  rw [upper_pole_probe_imag m eps (ne_of_gt hε)]
  exact div_pos hm hε

name: OverflowResidueRH.localLogDerivPoleDecomposition_forces_escape
statement:
theorem localLogDerivPoleDecomposition_forces_escape
    {R : ℂ → ℂ} {ρ : ℂ}
    (D : LocalLogDerivPoleDecomposition R ρ) :
    PositiveUpperImaginaryEscape R
proof:
:= by
  have hm_real_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (D.m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast D.hm_pos
  have hmK_pos : 0 < (D.m : ℝ) / D.K := div_pos hm_real_pos D.hK_pos
  let ε : ℝ := min (D.ε0 / 2) ((D.m : ℝ) / D.K / 2)
  have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by
    refine lt_min ?_ ?_
    · linarith [D.hε0]
    · linarith
  have hε_lt_ε0 : ε < D.ε0 := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) ?_
    linarith [D.hε0]
  have hε_lt_mK : ε < (D.m : ℝ) / D.K := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) ?_
    linarith
  refine ⟨ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have h_im : (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = ρ.im - ε := by
      simp [Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re,
            Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
    rw [h_im]
    linarith [D.hε0_lt]
  · 
    rw [D.decomp_at_probe ε hε_pos hε_lt_ε0]
    have hsub : (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I) - ρ = -(ε : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      ring
    rw [hsub]
    have hB := D.background_bounded ε hε_pos hε_lt_ε0
    exact upper_pole_escape_with_background_complex
      (D.m : ℝ) ε D.K (D.background (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      hm_real_pos D.hK_pos hε_pos hε_lt_mK hB

name: OverflowResidueRH.antiHerglotz_plus_symmetry_forces_real_zeros_complex
statement:
theorem antiHerglotz_plus_symmetry_forces_real_zeros_complex
    {f R : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hpole : LogDerivPoleWitnessLaw f R)
    (hanti : AntiHerglotzUHP R)
    (hsym : ∀ z : ℂ, f (star z) = star (f z)) :
    ∀ ρ : ℂ, f ρ = 0 → ρ.im = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro ρ hρzero
  rcases lt_trichotomy ρ.im 0 with hneg | hzero | hpos
  · 
    have hconj_zero : f (star ρ) = 0 := by
      rw [hsym ρ, hρzero]
      simp
    have hupper_conj : 0 < (star ρ).im := by
      rw [complex_star_im]
      linarith
    exact absurd hconj_zero
      (antiHerglotz_forbids_upper_zeros hpole hanti (star ρ) hupper_conj)
  · exact hzero
  · 
    exact absurd hρzero
      (antiHerglotz_forbids_upper_zeros hpole hanti ρ hpos)

name: OverflowResidueRH.engine_probe_is_not_the_zero
statement:
theorem engine_probe_is_not_the_zero
    (ρ : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I ≠ ρ
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have him_diff : (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = ρ.im := by rw [h]
  have him_calc : (ρ - (ε : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = ρ.im - ε := by
    simp [Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  rw [him_calc] at him_diff
  linarith

proof:

  ·

    unfold logDerivativeResponse

name: OverflowResidueRH.XiCloudDensityErrorPackage.implies_XiPullbackAntiHerglotzTarget
statement:
theorem XiCloudDensityErrorPackage.implies_XiPullbackAntiHerglotzTarget
    (P : XiCloudDensityErrorPackage) :
    XiPullbackAntiHerglotzTarget
proof:
:= by

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.hasDerivAt_smoothMainTerm
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_smoothMainTerm
    {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    HasDerivAt smoothMainTerm (smoothDensity u) u
proof:
:= by
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have hq_pos : (0 : ℝ) < u / (2 * Real.pi) := div_pos hu h2pi_pos
  have hq_ne : u / (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hq_pos
  have hlin :
      HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => v / (2 * Real.pi))
        (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) u := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).div_const (2 * Real.pi)
  have hlog :
      HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.log (v / (2 * Real.pi)))
        (1 / u) u := by
    have h := (Real.hasDerivAt_log hq_ne).comp u hlin
    have hsimp :
        (u / (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) = 1 / u := by
      field_simp
    rw [hsimp] at h
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using h
  have hprod := hlin.mul hlog
  have hsub := hprod.sub hlin
  have hfinal := hsub.add_const (7 / 8)
  have hderiv :
      (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))
        + (u / (2 * Real.pi)) * (1 / u) - 1 / (2 * Real.pi)
      = smoothDensity u := by
    unfold smoothDensity zeroDensityRho
    field_simp
    ring
  have hfunc :
      (fun v : ℝ => (v / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (v / (2 * Real.pi))
                    - v / (2 * Real.pi) + 7 / 8)
        = smoothMainTerm := by
    funext v
    rfl
  rw [← hfunc, ← hderiv]
  exact hfinal

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.smoothMainTerm_monotoneOn_Ici_two_pi
statement:
theorem smoothMainTerm_monotoneOn_Ici_two_pi :
    MonotoneOn smoothMainTerm (Set.Ici (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Ici _)
  · intro x hx
    have hx_ge : 2 * Real.pi ≤ x := hx
    have hx_pos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hx_ge
    exact (hasDerivAt_smoothMainTerm hx_pos).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · intro x hx
    rw [interior_Ici] at hx
    have hx_2pi : 2 * Real.pi < x := hx
    have hx_pos : 0 < x := lt_trans (by positivity) hx_2pi
    exact (hasDerivAt_smoothMainTerm hx_pos).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro x hx
    rw [interior_Ici] at hx
    have hx_2pi : 2 * Real.pi < x := hx
    rw [(hasDerivAt_smoothMainTerm (lt_trans (by positivity) hx_2pi)).deriv]
    exact smoothDensity_nonneg_of_ge_two_pi (le_of_lt hx_2pi)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.smoothMainTerm_bounds_of_endpoint_bounds
statement:
theorem smoothMainTerm_bounds_of_endpoint_bounds
    {A B T mainLower mainUpper : ℝ}
    (hA2pi : 2 * Real.pi ≤ A)
    (hAT : A ≤ T) (hTB : T ≤ B)
    (hlow : mainLower ≤ smoothMainTerm A)
    (hhigh : smoothMainTerm B ≤ mainUpper) :
    mainLower ≤ smoothMainTerm T ∧ smoothMainTerm T ≤ mainUpper
proof:
:= by
  have hmono := smoothMainTerm_monotoneOn_Ici_two_pi
  have hT2pi : 2 * Real.pi ≤ T := le_trans hA2pi hAT
  have hB2pi : 2 * Real.pi ≤ B := le_trans hT2pi hTB
  have hleft : smoothMainTerm A ≤ smoothMainTerm T :=
    hmono hA2pi hT2pi hAT
  have hright : smoothMainTerm T ≤ smoothMainTerm B :=
    hmono hT2pi hB2pi hTB
  constructor
  · exact le_trans hlow hleft
  · exact le_trans hright hhigh

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.smoothMainTerm_lower_bound_of_log_ratio_lower
statement:
theorem smoothMainTerm_lower_bound_of_log_ratio_lower
    {T logLower mainLower : ℝ}
    (hT0 : 0 ≤ T)
    (hlog : logLower ≤ Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)))
    (harith :
      mainLower
        ≤ (T / (2 * Real.pi)) * logLower
          - T / (2 * Real.pi) + 7 / 8) :
    mainLower ≤ smoothMainTerm T
proof:
:= by
  have hratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ T / (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have hmul :
      (T / (2 * Real.pi)) * logLower
        ≤ (T / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog hratio_nonneg
  unfold smoothMainTerm smoothZeroCountingN0
  linarith

      (T / (2 * Real.pi)) * logUpper
        - T / (2 * Real.pi) + 7 / 8
          ≤ mainUpper) :
    smoothMainTerm T ≤ mainUpper
proof:

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.smoothMainTerm_lower_bound_of_ratio_window
statement:
theorem smoothMainTerm_lower_bound_of_ratio_window
    {T ratioLower ratioUpper logLower mainLower : ℝ}
    (hT0 : 0 ≤ T)
    (hlogLower_nonneg : 0 ≤ logLower)
    (hratio_lower : ratioLower ≤ T / (2 * Real.pi))
    (hratio_upper : T / (2 * Real.pi) ≤ ratioUpper)
    (hlog_lower : logLower ≤ Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)))
    (harith :
      mainLower ≤ ratioLower * logLower - ratioUpper + 7 / 8) :
    mainLower ≤ smoothMainTerm T
proof:
:= by
  have hratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ T / (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have hmul_left :
      ratioLower * logLower ≤
        (T / (2 * Real.pi)) * logLower :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratio_lower hlogLower_nonneg
  have hmul_right :
      (T / (2 * Real.pi)) * logLower ≤
        (T / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog_lower hratio_nonneg
  unfold smoothMainTerm smoothZeroCountingN0
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.smoothMainTerm_upper_bound_of_ratio_window
statement:
theorem smoothMainTerm_upper_bound_of_ratio_window
    {T ratioLower ratioUpper logUpper mainUpper : ℝ}
    (hT0 : 0 ≤ T)
    (hlogUpper_nonneg : 0 ≤ logUpper)
    (hratio_lower : ratioLower ≤ T / (2 * Real.pi))
    (hratio_upper : T / (2 * Real.pi) ≤ ratioUpper)
    (hlog_upper : Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) ≤ logUpper)
    (harith :
      ratioUpper * logUpper - ratioLower + 7 / 8 ≤ mainUpper) :
    smoothMainTerm T ≤ mainUpper
proof:
:= by
  have hratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ T / (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have hmul_left :
      (T / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) ≤
        (T / (2 * Real.pi)) * logUpper :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog_upper hratio_nonneg
  have hmul_right :
      (T / (2 * Real.pi)) * logUpper ≤ ratioUpper * logUpper :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratio_upper hlogUpper_nonneg
  unfold smoothMainTerm smoothZeroCountingN0
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.backlund_exp_nat_add_le
statement:
theorem backlund_exp_nat_add_le
    (k : ℕ) {x E X : ℝ}
    (hE : Real.exp (1 : ℝ) ≤ E)
    (hX : Real.exp x ≤ X) :
    Real.exp ((k : ℝ) + x) ≤ E ^ k * X
proof:
:= by
  have hE_nonneg : 0 ≤ E := le_trans (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos 1)) hE
  have hkexp : Real.exp ((k : ℝ)) = (Real.exp (1 : ℝ)) ^ k := by
    have h := Real.exp_one_pow k
    exact h.symm
  have hkpow : (Real.exp (1 : ℝ)) ^ k ≤ E ^ k :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos 1)) hE k
  rw [Real.exp_add, hkexp]
  exact mul_le_mul hkpow hX (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos x))
    (pow_nonneg hE_nonneg k)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.weightedZeroCountFromCertificate_eq_zero_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem weightedZeroCountFromCertificate_eq_zero_of_nonpos
    {T : ℝ} (hT : T ≤ 0) (W : WeightedZeroSetUpToHeight T) :
    weightedZeroCountFromCertificate W = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
  have hzeros :
      W.zeros = (emptyWeightedZeroSetUpToHeight_of_nonpos hT).zeros :=
    weightedZeroSet_zeros_unique W
      (emptyWeightedZeroSetUpToHeight_of_nonpos hT)
  rw [hzeros]
  simp [emptyWeightedZeroSetUpToHeight_of_nonpos]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.weightedZeroCountFromCertificate_eq_card_of_mult_one
statement:
theorem weightedZeroCountFromCertificate_eq_card_of_mult_one
    {T : ℝ} (W : WeightedZeroSetUpToHeight T)
    (hone : ∀ s : ℂ, s ∈ W.zeros → W.mult s = 1) :
    weightedZeroCountFromCertificate W =
      zeroCountFromCertificate W.toZeroSetUpToHeight
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
  unfold zeroCountFromCertificate
  change W.zeros.sum W.mult = W.zeros.card
  calc W.zeros.sum W.mult
      = W.zeros.sum (fun _ => 1) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s hs => hone s hs)
    _ = W.zeros.card := by simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.weightedFluctuationFromCertificate_eq_fluctuation_of_mult_one
statement:
theorem weightedFluctuationFromCertificate_eq_fluctuation_of_mult_one
    {T : ℝ} (W : WeightedZeroSetUpToHeight T)
    (hone : ∀ s : ℂ, s ∈ W.zeros → W.mult s = 1) :
    weightedFluctuationFromCertificate W =
      fluctuationFromCertificate W.toZeroSetUpToHeight
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedFluctuationFromCertificate
  unfold fluctuationFromCertificate
  rw [weightedZeroCountFromCertificate_eq_card_of_mult_one W hone]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.isZetaZeroUpToHeight_mono
statement:
theorem isZetaZeroUpToHeight_mono
    {T₁ T₂ : ℝ} (hT : T₁ ≤ T₂) {s : ℂ}

    IsZetaZeroUpToHeight T₂ s
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs with ⟨hzero, him_pos, him_le⟩
  exact ⟨hzero, him_pos, le_trans him_le hT⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zeroSet_subset_of_le
statement:
theorem zeroSet_subset_of_le
    {T₁ T₂ : ℝ} (hT : T₁ ≤ T₂)
    (Z₁ : ZeroSetUpToHeight T₁) (Z₂ : ZeroSetUpToHeight T₂) :
    Z₁.zeros ⊆ Z₂.zeros
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  exact (Z₂.complete s).mpr
    (isZetaZeroUpToHeight_mono hT ((Z₁.complete s).mp hs))

statement:
theorem weightedZeroSet_subset_of_le

    W₁.zeros ⊆ W₂.zeros

    (isZetaZeroUpToHeight_mono hT ((W₁.complete s).mp hs))

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zeroCountFromCertificate_le_of_le
statement:
theorem zeroCountFromCertificate_le_of_le
    {T₁ T₂ : ℝ} (hT : T₁ ≤ T₂)
    (Z₁ : ZeroSetUpToHeight T₁) (Z₂ : ZeroSetUpToHeight T₂) :
    zeroCountFromCertificate Z₁ ≤ zeroCountFromCertificate Z₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold zeroCountFromCertificate
  exact Finset.card_le_card (zeroSet_subset_of_le hT Z₁ Z₂)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.weightedZeroCountFromCertificate_le_of_le
statement:
theorem weightedZeroCountFromCertificate_le_of_le
    {T₁ T₂ : ℝ} (hT : T₁ ≤ T₂)
    (W₁ : WeightedZeroSetUpToHeight T₁)
    (W₂ : WeightedZeroSetUpToHeight T₂)
    (hcompat : WeightedMultiplicityCompatible W₁ W₂) :
    weightedZeroCountFromCertificate W₁ ≤
      weightedZeroCountFromCertificate W₂
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
  calc
    W₁.zeros.sum W₁.mult = W₁.zeros.sum W₂.mult := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s hs
      exact hcompat s hs
    _ ≤ W₂.zeros.sum W₂.mult := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        (weightedZeroSet_subset_of_le hT W₁ W₂)
      intro s _hsW₂ _hsNotW₁
      exact Nat.zero_le (W₂.mult s)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.weightedZeroCountFromCertificate_eq_of_same_height_compatible
statement:
theorem weightedZeroCountFromCertificate_eq_of_same_height_compatible
    {T : ℝ}
    (W₁ W₂ : WeightedZeroSetUpToHeight T)
    (hcompat : WeightedMultiplicityCompatible W₁ W₂) :
    weightedZeroCountFromCertificate W₁ =
      weightedZeroCountFromCertificate W₂
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact weightedZeroCountFromCertificate_le_of_le
      (le_refl T) W₁ W₂ hcompat
  · have hcompat' : WeightedMultiplicityCompatible W₂ W₁ := by
      intro s hs
      have hs₁ : s ∈ W₁.zeros := by
        rw [weightedZeroSet_zeros_unique W₂ W₁] at hs
        exact hs
      exact (hcompat s hs₁).symm
    exact weightedZeroCountFromCertificate_le_of_le
      (le_refl T) W₂ W₁ hcompat'

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity_compatible_of_le
statement:
theorem weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity_compatible_of_le
    (M : GlobalZeroMultiplicity)
    {T₁ T₂ : ℝ} (hT : T₁ ≤ T₂)
    (Z₁ : ZeroSetUpToHeight T₁)
    (Z₂ : ZeroSetUpToHeight T₂) :
    WeightedMultiplicityCompatible
      (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M Z₁)
      (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M Z₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  have hs₁ : IsZetaZeroUpToHeight T₁ s := (Z₁.complete s).mp hs
  have hs₂ : IsZetaZeroUpToHeight T₂ s :=
    isZetaZeroUpToHeight_mono hT hs₁
  change truncatedMultiplicity M T₁ s = truncatedMultiplicity M T₂ s
  rw [truncatedMultiplicity_eq_global M hs₁,
      truncatedMultiplicity_eq_global M hs₂]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.weightedZeroCountOfGlobalMultiplicity_le_of_le
statement:
theorem weightedZeroCountOfGlobalMultiplicity_le_of_le
    (M : GlobalZeroMultiplicity)
    {T₁ T₂ : ℝ} (hT : T₁ ≤ T₂)
    (Z₁ : ZeroSetUpToHeight T₁)

        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M Z₁)
      ≤
    weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M Z₂)

  apply weightedZeroCountFromCertificate_le_of_le hT
  exact weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity_compatible_of_le M hT Z₁ Z₂

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zeroCountInHeightSlabOfDifference_eq_sub
statement:
theorem zeroCountInHeightSlabOfDifference_eq_sub
    {A B : ℝ} (hA_nonneg : 0 ≤ A) (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (ZA : ZeroSetUpToHeight A) (ZB : ZeroSetUpToHeight B) :
    zeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate
        (zeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference hA_nonneg hAB ZA ZB)
      =
    zeroCountFromCertificate ZB - zeroCountFromCertificate ZA
proof:
:= by
  change (ZB.zeros \ ZA.zeros).card = ZB.zeros.card - ZA.zeros.card
  exact Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset (zeroSet_subset_of_le hAB ZA ZB)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabOfDifference_eq_sub
statement:
theorem weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabOfDifference_eq_sub
    (M : GlobalZeroMultiplicity)
    {A B : ℝ} (hA_nonneg : 0 ≤ A) (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (ZA : ZeroSetUpToHeight A) (ZB : ZeroSetUpToHeight B) :
    weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference M hA_nonneg hAB ZA ZB)
      =
    weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZB)
      -
    weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZA)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsubset : ZA.zeros ⊆ ZB.zeros := zeroSet_subset_of_le hAB ZA ZB
  
  
  have hslab_eq_B :
      (ZB.zeros \ ZA.zeros).sum
          (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference M hA_nonneg hAB ZA ZB).mult
        =
      (ZB.zeros \ ZA.zeros).sum (truncatedMultiplicity M B) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s hs
    have hslab : IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab A B s :=
      ((weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference M hA_nonneg hAB ZA ZB).complete s).mp
        hs
    rcases hslab with ⟨hzero, hA_lt, him_le_B⟩
    have him_pos : 0 < s.im := lt_of_le_of_lt hA_nonneg hA_lt
    have hsB : IsZetaZeroUpToHeight B s := ⟨hzero, him_pos, him_le_B⟩
    change (if IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab A B s then M.mult s else 0)
         = truncatedMultiplicity M B s
    rw [if_pos ⟨hzero, hA_lt, him_le_B⟩,
        truncatedMultiplicity_eq_global M hsB]
  
  
  have hA_eq_B_on_ZA :
      ZA.zeros.sum (truncatedMultiplicity M A)
        =
      ZA.zeros.sum (truncatedMultiplicity M B) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s hs
    have hsA : IsZetaZeroUpToHeight A s := (ZA.complete s).mp hs
    have hsB : IsZetaZeroUpToHeight B s := isZetaZeroUpToHeight_mono hAB hsA
    rw [truncatedMultiplicity_eq_global M hsA,
        truncatedMultiplicity_eq_global M hsB]
  
  have hadd :
      (ZB.zeros \ ZA.zeros).sum (truncatedMultiplicity M B)
      + ZA.zeros.sum (truncatedMultiplicity M B)
        =
      ZB.zeros.sum (truncatedMultiplicity M B) :=
    Finset.sum_sdiff hsubset
  
  change (ZB.zeros \ ZA.zeros).sum
        (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference M hA_nonneg hAB ZA ZB).mult
      =
      ZB.zeros.sum (truncatedMultiplicity M B)
      - ZA.zeros.sum (truncatedMultiplicity M A)
  rw [hslab_eq_B, hA_eq_B_on_ZA]
  omega

statement:
theorem TuringIntervalCertificate.cumulative_count_sub_eq

        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity C.M C.ZB)
      -
    weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity C.M C.ZA)
      =
    C.certifiedCount
proof:

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.TuringIntervalCertificate.not_mem_weightedSlab_of_count_zero
statement:
theorem TuringIntervalCertificate.not_mem_weightedSlab_of_count_zero
    (C : TuringIntervalCertificate)
    (hC : C.certifiedCount = 0)
    {s : ℂ} :
    s ∉ C.weightedSlab.zeros
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  have hsum_zero :
      weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate C.weightedSlab = 0 :=
    C.weightedSlab_count_eq_zero hC
  unfold weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate at hsum_zero
  have hpos : 0 < C.weightedSlab.mult s :=
    C.weightedSlab.positive_on_zeros s hs
  have hle :
      C.weightedSlab.mult s
        ≤ C.weightedSlab.zeros.sum C.weightedSlab.mult :=
    Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := C.weightedSlab.mult)
      (fun x _ => Nat.zero_le (C.weightedSlab.mult x))
      hs
  rw [hsum_zero] at hle
  exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ (lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hle)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.TuringIntervalCertificate.not_isZetaZeroInHeightSlab_of_count_zero

  exact C.not_mem_weightedSlab_of_count_zero hC hmem

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ListedTuringIntervalCertificate.listedZeros_card_eq_certifiedCount_of_mult_one
statement:
theorem
    ListedTuringIntervalCertificate.listedZeros_card_eq_certifiedCount_of_mult_one
    (C : ListedTuringIntervalCertificate)
    (hone :
      ∀ s : ℂ,
        s ∈ C.toTuringIntervalCertificate.weightedSlab.zeros →
          C.toTuringIntervalCertificate.weightedSlab.mult s = 1) :
    C.listedZeros.card = C.certifiedCount
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.listedZeros_card_eq_support_card]
  have hweighted_eq_card :
      weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate
          C.toTuringIntervalCertificate.weightedSlab
        =
      C.toTuringIntervalCertificate.weightedSlab.zeros.card := by
    unfold weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate
    calc
      C.toTuringIntervalCertificate.weightedSlab.zeros.sum
          C.toTuringIntervalCertificate.weightedSlab.mult
          =
        C.toTuringIntervalCertificate.weightedSlab.zeros.sum
          (fun _ => 1) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro s hs
            exact hone s hs
      _ = C.toTuringIntervalCertificate.weightedSlab.zeros.card := by simp
  rw [← hweighted_eq_card]
  exact C.toTuringIntervalCertificate.weightedSlab_count_eq

    ListedTuringIntervalCertificate.certifiedCount_eq_zero_of_listedZeros_eq_empty

  have hsupport :
      C.toTuringIntervalCertificate.weightedSlab.zeros = ∅ := by
    rw [← C.listedZeros_eq_support, hC]
  have hweighted :
      weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate
          C.toTuringIntervalCertificate.weightedSlab = 0 := by
    unfold weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate
    rw [hsupport]
    simp
  have hcount :=
    C.toTuringIntervalCertificate.weightedSlab_count_eq
  rw [hweighted] at hcount
  exact hcount.symm

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.isZetaZeroInHeightSlab_union_adjacent
statement:
theorem isZetaZeroInHeightSlab_union_adjacent
    {A B C : ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B) (hBC : B ≤ C) (s : ℂ) :
    IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab A C s ↔
      IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab A B s ∨ IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab B C s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    rcases hs with ⟨hzero, hA_lt, him_le_C⟩
    by_cases hleB : s.im ≤ B
    · left
      exact ⟨hzero, hA_lt, hleB⟩
    · right
      have hB_lt : B < s.im := lt_of_not_ge hleB
      exact ⟨hzero, hB_lt, him_le_C⟩
  · intro hs
    rcases hs with hs | hs
    · rcases hs with ⟨hzero, hA_lt, him_le_B⟩
      exact ⟨hzero, hA_lt, le_trans him_le_B hBC⟩
    · rcases hs with ⟨hzero, hB_lt, him_le_C⟩
      have hA_lt : A < s.im := lt_of_le_of_lt hAB hB_lt
      exact ⟨hzero, hA_lt, him_le_C⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.disjoint_isZetaZeroInHeightSlab_adjacent
statement:
theorem disjoint_isZetaZeroInHeightSlab_adjacent
    {A B C : ℝ} {s : ℂ} :
    ¬ (IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab A B s ∧
        IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab B C s)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rcases h with ⟨hABslab, hBCslab⟩
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hABslab.2.2) hBCslab.2.1

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.disjoint_zeroSetInHeightSlab_adjacent
statement:
theorem disjoint_zeroSetInHeightSlab_adjacent
    {A B C : ℝ}
    (ZAB : ZeroSetInHeightSlab A B)
    (ZBC : ZeroSetInHeightSlab B C) :
    Disjoint ZAB.zeros ZBC.zeros
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro s hsAB hsBC
  have hABslab : IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab A B s :=
    (ZAB.complete s).mp hsAB
  have hBCslab : IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab B C s :=
    (ZBC.complete s).mp hsBC
  exact disjoint_isZetaZeroInHeightSlab_adjacent ⟨hABslab, hBCslab⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zeroCountInHeightSlabGlueAdjacent_eq_add
statement:
theorem zeroCountInHeightSlabGlueAdjacent_eq_add
    {A B C : ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B) (hBC : B ≤ C)
    (ZAB : ZeroSetInHeightSlab A B)
    (ZBC : ZeroSetInHeightSlab B C) :
    zeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate
        (zeroSetInHeightSlabGlueAdjacent hAB hBC ZAB ZBC)
      =
    zeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate ZAB +
      zeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate ZBC
proof:
:= by
  change (ZAB.zeros ∪ ZBC.zeros).card = ZAB.zeros.card + ZBC.zeros.card
  exact Finset.card_union_of_disjoint
    (disjoint_zeroSetInHeightSlab_adjacent ZAB ZBC)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabGlueAdjacent_eq_add
statement:
theorem weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabGlueAdjacent_eq_add
    (M : GlobalZeroMultiplicity)
    {A B C : ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B) (hBC : B ≤ C)
    (WAB : WeightedZeroSetInHeightSlab A B)
    (WBC : WeightedZeroSetInHeightSlab B C)
    (hWAB : ∀ s : ℂ, s ∈ WAB.zeros → WAB.mult s = M.mult s)
    (hWBC : ∀ s : ℂ, s ∈ WBC.zeros → WBC.mult s = M.mult s) :
    weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabGlueAdjacent
          M hAB hBC WAB WBC hWAB hWBC)
      =
    weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate WAB +
      weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate WBC
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdisj : Disjoint WAB.zeros WBC.zeros :=
    disjoint_zeroSetInHeightSlab_adjacent
      WAB.toZeroSetInHeightSlab
      WBC.toZeroSetInHeightSlab
  change (WAB.zeros ∪ WBC.zeros).sum
        (fun s => if IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab A C s then M.mult s else 0)
      =
      WAB.zeros.sum WAB.mult + WBC.zeros.sum WBC.mult
  rw [Finset.sum_union hdisj]
  have hAB_sum :
      WAB.zeros.sum
          (fun s =>
            if IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab A C s then M.mult s else 0)
        = WAB.zeros.sum WAB.mult := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s hs
    have hABslab : IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab A B s := (WAB.complete s).mp hs
    have hACslab : IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab A C s :=
      (isZetaZeroInHeightSlab_union_adjacent hAB hBC s).mpr (Or.inl hABslab)
    rw [if_pos hACslab, ← hWAB s hs]
  have hBC_sum :
      WBC.zeros.sum
          (fun s =>
            if IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab A C s then M.mult s else 0)
        = WBC.zeros.sum WBC.mult := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s hs
    have hBCslab : IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab B C s := (WBC.complete s).mp hs
    have hACslab : IsZetaZeroInHeightSlab A C s :=
      (isZetaZeroInHeightSlab_union_adjacent hAB hBC s).mpr (Or.inr hBCslab)
    rw [if_pos hACslab, ← hWBC s hs]
  rw [hAB_sum, hBC_sum]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.nat_sub_glue_adjacent
statement:
theorem nat_sub_glue_adjacent
    {NA NB NC kAB kBC : ℕ}
    (hNA_NB : NA ≤ NB)
    (hNB_NC : NB ≤ NC)

    (hBC : NC - NB = kBC) :
    NC - NA = kAB + kBC
proof:

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.weighted_cumulative_count_glue_adjacent
statement:
theorem weighted_cumulative_count_glue_adjacent
    (M : GlobalZeroMultiplicity)
    {A B C : ℝ} (hAB : A ≤ B) (hBC : B ≤ C)
    (ZA : ZeroSetUpToHeight A)
    (ZB : ZeroSetUpToHeight B)
    (ZC : ZeroSetUpToHeight C) :
    weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZC)
      -
    weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZA)
      =
    (weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZB)
      -
     weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZA))
    +
    (weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZC)
      -
     weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZB))
proof:
:= by
  have hNA_NB :
      weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZA)
        ≤
      weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZB) :=
    weightedZeroCountOfGlobalMultiplicity_le_of_le M hAB ZA ZB
  have hNB_NC :
      weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZB)
        ≤
      weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZC) :=
    weightedZeroCountOfGlobalMultiplicity_le_of_le M hBC ZB ZC
  omega

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.TuringIntervalCertificate.glueAdjacentExplicit_certifiedCount
statement:
theorem TuringIntervalCertificate.glueAdjacentExplicit_certifiedCount
    (M : GlobalZeroMultiplicity)
    {A B C : ℝ}
    (hA_nonneg : 0 ≤ A)
    (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (hBC : B ≤ C)
    (ZA : ZeroSetUpToHeight A)
    (ZB : ZeroSetUpToHeight B)
    (ZC : ZeroSetUpToHeight C)
    (certAB certBC : ℕ)
    (hCountAB :
      weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference
            M hA_nonneg hAB ZA ZB)
        =
      certAB)
    (hCountBC :
      weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference
            M (le_trans hA_nonneg hAB) hBC ZB ZC)
        =
      certBC) :
    (TuringIntervalCertificate.glueAdjacentExplicit
      M hA_nonneg hAB hBC ZA ZB ZC
      certAB certBC hCountAB hCountBC).certifiedCount
      =
    certAB + certBC
proof: := rfl

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ListedTuringIntervalCertificate.glueAdjacentExplicit_listedZeros
statement:
theorem ListedTuringIntervalCertificate.glueAdjacentExplicit_listedZeros
    (M : GlobalZeroMultiplicity)
    {A B C : ℝ}
    (hA_nonneg : 0 ≤ A)
    (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (hBC : B ≤ C)
    (ZA : ZeroSetUpToHeight A)
    (ZB : ZeroSetUpToHeight B)
    (ZC : ZeroSetUpToHeight C)
    (certAB certBC : ℕ)
    (hCountAB :
      weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference
            M hA_nonneg hAB ZA ZB)
        =
      certAB)
    (hCountBC :
      weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference
            M (le_trans hA_nonneg hAB) hBC ZB ZC)
        =
      certBC)
    (listedAB : Finset ℂ)
    (listedBC : Finset ℂ)
    (hlistedAB :
      listedAB =
        (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference
          M hA_nonneg hAB ZA ZB).zeros)
    (hlistedBC :
      listedBC =
        (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference
          M (le_trans hA_nonneg hAB) hBC ZB ZC).zeros) :
    (ListedTuringIntervalCertificate.glueAdjacentExplicit
      M hA_nonneg hAB hBC ZA ZB ZC
      certAB certBC hCountAB hCountBC
      listedAB listedBC hlistedAB hlistedBC).listedZeros
      =
    listedAB ∪ listedBC
proof: := rfl

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.listedZeros_disjoint_of_adjacent
statement:
theorem listedZeros_disjoint_of_adjacent
    (M : GlobalZeroMultiplicity)
    {A B C : ℝ}
    (hA_nonneg : 0 ≤ A)
    (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (hBC : B ≤ C)
    (ZA : ZeroSetUpToHeight A)
    (ZB : ZeroSetUpToHeight B)
    (ZC : ZeroSetUpToHeight C)
    (listedAB : Finset ℂ)
    (listedBC : Finset ℂ)
    (hlistedAB :
      listedAB =
        (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference
          M hA_nonneg hAB ZA ZB).zeros)
    (hlistedBC :
      listedBC =
        (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference
          M (le_trans hA_nonneg hAB) hBC ZB ZC).zeros) :
    Disjoint listedAB listedBC
proof:
:= by
  rw [hlistedAB, hlistedBC]
  exact
    disjoint_zeroSetInHeightSlab_adjacent
      (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference
        M hA_nonneg hAB ZA ZB).toZeroSetInHeightSlab

        M (le_trans hA_nonneg hAB) hBC ZB ZC).toZeroSetInHeightSlab

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.listedZeros_card_union_adjacent
statement:
theorem listedZeros_card_union_adjacent
    (M : GlobalZeroMultiplicity)
    {A B C : ℝ}
    (hA_nonneg : 0 ≤ A)
    (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (hBC : B ≤ C)
    (ZA : ZeroSetUpToHeight A)
    (ZB : ZeroSetUpToHeight B)
    (ZC : ZeroSetUpToHeight C)
    (listedAB : Finset ℂ)

    (hlistedBC :
      listedBC =
        (weightedZeroSetInHeightSlabOfDifference
          M (le_trans hA_nonneg hAB) hBC ZB ZC).zeros) :

      listedAB listedBC hlistedAB hlistedBC)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.weighted_cumulative_count_glue_three
statement:
theorem weighted_cumulative_count_glue_three
    (M : GlobalZeroMultiplicity)
    {A B C D : ℝ}
    (hAB : A ≤ B) (hBC : B ≤ C) (hCD : C ≤ D)
    (ZA : ZeroSetUpToHeight A)
    (ZB : ZeroSetUpToHeight B)
    (ZC : ZeroSetUpToHeight C)
    (ZD : ZeroSetUpToHeight D) :
    weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZD)
      -
    weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZA)
      =
    (weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZB)
      -
     weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZA))
    +
    (weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZC)
      -
     weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZB))
    +
    (weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZD)
      -
     weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
        (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZC))
proof:
:= by
  have hNA_NB :
      weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZA)
        ≤
      weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZB) :=
    weightedZeroCountOfGlobalMultiplicity_le_of_le M hAB ZA ZB
  have hNB_NC :
      weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZB)
        ≤
      weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZC) :=
    weightedZeroCountOfGlobalMultiplicity_le_of_le M hBC ZB ZC
  have hNC_ND :
      weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZC)
        ≤
      weightedZeroCountFromCertificate
          (weightedZeroSetOfGlobalMultiplicity M ZD) :=
    weightedZeroCountOfGlobalMultiplicity_le_of_le M hCD ZC ZD
  omega

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.TuringIntervalCertificate.glueThreeExplicit_certifiedCount

theorem halfLogPlusHalfEnvelope
    (B : ProvenBacklundTuringBound)
    {z : ℂ} {T u : ℝ}
    (hTlower : B.lower ≤ T)
    (_hy : 0 < z.im)
    (_hregime : 2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T)
    (hTu : T ≤ u) :
    |B.S u| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log u + 1 / 2
proof:
:=
  B.halfLogPlusHalf u (le_trans hTlower hTu)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ProvenBacklundTuringBound.highLogEnvelope
statement:
theorem highLogEnvelope
    (B : ProvenBacklundTuringBound)
    {z : ℂ} {T u : ℝ}
    (hTlower : B.lower ≤ T)
    (hy : 0 < z.im)
    (hregime : 2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T)
    (hTu : T ≤ u) :
    |B.S u| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log u + 49 / 20
proof:
:= by
  have hsharp :=
    B.halfLogPlusHalfEnvelope hTlower hy hregime hTu
  linarith

theorem riemannZeta_analyticAt_of_ne_one

proof:
:= by

  have hDiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ riemannZeta ({1}ᶜ : Set ℂ) :=

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.riemannZeta_not_eventuallyEq_zero_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem riemannZeta_not_eventuallyEq_zero_of_ne_one
    {p : ℂ} (hp : p ≠ 1) :
    ¬ riemannZeta =ᶠ[𝓝 p] 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hlocal
  have hp_mem : p ∈ ({1}ᶜ : Set ℂ) := hp
  have hOpen : IsOpen ({1}ᶜ : Set ℂ) := isClosed_singleton.isOpen_compl
  have hPre : IsPreconnected ({(1 : ℂ)}ᶜ : Set ℂ) :=
    (isConnected_compl_singleton_of_one_lt_rank (by simp) (1 : ℂ)).isPreconnected
  have hAnalytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ riemannZeta ({1}ᶜ : Set ℂ) := by
    intro z hz
    have hDiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ riemannZeta ({1}ᶜ : Set ℂ) :=
      fun w hw => (differentiableAt_riemannZeta hw).differentiableWithinAt
    exact hDiff.analyticAt (hOpen.mem_nhds hz)
  have hZero_on : Set.EqOn riemannZeta 0 ({1}ᶜ : Set ℂ) :=
    hAnalytic.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero hPre hp_mem hlocal
  have htwo_ne_one : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hre : (2 : ℂ).re = (1 : ℂ).re := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp at hre
  have htwo_mem : (2 : ℂ) ∈ ({1}ᶜ : Set ℂ) := htwo_ne_one
  have hZeta_two_zero : riemannZeta (2 : ℂ) = 0 := by
    have h := hZero_on htwo_mem
    simp at h
    exact h
  have hZeta_two_ne : riemannZeta (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    apply riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re
    change (1 : ℝ) < (2 : ℂ).re
    norm_num
  exact hZeta_two_ne hZeta_two_zero

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.riemannZeta_not_eventuallyEq_zero_at_nontrivial_zero
statement:
theorem riemannZeta_not_eventuallyEq_zero_at_nontrivial_zero

    ¬ riemannZeta =ᶠ[𝓝 s] 0
proof:

    (isNontrivialZetaZero_ne_one hs)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.hasFinitePositiveZetaMultiplicity_of_isNontrivialZetaZero
statement:
theorem hasFinitePositiveZetaMultiplicity_of_isNontrivialZetaZero
    {s : ℂ} (hs : IsNontrivialZetaZero s) :
    HasFinitePositiveZetaMultiplicity s
proof:
:= by
  have hAn : AnalyticAt ℂ riemannZeta s :=
    riemannZeta_analyticAt_of_isNontrivialZetaZero hs
  have hNotLocal : ¬ riemannZeta =ᶠ[𝓝 s] 0 :=
    riemannZeta_not_eventuallyEq_zero_at_nontrivial_zero hs
  have hzero : riemannZeta s = 0 := hs.1
  have hnot_top : analyticOrderAt riemannZeta s ≠ ⊤ := fun htop =>
    hNotLocal (analyticOrderAt_eq_top.mp htop)
  have hnot_zero : analyticOrderAt riemannZeta s ≠ 0 := fun hzero_order =>
    (hAn.analyticOrderAt_eq_zero.mp hzero_order) hzero
  refine ⟨analyticOrderNatAt riemannZeta s, ?_,
    (Nat.cast_analyticOrderNatAt hnot_top).symm⟩
  by_contra hn_not_pos
  push Not at hn_not_pos
  have hn_zero : analyticOrderNatAt riemannZeta s = 0 := by omega
  apply hnot_zero
  rw [← Nat.cast_analyticOrderNatAt hnot_top, hn_zero]
  simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.isClosed_closedCriticalRectangle
statement:
theorem isClosed_closedCriticalRectangle (T : ℝ) :
    IsClosed (closedCriticalRectangle T)
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq : closedCriticalRectangle T =
      {s : ℂ | 0 ≤ s.re} ∩ {s | s.re ≤ 1} ∩
        {s | 0 ≤ s.im} ∩ {s | s.im ≤ T} := by
    ext s
    simp [closedCriticalRectangle, and_assoc]
  rw [h_eq]
  exact (((isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).inter
    (isClosed_le Complex.continuous_re continuous_const)).inter
    (isClosed_le continuous_const Complex.continuous_im)).inter
    (isClosed_le Complex.continuous_im continuous_const)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.isBounded_closedCriticalRectangle
statement:
theorem isBounded_closedCriticalRectangle (T : ℝ) :
    Bornology.IsBounded (closedCriticalRectangle T)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := (0 : ℂ)) (r := 1 + max 0 T)).subset
  intro s hs
  rcases hs with ⟨h1, _h2, h3, h4⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  have hTle : s.im ≤ max 0 T := le_max_of_le_right h4
  calc ‖s‖
      ≤ |s.re| + |s.im| := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im s
    _ = s.re + s.im := by rw [abs_of_nonneg h1, abs_of_nonneg h3]
    _ ≤ 1 + max 0 T := by linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.isCompact_closedCriticalRectangle
statement:
theorem isCompact_closedCriticalRectangle (T : ℝ) :
    IsCompact (closedCriticalRectangle T)
proof:
:=
  Metric.isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded.mpr
    ⟨isClosed_closedCriticalRectangle T, isBounded_closedCriticalRectangle T⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_eventually_empty_of_analytic_ne_zero
statement:
theorem zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_eventually_empty_of_analytic_ne_zero
    {T : ℝ} {p : ℂ}
    (hAn : AnalyticAt ℂ riemannZeta p)
    (hp : riemannZeta p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p, ∀ z ∈ U, z ∉ zetaZerosUpToHeightSet T
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : ContinuousAt riemannZeta p := hAn.continuousAt
  have hEventually_ne : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 p, riemannZeta z ≠ 0 := hcont.eventually_ne hp
  refine ⟨{z : ℂ | riemannZeta z ≠ 0}, hEventually_ne, ?_⟩
  intro z hz hzset
  exact hz hzset.1.1

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_finite_inter_of_eventually_empty
proof:
:= by
  have hempty : U ∩ zetaZerosUpToHeightSet T = ∅ := by
    ext z
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨hzU, hzset⟩
      exact (hU z hzU) hzset
    · intro hz
      exact absurd hz (Set.notMem_empty z)
  rw [hempty]
  exact Set.finite_empty

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_of_analytic_ne_zero
statement:
theorem zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_of_analytic_ne_zero
    {T : ℝ} {p : ℂ}
    (hAn : AnalyticAt ℂ riemannZeta p)
    (hp : riemannZeta p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p, Set.Finite (U ∩ zetaZerosUpToHeightSet T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU_nhds, hU_empty⟩ :=
    zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_eventually_empty_of_analytic_ne_zero (T := T) hAn hp
  exact ⟨U, hU_nhds,
    zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_finite_inter_of_eventually_empty hU_empty⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_of_analytic_zero_not_local
statement:
theorem zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_of_analytic_zero_not_local
    {T : ℝ} {p : ℂ}
    (hAn : AnalyticAt ℂ riemannZeta p)
    (_hpzero : riemannZeta p = 0)
    (hNotLocal : ¬ riemannZeta =ᶠ[𝓝 p] 0) :
    ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p, Set.Finite (U ∩ zetaZerosUpToHeightSet T)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hAn.eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with hlocal | hpunct
  · exact absurd hlocal hNotLocal
  
  rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff] at hpunct
  refine ⟨{z : ℂ | z ∈ ({p}ᶜ : Set ℂ) → riemannZeta z ≠ 0}, hpunct, ?_⟩
  apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_singleton p)
  rintro z ⟨hzU, hzset⟩
  by_cases hzp : z = p
  · simp [hzp]
  · have hzmem : z ∈ ({p}ᶜ : Set ℂ) := hzp
    exact absurd hzset.1.1 (hzU hzmem)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_of_counted_zero
statement:
theorem zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_of_counted_zero

proof:
:= by
  have hpNT : IsNontrivialZetaZero p := hp.1
  exact
    zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_of_analytic_zero_not_local
      (T := T)
      (riemannZeta_analyticAt_of_isNontrivialZetaZero hpNT)
      hpNT.1
      (riemannZeta_not_eventuallyEq_zero_at_nontrivial_zero hpNT)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.riemannZeta_eventually_ne_zero_nhdsWithin_ne_one
statement:
theorem riemannZeta_eventually_ne_zero_nhdsWithin_ne_one :
    ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ), riemannZeta z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hprod_ne : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ), (z - 1) * riemannZeta z ≠ 0 :=
    riemannZeta_residue_one.eventually_ne (by norm_num : (1 : ℂ) ≠ 0)
  filter_upwards [hprod_ne] with z hzprod hzeta_zero
  rw [hzeta_zero, mul_zero] at hzprod
  exact hzprod rfl

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_at_one
statement:
theorem zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_at_one
    {T : ℝ} :
    ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 (1 : ℂ), Set.Finite (U ∩ zetaZerosUpToHeightSet T)
proof:
:= by
  have hpunct := riemannZeta_eventually_ne_zero_nhdsWithin_ne_one
  rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff] at hpunct
  refine ⟨{z : ℂ | z ∈ ({1}ᶜ : Set ℂ) → riemannZeta z ≠ 0}, hpunct, ?_⟩
  apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_singleton (1 : ℂ))
  rintro z ⟨hzU, hzset⟩
  by_cases hz_eq_one : z = 1
  · simp [hz_eq_one]
  · have hzmem : z ∈ ({1}ᶜ : Set ℂ) := hz_eq_one
    exact absurd hzset.1.1 (hzU hzmem)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_on_rectangle
statement:
theorem zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_on_rectangle
    (T : ℝ) :
    ∀ p ∈ closedCriticalRectangle T,
      ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p, Set.Finite (U ∩ zetaZerosUpToHeightSet T)
proof:
:= by
  intro p _hpRect
  by_cases hp_one : p = 1
  · subst hp_one
    exact zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_at_one
  · have hAn : AnalyticAt ℂ riemannZeta p := riemannZeta_analyticAt_of_ne_one hp_one
    by_cases hpzero : riemannZeta p = 0
    · exact
        zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_of_analytic_zero_not_local
          (T := T) hAn hpzero
          (riemannZeta_not_eventuallyEq_zero_of_ne_one hp_one)
    · exact
        zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_of_analytic_ne_zero
          (T := T) hAn hpzero

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.Set.Finite.of_subset_isCompact_of_locallyFinite_nhds
statement:
theorem Set.Finite.of_subset_isCompact_of_locallyFinite_nhds
    {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    {Z K : Set α}
    (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hZK : Z ⊆ K)
    (hlocal : ∀ p ∈ K, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p, Set.Finite (U ∩ Z)) :
    Set.Finite Z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose! V hV_nhds hV_finite using hlocal
  obtain ⟨t, ht_sub, ht_cover⟩ := hK.elim_nhds_subcover V hV_nhds
  have hZsubset : Z ⊆ ⋃ p ∈ t, V p ∩ Z := by
    intro z hz
    have hzK : z ∈ K := hZK hz
    obtain ⟨p, hpt, hzVp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht_cover hzK)
    exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨p, hpt, hzVp, hz⟩
  refine Set.Finite.subset ?_ hZsubset
  refine Set.Finite.biUnion t.finite_toSet ?_
  intro p hp
  exact hV_finite p (ht_sub p hp)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_finite
statement:

    (T : ℝ) (_hT : 0 ≤ T) :

    (K := closedCriticalRectangle T)
    (isCompact_closedCriticalRectangle T)
    (zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_subset_rectangle T)
    (zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_locallyFinite_on_rectangle T)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight_eq_of_endpoint_eq
statement:
theorem zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight_eq_of_endpoint_eq
    {A B T : ℝ} {count : ℕ}
    (hA0 : 0 ≤ A) (hT0 : 0 ≤ T) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B)
    (hAT : A ≤ T) (hTB : T ≤ B)
    (hAcount : zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight A hA0 = count)
    (hBcount : zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight B hB0 = count) :
    zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight T hT0 = count
proof:
:= by
  have hA_le_T :
      zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight A hA0 ≤
        zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight T hT0 :=
    zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight_mono hA0 hT0 hAT
  have hT_le_B :
      zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight T hT0 ≤
        zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight B hB0 :=
    zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight_mono hT0 hB0 hTB
  omega

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab_eq_sub
statement:
theorem zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab_eq_sub
    {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab A B hA hAB =
      zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight B (le_trans hA hAB)
        - zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight A hA
proof:
:= by
  unfold zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight
  exact
    weightedZeroCountInHeightSlabOfDifference_eq_sub
      zetaGlobalZeroMultiplicity hA hAB
      (zetaZeroSetUpToHeight A hA)
      (zetaZeroSetUpToHeight B (le_trans hA hAB))

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab_eq_zero_of_cumulative_eq

theorem zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab_eq_zero_of_cumulative_eq

      zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight B (le_trans hA hAB) =
        zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight A hA) :
    zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab A B hA hAB = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab_eq_sub hA hAB, hcount]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.TuringIntervalCertificate.ofEqualCumulativeCounts_certifiedCount

@[simp] theorem TuringIntervalCertificate.ofEqualCumulativeCounts_certifiedCount

      zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight B (le_trans hA hAB) =

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab_eq_of_eq
statement:
theorem zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab_eq_of_eq
    {A B A' B' : ℝ} (hAeq : A = A') (hBeq : B = B')
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (hA' : 0 ≤ A') (hA'B' : A' ≤ B') :
    zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab A B hA hAB =
    zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab A' B' hA' hA'B'
proof:
:= by
  subst A'
  subst B'
  have hA_proof : hA = hA' := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hAB_proof : hAB = hA'B' := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  cases hA_proof
  cases hAB_proof
  rfl

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight_right_eq_of_left_eq_slab_count
statement:
theorem zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight_right_eq_of_left_eq_slab_count
    {A B : ℝ} {leftCount slabCount : ℕ}
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hAB : A ≤ B)
    (hleft :
      zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight A hA = leftCount)
    (hslab :
      zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab A B hA hAB = slabCount) :
    zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight B (le_trans hA hAB)
      = leftCount + slabCount
proof:
:= by
  have hsub :
      zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight B (le_trans hA hAB)
        - zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight A hA = slabCount := by
    rw [← zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab_eq_sub hA hAB]
    exact hslab
  have hmono :
      zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight A hA ≤
        zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight B (le_trans hA hAB) :=
    zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight_mono hA (le_trans hA hAB) hAB
  omega

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.concreteS_eq_zeta_count_sub_riemannVonMangoldtMainTerm

theorem concreteS_eq_zeta_count_sub_riemannVonMangoldtMainTerm

        - riemannVonMangoldtMainTerm T

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ProvenRiemannVonMangoldtFormula.Sarg_eq_concreteS
statement:
theorem Sarg_eq_concreteS

proof:
:= by

      concreteS T =
        (zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight T hT : ℝ)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.goodHeight_iff_not_isZetaZeroHeight
statement:
theorem goodHeight_iff_not_isZetaZeroHeight (T : ℝ) :
    GoodHeight T ↔ ¬ IsZetaZeroHeight T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hgood hzeroHeight
    rcases hzeroHeight with ⟨s, hs, hsT⟩
    exact hgood s hs hsT
  · intro hnot s hs hsT
    exact hnot ⟨s, hs, hsT⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.positiveZetaZeroHeights_finite_upto
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Z : ZeroSetUpToHeight T := zetaZeroSetUpToHeight T hT
  let H : Finset ℝ := Z.zeros.image (fun s : ℂ => s.im)
  have hsubset :
      {t : ℝ | 0 < t ∧ t ≤ T ∧ IsZetaZeroHeight t} ⊆ (H : Set ℝ) := by
    intro t ht
    rcases ht with ⟨ht_pos, ht_le, hheight⟩
    rcases hheight with ⟨s, hsNT, hs_im⟩
    have hsCount : IsZetaZeroUpToHeight T s := by
      refine ⟨hsNT, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [hs_im] using ht_pos
      · simpa [hs_im] using ht_le
    have hs_mem : s ∈ Z.zeros := (Z.complete s).mpr hsCount
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨s, hs_mem, hs_im⟩
  exact H.finite_toSet.subset hsubset

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.exists_mem_Ioo_not_mem_finite
statement:
theorem exists_mem_Ioo_not_mem_finite
    {A B : ℝ} (hAB : A < B) {F : Set ℝ} (hF : F.Finite) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, A < t ∧ t < B ∧ t ∉ F
proof:
:= by
  have hinf : (Set.Ioo A B \ F).Infinite :=
    (Set.Ioo_infinite hAB).diff hF
  obtain ⟨t, ⟨⟨hAt, htB⟩, htF⟩⟩ := hinf.nonempty
  exact ⟨t, hAt, htB, htF⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.exists_goodHeight_between
statement:
theorem exists_goodHeight_between
    {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hAB : A < B) :
    ∃ T : ℝ, A < T ∧ T < B ∧ GoodHeight T
proof:
:= by
  have hF : Set.Finite {t : ℝ | 0 < t ∧ t ≤ B ∧ IsZetaZeroHeight t} :=
    positiveZetaZeroHeights_finite_upto B (le_trans hA.le hAB.le)
  obtain ⟨T, hAT, hTB, hTnot⟩ := exists_mem_Ioo_not_mem_finite hAB hF
  refine ⟨T, hAT, hTB, ?_⟩
  rw [goodHeight_iff_not_isZetaZeroHeight]
  intro hZeroHeight
  exact hTnot ⟨lt_trans hA hAT, hTB.le, hZeroHeight⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.exists_goodHeight_between_self_add
statement:
theorem exists_goodHeight_between_self_add
    {T ε : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ U : ℝ, T < U ∧ U < T + ε ∧ GoodHeight U
proof:
:=
  exists_goodHeight_between hT (by linarith)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.exists_goodHeight_between_sub_self
statement:
theorem exists_goodHeight_between_sub_self
    {T ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hεT : ε < T) :
    ∃ U : ℝ, T - ε < U ∧ U < T ∧ GoodHeight U
proof:
:= by
  have hleft_pos : 0 < T - ε := by linarith
  have hleft_lt : T - ε < T := by linarith
  exact exists_goodHeight_between hleft_pos hleft_lt

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.exists_goodHeight_between_not_mem_finite
statement:
theorem exists_goodHeight_between_not_mem_finite
    {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hAB : A < B)
    {F : Set ℝ} (hF : F.Finite) :
    ∃ T : ℝ, A < T ∧ T < B ∧ GoodHeight T ∧ T ∉ F
proof:
:= by
  have hZH : Set.Finite {t : ℝ | 0 < t ∧ t ≤ B ∧ IsZetaZeroHeight t} :=
    positiveZetaZeroHeights_finite_upto B (le_trans hA.le hAB.le)
  have hUnion :
      ({t : ℝ | 0 < t ∧ t ≤ B ∧ IsZetaZeroHeight t} ∪ F).Finite :=
    hZH.union hF
  obtain ⟨T, hAT, hTB, hTnot⟩ :=
    exists_mem_Ioo_not_mem_finite hAB hUnion
  have hTnotZH : T ∉ {t : ℝ | 0 < t ∧ t ≤ B ∧ IsZetaZeroHeight t} :=
    fun h => hTnot (Or.inl h)
  have hTnotF : T ∉ F :=
    fun h => hTnot (Or.inr h)
  have hgood : GoodHeight T := by
    rw [goodHeight_iff_not_isZetaZeroHeight]
    intro hheight
    exact hTnotZH ⟨lt_trans hA hAT, hTB.le, hheight⟩
  exact ⟨T, hAT, hTB, hgood, hTnotF⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.exists_safeContourHeight
statement:
theorem exists_safeContourHeight
    {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hAB : A < B) :

proof:

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.exists_safeContourHeight_avoiding_finite
statement:
theorem exists_safeContourHeight_avoiding_finite
    {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hAB : A < B)
    {F : Set ℝ} (hF : F.Finite) :
    ∃ H : SafeContourHeight A B, H.T ∉ F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hAT, hTB, hgood, hnotF⟩ :=
    exists_goodHeight_between_not_mem_finite hA hAB hF
  exact ⟨⟨T, hAT, hTB, hgood⟩, hnotF⟩

theorem ZetaArgumentPrincipleFormula.argumentIndex_eq_actual_slab_count
    {R : ZetaRectangle}
    (F : R.ZetaArgumentPrincipleFormula)
    (hleft : R.left < 0)
    (hright : 1 < R.right)
    (hbottom_nonneg : 0 ≤ R.bottom)
    (hbottom_pos : 0 < R.bottom)
    (hgood : GoodHeight R.top)
    (hZeroSet :
      F.zeroSet =
        R.zeroSetInsideOfSlab hleft hright hgood
          (R.canonicalSlabZeroSet hbottom_nonneg))
    (hM : F.M = zetaGlobalZeroMultiplicity) :
    F.argumentIndex =
      (zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab
        R.bottom R.top hbottom_nonneg R.hbottom_lt_top.le : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have harg :
      F.argumentIndex = (R.weightedZeroCountInside F.zeroSet F.M : ℤ) :=
    F.argumentIndex_eq_zeroCount_of_positive_bottom hbottom_pos
  rw [harg, hZeroSet, hM]
  have hcount := R.weightedZeroCountInside_zeroSetInsideOfSlab_eq
    hleft hright hgood (R.canonicalSlabZeroSet hbottom_nonneg)
    zetaGlobalZeroMultiplicity
  rw [hcount]
  rw [R.weighted_count_canonicalSlab_eq_zetaWeightedZeroCountInHeightSlab
    hbottom_nonneg]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.bottomEdge_mem_closed
statement:
theorem bottomEdge_mem_closed
    (R : ZetaRectangle) {t : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    R.ContainsClosed (R.bottomEdge t)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show R.left ≤ R.left + t * (R.right - R.left)
    nlinarith [R.hleft_lt_right]
  · show R.left + t * (R.right - R.left) ≤ R.right
    nlinarith [R.hleft_lt_right]
  · show R.bottom ≤ R.bottom
    rfl
  · show R.bottom ≤ R.top
    exact le_of_lt R.hbottom_lt_top

  · show R.left ≤ R.right
    exact le_of_lt R.hleft_lt_right
  · show R.right ≤ R.right
    rfl
  · show R.bottom ≤ R.bottom + t * (R.top - R.bottom)
    nlinarith [R.hbottom_lt_top]
  · show R.bottom + t * (R.top - R.bottom) ≤ R.top
    nlinarith [R.hbottom_lt_top]

theorem continuous_bottomEdge (R : ZetaRectangle) :
    Continuous R.bottomEdge
proof:
:= by
  have heq : R.bottomEdge =
      fun t : ℝ =>
        ((R.left + t * (R.right - R.left) : ℝ) : ℂ)
          + (R.bottom : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    funext t
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [bottomEdge]
  rw [heq]
  continuity

statement:
theorem continuousAt_zetaLogDeriv
    {z : ℂ}
    (hz_ne_one : z ≠ 1)
    (hz_ne_zero : riemannZeta z ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt zetaLogDeriv z
proof:
:= by
  unfold zetaLogDeriv
  have hAn : AnalyticAt ℂ riemannZeta z :=
    riemannZeta_analyticAt_of_ne_one hz_ne_one
  have hDerivCont : ContinuousAt (deriv riemannZeta) z :=
    hAn.deriv.continuousAt
  exact hDerivCont.div hAn.continuousAt hz_ne_zero

theorem continuousOn_logDeriv_comp_edge

proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := ht.1
  have ht1 : t ≤ 1 := ht.2
  have hcont :=
    continuousAt_zetaLogDeriv
      (hγ.avoids_pole t ht0 ht1) (hγ.zeta_ne_zero t ht0 ht1)
  exact hcont.comp_continuousWithinAt
    hγ.continuous_edge.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt

statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_logDerivIntegrand_of_edgeReady
    {γ : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hγ : EdgeLogDerivReady γ)
    (hγ_deriv : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => deriv γ t) (Set.Icc 0 1)) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ => zetaLogDeriv (γ t) * deriv γ t)
      MeasureTheory.volume 0 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := continuousOn_logDeriv_comp_edge hγ
  have hmul :
      ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => zetaLogDeriv (γ t) * deriv γ t)
        (Set.Icc 0 1) := h1.mul hγ_deriv
  exact hmul.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.hasDerivAt_bottomEdge
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_bottomEdge (R : ZetaRectangle) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt R.bottomEdge (((R.right - R.left : ℝ) : ℂ)) t
proof:
:= by
  have heq : R.bottomEdge = fun s : ℝ =>
      ((R.left : ℂ) + (R.bottom : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        + (s : ℂ) * ((R.right - R.left : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    funext s
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [bottomEdge]
  rw [heq]
  have h_ofReal : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ)) 1 t := by
    have := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := t)
    simp at this; convert this using 2
  have h_mul := h_ofReal.mul_const ((R.right - R.left : ℝ) : ℂ)
  have h_add := h_mul.const_add ((R.left : ℂ) + (R.bottom : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  simpa using h_add

theorem hasDerivAt_rightEdge (R : ZetaRectangle) (t : ℝ) :

proof:
:= by
  have heq : R.rightEdge = fun s : ℝ =>
      ((R.right : ℂ) + (R.bottom : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        + (s : ℂ) * (((R.top - R.bottom : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    funext s
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [rightEdge]
  rw [heq]
  have h_ofReal : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ)) 1 t := by
    have := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := t)
    simp at this; convert this using 2
  have h_mul := h_ofReal.mul_const (((R.top - R.bottom : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  have h_add := h_mul.const_add ((R.right : ℂ) + (R.bottom : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  simpa using h_add

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.hasDerivAt_topEdge
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_topEdge (R : ZetaRectangle) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt R.topEdge (-((R.right - R.left : ℝ) : ℂ)) t
proof:
:= by
  have heq : R.topEdge = fun s : ℝ =>
      ((R.right : ℂ) + (R.top : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        + (s : ℂ) * (-((R.right - R.left : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    funext s
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [topEdge]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  have h_ofReal : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ)) 1 t := by
    have := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := t)
    simp at this; convert this using 2
  have h_mul := h_ofReal.mul_const (-((R.right - R.left : ℝ) : ℂ))
  have h_add := h_mul.const_add ((R.right : ℂ) + (R.top : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  simpa using h_add

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.hasDerivAt_leftEdge
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_leftEdge (R : ZetaRectangle) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt R.leftEdge (-(((R.top - R.bottom : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) t
proof:
:= by
  have heq : R.leftEdge = fun s : ℝ =>
      ((R.left : ℂ) + (R.top : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        + (s : ℂ) * (-(((R.top - R.bottom : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
    funext s
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [leftEdge]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  have h_ofReal : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ)) 1 t := by
    have := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := t)
    simp at this; convert this using 2
  have h_mul := h_ofReal.mul_const (-(((R.top - R.bottom : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
  have h_add := h_mul.const_add ((R.left : ℂ) + (R.top : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  simpa using h_add

statement:
theorem ZetaRectangleEdgeDerivContinuous.of_affine_edges
    (R : ZetaRectangle) :
    R.ZetaRectangleEdgeDerivContinuous where
  bottom
proof:
