    rw [show (fun t : ℝ => deriv R.bottomEdge t)
          = fun _ : ℝ => ((R.right - R.left : ℝ) : ℂ) from
        funext fun t => R.deriv_bottomEdge t]

    rw [show (fun t : ℝ => deriv R.rightEdge t)

          = fun _ : ℝ => -((R.right - R.left : ℝ) : ℂ) from
        funext fun t => R.deriv_topEdge t]

  left := by
    rw [show (fun t : ℝ => deriv R.leftEdge t)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.hasLogDerivPrincipalPart_of_analytic_zero
statement:
theorem hasLogDerivPrincipalPart_of_analytic_zero
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {s : ℂ} {m : ℕ}
    (hAn : AnalyticAt ℂ f s)
    (horder : analyticOrderAt f s = (m : ℕ∞)) :
    HasLogDerivPrincipalPart f s m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg_an, hg_ne, hfg⟩ :=
    (hAn.analyticOrderAt_eq_natCast (n := m)).mp horder
  refine ⟨logDeriv g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [logDeriv] using (hg_an.deriv.div hg_an hg_ne)
  · let prod : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (z - s) ^ m * g z
    have hfg_prod : f =ᶠ[𝓝 s] prod := by
      filter_upwards [hfg] with z hz
      simpa [prod] using hz
    have h_eventual_local : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, f =ᶠ[𝓝 z] prod := by
      have hfg_univ :
          ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[Set.univ] s, f x = prod x := by
        rw [nhdsWithin_univ]; exact hfg_prod
      have hnear_univ :
          ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[Set.univ] s, f =ᶠ[𝓝[Set.univ] z] prod := by
        exact
          ((eventually_eventually_nhdsWithin (a := s) (s := Set.univ)
            (p := fun x => f x = prod x)).mpr hfg_univ)
      have hnear : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, f =ᶠ[𝓝 z] prod := by
        simpa using hnear_univ
      exact hnear.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hg_ne_event : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, g z ≠ 0 :=
      hg_an.continuousAt.eventually_ne hg_ne
    have hg_an_event : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, AnalyticAt ℂ g z :=
      hg_an.eventually_analyticAt
    filter_upwards
      [h_eventual_local,
       hg_ne_event.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
       hg_an_event.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds,
       self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hlocal hgz hgz_an hz_ne
    have hzsub : z - s ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hz_ne
    have hpow_ne : (z - s) ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hzsub
    have hval_eq : f z = prod z := hlocal.eq_of_nhds
    have hderiv_eq : deriv f z = deriv prod z := hlocal.deriv_eq
    have hlog_f_prod : logDeriv f z = logDeriv prod z := by
      simp [logDeriv, hderiv_eq, hval_eq]
    let a : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => (w - s) ^ m
    have hdiff_a : DifferentiableAt ℂ a z := by
      dsimp [a]
      fun_prop
    have hdiff_g : DifferentiableAt ℂ g z := hgz_an.differentiableAt
    have hprod_log : logDeriv prod z = logDeriv a z + logDeriv g z := by
      have h :=
        logDeriv_mul (f := a) (g := g) z hpow_ne hgz hdiff_a hdiff_g
      simpa [prod, a] using h
    have ha_log : logDeriv a z = (m : ℂ) / (z - s) := by
      dsimp [a]
      have hld :=
        logDeriv_fun_pow
          (f := fun w : ℂ => w - s) (x := z) (by fun_prop) m
      have hbase :
          logDeriv (fun w : ℂ => w - s) z = 1 / (z - s) := by
        simp [logDeriv]
      rw [hld, hbase]
      ring
    calc
      logDeriv f z = logDeriv prod z := hlog_f_prod
      _ = logDeriv a z + logDeriv g z := hprod_log
      _ = (m : ℂ) / (z - s) + logDeriv g z := by rw [ha_log]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.logDeriv_pow_sub
statement:
theorem logDeriv_pow_sub
    {s z : ℂ} {m : ℕ}
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (hz : z ≠ s) :
    logDeriv (fun w : ℂ => (w - s) ^ m) z = (m : ℂ) / (z - s)
proof:
:= by
  have hzs_ne : z - s ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hz
  have h_sub : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => w - s) 1 z :=
    (hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const s
  have h_pow : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (w - s) ^ m)
                  ((m : ℂ) * (z - s) ^ (m - 1) * 1) z := h_sub.pow m
  rw [logDeriv_apply]
  change deriv (fun w : ℂ => (w - s) ^ m) z / (z - s) ^ m = (m : ℂ) / (z - s)
  rw [h_pow.deriv, mul_one]
  rcases m with _ | m'
  · omega
  · have h_pow_m'_ne : (z - s) ^ m' ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero m' hzs_ne
    simp only [Nat.succ_sub_one, pow_succ]
    field_simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.logDeriv_eq_of_eventual_factorization
statement:
theorem logDeriv_eq_of_eventual_factorization
    {f u : ℂ → ℂ} {s z : ℂ} {m : ℕ}
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (hz : z ≠ s)
    (hu : u z ≠ 0)
    (hu_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ u z)
    (hf : f =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w : ℂ => (w - s) ^ m * u w) :
    logDeriv f z = (m : ℂ) / (z - s) + logDeriv u z
proof:
:= by
  have h_pow_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (w - s) ^ m) z := by
    fun_prop
  have h_pow_ne : (z - s) ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero m (sub_ne_zero.mpr hz)
  have h_logDeriv_eq :
      logDeriv f z = logDeriv (fun w : ℂ => (w - s) ^ m * u w) z := by
    rw [logDeriv_apply, logDeriv_apply, hf.deriv_eq, hf.self_of_nhds]
  rw [h_logDeriv_eq, logDeriv_mul z h_pow_ne hu h_pow_diff hu_diff,
      logDeriv_pow_sub hm hz]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.hasLogDerivPrincipalPartContinuous_of_factorization
statement:
theorem hasLogDerivPrincipalPartContinuous_of_factorization
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {s : ℂ} {m : ℕ}
    (hm_pos : 0 < m)
    (H : HasAnalyticZeroFactorization f s m) :
    HasLogDerivPrincipalPartContinuous f s (m : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  set u : ℂ → ℂ := H.unit with hu_def
  have hu_an : AnalyticAt ℂ u s := H.unit_analytic
  have hu_ne_s : u s ≠ 0 := H.unit_ne_zero
  have hu_cont : ContinuousAt u s := hu_an.continuousAt
  have hu_ne_eventually : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, u z ≠ 0 :=
    hu_cont.eventually_ne hu_ne_s
  have hu_diff_eventually : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, DifferentiableAt ℂ u z :=
    hu_an.eventually_analyticAt.mono (fun _ h => h.differentiableAt)
  have hfac_eventually_nhds :
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, f =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w : ℂ => (w - s) ^ m * u w :=
    H.factorization.eventually_nhds
  have hu_ne_punct : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, u z ≠ 0 :=
    hu_ne_eventually.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hu_diff_punct : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, DifferentiableAt ℂ u z :=
    hu_diff_eventually.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hfac_punct :
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, f =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w : ℂ => (w - s) ^ m * u w :=
    hfac_eventually_nhds.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hz_ne_punct : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, z ≠ s := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz using hz
  refine ⟨logDeriv u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show ContinuousAt (fun z => deriv u z / u z) s
    exact hu_an.deriv.continuousAt.div hu_cont hu_ne_s
  · filter_upwards [hfac_punct, hu_ne_punct, hu_diff_punct, hz_ne_punct]
      with z hfz huz hu_diff_z hz_ne_z
    have hmain :
        logDeriv f z = (m : ℂ) / (z - s) + logDeriv u z :=
      logDeriv_eq_of_eventual_factorization hm_pos hz_ne_z huz hu_diff_z hfz
    have hcast : ((m : ℤ) : ℂ) = (m : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
    rw [hcast]
    exact hmain

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.logDeriv_eq_of_eventual_simplePoleFactorization
statement:
theorem logDeriv_eq_of_eventual_simplePoleFactorization
    {f u : ℂ → ℂ} {s z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ≠ s)
    (hu : u z ≠ 0)
    (hu_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ u z)
    (hf : f =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w : ℂ => u w / (w - s)) :
    logDeriv f z = (-1 : ℂ) / (z - s) + logDeriv u z
proof:
:= by
  have hzs_ne : z - s ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hz
  have hsub_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w - s) z := by fun_prop
  have h_logDeriv_eq :
      logDeriv f z = logDeriv (fun w : ℂ => u w / (w - s)) z := by
    rw [logDeriv_apply, logDeriv_apply, hf.deriv_eq, hf.self_of_nhds]
  rw [h_logDeriv_eq, logDeriv_div z hu hzs_ne hu_diff hsub_diff]
  have h_sub_log :
      logDeriv (fun w : ℂ => w - s) z = (1 : ℂ) / (z - s) := by
    have h := logDeriv_pow_sub (m := 1) (s := s) (z := z) (by norm_num) hz
    simpa [pow_one] using h
  rw [h_sub_log]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.hasLogDerivPrincipalPartContinuous_of_simplePoleFactorization
statement:
theorem hasLogDerivPrincipalPartContinuous_of_simplePoleFactorization
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (H : HasSimplePoleFactorization f s) :
    HasLogDerivPrincipalPartContinuous f s (-1)
proof:
:= by
  set u : ℂ → ℂ := H.unit with hu_def
  have hu_an : AnalyticAt ℂ u s := H.unit_analytic
  have hu_ne_s : u s ≠ 0 := H.unit_ne_zero
  have hu_cont : ContinuousAt u s := hu_an.continuousAt
  have hu_ne_eventually : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, u z ≠ 0 :=
    hu_cont.eventually_ne hu_ne_s
  have hu_diff_eventually : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, DifferentiableAt ℂ u z :=
    hu_an.eventually_analyticAt.mono (fun _ h => h.differentiableAt)
  have hu_ne_punct : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, u z ≠ 0 :=
    hu_ne_eventually.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hu_diff_punct : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, DifferentiableAt ℂ u z :=
    hu_diff_eventually.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hz_ne_punct : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, z ≠ s := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz using hz
  refine ⟨logDeriv u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show ContinuousAt (fun z => deriv u z / u z) s
    exact hu_an.deriv.continuousAt.div hu_cont hu_ne_s
  · filter_upwards
      [H.factorization_local, hu_ne_punct, hu_diff_punct, hz_ne_punct]
      with z hfz huz hu_diff_z hz_ne_z
    have hmain :
        logDeriv f z = (-1 : ℂ) / (z - s) + logDeriv u z :=
      logDeriv_eq_of_eventual_simplePoleFactorization
        hz_ne_z huz hu_diff_z hfz
    have hcast : ((-1 : ℤ) : ℂ) = (-1 : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
    rw [hcast]
    exact hmain

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaLogDeriv_principalPartContinuous_at_one
statement:
theorem zetaLogDeriv_principalPartContinuous_at_one
    (H : HasSimplePoleFactorization riemannZeta (1 : ℂ)) :
    HasLogDerivPrincipalPartContinuous riemannZeta (1 : ℂ) (-1)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.riemannZetaPoleUnit_analyticAt_one
statement:
theorem riemannZetaPoleUnit_analyticAt_one :
    AnalyticAt ℂ riemannZetaPoleUnit (1 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  set f : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => (z - 1) * riemannZeta z with hf_def
  have h_tend : Tendsto f (𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ)) (𝓝 1) := riemannZeta_residue_one
  have h_lim_one : limUnder (𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ)) f = 1 := h_tend.limUnder_eq
  
  have h_norm_tend : Tendsto (fun z => ‖f z‖) (𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ)) (𝓝 (1 : ℝ)) := by
    have := h_tend.norm
    simpa using this
  have h_bd_event : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ), ‖f z‖ < 2 :=
    h_norm_tend.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2))
  
  rw [eventually_iff_exists_mem] at h_bd_event
  obtain ⟨E, hE_mem, hE⟩ := h_bd_event
  rw [mem_nhdsWithin] at hE_mem
  obtain ⟨V, hV_open, hV_mem_self, hV_sub⟩ := hE_mem
  have hV_nhds : V ∈ 𝓝 (1 : ℂ) := hV_open.mem_nhds hV_mem_self
  have h_bdd : BddAbove (norm ∘ f '' (V \ {1})) := by
    refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
    rintro x ⟨z, ⟨hz_V, hz_ne_one⟩, rfl⟩
    have hz_in_E : z ∈ E := hV_sub ⟨hz_V, hz_ne_one⟩
    exact le_of_lt (hE z hz_in_E)
  
  have h_diff_on : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (V \ {1}) := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨_, hz_ne_one⟩ := hz
    have hz_ne : z ≠ 1 := hz_ne_one
    have h_zeta : DifferentiableAt ℂ riemannZeta z := differentiableAt_riemannZeta hz_ne
    have h_sub : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w - 1) z := by fun_prop
    exact (h_sub.mul h_zeta).differentiableWithinAt
  
  have h_diff_update :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ (Function.update f 1 (limUnder (𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ)) f)) V :=
    differentiableOn_update_limUnder_of_bddAbove hV_nhds h_diff_on h_bdd
  
  have h_eq : Function.update f 1 (limUnder (𝓝[≠] (1 : ℂ)) f) = riemannZetaPoleUnit := by
    rw [h_lim_one]
    funext z
    by_cases hz : z = 1
    · subst hz; simp [riemannZetaPoleUnit]
    · rw [riemannZetaPoleUnit_eq_of_ne_one hz, Function.update_of_ne hz]
  rw [← h_eq]
  exact h_diff_update.analyticAt hV_nhds

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.hasLogDerivPrincipalPart_of_factorization
statement:
theorem hasLogDerivPrincipalPart_of_factorization
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {s : ℂ} {m : ℕ}
    (hm_pos : 0 < m) (H : HasAnalyticZeroFactorization f s m) :
    HasLogDerivPrincipalPart f s m
proof:
:= by
  set u : ℂ → ℂ := H.unit with hu_def
  have hu_an : AnalyticAt ℂ u s := H.unit_analytic
  have hu_ne_s : u s ≠ 0 := H.unit_ne_zero
  have hu_cont : ContinuousAt u s := hu_an.continuousAt
  have hu_ne_eventually : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, u z ≠ 0 :=
    hu_cont.eventually_ne hu_ne_s
  have hu_diff_eventually : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, DifferentiableAt ℂ u z :=
    hu_an.eventually_analyticAt.mono (fun _ h => h.differentiableAt)
  have hfac_eventually_nhds :
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, f =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w : ℂ => (w - s) ^ m * u w :=
    H.factorization.eventually_nhds
  have hu_ne_punct : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, u z ≠ 0 :=
    hu_ne_eventually.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hu_diff_punct : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, DifferentiableAt ℂ u z :=
    hu_diff_eventually.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hfac_punct :
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, f =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w : ℂ => (w - s) ^ m * u w :=
    hfac_eventually_nhds.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hz_ne_punct : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, z ≠ s := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz using hz
  refine ⟨logDeriv u, analyticAt_logDeriv_of_analyticAt_ne_zero hu_an hu_ne_s, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hfac_punct, hu_ne_punct, hu_diff_punct, hz_ne_punct]
    with z hfz huz hu_diff_z hz_ne_z
  exact logDeriv_eq_of_eventual_factorization hm_pos hz_ne_z huz hu_diff_z hfz

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.hasLogDerivIntegerPrincipalPart_of_simplePoleFactorization
statement:
theorem hasLogDerivIntegerPrincipalPart_of_simplePoleFactorization
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {s : ℂ} (H : HasSimplePoleFactorization f s) :
    HasLogDerivIntegerPrincipalPart f s (-1)
proof:
:= by
  set u : ℂ → ℂ := H.unit with hu_def
  have hu_an : AnalyticAt ℂ u s := H.unit_analytic
  have hu_ne_s : u s ≠ 0 := H.unit_ne_zero
  have hu_cont : ContinuousAt u s := hu_an.continuousAt
  have hu_ne_eventually : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, u z ≠ 0 :=
    hu_cont.eventually_ne hu_ne_s
  have hu_diff_eventually : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, DifferentiableAt ℂ u z :=
    hu_an.eventually_analyticAt.mono (fun _ h => h.differentiableAt)
  have hu_ne_punct : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, u z ≠ 0 :=
    hu_ne_eventually.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hu_diff_punct : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, DifferentiableAt ℂ u z :=
    hu_diff_eventually.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hz_ne_punct : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] s, z ≠ s := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz using hz
  refine ⟨logDeriv u, analyticAt_logDeriv_of_analyticAt_ne_zero hu_an hu_ne_s, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards
    [H.factorization_local, hu_ne_punct, hu_diff_punct, hz_ne_punct]
    with z hfz huz hu_diff_z hz_ne_z
  have hmain :
      logDeriv f z = (-1 : ℂ) / (z - s) + logDeriv u z :=
    logDeriv_eq_of_eventual_simplePoleFactorization hz_ne_z huz hu_diff_z hfz
  have hcast : ((-1 : ℤ) : ℂ) = (-1 : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
  rw [hcast]
  exact hmain

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.principalKernelRectangleIntegral_eq_int_mul_unit
statement:
theorem principalKernelRectangleIntegral_eq_int_mul_unit
    (R : ZetaRectangle) (k : ℤ) (a : ℂ) :
    R.principalKernelRectangleIntegral k a =
      (k : ℂ) * R.unitPrincipalKernelRectangleIntegral a
proof:
:= by
  have h_kernel : ∀ z : ℂ,
      principalKernel k a z = (k : ℂ) * principalKernel 1 a z := by
    intro z; unfold principalKernel; ring
  have edge_eq : ∀ edge : ℝ → ℂ,
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, principalKernel k a (edge t) * deriv edge t) =
        (k : ℂ) *
          ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, principalKernel 1 a (edge t) * deriv edge t := by
    intro edge
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun t _ => ?_)
    rw [h_kernel]; ring
  unfold principalKernelRectangleIntegral unitPrincipalKernelRectangleIntegral
  rw [edge_eq R.bottomEdge, edge_eq R.rightEdge,
      edge_eq R.topEdge, edge_eq R.leftEdge]
  
  
  
  unfold principalKernelRectangleIntegral
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.isOpen_containsOpen

theorem isOpen_containsOpen (R : ZetaRectangle) :
    IsOpen {z : ℂ | R.ContainsOpen z}
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsOpen {z : ℂ | R.left < z.re} :=
    isOpen_Ioi.preimage Complex.continuous_re
  have h2 : IsOpen {z : ℂ | z.re < R.right} :=
    isOpen_Iio.preimage Complex.continuous_re
  have h3 : IsOpen {z : ℂ | R.bottom < z.im} :=
    isOpen_Ioi.preimage Complex.continuous_im
  have h4 : IsOpen {z : ℂ | z.im < R.top} :=
    isOpen_Iio.preimage Complex.continuous_im
  exact h1.inter (h2.inter (h3.inter h4))

proof:

statement:
theorem analyticAt_unitPrincipalKernel_of_ne
    {a z : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ a) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => unitPrincipalKernel a w) z
proof:
:= by
  unfold unitPrincipalKernel
  have h_id : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w) z := analyticAt_id
  have h_const_a : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => a) z := analyticAt_const
  have h_den : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w - a) z := h_id.sub h_const_a
  have h_num : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => (1 : ℂ)) z := analyticAt_const
  exact h_num.div h_den (sub_ne_zero.mpr hz)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.exists_smallSquareInsideRectangle
statement:
theorem exists_smallSquareInsideRectangle
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {a : ℂ}
    (ha : R.ContainsOpen a) :
    Nonempty (R.SmallSquareInsideRectangle a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hL, hRt, hB, hT⟩ := ha
  set r : ℝ :=
    min (min ((a.re - R.left) / 2) ((R.right - a.re) / 2))
      (min ((a.im - R.bottom) / 2) ((R.top - a.im) / 2)) with hr_def
  have hr_pos : 0 < r := by
    refine lt_min (lt_min ?_ ?_) (lt_min ?_ ?_) <;> linarith
  refine ⟨⟨r, hr_pos, ?_⟩⟩
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨hre_abs, him_abs⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨hre_low, hre_high⟩ := abs_le.mp hre_abs
  obtain ⟨him_low, him_high⟩ := abs_le.mp him_abs
  have hr_le_left : r ≤ (a.re - R.left) / 2 :=
    (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hr_le_right : r ≤ (R.right - a.re) / 2 :=
    (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hr_le_bottom : r ≤ (a.im - R.bottom) / 2 :=
    (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hr_le_top : r ≤ (R.top - a.im) / 2 :=
    (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.rectangleIntegral_add_of_integrable
statement:
theorem rectangleIntegral_add_of_integrable
    (R : ZetaRectangle) (f g : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hf_bottom :
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun t : ℝ => f (R.bottomEdge t) * deriv R.bottomEdge t)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1)
    (hg_bottom :
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun t : ℝ => g (R.bottomEdge t) * deriv R.bottomEdge t)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1)
    (hf_right :
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun t : ℝ => f (R.rightEdge t) * deriv R.rightEdge t)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1)
    (hg_right :
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun t : ℝ => g (R.rightEdge t) * deriv R.rightEdge t)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1)
    (hf_top :
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun t : ℝ => f (R.topEdge t) * deriv R.topEdge t)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1)
    (hg_top :
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun t : ℝ => g (R.topEdge t) * deriv R.topEdge t)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1)
    (hf_left :
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun t : ℝ => f (R.leftEdge t) * deriv R.leftEdge t)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1)
    (hg_left :
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun t : ℝ => g (R.leftEdge t) * deriv R.leftEdge t)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1) :
    R.rectangleIntegral (fun z => f z + g z) =
      R.rectangleIntegral f + R.rectangleIntegral g
proof:
:= by
  unfold rectangleIntegral
  simp only [add_mul]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hf_bottom hg_bottom,
      intervalIntegral.integral_add hf_right hg_right,
      intervalIntegral.integral_add hf_top hg_top,
      intervalIntegral.integral_add hf_left hg_left]
  abel

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.rectangleIntegralIntegrable_finset_sum
statement:
theorem rectangleIntegralIntegrable_finset_sum
    (R : ZetaRectangle) (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S : Finset ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ s ∈ S, R.RectangleIntegralIntegrable (F s)) :
    R.RectangleIntegralIntegrable (fun z => S.sum (fun s => F s z))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  revert hF
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro _
    have h : (fun z : ℂ => (∅ : Finset ℂ).sum (fun s => F s z)) = (fun _ : ℂ => 0) := by
      funext z; exact Finset.sum_empty
    rw [h]
    exact RectangleIntegralIntegrable.zero R
  | insert a S' ha ih =>
    intro hF
    have hFa : R.RectangleIntegralIntegrable (F a) :=
      hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self a S')
    have hF' : ∀ t ∈ S', R.RectangleIntegralIntegrable (F t) := fun t ht =>
      hF t (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem ht)
    have h_rest := ih hF'
    have h_eq : (fun z : ℂ => (insert a S').sum (fun t => F t z))
              = fun z => F a z + S'.sum (fun t => F t z) := by
      funext z
      exact Finset.sum_insert ha
    rw [h_eq]
    exact hFa.add h_rest

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.rectangleIntegral_finset_sum
statement:
theorem rectangleIntegral_finset_sum
    (R : ZetaRectangle) (F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) (S : Finset ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ s ∈ S, R.RectangleIntegralIntegrable (F s)) :
    R.rectangleIntegral (fun z => S.sum (fun s => F s z)) =
      S.sum (fun s => R.rectangleIntegral (F s))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  revert hF
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro _
    simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
    unfold rectangleIntegral
    simp
  | insert a S' ha ih =>
    intro hF
    have hFa : R.RectangleIntegralIntegrable (F a) :=
      hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self a S')
    have hF' : ∀ t ∈ S', R.RectangleIntegralIntegrable (F t) := fun t ht =>
      hF t (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem ht)
    have hSumInt :
        R.RectangleIntegralIntegrable (fun z => S'.sum (fun t => F t z)) :=
      rectangleIntegralIntegrable_finset_sum R F S' hF'
    have h_eq : (fun z : ℂ => (insert a S').sum (fun t => F t z))
              = fun z => F a z + S'.sum (fun t => F t z) := by
      funext z
      exact Finset.sum_insert ha
    rw [h_eq]
    rw [rectangleIntegral_add_of_integrable_package R (F a)
        (fun z => S'.sum (fun t => F t z)) hFa hSumInt]
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, ih hF']

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.boundary_ne_of_mem_principalPart_singularities
statement:
theorem boundary_ne_of_mem_principalPart_singularities
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {P : R.RectanglePrincipalPartData} {s z : ℂ}
    (hs : s ∈ P.singularities) (hz : R.ContainsBoundary z) :
    z ≠ s
proof:
:= by
  have hsCounted : R.IsCountedZetaSingularityInside s :=
    (P.singularities_complete s).mp hs
  intro hzs
  subst z
  rcases hsCounted with hsZero | hsPole
  · exact P.stronglyAdmissible.noZetaZerosOnBoundary s hsZero.1.1 hz
  · obtain ⟨_, hs_eq⟩ := hsPole
    subst hs_eq
    exact P.stronglyAdmissible.poleNotOnBoundary hz

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.continuousAt_principalKernel_of_ne
statement:
theorem continuousAt_principalKernel_of_ne
    {k : ℤ} {s z : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ s) :
    ContinuousAt (fun w : ℂ => principalKernel k s w) z
proof:
:= by
  unfold principalKernel
  refine continuousAt_const.div (continuousAt_id.sub continuousAt_const) ?_
  simpa [sub_eq_zero] using hz

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.intervalIntegrable_principalKernel_on_edge
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_principalKernel_on_edge
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {P : R.RectanglePrincipalPartData} {s : ℂ}
    (hs : s ∈ P.singularities) (γ : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hγ_cont : Continuous γ)
    (hγ_deriv_cont : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => deriv γ t) (Set.Icc 0 1))
    (hγ_boundary :
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → R.ContainsBoundary (γ t)) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t : ℝ =>
        principalKernel (P.principalCoeff s) s (γ t) * deriv γ t)
      MeasureTheory.volume 0 1
proof:
:= by
  have hkernel :
      ContinuousOn
        (fun t : ℝ => principalKernel (P.principalCoeff s) s (γ t))
        (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
    intro t ht
    have hzbd : R.ContainsBoundary (γ t) := hγ_boundary t ht.1 ht.2
    have hz_ne : γ t ≠ s :=
      boundary_ne_of_mem_principalPart_singularities hs hzbd
    exact
      ((continuousAt_principalKernel_of_ne hz_ne).comp
        hγ_cont.continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  exact (hkernel.mul hγ_deriv_cont).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.rectangleIntegralIntegrable_principalKernel
statement:
theorem rectangleIntegralIntegrable_principalKernel
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {P : R.RectanglePrincipalPartData} {s : ℂ}
    (hs : s ∈ P.singularities) :
    R.RectangleIntegralIntegrable
      (fun z => principalKernel (P.principalCoeff s) s z) where
  bottom
proof:
:=
    intervalIntegrable_principalKernel_on_edge (R := R) (P := P) hs
      R.bottomEdge R.continuous_bottomEdge
      (ZetaRectangleEdgeDerivContinuous.of_affine_edges R).bottom
      (fun _ ht0 ht1 => R.bottomEdge_mem_boundary ht0 ht1)
  right :=
    intervalIntegrable_principalKernel_on_edge (R := R) (P := P) hs
      R.rightEdge R.continuous_rightEdge
      (ZetaRectangleEdgeDerivContinuous.of_affine_edges R).right
      (fun _ ht0 ht1 => R.rightEdge_mem_boundary ht0 ht1)
  top :=
    intervalIntegrable_principalKernel_on_edge (R := R) (P := P) hs
      R.topEdge R.continuous_topEdge
      (ZetaRectangleEdgeDerivContinuous.of_affine_edges R).top
      (fun _ ht0 ht1 => R.topEdge_mem_boundary ht0 ht1)
  left :=
    intervalIntegrable_principalKernel_on_edge (R := R) (P := P) hs
      R.leftEdge R.continuous_leftEdge
      (ZetaRectangleEdgeDerivContinuous.of_affine_edges R).left
      (fun _ ht0 ht1 => R.leftEdge_mem_boundary ht0 ht1)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.rectangleIntegralIntegrable_principalPartSum
statement:
theorem rectangleIntegralIntegrable_principalPartSum
    {R : ZetaRectangle} (P : R.RectanglePrincipalPartData) :
    R.RectangleIntegralIntegrable (R.principalPartSum P)
proof:
:= by
  unfold principalPartSum
  exact rectangleIntegralIntegrable_finset_sum R
    (fun s z => principalKernel (P.principalCoeff s) s z)
    P.singularities
    (fun s hs => rectangleIntegralIntegrable_principalKernel hs)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.intervalIntegral_affine_horizontal_complex
statement:
theorem intervalIntegral_affine_horizontal_complex
    (g : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, g ((b - a) * t + a) * ((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      ∫ x in a..b, g x
proof:
:= by
  have h_smul :
      (fun t : ℝ => g ((b - a) * t + a) * ((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun t : ℝ => (b - a : ℝ) • g ((b - a) * t + a)) := by
    funext t
    rw [Complex.real_smul, mul_comm]
  rw [h_smul, intervalIntegral.integral_smul,
      intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_mul_add]
  simp only [mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add, sub_add_cancel]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.bottomEdgeIntegral_eq_bottomHorizontalIntegral
statement:
theorem bottomEdgeIntegral_eq_bottomHorizontalIntegral
    (R : ZetaRectangle) (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, f (R.bottomEdge t) * deriv R.bottomEdge t) =
      R.bottomHorizontalIntegral f
proof:
:= by
  unfold bottomHorizontalIntegral
  have h_pointwise :
      (fun t : ℝ => f (R.bottomEdge t) * deriv R.bottomEdge t) =
        (fun t : ℝ =>
          (fun x : ℝ => f ⟨x, R.bottom⟩) ((R.right - R.left) * t + R.left) *
            ((R.right - R.left : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    funext t
    rw [R.deriv_bottomEdge t]
    have he : R.bottomEdge t = ⟨(R.right - R.left) * t + R.left, R.bottom⟩ := by
      unfold ZetaRectangle.bottomEdge
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [he]
  rw [h_pointwise]
  exact intervalIntegral_affine_horizontal_complex
    (fun x : ℝ => f ⟨x, R.bottom⟩) R.left R.right

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.intervalIntegral_affine_vertical_complex
statement:
theorem intervalIntegral_affine_vertical_complex
    (g : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      g ((b - a) * t + a) * (((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
      ∫ y in a..b, g y * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  have h := intervalIntegral_affine_horizontal_complex
    (fun y : ℝ => g y * Complex.I) a b
  have h_eq :
      (fun t : ℝ =>
        g ((b - a) * t + a) * (((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
      (fun t : ℝ =>
        (fun y : ℝ => g y * Complex.I) ((b - a) * t + a) *
          ((b - a : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    funext t; ring
  rw [h_eq]
  exact h

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.rightEdgeIntegral_eq_rightVerticalIntegral
statement:
theorem rightEdgeIntegral_eq_rightVerticalIntegral
    (R : ZetaRectangle) (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, f (R.rightEdge t) * deriv R.rightEdge t) =
      R.rightVerticalIntegral f
proof:
:= by
  unfold rightVerticalIntegral
  have h_pointwise :
      (fun t : ℝ => f (R.rightEdge t) * deriv R.rightEdge t) =
        (fun t : ℝ =>
          (fun y : ℝ => f ⟨R.right, y⟩)
            ((R.top - R.bottom) * t + R.bottom) *
            (((R.top - R.bottom : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
    funext t
    rw [R.deriv_rightEdge t]
    have he : R.rightEdge t = ⟨R.right, (R.top - R.bottom) * t + R.bottom⟩ := by
      unfold ZetaRectangle.rightEdge
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [he]
  rw [h_pointwise]
  exact intervalIntegral_affine_vertical_complex
    (fun y : ℝ => f ⟨R.right, y⟩) R.bottom R.top

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.topEdgeIntegral_eq_topHorizontalIntegral
statement:
theorem topEdgeIntegral_eq_topHorizontalIntegral
    (R : ZetaRectangle) (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, f (R.topEdge t) * deriv R.topEdge t) =
      R.topHorizontalIntegral f
proof:
:= by
  unfold topHorizontalIntegral
  have h_pointwise :
      (fun t : ℝ => f (R.topEdge t) * deriv R.topEdge t) =
        (fun t : ℝ =>
          (fun x : ℝ => f ⟨x, R.top⟩) ((R.left - R.right) * t + R.right) *
            ((R.left - R.right : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    funext t
    rw [R.deriv_topEdge t]
    have he : R.topEdge t = ⟨(R.left - R.right) * t + R.right, R.top⟩ := by
      unfold ZetaRectangle.topEdge
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [he]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [h_pointwise]
  exact intervalIntegral_affine_horizontal_complex
    (fun x : ℝ => f ⟨x, R.top⟩) R.right R.left

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.leftEdgeIntegral_eq_leftVerticalIntegral
statement:
theorem leftEdgeIntegral_eq_leftVerticalIntegral
    (R : ZetaRectangle) (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, f (R.leftEdge t) * deriv R.leftEdge t) =
      R.leftVerticalIntegral f
proof:
:= by
  unfold leftVerticalIntegral
  have h_pointwise :
      (fun t : ℝ => f (R.leftEdge t) * deriv R.leftEdge t) =
        (fun t : ℝ =>
          (fun y : ℝ => f ⟨R.left, y⟩) ((R.bottom - R.top) * t + R.top) *
            (((R.bottom - R.top : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
    funext t
    rw [R.deriv_leftEdge t]
    have he : R.leftEdge t = ⟨R.left, (R.bottom - R.top) * t + R.top⟩ := by
      unfold ZetaRectangle.leftEdge
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [he]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [h_pointwise]
  exact intervalIntegral_affine_vertical_complex
    (fun y : ℝ => f ⟨R.left, y⟩) R.top R.bottom

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.rectangleEdgeIntegralCoordinateBridge
statement:
theorem rectangleEdgeIntegralCoordinateBridge
    (R : ZetaRectangle) (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    R.RectangleEdgeIntegralCoordinateBridge f where
  bottom
proof:
:= bottomEdgeIntegral_eq_bottomHorizontalIntegral R f
  right := rightEdgeIntegral_eq_rightVerticalIntegral R f
  top := topEdgeIntegral_eq_topHorizontalIntegral R f
  left := leftEdgeIntegral_eq_leftVerticalIntegral R f

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.mathlibCauchyGoursatHook
statement:
theorem mathlibCauchyGoursatHook : MathlibCauchyGoursatHook where
  vanishes R f hf
proof:
:= by
    have hLR : R.left ≤ R.right := R.hleft_lt_right.le
    have hBT : R.bottom ≤ R.top := R.hbottom_lt_top.le
    set z₀ : ℂ := ⟨R.left, R.bottom⟩
    set w₀ : ℂ := ⟨R.right, R.top⟩
    have hz_re : z₀.re = R.left := rfl
    have hz_im : z₀.im = R.bottom := rfl
    have hw_re : w₀.re = R.right := rfl
    have hw_im : w₀.im = R.top := rfl
    
    have hcont : ContinuousOn f
        (Set.uIcc z₀.re w₀.re ×ℂ Set.uIcc z₀.im w₀.im) := by
      intro p hp
      have hp_mem := mem_reProdIm.mp hp
      have hp_re : p.re ∈ Set.uIcc z₀.re w₀.re := hp_mem.1
      have hp_im : p.im ∈ Set.uIcc z₀.im w₀.im := hp_mem.2
      rw [show z₀.re = R.left from rfl, show w₀.re = R.right from rfl,
          Set.uIcc_of_le hLR, Set.mem_Icc] at hp_re
      rw [show z₀.im = R.bottom from rfl, show w₀.im = R.top from rfl,
          Set.uIcc_of_le hBT, Set.mem_Icc] at hp_im
      have hp_closed : R.ContainsClosed p :=
        ⟨hp_re.1, hp_re.2, hp_im.1, hp_im.2⟩
      exact (hf p hp_closed).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    
    have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℂ f
        (Set.Ioo (min z₀.re w₀.re) (max z₀.re w₀.re) ×ℂ
         Set.Ioo (min z₀.im w₀.im) (max z₀.im w₀.im)) := by
      intro p hp
      have hp_mem := mem_reProdIm.mp hp
      have hp_re : p.re ∈ Set.Ioo (min z₀.re w₀.re) (max z₀.re w₀.re) :=
        hp_mem.1
      have hp_im : p.im ∈ Set.Ioo (min z₀.im w₀.im) (max z₀.im w₀.im) :=
        hp_mem.2
      rw [show z₀.re = R.left from rfl, show w₀.re = R.right from rfl,
          min_eq_left hLR, max_eq_right hLR, Set.mem_Ioo] at hp_re
      rw [show z₀.im = R.bottom from rfl, show w₀.im = R.top from rfl,
          min_eq_left hBT, max_eq_right hBT, Set.mem_Ioo] at hp_im
      have hp_closed : R.ContainsClosed p :=
        ⟨hp_re.1.le, hp_re.2.le, hp_im.1.le, hp_im.2.le⟩
      exact (hf p hp_closed).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    
    have h_mathlib :=
      Complex.integral_boundary_rect_eq_zero_of_continuousOn_of_differentiableOn
        f z₀ w₀ hcont hdiff
    rw [hz_re, hz_im, hw_re, hw_im] at h_mathlib
    
    have h_bot_eq :
        R.bottomHorizontalIntegral f =
          ∫ x in R.left..R.right, f (↑x + ↑R.bottom * Complex.I) := by
      unfold bottomHorizontalIntegral
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x _
      change f ⟨x, R.bottom⟩ = f (↑x + ↑R.bottom * Complex.I)
      rw [Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I]
    have h_top_eq :
        R.topHorizontalIntegral f =
          -(∫ x in R.left..R.right, f (↑x + ↑R.top * Complex.I)) := by
      unfold topHorizontalIntegral
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm]
      congr 1
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x _
      change f ⟨x, R.top⟩ = f (↑x + ↑R.top * Complex.I)
      rw [Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I]
    have h_right_eq :
        R.rightVerticalIntegral f =
          Complex.I • (∫ y in R.bottom..R.top, f (↑R.right + ↑y * Complex.I)) := by
      unfold rightVerticalIntegral
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
      have h_inner :
          (∫ y in R.bottom..R.top, f ⟨R.right, y⟩) =
            ∫ y in R.bottom..R.top, f (↑R.right + ↑y * Complex.I) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro y _
        change f ⟨R.right, y⟩ = f (↑R.right + ↑y * Complex.I)
        rw [Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I]
      rw [h_inner, smul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_comm _ _
    have h_left_eq :
        R.leftVerticalIntegral f =
          -(Complex.I • (∫ y in R.bottom..R.top, f (↑R.left + ↑y * Complex.I))) := by
      unfold leftVerticalIntegral
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
      have h_inner :
          (∫ y in R.bottom..R.top, f ⟨R.left, y⟩) =
            ∫ y in R.bottom..R.top, f (↑R.left + ↑y * Complex.I) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro y _
        change f ⟨R.left, y⟩ = f (↑R.left + ↑y * Complex.I)
        rw [Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I]
      rw [h_inner, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    
    have h_sum : R.coordinateBoundaryIntegral f =
        (∫ x in R.left..R.right, f (↑x + ↑R.bottom * Complex.I)) -
          (∫ x in R.left..R.right, f (↑x + ↑R.top * Complex.I)) +
          Complex.I • (∫ y in R.bottom..R.top, f (↑R.right + ↑y * Complex.I)) -
          Complex.I • (∫ y in R.bottom..R.top, f (↑R.left + ↑y * Complex.I)) := by
      unfold coordinateBoundaryIntegral
      rw [h_bot_eq, h_right_eq, h_top_eq, h_left_eq]
      ring
    rw [h_sum]
    exact h_mathlib

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.fourStripBoundaryCancellation_of_sumIdentity
statement:
theorem fourStripBoundaryCancellation_of_sumIdentity
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {a : ℂ}
    {S : R.SmallSquareInsideRectangle a}
    (CG : FourStripCauchyGoursatData S)
    (H : FourStripBoundarySumIdentity S) :
    FourStripBoundaryCancellation S where
  rectangle_eq_square
proof:
:= by
    have h_top : S.topStrip.unitPrincipalKernelRectangleIntegral a = 0 := by
      have := CG.topCG.integral_eq_zero
      rwa [rectangleIntegral_unitPrincipalKernel_eq] at this
    have h_bot : S.bottomStrip.unitPrincipalKernelRectangleIntegral a = 0 := by
      have := CG.bottomCG.integral_eq_zero
      rwa [rectangleIntegral_unitPrincipalKernel_eq] at this
    have h_left : S.leftStrip.unitPrincipalKernelRectangleIntegral a = 0 := by
      have := CG.leftCG.integral_eq_zero
      rwa [rectangleIntegral_unitPrincipalKernel_eq] at this
    have h_right : S.rightStrip.unitPrincipalKernelRectangleIntegral a = 0 := by
      have := CG.rightCG.integral_eq_zero
      rwa [rectangleIntegral_unitPrincipalKernel_eq] at this
    have hsum_zero :
        S.topStrip.unitPrincipalKernelRectangleIntegral a
          + S.bottomStrip.unitPrincipalKernelRectangleIntegral a
          + S.leftStrip.unitPrincipalKernelRectangleIntegral a
          + S.rightStrip.unitPrincipalKernelRectangleIntegral a = 0 := by
      rw [h_top, h_bot, h_left, h_right]; ring
    have hsub :
        R.unitPrincipalKernelRectangleIntegral a -
          R.smallSquareUnitKernelIntegral S = 0 := by
      rw [← H.sum_eq]; exact hsum_zero
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hsub

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.FourStripCoordinateBoundarySumIdentity.toBoundarySumIdentity
proof:
:= by
    
    have h_to_coord : ∀ (R' : ZetaRectangle),
        R'.unitPrincipalKernelRectangleIntegral a =
          R'.coordinateBoundaryIntegral (unitPrincipalKernel a) := by
      intro R'
      rw [← rectangleIntegral_unitPrincipalKernel_eq]
      exact rectangleIntegral_eq_coordinateBoundaryIntegral
        (rectangleEdgeIntegralCoordinateBridge R' (unitPrincipalKernel a))
    have h_inner :
        R.smallSquareUnitKernelIntegral S =
          S.toRectangle.coordinateBoundaryIntegral (unitPrincipalKernel a) := by
      unfold smallSquareUnitKernelIntegral
      exact h_to_coord S.toRectangle
    rw [h_to_coord S.topStrip, h_to_coord S.bottomStrip,
        h_to_coord S.leftStrip, h_to_coord S.rightStrip,
        h_to_coord R, h_inner]
    exact H.coordinate_sum_eq

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.fourStripBoundarySymbolic
statement:
theorem fourStripBoundarySymbolic
    (L Rgt B T xl xr yb yt : ℝ) (a : ℂ)
    (hRight :
      vEdge Rgt B yb a + vEdge Rgt yb yt a + vEdge Rgt yt T a =
        vEdge Rgt B T a)
    (hLeft :
      vEdge L T yt a + vEdge L yt yb a + vEdge L yb B a =
        vEdge L T B a)
    (hInnerBottomJoin :
      hEdge yb L xl a + hEdge yb xl xr a + hEdge yb xr Rgt a =
        hEdge yb L Rgt a)
    (hInnerTopJoin :
      hEdge yt Rgt xr a + hEdge yt xr xl a + hEdge yt xl L a =
        hEdge yt Rgt L a)
    (hInnerBottomReverse :
      hEdge yb Rgt L a = -hEdge yb L Rgt a)
    (hInnerTopReverse :
      hEdge yt L Rgt a = -hEdge yt Rgt L a)
    (hInnerLeftReverse :
      vEdge xl yb yt a = -vEdge xl yt yb a)
    (hInnerRightReverse :
      vEdge xr yt yb a = -vEdge xr yb yt a) :
    ((hEdge B L Rgt a + vEdge Rgt B yb a
        + hEdge yb Rgt L a + vEdge L yb B a)
      +
      (hEdge yt L Rgt a + vEdge Rgt yt T a
        + hEdge T Rgt L a + vEdge L T yt a)
      +
      (hEdge yb L xl a + vEdge xl yb yt a
        + hEdge yt xl L a + vEdge L yt yb a)
      +
      (hEdge yb xr Rgt a + vEdge Rgt yb yt a
        + hEdge yt Rgt xr a + vEdge xr yt yb a)) =
    (hEdge B L Rgt a + vEdge Rgt B T a
      + hEdge T Rgt L a + vEdge L T B a) -
    (hEdge yb xl xr a + vEdge xr yb yt a
      + hEdge yt xr xl a + vEdge xl yt yb a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hRight, ← hLeft]
  rw [hInnerBottomReverse, hInnerTopReverse,
      hInnerLeftReverse, hInnerRightReverse]
  rw [← hInnerBottomJoin, ← hInnerTopJoin]
  abel

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.continuous_complex_mk_real_horizontal
statement:
theorem continuous_complex_mk_real_horizontal (y : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (⟨x, y⟩ : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq :
      (fun x : ℝ => (⟨x, y⟩ : ℂ)) =
        fun x : ℝ => ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    funext x; exact Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I x y
  rw [h_eq]
  exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.continuous_complex_mk_real_vertical
statement:

    Continuous (fun y : ℝ => (⟨x, y⟩ : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq :
      (fun y : ℝ => (⟨x, y⟩ : ℂ)) =
        fun y : ℝ => ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    funext y; exact Complex.mk_eq_add_mul_I x y
  rw [h_eq]
  exact continuous_const.add (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.continuous_unitPrincipalKernel_horizontal
statement:
theorem continuous_unitPrincipalKernel_horizontal
    (a : ℂ) {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ a.im) :
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => unitPrincipalKernel a ⟨x, y⟩)
proof:
:= by
  unfold unitPrincipalKernel
  refine Continuous.div continuous_const
    ((continuous_complex_mk_real_horizontal y).sub continuous_const) ?_
  intro x heq
  have h_eq : (⟨x, y⟩ : ℂ) = a := sub_eq_zero.mp heq
  have hyeq : y = a.im := by
    have := congrArg Complex.im h_eq
    simpa using this
  exact hy hyeq

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.continuous_unitPrincipalKernel_vertical_with_I
statement:
theorem continuous_unitPrincipalKernel_vertical_with_I
    (a : ℂ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ a.re) :
    Continuous (fun y : ℝ => unitPrincipalKernel a ⟨x, y⟩ * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  have h_inner : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => unitPrincipalKernel a ⟨x, y⟩) := by
    unfold unitPrincipalKernel
    refine Continuous.div continuous_const
      ((continuous_complex_mk_real_vertical x).sub continuous_const) ?_
    intro y heq
    have h_eq : (⟨x, y⟩ : ℂ) = a := sub_eq_zero.mp heq
    have hxeq : x = a.re := by
      have := congrArg Complex.re h_eq
      simpa using this
    exact hx hxeq
  exact h_inner.mul continuous_const

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.fourStripCoordinateBoundarySumIdentity
statement:
theorem fourStripCoordinateBoundarySumIdentity
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {a : ℂ}
    (S : R.SmallSquareInsideRectangle a) :
    FourStripCoordinateBoundarySumIdentity S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  have haOpen : R.ContainsOpen a := by
    apply S.square_subset_open
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show |a.re - a.re| ≤ S.r; simp; exact S.r_pos.le
    · show |a.im - a.im| ≤ S.r; simp; exact S.r_pos.le
  have hright_ne : R.right ≠ a.re := fun h => by linarith [haOpen.2.1]
  have hleft_ne : R.left ≠ a.re := fun h => by linarith [haOpen.1]
  have hyb_ne : a.im - S.r ≠ a.im := fun h => by linarith [S.r_pos]
  have hyt_ne : a.im + S.r ≠ a.im := fun h => by linarith [S.r_pos]
  have h_sym :=
    fourStripBoundarySymbolic
      R.left R.right R.bottom R.top
      (a.re - S.r) (a.re + S.r)
      (a.im - S.r) (a.im + S.r) a
      (vEdge_add_three_adjacent_eq
        (intervalIntegrable_unitPrincipalKernel_vertical_with_I
          a hright_ne R.bottom (a.im - S.r))
        (intervalIntegrable_unitPrincipalKernel_vertical_with_I
          a hright_ne (a.im - S.r) (a.im + S.r))
        (intervalIntegrable_unitPrincipalKernel_vertical_with_I
          a hright_ne (a.im + S.r) R.top))
      (vEdge_add_three_adjacent_eq
        (intervalIntegrable_unitPrincipalKernel_vertical_with_I
          a hleft_ne R.top (a.im + S.r))
        (intervalIntegrable_unitPrincipalKernel_vertical_with_I
          a hleft_ne (a.im + S.r) (a.im - S.r))
        (intervalIntegrable_unitPrincipalKernel_vertical_with_I
          a hleft_ne (a.im - S.r) R.bottom))
      (hEdge_add_three_adjacent_eq
        (intervalIntegrable_unitPrincipalKernel_horizontal
          a hyb_ne R.left (a.re - S.r))
        (intervalIntegrable_unitPrincipalKernel_horizontal
          a hyb_ne (a.re - S.r) (a.re + S.r))
        (intervalIntegrable_unitPrincipalKernel_horizontal
          a hyb_ne (a.re + S.r) R.right))
      (hEdge_add_three_adjacent_eq
        (intervalIntegrable_unitPrincipalKernel_horizontal
          a hyt_ne R.right (a.re + S.r))
        (intervalIntegrable_unitPrincipalKernel_horizontal
          a hyt_ne (a.re + S.r) (a.re - S.r))
        (intervalIntegrable_unitPrincipalKernel_horizontal
          a hyt_ne (a.re - S.r) R.left))
      (hEdge_reverse_eq_neg (a.im - S.r) R.left R.right a)
      (hEdge_reverse_eq_neg (a.im + S.r) R.right R.left a)
      (vEdge_reverse_eq_neg (a.re - S.r) (a.im + S.r) (a.im - S.r) a)
      (vEdge_reverse_eq_neg (a.re + S.r) (a.im - S.r) (a.im + S.r) a)
  unfold coordinateBoundaryIntegral bottomHorizontalIntegral
    topHorizontalIntegral rightVerticalIntegral leftVerticalIntegral
    SmallSquareInsideRectangle.topStrip
    SmallSquareInsideRectangle.bottomStrip
    SmallSquareInsideRectangle.leftStrip
    SmallSquareInsideRectangle.rightStrip
    SmallSquareInsideRectangle.toRectangle
  unfold hEdge vEdge at h_sym
  linear_combination h_sym

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.square_subset_closedBall_of_radius_quarter
statement:
theorem square_subset_closedBall_of_radius_quarter
    (a z : ℂ) {r : ℝ}
    (hz : |z.re - a.re| ≤ r / 4 ∧ |z.im - a.im| ≤ r / 4) :
    z ∈ Metric.closedBall a r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := hz
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
  have h_bound : ‖z - a‖ ≤ |(z - a).re| + |(z - a).im| :=
    Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im (z - a)
  have h_re : (z - a).re = z.re - a.re := Complex.sub_re z a
  have h_im : (z - a).im = z.im - a.im := Complex.sub_im z a
  rw [h_re, h_im] at h_bound
  have h_re_nn : 0 ≤ |z.re - a.re| := abs_nonneg _
  have h_im_nn : 0 ≤ |z.im - a.im| := abs_nonneg _
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.canonicalSquare_bottom_eq_centered
statement:
theorem canonicalSquare_bottom_eq_centered
    (a : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    (∫ X in (a.re - ρ)..(a.re + ρ),
      unitPrincipalKernel a ⟨X, a.im - ρ⟩) =
      ∫ x in (-ρ)..ρ, (1 : ℂ) / ((x : ℂ) - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (a.re - ρ : ℝ) = a.re + (-ρ) from by ring,
      show (a.re + ρ : ℝ) = a.re + ρ from rfl,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_left]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro x _
  change unitPrincipalKernel a ⟨a.re + x, a.im - ρ⟩ =
       (1 : ℂ) / ((x : ℂ) - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  unfold unitPrincipalKernel
  have h_inner : (⟨a.re + x, a.im - ρ⟩ : ℂ) - a =
                 (x : ℂ) - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  rw [h_inner]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.canonicalSquare_top_eq_centered
statement:
theorem canonicalSquare_top_eq_centered
    (a : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    (∫ X in (a.re + ρ)..(a.re - ρ),
      unitPrincipalKernel a ⟨X, a.im + ρ⟩) =
      ∫ x in ρ..(-ρ), (1 : ℂ) / ((x : ℂ) + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (a.re - ρ : ℝ) = a.re + (-ρ) from by ring,
      show (a.re + ρ : ℝ) = a.re + ρ from rfl,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_left]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro x _
  change unitPrincipalKernel a ⟨a.re + x, a.im + ρ⟩ =
       (1 : ℂ) / ((x : ℂ) + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I)
  unfold unitPrincipalKernel
  have h_inner : (⟨a.re + x, a.im + ρ⟩ : ℂ) - a =
                 (x : ℂ) + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  rw [h_inner]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.canonicalSquare_right_eq_centered
statement:
theorem canonicalSquare_right_eq_centered
    (a : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ) :
    (∫ Y in (a.im - ρ)..(a.im + ρ),
      unitPrincipalKernel a ⟨a.re + ρ, Y⟩ * Complex.I) =
      (∫ y in (-ρ)..ρ, (1 : ℂ) / ((ρ : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
        Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (a.im - ρ : ℝ) = a.im + (-ρ) from by ring,
      show (a.im + ρ : ℝ) = a.im + ρ from rfl,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_left]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]

  intro y _
  change unitPrincipalKernel a ⟨a.re + ρ, a.im + y⟩ =

  unfold unitPrincipalKernel
  have h_inner : (⟨a.re + ρ, a.im + y⟩ : ℂ) - a =
                 (ρ : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp

statement:

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.integral_rho_div_sq_add_sq
statement:
theorem integral_rho_div_sq_add_sq
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    (∫ x in (-ρ)..ρ, ρ / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2)) = Real.pi / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hρ_ne : ρ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hρ
  
  have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ρ / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2)) := by
    refine Continuous.div continuous_const ?_ ?_
    · exact (continuous_pow 2).add continuous_const
    · intro x
      have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x ^ 2 := sq_nonneg x
      have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < ρ ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith
  have h_int : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : ℝ => ρ / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2)) MeasureTheory.volume (-ρ) ρ :=
    h_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _
  
  have h_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (-ρ) ρ,
      HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.arctan (y / ρ))
        (ρ / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2)) x := by
    intro x _
    have h_arctan : HasDerivAt Real.arctan (1 / (1 + (x / ρ) ^ 2)) (x / ρ) :=
      Real.hasDerivAt_arctan _
    have h_div : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y / ρ) (1 / ρ) x := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).div_const ρ
    have h_comp := h_arctan.comp x h_div
    convert h_comp using 1
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt h_deriv h_int
  rw [hFTC]
  have hρρ : ρ / ρ = 1 := div_self hρ_ne
  have hnρρ : (-ρ) / ρ = -1 := by rw [neg_div, hρρ]
  rw [hρρ, hnρρ, Real.arctan_one, Real.arctan_neg, Real.arctan_one]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.integral_x_div_sq_add_sq_symm
statement:
theorem integral_x_div_sq_add_sq_symm
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    (∫ x in (-ρ)..ρ, x / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, (0 : ℝ) < x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2 := fun x => by
    have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x ^ 2 := sq_nonneg x
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < ρ ^ 2 := by positivity
    linarith
  have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => x / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2)) := by
    refine Continuous.div continuous_id ?_ ?_
    · exact (continuous_pow 2).add continuous_const
    · intro x; exact ne_of_gt (h_pos x)
  have h_int : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun x : ℝ => x / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2)) MeasureTheory.volume (-ρ) ρ :=
    h_cont.intervalIntegrable _ _
  have h_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (-ρ) ρ,
      HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (1/2 : ℝ) * Real.log (y ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2))
        (x / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2)) x := by
    intro x _
    have hpx : (0 : ℝ) < x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2 := h_pos x
    have h_ne : (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpx
    have h_sq : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2) (2 * x) x := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).add_const (ρ ^ 2)
    have h_log : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.log (y ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2))
        ((2 * x) / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2)) x := h_sq.log h_ne
    have h_half := h_log.const_mul (1/2 : ℝ)
    convert h_half using 1
    field_simp
  have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt h_deriv h_int
  rw [hFTC]
  have h_eq : ((-ρ : ℝ)) ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [h_eq]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.centeredSquare_bottom_eq_pi_over_two_I
statement:
theorem centeredSquare_bottom_eq_pi_over_two_I
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    (∫ x in (-ρ)..ρ, (1 : ℂ) / ((x : ℂ) - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
      = (Real.pi / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  have h_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, (0 : ℝ) < x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2 := fun x => by
    have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x ^ 2 := sq_nonneg x
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < ρ ^ 2 := by positivity
    linarith
  have h_ptwise : ∀ x : ℝ,
      (1 : ℂ) / ((x : ℂ) - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        ((x / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
          + ((ρ / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    intro x
    have hpx_pos : (0 : ℝ) < x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2 := h_pos x
    have hpx_ne : (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpx_pos
    have h_denom : ((x : ℂ) - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have h_im_z : ((x : ℂ) - (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
      simp at h_im_z
      linarith
    have h_sum_C_ne : ((x : ℂ) ^ 2 + (ρ : ℂ) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
      have h : ((x : ℂ) ^ 2 + (ρ : ℂ) ^ 2) = ((x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h]
      exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hpx_ne
    have hI : (Complex.I : ℂ) ^ 2 = -1 := Complex.I_sq
    push_cast
    field_simp
    linear_combination ((ρ : ℂ) ^ 2) * hI
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => h_ptwise x)]
  have h_cont1 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ((x / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    refine Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ?_
    refine Continuous.div continuous_id ?_ ?_
    · exact (continuous_pow 2).add continuous_const
    · intro x; exact ne_of_gt (h_pos x)
  have h_cont2 : Continuous
      (fun x : ℝ => ((ρ / (x ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    refine Continuous.mul ?_ continuous_const
    refine Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ?_
    refine Continuous.div continuous_const ?_ ?_
    · exact (continuous_pow 2).add continuous_const
    · intro x; exact ne_of_gt (h_pos x)
  have h_int1 := h_cont1.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (-ρ) ρ
  have h_int2 := h_cont2.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (-ρ) ρ
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add h_int1 h_int2]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal, intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
  rw [integral_x_div_sq_add_sq_symm hρ, integral_rho_div_sq_add_sq hρ]
  push_cast
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.centeredSquare_right_eq_pi_over_two_I
statement:
theorem centeredSquare_right_eq_pi_over_two_I
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    (∫ y in (-ρ)..ρ, (1 : ℂ) / ((ρ : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) * Complex.I
      = (Real.pi / 2 : ℂ) * Complex.I
proof:
:= by
  have h_pos : ∀ y : ℝ, (0 : ℝ) < ρ ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := fun y => by
    have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ y ^ 2 := sq_nonneg y
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < ρ ^ 2 := by positivity
    linarith
  have h_ptwise : ∀ y : ℝ,
      (1 : ℂ) / ((ρ : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
        ((ρ / (ρ ^ 2 + y ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
          + ((-y / (ρ ^ 2 + y ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    intro y
    have hpy_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ρ ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := h_pos y
    have hpy_ne : (ρ ^ 2 + y ^ 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hpy_pos
    have h_denom : ((ρ : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have h_re_z : ((ρ : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).re = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
      simp at h_re_z
      linarith
    have h_sum_C_ne : ((ρ : ℂ) ^ 2 + (y : ℂ) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
      have h : ((ρ : ℂ) ^ 2 + (y : ℂ) ^ 2) = ((ρ ^ 2 + y ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h]
      exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hpy_ne
    have hI : (Complex.I : ℂ) ^ 2 = -1 := Complex.I_sq
    push_cast
    field_simp
    linear_combination ((y : ℂ) ^ 2) * hI
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun y _ => h_ptwise y)]
  have h_cont1 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => ((ρ / (ρ ^ 2 + y ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    refine Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ?_
    refine Continuous.div continuous_const ?_ ?_
    · exact continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)
    · intro y; exact ne_of_gt (h_pos y)
  have h_cont2 : Continuous
      (fun y : ℝ => ((-y / (ρ ^ 2 + y ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
    refine Continuous.mul ?_ continuous_const
    refine Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ?_
    refine Continuous.div continuous_id.neg ?_ ?_
    · exact continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)
    · intro y; exact ne_of_gt (h_pos y)
  have h_int1 := h_cont1.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (-ρ) ρ
  have h_int2 := h_cont2.intervalIntegrable (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (-ρ) ρ
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add h_int1 h_int2]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal, intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
  have h_re : (∫ y in (-ρ)..ρ, ρ / (ρ ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) = Real.pi / 2 := by
    have h_eq : (fun y : ℝ => ρ / (ρ ^ 2 + y ^ 2))
              = (fun y : ℝ => ρ / (y ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2)) := by
      funext y; ring
    rw [h_eq]
    exact integral_rho_div_sq_add_sq hρ
  have h_im : (∫ y in (-ρ)..ρ, -y / (ρ ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) = 0 := by
    have h_eq : (fun y : ℝ => -y / (ρ ^ 2 + y ^ 2))
              = (fun y : ℝ => -(y / (y ^ 2 + ρ ^ 2))) := by
      funext y; ring
    rw [h_eq]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
    rw [integral_x_div_sq_add_sq_symm hρ]
    ring
  rw [h_re, h_im]
  push_cast
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.rectangleIntegral_remainderExt_eq_raw
statement:
theorem rectangleIntegral_remainderExt_eq_raw
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {P : R.RectanglePrincipalPartData}
    (E : R.RectangleLogDerivRemainderExtensionData P) :
    R.rectangleIntegral E.remainderExt =
      R.rectangleIntegral (R.logDerivRemainder P)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rectangleIntegral
  have h_eq_bottom :
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        E.remainderExt (R.bottomEdge t) * deriv R.bottomEdge t) =
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        R.logDerivRemainder P (R.bottomEdge t) * deriv R.bottomEdge t) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro t ht
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at ht
    have hbd : R.ContainsBoundary (R.bottomEdge t) :=
      R.bottomEdge_mem_boundary ht.1 ht.2
    have hnot : R.bottomEdge t ∉ P.singularities := fun hs =>
      boundary_ne_of_mem_principalPart_singularities hs hbd rfl
    change E.remainderExt (R.bottomEdge t) * deriv R.bottomEdge t =
      R.logDerivRemainder P (R.bottomEdge t) * deriv R.bottomEdge t
    rw [E.agrees_off_singularities (R.bottomEdge t) hnot]
  have h_eq_right :
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        E.remainderExt (R.rightEdge t) * deriv R.rightEdge t) =
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        R.logDerivRemainder P (R.rightEdge t) * deriv R.rightEdge t) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro t ht
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at ht
    have hbd : R.ContainsBoundary (R.rightEdge t) :=
      R.rightEdge_mem_boundary ht.1 ht.2
    have hnot : R.rightEdge t ∉ P.singularities := fun hs =>
      boundary_ne_of_mem_principalPart_singularities hs hbd rfl
    change E.remainderExt (R.rightEdge t) * deriv R.rightEdge t =
      R.logDerivRemainder P (R.rightEdge t) * deriv R.rightEdge t
    rw [E.agrees_off_singularities (R.rightEdge t) hnot]
  have h_eq_top :
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        E.remainderExt (R.topEdge t) * deriv R.topEdge t) =
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        R.logDerivRemainder P (R.topEdge t) * deriv R.topEdge t) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro t ht
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at ht
    have hbd : R.ContainsBoundary (R.topEdge t) :=
      R.topEdge_mem_boundary ht.1 ht.2
    have hnot : R.topEdge t ∉ P.singularities := fun hs =>
      boundary_ne_of_mem_principalPart_singularities hs hbd rfl
    change E.remainderExt (R.topEdge t) * deriv R.topEdge t =
      R.logDerivRemainder P (R.topEdge t) * deriv R.topEdge t
    rw [E.agrees_off_singularities (R.topEdge t) hnot]
  have h_eq_left :
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        E.remainderExt (R.leftEdge t) * deriv R.leftEdge t) =
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        R.logDerivRemainder P (R.leftEdge t) * deriv R.leftEdge t) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro t ht
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at ht
    have hbd : R.ContainsBoundary (R.leftEdge t) :=
      R.leftEdge_mem_boundary ht.1 ht.2
    have hnot : R.leftEdge t ∉ P.singularities := fun hs =>
      boundary_ne_of_mem_principalPart_singularities hs hbd rfl
    change E.remainderExt (R.leftEdge t) * deriv R.leftEdge t =
      R.logDerivRemainder P (R.leftEdge t) * deriv R.leftEdge t
    rw [E.agrees_off_singularities (R.leftEdge t) hnot]
  rw [h_eq_bottom, h_eq_right, h_eq_top, h_eq_left]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.countedPrincipalPartData_analyticPrincipalPartData
statement:
theorem countedPrincipalPartData_analyticPrincipalPartData
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {hAdm : R.StronglyAdmissibleForZeta}
    {Z : R.ZeroSetInside} :
    R.RectangleAnalyticPrincipalPartData
      (R.countedPrincipalPartData hAdm Z) where
  localAnalyticPrincipalPart
proof:
:= by
    intro s hs
    have hsCounted : R.IsCountedZetaSingularityInside s :=
      ((R.countedPrincipalPartData hAdm Z).singularities_complete s).mp hs
    rcases hsCounted with hsZero | hsPole
    · have hsNT : IsNontrivialZetaZero s := hsZero.1
      change HasLogDerivIntegerPrincipalPart riemannZeta s
        (zetaLogDerivPrincipalCoeff s)
      rw [zetaLogDerivPrincipalCoeff_of_zero hsNT]
      exact zetaLogDeriv_principalPart_at_nontrivial_zero hsNT
    · obtain ⟨_, hs_eq⟩ := hsPole
      subst hs_eq
      change HasLogDerivIntegerPrincipalPart riemannZeta (1 : ℂ)
        (zetaLogDerivPrincipalCoeff 1)
      rw [zetaLogDerivPrincipalCoeff_one]
      exact zetaLogDeriv_principalPart_at_one_unconditional

statement:
theorem RectangleAnalyticPrincipalPartData.localAnalyticRemainder_analyticAt

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.RectangleAnalyticPrincipalPartData.localAnalyticRemainder_eventuallyEq
statement:
theorem RectangleAnalyticPrincipalPartData.localAnalyticRemainder_eventuallyEq
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {P : R.RectanglePrincipalPartData}
    (A : R.RectangleAnalyticPrincipalPartData P)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : s ∈ P.singularities) :
    logDeriv riemannZeta =ᶠ[𝓝[≠] s]
      (fun z : ℂ =>
        (P.principalCoeff s : ℂ) / (z - s)
          + A.localAnalyticRemainder s hs z)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (A.localAnalyticPrincipalPart s hs)).2

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.RectangleAnalyticPrincipalPartData.fullLocalAnalyticRemainderAt_analyticAt
statement:
theorem RectangleAnalyticPrincipalPartData.fullLocalAnalyticRemainderAt_analyticAt
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {P : R.RectanglePrincipalPartData}
    (A : R.RectangleAnalyticPrincipalPartData P)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : s ∈ P.singularities) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (A.fullLocalAnalyticRemainderAt s hs) s
proof:
:= by
  unfold RectangleAnalyticPrincipalPartData.fullLocalAnalyticRemainderAt
  have hlocal : AnalyticAt ℂ (A.localAnalyticRemainder s hs) s :=
    A.localAnalyticRemainder_analyticAt hs
  have hsum :
      AnalyticAt ℂ
        (fun z : ℂ =>
          (P.singularities.erase s).sum
            (fun t => principalKernel (P.principalCoeff t) t z)) s := by
    refine Finset.analyticAt_fun_sum (c := s) (P.singularities.erase s) ?_
    intro t ht
    have hts : t ≠ s := (Finset.mem_erase.mp ht).1
    exact analyticAt_principalKernel_of_ne (Ne.symm hts)
  exact hlocal.sub hsum

statement:
theorem patchedLogDerivRemainder_agrees_off_singularities
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {P : R.RectanglePrincipalPartData}
    (A : R.RectangleAnalyticPrincipalPartData P)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.patchedLogDerivRemainder_analyticAt_of_not_singular
statement:
theorem patchedLogDerivRemainder_analyticAt_of_not_singular
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {P : R.RectanglePrincipalPartData}
    (I : R.RectangleLogDerivRemainderExtensionInput P)
    {z : ℂ} (hzClosed : R.ContainsClosed z) (hz : z ∉ P.singularities) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (patchedLogDerivRemainder P I.analyticPP) z
proof:
:= by
  have hraw : AnalyticAt ℂ (R.logDerivRemainder P) z :=
    analyticAt_logDerivRemainder_of_not_singular hz
      (I.off_singularity_not_pole z hzClosed hz)
      (I.off_singularity_zeta_nonzero z hzClosed hz)
  have hClosed : IsClosed ((P.singularities : Set ℂ)) :=
    P.singularities.finite_toSet.isClosed
  have hOpen : IsOpen ((P.singularities : Set ℂ)ᶜ) := hClosed.isOpen_compl
  have hAvoid : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, w ∉ P.singularities := by
    have h_mem : z ∈ ((P.singularities : Set ℂ)ᶜ) := by simpa using hz
    exact hOpen.mem_nhds h_mem
  refine hraw.congr ?_
  filter_upwards [hAvoid] with w hw
  exact (patchedLogDerivRemainder_agrees_off_singularities I.analyticPP hw).symm

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.eventually_eq_or_not_mem_finset
statement:
theorem eventually_eq_or_not_mem_finset
    {S : Finset ℂ} {s : ℂ} :
    ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, z = s ∨ z ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs_not : s ∉ ((S.erase s : Set ℂ)) := by
    intro h
    exact (Finset.notMem_erase s S) (by exact_mod_cast h)
  have hclosed : IsClosed ((S.erase s : Set ℂ)) :=
    (S.erase s).finite_toSet.isClosed
  have hopen : IsOpen ((S.erase s : Set ℂ)ᶜ) := hclosed.isOpen_compl
  have hmem : ((S.erase s : Set ℂ)ᶜ) ∈ 𝓝 s := hopen.mem_nhds hs_not
  filter_upwards [hmem] with z hz
  by_cases hzs : z = s
  · exact Or.inl hzs
  · refine Or.inr ?_
    intro hzS
    apply hz
    change z ∈ (S.erase s : Set ℂ)
    exact_mod_cast Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hzs, hzS⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.patchedLogDerivRemainder_eventuallyEq_fullLocal
statement:
theorem patchedLogDerivRemainder_eventuallyEq_fullLocal
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {P : R.RectanglePrincipalPartData}
    (A : R.RectangleAnalyticPrincipalPartData P)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : s ∈ P.singularities) :
    patchedLogDerivRemainder P A =ᶠ[𝓝 s] A.fullLocalAnalyticRemainderAt s hs
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hIso : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, z = s ∨ z ∉ P.singularities :=
    eventually_eq_or_not_mem_finset
  have hPP_nhds : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 s, z ∈ ({s}ᶜ : Set ℂ) →
      logDeriv riemannZeta z =
        (P.principalCoeff s : ℂ) / (z - s) + A.localAnalyticRemainder s hs z :=
    eventually_nhdsWithin_iff.mp (A.localAnalyticRemainder_eventuallyEq hs)
  filter_upwards [hIso, hPP_nhds] with z hzIso hzPPimp
  obtain hzs | hzNot := hzIso
  · 
    rw [hzs]
    unfold patchedLogDerivRemainder
    simp [hs]
  · 
    have hz_ne : z ≠ s := fun h => hzNot (h ▸ hs)
    have hz_compl : z ∈ ({s}ᶜ : Set ℂ) := hz_ne
    have hPP := hzPPimp hz_compl
    have h_patched_eq : patchedLogDerivRemainder P A z = R.logDerivRemainder P z :=
      patchedLogDerivRemainder_agrees_off_singularities A hzNot
    rw [h_patched_eq]
    
    unfold ZetaRectangle.logDerivRemainder ZetaRectangle.principalPartSum
      RectangleAnalyticPrincipalPartData.fullLocalAnalyticRemainderAt
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hs]
    have hzeta : zetaLogDeriv z = logDeriv riemannZeta z := rfl
    rw [hzeta, hPP]
    unfold principalKernel
    ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.patchedLogDerivRemainder_analyticAt_singularity
statement:
theorem patchedLogDerivRemainder_analyticAt_singularity
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {P : R.RectanglePrincipalPartData}

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.not_pole_of_closed_not_mem_countedPrincipalPart_singularities
proof:
:= by
  intro hz1
  subst hz1
  have hnb : ¬ R.ContainsBoundary (1 : ℂ) := hAdm.poleNotOnBoundary
  have hOpen : R.ContainsOpen (1 : ℂ) :=
    R.containsOpen_of_containsClosed_not_boundary hzClosed hnb

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.zeta_nonzero_of_closed_not_mem_countedPrincipalPart_singularities
statement:
theorem zeta_nonzero_of_closed_not_mem_countedPrincipalPart_singularities
    {R : ZetaRectangle} {hAdm : R.StronglyAdmissibleForZeta}
    {Z : R.ZeroSetInside} {z : ℂ}
    (_hzClosed : R.ContainsClosed z)
    (hz : z ∉ (R.countedPrincipalPartData hAdm Z).singularities)
    (hZeroInside : riemannZeta z = 0 → R.IsNontrivialZeroInside z) :
    riemannZeta z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzeta
  have hInside : R.IsNontrivialZeroInside z := hZeroInside hzeta
  have hcounted : R.IsCountedZetaSingularityInside z := Or.inl hInside
  exact hz ((R.countedPrincipalPartData hAdm Z).singularities_complete z |>.mpr hcounted)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.countedPrincipalCoeff_sum_eq_zeroCount_sub_poleCount
statement:
theorem countedPrincipalCoeff_sum_eq_zeroCount_sub_poleCount
    {R : ZetaRectangle}
    (hAdm : R.StronglyAdmissibleForZeta)
    (Z : R.ZeroSetInside) :
    (R.countedPrincipalPartData hAdm Z).singularities.sum
        (R.countedPrincipalPartData hAdm Z).principalCoeff =
      (R.weightedZeroCountInside Z zetaGlobalZeroMultiplicity : ℤ)
        - (R.poleCountInside : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (R.canonicalSingularities Z).sum zetaLogDerivPrincipalCoeff =
       (R.weightedZeroCountInside Z zetaGlobalZeroMultiplicity : ℤ)
         - (R.poleCountInside : ℤ)
  have h_zero_sum :
      Z.zeros.sum zetaLogDerivPrincipalCoeff =
        (R.weightedZeroCountInside Z zetaGlobalZeroMultiplicity : ℤ) := by
    unfold weightedZeroCountInside
    push_cast
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun s hs => ?_)
    have hsNT : IsNontrivialZetaZero s := ((Z.complete s).mp hs).1
    exact zetaLogDerivPrincipalCoeff_of_zero hsNT
  have h1_not_mem : (1 : ℂ) ∉ Z.zeros := by
    intro h1
    have hNT : IsNontrivialZetaZero (1 : ℂ) := ((Z.complete 1).mp h1).1
    have hlt : (1 : ℂ).re < 1 := hNT.2.2
    norm_num at hlt
  unfold canonicalSingularities
  by_cases hpole : R.PoleInside
  · rw [if_pos hpole, Finset.sum_insert h1_not_mem,
        zetaLogDerivPrincipalCoeff_one, h_zero_sum]
    have h_pole_one : R.poleCountInside = 1 := by
      simp [poleCountInside, hpole]
    rw [h_pole_one]
    push_cast
    ring
  · rw [if_neg hpole, h_zero_sum]
    have h_pole_zero : R.poleCountInside = 0 := by
      simp [poleCountInside, hpole]
    rw [h_pole_zero]
    push_cast
    ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.pole_not_on_boundary_safeRectangle
statement:
theorem pole_not_on_boundary_safeRectangle
    {B T : ℝ} (hBpos : 0 < B) (hBT : B < T) :
    ¬ (rectangleOfSafeHeights hBpos hBT).ContainsBoundary (1 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := h.1
  have h_im : B ≤ (1 : ℂ).im := hc.2.2.1
  simp at h_im
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.boundary_cases_safeRectangle
statement:
theorem boundary_cases_safeRectangle
    {B T : ℝ} (hBpos : 0 < B) (hBT : B < T) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : (rectangleOfSafeHeights hBpos hBT).ContainsBoundary z) :
    z.re = -1 ∨ z.re = 2 ∨ z.im = B ∨ z.im = T
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hC, hO⟩ := hz
  have h1 : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ z.re := hC.1
  have h2 : z.re ≤ (2 : ℝ) := hC.2.1
  have h3 : B ≤ z.im := hC.2.2.1
  have h4 : z.im ≤ T := hC.2.2.2
  by_contra hcontra
  push Not at hcontra
  obtain ⟨hL, hR, hBe, hTe⟩ := hcontra
  apply hO
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact lt_of_le_of_ne h1 (Ne.symm hL)
  · exact lt_of_le_of_ne h2 hR
  · exact lt_of_le_of_ne h3 (Ne.symm hBe)
  · exact lt_of_le_of_ne h4 hTe

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.stronglyAdmissible_rectangleOfSafeHeights
statement:
theorem stronglyAdmissible_rectangleOfSafeHeights
    {B T : ℝ} (hBpos : 0 < B) (hBT : B < T)
    (hBgood : GoodHeight B) (hTgood : GoodHeight T)
    (H : SafeHeightRectangleBoundaryZeroFree B T) :
    (rectangleOfSafeHeights hBpos hBT).StronglyAdmissibleForZeta where
  noZetaZerosOnBoundary
proof:
:= by
    intro s hsZero hsBoundary
    rcases boundary_cases_safeRectangle hBpos hBT hsBoundary with hL | hR | hB | hT'
    · exact H.left_edge s.im (by
        have h_eq : (⟨-1, s.im⟩ : ℂ) = s := by
          apply Complex.ext
          · simp [hL]
          · simp
        rw [h_eq]; exact hsZero)
    · exact zeta_ne_zero_of_re_eq_two hR hsZero
    · have hNT : IsNontrivialZetaZero s := H.bottom_zeros_nontrivial s hB hsZero
      exact hBgood s hNT hB
    · have hNT : IsNontrivialZetaZero s := H.top_zeros_nontrivial s hT' hsZero
      exact hTgood s hNT hT'
  poleNotOnBoundary := pole_not_on_boundary_safeRectangle hBpos hBT

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ZetaRectangle.isNontrivialZeroInside_of_closed_safeRectangle_zero
statement:
theorem isNontrivialZeroInside_of_closed_safeRectangle_zero
    {B T : ℝ} (hBpos : 0 < B) (hBT : B < T)
    (hBgood : GoodHeight B) (hTgood : GoodHeight T)
    (H : SafeHeightRectangleZeroClassification hBpos hBT)
    {z : ℂ}
    (hzClosed : (rectangleOfSafeHeights hBpos hBT).ContainsClosed z)
    (hzeta : riemannZeta z = 0) :
    (rectangleOfSafeHeights hBpos hBT).IsNontrivialZeroInside z
proof:
:= by
  have hCases :
      (rectangleOfSafeHeights hBpos hBT).ContainsOpen z ∨
        (rectangleOfSafeHeights hBpos hBT).ContainsBoundary z :=
    (rectangleOfSafeHeights hBpos hBT).containsOpen_or_boundary_of_containsClosed hzClosed
  rcases hCases with hOpen | hBoundary
  · 
    exact ⟨H.interior_zeros_nontrivial z hOpen hzeta, hOpen⟩
  · 
    exfalso
    rcases boundary_cases_safeRectangle hBpos hBT hBoundary with hL | hR | hBdry | hTop
    · apply H.left_edge z.im
      have h_eq : (⟨-1, z.im⟩ : ℂ) = z := by
        apply Complex.ext
        · simpa using hL.symm
        · simp
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hzeta
    · exact zeta_ne_zero_of_re_eq_two hR hzeta
    · have hNT : IsNontrivialZetaZero z := H.bottom_zeros_nontrivial z hBdry hzeta
      exact hBgood z hNT hBdry
    · have hNT : IsNontrivialZetaZero z := H.top_zeros_nontrivial z hTop hzeta
      exact hTgood z hNT hTop

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.cos_pi_mul_twoMinusYI_div_two_eq_neg_cosh
statement:
theorem cos_pi_mul_twoMinusYI_div_two_eq_neg_cosh (y : ℝ) :
    Complex.cos ((Real.pi : ℂ) * (⟨2, -y⟩ : ℂ) / 2) =
      -((Real.cosh (Real.pi * y / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have h_decomp :
      ((Real.pi : ℂ) * (⟨2, -y⟩ : ℂ) / 2) =
        (Real.pi : ℂ) + (-((Real.pi * y / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
            Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.add_re,
            Complex.neg_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    · simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
            Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.add_im,
            Complex.neg_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
      ring
  rw [h_decomp, Complex.cos_add]
  have h_cos_pi : Complex.cos (Real.pi : ℂ) = -1 := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_cos, Real.cos_pi]; push_cast; rfl
  have h_sin_pi : Complex.sin (Real.pi : ℂ) = 0 := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_sin, Real.sin_pi]; push_cast; rfl
  rw [h_cos_pi, h_sin_pi]
  rw [Complex.cos_mul_I]
  rw [show -((Real.pi * y / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = -(((Real.pi * y / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) from rfl,
      Complex.cosh_neg]
  rw [Complex.ofReal_cosh]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.cos_pi_mul_twoMinusYI_div_two_ne_zero
statement:
theorem cos_pi_mul_twoMinusYI_div_two_ne_zero (y : ℝ) :
    Complex.cos ((Real.pi : ℂ) * (⟨2, -y⟩ : ℂ) / 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [cos_pi_mul_twoMinusYI_div_two_eq_neg_cosh]
  rw [neg_ne_zero, Complex.ofReal_ne_zero]
  exact (Real.cosh_pos _).ne'

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaFunctionalEquationLeftEdgeTransfer
statement:
theorem zetaFunctionalEquationLeftEdgeTransfer :
    ZetaFunctionalEquationLeftEdgeTransfer
proof:
:= by
  intro y _hright
  set s : ℂ := ⟨2, -y⟩ with hs_def
  have h_s_re : s.re = 2 := by simp [hs_def]
  have h_one_sub_s : (1 : ℂ) - s = ⟨(-1 : ℝ), y⟩ := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · show (1 - s).re = -1
      simp [hs_def, Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re]
      norm_num
    · show (1 - s).im = y
      simp [hs_def, Complex.sub_im, Complex.one_im]
  have h_s_ne_neg_n : ∀ n : ℕ, s ≠ -↑n := by
    intro n h
    have h_re : s.re = (-(n : ℂ)).re := congrArg Complex.re h
    rw [h_s_re] at h_re
    simp at h_re
    linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
  have h_s_ne_one : s ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have h_re : s.re = (1 : ℂ).re := congrArg Complex.re h
    rw [h_s_re] at h_re
    simp at h_re
  rw [← h_one_sub_s, riemannZeta_one_sub h_s_ne_neg_n h_s_ne_one]
  have h_2pi_ne_C : ((2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
    have hπ : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero
    exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hπ
  have h_2pi_pow : ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ^ (-s)) ≠ 0 :=
    Complex.cpow_ne_zero_iff.mpr (Or.inl h_2pi_ne_C)
  have h_gamma_ne : Complex.Gamma s ≠ 0 := by
    apply Complex.Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos
    rw [h_s_re]; norm_num
  have h_zeta_ne : riemannZeta s ≠ 0 := by
    apply riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re
    rw [h_s_re]; norm_num
  have h_cos_ne : Complex.cos ((Real.pi : ℂ) * s / 2) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hs_def]
    exact cos_pi_mul_twoMinusYI_div_two_ne_zero y
  refine mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ?_ ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_
  · norm_num
  · exact h_2pi_pow
  · exact h_gamma_ne
  · exact h_cos_ne
  · exact h_zeta_ne

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.Complex.cos_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Complex.cos_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero
    {w : ℂ} (hw : w.im ≠ 0) :
    Complex.cos w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.cos_ne_zero_iff]
  intro k heq
  have h_im_eq :
      w.im = ((2 * (k : ℂ) + 1) * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 2).im :=
    congrArg Complex.im heq
  have h_rhs_im : ((2 * (k : ℂ) + 1) * (Real.pi : ℂ) / 2).im = 0 := by
    simp [Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.intCast_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.one_im]
  rw [h_rhs_im] at h_im_eq
  exact hw h_im_eq

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaNoZerosLeftHalfPlaneUpper
statement: theorem zetaNoZerosLeftHalfPlaneUpper : ZetaNoZerosLeftHalfPlaneUpper
proof:
:= by
  intro z hzRe hzIm hzeta
  set s : ℂ := 1 - z with hs_def
  have hs_re : s.re = 1 - z.re := by simp [hs_def]
  have hs_im : s.im = -z.im := by simp [hs_def]
  have hs_re_ge_one : 1 ≤ s.re := by rw [hs_re]; linarith
  have hs_re_pos : 0 < s.re := by linarith
  have hs_im_neg : s.im < 0 := by rw [hs_im]; linarith
  have hs_im_ne : s.im ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hs_im_neg
  have h_zeta_s_ne : riemannZeta s ≠ 0 :=
    riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re hs_re_ge_one
  have hs_ne_neg_n : ∀ n : ℕ, s ≠ -↑n := by
    intro n h
    have h_re : s.re = (-(n : ℂ)).re := congrArg Complex.re h
    rw [hs_re] at h_re
    simp at h_re
    linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
  have hs_ne_one : s ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have h_im : s.im = (1 : ℂ).im := congrArg Complex.im h
    simp at h_im
    linarith
  have h_1s_z : (1 : ℂ) - s = z := by simp [hs_def]
  have hFE := riemannZeta_one_sub hs_ne_neg_n hs_ne_one
  rw [h_1s_z, hzeta] at hFE
  apply absurd hFE.symm
  have h_2pi_ne_C : ((2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ≠ 0 := by
    have hπ : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero
    exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hπ
  have h_2pi_pow : ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ)) ^ (-s)) ≠ 0 :=
    Complex.cpow_ne_zero_iff.mpr (Or.inl h_2pi_ne_C)
  have h_gamma_ne : Complex.Gamma s ≠ 0 :=
    Complex.Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos hs_re_pos
  have h_cos_ne : Complex.cos ((Real.pi : ℂ) * s / 2) ≠ 0 := by
    apply Complex.cos_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero
    have h_arg_im : ((Real.pi : ℂ) * s / 2).im = Real.pi * s.im / 2 := by
      simp [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
            Complex.ofReal_im]
    rw [h_arg_im]
    have hpi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
    intro h
    have : Real.pi * s.im = 0 := by linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h1 | h2
    · exact absurd h1 hpi_pos.ne'
    · exact hs_im_ne h2
  refine mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ?_ ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_
  · norm_num
  · exact h_2pi_pow
  · exact h_gamma_ne
  · exact h_cos_ne
  · exact h_zeta_s_ne

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.ConcreteSBacklundEstimateFrom140OnGoodHeights.to_concreteS_halfLogPlusHalf_unconditionalZetaClass
statement:
theorem
    ConcreteSBacklundEstimateFrom140OnGoodHeights.to_concreteS_halfLogPlusHalf_unconditionalZetaClass
    (H140 : ConcreteSBacklundEstimateFrom140OnGoodHeights)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.continuousAt_smoothZeroCountingN0
statement:
theorem continuousAt_smoothZeroCountingN0 {T : ℝ} (hT_pos : 0 < T) :
    ContinuousAt smoothZeroCountingN0 T
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothZeroCountingN0
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have h_arg_pos : (0 : ℝ) < T / (2 * Real.pi) :=
    div_pos hT_pos h2pi_pos
  have h_arg_ne : T / (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := h_arg_pos.ne'
  have h_div_id : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ => u / (2 * Real.pi)) T :=
    continuousAt_id.div_const (2 * Real.pi)
  have h_log_inner :
      ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))) T :=
    h_div_id.log h_arg_ne
  have h_mul :
      ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ =>
          (u / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))) T :=
    h_div_id.mul h_log_inner
  exact (h_mul.sub h_div_id).add continuousAt_const
