name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.BacklundJensenRectangleEstimate.of_height_ge_140
statement:
theorem BacklundJensenRectangleEstimate.of_height_ge_140
    {T : ℝ} (hT : (140 : ℝ) ≤ T) :
    BacklundJensenRectangleEstimate T
proof:
:= by
  let D : ℝ :=
    zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeightReal (T + 1)
      - zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeightReal T
  let C : ℝ := max 0 D / Real.log (T + 2)
  have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log (T + 2) :=
    Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlogne : Real.log (T + 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlogpos
  refine BacklundJensenRectangleEstimate.of_window_bound (C := C) ?_ ?_
  · exact div_nonneg (le_max_left _ _) hlogpos.le
  · have hD_le : D ≤ max 0 D := le_max_right _ _
    have hmul : C * Real.log (T + 2) = max 0 D :=
      div_mul_cancel₀ (max 0 D) hlogne
    simp [D, C, hmul, hD_le]

statement:
theorem backlund_right_side_vonMangoldt_eq_neg_logDeriv (y : ℝ) :
    L ↗Λ ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      = - deriv riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) /
          riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)
proof:

  norm_num [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.BacklundRightSideArgumentVariationEstimate.of_vonMangoldt_bound_on_re_two
statement:
theorem BacklundRightSideArgumentVariationEstimate.of_vonMangoldt_bound_on_re_two
    {T C : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound :
      ∀ y : ℝ, T ≤ y → y ≤ T + 1 →
        ‖L ↗Λ ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
          C * Real.log (T + 2)) :
    BacklundRightSideArgumentVariationEstimate T
proof:
:= by
  apply BacklundRightSideArgumentVariationEstimate.of_logDeriv_bound_on_re_two hC
  intro y hyT hyTop
  let s : ℂ := (2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I
  have hident :
      L ↗Λ s = - deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s := by
    simpa [s] using backlund_right_side_vonMangoldt_eq_neg_logDeriv y
  have hident' :
      L ↗Λ s = -(deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s) := by
    simpa [neg_div] using hident
  have hquot :
      deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s = - L ↗Λ s := by
    rw [hident']
    simp
  simpa [s, hquot] using hbound y hyT hyTop

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.backlund_right_side_vonMangoldtLSeries_continuous
statement:
theorem backlund_right_side_vonMangoldtLSeries_continuous :
    Continuous (fun y : ℝ => L ↗Λ ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I))
proof:
:= by
  refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun y => ?_)
  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n : ℕ => (Λ n : ℂ)
  let line : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => (2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I
  let s : ℂ := line y
  have hsum : LSeriesSummable f (((3 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
    dsimp [f]
    simpa only using
      ArithmeticFunction.LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt
        (s := (((3 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))) (by norm_num)
  have habs_le : LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv f ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    simpa using hsum.abscissaOfAbsConv_le
  have hsre : LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv f < s.re := by
    have hsre_eq : s.re = (2 : ℝ) := by
      simp [s, line, Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re]
    rw [hsre_eq]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt habs_le (by norm_num)
  have hline : ContinuousAt line y := by
    dsimp [line]
    fun_prop
  have hL : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℂ => LSeries f z) (line y) := by
    simpa [s] using (LSeries_hasDerivAt hsre).continuousAt
  change ContinuousAt
    (fun y : ℝ => (fun z : ℂ => LSeries f z) (line y)) y
  exact ContinuousAt.comp' (g := fun z : ℂ => LSeries f z) (f := line)
    hL hline

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.backlund_right_side_vonMangoldt_plain_bound
statement:
theorem backlund_right_side_vonMangoldt_plain_bound (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ y : ℝ, T ≤ y → y ≤ T + 1 →
        ‖L ↗Λ ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm_cont :
      Continuous (fun y : ℝ =>
        ‖L ↗Λ ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) :=
    continuous_norm.comp backlund_right_side_vonMangoldtLSeries_continuous
  have hnonempty : (Set.Icc T (T + 1)).Nonempty :=
    ⟨T, by constructor <;> linarith⟩
  obtain ⟨y₀, _hy₀mem, hy₀max⟩ :=
    (isCompact_Icc (a := T) (b := T + 1)).exists_isMaxOn
      hnonempty hnorm_cont.continuousOn
  refine ⟨‖L ↗Λ ((2 : ℂ) + (y₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖, norm_nonneg _, ?_⟩
  intro y hyT hyTop
  exact hy₀max ⟨hyT, hyTop⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.BacklundRightSideArgumentVariationEstimate.of_abs_vonMangoldt_bound_on_re_two
statement:
theorem BacklundRightSideArgumentVariationEstimate.of_abs_vonMangoldt_bound_on_re_two
    {T C : ℝ}
    (hT : (140 : ℝ) ≤ T)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hbound :
      ∀ y : ℝ, T ≤ y → y ≤ T + 1 →
        ‖L ↗Λ ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C) :
    BacklundRightSideArgumentVariationEstimate T
proof:
:= by
  have hlogpos : 0 < Real.log (T + 2) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hlogne : Real.log (T + 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlogpos
  refine
    BacklundRightSideArgumentVariationEstimate.of_vonMangoldt_bound_on_re_two
      (C := C / Real.log (T + 2))
      (div_nonneg hC hlogpos.le) ?_
  intro y hyT hyTop
  have hb := hbound y hyT hyTop
  have hmul :
      C / Real.log (T + 2) * Real.log (T + 2) = C :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ C hlogne
  rw [hmul]
  exact hb

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.backlundHorizontalZetaBoundInput
statement:
theorem backlundHorizontalZetaBoundInput :
    BacklundHorizontalZetaBoundInput where
  bound
proof:
:= by
    intro T _hgood hT
    have hT_pos : (0 : ℝ) < T :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 140) hT
    have hne : ∀ σ : ℝ,
        ((σ : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 1 := by
      intro σ heq
      have h_im :
          ((σ : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I).im = T := by simp
      rw [heq, Complex.one_im] at h_im
      linarith
    have hline_cont :
        Continuous (fun σ : ℝ => (σ : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.add continuous_const
    have hzeta_cont :
        Continuous (fun σ : ℝ =>
            riemannZeta ((σ : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by
      refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun σ => ?_)
      change ContinuousAt
        (riemannZeta ∘ (fun σ' : ℝ => (σ' : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I)) σ
      refine ContinuousAt.comp ?_ hline_cont.continuousAt
      exact (differentiableAt_riemannZeta (hne σ)).continuousAt
    have hnorm_cont :
        Continuous (fun σ : ℝ =>
            ‖riemannZeta ((σ : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) :=
      continuous_norm.comp hzeta_cont
    have hnonempty : (Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 2).Nonempty :=
      ⟨0, by norm_num⟩
    obtain ⟨σ₀, _hσ₀mem, hσ₀max⟩ :=
      (isCompact_Icc (a := (-1 : ℝ)) (b := 2)).exists_isMaxOn hnonempty
        hnorm_cont.continuousOn
    set C : ℝ :=
      ‖riemannZeta ((σ₀ : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ with hC_def
    have hC_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C := norm_nonneg _
    refine BacklundHorizontalBoundaryEstimate.of_abs_bound hT hC_nonneg ?_
    intro σ hσ₁ hσ₂
    exact hσ₀max ⟨hσ₁, hσ₂⟩

  refine BacklundRightSideArgumentVariationEstimate.of_logDeriv_bound
    hnonzero (div_nonneg hC hlogpos.le) ?_
  intro y hyT hyT1
  have hb := hbound y hyT hyT1
  have hmul :
      C / Real.log (T + 2) * Real.log (T + 2) = C :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ C hlogne
  rw [hmul]; exact hb

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.exists_bound_zeta_logDeriv_rightSide_of_continuousOn
statement:
theorem exists_bound_zeta_logDeriv_rightSide_of_continuousOn
    (T : ℝ)
    (hcont :
      ContinuousOn
        (fun y : ℝ =>
          ‖deriv riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) /
              riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖)
        (Set.Icc T (T + 1))) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ y : ℝ, T ≤ y → y ≤ T + 1 →
        ‖deriv riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) /
            riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : IsCompact (Set.Icc T (T + 1)) := isCompact_Icc
  have hne : (Set.Icc T (T + 1)).Nonempty :=
    Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨y₀, _hy₀mem, hy₀max⟩ :=
    hcomp.exists_isMaxOn hne hcont
  set M : ℝ :=
    ‖deriv riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I) /
        riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ with hM_def
  refine ⟨max M 0, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro y hyT hyT1
  have hmem : y ∈ Set.Icc T (T + 1) := ⟨hyT, hyT1⟩
  have hle :
      ‖deriv riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) /
          riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ M :=
    hy₀max hmem
  exact le_trans hle (le_max_left _ _)

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.continuousOn_zeta_logDeriv_rightSide
statement:
theorem continuousOn_zeta_logDeriv_rightSide
    (T : ℝ) (_hT : (140 : ℝ) ≤ T) :
    ContinuousOn
      (fun y : ℝ =>
        ‖deriv riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) /
            riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖)
      (Set.Icc T (T + 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro y _hy
  refine ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt ?_
  
  have hre :
      ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I).re = 2 := by
    simp [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
          Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  have hne : ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 1 := by
    intro heq
    have h1re : ((1 : ℂ).re) = 2 := by rw [← hre, heq]
    norm_num at h1re
  have hzeta_ne :
      riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 :=
    riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re (by rw [hre]; norm_num)
  have hAn :
      AnalyticAt ℂ riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
    riemannZeta_analyticAt_of_ne_one hne
  
  have hquot_at :
      ContinuousAt
        (fun z : ℂ => deriv riemannZeta z / riemannZeta z)
        ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
    (hAn.deriv.continuousAt).div hAn.continuousAt hzeta_ne
  
  have hline_cont :
      Continuous (fun y : ℝ => (2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) :=
    continuous_const.add
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const)
  
  have hcompose_at :
      ContinuousAt
        (fun y : ℝ =>
          deriv riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I) /
            riemannZeta ((2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) y := by
    change ContinuousAt
      ((fun z : ℂ => deriv riemannZeta z / riemannZeta z) ∘
        (fun y : ℝ => (2 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)) y
    refine ContinuousAt.comp ?_ hline_cont.continuousAt
    exact hquot_at
  exact hcompose_at.norm

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_eq_of_strip_gap
statement:
theorem zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_eq_of_strip_gap
    {T u ε : ℝ}
    (_hT : (140 : ℝ) ≤ T)
    (huT : T < u)
    (huε : u ≤ T + ε)
    (_hε : 0 < ε)
    (hgap :
      ∀ ρ : ℂ,
        riemannZeta ρ = 0 →
        (-1 : ℝ) ≤ ρ.re →
        ρ.re ≤ 2 →
        T < ρ.im →
        ρ.im ≤ T + ε →
        False) :
    zetaZerosUpToHeightSet u = zetaZerosUpToHeightSet T
proof:
:= by
  ext ρ
  constructor
  · intro hρu
    obtain ⟨⟨hzero, hre_pos, hre_lt_one⟩, him_pos, him_le_u⟩ := hρu
    by_cases hle : ρ.im ≤ T
    · exact ⟨⟨hzero, hre_pos, hre_lt_one⟩, him_pos, hle⟩
    · push Not at hle
      have him_le_eps : ρ.im ≤ T + ε := le_trans him_le_u huε
      have hre_low : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ ρ.re := by linarith
      have hre_high : ρ.re ≤ 2 := by linarith
      exact (hgap ρ hzero hre_low hre_high hle him_le_eps).elim
  · intro hρT
    obtain ⟨nontriv, him_pos, him_le_T⟩ := hρT
    exact ⟨nontriv, him_pos, le_trans him_le_T (le_of_lt huT)⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.zetaWeightedCountExtensionalityInput
statement:
theorem zetaWeightedCountExtensionalityInput :
    ZetaWeightedCountExtensionalityInput where
  count_eq_of_set_eq
proof:
:= by
    intro T U hset
    classical
    have hempty_neg : ∀ V : ℝ, V < 0 → zetaZerosUpToHeightSet V = ∅ := by
      intro V hV
      ext s
      refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h.elim⟩
      obtain ⟨_, him_pos, him_le⟩ := h
      linarith
    have hcount_zero_of_empty :
        ∀ {V : ℝ} (hV : 0 ≤ V),
          zetaZerosUpToHeightSet V = ∅ →
          zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight V hV = 0 := by
      intro V hV hVempty
      change (zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_finite V hV).toFinset.sum
          (truncatedMultiplicity zetaGlobalZeroMultiplicity V) = 0
      have htofin_eq :
          (zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_finite V hV).toFinset = ∅ :=
        Set.Finite.toFinset_eq_empty.mpr hVempty
      rw [htofin_eq, Finset.sum_empty]
    unfold zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeightReal
    by_cases hT_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ T
    · by_cases hU_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ U
      · rw [dif_pos hT_nn, dif_pos hU_nn]
        simp only [Nat.cast_inj]
        change (zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_finite T hT_nn).toFinset.sum
            (truncatedMultiplicity zetaGlobalZeroMultiplicity T) =
          (zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_finite U hU_nn).toFinset.sum
            (truncatedMultiplicity zetaGlobalZeroMultiplicity U)
        have hfin_eq :
            (zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_finite T hT_nn).toFinset =
              (zetaZerosUpToHeightSet_finite U hU_nn).toFinset := by
          ext ρ
          rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, hset]
        refine Finset.sum_congr hfin_eq ?_
        intro ρ hρmem
        have hρU : ρ ∈ zetaZerosUpToHeightSet U :=
          (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hρmem
        have hρT : ρ ∈ zetaZerosUpToHeightSet T := hset ▸ hρU
        rw [truncatedMultiplicity_eq_global zetaGlobalZeroMultiplicity hρT,
            truncatedMultiplicity_eq_global zetaGlobalZeroMultiplicity hρU]
      · push Not at hU_nn
        rw [dif_pos hT_nn, dif_neg hU_nn.not_ge]
        have hU_empty : zetaZerosUpToHeightSet U = ∅ := hempty_neg U hU_nn
        have hT_empty : zetaZerosUpToHeightSet T = ∅ := hset.trans hU_empty
        have h0 : zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight T hT_nn = 0 :=
          hcount_zero_of_empty hT_nn hT_empty
        rw [h0]
        norm_num
    · push Not at hT_nn
      rw [dif_neg hT_nn.not_ge]
      by_cases hU_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ U
      · rw [dif_pos hU_nn]
        have hT_empty : zetaZerosUpToHeightSet T = ∅ := hempty_neg T hT_nn
        have hU_empty : zetaZerosUpToHeightSet U = ∅ := by
          rw [← hset]; exact hT_empty
        have h0 : zetaWeightedZeroCountUpToHeight U hU_nn = 0 :=
          hcount_zero_of_empty hU_nn hU_empty
        rw [h0]
        symm; norm_num
      · push Not at hU_nn
        rw [dif_neg hU_nn.not_ge]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.BacklundNumericalConstantsAdmissible.of_nonneg_coeffs_and_budget
statement:
theorem BacklundNumericalConstantsAdmissible.of_nonneg_coeffs_and_budget
    {K : BacklundNumericalConstants}
    (hJlog : 0 ≤ K.jensenLogCoeff)
    (hRlog : 0 ≤ K.rightLogCoeff)
    (hHlog : 0 ≤ K.horizontalLogCoeff)
    (hJconst : 0 ≤ K.jensenConst)
    (hRconst : 0 ≤ K.rightConst)
    (hHconst : 0 ≤ K.horizontalConst)
    (hLogBudget :
      K.jensenLogCoeff + K.rightLogCoeff + K.horizontalLogCoeff
        ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (hConstBudget :
      K.jensenConst + K.rightConst + K.horizontalConst
        ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    BacklundNumericalConstantsAdmissible K where
  jensen_nonneg
proof:
:= by
    intro T hT
    have hT_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ T := by linarith
    have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log T := Real.log_nonneg hT_one
    have hmul : 0 ≤ K.jensenLogCoeff * Real.log T :=
      mul_nonneg hJlog hlog
    dsimp [BacklundNumerics.jensenAllowanceOf]
    nlinarith
  right_nonneg := by
    intro T hT
    have hT_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ T := by linarith
    have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log T := Real.log_nonneg hT_one
    have hmul : 0 ≤ K.rightLogCoeff * Real.log T :=
      mul_nonneg hRlog hlog
    dsimp [BacklundNumerics.rightSideAllowanceOf]
    nlinarith
  horizontal_nonneg := by
    intro T hT
    have hT_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ T := by linarith
    have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log T := Real.log_nonneg hT_one
    have hmul : 0 ≤ K.horizontalLogCoeff * Real.log T :=
      mul_nonneg hHlog hlog
    dsimp [BacklundNumerics.horizontalAllowanceOf]
    nlinarith
  total_le := by
    intro T hT
    have hT_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ T := by linarith
    have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log T := Real.log_nonneg hT_one

              * Real.log T

              simp [BacklundNumerics.totalAllowanceOf,

                BacklundNumerics.horizontalAllowanceOf]

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.backlund_exp_24_5_lt_140
statement: theorem backlund_exp_24_5_lt_140 : Real.exp (24 / 5 : ℝ) < 140
proof:
:= by
  have h_e_lt : Real.exp 1 < 2.72 :=
    lt_trans Real.exp_one_lt_d9 (by norm_num)
  have h_e_pos : 0 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos 1
  have h_pow_lt : (Real.exp 1)^24 < (2.72 : ℝ)^24 :=
    pow_lt_pow_left₀ h_e_lt (le_of_lt h_e_pos) (by norm_num)
  have h_exp24_eq : Real.exp (24 : ℝ) = (Real.exp 1)^24 := by
    have h := Real.exp_one_pow 24
    have h_cast : ((24 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (24 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [← h_cast]
    exact h.symm
  have h_exp_24_5_pow : (Real.exp (24 / 5 : ℝ))^5 = Real.exp 24 := by
    have h := Real.exp_nat_mul (24 / 5 : ℝ) 5
    have h_eq : ((5 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (24 / 5 : ℝ) = 24 := by norm_num
    rw [h_eq] at h
    exact h.symm
  have h_pow_num : (2.72 : ℝ)^24 < (140 : ℝ)^5 := by norm_num
  have h_exp_pow_lt :
      (Real.exp (24 / 5 : ℝ))^5 < (140 : ℝ)^5 := by
    rw [h_exp_24_5_pow, h_exp24_eq]
    linarith
  have hexp_nn : 0 ≤ Real.exp (24 / 5 : ℝ) :=
    le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)
  have h140_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 140 := by norm_num
  exact
    (pow_lt_pow_iff_left₀ hexp_nn h140_nn
      (by norm_num : (5 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mp h_exp_pow_lt

name: OverflowResidueRH.BacklundTuring.backlund_log_le_tangent
statement:
theorem backlund_log_le_tangent
    {T T₀ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hT₀ : 0 < T₀) :
    Real.log T ≤ Real.log T₀ + (T - T₀) / T₀
proof:
:= by
  have h_ratio_pos : 0 < T / T₀ := div_pos hT hT₀
  have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos h_ratio_pos
  rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hT) (ne_of_gt hT₀)] at h
  have h_simp : (T - T₀) / T₀ = T / T₀ - 1 := by
    field_simp
  linarith [h, h_simp]

statement:
theorem backlund_log_ten_le_twelve_fifths :
    Real.log (10 : ℝ) ≤ 12 / 5
proof:
:= by
  have h_e_gt : (2.71 : ℝ) < Real.exp 1 :=
    lt_trans (by norm_num : (2.71 : ℝ) < 2.7182818283)
      Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  have h_pow_lt : (2.71 : ℝ)^12 < (Real.exp 1)^12 :=
    pow_lt_pow_left₀ h_e_gt (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h_10_pow : (10 : ℝ)^5 < (2.71 : ℝ)^12 := by norm_num
  have h_10_pow_lt_exp12 : (10 : ℝ)^5 < (Real.exp 1)^12 := by
    linarith
  have h_exp12_eq : Real.exp (12 : ℝ) = (Real.exp 1)^12 := by
    have h := Real.exp_one_pow 12
    have h_cast : ((12 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (12 : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [← h_cast]
    exact h.symm
  have h_exp_12_5_pow : (Real.exp (12 / 5 : ℝ))^5 = Real.exp 12 := by
    have h := Real.exp_nat_mul (12 / 5 : ℝ) 5
    have h_eq : ((5 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (12 / 5 : ℝ) = 12 := by norm_num
    rw [h_eq] at h
    exact h.symm
  have h10_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 10 := by norm_num
  have hexp_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.exp (12 / 5 : ℝ) :=
    le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)
  have h10_le_exp : (10 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (12 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    apply
      (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ h10_nonneg hexp_nonneg
        (by norm_num : (5 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mp
    rw [h_exp_12_5_pow, h_exp12_eq]
    exact le_of_lt h_10_pow_lt_exp12
  have h := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 10) h10_le_exp
  rwa [Real.log_exp] at h

    (hy : 0 < z.im) (hreg : 2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T) :
    closedFormSErrorBoundCD C D z.im T ≤ -(M.model z).im
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed :
      closedFormSErrorBoundCD C D z.im T
        ≤ simpleCloudSum zeros100ceil z.re z.im
          + smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs z.re z.im T :=
    slab z.re z.im T hTmin hTmax hy hreg
  have h_cloud_bound :
      simpleCloudSum zeros100ceil z.re z.im
        ≤ cloudImNegSum zeros100ceil z.re z.im :=
    cloudImNegSum_ge_simpleCloudSum zeros100ceil z.re z.im hy
  have h_cloud_im :
      -(cloudModel zeros100ceil z).im = cloudImNegSum zeros100ceil z.re z.im :=
    cloudModel_neg_im_at zeros100ceil z
  have h_tail_lb :
      smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs z.re z.im T ≤ -(M.densityTail z).im :=
    M.densityTailRationalLB z T hT_2pi hy hreg
  have h_model : M.model z = cloudModel M.zeros z + M.densityTail z := rfl
  have h_model' : M.model z = cloudModel zeros100ceil z + M.densityTail z := by
    rw [h_model, hM_zeros]
  have h_model_im :
      -(M.model z).im = -(cloudModel zeros100ceil z).im + -(M.densityTail z).im := by
    rw [h_model', Complex.add_im]; ring
  calc closedFormSErrorBoundCD C D z.im T
      ≤ simpleCloudSum zeros100ceil z.re z.im
          + smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs z.re z.im T := hclosed
    _ ≤ cloudImNegSum zeros100ceil z.re z.im + -(M.densityTail z).im := by linarith
    _ = -(cloudModel zeros100ceil z).im + -(M.densityTail z).im := by rw [h_cloud_im]
    _ = -(M.model z).im := h_model_im.symm

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.ImproperKernelStieltjesIBP.improper_identity
statement:
theorem ImproperKernelStieltjesIBP.improper_identity
    (I : ImproperKernelStieltjesIBP) :
    ∃ J : ℝ,
      Tendsto
        (fun X : ℝ => kernelIBPDerivativeIntegral I.S I.x I.y I.T X)
        atTop
        (𝓝 J) ∧
      I.L = - pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T - J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := I.derivative_integral_tendsto
  refine ⟨J, hJ, ?_⟩
  
  have h_finite_X :
      ∀ X : ℝ,
        I.partialF X =
          pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y X * I.S X
          - pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T
          - kernelIBPDerivativeIntegral I.S I.x I.y I.T X := by
    intro X
    have h := I.finiteIBP.finite_ibp X
    
    rw [I.finiteIBP_partial_eq] at h
    unfold kernelBoundaryTerm at h
    rw [I.finiteIBP_S_eq, I.finiteIBP_x_eq, I.finiteIBP_y_eq, I.finiteIBP_T_eq] at h
    exact h
  
  have h_const :
      Tendsto
        (fun _ : ℝ => pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T)
        atTop
        (𝓝 (pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have h_diff :
      Tendsto
        (fun X : ℝ =>
          pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y X * I.S X
            - pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T)
        atTop
        (𝓝 (0 - pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T)) :=
    I.boundary_atTop.sub h_const
  have h_rhs :
      Tendsto
        (fun X : ℝ =>
          pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y X * I.S X
            - pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T
            - kernelIBPDerivativeIntegral I.S I.x I.y I.T X)
        atTop
        (𝓝 (0 - pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T - J)) :=
    h_diff.sub hJ
  
  have h_partial_rhs :
      (fun X : ℝ => I.partialF X) =
      (fun X : ℝ =>
        pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y X * I.S X
          - pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T
          - kernelIBPDerivativeIntegral I.S I.x I.y I.T X) :=
    funext h_finite_X
  have h_partial_lim :
      Tendsto (fun X : ℝ => I.partialF X) atTop
        (𝓝 (0 - pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T - J)) := by
    rw [h_partial_rhs]; exact h_rhs
  
  have h_unique :
      I.L = 0 - pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T - J :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique I.partialF_tendsto h_partial_lim
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.ImproperKernelStieltjesIBP.abs_L_le_triangle
statement:
theorem ImproperKernelStieltjesIBP.abs_L_le_triangle
    (I : ImproperKernelStieltjesIBP) :
    ∃ J : ℝ,
      Tendsto
        (fun X : ℝ => kernelIBPDerivativeIntegral I.S I.x I.y I.T X)
        atTop
        (𝓝 J) ∧
      |I.L| ≤ |pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T| + |J|
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hL⟩ := I.improper_identity
  refine ⟨J, hJ, ?_⟩
  
  rw [hL]
  calc |(- pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T) - J|
      ≤ |- pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T| + |J| := abs_sub _ _
    _ = |pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T| + |J| := by
        rw [neg_mul, abs_neg]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.ImproperKernelStieltjesIBP.abs_L_le_of_S_and_J_bound
statement:
theorem ImproperKernelStieltjesIBP.abs_L_le_of_S_and_J_bound
    (I : ImproperKernelStieltjesIBP)
    (B : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hS_bound : ∀ u : ℝ, I.T ≤ u → |I.S u| ≤ B u)
    (Jbound : ℝ)
    (hJ_bound :
      ∀ J : ℝ,
        Tendsto
          (fun X : ℝ => kernelIBPDerivativeIntegral I.S I.x I.y I.T X)
          atTop
          (𝓝 J) → |J| ≤ Jbound) :
    |I.L| ≤ |pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T| * B I.T + Jbound
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hLtri⟩ := I.abs_L_le_triangle
  have hJ_le : |J| ≤ Jbound := hJ_bound J hJ
  have hS_T : |I.S I.T| ≤ B I.T := hS_bound I.T le_rfl
  have h_kS : |pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T * I.S I.T|
              ≤ |pairedCauchyImKernel I.x I.y I.T| * B I.T := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS_T (abs_nonneg _)
  linarith [hLtri, hJ_le, h_kS]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.zeroDensityRho_continuousAt
statement:
lemma zeroDensityRho_continuousAt {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) :
    ContinuousAt zeroDensityRho X
proof:
:= by
  unfold zeroDensityRho
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have h_div_pos : 0 < X / (2 * Real.pi) := div_pos hX h2pi_pos
  have h_div_ne : X / (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_div_pos
  have h_inner : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ => u / (2 * Real.pi)) X :=
    (continuous_id.div_const _).continuousAt
  
  
  have h_log : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.log (u / (2 * Real.pi))) X :=
    h_inner.log h_div_ne
  exact continuousAt_const.mul h_log

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.zeroDensityRho_continuousOn_Ioi
statement:
lemma zeroDensityRho_continuousOn_Ioi :

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.zeroDensityRho_intervalIntegrable
statement:
lemma zeroDensityRho_intervalIntegrable
    {T X : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hTX : T ≤ X) :
    IntervalIntegrable zeroDensityRho MeasureTheory.volume T X
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hTX ?_
  intro u hu
  have hu_pos : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le hT hu.1
  exact (zeroDensityRho_continuousAt hu_pos).continuousWithinAt

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.smoothCountingPrimitive_hasDerivAt
statement:
lemma smoothCountingPrimitive_hasDerivAt
    {T X : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hTX : T ≤ X) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => smoothCountingPrimitive T u)
      (zeroDensityRho X) X
proof:
:= by
  have hX : 0 < X := lt_of_lt_of_le hT hTX
  have hX_cont : ContinuousAt zeroDensityRho X := zeroDensityRho_continuousAt hX
  have h_int : IntervalIntegrable zeroDensityRho MeasureTheory.volume T X :=
    zeroDensityRho_intervalIntegrable hT hTX
  
  
  have h_Ioi_mem : Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∈ 𝓝 X := Ioi_mem_nhds hX
  have h_smaf : StronglyMeasurableAtFilter zeroDensityRho (𝓝 X) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    ⟨Set.Ioi 0, h_Ioi_mem,
     zeroDensityRho_continuousOn_Ioi.aestronglyMeasurable measurableSet_Ioi⟩
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right h_int h_smaf hX_cont

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.pairedCauchyImKernel_hasDerivAt
statement:
lemma pairedCauchyImKernel_hasDerivAt
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (x u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => pairedCauchyImKernel x y v)
      (pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u) u
proof:
:= by
  have hd1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (x - u)^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  have hd2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (x + u)^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  have h_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v : ℝ => pairedCauchyImKernel x y v) u := by
    unfold pairedCauchyImKernel
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v : ℝ => (x - v)^2 + y^2) u :=
      (((differentiableAt_const x).sub differentiableAt_fun_id).pow 2).add_const _
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v : ℝ => (x + v)^2 + y^2) u :=
      (((differentiableAt_const x).add differentiableAt_fun_id).pow 2).add_const _
    have hi1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v : ℝ => 1 / ((x - v)^2 + y^2)) u :=
      (differentiableAt_const _).div h1 (ne_of_gt hd1_pos)
    have hi2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v : ℝ => 1 / ((x + v)^2 + y^2)) u :=
      (differentiableAt_const _).div h2 (ne_of_gt hd2_pos)
    exact (differentiableAt_const (-y)).mul (hi1.add hi2)
  have h_value : deriv (fun v : ℝ => pairedCauchyImKernel x y v) u
                  = pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u :=
    deriv_pairedCauchyImKernel x y u hy
  rw [← h_value]
  exact h_diff.hasDerivAt

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_continuous
statement:
lemma pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_continuous
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (x : ℝ) :
    Continuous (fun u : ℝ => pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv
  have h_plus_sq : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2) := by
    have h : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => (x + u)^2 + y^2) :=
      ((continuous_const.add continuous_id).pow 2).add continuous_const
    exact h.pow 2
  have h_minus_sq : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2) := by
    have h : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => (x - u)^2 + y^2) :=
      ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).pow 2).add continuous_const
    exact h.pow 2
  have hne_plus : ∀ u : ℝ, ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2 ≠ 0 := fun u => by
    have : 0 < ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2 := by positivity
    exact ne_of_gt this
  have hne_minus : ∀ u : ℝ, ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2 ≠ 0 := fun u => by
    have : 0 < ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2 := by positivity
    exact ne_of_gt this
  have h_div_plus : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => (x + u) / ((x + u)^2 + y^2)^2) :=
    (continuous_const.add continuous_id).div h_plus_sq hne_plus
  have h_div_minus : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => (x - u) / ((x - u)^2 + y^2)^2) :=
    (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).div h_minus_sq hne_minus
  exact continuous_const.mul (h_div_plus.sub h_div_minus)

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable
statement:
lemma pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (x T X : ℝ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      MeasureTheory.volume T X
proof:
:=
  (pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_continuous hy x).intervalIntegrable T X

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.smooth_zeroDensity_kernel_ibp
statement:
theorem smooth_zeroDensity_kernel_ibp
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (x T X : ℝ)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hTX : T ≤ X) :
    (∫ u in T..X, pairedCauchyImKernel x y u * zeroDensityRho u) =
      pairedCauchyImKernel x y X * smoothCountingPrimitive T X
        - pairedCauchyImKernel x y T * smoothCountingPrimitive T T
        - ∫ u in T..X,
            smoothCountingPrimitive T u * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
proof:
:= by
  have hu_deriv :
      ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc T X,
        HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => pairedCauchyImKernel x y v)
          (pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u) u :=
    fun u _ => pairedCauchyImKernel_hasDerivAt hy x u
  have hv_deriv :
      ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc T X,
        HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => smoothCountingPrimitive T v)
          (zeroDensityRho u) u := by
    intro u hu
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hTX] at hu
    exact smoothCountingPrimitive_hasDerivAt hT hu.1
  have hu'_int :
      IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
        MeasureTheory.volume T X :=
    pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable hy x T X
  have hv'_int : IntervalIntegrable zeroDensityRho MeasureTheory.volume T X :=
    zeroDensityRho_intervalIntegrable hT hTX
  have h_ibp :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul
      hu_deriv hv_deriv hu'_int hv'_int
  
  
  have h_swap :
      (∫ u in T..X,
         pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u * smoothCountingPrimitive T u) =
      (∫ u in T..X,
         smoothCountingPrimitive T u * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u) := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr ?_
    intro u _; exact mul_comm _ _
  linarith [h_ibp, h_swap]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.fin_sum_mul_eq_boundary_sub_sum_succ
statement:
lemma fin_sum_mul_eq_boundary_sub_sum_succ
    (n : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a j * b j)
      =
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a j) * b n
      -
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), a i) * (b (j + 1) - b j)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ (fun j => a j * b j) (n + 1), ih,
        Finset.sum_range_succ (fun j => a j) (n + 1),
        Finset.sum_range_succ
          (fun j => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), a i) * (b (j + 1) - b j)) n]
    ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteCountingPrimitive_left
statement:
lemma discreteCountingPrimitive_left
    (D : FluctuationMeasureData) (T : ℝ) :
    discreteCountingPrimitive D T T
      =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range D.n,
      if D.Z j = T then (D.mult j : ℝ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold discreteCountingPrimitive
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  by_cases h : D.Z j = T
  · have hpair : T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ T := ⟨h.ge, h.le⟩
    simp [h]
  · have hnot : ¬ (T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ T) := by
      intro hpair
      exact h (le_antisymm hpair.2 hpair.1)
    simp [h, hnot]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteCountingPrimitive_mono
statement:
lemma discreteCountingPrimitive_mono
    (D : FluctuationMeasureData) (T : ℝ) :
    Monotone (fun X => discreteCountingPrimitive D T X)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro X Y hXY
  unfold discreteCountingPrimitive
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j _
  have hmult_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (D.mult j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  by_cases hTX : T ≤ D.Z j
  · by_cases hZX : D.Z j ≤ X
    · have hZY : D.Z j ≤ Y := le_trans hZX hXY
      have hX_pair : T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ X := ⟨hTX, hZX⟩
      have hY_pair : T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ Y := ⟨hTX, hZY⟩
      rw [if_pos hX_pair, if_pos hY_pair]
    · by_cases hZY : D.Z j ≤ Y
      · have hY_pair : T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ Y := ⟨hTX, hZY⟩
        have hX_nopair : ¬ (T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ X) := fun ⟨_, h⟩ => hZX h
        rw [if_neg hX_nopair, if_pos hY_pair]
        exact hmult_nn
      · have hX_nopair : ¬ (T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ X) := fun ⟨_, h⟩ => hZX h
        have hY_nopair : ¬ (T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ Y) := fun ⟨_, h⟩ => hZY h
        rw [if_neg hX_nopair, if_neg hY_nopair]
  · have hX_nopair : ¬ (T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ X) := fun ⟨h, _⟩ => hTX h
    have hY_nopair : ¬ (T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ Y) := fun ⟨h, _⟩ => hTX h
    rw [if_neg hX_nopair, if_neg hY_nopair]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteKernelPartial_eq_clippedSum
statement:
lemma discreteKernelPartial_eq_clippedSum
    (D : FluctuationMeasureData) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T X : ℝ) :
    discreteKernelPartial D f T X
      =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range D.n,
      clippedWeight D T X j * f (D.Z j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold discreteKernelPartial clippedWeight
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  by_cases h : T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ X
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, zero_mul]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteCountingPrimitive_eq_clippedSum
statement:
lemma discreteCountingPrimitive_eq_clippedSum
    (D : FluctuationMeasureData) (T X : ℝ) :
    discreteCountingPrimitive D T X
      = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range D.n, clippedWeight D T X j
proof: := rfl

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.ordered_discrete_kernel_abel_clipped
statement:
theorem ordered_discrete_kernel_abel_clipped
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (hn : D.n = m + 1) :
    discreteKernelPartial D.toFluctuationMeasureData f T X
      =
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range D.n,
        clippedWeight D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X j) * f (D.Z m)
      -
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
          clippedWeight D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X i) *
        (f (D.Z (j + 1)) - f (D.Z j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [discreteKernelPartial_eq_clippedSum, hn]
  exact fin_sum_mul_eq_boundary_sub_sum_succ m
    (fun j => clippedWeight D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X j)
    (fun j => f (D.Z j))

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.ordered_discrete_pairedCauchyIm_abel_clipped
statement:
theorem ordered_discrete_pairedCauchyIm_abel_clipped
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (hn : D.n = m + 1) :
    discreteKernelPartial D.toFluctuationMeasureData
        (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X
      =
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range D.n,
        clippedWeight D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X j) *
          pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z m)
      -
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
          clippedWeight D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X i) *
        (pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z (j + 1))
          - pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z j))
proof:
:=
  ordered_discrete_kernel_abel_clipped D
    (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X hn

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.clippedCumulativeWeight_eq_discreteCountingPrefix
statement:
lemma clippedCumulativeWeight_eq_discreteCountingPrefix
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T X : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    clippedCumulativeWeight D T X j
      =
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
      if T ≤ D.Z i ∧ D.Z i ≤ X then (D.mult i : ℝ) else 0
proof: := rfl

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.ordered_discrete_kernel_abel_clipped_named
statement:
theorem ordered_discrete_kernel_abel_clipped_named
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (hn : D.n = m + 1) :
    discreteKernelPartial D.toFluctuationMeasureData f T X
      =
    (discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X) * f (D.Z m)
      -
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
      clippedCumulativeWeight D T X j * (f (D.Z (j + 1)) - f (D.Z j))
proof:
:=
  ordered_discrete_kernel_abel_clipped D f T X hn

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.ordered_discrete_kernel_ibp_raw
statement:
theorem ordered_discrete_kernel_ibp_raw
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData)
    (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ} (hn : D.n = m + 1) :
    discreteKernelPartial D.toFluctuationMeasureData
        (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X
      =
    discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X
      * pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z m)
      -
    discreteKernelAbelRemainder D x y T X m
proof:
:= by
  unfold discreteKernelAbelRemainder discreteAbelRemainder
  exact ordered_discrete_kernel_abel_clipped_named D
    (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X hn

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive_left
statement:
lemma finiteFluctuationPrimitive_left
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T : ℝ) :
    finiteFluctuationPrimitive D T T
      =
    discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T T
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteFluctuationPrimitive, smoothCountingPrimitive_self]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteCountingPrimitive_left_zero_of_no_atom
statement:
lemma discreteCountingPrimitive_left_zero_of_no_atom
    (D : FluctuationMeasureData) (T : ℝ)
    (hno : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range D.n, D.Z j ≠ T) :
    discreteCountingPrimitive D T T = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold discreteCountingPrimitive
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j hj
  have hnot : ¬ (T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ T) := by
    intro h
    exact hno j hj (le_antisymm h.2 h.1)
  simp [hnot]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationKernelPartial_raw_ibp
statement:
theorem finiteFluctuationKernelPartial_raw_ibp
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData)
    (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ} (hn : D.n = m + 1)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hTX : T ≤ X) (hy : 0 < y) :
    finiteFluctuationKernelPartial D x y T X
      =
    discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X
      * pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z m)
      -
    discreteKernelAbelRemainder D x y T X m
      -
    (pairedCauchyImKernel x y X * smoothCountingPrimitive T X
      - pairedCauchyImKernel x y T * smoothCountingPrimitive T T
      - ∫ u in T..X,
          smoothCountingPrimitive T u *
            pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteFluctuationKernelPartial
  rw [ordered_discrete_kernel_ibp_raw D x y T X hn,
      smooth_zeroDensity_kernel_ibp hy x T X hT hTX]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.ordered_discrete_kernel_ibp_endpoint_corrected
statement:
theorem ordered_discrete_kernel_ibp_endpoint_corrected
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData)
    (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ} (hn : D.n = m + 1) :
    discreteKernelPartial D.toFluctuationMeasureData
        (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X
      =
    discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X
      * pairedCauchyImKernel x y X
      -
    discreteKernelAbelRemainder D x y T X m
      -
    discreteAbelEndpointCorrection D.toFluctuationMeasureData
      (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X m
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordered_discrete_kernel_ibp_raw D x y T X hn]
  unfold discreteAbelEndpointCorrection
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.ordered_discrete_kernel_ibp_endpoint_corrected_paired
statement:
theorem ordered_discrete_kernel_ibp_endpoint_corrected_paired

    (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ} (hn : D.n = m + 1) :
    discreteKernelPartial D.toFluctuationMeasureData
        (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X
      =
    discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X
      * pairedCauchyImKernel x y X
      -
    discreteKernelAbelRemainder D x y T X m
      -
    discreteKernelEndpointCorrection D x y T X m
proof:

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationKernelPartial_endpoint_corrected_ibp
statement:
theorem finiteFluctuationKernelPartial_endpoint_corrected_ibp
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData)
    (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ} (hn : D.n = m + 1)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hTX : T ≤ X) (hy : 0 < y) :
    finiteFluctuationKernelPartial D x y T X
      =
    finiteFluctuationPrimitive D T X
      * pairedCauchyImKernel x y X
      -
    finiteFluctuationRawRemainder D x y T X m
      -
    finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection D x y T X m
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteFluctuationKernelPartial_raw_ibp D x y T X hn hT hTX hy]
  unfold finiteFluctuationPrimitive finiteFluctuationRawRemainder
        finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection
        discreteKernelEndpointCorrection
        discreteAbelEndpointCorrection
  rw [smoothCountingPrimitive_self]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteAbelEndpointCorrection_eq_zero_of_X_eq_Z
statement:
theorem discreteAbelEndpointCorrection_eq_zero_of_X_eq_Z
    (D : FluctuationMeasureData) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T X : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hX : X = D.Z m) :
    discreteAbelEndpointCorrection D f T X m = 0
proof:
:= by

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteKernelEndpointCorrection_eq_zero_of_X_eq_Z
statement:
theorem discreteKernelEndpointCorrection_eq_zero_of_X_eq_Z
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hX : X = D.Z m) :

proof:
:= by

    D.toFluctuationMeasureData (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X m hX

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection_eq_zero_of_X_eq_Z
statement:
theorem finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection_eq_zero_of_X_eq_Z
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hX : X = D.Z m) :

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteAbelEndpointCorrection_abs_le
statement:
theorem discreteAbelEndpointCorrection_abs_le
    (D : FluctuationMeasureData) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T X : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    |discreteAbelEndpointCorrection D f T X m|
      ≤ |discreteCountingPrimitive D T X|
          * |f X - f (D.Z m)|
proof:
:= by
  unfold discreteAbelEndpointCorrection
  rw [abs_mul]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteAbelEndpointCorrection_abs_le_count
statement:
theorem discreteAbelEndpointCorrection_abs_le_count
    (D : FluctuationMeasureData) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (T X : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hN : 0 ≤ discreteCountingPrimitive D T X) :
    |discreteAbelEndpointCorrection D f T X m|
      ≤ discreteCountingPrimitive D T X
          * |f X - f (D.Z m)|
proof:
:= by
  unfold discreteAbelEndpointCorrection
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hN]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteKernelEndpointCorrection_abs_le
statement:
theorem discreteKernelEndpointCorrection_abs_le
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    |discreteKernelEndpointCorrection D x y T X m|
      ≤ |discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X|
          * |pairedCauchyImKernel x y X
              - pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z m)|
proof:
:= by
  unfold discreteKernelEndpointCorrection
  exact discreteAbelEndpointCorrection_abs_le
    D.toFluctuationMeasureData (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X m

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection_abs_le
statement:
theorem finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection_abs_le
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    |finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection D x y T X m|
      ≤ |discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X|
          * |pairedCauchyImKernel x y X
              - pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z m)|
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection
  exact discreteKernelEndpointCorrection_abs_le D x y T X m

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteKernelEndpointCorrection_abs_le_deriv_bound
statement:
theorem discreteKernelEndpointCorrection_abs_le_deriv_bound
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (K : ℝ)
    (hN : 0 ≤ discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X)
    (hLip :
      |pairedCauchyImKernel x y X
        - pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z m)|
        ≤ K * |X - D.Z m|) :
    |discreteKernelEndpointCorrection D x y T X m|
      ≤ discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X
          * K * |X - D.Z m|
proof:
:= by
  have h0 :
      |discreteKernelEndpointCorrection D x y T X m|
        ≤ |discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X|
            * |pairedCauchyImKernel x y X
                - pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z m)| :=
    discreteKernelEndpointCorrection_abs_le D x y T X m
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hN] at h0
  have h_step :
      discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X
        * |pairedCauchyImKernel x y X
            - pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z m)|
        ≤ discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X
            * (K * |X - D.Z m|) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLip hN
  calc |discreteKernelEndpointCorrection D x y T X m|
      ≤ discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X
          * |pairedCauchyImKernel x y X
              - pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z m)| := h0
    _ ≤ discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X
          * (K * |X - D.Z m|) := h_step
    _ = discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X
          * K * |X - D.Z m| := by ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationCorrection_abs_le_of_parts
statement:
theorem finiteFluctuationCorrection_abs_le_of_parts
    {D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData} {x y T X : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    {Braw Bend : ℝ}
    (hraw : |finiteFluctuationRawRemainder D x y T X m| ≤ Braw)
    (hend : |finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection D x y T X m| ≤ Bend) :
    |finiteFluctuationRawRemainder D x y T X m
      + finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection D x y T X m|
      ≤ Braw + Bend
proof:
:= by
  calc |finiteFluctuationRawRemainder D x y T X m
        + finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection D x y T X m|
      ≤ |finiteFluctuationRawRemainder D x y T X m|
        + |finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection D x y T X m| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ Braw + Bend := add_le_add hraw hend

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.OrderedWindow.Z_mem_window
statement:
lemma OrderedWindow.Z_mem_window
    {D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData} {T X : ℝ} {m j : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m) (hj : j ≤ m) :
    T ≤ D.Z j ∧ D.Z j ≤ X
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact le_trans W.hT_le_first (D.mono_Z (Nat.zero_le j))
  · exact le_trans (D.mono_Z hj) W.hlast_le_X

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.clippedWeight_eq_mult_of_orderedWindow
statement:
lemma clippedWeight_eq_mult_of_orderedWindow
    {D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData} {T X : ℝ} {m j : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m) (hj : j ≤ m) :
    clippedWeight D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X j = (D.mult j : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold clippedWeight
  rw [if_pos (W.Z_mem_window hj)]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.clippedCumulativeWeight_eq_partialSum_of_orderedWindow
statement:
lemma clippedCumulativeWeight_eq_partialSum_of_orderedWindow
    {D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData} {T X : ℝ} {m j : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m) (hj : j ≤ m) :
    clippedCumulativeWeight D T X j
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), (D.mult i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold clippedCumulativeWeight
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hi_le_m : i ≤ m := by
    have hi_lt : i < j + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    omega
  exact clippedWeight_eq_mult_of_orderedWindow W hi_le_m

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteCountingPrimitive_full_of_orderedWindow
statement:
lemma discreteCountingPrimitive_full_of_orderedWindow
    {D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData} {T X : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m) :
    discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range D.n, (D.mult i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [discreteCountingPrimitive_eq_clippedSum, W.hn]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hi_lt : i < m + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  exact clippedWeight_eq_mult_of_orderedWindow W (by omega)

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discrete_remainder_plus_correction_eq_explicit_sum
statement:
theorem discrete_remainder_plus_correction_eq_explicit_sum
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m) :
    discreteKernelAbelRemainder D x y T X m
      + discreteAbelEndpointCorrection D.toFluctuationMeasureData
          (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X m
      =
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range D.n,
      (D.mult i : ℝ) *
        (pairedCauchyImKernel x y X - pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z i))
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_ibp :=
    ordered_discrete_kernel_ibp_endpoint_corrected D x y T X W.hn
  
  have h_RE :
      discreteKernelAbelRemainder D x y T X m
        + discreteAbelEndpointCorrection D.toFluctuationMeasureData
            (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X m
        = discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X
            * pairedCauchyImKernel x y X
          - discreteKernelPartial D.toFluctuationMeasureData
              (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X := by
    linarith [h_ibp]
  rw [h_RE]
  
  have h_partial :
      discreteKernelPartial D.toFluctuationMeasureData
          (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X
        = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range D.n,
            (D.mult i : ℝ) * pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z i) := by
    unfold discreteKernelPartial
    rw [W.hn]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    have hi_lt : i < m + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hi_le_m : i ≤ m := by omega
    rw [if_pos (W.Z_mem_window hi_le_m)]
  rw [h_partial, discreteCountingPrimitive_full_of_orderedWindow W]
  
  rw [Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discrete_corrected_remainder_eq_intervalIntegral
statement:
theorem discrete_corrected_remainder_eq_intervalIntegral
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m)
    (h_decomp : NDecompositionIntegrandHypothesis D x y T X)
    (h_linear : IntegralSumLinearityHypothesis D x y T X)
    (h_ftc : IndicatorKernelFTCHypothesis D x y T X m) :
    discreteKernelAbelRemainder D x y T X m
      + discreteAbelEndpointCorrection D.toFluctuationMeasureData
          (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X m
      =
    ∫ u in T..X,
      discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T u
        * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [discrete_remainder_plus_correction_eq_explicit_sum D x y T X W]
  
  rw [h_decomp, h_linear]
  
  
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hi_lt : i < D.n := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  have hi_le_m : i ≤ m := by rw [W.hn] at hi_lt; omega
  rw [h_ftc i hi hi_le_m]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteCountingPrimitive_eq_indicator_sum_of_orderedWindow
statement:
lemma discreteCountingPrimitive_eq_indicator_sum_of_orderedWindow
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T X u : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m) :
    discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T u
      =
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range D.n,
      (D.mult i : ℝ) * (if D.Z i ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold discreteCountingPrimitive
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hi_lt : i < D.n := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  have hi_le_m : i ≤ m := by rw [W.hn] at hi_lt; omega
  have hT_Zi : T ≤ D.Z i := (W.Z_mem_window hi_le_m).1
  by_cases hZi_u : D.Z i ≤ u
  · have hclip : T ≤ D.Z i ∧ D.Z i ≤ u := ⟨hT_Zi, hZi_u⟩
    rw [if_pos hclip, if_pos hZi_u, mul_one]
  · have hclip : ¬ (T ≤ D.Z i ∧ D.Z i ≤ u) := fun h => hZi_u h.2
    rw [if_neg hclip, if_neg hZi_u, mul_zero]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.nDecompositionIntegrand_of_orderedWindow
statement:
theorem nDecompositionIntegrand_of_orderedWindow
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m) :
    NDecompositionIntegrandHypothesis D x y T X
proof:
:= by
  unfold NDecompositionIntegrandHypothesis
  refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr ?_
  intro u _
  change discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T u
        * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
      = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D.n, (D.mult i : ℝ) * (if D.Z i ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
  rw [discreteCountingPrimitive_eq_indicator_sum_of_orderedWindow D T X u W]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_integral_eq_sub
statement:
theorem pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_integral_eq_sub
    {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (x a b : ℝ) :
    (∫ u in a..b, pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      =
    pairedCauchyImKernel x y b - pairedCauchyImKernel x y a
proof:
:= by
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
  · intro u _
    exact pairedCauchyImKernel_hasDerivAt hy x u
  · exact pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable hy x a b

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.ae_ne_real
statement:
lemma ae_ne_real (a : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ u : ℝ ∂MeasureTheory.volume, u ≠ a
proof:
:= by
  refine MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mpr ?_
  have h_eq : {u : ℝ | ¬ u ≠ a} = {a} := by
    ext u
    simp [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  rw [h_eq]
  exact Real.volume_singleton

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.integral_if_le_eq_integral_if_lt
statement:
lemma integral_if_le_eq_integral_if_lt
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a T X : ℝ) :
    (∫ u in T..X, (if a ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u)
      =
    ∫ u in T..X, (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u
proof:
:= by
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_ne_real a] with u hu_ne _
  by_cases hle : a ≤ u
  · have hlt : a < u := lt_of_le_of_ne hle (Ne.symm hu_ne)
    rw [if_pos hle, if_pos hlt]
  · have hnlt : ¬ a < u := fun h => hle (le_of_lt h)
    rw [if_neg hle, if_neg hnlt]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.integral_if_lt_left_zero
statement:
lemma integral_if_lt_left_zero
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (T a : ℝ) (hTa : T ≤ a) :
    (∫ u in T..a, (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc T a,
      (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hTa] at hu
    have hua : u ≤ a := hu.2
    have hnlt : ¬ a < u := not_lt.mpr hua
    rw [if_neg hnlt, zero_mul]
  calc (∫ u in T..a, (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u)
      = ∫ _ in T..a, (0 : ℝ) := intervalIntegral.integral_congr h_eq
    _ = 0 := intervalIntegral.integral_zero

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.integral_if_lt_right_eq
statement:
lemma integral_if_lt_right_eq
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a X : ℝ) (haX : a ≤ X) :
    (∫ u in a..X, (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u)
      =
    ∫ u in a..X, g u
proof:
:= by
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [ae_ne_real a] with u hu_ne hu_mem
  rw [Set.uIoc_of_le haX] at hu_mem
  have hau_lt : a < u := hu_mem.1
  rw [if_pos hau_lt, one_mul]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.intervalIntegrable_if_lt_mul_left
statement:
lemma intervalIntegrable_if_lt_mul_left
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a T : ℝ) (hTa : T ≤ a) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u => (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u)
      MeasureTheory.volume T a
proof:
:= by
  refine (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr ?_
  rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hTa]
  intro u hu
  have hua : u ≤ a := hu.2
  have hnlt : ¬ a < u := not_lt.mpr hua
  change (0 : ℝ) = (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u
  rw [if_neg hnlt, zero_mul]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.intervalIntegrable_if_lt_mul_right
statement:
lemma intervalIntegrable_if_lt_mul_right
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a X : ℝ) (haX : a ≤ X)
    (hg_int : IntervalIntegrable g MeasureTheory.volume a X) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u => (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u)
      MeasureTheory.volume a X
proof:
:= by
  refine hg_int.congr ?_
  rw [Set.uIoc_of_le haX]
  intro u hu
  have hau : a < u := hu.1
  change g u = (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u
  rw [if_pos hau, one_mul]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.integral_if_lt_eq_integral_from_cut
statement:
lemma integral_if_lt_eq_integral_from_cut
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (T a X : ℝ)
    (hTa : T ≤ a) (haX : a ≤ X)
    (hg_int : IntervalIntegrable g MeasureTheory.volume T X) :
    (∫ u in T..X, (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u)
      =
    ∫ u in a..X, g u
proof:
:= by
  
  have hTX : T ≤ X := le_trans hTa haX
  have h_sub_right : Set.uIcc a X ⊆ Set.uIcc T X := by
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le haX, Set.uIcc_of_le hTX]
    exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc_left hTa
  have hg_right : IntervalIntegrable g MeasureTheory.volume a X :=
    hg_int.mono_set h_sub_right
  
  have h_int_left := intervalIntegrable_if_lt_mul_left g a T hTa
  have h_int_right := intervalIntegrable_if_lt_mul_right g a X haX hg_right
  calc
    (∫ u in T..X, (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u)
        =
      (∫ u in T..a, (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u)
        + ∫ u in a..X, (if a < u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u :=
        (intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
          h_int_left h_int_right).symm
    _ = 0 + ∫ u in a..X, g u := by
          rw [integral_if_lt_left_zero g T a hTa,
              integral_if_lt_right_eq g a X haX]
    _ = ∫ u in a..X, g u := zero_add _

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.indicator_Ici_integral_eq_integral_from_cut
statement:
theorem indicator_Ici_integral_eq_integral_from_cut
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (T a X : ℝ)
    (hTa : T ≤ a) (haX : a ≤ X)
    (hg_int : IntervalIntegrable g MeasureTheory.volume T X) :
    (∫ u in T..X, (if a ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * g u)
      =
    ∫ u in a..X, g u
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_if_le_eq_integral_if_lt g a T X,
      integral_if_lt_eq_integral_from_cut g T a X hTa haX hg_int]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.pairedCauchy_indicator_Ici_integral_eq_integral_from_cut
statement:
theorem pairedCauchy_indicator_Ici_integral_eq_integral_from_cut
    (x y T a X : ℝ) (hTa : T ≤ a) (haX : a ≤ X) (hy : 0 < y) :
    (∫ u in T..X,
        (if a ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      =
    ∫ u in a..X, pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
proof:
:=
  indicator_Ici_integral_eq_integral_from_cut
    (pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y) T a X hTa haX
    (pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable hy x T X)

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.indicatorKernelFTC_of_orderedWindow
statement:
theorem indicatorKernelFTC_of_orderedWindow
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m) (hy : 0 < y) :
    IndicatorKernelFTCHypothesis D x y T X m
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi hi_le_m
  have hZi := W.Z_mem_window hi_le_m
  rw [pairedCauchy_indicator_Ici_integral_eq_integral_from_cut
        x y T (D.Z i) X hZi.1 hZi.2 hy]
  exact pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_integral_eq_sub hy x (D.Z i) X

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.indicator_kernel_deriv_term_intervalIntegrable
statement:
lemma indicator_kernel_deriv_term_intervalIntegrable
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) (i : ℕ)
    (hy : 0 < y) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u : ℝ =>
        (D.mult i : ℝ) * (if D.Z i ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      MeasureTheory.volume T X
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_eq :
      (fun u : ℝ =>
        (D.mult i : ℝ) * (if D.Z i ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      = Set.indicator (Set.Ici (D.Z i))
          (fun u : ℝ => (D.mult i : ℝ) * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u) := by
    funext u
    by_cases h : D.Z i ≤ u
    · have hmem : u ∈ Set.Ici (D.Z i) := h
      rw [if_pos h, mul_one, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
    · have hnmem : u ∉ Set.Ici (D.Z i) := h
      rw [if_neg h, mul_zero, zero_mul, Set.indicator_of_notMem hnmem]
  rw [h_eq]
  
  
  have h_const_mul : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u : ℝ => (D.mult i : ℝ) * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      MeasureTheory.volume T X :=
    (pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable hy x T X).const_mul (D.mult i : ℝ)
  exact ⟨h_const_mul.1.indicator measurableSet_Ici,
         h_const_mul.2.indicator measurableSet_Ici⟩

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.integralSumLinearity_of_orderedWindow
statement:
theorem integralSumLinearity_of_orderedWindow
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ)
    (hy : 0 < y) :
    IntegralSumLinearityHypothesis D x y T X
proof:
:= by
  unfold IntegralSumLinearityHypothesis
  
  have h_distrib : ∀ u : ℝ,
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D.n,
        (D.mult i : ℝ) * (if D.Z i ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
        * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
      =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range D.n,
        (D.mult i : ℝ) * (if D.Z i ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u := by
    intro u
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  
  have h_rewrite :
      (∫ u in T..X,
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D.n,
          (D.mult i : ℝ) * (if D.Z i ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      =
      ∫ u in T..X,
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range D.n,
          (D.mult i : ℝ) * (if D.Z i ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
            * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr ?_
    intro u _
    exact h_distrib u
  rw [h_rewrite]
  
  have h_int : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range D.n,
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u : ℝ =>
          (D.mult i : ℝ) * (if D.Z i ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
            * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
        MeasureTheory.volume T X :=
    fun i _ => indicator_kernel_deriv_term_intervalIntegrable D x y T X i hy
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum h_int]
  
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have h_term :
      (fun u : ℝ =>
        (D.mult i : ℝ) * (if D.Z i ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      = (fun u : ℝ =>
          (D.mult i : ℝ) *
            ((if D.Z i ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)) := by
    funext u; ring
  rw [h_term, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discrete_corrected_remainder_eq_intervalIntegral_of_orderedWindow
statement:
theorem discrete_corrected_remainder_eq_intervalIntegral_of_orderedWindow
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m) (hy : 0 < y) :
    discreteKernelAbelRemainder D x y T X m
      + discreteAbelEndpointCorrection D.toFluctuationMeasureData
          (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernel x y u) T X m
      =
    ∫ u in T..X,
      discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T u
        * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
proof:
:=
  discrete_corrected_remainder_eq_intervalIntegral D x y T X W
    (nDecompositionIntegrand_of_orderedWindow D x y T X W)
    (integralSumLinearity_of_orderedWindow D x y T X hy)
    (indicatorKernelFTC_of_orderedWindow D x y T X W hy)

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.discreteCountingPrimitive_mul_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable
statement:
lemma discreteCountingPrimitive_mul_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m) (hy : 0 < y) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u => discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T u
                  * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      MeasureTheory.volume T X
proof:
:= by
  have h_sum_fun_int :
      IntervalIntegrable
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D.n, discreteKernelDerivIndicatorTerm D x y i)
        MeasureTheory.volume T X :=
    IntervalIntegrable.sum (Finset.range D.n) (by
      intro i _
      unfold discreteKernelDerivIndicatorTerm
      exact indicator_kernel_deriv_term_intervalIntegrable D x y T X i hy)
  refine h_sum_fun_int.congr ?_
  intro u _hu
  
  
  
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D.n, discreteKernelDerivIndicatorTerm D x y i) u
        =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range D.n,
        (D.mult i : ℝ) * (if D.Z i ≤ u then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_apply, discreteKernelDerivIndicatorTerm]
    _ =
      discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T u
        * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u := by
          symm
          rw [discreteCountingPrimitive_eq_indicator_sum_of_orderedWindow D T X u W,
              Finset.sum_mul]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.smoothCountingPrimitive_mul_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable
statement:
lemma smoothCountingPrimitive_mul_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable
    {T X : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (hTX : T ≤ X) (x : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u => smoothCountingPrimitive T u
                  * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      MeasureTheory.volume T X
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_S_cont : ContinuousOn (fun u => smoothCountingPrimitive T u)
      (Set.Icc T X) := by
    intro u hu
    have h_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v => smoothCountingPrimitive T v) u :=
      (smoothCountingPrimitive_hasDerivAt hT hu.1).differentiableAt
    exact h_diff.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have h_k_cont : ContinuousOn (fun u => pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      (Set.Icc T X) :=
    (pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv_continuous hy x).continuousOn
  have h_prod_cont : ContinuousOn
      (fun u => smoothCountingPrimitive T u
                  * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      (Set.Icc T X) :=
    h_S_cont.mul h_k_cont
  exact ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hTX h_prod_cont

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationDerivativeIntegral_expand
statement:
lemma finiteFluctuationDerivativeIntegral_expand
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m) (hT : 0 < T) (hTX : T ≤ X) (hy : 0 < y) :
    finiteFluctuationDerivativeIntegral D x y T X
      =
    (∫ u in T..X,
      discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T u
        * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      -
    ∫ u in T..X,
      smoothCountingPrimitive T u
        * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteFluctuationDerivativeIntegral finiteFluctuationPrimitive
  have h_pointwise : ∀ u : ℝ,
      (discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T u
        - smoothCountingPrimitive T u) * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
      =
      discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T u
        * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
      - smoothCountingPrimitive T u * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u := by
    intro u; ring
  rw [show (fun u : ℝ =>
        (discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T u
          - smoothCountingPrimitive T u) * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      = (fun u : ℝ =>
        discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T u
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
        - smoothCountingPrimitive T u * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      from funext h_pointwise]
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_sub
    (discreteCountingPrimitive_mul_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable D x y T X W hy)
    (smoothCountingPrimitive_mul_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable hT hTX x hy)

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationKernelPartial_true_ibp
statement:
theorem finiteFluctuationKernelPartial_true_ibp
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (x y T X : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (W : OrderedWindow D T X m)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hTX : T ≤ X) (hy : 0 < y) :
    finiteFluctuationKernelPartial D x y T X
      =
    pairedCauchyImKernel x y X * finiteFluctuationPrimitive D T X
      -
    finiteFluctuationDerivativeIntegral D x y T X
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [finiteFluctuationKernelPartial_endpoint_corrected_ibp
        D x y T X W.hn hT hTX hy]
  
  unfold finiteFluctuationRawRemainder finiteFluctuationEndpointCorrection
        discreteKernelEndpointCorrection discreteAbelEndpointCorrection
  
  have h_bridge :=
    discrete_corrected_remainder_eq_intervalIntegral_of_orderedWindow D x y T X W hy
  
  have h_expand :=
    finiteFluctuationDerivativeIntegral_expand D x y T X W hT hTX hy
  
  set N := discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T X with hN
  set ffP := finiteFluctuationPrimitive D T X with hffP
  set kX := pairedCauchyImKernel x y X with hkX
  set ffDI := finiteFluctuationDerivativeIntegral D x y T X with hffDI
  set R := discreteKernelAbelRemainder D x y T X m with hR
  set SI := ∫ u in T..X,
              smoothCountingPrimitive T u * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
    with hSI
  set NI := ∫ u in T..X,
              discreteCountingPrimitive D.toFluctuationMeasureData T u
                * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
    with hNI
  
  
  
  unfold discreteAbelEndpointCorrection at h_bridge
  change ffP * kX - (R - SI) - N * (kX - pairedCauchyImKernel x y (D.Z m))
       = kX * ffP - ffDI
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive_left_zero_of_no_atom
statement:
lemma finiteFluctuationPrimitive_left_zero_of_no_atom
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T : ℝ)
    (hnoT : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range D.n, D.Z j ≠ T) :
    finiteFluctuationPrimitive D T T = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteFluctuationPrimitive
  rw [discreteCountingPrimitive_left_zero_of_no_atom D.toFluctuationMeasureData T hnoT,
      smoothCountingPrimitive_self]
  ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.orderedWindow_eventually_atTop
statement:
lemma orderedWindow_eventually_atTop
    (D : OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T : ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (Wtail : OrderedTailWindowData D T m) :
    ∀ᶠ X in Filter.atTop, OrderedWindow D T X m
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (D.Z m)] with X hXm
  exact
    { hn := Wtail.hn
      hT_le_first := Wtail.hT_le_first
      hlast_le_X := hXm
      hstrict := Wtail.hstrict }

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.tailGap_pos_of_abs_lt
statement:
lemma tailGap_pos_of_abs_lt (x X : ℝ) (hX : |x| < X) :
    0 < X - |x|
proof: := by linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.tailGap_sq_pos_of_abs_lt
statement:
lemma tailGap_sq_pos_of_abs_lt (x X : ℝ) (hX : |x| < X) :
    0 < (X - |x|)^2
proof:
:= by
  have h : 0 < X - |x| := tailGap_pos_of_abs_lt x X hX
  positivity

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.tailGap_sq_le_sub_sq
statement:
lemma tailGap_sq_le_sub_sq (x X : ℝ) (hX : |x| < X) :
    (X - |x|)^2 ≤ (X - x)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hX_pos : 0 < X := lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg x) hX
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg hx]
  · have hxle : x ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hx
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hxle]
    
    have hXx_nonpos : X * x ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hX_pos.le hxle
    nlinarith [hXx_nonpos]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.tailGap_sq_le_add_sq
statement:
lemma tailGap_sq_le_add_sq (x X : ℝ) (hX : |x| < X) :
    (X - |x|)^2 ≤ (X + x)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hX_pos : 0 < X := lt_of_le_of_lt (abs_nonneg x) hX
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg hx]
    
    have hXx_nonneg : 0 ≤ X * x := mul_nonneg hX_pos.le hx
    nlinarith [hXx_nonneg]
  · have hxle : x ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hx
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hxle, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.tailGap_sq_le_sub_den
statement:
lemma tailGap_sq_le_sub_den (x y X : ℝ) (hX : |x| < X) :
    (X - |x|)^2 ≤ (X - x)^2 + y^2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := tailGap_sq_le_sub_sq x X hX
  have h2 : 0 ≤ y^2 := sq_nonneg y
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.tailGap_sq_le_add_den
statement:
lemma tailGap_sq_le_add_den (x y X : ℝ) (hX : |x| < X) :
    (X - |x|)^2 ≤ (X + x)^2 + y^2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := tailGap_sq_le_add_sq x X hX
  have h2 : 0 ≤ y^2 := sq_nonneg y
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.cauchy_sub_term_le_tail
statement:
lemma cauchy_sub_term_le_tail
    (x y X : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hX : |x| < X) :
    y / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) ≤ y / (X - |x|)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hsq_eq : (x - X)^2 = (X - x)^2 := by ring
  rw [hsq_eq]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hy
    (tailGap_sq_pos_of_abs_lt x X hX) (tailGap_sq_le_sub_den x y X hX)

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.cauchy_add_term_le_tail
statement:
lemma cauchy_add_term_le_tail
    (x y X : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hX : |x| < X) :
    y / ((x + X)^2 + y^2) ≤ y / (X - |x|)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hsq_eq : (x + X)^2 = (X + x)^2 := by ring
  rw [hsq_eq]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hy
    (tailGap_sq_pos_of_abs_lt x X hX) (tailGap_sq_le_add_den x y X hX)

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.reciprocal_quadratic_nonneg
statement:
lemma reciprocal_quadratic_nonneg (x X y : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ 1 / ((x - X)^2 + y^2)
proof: := by positivity

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.reciprocal_quadratic_sum_nonneg
statement:
lemma reciprocal_quadratic_sum_nonneg (x X y : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ 1 / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + X)^2 + y^2)
proof: := by positivity

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.abs_pairedCauchyImKernel_le_quadratic_tail
statement:
theorem abs_pairedCauchyImKernel_le_quadratic_tail
    (x y X : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hX : |x| < X) :
    |pairedCauchyImKernel x y X|
      ≤ 2 * y / (X - |x|)^2
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairedCauchyImKernel
  
  have h_neg_form :
      -y * (1 / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + X)^2 + y^2))
      = -(y * (1 / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + X)^2 + y^2))) := by ring
  rw [h_neg_form, abs_neg]
  
  have h_sum_nn : 0 ≤ 1 / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + X)^2 + y^2) :=
    reciprocal_quadratic_sum_nonneg x X y
  have h_prod_nn : 0 ≤ y * (1 / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + X)^2 + y^2)) :=
    mul_nonneg hy h_sum_nn
  rw [abs_of_nonneg h_prod_nn]
  
  have h_distrib :
      y * (1 / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + 1 / ((x + X)^2 + y^2))
      = y / ((x - X)^2 + y^2) + y / ((x + X)^2 + y^2) := by
    rw [mul_add, mul_one_div, mul_one_div]
  rw [h_distrib]
  have h_sub := cauchy_sub_term_le_tail x y X hy hX
  have h_add := cauchy_add_term_le_tail x y X hy hX
  have h_double : y / (X - |x|)^2 + y / (X - |x|)^2
                = 2 * y / (X - |x|)^2 := by ring
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.eventually_abs_lt_atTop
statement:
lemma eventually_abs_lt_atTop (x : ℝ) :
    ∀ᶠ X : ℝ in Filter.atTop, |x| < X

:=

name: OverflowResidueRH.Phase1IBP.eventually_two_abs_le_atTop
statement:

    ∀ᶠ X : ℝ in Filter.atTop, 2 * |x| ≤ X
proof:
:=
