name: OverflowResidueRH.finiteFluctuationPrimitive_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable_generic
statement:
theorem finiteFluctuationPrimitive_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable_generic
    (Dzero : Phase1IBP.OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T0 T X x y : ℝ)
    (hT0_pos : 0 < T0)
    (hT0_le_T : T0 ≤ T)
    (hTX : T ≤ X)
    (hy : 0 < y) :
    IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u =>
        Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u *
          pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      MeasureTheory.volume T X
proof:
:= by
  have hN : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u =>
        Phase1IBP.discreteCountingPrimitive Dzero.toFluctuationMeasureData T0 u
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      MeasureTheory.volume T X :=
    discreteCountingPrimitive_mul_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable_anyWindow
      Dzero x y T0 T X hy
  have hT0_le_X : T0 ≤ X := le_trans hT0_le_T hTX
  have hS_big : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u =>
        Phase1IBP.smoothCountingPrimitive T0 u
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      MeasureTheory.volume T0 X :=
    Phase1IBP.smoothCountingPrimitive_mul_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable
      hT0_pos hT0_le_X x hy
  have hS : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun u =>
        Phase1IBP.smoothCountingPrimitive T0 u
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      MeasureTheory.volume T X := by
    refine hS_big.mono_set ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hTX, Set.uIcc_of_le hT0_le_X]
    exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc_left hT0_le_T
  have hfunc_eq :
      (fun u =>
        Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u
          * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u)
      = (fun u =>
          Phase1IBP.discreteCountingPrimitive Dzero.toFluctuationMeasureData T0 u
            * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u
          - Phase1IBP.smoothCountingPrimitive T0 u
            * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv x y u) := by
    funext u
    unfold Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive
    ring
  rw [hfunc_eq]
  exact hN.sub hS

name: OverflowResidueRH.trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope_im_tendsto_realPartial
statement:
theorem trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope_im_tendsto_realPartial
    (Dzero : Phase1IBP.OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T0 : ℝ)
    (hT0_pos : 0 < T0)
    {C D T : ℝ} {z : ℂ}
    (hT0_le_T : T0 ≤ T) (hTpos : 0 < T) (hy : 0 < z.im)
    (hSlogEnv :
      ∀ᶠ u in Filter.atTop,
        |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u|
          ≤ C * Real.log u + D) :
    Tendsto
      (fun X : ℝ =>
        Phase1IBP.derivativeSidePartial
          (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u)
          z.re z.im T X)
      Filter.atTop
      (𝓝 (trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope
        Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_T hTpos hy hSlogEnv).im)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomplex := trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope_tendsto
    Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_T hTpos hy hSlogEnv
  have him_complex :
      Tendsto
        (fun X : ℝ =>
          (complexDensityTailPartial pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue
            (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u)
            T X z).im)
        Filter.atTop
        (𝓝 (trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope
          Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_T hTpos hy hSlogEnv).im) :=
    (Complex.continuous_im.tendsto _).comp hcomplex
  have htrue_int : ∀ X, T ≤ X →
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u => pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue u z *
          ((Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u : ℝ) : ℂ))
        MeasureTheory.volume T X := by
    intro X hTX
    exact finiteFluctuationPrimitive_trueKernel_intervalIntegrable
      Dzero T0 T X z hT0_pos hT0_le_T hTX (ne_of_gt hy)
  have hreal_int : ∀ X, T ≤ X →
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u =>
          Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u
            * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv z.re z.im u)
        MeasureTheory.volume T X := by
    intro X hTX
    exact finiteFluctuationPrimitive_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable_generic
      Dzero T0 T X z.re z.im hT0_pos hT0_le_T hTX hy
  have hwrap_int : ∀ X, T ≤ X →
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u => pairedCauchyComplexKernelDeriv u z *
          ((Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u : ℝ) : ℂ))
        MeasureTheory.volume T X := by
    intro X hTX
    have hz : upperHalfPoint z.re z.im = z := upperHalfPoint_re_im z
    have hwrap := wrapKernel_intervalIntegrable_of_real_derivative_integrable
      (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u)
      z.re z.im T X (hreal_int X hTX)
    rw [hz] at hwrap
    exact hwrap
  have him_eq := trueKernel_im_eq_realPartial_eventually
    (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u)
    T z htrue_int hwrap_int
  exact him_complex.congr' him_eq

name: OverflowResidueRH.trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope_im_bound
statement:
theorem trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope_im_bound
    (Dzero : Phase1IBP.OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T0 : ℝ)
    (hT0_pos : 0 < T0)
    {C D T : ℝ} {z : ℂ}
    (hT0_le_T : T0 ≤ T)
    (hTpos : 0 < T)
    (hT_ge_one : 1 ≤ T)
    (hy : 0 < z.im)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hregime : 2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T)
    (hS_T :
      ∀ u, T ≤ u →
        |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u|
          ≤ C * Real.log u + D) :
    |(trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope
      Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_T hTpos hy
      (by
        filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop T] with u hu
        exact hS_T u hu)).im|
      ≤ closedFormSErrorBoundCD C D z.im T
proof:
:= by
  have hSlogEnv : ∀ᶠ u in Filter.atTop,
      |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u|
        ≤ C * Real.log u + D := by
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop T] with u hu
    exact hS_T u hu
  have hJ := trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope_im_tendsto_realPartial
    Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_T hTpos hy hSlogEnv
  have hInt :
      ∀ X, T ≤ X →
        IntervalIntegrable
          (fun u =>
            Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u
              * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv z.re z.im u)
          MeasureTheory.volume T X := by
    intro X hTX
    exact finiteFluctuationPrimitive_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable_generic
      Dzero T0 T X z.re z.im hT0_pos hT0_le_T hTX hy
  have hmajor :
      |(trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope
        Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_T hTpos hy hSlogEnv).im|
        ≤ -Phase1IBP.derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive z.im C D T :=
    Phase1IBP.derivative_integral_limit_abs_le_majorant_tail
      (S := fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u)
      (C := C) (D := D) (x := z.re) (y := z.im) (T := T)
      hy hTpos hC hD hregime hS_T hInt hJ
  exact le_trans hmajor
    (neg_derivativeSideMajorantPrimitive_le_closedFormSErrorBoundCD
      C D z.im T hC hD hT_ge_one (le_of_lt hy))

name: OverflowResidueRH.highTErrorControlled_of_highTuringLogEnvelope
statement:
theorem highTErrorControlled_of_highTuringLogEnvelope
    (Dzero : Phase1IBP.OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T0 : ℝ)
    (hT0_pos : 0 < T0) (hT0_le_140 : T0 ≤ 140)
    (error : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hHighLog :
      ∀ {z : ℂ} {T u : ℝ},
        140 ≤ T → 0 < z.im →
        2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T →
        T ≤ u →
        |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u|
          ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log u + (49 / 20 : ℝ))
    (herror_high :
      ∀ {z : ℂ} {T : ℝ}
        (hT140 : 140 ≤ T) (hy : 0 < z.im)
        (hregime : 2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T),
        (error z).im =
          (trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope
            Dzero T0 hT0_pos
            (le_trans hT0_le_140 hT140)
            (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < T)
            hy
            (by
              filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop T] with u hu
              exact hHighLog hT140 hy hregime hu)).im) :
    highTErrorControlled error
proof:
:= by
  intro z T hT140 hy hregime
  rw [herror_high hT140 hy hregime]
  unfold highTClosedFormBound
  exact trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope_im_bound
    Dzero T0 hT0_pos
    (le_trans hT0_le_140 hT140)
    (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < T)
    (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ T)
    hy
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 49 / 20)
    hregime
    (fun u hu => hHighLog hT140 hy hregime hu)

name: OverflowResidueRH.trueKernelAdaptiveTail_im_bound
statement:
theorem trueKernelAdaptiveTail_im_bound
    (Dzero : Phase1IBP.OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T0 : ℝ)
    (hT0_pos : 0 < T0) (hT0_le_10 : T0 ≤ 10)
    (hTuring :

        T ≤ u →
        |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u|
          ≤ (slabCD T).1 * Real.log u + (slabCD T).2)
    {z : ℂ} {T : ℝ}
    (h10 : 10 ≤ T) (h140 : T ≤ 140) (hy : 0 < z.im)
    (hregime : 2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T) :
    |(trueKernelAdaptiveTail Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_10 hTuring T z).im|
      ≤ closedFormSErrorBoundCD (slabCD T).1 (slabCD T).2 z.im T
proof:
:= by
  have hT_pos : (0 : ℝ) < T := by linarith
  have hT_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ T := by linarith
  have hT0_le_T : T0 ≤ T := le_trans hT0_le_10 h10
  have hS_T : ∀ u, T ≤ u →
      |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u|
        ≤ (slabCD T).1 * Real.log u + (slabCD T).2 :=
    fun u hu => hTuring h10 h140 hy hregime hu
  have hSlogEnv : ∀ᶠ u in Filter.atTop,
      |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u|
        ≤ (slabCD T).1 * Real.log u + (slabCD T).2 := by
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop T] with u hu
    exact hS_T u hu
  have h1 := trueKernelAdaptiveTail_tendsto
    Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_10 hTuring h10 h140 hy hregime
  have h2 := trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope_tendsto
    Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_T hT_pos hy hSlogEnv
  have h_eq : trueKernelAdaptiveTail Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_10 hTuring T z
            = trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope
                Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_T hT_pos hy hSlogEnv :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2
  rw [h_eq]
  have hC : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (slabCD T).1 := by
    unfold slabCD
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (slabCD T).2 := by
    unfold slabCD
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  exact trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope_im_bound
    Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_T hT_pos hT_ge_one hy hC hD hregime hS_T

name: OverflowResidueRH.zeroDensitySmoothTailModel_neg_im_tendsto_real_integral
statement:
theorem zeroDensitySmoothTailModel_neg_im_tendsto_real_integral
    (Tsmooth : ℝ) (hTsmooth_ge : 2 * Real.pi ≤ Tsmooth)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.im) :
    Tendsto
      (fun X : ℝ =>
        ∫ u in Tsmooth..X,
          zeroDensityRho u *
            (z.im *
              (1 / ((z.re - u)^2 + z.im^2) +
               1 / ((z.re + u)^2 + z.im^2))))
      Filter.atTop
      (𝓝 (-(zeroDensitySmoothTailModel Tsmooth hTsmooth_ge z).im))
proof:
:= by
  have hTpos : 0 < Tsmooth := by
    have hpi : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpi hTsmooth_ge
  have hcomplex :=
    zeroDensitySmoothTailModel_tendsto_complex Tsmooth hTsmooth_ge hz
  have him :
      Tendsto
        (fun X : ℝ =>
          -(smoothDensityTailModelPartial zeroDensityRho Tsmooth X z).im)
        Filter.atTop
        (𝓝 (-(zeroDensitySmoothTailModel Tsmooth hTsmooth_ge z).im)) :=
    (continuous_neg.tendsto _).comp
      ((Complex.continuous_im.tendsto _).comp hcomplex)
  refine him.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop Tsmooth] with X hTX
  exact smoothDensityTailModelPartial_neg_im_eq_real_integral
    zeroDensityRho Tsmooth X
    (zeroDensityRho_pairedCauchyKernel_intervalIntegrable_UHP
      Tsmooth X hTpos hTX hz)

name: OverflowResidueRH.constDensity_positiveSmoothKernel_tail_tendsto
statement:
theorem constDensity_positiveSmoothKernel_tail_tendsto
    (x T : ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) :
    Tendsto
      (fun X : ℝ =>
        zeroDensityRho T *
          ∫ u in T..X, positiveSmoothKernel x y u)
      Filter.atTop
      (𝓝 (zeroDensityRho T *
        ((Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T - x) / y))
          + (Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T - (-x)) / y)))))
proof:
:=
  tendsto_const_nhds.mul
    (positiveSmoothKernel_tail_integral_tendsto x T hy)

name: OverflowResidueRH.zeroDensity_realIntegral_mono_lower_limit
statement:
lemma zeroDensity_realIntegral_mono_lower_limit
    {x y T X : ℝ}
    (hT : 2 * Real.pi ≤ T)
    (hTX : T ≤ X)
    (hy : 0 < y) :
    (∫ u in T..X, zeroDensityRho u * positiveSmoothKernel x y u)
      ≤ ∫ u in (2 * Real.pi)..X,
          zeroDensityRho u * positiveSmoothKernel x y u
proof:
:= by
  have h2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have hy_ne : y ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hy
  have h_int_left :=
    zeroDensity_mul_positiveSmoothKernel_intervalIntegrable
      (x := x) (y := y) h2pi_pos hT hy_ne
  have h_int_right :=
    zeroDensity_mul_positiveSmoothKernel_intervalIntegrable
      (x := x) (y := y) (lt_of_lt_of_le h2pi_pos hT) hTX hy_ne
  have hadd := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
    h_int_left h_int_right
  have h_nn :
      0 ≤ ∫ u in (2 * Real.pi)..T,
            zeroDensityRho u * positiveSmoothKernel x y u := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hT
    intro u hu
    exact zeroDensity_mul_positiveSmoothKernel_nonneg hu.1 hy
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.constDensity_arctanTail_le_zeroDensitySmoothTail_neg_im
statement:
theorem constDensity_arctanTail_le_zeroDensitySmoothTail_neg_im
    {z : ℂ} {T : ℝ}
    (hT : 2 * Real.pi ≤ T)
    (hy : 0 < z.im) :
    zeroDensityRho T *
      ((Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T - z.re) / z.im))
        + (Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T - (-z.re)) / z.im)))
      ≤ -(zeroDensitySmoothTailModel (2 * Real.pi) le_rfl z).im
proof:
:= by
  have hy_ne : z.im ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hy
  
  have h_lhs := constDensity_positiveSmoothKernel_tail_tendsto z.re T hy
  
  have h_rhs_raw :=
    zeroDensitySmoothTailModel_neg_im_tendsto_real_integral
      (2 * Real.pi) le_rfl hy
  have h_rhs : Tendsto
      (fun X : ℝ =>
        ∫ u in (2 * Real.pi)..X,
          zeroDensityRho u * positiveSmoothKernel z.re z.im u)
      Filter.atTop
      (𝓝 (-(zeroDensitySmoothTailModel (2 * Real.pi) le_rfl z).im)) := by
    refine h_rhs_raw.congr' ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun X => ?_)
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro u _
    change zeroDensityRho u
            * (z.im * (1 / ((z.re - u) ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2)
                + 1 / ((z.re + u) ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2)))
          = zeroDensityRho u * positiveSmoothKernel z.re z.im u
    unfold positiveSmoothKernel
    ring
  
  have h_ev :
      ∀ᶠ X : ℝ in Filter.atTop,
        zeroDensityRho T *
            (∫ u in T..X, positiveSmoothKernel z.re z.im u)
          ≤ ∫ u in (2 * Real.pi)..X,
              zeroDensityRho u * positiveSmoothKernel z.re z.im u := by
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop T] with X hTX
    have h_kInt :=
      positiveSmoothKernel_intervalIntegrable (x := z.re) (y := z.im) hy_ne T X
    have h_rInt :=
      zeroDensity_mul_positiveSmoothKernel_intervalIntegrable
        (x := z.re) (y := z.im)
        (lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi) hT)
        hTX hy_ne
    have h_step1 :
        zeroDensityRho T *
            (∫ u in T..X, positiveSmoothKernel z.re z.im u)
          ≤ ∫ u in T..X,
              zeroDensityRho u * positiveSmoothKernel z.re z.im u :=
      zeroDensity_realIntegral_ge_constDensity_finite
        (x := z.re) (y := z.im) hT hTX hy h_kInt h_rInt
    have h_step2 :=
      zeroDensity_realIntegral_mono_lower_limit
        (x := z.re) (y := z.im) hT hTX hy
    linarith
  
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_frequently h_lhs h_rhs h_ev.frequently

name: OverflowResidueRH.HonestSmoothTailRationalLB_twoPi
statement:
theorem HonestSmoothTailRationalLB_twoPi :
    HonestSmoothTailRationalLB (2 * Real.pi) le_rfl
proof:
:= by
  intro z T hT hy hregime
  
  have habs_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ |z.re| := abs_nonneg _
  have hminus : 0 < T - |z.re| := by
    have hy_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z.im := le_of_lt hy
    nlinarith
  have hplus : 0 < T + |z.re| := by
    have h_pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
    have : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    linarith
  
  have h_unfold :
      smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs z.re z.im T
        = zeroDensityRho T *
          (z.im * (T - |z.re|) / ((T - |z.re|) ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2)
            + z.im * (T + |z.re|) / ((T + |z.re|) ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2)) := rfl
  rw [h_unfold]
  
  have h_paired := paired_arctan_tail_lower_rational
    (x := z.re) (y := z.im) (T := T) hy hminus hplus
  have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ zeroDensityRho T :=
    zeroDensityRho_nonneg_of_ge_two_pi hT
  have h_chain1 :
      zeroDensityRho T *
          (z.im * (T - |z.re|) / ((T - |z.re|) ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2)
            + z.im * (T + |z.re|) / ((T + |z.re|) ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2))
        ≤ zeroDensityRho T *
          ((Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T - z.re) / z.im))
            + (Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T + z.re) / z.im))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_paired hρ_nn
  
  have h_chain2 :
      zeroDensityRho T *
          ((Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T - z.re) / z.im))
            + (Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan ((T - (-z.re)) / z.im)))
        ≤ -(zeroDensitySmoothTailModel (2 * Real.pi) le_rfl z).im :=
    constDensity_arctanTail_le_zeroDensitySmoothTail_neg_im hT hy
  
  have hT_neg_re : T - (-z.re) = T + z.re := by ring
  rw [hT_neg_re] at h_chain2
  linarith

name: OverflowResidueRH.XiPullbackAntiHerglotzTarget_of_twoPiModel
statement:
theorem XiPullbackAntiHerglotzTarget_of_twoPiModel
    (Dzero : Phase1IBP.OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T0 : ℝ)
    (hT0_pos : 0 < T0) (hT0_le_10 : T0 ≤ 10)
    (hTuring :
      ∀ {z : ℂ} {T u : ℝ},
        10 ≤ T → T ≤ 140 → 0 < z.im →
        2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T →
        T ≤ u →
        |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u|
          ≤ (slabCD T).1 * Real.log u + (slabCD T).2)
    (hHighLog :
      ∀ {z : ℂ} {T u : ℝ},
        140 ≤ T → 0 < z.im →
        2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T →
        T ≤ u →
        |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u|
          ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log u + (49 / 20 : ℝ))
    (Rcanon : XiResidualCanonicalFormulaData
      Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_10 hTuring honestZeroDensityModelTwoPi)
    (Rhigh : XiHighResidualFormulaData
      Dzero T0 hT0_pos
      (le_trans hT0_le_10 (by norm_num : (10 : ℝ) ≤ 140))
      honestZeroDensityModelTwoPi hHighLog)
    (Hlow : XiLowResidualMargin honestZeroDensityModelTwoPi) :
    XiPullbackAntiHerglotzTarget
proof:
:=
  XiPullbackAntiHerglotzTarget_of_honestZeroDensity
    Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_10 hTuring hHighLog
    (2 * Real.pi) le_rfl
    HonestSmoothTailRationalLB_twoPi
    Rcanon Rhigh Hlow

name: OverflowResidueRH.lowFirstZeroBoundaryTerm_abs_le
statement:
theorem lowFirstZeroBoundaryTerm_abs_le
    {Dzero : Phase1IBP.OrderedFluctuationMeasureData} {T0 x y T D : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 ≤ y)
    (h_reg : 2 * (1 + |x| + y) ≤ T)
    (hS_T : |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 T| ≤ D) :
    |lowFirstZeroBoundaryTerm Dzero T0 x y T| ≤ 8 * y * D / T ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowFirstZeroBoundaryTerm
  have hx_nn : 0 ≤ |x| := abs_nonneg x
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have h_T_sq_pos : 0 < T ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h_k_bnd : |pairedCauchyImKernel x y T| ≤ 8 * y / T ^ 2 :=
    abs_pairedCauchyImKernel_adaptive_8 hy h_reg
  have h_k_nn : 0 ≤ 8 * y / T ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h_D_nn : 0 ≤ D := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hS_T
  rw [abs_mul]
  calc |pairedCauchyImKernel x y T|
        * |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 T|
      ≤ (8 * y / T ^ 2) * D :=
        mul_le_mul h_k_bnd hS_T (abs_nonneg _) h_k_nn
    _ = 8 * y * D / T ^ 2 := by ring

    (Dzero : Phase1IBP.OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T0 : ℝ)
    (hT0_pos : 0 < T0) (hT0_le_140 : T0 ≤ 140)
    (error : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hHighLog :
      ∀ {z : ℂ} {T u : ℝ},
        140 ≤ T → 0 < z.im →
        2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T →
        T ≤ u →
        |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u|
          ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log u + (49 / 20 : ℝ))
    (herror_high :
      ∀ {z : ℂ} {T : ℝ}
        (hT140 : 140 ≤ T) (hy : 0 < z.im)
        (hregime : 2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T),
        XiPullback z ≠ 0 →
        (error z).im =
          (trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope
            Dzero T0 hT0_pos
            (le_trans hT0_le_140 hT140)
            (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < T)

              exact hHighLog hT140 hy hregime hu)).im) :

  rw [show |(error z).im| = |(error z).im| from rfl]
  have h_id := herror_high hT140 hy hregime hne

  unfold highTClosedFormBound
  exact trueKernelTailOfLogEnvelope_im_bound
    Dzero T0 hT0_pos

    XiPullbackAntiHerglotzTarget

:= by
  have hmodelAnti :=
    hmodelAnti_of_honestZeroDensityModel us Tsmooth hTsmooth_ge HModel
  let mid : LocalXiCloudDensityErrorPackage :=
    midLocalPackage_of_canonicalResidualFormulaAwayFromZeros
      Dzero T0 hT0_pos hT0_le_10 hTuring

  refine XiCloudDensityCoveringFamily.implies_XiPullbackAntiHerglotzTarget
    { package := fun n =>

      ∃ T : ℝ, 10 ≤ T ∧ T ≤ 140 ∧ 2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T

    change mid.region z
    exact hmid
  · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    change high.region z
    exact hmid

name: OverflowResidueRH.XiResidualLowIBPRepresentationAt_11_14_half_of_finiteIBP
statement:
theorem XiResidualLowIBPRepresentationAt_11_14_half_of_finiteIBP
    (Dzero : Phase1IBP.OrderedFluctuationMeasureData) (T0 : ℝ)
    (Hdom : XiLowResidualFiniteIBPDomination Dzero T0 honestZeroDensityModelTwoPi)
    (Hgap : FirstZeroGapForDzero Dzero T0 14)
    (Hint : ∀ z : ℂ, lowCompactRegion z →
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u => |lowFirstZeroIBPIntegrand Dzero T0 z.re z.im u|)
        MeasureTheory.volume 11 14) :
    XiResidualLowIBPRepresentationAt 11 14 (1 / 2)
      honestZeroDensityModelTwoPi
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hy : 0 < z.im := hz.1
  have hregime10 : 2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ 10 := hz.2
  have hregime11 : 2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ 11 := by linarith
  have hS : ∀ u : ℝ, 11 ≤ u → u ≤ 14 →
      |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    fun u hu11 hu14 =>
      finiteFluctuation_abs_le_half_on_11_14 Hgap hu11 hu14
  have hS11 : |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 11| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    hS 11 le_rfl (by norm_num)
  have hbdy : |lowFirstZeroBoundaryTerm Dzero T0 z.re z.im 11|
              ≤ 8 * z.im * (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (11 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    lowFirstZeroBoundaryTerm_abs_le hy.le hregime11 hS11
  have hderiv : |lowFirstZeroDerivativeSide Dzero T0 z.re z.im 11 14|
              ≤ 9 * z.im * (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (11 : ℝ) ^ 2
                - 9 * z.im * (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (14 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    lowFirstZeroDerivativeSide_abs_le_majorant
      Dzero T0 hy hregime11 (by norm_num : (11 : ℝ) ≤ 14)
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) hS (Hint z hz)
  have hsum :
      |lowFirstZeroBoundaryTerm Dzero T0 z.re z.im 11|
        + |lowFirstZeroDerivativeSide Dzero T0 z.re z.im 11 14|
          ≤ closedFormFirstZeroErrorBound z.im 11 14 (1 / 2) :=
    lowFirstZeroIBP_sum_le_closedForm hbdy hderiv
  exact le_trans (Hdom.residual_le_finite_ibp z hz) hsum

      Dzero T0 11 14 z hT0_pos hT0_le_11 h11_le_14 (ne_of_gt hy)
  have hreal :
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u
                    * pairedCauchyImKernelDeriv z.re z.im u)
        MeasureTheory.volume 11 14 :=
    finiteFluctuationPrimitive_kernelDeriv_intervalIntegrable_generic
      Dzero T0 11 14 z.re z.im hT0_pos hT0_le_11 h11_le_14 hy
  have h_deriv_int :
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun u => pairedCauchyComplexKernelDeriv u (upperHalfPoint z.re z.im)
                    * ((Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u : ℝ) : ℂ))
        MeasureTheory.volume 11 14 :=
    wrapKernel_intervalIntegrable_of_real_derivative_integrable
      (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u)
      z.re z.im 11 14 hreal
  have h_im_eq :
      (complexDensityTailPartial pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue
          (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u) 11 14
          (upperHalfPoint z.re z.im)).im
        =
      (complexDensityTailPartial pairedCauchyComplexKernelDeriv
          (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u) 11 14
          (upperHalfPoint z.re z.im)).im :=
    complexDensityTailPartial_im_eq_of_kernelImCompatible
      pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue_imCompatible
      (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u)
      z.re z.im 11 14 h_true_int h_deriv_int
  have h_deriv_eq :
      (complexDensityTailPartial pairedCauchyComplexKernelDeriv
          (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u) 11 14
          (upperHalfPoint z.re z.im)).im
        =
      Phase1IBP.derivativeSidePartial
        (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u)
        z.re z.im 11 14 :=
    complexDensityTailPartial_im_eq_derivativeSidePartial
      (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u)
      z.re z.im 11 14
  calc (complexDensityTailPartial pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue
          (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u) 11 14 z).im
      = (complexDensityTailPartial pairedCauchyComplexKernelTrue
          (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u) 11 14
          (upperHalfPoint z.re z.im)).im := by rw [hzUHP]
    _ = (complexDensityTailPartial pairedCauchyComplexKernelDeriv
          (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u) 11 14
          (upperHalfPoint z.re z.im)).im := h_im_eq
    _ = Phase1IBP.derivativeSidePartial
        (fun u => Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero T0 u)
        z.re z.im 11 14 := h_deriv_eq
    _ = lowFirstZeroDerivativeSide Dzero T0 z.re z.im 11 14 :=
        (lowFirstZeroDerivativeSide_eq_partial Dzero T0 z.re z.im 11 14).symm

    {U : Set ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hU : IsOpen U)

    (hUbound : ∀ s : ℂ, s ∈ U → ‖s‖ ≤ R) :

  exact
    tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct_of_summable_bound
      hU
      hu
      (H.eventually_uniform_factor_sub_one_bound hR hUbound)

name: OverflowResidueRH.deriv_entireRiemannXi_expAffineHadamardQuotient_eq_zero
statement:
theorem deriv_entireRiemannXi_expAffineHadamardQuotient_eq_zero
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    {C a b s : ℂ}
    (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (hxi_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ entireRiemannXi s)
    (hprod_diff :
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) s)
    (hxi_ne : entireRiemannXi s ≠ 0)
    (hprod_ne : infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s ≠ 0)
    (hxi_log :
      logDerivativeResponse entireRiemannXi s
        = b + hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries zeroLoc s)
    (hprod_log :
      logDerivativeResponse (infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc) s
        = hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries zeroLoc s) :
    deriv
        (fun w : ℂ =>
          entireRiemannXi w
            / ((C * Complex.exp (a + b * w))
                * infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc w)) s = 0
proof:
:= by
  let pref : ℂ → ℂ := fun w : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * w)
  let prod : ℂ → ℂ := infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc
  have hpref_diff : DifferentiableAt ℂ pref s := by
    dsimp [pref]
    have h_aff : DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => a + b * w) s :=
      (differentiableAt_const _).add
        ((differentiableAt_const _).mul differentiableAt_fun_id)
    exact (differentiableAt_const _).mul h_aff.cexp
  have hpref_ne : pref s ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [pref]
    exact mul_ne_zero hC (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
  have hden_diff :
      DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => pref w * prod w) s :=
    hpref_diff.mul hprod_diff
  have hden_ne : pref s * prod s ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero hpref_ne hprod_ne
  have hden_log :
      logDerivativeResponse (fun w : ℂ => pref w * prod w) s
        = b + hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries zeroLoc s := by
    rw [logDerivativeResponse_mul_eq_add hpref_diff hprod_diff
        hpref_ne hprod_ne]
    rw [show logDerivativeResponse pref s = b from by
      dsimp [pref]
      exact logDerivativeResponse_exp_affine_prefactor hC]
    rw [show logDerivativeResponse prod s
        = hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries zeroLoc s from by
      simpa [prod] using hprod_log]
  have hlog :
      logDerivativeResponse entireRiemannXi s
        = logDerivativeResponse (fun w : ℂ => pref w * prod w) s := by
    rw [hxi_log, hden_log]
  simpa [pref, prod] using
    deriv_div_eq_zero_of_logDerivativeResponse_eq
      hxi_diff hden_diff hxi_ne hden_ne hlog

name: OverflowResidueRH.quotient_eq_const_on_preconnected_of_deriv_eq_zero
statement:
theorem quotient_eq_const_on_preconnected_of_deriv_eq_zero
    {U : Set ℂ} {q : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hU_open : IsOpen U)
    (hU_pre : IsPreconnected U)
    (hq_diff : DifferentiableOn ℂ q U)
    (hq_deriv : U.EqOn (deriv q) 0)
    {s₀ c : ℂ} (hs₀ : s₀ ∈ U)
    (hbase : q s₀ = c) :
    U.EqOn q (fun _ : ℂ => c)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  have hconst :
      q s₀ = q s :=
    hU_open.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
      hU_pre hq_diff hq_deriv hs₀ hs
  exact hconst.symm.trans hbase

name: OverflowResidueRH.entireRiemannXi_eq_expAffineHadamardProduct_on_preconnected_of_quotient_deriv_zero
statement:
theorem entireRiemannXi_eq_expAffineHadamardProduct_on_preconnected_of_quotient_deriv_zero
    {ι : Type*} {zeroLoc : ι → ℂ}
    {U : Set ℂ} {C a b s₀ : ℂ}
    (hU_open : IsOpen U)
    (hU_pre : IsPreconnected U)
    (hden_ne :
      ∀ s ∈ U,
        (C * Complex.exp (a + b * s))
          * infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s ≠ 0)
    (hq_diff :
      DifferentiableOn ℂ
        (fun s : ℂ =>
          entireRiemannXi s
            / ((C * Complex.exp (a + b * s))
                * infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s)) U)
    (hq_deriv :
      U.EqOn
        (deriv
          (fun s : ℂ =>
            entireRiemannXi s
              / ((C * Complex.exp (a + b * s))
                  * infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s)))
        0)
    (hs₀ : s₀ ∈ U)
    (hbase :
      entireRiemannXi s₀
        / ((C * Complex.exp (a + b * s₀))
            * infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s₀)
        = 1) :
    U.EqOn entireRiemannXi
      (fun s : ℂ =>
        (C * Complex.exp (a + b * s))
          * infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  have hq :
      entireRiemannXi s
        / ((C * Complex.exp (a + b * s))
            * infiniteHadamardProduct zeroLoc s)
        = 1 :=
    quotient_eq_const_on_preconnected_of_deriv_eq_zero
      hU_open hU_pre hq_diff hq_deriv hs₀ hbase (x := s) hs
  rw [div_eq_iff (hden_ne s hs)] at hq
  simpa using hq

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiHadamardFactorization.of_offZeroProductEq
statement:
theorem EntireXiHadamardFactorization.of_offZeroProductEq
    {ι : Type} {HZ : ConcreteEntireXiZeroSystem ι}
    {prefactor : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hprod_zero :
      ∀ i : ι,
        infiniteHadamardProduct HZ.zeroLoc (HZ.zeroLoc i) = 0)
    (hprod_eq :
      ∀ s : ℂ,
        (∀ i : ι, s ≠ HZ.zeroLoc i) →
          entireRiemannXi s
            = prefactor s * infiniteHadamardProduct HZ.zeroLoc s) :
    EntireXiHadamardFactorization HZ prefactor
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro s
  by_cases hhit : ∃ i : ι, HZ.zeroLoc i = s
  · rcases hhit with ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hxi : entireRiemannXi s = 0 := by
      rw [← hi]
      exact HZ.zeroLoc_is_zero i
    have hprod :
        infiniteHadamardProduct HZ.zeroLoc s = 0 := by
      rw [← hi]
      exact hprod_zero i
    simp [hxi, hprod]
  · have hno : ∀ i : ι, s ≠ HZ.zeroLoc i := by
      intro i hsi
      exact hhit ⟨i, hsi.symm⟩
    exact hprod_eq s hno

statement:
theorem entireXiHadamardOffZeroQuotient_iff_offZeroProductEq_invSq
    {ι : Type} {HZ : ConcreteEntireXiZeroSystem ι}
    {prefactor : ℂ → ℂ}
    (Hdist : EntireXiZeroInvSqDistribution HZ) :
    (∀ s : ℂ,
      (∀ i : ι, s ≠ HZ.zeroLoc i) →
        entireRiemannXi s / infiniteHadamardProduct HZ.zeroLoc s
          = prefactor s)
      ↔
    ∀ s : ℂ,
      (∀ i : ι, s ≠ HZ.zeroLoc i) →
        entireRiemannXi s
          = prefactor s * infiniteHadamardProduct HZ.zeroLoc s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hquot s hno
    have hprod_ne :
        infiniteHadamardProduct HZ.zeroLoc s ≠ 0 :=
      Hdist.infiniteProduct_ne_zero hno
    have hq := hquot s hno
    rw [div_eq_iff hprod_ne] at hq
    exact hq
  · intro hprod s hno
    have hprod_ne :
        infiniteHadamardProduct HZ.zeroLoc s ≠ 0 :=
      Hdist.infiniteProduct_ne_zero hno
    rw [hprod s hno]
    field_simp [hprod_ne]

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiClassicalHadamardTheorem.expAffineHadamardPullbackFiniteContribution_eq_prefactor_plus_finiteProductLogDeriv
statement:
theorem EntireXiClassicalHadamardTheorem.expAffineHadamardPullbackFiniteContribution_eq_prefactor_plus_finiteProductLogDeriv
    {ι : Type}
    (H : EntireXiClassicalHadamardTheorem ι)
    (Hbridge : EntireXiToCompletedXiLogDerivBridge)
    {b z : ℂ} (F : Finset ι)
    (hne : XiPullback z ≠ 0) :
    expAffineHadamardPullbackFiniteContribution
        H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc b F z
      =
    Complex.I * b
      + Complex.I *
          logDerivativeResponse
            (fun s' : ℂ =>
              indexedFiniteHadamardProduct H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc F s')
            ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [expAffineHadamardPullbackFiniteContribution_eq_prefactor_plus_finiteRegularizedSum]
  have hs_completed :
      completedXiFunction ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) ≠ 0 := by
    unfold XiPullback at hne
    exact hne
  have hs_entire :
      entireRiemannXi ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) ≠ 0 :=
    Hbridge.entire_nonzero_of_completed_nonzero _ hs_completed
  have hρ :
      ∀ i ∈ F, H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i _hi
    exact H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc_ne_zero i
  have hs :
      ∀ i ∈ F, ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) ≠ H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc i := by
    intro i _hi
    exact H.zeroSystem.nonzero_no_collision hs_entire i
  have hlog :
      logDerivativeResponse
          (fun s' : ℂ =>
            indexedFiniteHadamardProduct H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc F s')
          ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z)
        =
      finiteHadamardRegularizedSum H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc F
        ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) :=
    logDerivativeResponse_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct
      (zeroLoc := H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc) (F := F)
      (s := ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z)) hρ hs
  rw [hlog]

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiClassicalHadamardTheorem.tendsto_finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_at_XiPullback_nonzero
statement:
theorem EntireXiClassicalHadamardTheorem.tendsto_finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_at_XiPullback_nonzero
    {ι : Type}
    (H : EntireXiClassicalHadamardTheorem ι)
    (Hbridge : EntireXiToCompletedXiLogDerivBridge)
    {z : ℂ}
    (hne : XiPullback z ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto
      (fun F : Finset ι =>
        finiteHadamardRegularizedSum H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc F
          ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z))
      Filter.atTop
      (𝓝 (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc
        ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z)))
proof:

  have hs_completed :
      completedXiFunction ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) ≠ 0 := by
    unfold XiPullback at hne

    Hbridge.entire_nonzero_of_completed_nonzero _ hs_completed

    (H.regularized_summable_at_nonzero hs_entire).hasSum
  simpa [HasSum, finiteHadamardRegularizedSum,
    hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries] using hsum

name: OverflowResidueRH.EntireXiClassicalHadamardTheorem.tendsto_finiteProductLogDeriv_at_XiPullback_nonzero
statement:
theorem EntireXiClassicalHadamardTheorem.tendsto_finiteProductLogDeriv_at_XiPullback_nonzero
    {ι : Type}
    (H : EntireXiClassicalHadamardTheorem ι)
    (Hbridge : EntireXiToCompletedXiLogDerivBridge)
    {z : ℂ}
    (hne : XiPullback z ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto
      (fun F : Finset ι =>
        logDerivativeResponse
          (fun s' : ℂ =>
            indexedFiniteHadamardProduct H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc F s')
          ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z))
      Filter.atTop
      (𝓝 (hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc
        ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z)))
proof:
:= by
  have hsum :=
    H.tendsto_finiteHadamardRegularizedSum_at_XiPullback_nonzero
      Hbridge hne
  have hs_completed :
      completedXiFunction ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) ≠ 0 := by
    unfold XiPullback at hne
    exact hne
  have hs_entire :
      entireRiemannXi ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z) ≠ 0 :=
    Hbridge.entire_nonzero_of_completed_nonzero _ hs_completed
  refine hsum.congr' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
  intro F
  exact
    (logDerivativeResponse_indexedFiniteHadamardProduct
      (zeroLoc := H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc) (F := F)
      (s := ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z))
      (by

    {ι : Type}

    {C a b z : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (hpref : H.prefactor = fun s : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * s))
    (hy : 0 < z.im)

      (fun F : Finset ι =>
        Complex.I * b
          + Complex.I *
            logDerivativeResponse
              (fun s' : ℂ =>
                indexedFiniteHadamardProduct H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc F s')
              ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z))
      Filter.atTop
      (𝓝 (logDerivativeResponse XiPullback z))
proof:
:= by

    H.tendsto_finiteProductLogDeriv_at_XiPullback_nonzero
      Hbridge hne

            + Complex.I *

          + Complex.I *
            hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc
              ((1 / 2 : ℂ) + Complex.I * z))) :=

            hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc

      logDerivativeResponse XiPullback z := by

    unfold expAffineHadamardPullbackZeroContribution
    ring
  exact htarget ▸ htotal

statement:
theorem

    {Dzero : Phase1IBP.OrderedFluctuationMeasureData}
    {ι : Type} {H : EntireXiClassicalHadamardTheorem ι}
    (Hbridge : EntireXiToCompletedXiLogDerivBridge)
    {C a b : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (hpref : H.prefactor = fun s : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * s))
    (h_Z_ge_15 : ∀ i : ℕ, (15 : ℝ) ≤ Dzero.toFluctuationMeasureData.Z i)
    (hTuring :
      ∀ {z : ℂ} {T u : ℝ},
        10 ≤ T → T ≤ 140 → 0 < z.im →
        2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T →
        T ≤ u →
        |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero 10 u|
          ≤ (slabCD T).1 * Real.log u + (slabCD T).2)
    (hHighLog :
      ∀ {z : ℂ} {T u : ℝ},
        140 ≤ T → 0 < z.im →
        2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T →
        T ≤ u →
        |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero 10 u|
          ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log u + (49 / 20 : ℝ))
    (HmidProductToChosen :
      ∀ {z : ℂ},
        (hy : 0 < z.im) →
        XiPullback z ≠ 0 →
        (hmid : ∃ T : ℝ, 10 ≤ T ∧ T ≤ 140 ∧
          2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T) →
        Tendsto
          (fun F : Finset ι =>
            expAffineHadamardFiniteProductResidualTail
              H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc b F z)
          Filter.atTop
          (𝓝
            (Classical.choose
              (XiFluctuationTailValue_exists_mid_of_turing
                Dzero 10 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
                hTuring hy hmid))))
    (HhighProductToChosen :
      ∀ {z : ℂ} {T : ℝ},
        (hT : 140 ≤ T) →
        (hy : 0 < z.im) →
        XiPullback z ≠ 0 →
        (hreg : 2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T) →
        Tendsto
          (fun F : Finset ι =>
            expAffineHadamardFiniteProductResidualTail
              H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc b F z)
          Filter.atTop
          (𝓝
            (Classical.choose
              (XiFluctuationTailValue_exists_high_of_highLog
                Dzero 10 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
                hHighLog hT hy hreg))))
    (HlowProd :
      ∀ {z : ℂ},
        lowCompactRegion z →
        XiPullback z ≠ 0 →
        LowFirstZeroGapNoAtoms Dzero →
        Tendsto
          (fun F : Finset ι =>
            expAffineHadamardFiniteProductLowTail
              H.zeroSystem.zeroLoc b F z)
          Filter.atTop
          (𝓝 (lowTailZeroContribution Dzero 10 z))) :
    CanonicalXiPullbackStieltjesSourceAFZ Dzero

:= by
  refine
    CanonicalXiPullbackStieltjesSourceAFZ.of_expAffineHadamardIdentifiedFiniteProductTails
      Hbridge hC hpref h_Z_ge_15 ?_ ?_ HlowProd
  · intro z hy hne hmid
    let Hexists :=
      XiFluctuationTailValue_exists_mid_of_turing
        Dzero 10 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hTuring hy hmid
    exact
      ⟨Classical.choose Hexists,
        Classical.choose_spec Hexists,
        HmidProductToChosen hy hne hmid⟩
  · intro z T hT hy hne hreg
    let Hexists :=
      XiFluctuationTailValue_exists_high_of_highLog
        Dzero 10 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hHighLog hT hy hreg
    exact
      ⟨Classical.choose Hexists,
        Classical.choose_spec Hexists,
        HhighProductToChosen hT hy hne hreg⟩

theorem XiPullbackAntiHerglotzTarget_of_connectedXiLogDerivHadamard_midHighResidual_lowIBP_turingEnvelopes
    (Dzero : Phase1IBP.OrderedFluctuationMeasureData)
    {C a b s₀ : ℂ} (hC : C ≠ 0)
    (hinv :
      Summable fun i : EntireXiNonzeroZeroIndex =>
        (‖concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
    {U : Set ℂ}
    (hU_open : IsOpen U)
    (hU_pre : IsPreconnected U)
    (hU_cover :
      ∀ s : ℂ,
        (∀ i : EntireXiNonzeroZeroIndex,
          s ≠ concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc i) →
          s ∈ U)
    (hxi_ne : ∀ s ∈ U, entireRiemannXi s ≠ 0)
    (hxi_log :
      ∀ s ∈ U,
        logDerivativeResponse entireRiemannXi s
          = b
            + hadamardRegularizedLogDerivSeries
                concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc s)
    (hs₀ : s₀ ∈ U)
    (hbase :
      entireRiemannXi s₀
        / ((C * Complex.exp (a + b * s₀))
            * infiniteHadamardProduct
                concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc s₀)
        = 1)
    (h_Z_ge_15 : ∀ i : ℕ, (15 : ℝ) ≤ Dzero.toFluctuationMeasureData.Z i)
    (HmidHigh :
      StieltjesMidHighTailResidualIdentityAFZ
        Dzero 10
        (expAffineHadamardPullbackZeroContribution
          concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc b))
    (HlowIBP :
      LowFiniteStieltjesIBPSourceAFZ
        Dzero 10
        (expAffineHadamardPullbackZeroContribution
          concreteEntireXiZeroSystem.zeroLoc b))
    (hTuring :
      ∀ {z : ℂ} {T u : ℝ},
        10 ≤ T → T ≤ 140 → 0 < z.im →
        2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T →
        T ≤ u →
        |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero 10 u|
          ≤ (slabCD T).1 * Real.log u + (slabCD T).2)
    (hHighLog :
      ∀ {z : ℂ} {T u : ℝ},
        140 ≤ T → 0 < z.im →
        2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T →
        T ≤ u →
        |Phase1IBP.finiteFluctuationPrimitive Dzero 10 u|
          ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log u + (49 / 20 : ℝ)) :
    XiPullbackAntiHerglotzTarget
proof:
:= by
  let Hhad :
      EntireXiClassicalHadamardTheorem EntireXiNonzeroZeroIndex :=
    EntireXiClassicalHadamardTheorem.of_canonicalZeros_expAffine_connectedXiLogDeriv_invSqSummable_normExhaustion
      hC hinv hU_open hU_pre hU_cover hxi_ne hxi_log hs₀ hbase
  have hpref :
      Hhad.prefactor = fun s : ℂ => C * Complex.exp (a + b * s) := rfl
  have HmidHigh' :
      StieltjesMidHighTailResidualIdentityAFZ
        Dzero 10
        (expAffineHadamardPullbackZeroContribution
          Hhad.zeroSystem.zeroLoc b) := by
    exact HmidHigh
  have HlowIBP' :
      LowFiniteStieltjesIBPSourceAFZ
        Dzero 10
        (expAffineHadamardPullbackZeroContribution
          Hhad.zeroSystem.zeroLoc b) := by
    exact HlowIBP
  have Hst : CanonicalXiPullbackStieltjesSourceAFZ Dzero :=
    CanonicalXiPullbackStieltjesSourceAFZ.of_expAffineHadamardMidHighResidualIdentity_lowIBPSource
      (H := Hhad)
      entireXiToCompletedXiLogDerivBridge
      hC
      hpref
      h_Z_ge_15
      HmidHigh'
      HlowIBP'
  exact
    XiPullbackAntiHerglotzTarget_of_sourceCanonicalXiPullbackStieltjesSource_turingEnvelopes
      Dzero h_Z_ge_15 Hst hTuring hHighLog

  · intro hρA

name: OverflowResidueRH.ClosedFormDominatedBySmoothTail.closes_hclosed_via_model_decomp
statement:
theorem ClosedFormDominatedBySmoothTail.closes_hclosed_via_model_decomp
    (Q : ClosedFormDominatedBySmoothTail)
    (P : SmoothTailRationalMarginBound)
    (h_z : Q.z = P.z) (h_T : Q.T = P.T)
    (cloud : ℂ → ℂ) (model : ℂ → ℂ)
    (decomp : model Q.z = cloud Q.z + P.densityTail P.z)
    (cloudAntiAt : (cloud Q.z).im ≤ 0) :
    closedFormSErrorBoundCD Q.C Q.D Q.z.im Q.T ≤ -(model Q.z).im
proof:
:= by
  have step1 :
      closedFormSErrorBoundCD Q.C Q.D Q.z.im Q.T
        ≤ smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs Q.z.re Q.z.im Q.T := Q.hdom
  have step2 :
      smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs P.z.re P.z.im P.T
        ≤ -(P.densityTail P.z).im := P.lower_le_tail
  
  have h_eq : smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs Q.z.re Q.z.im Q.T
            = smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs P.z.re P.z.im P.T := by
    rw [h_z, h_T]
  have step3 :
      -(P.densityTail P.z).im ≤ -(model Q.z).im := by
    rw [decomp, Complex.add_im]
    linarith
  linarith [step1, step2.trans step3, h_eq]

name: OverflowResidueRH.smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs_ge_geometric
statement:
theorem smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs_ge_geometric
    {x y T : ℝ}
    (hT : 2 * Real.pi ≤ T)
    (hy : 0 < y)
    (hadapt : 2 * (1 + |x| + y) ≤ T) :
    (2 / 5) * zeroDensityRho T * y / T
      ≤ smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs x y T
proof:
:= by
  unfold smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs
  
  have hρ_nn : 0 ≤ zeroDensityRho T := zeroDensityRho_nonneg_of_ge_two_pi hT
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hT_nn : 0 ≤ T := le_of_lt hT_pos
  have hy_nn : 0 ≤ y := le_of_lt hy
  have hx_nn : 0 ≤ |x| := abs_nonneg x
  
  have hx_le : |x| ≤ T / 2 := by linarith
  have hy_le : y ≤ T / 2 := by linarith
  
  have h_tmx_ge_half : T / 2 ≤ T - |x| := by linarith
  have h_tmx_pos : 0 < T - |x| := by linarith
  have h_tmx_nn : 0 ≤ T - |x| := le_of_lt h_tmx_pos
  have h_tpx_pos : 0 < T + |x| := by linarith
  have h_tpx_nn : 0 ≤ T + |x| := le_of_lt h_tpx_pos
  have h_tmx_le_T : T - |x| ≤ T := by linarith
  
  have h_denom1_pos : 0 < (T - |x|)^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  have h_denom2_pos : 0 < (T + |x|)^2 + y^2 := by positivity
  
  have h_term2_nn :
      0 ≤ y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2) :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hy_nn h_tpx_nn) (le_of_lt h_denom2_pos)
  
  have h_num_ge : y * (T / 2) ≤ y * (T - |x|) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_tmx_ge_half hy_nn
  
  have h_tmx_sq_le : (T - |x|)^2 ≤ T^2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ h_tmx_nn h_tmx_le_T 2
  have hy_sq_le : y^2 ≤ T^2 / 4 := by
    have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ hy_nn hy_le 2
    calc y^2 ≤ (T / 2)^2 := h
      _ = T^2 / 4 := by ring
  have h_denom1_le : (T - |x|)^2 + y^2 ≤ (5 / 4) * T^2 := by
    have : T^2 + T^2 / 4 = (5 / 4) * T^2 := by ring
    linarith [h_tmx_sq_le, hy_sq_le]
  
  have h_term1_ge_raw :
      y * (T / 2) / ((5 / 4) * T^2)
        ≤ y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2) := by
    apply div_le_div₀
    · exact mul_nonneg hy_nn h_tmx_nn
    · exact h_num_ge
    · exact h_denom1_pos
    · exact h_denom1_le
  
  have h_simp :
      y * (T / 2) / ((5 / 4) * T^2) = 2 * y / (5 * T) := by
    have hT_ne : T ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hT_pos
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [h_simp] at h_term1_ge_raw
  
  have h_sum_ge :
      2 * y / (5 * T)
        ≤ y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2)
            + y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2) := by
    linarith
  
  have h_mul_le :
      zeroDensityRho T * (2 * y / (5 * T))
        ≤ zeroDensityRho T *
            (y * (T - |x|) / ((T - |x|)^2 + y^2)
              + y * (T + |x|) / ((T + |x|)^2 + y^2)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_ge hρ_nn
  
  have h_eq :
      (2 / 5) * zeroDensityRho T * y / T
        = zeroDensityRho T * (2 * y / (5 * T)) := by
    have hT_ne : T ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hT_pos
    field_simp
  rw [h_eq]
  exact h_mul_le

name: OverflowResidueRH.simpleCloudSum_ge_const_bound
statement:
theorem simpleCloudSum_ge_const_bound
    (zeros : List ℝ) (x y x_max y_max : ℝ)
    (hx_sq : x^2 ≤ x_max^2) (hy_sq : y^2 ≤ y_max^2) (hy : 0 < y) :
    2 * y * (zeros.map fun g => 1 / (x_max^2 + g^2 + y_max^2)).sum
      ≤ simpleCloudSum zeros x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold simpleCloudSum
  induction zeros with
  | nil => simp
  | cons g rest ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    
    
    have h_den_pos : 0 < x^2 + g^2 + y^2 := by positivity
    have h_den_le : x^2 + g^2 + y^2 ≤ x_max^2 + g^2 + y_max^2 := by linarith
    have h_term : 1 / (x_max^2 + g^2 + y_max^2) ≤ 1 / (x^2 + g^2 + y^2) :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le h_den_pos h_den_le
    have hy_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * y := by linarith
    have h_term_mul : 2 * y * (1 / (x_max^2 + g^2 + y_max^2))
                      ≤ 2 * y * (1 / (x^2 + g^2 + y^2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_term hy_nn
    
    have h_distrib_left :
        2 * y * (1 / (x_max^2 + g^2 + y_max^2)
            + (List.map (fun g => 1 / (x_max^2 + g^2 + y_max^2)) rest).sum)
          = 2 * y * (1 / (x_max^2 + g^2 + y_max^2))
            + 2 * y * (List.map (fun g => 1 / (x_max^2 + g^2 + y_max^2)) rest).sum := by
      ring
    have h_two_y_div :
        2 * y * (1 / (x^2 + g^2 + y^2)) = 2 * y / (x^2 + g^2 + y^2) := by
      field_simp
    have h_two_y_div_max :
        2 * y * (1 / (x_max^2 + g^2 + y_max^2))
          = 2 * y / (x_max^2 + g^2 + y_max^2) := by
      field_simp
    rw [h_distrib_left]
    have h_ih := ih
    linarith [h_term_mul, h_two_y_div, h_two_y_div_max]

name: OverflowResidueRH.cloudPlusRationalLB_le_negIm_model
statement:
theorem cloudPlusRationalLB_le_negIm_model
    (M : CloudDensityTailModelDecomposition)
    {z : ℂ} {T : ℝ}
    (hT : 2 * Real.pi ≤ T) (hy : 0 < z.im)
    (hreg : 2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T)
    (h_cloud_im :
      -(cloudModel M.zeros z).im = cloudImNegSum M.zeros z.re z.im) :

      + smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs z.re z.im T

        = -(cloudModel M.zeros z).im + -(M.densityTail z).im := by

name: OverflowResidueRH.cloudImNegSum_neg_x
statement:
theorem cloudImNegSum_neg_x (zeros : List ℝ) (x y : ℝ) :
    cloudImNegSum zeros (-x) y = cloudImNegSum zeros x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold cloudImNegSum
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro g _
  have h1 : ((-x) - g)^2 = (x + g)^2 := by ring
  have h2 : ((-x) + g)^2 = (x - g)^2 := by ring
  rw [h1, h2]; ring

name: OverflowResidueRH.slabPolyIneq_of_nonneg_x
statement:
theorem slabPolyIneq_of_nonneg_x
    {zeros : List ℝ} {Tmin Tmax C D : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ x y T : ℝ,
        0 ≤ x →
        Tmin ≤ T → T ≤ Tmax → 0 < y →
        2 * (1 + x + y) ≤ T →
          closedFormSErrorBoundCD C D y T
            ≤ cloudImNegSum zeros x y
              + smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs x y T) :
    SlabPolyIneq zeros Tmin Tmax C D
proof:
:= by
  intro x y T hTmin hTmax hy hreg
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · have habs : |x| = x := abs_of_nonneg hx
    rw [habs] at hreg
    exact H x y T hx hTmin hTmax hy hreg
  · push Not at hx
    have hxneg : 0 ≤ -x := by linarith
    have habs : |x| = -x := abs_of_neg hx
    rw [habs] at hreg
    have Hneg := H (-x) y T hxneg hTmin hTmax hy hreg
    
    rw [← cloudImNegSum_neg_x zeros x y,
        ← smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs_neg_x x y T]
    exact Hneg

  have h_one_sub : (-0.3 : ℝ) + 1 ≤ Real.exp (-0.3) := Real.add_one_le_exp (-0.3)

  rw [Real.exp_neg] at h_07
  have h_07_mul : (7 / 10 : ℝ) * Real.exp 0.3 ≤ 1 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_07 (le_of_lt h_exp_03_pos)

name: OverflowResidueRH.cert_9_10_real
statement:
theorem cert_9_10_real :

      9 ≤ T → T ≤ 10 → 0 < z.im →
      2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T →
        closedFormSErrorBoundCD 0 (1 / 100 : ℝ) z.im T
          ≤ -((cloudModel [] z + demoDensityTailT T z).im)
proof:
:= by
  intro z T hT9 hT10 hy hreg
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_pi_lt : Real.pi < 3.15 := Real.pi_lt_d2
  have h_pi_lt_4 : Real.pi < 4 := Real.pi_lt_four
  have hT_2pi : 2 * Real.pi ≤ T := by linarith
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hy_nn : 0 ≤ z.im := le_of_lt hy
  have h_cloud_zero : (cloudModel ([] : List ℝ) z).im = 0 := by
    simp [cloudModel]
  have htail := demoDensityTailT_neg_im T z
  have h_split :
      -((cloudModel ([] : List ℝ) z + demoDensityTailT T z).im)
        = -(cloudModel ([] : List ℝ) z).im + -(demoDensityTailT T z).im := by
    rw [Complex.add_im]; ring
  have h_log_lb := log_T_div_2pi_ge_3_10_of_ge_9 hT9
  
  have h_rho_ge : (1 / 21 : ℝ) ≤ zeroDensityRho T := by
    unfold zeroDensityRho
    have h_2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
    rw [show (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi))
          = Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) / (2 * Real.pi) by ring,
        le_div_iff₀ h_2pi_pos]
    nlinarith [h_log_lb, h_pi_lt]
  
  have h_smooth_22_15 := smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs_ge_22_15 hT_2pi hy hreg
  
  have h_smooth_linear :
      (11 / 1575 : ℝ) * z.im
        ≤ (22 / 15 : ℝ) * zeroDensityRho T * z.im / T := by
    have h_rho_nn : 0 ≤ zeroDensityRho T := zeroDensityRho_nonneg_of_ge_two_pi hT_2pi
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hT_pos]
    
    
    
    
    nlinarith [h_rho_ge, hT10, hT_pos, hy_nn,
               mul_nonneg hy_nn h_rho_nn,
               mul_nonneg hy_nn (le_of_lt hT_pos)]
  have h_smooth_lb :
      (11 / 1575 : ℝ) * z.im ≤ smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs z.re z.im T :=
    le_trans h_smooth_linear h_smooth_22_15
  
  have h_lhs_eq :
      closedFormSErrorBoundCD 0 (1/100 : ℝ) z.im T
        = 17 * z.im / (100 * T^2) := by
    unfold closedFormSErrorBoundCD
    ring
  
  have hT_sq_ge : (81 : ℝ) ≤ T^2 := by nlinarith
  have h_lhs_le : 17 * z.im / (100 * T^2) ≤ 17 * z.im / 8100 := by
    apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) (by norm_num) (by nlinarith)
  
  have h_const_step : (17 : ℝ) * z.im / 8100 ≤ 11 * z.im / 1575 := by
    rcases hy_nn.lt_or_eq with hy_pos | hy_zero
    · rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 8100) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1575)]
      nlinarith
    · rw [← hy_zero]; simp
  
  rw [h_lhs_eq, h_split, htail, h_cloud_zero]
  linarith [h_lhs_le, h_const_step, h_smooth_lb]

      nlinarith
    · rw [← hy_zero]; simp

name: OverflowResidueRH.cert_2pi_7_real
statement:
theorem cert_2pi_7_real :
    ∀ z : ℂ, ∀ T : ℝ,
      2 * Real.pi ≤ T → T ≤ 7 → 0 < z.im →
      2 * (1 + |z.re| + z.im) ≤ T →
        (T - 2 * Real.pi) * z.im / 1000
          ≤ -((cloudModel [] z + demoDensityTailT T z).im)
proof:
:= by
  intro z T hT2pi hT7 hy hreg
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_pi_lt : Real.pi < 3.15 := Real.pi_lt_d2
  have h_pi_lt_4 : Real.pi < 4 := Real.pi_lt_four
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hT_2pi_nn : 0 ≤ T - 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have hy_nn : 0 ≤ z.im := le_of_lt hy
  have h_cloud_zero : (cloudModel ([] : List ℝ) z).im = 0 := by
    simp [cloudModel]
  have htail := demoDensityTailT_neg_im T z
  have h_split :
      -((cloudModel ([] : List ℝ) z + demoDensityTailT T z).im)
        = -(cloudModel ([] : List ℝ) z).im + -(demoDensityTailT T z).im := by
    rw [Complex.add_im]; ring
  
  have h_T_2pi_div_pos : 0 < T / (2 * Real.pi) := div_pos hT_pos h_2pi_pos
  have h_log_bound : (T - 2 * Real.pi) / T ≤ Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) := by
    have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi))))
    rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log h_T_2pi_div_pos] at h
    have h_inv : (T / (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ = (2 * Real.pi) / T := by rw [inv_div]
    rw [h_inv] at h
    have h_simp : (T - 2 * Real.pi) / T = 1 - (2 * Real.pi) / T := by
      field_simp
    rw [h_simp]
    linarith
  
  have h_rho_ge :
      (T - 2 * Real.pi) / (T * (2 * Real.pi)) ≤ zeroDensityRho T := by
    unfold zeroDensityRho
    have h_step :
        (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * ((T - 2 * Real.pi) / T)
          ≤ (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * Real.log (T / (2 * Real.pi)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_log_bound (by positivity)
    have h_eq :
        (T - 2 * Real.pi) / (T * (2 * Real.pi))
          = (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) * ((T - 2 * Real.pi) / T) := by
      have hT_ne : T ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hT_pos
      have h_2pi_ne : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_2pi_pos
      rw [mul_comm T (2 * Real.pi), ← div_div]
      rw [mul_div_assoc' (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) (T - 2 * Real.pi) T]
      rw [one_div_mul_eq_div]
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_step
  have h_smooth_22_15 := smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs_ge_22_15 hT2pi hy hreg
  
  have h_smooth_linear :
      (T - 2 * Real.pi) * z.im / 1000
        ≤ (22 / 15 : ℝ) * zeroDensityRho T * z.im / T := by
    have h_chain :
        (22 / 15 : ℝ) * ((T - 2 * Real.pi) / (T * (2 * Real.pi))) * z.im / T
          ≤ (22 / 15) * zeroDensityRho T * z.im / T := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (le_of_lt hT_pos)
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hy_nn
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_rho_ge (by norm_num)
    apply le_trans _ h_chain
    
    
    have hT_sq_le : T^2 ≤ 49 := by nlinarith
    have h_15piT_le : 15 * Real.pi * T^2 ≤ 11000 := by nlinarith
    have h_prod_nn : 0 ≤ (T - 2 * Real.pi) * z.im := mul_nonneg hT_2pi_nn hy_nn
    have h_rhs_eq :
        (22 / 15 : ℝ) * ((T - 2 * Real.pi) / (T * (2 * Real.pi))) * z.im / T
          = 11 * (T - 2 * Real.pi) * z.im / (15 * Real.pi * T^2) := by
      have hT_ne : T ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hT_pos
      have h_pi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_pi_pos
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [h_rhs_eq]
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1000) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [h_15piT_le, h_prod_nn, hy_nn, hT_2pi_nn]
  have h_smooth_lb :
      (T - 2 * Real.pi) * z.im / 1000
        ≤ smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs z.re z.im T :=
    le_trans h_smooth_linear h_smooth_22_15
  rw [h_split, htail, h_cloud_zero]
  linarith [h_smooth_lb]

:= by

  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_pi_lt_4 : Real.pi < 4 := Real.pi_lt_four
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by linarith
  have hT_pos : 0 < T := by linarith
  have hy_nn : 0 ≤ y := le_of_lt hy
  have hT_2pi : 2 * Real.pi ≤ T := by linarith
  have hreg' : 2 * (1 + |x| + y) ≤ T := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hx]; exact hreg
  have hrho : ((9/25 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.pi)) ≤ zeroDensityRho T :=
    zeroDensityRho_ge_const_10_12 hT10 hT12
  have h_22_15_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 22 / 15 := by norm_num
  have h_22_15_rho_le :
      (22 / 15 : ℝ) * ((9/25 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.pi))
      ≤ (22 / 15) * zeroDensityRho T :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrho h_22_15_nn
  have hy_over_T_nn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ y / T := div_nonneg hy_nn (le_of_lt hT_pos)
  have h_chain :
      (22 / 15 : ℝ) * ((9/25 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.pi)) * y / T
        ≤ (22 / 15) * zeroDensityRho T * y / T := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_22_15_rho_le hy_over_T_nn
    rw [show (22 / 15 : ℝ) * ((9/25 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.pi)) * (y / T)
          = (22 / 15 : ℝ) * ((9/25 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.pi)) * y / T by ring] at this
    rw [show (22 / 15 : ℝ) * zeroDensityRho T * (y / T)
          = (22 / 15 : ℝ) * zeroDensityRho T * y / T by ring] at this
    exact this
  have h_base : (22 / 15 : ℝ) * zeroDensityRho T * y / T
                ≤ smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs x y T :=
    smoothTailRationalLowerBoundAbs_ge_22_15 hT_2pi hy hreg'
  have h_y_form : y * ((22 / 15 : ℝ) *
      ((9/25 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.pi)) / T)
      = (22 / 15 : ℝ) * ((9/25 : ℝ) / (2 * Real.pi)) * y / T := by ring
  rw [h_y_form]
  exact le_trans h_chain h_base

  have hT_ne : T ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hTpos

        ≤ y * (2 * cloudK_T zeros25ceil T + tailK_10_12 T) :=

  rw [hclosed]

    y * ((357 / 100 : ℝ) / T^2)
        ≤ y * (2 * cloudK_T zeros25ceil T + tailK_10_12 T) := hscaled
    _ = 2 * y * cloudK_T zeros25ceil T + y * tailK_10_12 T := hsplit
